FILE: .github/workflows/build-apk.yml
=================================================================================
name: Build Debug APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: gradle

      - name: Setup Android SDK packages
        run: |
          echo "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
          sdkmanager --install "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0" || true
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses || true

      - name: Make gradlew executable
        run: chmod +x ./gradlew

      - name: Run unit tests
        # Robolectric downloads its android-all jar at test time, outside
        # Gradle's cache, so a flaky Maven response fails the whole suite with
        # MavenArtifactFetcher/FileNotFoundException noise unrelated to the
        # code. Retry: the fetch is cached after the first success.
        run: |
          for i in 1 2 3; do
            if ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --stacktrace; then
              echo "unit tests passed on attempt $i"; exit 0
            fi
            echo "unit tests failed on attempt $i; retrying"
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "unit tests still failing after 3 attempts"
          exit 1

      - name: Compile on-device (instrumentation) tests
        # The androidTest source set is not built by the unit-test or
        # assembleDebug tasks, so a broken on-device test would otherwise
        # only surface when someone runs it on a real device/emulator.
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebugAndroidTest --stacktrace

      - name: Upload test reports
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: unit-test-reports
          path: app/build/reports/tests/testDebugUnitTest/

      - name: Run lint
        timeout-minutes: 15
        # Diagnostic wrapper: while lintAnalyzeDebug runs (it can hang),
        # snapshot jstack of every JVM so a hung analysis still yields the
        # spinning detector's stack in the lint-report artifact.
        run: |
          ./gradlew lintDebug --stacktrace &
          GRADLE_PID=$!
          mkdir -p lint-jstack
          for t in 60 120 180 240 300; do
            if ! kill -0 "$GRADLE_PID" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
            sleep 60
            if ! kill -0 "$GRADLE_PID" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
            for p in $(jps -q 2>/dev/null || true); do
              jstack "$p" > "lint-jstack/jstack-${t}s-p${p}.txt" 2>&1 || true
            done
          done
          wait "$GRADLE_PID"

      - name: Print lint errors
        if: failure()
        run: |
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          t = ET.parse('app/build/reports/lint-results-debug.xml')
          for issue in t.getroot().iter('issue'):
              if issue.get('severity') == 'Error':
                  locs = [l.get('file', '') + ':' + l.get('line', '?')
                          for l in issue.iter('location')]
                  print(issue.get('id'), '|', issue.get('message', '')[:160])
                  for l in locs:
                      print('   at', l)
          EOF

      - name: Upload lint report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lint-report
          path: |
            app/build/reports/lint-results-debug.html
            app/build/reports/lint-results-debug.xml
            lint-jstack/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Build Debug APK
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: List APK output
        if: always()
        run: ls -lh app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ || echo "No APK dir found"

      - name: Upload Debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-debug
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Build Release App Bundle (.aab)
        env:
          TAKEONE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TAKEONE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          TAKEONE_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.TAKEONE_KEY_ALIAS }}
          TAKEONE_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TAKEONE_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: ./gradlew bundleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Release App Bundle (.aab)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-release-bundle
          path: app/build/outputs/bundle/release/*.aab
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # The interesting regressions in this app (RecyclerView stable-id swaps,
  # the conversion service queue, the streaming encoder handoff) only show up
  # on a device, so the instrumentation suite runs here too.
  device-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: gradle

      - name: Setup Android SDK packages
        run: |
          sdkmanager --install "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0" || true
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses || true

      - name: Make gradlew executable
        run: chmod +x ./gradlew

      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm

      - name: Run instrumentation tests on emulator
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          target: aosp_atd
          arch: x86_64
          profile: Nexus 6
          disable-animations: true
          emulator-options: -no-window -no-snapshot -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-boot-anim -camera-back none
          script: |
            adb emu avd hostmicon
            adb emu avd rewindaudio || true
            adb shell settings put global stay_on_while_plugged_in 3
            adb shell input keyevent 82 || true
            ./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest --stacktrace

      - name: Summarise instrumentation results
        if: always()
        run: |
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import glob, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          total = failed = skipped = 0
          for p in glob.glob('app/build/outputs/androidTest-results/connected/debug/*.xml'):
              r = ET.parse(p).getroot()
              total += int(r.get('tests', 0))
              failed += int(r.get('failures', 0)) + int(r.get('errors', 0))
              skipped += int(r.get('skipped', 0))
              for tc in r.iter('testcase'):
                  for x in list(tc):
                      if x.tag in ('failure', 'error'):
                          print('FAIL:', tc.get('classname', '').split('.')[-1],
                              '::', tc.get('name'), '::', (x.get('message') or '')[:200])
          print('device tests:', total, 'failures:', failed, 'skipped:', skipped)
          EOF

      - name: Upload instrumentation reports
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: device-test-reports
          path: app/build/outputs/androidTest-results/connected/

FILE: .github/workflows/fx-verify.yml

name: FX Parameter Verification

# Exhaustive verification of the effects rack:
#   params        - the runtime parameter inventory (and a drift guard)
#   dsp-matrix    - one job per effect: every parameter rendered off-device
#   fx-ui-device  - one job per effect: the real UI driven on an emulator,
#                   screen-recorded, screenshots at every parameter value
#   format-matrix - the uploaded clip converted into every container
#   analyze       - merges everything into one report

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      smoke_only:
        description: 'Run only the single-effect smoke check (validates capture)'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      skip_dsp:
        description: 'Skip the off-device parameter matrix'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      skip_device:
        description: 'Skip the emulator sweep and the format matrix'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      keep_all_wavs:
        description: 'Upload every rendered WAV from the DSP matrix (large)'
        type: boolean
        default: false
  push:
    branches: [verify/fx-matrix]
    paths:
      - 'app/src/**'
      - 'tools/fxverify/**'
      - '.github/workflows/fx-verify.yml'

concurrency:
  group: fx-verify-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  APP_ID: com.takeone.studio.debug

jobs:
  params:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: gradle
      - name: Setup Android SDK packages
        run: |
          sdkmanager --install "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0" || true
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses || true
      - name: Inventory every effect parameter
        run: |
          chmod +x ./gradlew
          ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*FxParamInventoryTest' --stacktrace
      - name: Check the workflow matrix against the catalog
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --quiet numpy
          python3 tools/fxverify/selftest.py
          python3 tools/fxverify/check_drift.py
      - name: Upload inventory
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-params
          path: app/build/fxverify/params/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: gradle
      - name: Setup Android SDK packages
        run: |
          sdkmanager --install "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0" || true
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses || true
      - name: Build the app and instrumentation APKs
        run: |
          chmod +x ./gradlew
          ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest --stacktrace
      - name: Upload APKs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-apks
          path: |
            app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
            app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/app-debug-androidTest.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  dsp-matrix:
    needs: params
    if: ${{ !inputs.skip_dsp && !inputs.smoke_only }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 40
      matrix:
        effect: [noise, deess, comp, hpf, presence, warmth, gate, limiter,
                 eq6, geq, fcurve, basstreble, highpass, lowpass, notch, shelf,
                 classic, amplify, normalize, loudness, dyncomp, mbcomp,
                 bricklim, gateexp, deesssplit, autoduck, specnr, declick,
                 clipfix, repair, dehum, plosive, reverb, multidelay, echo,
                 stereoimg, distort, phaser, chorus, tremolo, wah, vocoder,
                 changepitch, tempo, speedpitch, slidestretch, paulstretch,
                 fade, timeline, truncsil, spectraledit, generator]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: gradle
      - name: Setup Android SDK packages
        run: |
          sdkmanager --install "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0" || true
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses || true
      - name: Render every parameter of ${{ matrix.effect }}
        env:
          FX_EFFECT: ${{ matrix.effect }}
        run: |
          chmod +x ./gradlew
          # Robolectric fetches its android-all jar at test time, outside the
          # Gradle cache; retry as the repo's other test steps do.
          for i in 1 2 3; do
            if ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*FxParamMatrixDumpTest' --stacktrace; then
              echo "shard $FX_EFFECT passed on attempt $i"; exit 0
            fi
            echo "shard $FX_EFFECT failed on attempt $i; retrying"
            sleep 15
          done
          exit 1
      - name: Measure the renders
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --quiet numpy
          python3 tools/fxverify/analyze.py --cases "app/build/fxverify/${{ matrix.effect }}" --compact
      - name: Upload metrics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-metrics-${{ matrix.effect }}
          path: |
            app/build/fxverify/${{ matrix.effect }}/verdicts.json
            app/build/fxverify/${{ matrix.effect }}/metrics.json
            app/build/fxverify/${{ matrix.effect }}/cases.json
            app/build/fxverify/${{ matrix.effect }}/anomalies/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Upload every render
        if: ${{ always() && inputs.keep_all_wavs }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-renders-${{ matrix.effect }}
          path: |
            app/build/fxverify/${{ matrix.effect }}/wet/
            app/build/fxverify/${{ matrix.effect }}/dry/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  fx-ui-device:
    needs: [params, build]
    # Emulator jobs are opt-in, as in verify.yml: a push runs the JVM tiers only.
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && !inputs.skip_device && !inputs.smoke_only }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 40
      matrix:
        effect: [noise, deess, comp, hpf, presence, warmth, gate, limiter,
                 eq6, geq, fcurve, basstreble, highpass, lowpass, notch, shelf,
                 classic, amplify, normalize, loudness, dyncomp, mbcomp,
                 bricklim, gateexp, deesssplit, autoduck, specnr, declick,
                 clipfix, repair, dehum, plosive, reverb, multidelay, echo,
                 stereoimg, distort, phaser, chorus, tremolo, wah, vocoder,
                 changepitch, tempo, speedpitch, slidestretch, paulstretch,
                 fade, timeline, truncsil, spectraledit, generator]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-apks
          path: apks
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
      - name: Setup Android SDK packages
        run: |
          sdkmanager --install "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0" || true
          yes | sdkmanager --licenses || true
      - name: Enable KVM
        run: |
          echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
          sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
          sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm
      - name: Drive ${{ matrix.effect }} through the real UI
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 35
          target: google_apis
          arch: x86_64
          profile: Nexus 5X
          disable-animations: true
          emulator-options: -no-window -no-snapshot -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-boot-anim -camera-back none -memory 3072
          script: |
            adb shell settings put global stay_on_while_plugged_in 3
            # A background launcher ANR freezes the whole display and every
            # capture with it, so keep system error dialogs off the screen and
            # stop the launcher we never use (the test starts the activity).
            adb shell settings put global hide_error_dialogs 1
            adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0
            adb shell am force-stop com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher || true
            adb shell input keyevent 82 || true
            adb install -r -t "$(find apks -name 'app-debug.apk' | head -1)"
            adb install -r -t "$(find apks -name 'app-debug-androidTest.apk' | head -1)"
            mkdir -p fx-out
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do adb wait-for-device; timeout 1200 adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.example.hello.FxPanelDialDeviceTest -e fxEffect "${{ matrix.effect }}" "$(adb shell pm list instrumentation | grep AndroidJUnitRunner | head -1 | sed 's/.*instrumentation://; s/ .*//' | tr -d '\r')" > fx-out/instrumentation.txt 2>&1; grep -q "OK (" fx-out/instrumentation.txt && break; echo "attempt $attempt did not report OK"; sleep 15; done
            cat fx-out/instrumentation.txt
            adb pull "/sdcard/Android/data/$APP_ID/files/takes/fxverify-${{ matrix.effect }}" fx-out/ || true
            adb shell logcat -d -v brief > fx-out/logcat-full.txt || true
            grep -q "OK (" fx-out/instrumentation.txt || { echo "instrumentation did not report OK"; exit 1; }
      - name: Upload the sweep evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-video-${{ matrix.effect }}
          path: fx-out/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  format-matrix:
    needs: build
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && !inputs.skip_device && !inputs.smoke_only }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Convert the uploaded clip into every container
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:

          target: google_apis
          arch: x86_64
          profile: Nexus 5X
          disable-animations: true
          emulator-options: -no-window -no-snapshot -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-boot-anim -camera-back none -memory 3072
          script: |
            adb shell settings put global stay_on_while_plugged_in 3
            # A background launcher ANR freezes the whole display and every
            # capture with it, so keep system error dialogs off the screen and
            # stop the launcher we never use (the test starts the activity).
            adb shell settings put global hide_error_dialogs 1
            adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0
            adb shell am force-stop com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher || true
            adb install -r -t "$(find apks -name 'app-debug.apk' | head -1)"

            mkdir -p fx-formats

            cat fx-formats/instrumentation.txt

            grep -q "OK (" fx-formats/instrumentation.txt || { echo "instrumentation did not report OK"; exit 1; }
      - name: Verify the containers independently
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg
          python3 -m pip install --quiet numpy
          python3 tools/fxverify/verify_formats.py --dir fx-formats/fxverify-formats
      - name: Upload the converted files and the verification
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-formats
          path: fx-formats/fxverify-formats/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  smoke:
    needs: build
    if: ${{ inputs.smoke_only }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:

        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2

          arch: x86_64

            adb shell am force-stop com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher || true
            adb install -r -t "$(find apks -name 'app-debug.apk' | head -1)"
            adb install -r -t "$(find apks -name 'app-debug-androidTest.apk' | head -1)"
            mkdir -p smoke
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do adb wait-for-device; timeout 1200 adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.example.hello.FxPanelDialDeviceTest -e fxEffect hpf "$(adb shell pm list instrumentation | grep AndroidJUnitRunner | head -1 | sed 's/.*instrumentation://; s/ .*//' | tr -d '\r')" > smoke/instrumentation.txt 2>&1; grep -q "OK (" smoke/instrumentation.txt && break; echo "attempt $attempt did not report OK"; sleep 15; done
            cat smoke/instrumentation.txt
            adb pull "/sdcard/Android/data/$APP_ID/files/takes/fxverify-hpf" smoke/ || true
            adb shell ls -l "/sdcard/Android/data/$APP_ID/files/takes/fxverify-hpf" > smoke/files.txt 2>&1 || true
            cat smoke/files.txt
            adb shell logcat -d -v brief > smoke/logcat-full.txt || true
            grep -E "FATAL|ANR in|ActivityManager: Start proc" smoke/logcat-full.txt | tail -20 || true
            grep -q "OK (" smoke/instrumentation.txt || { echo "smoke check failed"; exit 1; }
      - name: Upload the smoke evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-smoke
          path: smoke/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  analyze:
    needs: [params, dsp-matrix, fx-ui-device, format-matrix]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Download every artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
      - name: Install analysis dependencies
        run: python3 -m pip install --quiet numpy
      - name: Verify the applied audio per parameter
        run: python3 tools/fxverify/verify_applied.py --root artifacts
      - name: Merge the verdicts into one report
        run: |
          mkdir -p fx-report
          python3 tools/fxverify/aggregate_report.py --root artifacts \
            --report fx-report/REPORT.md --json-out fx-report/combined.json || true
          cat fx-report/REPORT.md
      - name: Upload the report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fx-report
          path: fx-report/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

FILE: .github/workflows/verify.yml

name: Parallel Verify

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      device_tests:
        description: 'Run emulator instrumentation tests'
        type: boolean
        default: false
  push:
    branches-ignore: [master, main]
    paths:
      - 'app/src/**'
      - 'app/build.gradle*'
      - 'gradle/**'
      - '.github/workflows/verify.yml'

concurrency:
  group: verify-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# AGENTS.md — TakeOne (Android audio editor)

This file gives coding agents the context needed to work on this repository.

## Project overview
- Android app (TakeOne studio): audio recording/editing, DSP/FX pipeline, teleprompter, conversion/export.
- Single Gradle module `:app`. Package `com.example.hello`. applicationId `com.takeone.studio`.
- Min SDK 24, target/compile SDK 35. Java 17. Gradle 8.7, AGP 8.6.1.

## Layout
- `app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/` — 100+ Java sources (DSP processors, EditEngine, DspChain, Recording/Conversion services, UI).
- `app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/` — 66+ Robolectric/JUnit unit tests.
- `app/src/androidTest/java/com/example/hello/` — 28 instrumentation tests.
- `app/schemas/` — exported Room schema.
- Workflows: `.github/workflows/{verify,build-apk,fx-verify}.yml`.

## Build & test (run on GitHub runners — host here is aarch64, cannot run x86_64 tools)
- Always invoke Gradle via `sh gradlew` (noexec filesystem).
- Unit (Robolectric): `sh gradlew testDebugUnitTest`
- Instrumentation (emulator): `sh gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest` (needs device/emulator + KVM).
- Compile all: `sh gradlew :app:compileDebugJavaWithJavac :app:compileDebugUnitTestJavaWithJavac :app:compileDebugAndroidTestJavaWithJavac`
- Debug APK: `sh gradlew assembleDebug` -> `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`
- Lint: `sh gradlew lintDebug`
- Release bundle: `sh gradlew bundleRelease` (needs keystore secrets).

## CI
- `verify.yml`: compiles all source sets; runs unit tests sharded across 6 GitHub runners (Robolectric tests included); optional emulator job via workflow_dispatch.
- `build-apk.yml`: unit tests + compile androidTest + lint + assembleDebug + device tests on emulator + bundleRelease.
- `fx-verify.yml`: FX param inventory/matrix + device sweep.
- Robolectric tests run on ubuntu-latest GitHub runners (no emulator needed). Emulator tests run on GitHub runners with KVM via reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner.

## Conventions
- Java 17; follow existing processor patterns (AudioProcessor, FxParameter, DspChain).
- No comments unless requested. Match existing code style.
- Tests: JUnit 4 + Robolectric (sdk 34) for UI; plain JUnit for DSP.
- Never commit unless user asks; co-author trailer required.

## Taste
- See `.commandcode/taste/taste.md` for learned preferences (verification must be evidence-based end-to-end).

## Notes
- Environment is aarch64; local gradle execution fails on x86_64 aapt2. Use CI.
- Large test matrices parallelise on GitHub Actions (~40 concurrent jobs available).

========================================================================================
TAKEONE STUDIO — DEEP AUDIT, BUG FIXES & FEATURE IMPLEMENTATION REPORT
========================================================================================

SUMMARY OF CHANGES
------------------
1. Default FX Preset Enabled on First Opening (`DspChain.java`, `StudioFragment.java`):
   - In `DspChain.Config.load(Context)`, when no saved slot configuration exists yet, the 4 starter slots (`NOISE_SUPPRESSION`, `DE_ESSER`, `COMPRESSOR`, `LOW_CUT_HPF`) are now seeded with `enabled = true`, `activePresetId` is set to `Preset.VOICE_POLISH.id`, and legacy fields are synced via `syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots()`.
   - In `StudioFragment`, added `fxEverOpened` tracking so opening the FX panel immediately arms the active default preset for live preview and bake on Save, while untouched dry recordings continue to use fast-path `StreamingEncoder` adoption.

2. Disabled Undo Popup (`StudioFragment.java`):
   - Removed `OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Edit undone");` from `StudioFragment.performStudioUndo()` and kept `performStudioRedo()` silent.

3. Robust 10-Step Undo & 10-Step Redo (`EditEngine.java`, `WaveformView.java`, `StudioFragment.java`, `fragment_studio.xml`, `ic_edit_redo.xml`):
   - Increased `EditEngine.MAX_UNDO_STEPS` from 3 to 10.
   - Added a bounded 10-step `redoStack` to `EditEngine.UndoJournal` (`canRedo()`, `redo(File)`, `undoDepth()`, `redoDepth()`, `clearRedo()`) that automatically clears when a new edit snapshot is recorded.
   - Upgraded `WaveformView` with 10-step `undoPeakStack`/`undoFramesPerBar` and `redoPeakStack`/`redoFramesPerBar` deques (`popUndoPeaks()`, `popRedoPeaks()`, `discardTopUndoPeaks()`), fixing an unbounded memory leak on `undoFramesPerBar`.
   - Added `ic_edit_redo.xml` and `@+id/btnEditRedo` to both portrait and landscape `fragment_studio.xml` layouts and wired `performStudioRedo()` and button state styling in `StudioFragment`.

4. Small Centered Popups with Large Rounded Corners (`bg_modal.xml`, `dialog_result.xml`, `OptionsSheet.java`, `TeleDialogs.java`, `StudioFragment.java`):
   - Increased `@drawable/bg_modal` corner radius from `22dp` to `28dp`.
   - Updated `layout/dialog_result.xml` from `match_parent` width to a compact `wrap_content` pill layout with `240dp` max text width.
   - Updated `OptionsSheet.styleAsTopPopup(Dialog)` to use `WRAP_CONTENT` width and height with `Gravity.CENTER` instead of stretching across `dm.widthPixels - dp(ctx, 24)` at the top of the screen.
   - Tightened centered modal width caps in `OptionsSheet.styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth`, `TeleDialogs.style`, and `StudioFragment.showEffectDetailModal`.

5. Deep File-by-File Audit Fixes (Bugs, Edge Cases & Dead Code):
   - `app/src/main/res/mipmap/ic_launcher_round.xml`: Removed trailing non-XML plain text after `</layer-list>` that broke XML parsing.
   - `app/src/main/res/layout-land/fragment_studio.xml`: Replaced dead, unwired `fxPreviewBtn`/`fxApplyBtn` buttons in the landscape FX panel with `@+id/fxHint` matching portrait.
   - `MultibandCompressorProcessor.java`: Replaced independent LP/HP subtraction (`mid = buf - low - high`) with a complementary cascade split (`midHigh = buf - low`, `mid = midHigh - high`) to eliminate IIR phase-cancellation notches.
   - `DeEsserProcessor.java`: Removed `splitHigh` and computed the complementary high band as `buf[idx + c] - lowBand[f * ch + c]` to eliminate the 180° phase-cancellation notch at the crossover frequency.
   - `ClipFixProcessor.java`: Clamped `start - 3` and `end + 1` slope indices (`Math.max(0, start - 3)`, `Math.min(frames - 1, end + 1)`) to prevent `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` when clipping starts at frame 1 or 2.
   - `StereoImagingProcessor.java`: Promoted mono Haas delay buffer (`haasHist`, `haasPos`) to persistent instance fields reset in `reset()`, and removed the duplicate `/ 100f` division on `centerPct` that made stereo Center Isolation 100x too weak.
   - `VocoderProcessor.java`: Moved filter `setSections(...)` initialization from `processInPlace()` into `rebuild()` so filter states are not wiped at every block boundary.
   - `TruncateSilenceProcessor.java`: Removed unused `ByteArrayOutputStream` allocation and redundant byte-buffer conversions, copying `float[]` slices directly.
   - `DspChain.java` & `RawFloatPlayer.java`: Fixed `reset()` / `prepareOffline()` call order so two-pass processors (`Normalize`, `LoudnessNormalization`, `Amplify`) keep their scanned state; scaled offline tail samples by `mix`; guarded `if (!stop) framePos = limitFrame;` on offline preview pause; removed dead `isLegacyProcessor`.
   - `FormatConverter.java`, `FadeProcessor.java`, `StftProcessor.java`: Added `if (pct != lastPct)` progress throttling across all encoders in `FormatConverter` and removed unused fields (`lastCbAt`, `regionFrames`, `frameCounter`, `mag`, `phase`).

FILE 1/25: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/DspChain.java
TITLE: Enable Default FX Preset (Voice Polish) on First Open, Fix Offline Region Render & Remove Dead Code
========================================================================================
EXPLANATION OF CHANGES:
1. Default FX Preset Enabled on First Open (`Config.load(Context)`):
   - Previously, when `dsp_slots_json` was absent on first install/launch, `Config.load()` defaulted `activePresetId` to `Preset.CLEAR_ALL.id` and seeded the 4 starter slots (`NOISE_SUPPRESSION`, `DE_ESSER`, `COMPRESSOR`, `LOW_CUT_HPF`) with `enabled = false`.
   - Changed the default `activePresetId` when `slotsJson == null` to `Preset.VOICE_POLISH.id`, seeded all 4 starter slots with `enabled = true`, and called `c.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots()` so the FX rack opens with all 4 default effects enabled (`Effects Rack · 4 on`, `Preset: Voice Polish ▾`).
   - Preserved `new DspChain.Config()` (the no-arg constructor) as inactive so unit tests expecting an empty default constructor continue to pass.

2. Offline + In-Place Region Rendering Fixes (`renderRegionOfflineAndInPlace`):
   - Previously, `prepareOffline(...)` was called BEFORE `reset()`, which immediately wiped the two-pass analysis state (`scanned = false`) on `NormalizeProcessor`, `LoudnessNormalizationProcessor`, and `AmplifyProcessor`. Swapped the order so `reset()` runs before `prepareOffline(...)`.
   - When an offline processor lengthened a region (`next.length > buf.length`) with a partial wet/dry mix (`mix < 0.999f`), samples beyond `common = Math.min(buf.length, next.length)` were left unscaled at 100% wet instead of `next[i] *= mix`. Added tail scaling for `[common, next.length)`.
   - Replaced the manual per-processor loop over `rack.processors()` with `rack.processInPlace(block, n)` so automatic safety limiting and shared tone slot mix rules are respected.

3. Dead Code Removal:
   - Removed the unused private helper `isLegacyProcessor(AudioProcessor)`.

FILE 2/25: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/EditEngine.java
TITLE: Upgrade UndoJournal to 10-Step Undo and 10-Step Redo
========================================================================================
EXPLANATION OF CHANGES:
1. Increased Undo Capacity to 10 Steps:
   - Changed `MAX_UNDO_STEPS` from `private static final int MAX_UNDO_STEPS = 3;` to `public static final int MAX_UNDO_STEPS = 10;`.

2. Added Bounded 10-Step Redo Stack (`UndoJournal`):
   - Added `private final Deque<File> redoStack = new ArrayDeque<>();`.
   - Added `canRedo()`, `undoDepth()`, `redoDepth()`, `clearRedo()`, and `redo(File raw)`.
   - Updated `canUndo()` and `canRedo()` to prune any stale/non-existent snapshot files from the head of their respective deques before checking `!isEmpty()`.
   - Updated `recordSnapshot(File raw)` to call `clearRedo()` whenever a brand-new edit is recorded so stale redo states cannot be applied on top of a new timeline branch.
   - Updated `undo(File raw)` to snapshot the current pre-undo `raw` file into a `.redo` file on `redoStack` (bounded to 10 steps) before restoring the `.undo` snapshot.
   - Implemented `redo(File raw)` to snapshot the current `raw` file onto the undo `stack` (bounded to 10 steps) before restoring the `.redo` snapshot.
   - Updated `clear()` to clear and delete both undo and redo snapshot files.

+        /** Re-applies the most recently undone edit over `raw` and pushes current state to undo. */
+        public synchronized boolean redo(File raw) {
+            if (!canRedo() || raw == null) return false;
+            File redoSnap = redoStack.pollFirst();
+            if (redoSnap == null || !redoSnap.exists()) return false;
+
+            File undoSnap = null;
+            if (wouldRecord(raw)) {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                undoDir.mkdirs();
+                while (stack.size() >= MAX_UNDO_STEPS) {
+                    File oldUndo = stack.removeLast();
+                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                    oldUndo.delete();
+                }
+                undoSnap = new File(undoDir,
+                        raw.getName() + "." + (++seq) + ".undo");
+                try (FileInputStream curIn = new FileInputStream(raw);
+                     FileOutputStream undoOut = new FileOutputStream(undoSnap)) {
+                    byte[] buf = new byte[CHUNK_BYTES];
+                    int n;
+                    while ((n = curIn.read(buf)) > 0) undoOut.write(buf, 0, n);
+                } catch (Exception ignored) {
+                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                    undoSnap.delete();
+                    undoSnap = null;
+                }
+            }
+
+            try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(redoSnap);
+                 RandomAccessFile out = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw")) {
+                out.setLength(0);
+                byte[] buf = new byte[CHUNK_BYTES];
+                int n;
+                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
+                if (undoSnap != null) {
+                    stack.addFirst(undoSnap);
+                }
+                return true;
+            } catch (Exception e) {
+                if (undoSnap != null) {
+                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                    undoSnap.delete();
+                }
+                return false;
+            } finally {
+                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                redoSnap.delete();
+            }
+        }
+
         public synchronized void clear() {
             while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
                 // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                 stack.pollFirst().delete();
             }
+            clearRedo();
         }

FILE 13/25: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/MultibandCompressorProcessor.java
TITLE: Fix 3-Band Crossover Phase Cancellation Bug
========================================================================================
EXPLANATION OF CHANGES:
1. Complementary Cascade Crossover Split:
   - Previously, `low` and `high` were filtered independently from `buf` using 4th-order Butterworth IIR filters and subtracted from `buf` (`mid[i] = buf[i] - low[i] - high[i]`). Because 4th-order IIR filters introduce a 360° phase rotation around their cutoff frequencies, subtracting `low` and `high` from the zero-phase dry `buf` created a faulty `mid` band that did not complement the phase-shifted `low` and `high` bands when band gains/compressors differed.
   - Replaced with a complementary cascade split (`midHigh[i] = buf[i] - low[i]`, then filter `midHigh` through `highPass` to obtain `high`, and `mid[i] = midHigh[i] - high[i]`), guaranteeing `low + mid + high == buf` to within floating-point precision (`< 1e-7`).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
UNIFIED DIFF:
--- a/app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/MultibandCompressorProcessor.java
+++ b/app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/MultibandCompressorProcessor.java
@@ -140,13 +140,15 @@
         float gHighLin = Dsp.dbToLin(highGain.getFloat());
 
         float[] low = new float[frames * ch];
+        float[] midHigh = new float[frames * ch];
         float[] high = new float[frames * ch];
         float[] mid = new float[frames * ch];
         System.arraycopy(buf, 0, low, 0, low.length);
         lowPass.process(low, frames, ch);
-        System.arraycopy(buf, 0, high, 0, high.length);
+        for (int i = 0; i < midHigh.length; i++) midHigh[i] = buf[i] - low[i];
+        System.arraycopy(midHigh, 0, high, 0, high.length);

-        for (int i = 0; i < mid.length; i++) mid[i] = buf[i] - low[i] - high[i];
+        for (int i = 0; i < mid.length; i++) mid[i] = midHigh[i] - high[i];

FILE 14/25: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/DeEsserProcessor.java
TITLE: Fix Split-Band Crossover Notch Bug
========================================================================================
EXPLANATION OF CHANGES:
1. Complementary High-Band Extraction:
   - Previously, `DeEsserProcessor` used a 2nd-order Butterworth low-pass (`splitLow`) and a 2nd-order Butterworth high-pass (`splitHigh`) at the same frequency and summed `lowBand + highBand * g`. Because 2nd-order Butterworth LP and HP outputs are 180° out of phase at the crossover frequency, summing them at `g = 1.0` (0 dB reduction) cancelled the signal at the crossover frequency!
   - Removed `splitHigh` and computed the high band complementarily as `float high = buf[idx + c] - low;`, eliminating the crossover notch completely.

FILE: Takeone Conversion Pipeline Fixes.txt
=================================================================================
================================================================================
TAKEONE AUDIO CONVERSION PIPELINE FIXES & DEFAULT MUSIC FORMAT UPDATE (WAV 32-BIT)
================================================================================

SUMMARY OF CHANGES:
1. Default Music Recording Format Changed from FLAC to WAV 32-bit (WAV32):
   - app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/SaveFormat.java
     SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset) now resolves to SaveFormat.WAV32
     whenever preset.autoSavesLossless is true (RecordPreset.MUSIC).
   - app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/RecordPreset.java
     Updated Javadoc for autoSavesLossless to document WAV 32-bit float.
   - app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml
     Updated preset_music_sub subtitle from '(FLAC)' to '(WAV 32-bit)'.
   - Updated SaveFormatTest.java and EncodeFormatsTest.java expectations.

2. Fixed Replace-While-Converting Bug in Conversion Pipeline:
   - app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/ConversionJobs.java
     * Registers NEG_TO_RAW immediately inside enqueue() and sweep() so in-flight
       and recently-completed jobs are always resolvable by negative takeId even
       before LibraryFragment.convertingCards() refreshes.
     * Sets job.title to replaceTitle when enqueueing a replacement conversion.
     * In dispatchSave(): immediately cancels any active conversion via
       cancelForReplace(ctx, replaceTakeId) (deleting its .raw.wav, .part, and
       .conv.json sidecar), and if replaceTakeId > 0 (either replacing an
       existing take or a conversion that finished while the user was editing
       in Studio), immediately calls TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace()
       before starting the new conversion and resets replaceTakeId = -1L.
   - app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/TakesRepository.java
     * Added deleteImmediateForReplace(long targetId) to immediately remove the
       previous Take entry from memory/Room and hard-delete its backing audio
       file on disk before the new conversion starts.
   - app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/FormatConverter.java
     * Removed the 250ms / pct != lastPct callback throttling in toWav16,
       toWav24, toWav32, encodeMuxed (toM4a/toOpus), and toFlac so progress
       callbacks fire on every chunk (~16k-64k frames), allowing
       ConversionService to abort a cancelled conversion immediately within
       milliseconds and free WORKER_SERIAL_LOCK for the new conversion.
   - app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/ConversionService.java
     * Checks job.cancelled on every chunk callback while deduplicating UI/notif
       updates to percentage changes (pct != lastReportedPct[0]).
   - app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/StudioFragment.java & RecordingService.java
     * Updated inline-adoption callbacks after dispatchSave() to use replaceTitle
       directly since dispatchSave() has already deleted the replaced file.
   - app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/ConversionJobsTest.java
     * Added unit test verifying immediate cancellation/deletion on replace.

+        }

+            if (r1.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r1.job.jobId, true);
+            engine.abortAndDelete();
+        }
+
+        // Case 2: Original conversion finished (or was already a finished file)
+        // before user clicked Replace -> must delete old file & Take immediately
+        // before the new conversion runs!
+        File finishedFile = new File(dir, "orig_done_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
+        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(finishedFile, "rw")) {
+            w.write(new byte[2048]);
+        }

+                finishedFile, 1000, "Finished Take", "M4A");

+                finishedSyntheticId, "Finished Take");

+                    TakesRepository.find(oldTake.id));

+                    finishedFile.exists());

+        } finally {

+            ConversionJobs.forgetCompletion(finishedRawPath);
+            engine.abortAndDelete();
+        }

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.MediaCodecInfo;
import android.media.MediaCodecList;
import android.media.MediaFormat;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Container/codec the user wants the finished take written in.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Audio is always captured to a crash-safe 32-bit float WAV on disk first;
 * this choice only governs the final conversion step after the user stops.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;WAV16/WAV24/WAV32 are written by our own pure-Java writer (always available);
 * M4A uses the baseline AAC encoder mandated by the Android CDD. The other
 * formats (FLAC, Opus, AMR-NB, AMR-WB) are gated by a one-shot
 * {@link MediaCodecList} probe so the picker never offers an encoder the
 * device does not actually have.
 */
public enum SaveFormat {
    AUTO("auto", R.string.save_auto, R.string.save_auto_sub, "AUTO"),
    M4A("m4a", R.string.save_m4a, R.string.save_m4a_sub, "M4A"),
    WAV16("wav16", R.string.save_wav16, R.string.save_wav16_sub, "WAV"),
    WAV24("wav24", R.string.save_wav24, R.string.save_wav24_sub, "WAV24"),
    WAV32("wav32", R.string.save_wav32, R.string.save_wav32_sub, "WAV32"),
    FLAC("flac", R.string.save_flac, R.string.save_flac_sub, "FLAC"),
    OPUS("opus", R.string.save_opus, R.string.save_opus_sub, "OPUS"),
    AMR_NB("amr_nb", R.string.save_amr_nb, R.string.save_amr_nb_sub, "AMR"),
    AMR_WB("amr_wb", R.string.save_amr_wb, R.string.save_amr_wb_sub, "AMR-WB");

    public final String id;
    public final int titleRes;
    public final int subRes;
    /** Short badge stored on the library card ("M4A", "WAV", "FLAC", …). */
    public final String badge;

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY = "save_format";
    private static volatile SaveFormat cached;
    private static final Map<SaveFormat, Boolean> AVAIL = new HashMap<>();

    SaveFormat(String id, int titleRes, int subRes, String badge) {
        this.id = id;
        this.titleRes = titleRes;
        this.subRes = subRes;
        this.badge = badge;
    }

    public static SaveFormat of(String id) {
        if (id != null) {
            for (SaveFormat f : values()) {
                if (f.id.equalsIgnoreCase(id)) return f;
            }
        }
        return AUTO;
    }

    public static SaveFormat load(Context ctx) {
        SaveFormat c = cached;
        if (c != null) return c;
        try {
            String raw = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getString(KEY, AUTO.id);
            c = of(raw);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            c = AUTO;
        }
        cached = c;
        return c;
    }

    public void save(Context ctx) {
        cached = this;
        try {
            ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putString(KEY, id).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** True if this device can actually encode this format right now. */
    public synchronized boolean available(Context ctx) {
        switch (this) {
            case AUTO:
            case M4A:
            case WAV16:
            case WAV24:
            case WAV32:
                return true;
            case OPUS:
                // MediaMuxer only gained OGG/WEBM Opus support across the
                // board on API 29; older builds have the codec but no muxer.
                if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 26) return false;
                break;
            case FLAC:
            case AMR_NB:
            case AMR_WB:
                break;
        }
        Boolean hit = AVAIL.get(this);
        if (hit != null) return hit;
        boolean ok = hasEncoder(encoderMime());
        AVAIL.put(this, ok);
        return ok;
    }

    /**
     * Proves the device can actually instantiate and configure the encoder
     * at our recording geometry — not merely that it lists the MIME in
     * {@link MediaCodecList}. Some builds advertise a codec that then throws
     * on {@code configure()} for 48 kHz stereo.
     */
    private boolean hasEncoder(String mime) {
        if (mime == null) return true;
        try {
            MediaCodecList list = new MediaCodecList(MediaCodecList.ALL_CODECS);
            boolean listed = false;
            for (MediaCodecInfo info : list.getCodecInfos()) {
                if (!info.isEncoder()) continue;
                for (String t : info.getSupportedTypes()) {
                    if (mime.equalsIgnoreCase(t)) {
                        listed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (listed) break;
            }
            if (!listed) return false;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public String encoderMime() {
        switch (this) {
            case M4A: return MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC;
            case FLAC: return "audio/flac";
            case OPUS: return "audio/opus";
            case AMR_NB: return "audio/3gpp";
            case AMR_WB: return "audio/amr-wb";
            default: return null;
        }
    }

    /** File extension (without dot) for a resolved format. */
    public String extension() {
        switch (this) {
            case WAV16:
            case WAV24:
            case WAV32: return "wav";
            case AMR_NB:
            case AMR_WB: return "3gp";
            case FLAC: return "flac";
            case OPUS:
                return android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29 ? "opus" : "webm";
            case M4A:
            case AUTO:
            default: return "m4a";
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resolves {@link #AUTO} against the active preset:
     * &lt;ul&gt;
     *   &lt;li&gt;Voice Memo / Podcast — speech, where AAC is transparent at a
     *       tenth of the size, so Auto picks {@link #M4A}.</li>
     *   &lt;li&gt;Music — unprocessed stereo master where any lossy pass
     *       discards real detail, so Auto saves lossless 32-bit float WAV
     *       ({@link #WAV32}).</li>
     * &lt;/ul&gt;
     * Any explicit choice is returned unchanged.
     */
    public SaveFormat effective(RecordPreset preset) {
        if (this != AUTO) return this;
        if (preset != null && preset.autoSavesLossless) {
            return WAV32;
        }
        return M4A;
    }

    /**
     * Next format to switch to when an encoder for {@code this} crashes the
     * process mid-save. Walks down to a simpler encoder and finally to
     * {@link #WAV16}, which is our own pure-Java writer (no MediaCodec) and
     * cannot die natively. Null when already at the bottom. FLAC falls back
     * to WAV24, never to lossy AAC: a lossless save must not silently
     * degrade when pure-Java WAV24 is available.
     */
    public SaveFormat fallbackAfterCrash() {
        switch (this) {
            case OPUS:
            case AMR_NB:
            case AMR_WB:
                return M4A;
            case FLAC:
                return WAV24;
            case M4A:
            case AUTO:
                return WAV16;
            case WAV16:
            case WAV24:
            case WAV32:
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Approximate bytes written per minute of audio when saved in this
     * format under the given preset. Constant-rate estimates are exact;
     * FLAC is a content-dependent guess (see {@link #FLAC_RATIO}).
     */
    public long bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset preset) {
        SaveFormat eff = effective(preset);
        int ch = preset != null ? Math.max(1, preset.channels) : 2;
        int br = preset != null ? preset.aacBitrate : 128000;
        long sr = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
        switch (eff) {
            case WAV16:
                return sr * ch * 2 * 60;
            case WAV24:
                return sr * ch * 3 * 60;
            case WAV32:
                return sr * ch * 4 * 60;
            case AMR_NB:
                // 12.2 kbps mono regardless of preset.
                return 12200L * 60 / 8;
            case AMR_WB:
                // 23.85 kbps mono regardless of preset.
                return 23850L * 60 / 8;
            case OPUS: {
                // FormatConverter clamps Opus to [32k, 256k].
                long clamped = Math.max(32000, Math.min(256000,
                        br <= 0 ? 128000 : br));
                return clamped * 60 / 8;
            }
            case FLAC:
                // Android's FLAC encoder takes 16-bit PCM input; typical
                // music compresses to ~55% of that.
                return (long) (sr * ch * 2 * 60 * FLAC_RATIO);
            case M4A:
            case AUTO:
            default: {
                long clamped = Math.max(64000, Math.min(320000, br));
                return clamped * 60 / 8;
            }
        }
    }

    /** Lossless-compression ratio used for the FLAC estimate. */
    private static final double FLAC_RATIO = 0.55d;

    /** True when the size estimate is content-dependent rather than fixed-rate. */
    public boolean sizeIsApproximate() {
        return this == FLAC || this == AUTO;
    }

    /**
     * Short human label for the format picker ("~1.9 MB/min", "17 MB/min").
     * Prefixed with {@code ~} when the rate is content-dependent so variable
     * formats never look like a promise.
     */
    public String sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset preset) {
        long bpm = bytesPerMinute(preset);
        double mb = bpm / (1024.0 * 1024.0);
        String prefix = sizeIsApproximate() ? "~" : "";
        if (mb >= 9.95) {
            return String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%s%.0f MB/min",
                    prefix, mb);
        }
        return String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%s%.1f MB/min",
                prefix, mb);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.media.MediaRecorder;

/**
 * The three recording presets. Each one is a distinct capture geometry —
 * mono vs stereo, processed mic vs unprocessed — so none overlaps another.
 * Containers live in {@link SaveFormat}: "Raw Studio" as a preset was just
 * Music-plus-WAV, and "Voice vs Standard" was one mono capture at two
 * bitrates, so both collapsed away. Everything is locked to 48&nbsp;kHz so
 * AudioFlinger never has to resample, and Music uses the UNPROCESSED source
 * to bypass AGC ducking and effects.
 */
public enum RecordPreset {
    MEMO("memo", R.string.preset_memo, R.string.preset_memo_sub,
            "MEMO 96k", 1, 96000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC),
    PODCAST("podcast", R.string.preset_podcast, R.string.preset_podcast_sub,
            "POD 256k", 2, 256000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC),
    MUSIC("music", R.string.preset_music, R.string.preset_music_sub,
            "MUS 320k", 2, 320000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.UNPROCESSED, true);

    public final String id;
    public final int titleRes;
    public final int subRes;
    /** Short badge text, e.g. "MUS 320k". */
    public final String shortLabel;
    /** 1 = mono, 2 = stereo (before any mono fallback). */
    public final int channels;
    /** AAC bitrate for the save conversion. */
    public final int aacBitrate;
    public final int audioSource;
    /**
     * True when the capture should be kept lossless by default. Only the
     * unprocessed stereo master qualifies: AAC is transparent for speech but
     * discards real detail in a music take, so AUTO saves Music as 32-bit
     * float WAV (WAV32) rather than squeezing it through a lossy codec.
     */
    public final boolean autoSavesLossless;

    RecordPreset(String id, int titleRes, int subRes, String shortLabel,
                 int channels, int aacBitrate, int audioSource) {
        this(id, titleRes, subRes, shortLabel, channels, aacBitrate,
                audioSource, false);
    }

    RecordPreset(String id, int titleRes, int subRes, String shortLabel,
                 int channels, int aacBitrate, int audioSource,
                 boolean autoSavesLossless) {
        this.id = id;
        this.titleRes = titleRes;
        this.subRes = subRes;
        this.shortLabel = shortLabel;
        this.channels = channels;
        this.aacBitrate = aacBitrate;
        this.audioSource = audioSource;
        this.autoSavesLossless = autoSavesLossless;
    }

    public boolean wantsStereo() {
        return channels == 2;
    }

    public boolean wantsUnprocessed() {
        return audioSource == MediaRecorder.AudioSource.UNPROCESSED;
    }

    public static RecordPreset of(String id) {
        if (id != null) {
            for (RecordPreset p : values()) {
                if (p.id.equals(id)) return p;
            }
            // Retired presets map to their closest surviving capture.
            if ("voice".equals(id) || "standard".equals(id)) return MEMO;
            if ("raw".equals(id)) return MUSIC;
        }
        return MEMO;
    }

    public static RecordPreset[] all() {
        return values();
    }

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY = "rec_preset";

    public static RecordPreset load(Context ctx) {
        try {
            SharedPreferences p = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            return of(p.getString(KEY, MEMO.id));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return MEMO;
        }
    }

    public void save(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putString(KEY, id).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}
