package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Foreground host for an ongoing take: keeps capture alive when the app is
 * backgrounded, owns audio-focus interruption handling (pause, never
 * auto-resume) and exposes one clean persistent notification — name, preset,
 * live timer plus pause/resume, Save and Cancel actions that work without
 * opening the app.
 */
public class RecordingService extends Service {

    public static final String ACTION_START =
            "com.example.hello.REC_START";
    public static final String ACTION_TOGGLE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_TOGGLE";
    public static final String ACTION_SAVE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_SAVE";
    public static final String ACTION_CANCEL =
            "com.example.hello.REC_CANCEL";
    public static final String ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF =
            "com.example.hello.action.RESTORE_NOTIF";

    public static final String EXTRA_FORMAT = "format";

    /** Broadcast when a background save/cancel finishes. */
    public static final String BROADCAST_DONE =
            "com.example.hello.REC_DONE";
    public static final String EXTRA_OK = "ok";
    public static final String EXTRA_MESSAGE = "message";
    public static final String EXTRA_TITLE = "title";
    public static final String EXTRA_KIND = "kind"; // "save" or "cancel"

    private static final String CHANNEL = "takeone_recording";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 41;
    /** Focus losses inside this window after a (re)start are spurious. */
    private static final long FOCUS_GRACE_MS = 1200;

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private boolean ticking;
    private boolean busy; // a save/cancel is running
    private int convertingPct = -1;
    private long lastToggleAt;
    private long lastPctPush;
    private long captureStartedAt;

    private static volatile RecordingService activeInstance;

    private PendingIntent cachedContentIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedToggleIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedSaveIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedCancelIntent;
    private PendingIntent cachedRestoreIntent;

    private String lastNotifTitle = "";
    private String lastNotifText = "";
    private Boolean lastNotifPaused = null;
    private int lastNotifPct = -2;
    private long lastChronoBaseMs = 0L;

    private AudioManager audioManager;
    private AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener focusListener;

    public static void start(Context ctx, String presetId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_START);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT, presetId);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            } else {
                ctx.startService(i);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            try {
                ctx.startService(i);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static void stopService(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.stopService(new Intent(ctx, RecordingService.class));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Called by RecordingEngine whenever capture starts, pauses, resumes,
     * finalizes, clears, aborts, or renames, so the notification updates
     * immediately without waiting for the next tick.
     */
    public static void onRecordingStateChanged() {
        RecordingService s = activeInstance;
        if (s != null) {
            s.handler.post(() -> s.refreshNotif(true));
        }
    }

    public static boolean isRunning(Context ctx) {
        // Best-effort: true while the engine holds an active capture session.
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        return e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        super.onCreate();
        activeInstance = this;
        ensureChannel();
        audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        initPendingIntents();
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent == null) {
            // System-restarted. START_NOT_STICKY means this should not happen,
            // but never re-enter startForeground() from here: a restart
            // racing the save could hit the Android 14+ rule that a
            // microphone FGS may not start from the background, and a
            // startForegroundService() that never promotes itself is fatal
            // to the process.
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        String a = intent.getAction();
        if (ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF.equals(a)) {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (e.hasSession() && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                    || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED)) {
                startFg();
                refreshNotif(true);
            } else {
                stopSelf();
            }
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        if (ACTION_START.equals(a)) {
            String preset = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_FORMAT);
            if (preset != null) RecordPreset.of(preset).save(this);
            captureStartedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            registerFocus();
            startFg();
            startTick();
        } else if (ACTION_TOGGLE.equals(a)) {
            doToggle();
        } else if (ACTION_SAVE.equals(a)) {
            doSave();
        } else if (ACTION_CANCEL.equals(a)) {
            doCancel();
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        if (activeInstance == this) activeInstance = null;
        stopTick();
        abandonFocus();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    // ---- audio focus: interruptions pause, never auto-resume ----

    private android.media.AudioFocusRequest focusReq26;

    /**
     * True when a cellular or VoIP call (ringing, dialing, or in-call) is active.
     * Prevents resuming AudioRecord while Android's telephony policy mutes the mic.
     */
    public static boolean isCallActive(Context ctx) {
        if (ctx == null) return false;
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) ctx.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am != null) {
                int mode = am.getMode();
                if (mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_CALL
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION
                        || mode == AudioManager.MODE_RINGTONE) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            android.telephony.TelephonyManager tm =
                    (android.telephony.TelephonyManager) ctx.getSystemService(
                            Context.TELEPHONY_SERVICE);
            if (tm != null) {
                int callState = tm.getCallState();
                if (callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_RINGING
                        || callState == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Requests audio focus and returns true only if granted.
     * If a call or exclusive speaker session rejects focus, returns false.
     */
    private boolean registerFocus() {
        try {
            if (isCallActive(this)) return false;
            if (audioManager == null) {
                audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            }
            if (audioManager == null) return true;
            if (focusListener == null) {
                focusListener = focus -> {
                    if (focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT
                            || focus == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK) {
                        if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - captureStartedAt
                                < FOCUS_GRACE_MS) {
                            return;
                        }
                        handler.post(() -> {
                            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
                            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                                e.pauseCapture();
                                abandonFocus();
                                boolean call = isCallActive(RecordingService.this);
                                toast(getString(call
                                        ? R.string.msg_paused_call
                                        : R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                                refreshNotif(true);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                };
            }
            int res;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                focusReq26 = new android.media.AudioFocusRequest.Builder(
                        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
                        .setAudioAttributes(new android.media.AudioAttributes.Builder()
                                .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(focusListener, handler)
                        .build();
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusReq26);
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                res = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(focusListener,
                        AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN);
            }
            return res == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    private void abandonFocus() {
        try {
            if (audioManager != null) {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && focusReq26 != null) {
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(focusReq26);
                    focusReq26 = null;
                } else if (focusListener != null) {
                    //noinspection deprecation
                    audioManager.abandonAudioFocus(focusListener);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        focusListener = null;
    }

    // ---- actions (debounced: one tap, one transition) ----

    private void doToggle() {
        if (busy) return;
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (now - lastToggleAt < 400) return;
        lastToggleAt = now;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        try {
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                e.pauseCapture();
                abandonFocus();
            } else if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED) {
                if (isCallActive(this)) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_call_active));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                captureStartedAt = now;
                if (!registerFocus()) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.msg_speaker_engaged));
                    refreshNotif(true);
                    return;
                }
                e.resumeCapture(getApplicationContext(),
                        RecordPreset.load(this).audioSource);
            } else {
                return;
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            toast(getString(R.string.msg_need_mic));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            toast(getString(R.string.couldnt_save));
            refreshNotif(true);
            return;
        }
        refreshNotif(true);
    }

    private void doSave() {
        if (busy) return;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        if (!e.hasSession()) {
            stopSelf();
            return;
        }
        if (e.isSaving()) return;
        e.setSaving(true);
        busy = true;
        convertingPct = 0;
        lastPctPush = 0;
        refreshNotif();
        new Thread(() -> {
            boolean ok;
            String msg;
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            try {
                Context appCtx = getApplicationContext();
                if (e.isInSubSession()) {
                    // The notification saved while a Select & Replace
                    // sub-session was open: splice first, then save the parent
                    // instead of exporting only the temporary snippet.
                    boolean commitSub = e.rawFile != null
                            && RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(e.rawFile) > 0;
                    e.exitSelectAndReplaceSubSession(commitSub, null);
                }
                RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
                SaveFormat save = SaveFormat.load(this);
                // NEW-06 fix: honour and clear stashed EditLink when saving
                // an edited take from the notification action.
                String rawPath = e.rawFile != null
                        ? e.rawFile.getAbsolutePath() : null;
                long replaceId = -1;
                String replaceTitle = null;
                if (EditLink.matches(appCtx, rawPath)) {
                    replaceId = EditLink.id(appCtx);
                    replaceTitle = EditLink.title(appCtx);
                }
                ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                        appCtx, preset, save, this::setPct,
                        replaceId, replaceTitle);
                EditLink.clear(appCtx);
                if (r.adopted) {
                    String rt = replaceTitle != null
                            && !replaceTitle.isEmpty()
                            ? replaceTitle : r.title;
                    TakesRepository.addRecording(r.file, r.durationMs,
                            rt, r.label);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.convert_done_msg, r.title,
                            r.label);
                } else {
                    // Handed to the conversion service; this service is done.
                    ConversionService.startJob(appCtx, r.job.jobId);
                    e.clearSession();
                    ok = true;
                    msg = getString(R.string.conv_bg_toast);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                ok = false;
                msg = getString(R.string.convert_failed_msg, title);
            }
            final boolean done = ok;
            final String text = msg;
            final String t = title;
            handler.post(() -> {
                e.setSaving(false);
                try {
                    convertingPct = -1;
                    refreshNotif();
                    Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, done);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "save");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, t);
                try {
                    // Explicit package: stays inside the app, satisfies
                    // UnsafeImplicitIntentLaunch, same delivery as before.
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                convertingPct = -1;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
                } catch (Exception ex) {
                    CrashLog.breadcrumb(getApplicationContext(),
                            "service completion FAILED: " + ex);
                    try {
                        stopSelf();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            });
        }).start();
    }

    private void doCancel() {
        if (busy) return;
        if (RecordingEngine.get().isSaving()) return;
        busy = true;
        new Thread(() -> {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
            boolean ok = e.abortAndDelete();
            EditLink.clear(getApplicationContext());
            final String text = ok
                    ? getString(R.string.delete_success_one, title)
                    : getString(R.string.delete_failed_msg);
            handler.post(() -> {
                toast(text);
                Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_DONE);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, ok);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_KIND, "cancel");
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_MESSAGE, text);
                b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, title);
                try {
                    b.setPackage(getPackageName());
                    sendBroadcast(b);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                busy = false;
                abandonFocus();
                try {
                    stopForeground(true);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                stopSelf();
            });
        }).start();
    }

    // ---- notification: one clean standard layout ----

    private void ensureChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;
        try {
            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(
                    CHANNEL, getString(R.string.notif_channel),
                    NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ch.setDescription(getString(R.string.notif_channel_desc));
            nm.createNotificationChannel(ch);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void startFg() {
        lastNotifTitle = "";
        lastNotifText = "";
        lastNotifPaused = null;
        lastNotifPct = -2;
        Notification n = buildNotif();
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n,
                        ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
            }
            return;
        } catch (Exception typed) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "typed startForeground failed: " + typed);
        }
        // Untyped retry: a service launched with startForegroundService()
        // must reach the foreground within ~5s or the system kills the app,
        // so it is always worth attempting the permissive call.
        try {
            startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "startForeground failed: " + e);
            try {
                stopSelf();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void refreshNotif() {
        refreshNotif(false);
    }

    private void refreshNotif(boolean force) {
        try {
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            if (!e.hasSession() && !busy) return;
            String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
            boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
            RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
            String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
            long durMs = e.durationMs();
            String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

            String title;
            String text;
            if (convertingPct >= 0) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
                text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
            } else if (paused) {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
                // Chronometer is hidden when paused, so show frozen MM:SS here.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                        + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
            } else {
                title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
                // Native Chronometer in header is the single live timer;
                // do not duplicate a second text timer in contentText.
                text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
            }

            long expectedBase = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            boolean baseDrifted = !paused && convertingPct < 0
                    && Math.abs(expectedBase - lastChronoBaseMs) > 250L;

            if (!force && !baseDrifted
                    && title.equals(lastNotifTitle)
                    && text.equals(lastNotifText)
                    && lastNotifPaused != null && lastNotifPaused == paused
                    && lastNotifPct == convertingPct) {
                return;
            }
            lastNotifTitle = title;
            lastNotifText = text;
            lastNotifPaused = paused;
            lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
            if (!paused && convertingPct < 0) {
                lastChronoBaseMs = expectedBase;
            }

            NotificationManager nm =
                    (NotificationManager) getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm != null) {
                nm.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * A single standard notification: small mic icon, "Recording — name"
     * title, "preset • live timer" text and exactly three actions. Built
     * with NotificationCompat so it renders identically (and lint-clean)
     * from API 24 up, with no custom RemoteViews for the system to duplicate.
     */
    private Notification buildNotif() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        String name = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : getString(R.string.app_name);
        boolean paused = e.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String presetTitle = getString(preset.titleRes);
        long durMs = e.durationMs();
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));

        String title;
        String text;
        if (convertingPct >= 0) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_converting, convertingPct);
            text = getString(R.string.converting_msg, saveLabel, convertingPct);
        } else if (paused) {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_paused, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel + " • "
                    + Take.formatDuration(durMs);
        } else {
            title = getString(R.string.notif_recording, name);
            text = presetTitle + " → " + saveLabel;
        }
        lastNotifTitle = title;
        lastNotifText = text;
        lastNotifPaused = paused;
        lastNotifPct = convertingPct;
        return buildNotifWith(title, text, paused, durMs);
    }

    private Notification buildNotifWith(String title, String text,
                                        boolean paused, long durMs) {
        if (cachedContentIntent == null && cachedToggleIntent == null) {
            initPendingIntents();
        }
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.load(this);
        String saveLabel = TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.load(this));
        androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL);
        b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_mic);
        // Match TakeOne brand colors: record red (#FF3B30) when active,
        // amber (#FF9F0A) when paused.
        // Tint only the icon badge and action buttons (never flood-fill the
        // card background with setColorized(true)).
        b.setColor(paused ? 0xFFFF9F0A : 0xFFFF3B30);
        b.setColorized(false);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setCategory(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_SERVICE);
        b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setOngoing(true);
        b.setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        b.setSilent(true);
        if (cachedRestoreIntent != null) {
            b.setDeleteIntent(cachedRestoreIntent);
        }
        // Native SystemUI Chronometer ticks in real time on the system UI
        // thread without requiring sub-second Binder IPC updates.
        if (convertingPct < 0 && !paused) {
            long base = System.currentTimeMillis() - Math.max(0L, durMs);
            lastChronoBaseMs = base;
            b.setWhen(base);
            b.setShowWhen(true);
            b.setUsesChronometer(true);
        } else {
            b.setShowWhen(false);
            b.setUsesChronometer(false);
        }
        if (cachedContentIntent != null) {
            b.setContentIntent(cachedContentIntent);
        }
        if (convertingPct < 0) {
            b.addAction(0,
                    paused ? getString(R.string.notif_resume)
                            : getString(R.string.notif_pause),
                    cachedToggleIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_save),
                    cachedSaveIntent);
            b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.notif_cancel),
                    cachedCancelIntent);
        } else {
            b.setProgress(100, Math.max(0, Math.min(100, convertingPct)), false);
        }
        try {
            Notification n = b.build();
            n.flags |= Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT
                    | Notification.FLAG_NO_CLEAR
                    | Notification.FLAG_FOREGROUND_SERVICE;
            return n;
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return new Notification();
        }
    }

    private void initPendingIntents() {
        Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
        open.putExtra("open_studio", true);
        open.setAction("com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO");
        try {
            cachedContentIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 10, open,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            cachedContentIntent = null;
        }
        cachedToggleIntent = action(ACTION_TOGGLE, 21);
        cachedSaveIntent = action(ACTION_SAVE, 22);
        cachedCancelIntent = action(ACTION_CANCEL, 23);
        cachedRestoreIntent = action(ACTION_RESTORE_NOTIF, 24);
    }

    private PendingIntent action(String what, int code) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, RecordingService.class);
        i.setAction(what);
        try {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return PendingIntent.getService(this, code, i,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT);
        }
    }

    private void startTick() {
        if (ticking) return;
        ticking = true;
        handler.post(tick);
    }

    private void stopTick() {
        ticking = false;
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
    }

    private final Runnable tick = new Runnable() {
        @Override
        public void run() {
            if (!ticking) return;
            refreshNotif(false);
            // Align to the next whole-second boundary while recording so the
            // MM:SS readout steps in sync with the audio duration and never
            // exceeds 1 update/sec.
            RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
            long delay = 1000L;
            if (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                long rem = 1000L - (e.durationMs() % 1000L);
                delay = Math.max(200L, Math.min(1000L, rem));
            }
            handler.postDelayed(this, delay);
        }
    };

    private void setPct(int pct) {
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (pct == convertingPct) return;
        if (pct < 100 && now - lastPctPush < 500) {
            convertingPct = pct;
            return;
        }
        convertingPct = pct;
        lastPctPush = now;
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    private void toast(String text) {
        try {
            Toast.makeText(getApplicationContext(), text, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class SaveFormatTest {

    @Test
    public void ofDefaultsToAuto() {
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.of(null));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.of("nope"));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.FLAC, SaveFormat.of("flac"));
    }

    @Test
    public void autoPicksTheAppropriateContainer() {
        // Speech: AAC is transparent and far smaller — that is the point.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.PODCAST));
        // Music: an unprocessed stereo master, so Auto defaults to 32-bit
        // float WAV (WAV32).
        SaveFormat musicEff = SaveFormat.AUTO.effective(RecordPreset.MUSIC);
        assertEquals("expected WAV32 for Music preset, got " + musicEff,
                SaveFormat.WAV32, musicEff);
        // An explicit choice always wins.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A,
                SaveFormat.M4A.effective(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.effective(RecordPreset.MEMO));
    }

    @Test
    public void onlyMusicDefaultsToLossless() {
        assertTrue(RecordPreset.MUSIC.autoSavesLossless);
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.MEMO.autoSavesLossless);
        assertFalse(RecordPreset.PODCAST.autoSavesLossless);
    }

    @Test
    public void extensions() {
        assertEquals("m4a", SaveFormat.M4A.extension());
        assertEquals("wav", SaveFormat.WAV16.extension());
        assertEquals("wav", SaveFormat.WAV24.extension());
        assertEquals("wav", SaveFormat.WAV32.extension());
        assertEquals("3gp", SaveFormat.AMR_NB.extension());
        assertEquals("flac", SaveFormat.FLAC.extension());
        assertEquals(android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29
                ? "opus" : "webm", SaveFormat.OPUS.extension());
    }

    @Test
    public void alwaysAvailable() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.AUTO.available(ctx));
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.M4A.available(ctx));
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV16.available(ctx));
        // Pure-Java lossless path: never gated on a platform encoder.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV24.available(ctx));
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV32.available(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void probingNeverCrashes() {
        // Under Robolectric there are no real encoders; the point is the
        // probe degrades gracefully instead of throwing.
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        for (SaveFormat f : SaveFormat.values()) {
            f.available(ctx);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void persistRoundTrip() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        SaveFormat.OPUS.save(ctx);
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.OPUS, SaveFormat.load(ctx));
        SaveFormat.AUTO.save(ctx);
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AUTO, SaveFormat.load(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void takeSaverLabels() {
        assertEquals("M4A", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("M4A", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.PODCAST, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("WAV32", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.AUTO));
        assertEquals("WAV", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV16));
        assertEquals("WAV24", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV24));
        assertEquals("WAV32", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV32));
        assertEquals("AMR", TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.AMR_NB));
    }

    @Test
    public void wav24SurvivesItsOwnValidation() throws Exception {
        java.io.File f = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy24", ".wav");
        try {
            int frames = 480;
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wav24Header(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 3);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + frames * 2 * 3];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(f);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(f, SaveFormat.WAV24);
            // 24-bit must be understood by the duration reader too, or the
            // library and orphan adoption would show 00:00 for these files.
            assertTrue(Dsp.wavDurationMs(f) > 0);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void wav32SurvivesItsOwnValidation() throws Exception {
        java.io.File f = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy32", ".wav");
        try {
            int frames = 480;
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000,
                    (long) frames * 2 * 4);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + frames * 2 * 4];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(f);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(f, SaveFormat.WAV32);
            assertEquals(10L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(f));
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void storageEstimatesTrackChannelsAndClamp() {
        // WAV is exact and scales with the preset's channel count.
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(48000L * 1 * 2 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 3 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV24.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 4 * 60,
                SaveFormat.WAV32.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // Music's Opus clamps 320k -> 256k, and the estimate must match the
        // file rather than the nominal preset bitrate.
        assertEquals(256000L / 8 * 60,
                SaveFormat.OPUS.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals(320000L / 8 * 60,
                SaveFormat.M4A.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // AMR always decimates to mono, so it is preset-independent.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.AMR_NB.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC),
                SaveFormat.AMR_NB.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        // Auto reports whatever it resolves to.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO),
                SaveFormat.AUTO.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV32.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC),
                SaveFormat.AUTO.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // FLAC must actually be smaller than the PCM it replaces.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC)
                < SaveFormat.WAV16.bytesPerMinute(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
    }

    @Test
    public void sizeLabelsAreCompactAndMarkEstimates() {
        assertEquals("17 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.WAV24.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals("11 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.WAV16.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        assertEquals("0.7 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.M4A.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MEMO));
        assertEquals("0.1 MB/min",
                SaveFormat.AMR_NB.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC));
        // Content-dependent sizes are flagged so they never read as exact.
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.sizePerMinuteLabel(RecordPreset.MUSIC)
                .startsWith("~"));
        assertFalse(SaveFormat.WAV16.sizeIsApproximate());
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.FLAC.sizeIsApproximate());
    }

    @Test
    public void fallbackLadder() {
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.OPUS.fallbackAfterCrash());
        // FLAC must never silently degrade to lossy AAC when pure-Java WAV24
        // is available.
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV24, SaveFormat.FLAC.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.AMR_NB.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.M4A, SaveFormat.AMR_WB.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16, SaveFormat.M4A.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(SaveFormat.WAV16, SaveFormat.AUTO.fallbackAfterCrash());
        assertEquals(null, SaveFormat.WAV16.fallbackAfterCrash());
    }

    @Test
    public void validateFinalAcceptsHealthyContainers() throws Exception {
        // WAV: real header + payload.
        java.io.File wav = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".wav");
        try {
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wav16Header(1, 48000, 200);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + 200];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(wav);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(wav, SaveFormat.WAV16);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            wav.delete();
        }
        // MP4: ftyp up front, moov somewhere inside.
        java.io.File mp4 = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            byte[] body = new byte[200];
            body[4] = 'f';
            body[5] = 't';
            body[6] = 'y';
            body[7] = 'p';
            body[100] = 'm';
            body[101] = 'o';
            body[102] = 'o';
            body[103] = 'v';
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(mp4);
            try {
                w.write(body);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(mp4, SaveFormat.M4A);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            mp4.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validateFinalRejectsTornContainers() throws Exception {
        // Too small.
        java.io.File tiny = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            boolean thrown = false;
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(tiny, SaveFormat.M4A);
            } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
                thrown = true;
            }
            assertTrue(thrown);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            tiny.delete();
        }
        // ftyp present but no moov: teardown never finished.
        java.io.File torn = java.io.File.createTempFile("vfy", ".m4a");
        try {
            byte[] body = new byte[200];
            body[4] = 'f';
            body[5] = 't';
            body[6] = 'y';
            body[7] = 'p';
            java.io.FileOutputStream w = new java.io.FileOutputStream(torn);
            try {
                w.write(body);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            boolean thrown = false;
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(torn, SaveFormat.M4A);
            } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
                thrown = true;
            }
            assertTrue(thrown);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            torn.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void encoderMimes() {
        assertEquals(android.media.MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC,
                SaveFormat.M4A.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/flac", SaveFormat.FLAC.encoderMime());

        assertEquals("audio/3gpp", SaveFormat.AMR_NB.encoderMime());
        assertEquals("audio/amr-wb", SaveFormat.AMR_WB.encoderMime());
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV16.encoderMime() == null);
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.WAV24.encoderMime() == null);
        assertTrue(SaveFormat.AUTO.encoderMime() == null);
    }

    @Test

        for (SaveFormat f : SaveFormat.values()) {

        }
    }

    @Test

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Job registry rules: one job per raw, stable card ids, cancel cleanup, and
 * the startup sweep resurrecting interrupted jobs while dropping garbage.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConversionJobsTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void takeIdsAreNegativeAndStable() {
        ConversionJob a = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob b = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("take id must be negative", a.takeId() < 0);
        assertEquals("take id must be stable", a.takeId(), b.takeId());
        ConversionJob c = new ConversionJob("job-2", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("different jobs must differ", c.takeId() != a.takeId());
    }

    @Test
    public void sidecarRoundTrip() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobtest.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-9", "Title",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.progress = 42;
        job.framesDone = 100000;
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals("job-9", back.jobId);
            assertEquals("Title", back.title);
            assertEquals(42, back.progress);
            assertEquals(100000, back.framesDone);
            assertEquals(1, back.channels);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void enqueueDedupesAndCancelCleans() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Job Test", 2);
        try {
            ConversionJob first = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            ConversionJob second = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            assertTrue("same raw must return the same job",
                    first.jobId.equals(second.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar missing", first.sidecar().exists());
            assertTrue("not active",
                    ConversionJobs.forRaw(engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())
                            != null);
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.cancel(first.jobId, false));
            assertNull("still active after cancel",
                    ConversionJobs.get(first.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar survived cancel", !first.sidecar().exists());
        } finally {
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsAndCleans() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "sweep.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-sweep", "Sweep",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.write();
        File orphanPart = new File(dir, "orphan.wav.part");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(orphanPart, "rw").close();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean found = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep")) found = true;
            }
            assertTrue("interrupted job was not resurrected", found);
            assertTrue("orphan part survived", !orphanPart.exists());
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
            assertTrue("raw survived cancel", !raw.exists());
        } finally {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                orphanPart.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            job.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void replaceLineageSurvivesSidecar() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobreplace.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-rep", "Edit",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.replaceTakeId = 12345L;
        job.replaceTitle = "Original";
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals(12345L, back.replaceTakeId);
            assertEquals("Original", back.replaceTitle);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
        // Old sidecars without the keys default to "no lineage".
        ConversionJob plain = new ConversionJob("job-plain", "T",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertEquals(-1L, plain.replaceTakeId);
        assertNull(plain.replaceTitle);
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsEveryJob() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw1 = new File(dir, "sweep1.wav");
        File raw2 = new File(dir, "sweep2.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw1, "rw").close();
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw2, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob j1 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-1", "One",
                raw1.getAbsolutePath(), raw1.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob j2 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-2", "Two",
                raw2.getAbsolutePath(), raw2.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        j1.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        j2.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
        j1.write();
        j2.write();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean f1 = false, f2 = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-1")) f1 = true;
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-2")) f2 = true;
            }
            assertTrue("first job lost", f1);
            assertTrue("second job lost (only first resumed)", f2);
        } finally {
            try {
                raw1.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                raw2.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            j1.deleteSidecar();
            j2.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-1", true);
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-2", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void cancelUnknownReturnsFalse() {
        assertFalse(ConversionJobs.cancel("no-such-job", false));
        assertFalse(ConversionJobs.cancelByTakeId(-123456789L, false));
    }

    @Test

    @Test
    public void dispatchSaveReplaceCancelsActiveConversionAndDeletesPreviousFileImmediately()
            throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // Case 1: Original take is still converting when user edits and chooses Replace
        File origRaw = new File(dir, "orig_conv_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(origRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 48000L * 2 * 4));
            w.write(new byte[48000 * 2 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJob origJob = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), origRaw,
                "Original Take", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
        long origSyntheticId = origJob.takeId();
        assertTrue("original job must be active",
                ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId) != null);

        // User edits in Studio and chooses a different format (OPUS) + Replace
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r1 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.OPUS, null,
                origSyntheticId, "Original Take");
        try {
            assertNull("original conversion must be cancelled immediately",
                    ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId));
            assertFalse("original raw must be deleted immediately",
                    origRaw.exists());
            assertFalse("original sidecar must be deleted immediately",
                    origJob.sidecar().exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must start immediately", r1.job);
            assertEquals("Original Take", r1.job.title);
            assertEquals("opus", r1.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r1.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r1.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r1.job.jobId, true);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }

        // Case 2: Original conversion finished (or was already a finished file)
        // before user clicked Replace -> must delete old file & Take immediately
        // before the new conversion runs!
        File finishedFile = new File(dir, "orig_done_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(finishedFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take oldTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                finishedFile, 1000, "Finished Take", "M4A");
        String finishedRawPath = new File(dir, "orig_done_raw.wav").getAbsolutePath();
        long finishedSyntheticId = -777777L;
        ConversionJobs.noteTakeRaw(finishedSyntheticId, finishedRawPath);
        ConversionJobs.noteCompletion(finishedRawPath, oldTake.id);

        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session 2", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r2 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.FLAC, null,
                finishedSyntheticId, "Finished Take");
        try {
            assertNull("old Take row must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    TakesRepository.find(oldTake.id));
            assertFalse("old file on disk must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    finishedFile.exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must be enqueued immediately", r2.job);
            assertEquals("Finished Take", r2.job.title);
            assertEquals("flac", r2.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r2.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r2.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r2.job.jobId, true);
            ConversionJobs.forgetCompletion(finishedRawPath);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.Log;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Runs the real encode/mux path on a real device image, one format per test
 * method. Robolectric stubs MediaCodec out, so this is the only way to see
 * which container actually works on a given Android build.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Each method is independent on purpose: a native crash in one encoder
 * kills the process and would hide the results of the rest.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class EncodeFormatsTest {

    private static final String TAG = "ENCFMT";

    private File makeFloatWav(String name) throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File f = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), name);
        int frames = 48000; // 1.0s at 48 kHz, stereo
        byte[] hdr = Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(hdr);
            float[] buf03 = new float[frames * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) {
                buf03[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.03) * 0.5f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf03, 0, buf03.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private File out(String ext) {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File f = new File(ctx.getCacheDir(), "out_" + System.nanoTime() + ext);
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void wav16() throws Exception {
        File src = makeFloatWav("wav16_in.wav");
        File dst = out(".wav");
        FormatConverter.toWav16(src, dst, null);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS wav16 bytes=" + dst.length());
        assertTrue(dst.length() > 1000);
    }

    @Test
    public void m4a() throws Exception {
        File src = makeFloatWav("m4a_in.wav");
        File dst = out(".m4a");
        FormatConverter.toM4a(src, dst, 128000, null);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS m4a bytes=" + dst.length());
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(dst, SaveFormat.M4A);
        assertTrue(dst.length() > 512);
    }

    @Test
    public void opus() throws Exception {
        File src = makeFloatWav("opus_in.wav");
        File dst = out("." + SaveFormat.OPUS.extension());
        FormatConverter.toOpus(src, dst, 128000, null);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS opus bytes=" + dst.length());
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(dst, SaveFormat.OPUS);
        assertTrue(dst.length() > 512);
    }

    @Test
    public void flac() throws Exception {
        File src = makeFloatWav("flac_in.wav");
        File dst = out(".flac");
        FormatConverter.toFlac(src, dst, null);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS flac bytes=" + dst.length());
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(dst, SaveFormat.FLAC);
        assertTrue(dst.length() > 512);
    }

    /** The full save pipeline, exactly as the save button drives it. */
    @Test
    public void fullSavePipeline() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.clearSession();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Instrumentation", 2);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        assertNotNull(raw);
        int frames = 24000;
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(w.length());
            float[] buf05 = new float[frames * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) {
                buf05[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05) * 0.4f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf05, 0, buf05.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS pipeline file=" + r.file.getName()
                + " bytes=" + r.file.length() + " dur=" + r.durationMs);
        try {
            assertTrue(r.file.exists());
        } finally {
            engine.clearSession();
            r.file.delete();
        }
    }

    /** Real 24-bit encode: our own pure-Java path, fully testable on device. */
    @Test
    public void wav24Encode() throws Exception {
        File src = makeFloatWav("wav24_in.wav");
        File dst = out(".wav");
        FormatConverter.toWav24(src, dst, null);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS wav24 bytes=" + dst.length());
        assertTrue(dst.length() > 1000);
        // 24-bit stereo 48k must be exactly 3/4 of the 32-bit float input.
        long expect = (src.length() - 44) * 3 / 4;
        assertEquals("unexpected 24-bit payload size", expect + 44,
                dst.length());
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(dst, SaveFormat.WAV24);
        // Duration must survive the 3-byte sample assembly.
        long dur = Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS wav24 duration=" + dur);
        assertTrue("duration off: " + dur, dur >= 950 && dur <= 1050);
    }

    /** WAV32 is the raw capture: header plus a byte-exact float payload. */
    @Test
    public void wav32Encode() throws Exception {
        File src = makeFloatWav("wav32_in.wav");
        File dst = out(".wav");
        FormatConverter.toWav32(src, dst, null);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS wav32 bytes=" + dst.length());
        assertEquals(src.length(), dst.length());
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(dst, SaveFormat.WAV32);
        assertArrayEquals(readAll(src), readAll(dst));
        long dur = Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst);
        Log.i(TAG, "PASS wav32 duration=" + dur);
        assertTrue("duration off: " + dur, dur >= 950 && dur <= 1050);
    }

    private static byte[] readAll(File f) throws Exception {
        java.io.RandomAccessFile r = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            byte[] out = new byte[(int) r.length()];
            r.readFully(out);
            return out;
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    /** Music + Auto must stay lossless (WAV32) and must never land on a lossy codec. */
    @Test
    public void musicAutoStaysLossless() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.clearSession();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Music Auto", 2);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        int frames = 24000;
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(w.length());
            float[] buf05 = new float[frames * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) {
                buf05[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05) * 0.4f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf05, 0, buf05.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.AUTO, null);
        Log.i(TAG, "LOSSLESS label=" + r.label + " bytes=" + r.file.length());
        try {
            assertEquals("music auto must be WAV32: " + r.label,
                    "WAV32", r.label);
            assertTrue(r.file.exists());
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(r.file, SaveFormat.WAV32);
            assertFalse("raw must be cleaned up", raw.exists());
        } finally {
            engine.clearSession();
            r.file.delete();
        }
    }

FILE: Takeone Save And Paywall Fixes.txt

================================================================================
TAKEONE: IMMUTABLE RECORDING ID + 32-BIT FLOAT LINKING + PAYWALL & BUTTON FIXES
================================================================================

1. UNIQUE IMMUTABLE RECORDING ID & FILE LINKING
   - Every recording is assigned a unique immutable positive ID (`long id`) via
     `TakesRepository.allocateId()` (persisted monotonically in SharedPreferences
     under `next_recording_id` so IDs never collide across restarts or async DB
     loads).
   - Both the converted library-visible recording (`Take.id` + `Take.filePath`
     in `TakesRepository`) and its separate 32-bit float recording
     (`takes/.float32/rec_<id>.f32.wav`) are linked directly to that immutable
     ID (`ConversionJob.recordingId` and `ConversionJobs.SaveResult.recordingId`).
   - When a recording is saved as WAV32 (already 48 kHz 32-bit float WAV), it is
     adopted in O(1) without storing a redundant `.f32.wav` copy in `.float32/`.
   - Imported recordings are copied in their native format on import and create
     their ID-linked `takes/.float32/rec_<id>.f32.wav` master the first time the
     user presses Edit (`TakesRepository.saveFloatMasterCopy(recordingId, ...)`).

2. RENAMING OF CONVERTED LIBRARY-VISIBLE RECORDING
   - `TakesRepository.rename(long id, String newTitle)` updates `t.title`,
     renames the converted library-visible file on disk (`t.filePath`) to match
     the sanitized new title (uniquified in `takes/`), updates `t.filePath`, and
     persists the updated `TakeEntity` to Room (`TakeDatabase`).
   - Because the separate 32-bit float file is linked to the immutable `t.id`
     (`takes/.float32/rec_<id>.f32.wav`), renaming the converted file on disk
     never breaks the link to the 32-bit float master.
   - Renaming a recording while it is still converting in the background
     (`ConversionJobs.renameConvertingOrCompleted` / `ConversionService.runJob`)
     also ensures both the title and the final converted file on disk match the
     renamed title.

3. GRACEFUL SAVE / REPLACE WITH IMMUTABLE ID PRESERVATION
   - When the user edits a recording and chooses Save -> Replace:
     * `ConversionJobs.dispatchSave`, `ConversionService.runJob`, and
       `TakesRepository.replaceRecording` resolve and preserve the original
       recording's immutable ID (`recordingId`).
     * The obsolete converted file is deleted immediately via
       `TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace`, the new converted file is
       registered under the exact same immutable `recordingId`, and the edited
       32-bit float WAV replaces `takes/.float32/rec_<recordingId>.f32.wav`.

4. PAYWALL ALLOWING ALL EDITING OPTIONS FOR ONE RECORDING (INCLUDING AFTER SAVE & EDIT)
   - `TrialAndBillingManager` binds the one-recording free allowance to the
     first recording's unique immutable ID (`free_recording_id` in
     SharedPreferences).
   - `hasProAccess()` and `hasProAccessForRecording(editSourceId)` return `true`
     when:
     * The user has an active Monthly (`takeone_pro_monthly`) or One-Time
       (`takeone_pro_lifetime`) Google Play purchase, OR
     * No recording has been saved yet (recording the 1st take), OR
     * The user is editing their 1st recording in Studio (`resolveRecordingId(editSourceId) == getFreeRecordingId()`),
       even after that 1st recording has been saved, renamed, or replaced
       multiple times!
   - Starting a 2nd recording (`editSourceId == -1` after the 1st recording is
     saved), saving as a New copy (which receives a new immutable ID), or
     editing any subsequent recording (`id != getFreeRecordingId()`) blocks all
     Studio features except Teleprompter and opens the Google Play Billing
     paywall on press.

5. STUDIO BUTTON DISABLED / CLICKABLE STATES (1ST RECORDING VS 2ND RECORDING)
   - On the 1st recording (`proUnlocked == true`, both during initial capture
     and when saved & re-edited from the Library):
     * Active editing buttons (`Replace`, `Select`, `Select & Replace`, `Trim`,
       `FX` when paused/editing, and `Undo`/`Redo` when history exists) are
       visually enabled (`alpha = 1.0f`, `0xFFF2F4F7`) and clickable
       (`setEnabled(true)`, `setClickable(true)`).
     * Disabled buttons (before recording starts, while actively recording on
       the mic, `Undo`/`Redo` with no history, or buttons locked by active
       Replace/FX mode, as well as `TeleValue` stepper buttons at min/max
       bounds) are visually disabled (`alpha = 0.35f`, `0xFF5D6672`) AND
       non-clickable (`setEnabled(false)`, `setClickable(false)`).
   - On the 2nd and subsequent recordings (`proUnlocked == false`):
     * All locked controls (`Replace`, `Select`, `Select & Replace`, `Trim`,
       `FX`, `Undo`, `Redo`, `Recording Settings`, `formatBadge`, and `Waveform Zoom`
       `TeleValue` `-`/`+`/value) are visually disabled (`alpha = 0.35f`,
       `0xFF5D6672`) AND clickable (`setEnabled(true)`, `setClickable(true)`) at
       all times so pressing any of them opens the paywall.

+     * Its 32-bit float master is created lazily the first time the user
+     * presses Edit on the imported take.
+     */
+    public static ImportedAudio importOriginal(Context ctx,
+                                               android.net.Uri uri,
+                                               File targetDir) throws Exception {
+        if (ctx == null || uri == null || targetDir == null) {
+            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing import source");
+        }
+        String display = queryDisplayName(ctx, uri);
+        String ext = extensionOf(display);
+        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
+            ext = extensionFromMime(ctx, uri);
+        }
+        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
+            ext = "m4a";
+        }
+        String rawTitle = stripExtension(display != null ? display
+                : "Imported_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
+        String cleanBase = rawTitle.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
+        if (cleanBase.isEmpty()) cleanBase = "Imported";
+        String prettyTitle = Dsp.prettyFileTitle(cleanBase + "." + ext);
+        if (prettyTitle.isEmpty()) prettyTitle = cleanBase;
+
+        File dst = uniqueImportedFile(targetDir, cleanBase, ext);
+        try {
+            try (java.io.InputStream in =
+                         ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
+                 java.io.FileOutputStream out =
+                         new java.io.FileOutputStream(dst)) {
+                if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("cannot open uri");
+                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
+                int n;
+                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
+                out.getFD().sync();
+            }
+            if (!dst.exists() || dst.length() <= 0) {
+                throw new IllegalStateException("empty import");
+            }
+            long durMs;
+            String badge;
+            if ("wav".equals(ext)) {
+                try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "r")) {
+                    Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
+                    if (h.channels < 1 || h.channels > 2 || h.sampleRate <= 0) {
+                        throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav");
+                    }
+                    long onDisk = Math.max(0L, r.length() - h.dataStart);
+                    if (onDisk <= 0) {
+                        throw new IllegalStateException("empty wav");
+                    }
+                }
+                durMs = Math.max(1000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst));
+                badge = TakesRepository.wavBadge(dst);
+            } else {
+                durMs = probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(dst);
+                badge = badgeForExtension(dst, ext);
+            }
+            return new ImportedAudio(dst, durMs, prettyTitle, badge);
+        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
+            try {
+                if (dst.exists()) {
+                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
+                    dst.delete();
+                }
+            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+            throw e;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static File uniqueImportedFile(File dir, String base, String ext) {
+        String stamp = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",
+                Locale.US).format(new java.util.Date());
+        File c = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + "." + ext);
+        if (!c.exists()) return c;
+        int i = 2;
+        while (true) {
+            File n = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + " (" + i + ")." + ext);
+            if (!n.exists()) return n;
+            i++;
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static String extensionFromMime(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri) {
+        try {
+            String mime = ctx.getContentResolver().getType(uri);
+            if (mime == null) return "";
+            String lower = mime.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
+            if (lower.contains("wav")) return "wav";
+            if (lower.contains("flac")) return "flac";
+            if (lower.contains("opus")) return "opus";
+            if (lower.contains("ogg")) return "ogg";
+            if (lower.contains("mpeg") || lower.contains("mp3")) return "mp3";
+            if (lower.contains("3gpp") || lower.contains("amr")) return "3gp";
+            if (lower.contains("aac")) return "aac";
+            if (lower.contains("mp4") || lower.contains("m4a")) return "m4a";
+        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+        return "";
+    }
+
+    private static String badgeForExtension(File f, String ext) {
+        switch (ext.toLowerCase(Locale.US)) {
+            case "wav":
+                return TakesRepository.wavBadge(f);
+            case "m4a":
+            case "aac":
+                return "M4A";
+            case "flac":
+                return "FLAC";
+            case "opus":
+            case "webm":
+            case "ogg":
+                return "OPUS";
+            case "3gp":
+            case "3ga":
+                return TakesRepository.containsToken(
+                        f, new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'}) ? "AMR-WB" : "AMR";
+            case "mp3":
+                return "MP3";
+            default:
+                return ext.toUpperCase(Locale.US);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static long probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(File src)
+            throws Exception {
+        long durationMs = -1L;
+        boolean hasAudio = false;
+        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
+        try {
+            ex.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
+            for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
+                MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
+                String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
+                if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
+                    hasAudio = true;
+                    try {
+                        if (f.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)) {
+                            durationMs = f.getLong(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)
+                                    / 1000L;
+                        }
+                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+                    break;
+                }
+            }
+        } catch (Exception ignored) {
+        } finally {
+            try {
+                ex.release();
+            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+        }
+        if (!hasAudio || durationMs <= 0) {
+            MediaMetadataRetriever mmr = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
+            try {
+                mmr.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
+                String has = mmr.extractMetadata(
+                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_HAS_AUDIO);
+                String dur = mmr.extractMetadata(
+                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
+                if (has != null && !has.isEmpty()) {
+                    hasAudio = true;
+                }
+                if (dur != null) {
+                    long parsed = (long) Double.parseDouble(dur);
+                    if (parsed > 0) {
+                        hasAudio = true;
+                        durationMs = parsed;
+                    }
+                }
+            } finally {
+                try {
+                    mmr.release();
+                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+            }
+        }
+        if (!hasAudio) {
+            throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track");
+        }
+        return Math.max(1000L, durationMs);
+    }

+    /**
+     * Allocates a unique, monotonically increasing positive ID for a new
+     * recording. Persisted in SharedPreferences so allocations before Room
+     * finishes loading can never collide with an existing database row.
+     */
+    public static synchronized long allocateId() {
+        long next = IDS.getAndIncrement();
+        if (app != null) {
+            try {
+                SharedPreferences p = app.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
+                long stored = p.getLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, 100L);
+                if (stored > next) {
+                    next = stored;
+                }
+                for (Take t : TAKES) {
+                    if (t.id >= next) {
+                        next = t.id + 1;
+                    }
+                }
+                IDS.set(next + 1);
+                p.edit().putLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, next + 1).apply();
+                return next;
+            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+        }
+        for (Take t : TAKES) {
+            if (t.id >= next) {
+                next = t.id + 1;
+            }
+        }
+        IDS.set(next + 1);
+        return next;
+    }

+    private static synchronized void ensureNextIdAtLeast(long minNext) {
+        if (minNext > IDS.get()) {
+            IDS.set(minNext);
+        }
+        if (app != null) {
+            try {
+                SharedPreferences p = app.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
+                long stored = p.getLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, 100L);
+                if (minNext > stored) {
+                    p.edit().putLong(KEY_NEXT_ID, minNext).apply();
+                }
+            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+        }

+    public static synchronized long findIdByFile(File takeFile) {
+        if (takeFile == null) return -1L;
+        String abs = takeFile.getAbsolutePath();
+        for (Take t : TAKES) {
+            if (abs.equals(t.filePath)) {
+                return t.id;

+    /**

+     * or {@code takeFile} belongs to a known {@link Take}, falling back to

+    /**
+     * Returns the 32-bit float WAV file to use when opening a recording with
+     * immutable {@code recordingId} and library file {@code takeFile} for
+     * editing:
+     * <ul>
+     *   <li>If {@code takeFile} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit float WAV (e.g. a
+     *       WAV32 take or a converting take's raw), returns {@code takeFile}
+     *       itself.</li>
+     *   <li>If an ID-linked 32-bit float master exists at
+     *       {@code takes/.float32/rec_<recordingId>.f32.wav}, returns it.</li>
+     *   <li>If a legacy filename-keyed master exists in {@code .float32/},
+     *       migrates it to {@code rec_<recordingId>.f32.wav} and returns it.</li>
+     *   <li>Otherwise returns {@code takeFile} (e.g. an imported recording
+     *       being edited for the first time).</li>
+     * </ul>
+     */
+    public static File resolveFloatMaster(long recordingId, File takeFile) {
+        if (takeFile == null || !takeFile.exists()) return takeFile;
+        if (AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(takeFile)) return takeFile;
+        File parent = takeFile.getParentFile();
+        long effId = recordingId > 0 ? recordingId : findIdByFile(takeFile);
+        if (parent != null && effId > 0) {
+            File byId = floatMasterForId(parent, effId);
+            if (byId != null && byId.exists()
+                    && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(byId)) {
+                return byId;
+            }
+            File legacy = new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
+                    takeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
+            if (legacy.exists() && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(legacy)) {
+                if (byId != null && legacy.renameTo(byId)) {
+                    return byId;
+                }
+                return legacy;
+            }
+        }
+        if (parent != null) {
+            File legacy = new File(floatMastersDir(parent),
+                    takeFile.getName() + ".f32.wav");
+            if (legacy.exists() && AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(legacy)) {
+                return legacy;
+            }
+        }
+        return takeFile;
+    }

+    public static File resolveFloatMaster(File takeFile) {
+        return resolveFloatMaster(-1L, takeFile);
+    }
