package com.example.hello;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Device-side helpers for the FX verification harness. The unit-test copy of
 * these lives in {@code app/src/test}; instrumentation tests cannot see it, so
 * the few pieces the device tier needs are duplicated here.
 */
public final class FxVerifySupportDevice {

    private FxVerifySupportDevice() {}

    /** Geometry of a 32-bit float WAV, read straight off the header. */
    public static final class WavInfo {
        public final int channels;
        public final int sampleRate;
        public final int bits;
        public final int audioFormat;
        public final long frames;

        WavInfo(int channels, int sampleRate, int bits, int audioFormat, long frames) {
            this.channels = channels;
            this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
            this.bits = bits;
            this.audioFormat = audioFormat;
            this.frames = frames;
        }
    }

    public static WavInfo readInfo(File f) throws Exception {
        try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
            long len = r.length();
            long pos = 12;
            int channels = 1, sampleRate = 48000, bits = 0, format = 0;
            long dataBytes = 0;
            while (pos + 8 <= len) {
                r.seek(pos);
                byte[] head = new byte[8];
                r.readFully(head);
                String tag = new String(head, 0, 4, "US-ASCII");
                long size = Integer.toUnsignedLong(
                        ByteBuffer.wrap(head, 4, 4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getInt());
                if ("fmt ".equals(tag)) {
                    byte[] fmt = new byte[(int) Math.min(size, 40)];
                    r.readFully(fmt);
                    ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(fmt).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                    // Absolute offsets: bitsPerSample sits at 14, behind
                    // byteRate and blockAlign.
                    format = b.getShort(0) & 0xFFFF;
                    channels = b.getShort(2) & 0xFFFF;
                    sampleRate = b.getInt(4);
                    bits = b.getShort(14) & 0xFFFF;
                } else if ("data".equals(tag)) {
                    dataBytes = Math.min(size, len - (pos + 8));
                }
                pos += 8 + size + (size % 2);
            }
            long frames = channels > 0 ? dataBytes / (4L * channels) : 0;
            return new WavInfo(channels, sampleRate, bits, format, frames);
        }
    }

    /** The dial the FX card drives; {@code DspChain.primaryParamId} is private. */
    public static String primaryParamId(DspChain.EffectType type) {
        try {
            Method m = DspChain.class.getDeclaredMethod("primaryParamId",
                    DspChain.EffectType.class);
            m.setAccessible(true);
            Object v = m.invoke(null, type);
            return v == null ? null : (String) v;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

    private Activity launch() {
        android.app.Instrumentation instr =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        android.content.Intent i = new android.content.Intent(
                instr.getTargetContext(), MainActivity.class);
        i.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                | android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        return instr.startActivitySync(i);
    }

    /**
     * Finds a view, tolerating a leftover result dialog.
     *
     * <p>A background conversion started by an earlier test class can finish
     * while this class browses the library, and the "conversion done" dialog
     * is modal: while it is up uiautomator only sees the dialog window, so
     * the chips, heart, search toggle and converting card all read as missing
     * even though the views are present and visible. The dialog is the app
     * behaving correctly, so the test dismisses it and looks again.
     */
    private UiObject findAllowingDialog(UiDevice d, UiSelector sel,
                                        String what) {
        UiObject o = d.findObject(sel);
        if (o.waitForExists(2500)) return o;
        dismissStrayDialogs(d);
        o = d.findObject(sel);
        if (!o.waitForExists(4000)) {
            throw new AssertionError(what + " not found after dismissing "
                    + "a stray dialog");
        }
        return o;
    }

    private void dismissStrayDialogs(UiDevice d) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            UiObject cancel = d.findObject(new UiSelector()
                    .resourceId(rid("dialogCancel")));
            if (cancel.waitForExists(400)) {
                try {
                    cancel.click();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(400);
                } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    return;
                }
                continue;
            }
            // Recovery is a 2-choice modal with no Cancel button. Discard the
            // orphaned raw so it cannot keep the library covered.
            UiObject discard = d.findObject(new UiSelector().text("Discard"));
            if (!discard.waitForExists(400)) return;
            try {
                discard.click();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                return;
            }
            try {
                Thread.sleep(400);
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private UiDevice device() {
        return UiDevice.getInstance(
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation());
    }

    private String rid(String name) {
        return InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext().getPackageName() + ":id/" + name;
    }

    private void seedTake(String title, String format) throws Exception {
        android.content.Context ctx =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().getTargetContext();
        File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File f = new File(takes, "flowlib_" + System.nanoTime()
                + (format.equals("WAV") ? ".wav" : ".m4a"));
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 48000L * 2 * 4));
            byte[] zeros = new byte[65536];
            for (long left = 48000L * 2 * 4; left > 0;
                 left -= Math.min(left, zeros.length)) {
                w.write(zeros, 0, (int) Math.min(left, zeros.length));
            }
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        TakesRepository.addRecording(f, 1000, title, format);
    }

    private Take findByTitle(String title) {
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (title.equals(t.title)) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void cleanupTitle(String title) {        try {
            for (Take t : new ArrayList<>(TakesRepository.all())) {
                if (title.equals(t.title)) {
                    TakesRepository.delete(t.id);
                    File f = new File(t.filePath);
                    if (f.exists()) {
                        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                        f.delete();
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static View findContaining(View v, String needle) {
        if (v instanceof TextView) {
            CharSequence cs = ((TextView) v).getText();
            if (cs != null && cs.toString().contains(needle)) return v;
        }
        if (v instanceof android.view.ViewGroup) {
            android.view.ViewGroup g = (android.view.ViewGroup) v;
            for (int i = 0; i < g.getChildCount(); i++) {
                View hit = findContaining(g.getChildAt(i), needle);
                if (hit != null) return hit;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static View findByText(View v, String needle) {
        if (v instanceof TextView) {
            CharSequence cs = ((TextView) v).getText();
            if (cs != null && needle.equals(cs.toString().trim())) return v;
        }
        if (v instanceof android.view.ViewGroup) {
            android.view.ViewGroup g = (android.view.ViewGroup) v;
            for (int i = 0; i < g.getChildCount(); i++) {
                View hit = findByText(g.getChildAt(i), needle);
                if (hit != null) return hit;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Test

        seedTake("FlowLib Alpha", "M4A");

    }

    private void clickChip(Activity a, String resId) throws Exception {

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Reproduces the reported flow on a real Android UI stack: a take is saved,
 * the studio hands back to the library, and the library must render and
 * survive a relaunch.
 *
 * <p>The emulator cannot fake a microphone, so the capture is synthesised
 * (same as the recorder would stream) and driven through the real
 * save/convert/library path. Everything downstream of the file is genuine.
 *
 * <p>Launches via {@code startActivitySync}: ActivityScenario never leaves
 * PRE_ON_CREATE on this image, so these tests use the same launch path as
 * every other UI test in the suite.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class LibraryRenderTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().getTargetContext();
    }

    private Activity launch() {
        android.app.Instrumentation instr =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        android.content.Intent i = new android.content.Intent(
                instr.getTargetContext(), MainActivity.class);
        i.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                | android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        return instr.startActivitySync(i);
    }

    /** Writes a real float capture and runs the genuine save pipeline. */
    private File saveTake(String name, int seconds, int channels)
            throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.clearSession();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), name, channels);
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        int frames = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE * seconds;
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(w.length());
            float[] buf = new float[frames * channels];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * channels; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.04) * 0.4f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx(),
                RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, null);
        TakesRepository.addRecording(r.file, r.durationMs, r.title, r.label);
        engine.clearSession();
        return r.file;
    }

    @Test
    public void libraryRendersAfterSave() {
        Activity activity = launch();
        try {
            // Library is the default screen; it must be alive right now.
            assertNotNull(activity.findViewById(android.R.id.content));
        } finally {
            activity.finish();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void librarySurvivesARealSavedTake() throws Exception {
        File saved = saveTake("Render Test A", 1, 2);
        Activity activity = launch();
        try {
            assertNotNull(activity.findViewById(android.R.id.content));
            // Let the async repository load + reconcile settle, as it does
            // on a real cold start.
            sleep(2500);
            assertNotNull(activity.findViewById(android.R.id.content));
            assertTrue("no takes in library",
                    TakesRepository.all().size() >= 1);
        } finally {
            activity.finish();
            TakesRepository.delete(findId("Render Test A"));
            if (saved.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                saved.delete();
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void libraryRendersAfterSeveralSavesAndRelaunch() throws Exception {
        File one = saveTake("Render One", 1, 1);
        File two = saveTake("Render Two", 1, 2);
        File three = saveTake("Render Three", 1, 1);
        try {
            // Relaunch: the rows come back from Room, which is where a stale
            // or null column would surface on the main thread.
            Activity first = launch();
            sleep(3000);
            try {
                assertNotNull(
                        first.findViewById(android.R.id.content));
            } finally {
                first.finish();
            }

            Activity second = launch();
            sleep(3000);
            try {
                assertNotNull(
                        second.findViewById(android.R.id.content));
            } finally {
                second.finish();
            }

            // And the studio -> library hand-off, the exact transition
            // reported.
            Activity third = launch();
            sleep(1500);
            final boolean[] done = {false};
            third.runOnUiThread(() -> {
                ((MainActivity) third).openStudio();
                done[0] = true;
            });
            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync();
            assertTrue(done[0]);
            sleep(1000);
            third.runOnUiThread(() -> {
                ((MainActivity) third).exitStudio();
                done[0] = false;
            });
            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync();
            sleep(2500);
            assertNotNull(third.findViewById(android.R.id.content));
            third.finish();
        } finally {
            deleteTitle("Render One");
            deleteTitle("Render Two");
            deleteTitle("Render Three");
            for (File f : new File[]{one, two, three}) {
                if (f != null && f.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    f.delete();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void everyTakeShapeBindsWithoutThrowing() {
        // Demo rows (null filePath), real rows, and odd values all have to
        // survive the adapter's bind + the library's filter/sort.
        TakesRepository.addTake(new Take(9001, "Demo-ish", 1000,
                System.currentTimeMillis(), "0.1 MB", "WAV", false, null));
        TakesRepository.addTake(new Take(9002, "Odd", 0,
                0, "0.0 MB", "M4A", true, "/nonexistent/x.m4a"));
        TakesRepository.addTake(new Take(9003, "Huge", Long.MAX_VALUE / 4,
                System.currentTimeMillis(), "999.9 MB", "FLAC", false, null));
        Activity activity = launch();
        try {
            sleep(2500);
            assertNotNull(activity.findViewById(android.R.id.content));
            assertTrue("odd takes missing",
                    TakesRepository.all().size() >= 3);
        } finally {
            activity.finish();
            TakesRepository.delete(9001L);
            TakesRepository.delete(9002L);
            TakesRepository.delete(9003L);
        }
    }

    private static long findId(String title) {
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (title.equals(t.title)) return t.id;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static void deleteTitle(String title) {
        long id = findId(title);
        if (id >= 0) TakesRepository.delete(id);
    }

    private static void sleep(long ms) {
        try {
            Thread.sleep(ms);
        } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
    }
}

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Proves the stored-raw preview path works on a real device image: play,
 * pause, seek and completion through AudioTrack without throwing.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class RawPreviewTest {

    private File makeRaw(Context ctx, String tag, int frames) throws Exception {
        File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File f = new File(takes, "preview_" + tag + "_" + System.nanoTime()
                + ".wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.03) * 0.5f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void previewPlaysPausesAndSeeks() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File raw = makeRaw(ctx, "long", 48000 * 3);
        final boolean[] done = {false};
        try {
            RawFloatPlayer player = new RawFloatPlayer(raw, ok -> {
                done[0] = true;
            });
            assertTrue("wrong duration: " + player.durationMs(),
                    player.durationMs() >= 2900
                            && player.durationMs() <= 3100);
            player.play();
            Thread.sleep(1200);
            long pos = player.positionMs();
            assertTrue("position did not advance (" + pos + "ms)", pos > 300);
            player.pause();
            long frozen = player.positionMs();
            Thread.sleep(400);
            assertTrue("pause did not hold",
                    Math.abs(player.positionMs() - frozen) < 200);
            player.seekToMs(200);
            assertTrue("seek missed",
                    Math.abs(player.positionMs() - 200) < 300);
            player.stop();
        } finally {
            if (raw.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void previewSignalsCompletion() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        // Short enough to fit the track buffer (~64KB): completion then
        // depends only on the player reaching end-of-file, not on the sink
        // draining. 7200 frames stereo float = 57.6KB.
        File raw = makeRaw(ctx, "short", 7200);
        final boolean[] done = {false};
        final boolean[] completed = {false};
        try {
            RawFloatPlayer player = new RawFloatPlayer(raw, ok -> {
                done[0] = true;
                completed[0] = ok;
            });
            player.play();
            long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
            while (!done[0] && System.currentTimeMillis() - t0 < 8000) {
                Thread.sleep(200);
            }
            assertTrue("never finished", done[0]);
            assertTrue("did not complete", completed[0]);
            player.stop();
        } finally {
            if (raw.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/java/com/example/hello/SaveWhileConvertingTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;
import android.view.View;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The flow the user reported: record, stop, save, land in the library with a
 * conversion card, then let it finish while the library is on screen.
 *
 * <p>Covers three regressions: the studio must not sit blocked while an
 * unconverted tail is encoded (the save hands off to the worker instead), the
 * library must survive the converting card turning into a finished take, and
 * the finished take must carry the title the user set while it converted.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class SaveWhileConvertingTest {

    @Rule
    public androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule mic =
            androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule.grant(
                    android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);

    /**
     * The studio capture path gates on POST_NOTIFICATIONS (SDK 33+): without
     * it the fab opens a rationale instead of recording. Granted once per
     * class so these tests verify recording instead of skipping.
     */
    @org.junit.BeforeClass
    public static void grantNotifForUiRecording() {
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
            try {
                androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
                        .getInstrumentation().getUiAutomation()
                        .executeShellCommand("pm grant "
                                + androidx.test.platform.app
                                        .InstrumentationRegistry
                                        .getInstrumentation()
                                        .getTargetContext().getPackageName()
                                + " android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS");
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void pump(long ms) {
        // One clock only: elapsedRealtime() and uptimeMillis() diverge by
        // the device's accumulated sleep time, which would stretch this
        // wait by that whole offset.
        long end = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + ms;
        while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < end) {
            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync();
            try {
                Thread.sleep(200);
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void saveHandsOffToWorkerAndLibrarySurvivesCompletion()
            throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        android.app.Instrumentation instr =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        android.content.Intent i = new android.content.Intent(
                instr.getTargetContext(), MainActivity.class);
        i.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                | android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        android.app.Activity a = instr.startActivitySync(i);

        RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        RecordingEngine.get().startNewSession(ctx, "Conv Flow", 2);
        // Write real audio so the pump has actual frames to encode.
        File raw = RecordingEngine.get().rawFile;
        Take finished = null;
        try {
        int frames = 48000 * 12; // 12 s: long enough that the pump lags
        java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(w.length());
            float[] buf = new float[65536 * 2];
            long written = 0;
            while (written < (long) frames * 2) {
                int n = (int) Math.min(buf.length, (long) frames * 2 - written);
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    buf[k] = (float) Math.sin((written + k) * 0.05) * 0.4f;
                }
                Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, n);
                written += n;
            }
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }

        View fab = a.findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
        assertNotNull("no record button", fab);
        a.runOnUiThread(fab::performClick);
        pump(1500);
        a.runOnUiThread(() -> {
            View stop = a.findViewById(R.id.fabStopWrap);
            if (stop != null) stop.performClick();
        });
        pump(800);
        // Choose Save in the stop sheet.
        androidx.test.uiautomator.UiDevice d = androidx.test.uiautomator
                .UiDevice.getInstance(instr);
        androidx.test.uiautomator.UiObject save = d.findObject(
                new androidx.test.uiautomator.UiSelector().text("Save"));
        assertTrue("save option never appeared", save.waitForExists(6000));
        save.click();

        long t0 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        boolean leftStudio = false;
        while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t0 < 20000) {
            pump(400);
            if (a.findViewById(R.id.teleView) == null) {
                leftStudio = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        long elapsed = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t0;
        assertTrue("save never left the studio", leftStudio);
        assertTrue("studio blocked for " + elapsed + "ms while converting",
                elapsed < 8000);

        // Wait for OUR take to appear. A fresh install seeds demo rows, so
        // waiting for "any take" returns instantly and proves nothing.
        long t1 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t1 < 90000) {
            pump(1000);
            boolean found = false;
            for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
                if ("Conv Flow".equals(t.title)) found = true;
            }
            if (found) break;
        }
        // The activity must still be alive: the crash reported by the user
        // happened here, with the converting card turning into a real take.
        assertTrue("library died while the conversion completed",
                !a.isFinishing() && !a.isDestroyed());

        // Look for our own take: a fresh install also seeds demo rows.
        StringBuilder titles = new StringBuilder();
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            titles.append(t.title).append('/');
            if ("Conv Flow".equals(t.title)) finished = t;
        }
        StringBuilder jobs = new StringBuilder();
        for (ConversionJob j : ConversionJobs.active()) {
            jobs.append(j.jobId).append(':').append(j.title).append(' ')
                    .append(j.state).append(' ')
                    .append(j.progress).append("% ");
        }
        assertNotNull("finished take never landed; takes=[" + titles
                + "] activeJobs=[" + jobs + "]", finished);
        assertTrue("finished take has no file", finished.hasFile());
        assertTrue("sidecar left behind",
                ConversionJobs.forRaw(raw.getAbsolutePath()) == null
                        && !ConversionJob.sidecarFor(raw).exists());
        } finally {
            RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
            if (raw != null) {
                ConversionJob.sidecarFor(raw).delete();
                ConversionJob.partFor(raw).delete();
                raw.delete();
            }
            for (Take t : new java.util.ArrayList<>(TakesRepository.all())) {
                if ("Conv Flow".equals(t.title)) {
                    TakesRepository.delete(t.id);
                    if (t.filePath != null) new File(t.filePath).delete();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Renaming while the take converts must stick: the worker inserts the
     * finished file under the job's title, so the new name has to travel
     * through the sidecar.
     */
    @Test
    public void renamingAConvertingTakeReachesTheJob() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File raw = new File(takes, "renconv_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 48000L * 2 * 4));
            byte[] zeros = new byte[65536];
            for (long left = 48000L * 2 * 4; left > 0;
                 left -= Math.min(left, zeros.length)) {
                w.write(zeros, 0, (int) Math.min(left, zeros.length));
            }
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        ConversionJob job = null;
        try {
            job = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx, raw, "Old Name",
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            assertTrue("job not active",
                    ConversionJobs.forRaw(raw.getAbsolutePath()) != null);

            // What the library's rename path does for a converting card.
            job.title = "New Name";
            job.write();
            assertEquals("New Name", job.title);

            // A fresh read of the sidecar must see it too, so a process
            // death mid-conversion does not resurrect the old name.
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals("rename did not survive the sidecar",
                    "New Name", back.title);

            // And the library renders that name.
            assertNotNull("job lost", ConversionJobs.get(job.jobId));
            assertEquals("New Name", ConversionJobs.get(job.jobId).title);
        } finally {
            if (job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true);
            if (raw.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Proves incremental encoding works on a real device image: while capture
 * runs, the streaming encoder follows the raw file, and saving adopts the
 * already-encoded output instead of reconverting.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class StreamingEncodeTest {

    @Rule
    public androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule mic =
            androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule.grant(
                    android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);

    @Test
    public void partFileGrowsDuringCapture() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Streaming", 2);
        try {
            engine.beginStreaming(ctx, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A);
            StreamingEncoder sess = engine.streaming();
            assertNotNull("no streaming session", sess);
            engine.startCapture(ctx,
                    android.media.MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            Thread.sleep(2500);
            assertTrue("streaming died: " + sess.failure(), sess.healthy());
            assertTrue("nothing encoded yet (frames=" + sess.framesEncoded()
                    + ")", sess.framesEncoded() > 48000);
            assertTrue("no part file", sess.partFile().exists()
                    && sess.partFile().length() > 1024);
        } finally {
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void saveAdoptsStreamedOutput() throws Exception {        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Streaming Adopt", 2);
        File adopted = null;
        try {
            engine.beginStreaming(ctx, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A);
            engine.startCapture(ctx,
                    android.media.MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            Thread.sleep(2500);
            engine.pauseCapture();
            ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(ctx,
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, null);
            assertTrue("did not adopt the streamed output", r.adopted);
            adopted = r.file;
            assertTrue("adopted file missing",
                    adopted != null && adopted.exists());
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(adopted, SaveFormat.M4A);
            assertTrue("raw was not deleted", !engine.hasSession()
                    || engine.rawFile == null || !engine.rawFile.exists());
        } finally {
            engine.clearSession();
            if (adopted != null && adopted.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                adopted.delete();
            }
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void wav16StreamAdopts() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Streaming WAV16", 2);
        File adopted = null;
        try {
            engine.beginStreaming(ctx, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16);
            assertNotNull(engine.streaming());
            engine.startCapture(ctx,
                    android.media.MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            Thread.sleep(2000);
            engine.pauseCapture();
            ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(ctx,
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
            assertTrue("wav16 stream was not adopted", r.adopted);
            adopted = r.file;
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(adopted, SaveFormat.WAV16);
            // ~2s stereo 16-bit: between 1s and 4s of payload plus header.
            long payload = adopted.length() - 44;
            assertTrue("payload=" + payload,
                    payload > 48000L * 2 * 2 * 1
                            && payload < 48000L * 2 * 2 * 4);
        } finally {
            engine.clearSession();
            if (adopted != null && adopted.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                adopted.delete();
            }
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                adopted.delete();

    @Test
    public void opusStreamAdoptsWhenEncoderExists() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue("no opus encoder on this device",
                SaveFormat.OPUS.available(ctx));
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();

        File adopted = null;

            engine.startCapture(ctx,

            Thread.sleep(2500);

            ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(ctx,
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.OPUS, null);

            adopted = r.file;
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(adopted, SaveFormat.OPUS);

    @Test
    public void pauseResumeKeepsStreamAdoptable() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Streaming Pause", 2);
        File adopted = null;
        try {
            engine.beginStreaming(ctx, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A);
            assertNotNull(engine.streaming());
            engine.startCapture(ctx,
                    android.media.MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            Thread.sleep(1500);
            engine.pauseCapture();
            // Encoder idles while paused; resume must continue the same
            // stream with contiguous timestamps.
            Thread.sleep(800);
            engine.resumeCapture(ctx,
                    android.media.MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            Thread.sleep(1500);
            engine.pauseCapture();
            assertTrue("streaming died across pause: "
                    + (engine.streaming() != null
                            ? engine.streaming().failure() : "gone"),
                    engine.streaming() != null
                            && engine.streaming().healthy());
            ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(ctx,
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, null);
            assertTrue("paused/resumed stream was not adopted", r.adopted);
            adopted = r.file;
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(adopted, SaveFormat.M4A);
            // ~3s of audio across the pause gap (gap itself not recorded).
            assertTrue("duration=" + r.durationMs,
                    r.durationMs >= 2000 && r.durationMs <= 5000);
        } finally {
            engine.clearSession();
            if (adopted != null && adopted.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                adopted.delete();
            }
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;
import androidx.test.uiautomator.UiDevice;
import androidx.test.uiautomator.UiObject;
import androidx.test.uiautomator.UiSelector;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

/**
 * Full studio screen flows against the real UI: navigation, pause/mirror
 * controls, and record-stop-save landing in the library.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class StudioFlowTest {

    /**
     * The studio capture path also gates on POST_NOTIFICATIONS (SDK 33+):
     * without it the fab opens a rationale instead of recording. Grant it
     * once per class so these tests verify recording instead of skipping.
     */
    @org.junit.BeforeClass
    public static void grantNotifForUiRecording() {
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
            try {
                androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
                        .getInstrumentation().getUiAutomation()
                        .executeShellCommand("pm grant "
                                + androidx.test.platform.app
                                        .InstrumentationRegistry
                                        .getInstrumentation()
                                        .getTargetContext().getPackageName()
                                + " android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS");
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    @Rule
    public androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule mic =
            androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule.grant(
                    android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);

    private Activity launch() {
        android.app.Instrumentation instr =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        android.content.Intent i = new android.content.Intent(
                instr.getTargetContext(), MainActivity.class);
        i.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                | android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        return instr.startActivitySync(i);
    }

    /** Opens the studio with a pre-seeded session (no name dialog). */
    private Activity openStudio() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        RecordingEngine.get().startNewSession(ctx, "Flow Take", 2);
        Activity a = launch();
        View fab = a.findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
        assertNotNull("no record button", fab);
        a.runOnUiThread(fab::performClick);
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync();
        assertNotNull("studio did not open",
                a.findViewById(R.id.teleView));
        return a;
    }

    private static void uiTap(Activity a, View v) {
        a.runOnUiThread(v::performClick);
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync();
    }

    @Test
    public void studioOpensFromLibrary() throws Exception {
        Activity a = openStudio();
        try {
            assertNotNull(a.findViewById(R.id.telePanel));
            assertNotNull(a.findViewById(R.id.waveform));
            assertNotNull(a.findViewById(R.id.timerText));
            assertNotNull(a.findViewById(R.id.zoomValue));
            assertEquals("00:00.00",
                    ((TextView) a.findViewById(R.id.timerText)).getText()
                            .toString());
        } finally {
            RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void pauseButtonFlipsLabelBothWays() throws Exception {
        Activity a = openStudio();
        try {
            TextView pause = a.findViewById(R.id.telePauseBtn);
            assertEquals("Play", pause.getText().toString());
            uiTap(a, pause);
            assertEquals("Pause", pause.getText().toString());
            uiTap(a, pause);
            assertEquals("Play", pause.getText().toString());
        } finally {
            RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void mirrorTogglePersistsSetting() throws Exception {
        Activity a = openStudio();
        try {
            TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
            boolean before = TeleSettings.load(a).mirror;
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.teleMirrorBtn));
            TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
            assertEquals(!before, TeleSettings.load(a).mirror);
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.teleMirrorBtn));
            TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
            assertEquals(before, TeleSettings.load(a).mirror);
        } finally {
            RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void presetLockedWhileAttachedSessionHasAudio() throws Exception {
        android.content.Context ctx =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().getTargetContext();
        RecordPreset before = RecordPreset.load(ctx);
        try {
            RecordPreset.MEMO.save(ctx);
            // Attach a synthetic session with real audio, IDLE (edit shape).
            RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
            java.io.File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
            java.io.File raw = new java.io.File(takes,
                    "lock_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
            int frames = 48000;
            java.io.RandomAccessFile w =
                    new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
                float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
                for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
                    buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05) * 0.3f;
                }
                Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            RecordingEngine.get().attachExisting(ctx, raw, "Lock Take", 2,
                    RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));
            Activity a = launch();
            try {
                View fab = a.findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
                assertNotNull("no record button", fab);
                a.runOnUiThread(fab::performClick);
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                        .waitForIdleSync();
                assertNotNull("studio did not open",
                        a.findViewById(R.id.teleView));
                Thread.sleep(600);
                uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.settingsRow));
                Thread.sleep(600);
                androidx.test.uiautomator.UiDevice d = UiDevice.getInstance(
                        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation());
                String podcast = ctx.getString(RecordPreset.PODCAST.titleRes);
                androidx.test.uiautomator.UiObject pill = d.findObject(
                        new UiSelector().text(podcast));
                assertTrue("no podcast pill", pill.waitForExists(5000));
                pill.click();
                Thread.sleep(600);
                assertEquals("preset switched on a fixed-geometry session",
                        RecordPreset.MEMO.id, RecordPreset.load(ctx).id);
                a.runOnUiThread(a::onBackPressed);
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                        .waitForIdleSync();
            } finally {
                RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
            }
        } finally {
            before.save(ctx);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void recordStopSaveLandsAdoptedInLibrary() throws Exception {
        Activity a = openStudio();
        UiDevice device = UiDevice.getInstance(
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation());
        try {
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.fabWrap));
            long t0 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            boolean recording = false;
            while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t0 < 4000) {
                if (RecordingEngine.get().state
                        == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                    recording = true;
                    break;
                }
                Thread.sleep(200);
            }
            org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue("no audio input on this device",
                    recording);
            Thread.sleep(2500);
            // Stop -> save dialog -> Save -> adopted save -> library.
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.fabStopWrap));
            UiObject save = device.findObject(new UiSelector().text("Save"));
            assertTrue("save dialog never appeared", save.waitForExists(5000));
            save.click();
            // Adopted save exits the studio quickly; the library row with
            // our take name must exist.
            boolean landed = false;
            t0 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t0 < 15000) {
                if (findByText(a.getWindow().getDecorView(), "Flow Take")
                        != null) {
                    landed = true;
                    break;
                }
                Thread.sleep(500);
            }
            assertTrue("saved take never landed in the library", landed);
        } finally {
            try {
                for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
                    if ("Flow Take".equals(t.title)) {
                        TakesRepository.delete(t.id);
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    private static View findByText(View v, String needle) {
        if (v instanceof TextView) {
            CharSequence cs = ((TextView) v).getText();
            if (cs != null && needle.equals(cs.toString().trim())) return v;
        }
        if (v instanceof android.view.ViewGroup) {
            android.view.ViewGroup g = (android.view.ViewGroup) v;
            for (int i = 0; i < g.getChildCount(); i++) {
                View hit = findByText(g.getChildAt(i), needle);
                if (hit != null) return hit;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Test
    public void backDuringRecordingSwitchesDirectlyToBackground() throws Exception {
        Activity a = openStudio();
        UiDevice device = UiDevice.getInstance(
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation());
        try {
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.fabWrap));
            long t0 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            boolean recording = false;
            while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t0 < 4000) {
                if (RecordingEngine.get().state
                        == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                    recording = true;
                    break;
                }
                Thread.sleep(200);
            }
            org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue("no audio input on this device",
                    recording);
            // Back arrow switches to background recording in Library with no modal.
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.backBtn));
            Thread.sleep(1000);
            assertTrue(RecordingEngine.get().state
                    == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING);
            assertNotNull(findByText(a.getWindow().getDecorView(),
                    "Library"));
            // Reopen and discard to leave no trace.
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.fabWrap));
            Thread.sleep(1000);
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.fabStopWrap));
            UiObject discard = device.findObject(
                    new UiSelector().text("Discard"));
            assertTrue("no discard option", discard.waitForExists(5000));
            discard.click();
            Thread.sleep(1500);
            assertTrue(!RecordingEngine.get().hasSession());
        } finally {
            RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void audioFocusLossPausesAndNeverResumes() throws Exception {
        // A phone call manifests to the app as audio-focus loss; the
        // contract is pause now, never resume on your own.
        Activity a = openStudio();
        try {
            uiTap(a, a.findViewById(R.id.fabWrap));
            long t0 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            boolean recording = false;
            while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t0 < 4000) {
                if (RecordingEngine.get().state
                        == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                    recording = true;
                    break;
                }
                Thread.sleep(200);
            }
            org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue("no audio input on this device",
                    recording);
            // Outlive the focus-loss grace window after capture start.
            Thread.sleep(1500);
            android.media.AudioManager am =
                    (android.media.AudioManager) a.getSystemService(
                            android.content.Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            android.media.AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener probe =
                    focus -> { };
            int res = am.requestAudioFocus(probe,
                    android.media.AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC,
                    android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN);
            assertEquals(android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED,
                    res);
            try {
                long t1 = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                boolean paused = false;
                while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - t1 < 5000) {
                    if (RecordingEngine.get().state
                            == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED) {
                        paused = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    Thread.sleep(200);
                }
                assertTrue("focus loss did not pause capture", paused);
                // Hand focus back: the app must NOT resume by itself.
                am.abandonAudioFocus(probe);
                Thread.sleep(2500);
                assertTrue("capture auto-resumed after focus returned",
                        RecordingEngine.get().state
                                == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
            } finally {
                am.abandonAudioFocus(probe);
            }
        } finally {
            RecordingEngine.get().abortAndDelete();
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/androidTest/java/com/example/hello/SyntheticVoiceCaptureTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Proves the emulator's virtual microphone is actually engaged: records a few
 * seconds while the host plays generated speech into the mic, then asserts
 * the captured float WAV contains real signal (not silence/zeros) and that
 * the engine's live level meter responds.
 *
 * <p>Run {@code adb emu avd rewindaudio} just before this class so the
 * file-backed mic starts at the beginning of the speech sample.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class SyntheticVoiceCaptureTest {

    @Rule
    public androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule mic =
            androidx.test.rule.GrantPermissionRule.grant(
                    android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);

    /**
     * True when the device offers a usable capture input.
     *
     * <p>This test needs a real audio source behind the mic: the emulator's
     * virtual mic, fed by the host. On a runner with no audio backend the HAL
     * rejects the input format outright ("getInputBufferSize:
     * INVALID_ARGUMENTS"), and there is nothing to assert about the app in
     * that case.
     */
    private boolean captureInputAvailable(Context ctx) {
        android.media.AudioManager am =
                (android.media.AudioManager) ctx.getSystemService(
                        Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        if (am == null) return false;
        android.media.AudioDeviceInfo[] ins =
                am.getDevices(android.media.AudioManager.GET_DEVICES_INPUTS);
        if (ins == null || ins.length == 0) return false;
        // Opening a record is not proof of a source: on a host with no audio
        // backend the HAL hands back an initialised record that never
        // produces a sample. Read briefly and require real energy.
        android.media.AudioRecord rec = null;
        try {
            int min = android.media.AudioRecord.getMinBufferSize(48000,
                    android.media.AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO,
                    android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT);
            if (min <= 0) min = 8192;
            rec = new android.media.AudioRecord(
                    android.media.MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC, 48000,
                    android.media.AudioFormat.CHANNEL_IN_MONO,
                    android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT,
                    min * 2);
            if (rec.getState() != android.media.AudioRecord.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                return false;
            }
            rec.startRecording();
            if (rec.getRecordingState()
                    != android.media.AudioRecord.RECORDSTATE_RECORDING) {
                return false;
            }
            float peak = 0f;
            byte[] buf = new byte[4096];
            long until = System.currentTimeMillis() + 1200;
            while (System.currentTimeMillis() < until && peak < 0.001f) {
                int n = rec.read(buf, 0, buf.length);
                if (n <= 0) continue;
                ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(buf, 0, n)
                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                while (bb.remaining() >= 4) {
                    float v = Math.abs(bb.getFloat());
                    if (v > peak) peak = v;
                }
            }
            return peak > 0.001f;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        } finally {
            if (rec != null) {
                try {
                    rec.stop();
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                try {
                    rec.release();
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void virtualMicCapturesGeneratedSpeech() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue("no usable capture input on this device",
                captureInputAvailable(ctx));
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx, "Synthetic Voice", 2);
        try {
            engine.startCapture(ctx,
                    android.media.MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC);
            assertTrue("capture did not start",
                    engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING);

            // Let ~2.5s of the generated speech stream in.
            Thread.sleep(2500);

            float level = engine.level;
            assertTrue("live meter never moved; mic is silent (level="
                    + level + ")", level > 0.001f);

            File raw = engine.finalizeRaw();
            assertTrue("no raw file", raw != null && raw.exists());

            float peak = 0f;
            double sum = 0d;
            long n = 0;
            RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "r");
            try {
                r.seek(44);
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(buf)
                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                int read;
                while ((read = r.read(buf)) > 0) {
                    bb.clear();
                    bb.limit(read);
                    while (bb.remaining() >= 4) {
                        float s = Math.abs(bb.getFloat());
                        if (s > peak) peak = s;
                        sum += s;
                        n++;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                r.close();
            }
            double mean = n == 0 ? 0 : sum / n;
            assertTrue("captured only " + n + " samples", n > 48000);
            assertTrue("captured silence (peak=" + peak + ", mean=" + mean
                    + "); the virtual mic is not engaged",
                    peak > 0.02f && mean > 0.0005);

            // And the synthetic take must survive the real save pipeline.
            TakeSaver.Result result = TakeSaver.finalizeAndConvert(ctx,
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, null);
            assertTrue("no saved file",
                    result != null && result.file.exists()
                            && result.file.length() > 512);
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            result.file.delete();
        } finally {
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * NEW-03 on device: conversions encode into {@code .part} first and only a
 * validated container is renamed to its final name — a kill mid-conversion
 * can never leave a corrupt final file, and no stray part survives success.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class TakeSaverPartTest {

    private File makeRaw(Context ctx, String name) throws Exception {
        File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File f = new File(takes, name + "_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        int frames = 48000 * 2;
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05) * 0.4f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void convertRawAdoptsValidatedPartOnly() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File raw = makeRaw(ctx, "PartLife");
        File fin = null;
        try {
            TakeSaver.Result r = TakeSaver.convertRaw(ctx, raw, "Part Life",
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
            fin = r.file;
            assertNotNull("no result file", fin);
            assertTrue("final file missing", fin.exists());
            assertTrue("final file too small", fin.length() > 1024);
            assertTrue("stray part survived success",
                    !ConversionJob.partFor(raw).exists());
            // Nothing half-written under a final-looking name either.
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(fin, SaveFormat.WAV16);
        } finally {
            if (fin != null && fin.exists()) fin.delete();
            File part = ConversionJob.partFor(raw);
            if (part.exists()) part.delete();
            if (raw.exists()) raw.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void convertRawFailureLeavesNoStrays() throws Exception {
        Context ctx = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
                .getTargetContext();
        File raw = new File(RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx),
                "PartFail_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(new byte[100]); // not a WAV at all
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        boolean threw = false;
        try {
            TakeSaver.convertRaw(ctx, raw, "Part Fail",
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, null);
        } catch (Exception expected) {
            threw = true;
        }
        try {
            assertTrue("garbage raw must fail conversion", threw);
            assertTrue("stray part survived failure",
                    !ConversionJob.partFor(raw).exists());
        } finally {
            if (raw.exists()) raw.delete();
            File part = ConversionJob.partFor(raw);
            if (part.exists()) part.delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Intent;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

/**
 * Opens the teleprompter dialogs against a real Activity on a real Android
 * image.
 *
 * <p>The reported crash was a framework rejection at show() time, which only
 * reproduces with a genuine window — Robolectric covers the ordering, this
 * covers the real thing.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class TeleDialogsDeviceTest {

    private Activity launch() {
        android.app.Instrumentation instr =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        Intent i = new Intent(instr.getTargetContext(), MainActivity.class);
        i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        return instr.startActivitySync(i);
    }

    @Test
    public void editorOpensOnRealDevice() {
        final Activity a = launch();
        a.runOnUiThread(() -> {
            TeleDialogs.showEditor(a, "line one\nline two", 120,
                    text -> { }, null);
        });
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync();
        // Reaching here without an exception is the assertion: the old code
        // threw requestFeature() must be called before adding content.
    }

    @Test
    public void appSurvivesOpeningEditorTwice() {
        Activity a = launch();
        a.runOnUiThread(() -> {
            TeleDialogs.showEditor(a, "script", 120, text -> { }, null);
        });
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync();
        a.runOnUiThread(() -> {
            TeleDialogs.showEditor(a, "script two", 120, text -> { }, null);
        });
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync();
        assertTrue("activity died while dialogs were open",
                !a.isFinishing() && !a.isDestroyed());
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * On-device checks for the prompter rework: centring, stable wrapping, the
 * windowed render, and the inline four-way controls.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class TeleprompterDisplayTest {

    private Activity launch() {
        android.app.Instrumentation instr =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        android.content.Intent i = new android.content.Intent(
                instr.getTargetContext(), MainActivity.class);
        i.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                | android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        return instr.startActivitySync(i);
    }

    private static String manyWords(int n) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(' ');
            sb.append("word").append(i);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    @Test
    public void splitsScriptIntoSegmentsThatCoverEveryWord() {
        Activity a = launch();
        TeleprompterView v = new TeleprompterView(a);
        int w = 900, h = 600;
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(w, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(h, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, w, h);

        int total = 400;
        v.setScript(manyWords(total));
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(w, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(h, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, w, h);

        assertTrue("no segments produced", v.segmentCount() > 0);
        // Every word must survive the split, in order.
        StringBuilder joined = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < v.segmentCount(); i++) {
            String s = v.segmentAt(i);
            if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (joined.length() > 0) joined.append(' ');
            joined.append(s);
        }
        String[] got = joined.toString().split("\\s+");
        assertEquals("segment split lost or reordered words", total, got.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            assertEquals("word " + i + " changed", "word" + i, got[i]);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void segmentsOutOfRangeAreEmptyNotCrashing() {
        Activity a = launch();
        TeleprompterView v = new TeleprompterView(a);
        int w = 900, h = 600;
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(w, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(h, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, w, h);
        v.setScript(manyWords(60));

        // Before the start and past the end must both return "".
        assertEquals("", v.segmentAt(-1));
        assertEquals("", v.segmentAt(v.segmentCount()));
        assertEquals("", v.segmentAt(v.segmentCount() + 500));
    }

    @Test
    public void wrappingIsStableAcrossRedraws() {
        Activity a = launch();
        TeleprompterView v = new TeleprompterView(a);
        int w = 900, h = 600;
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(w, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(h, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, w, h);
        v.setScript(manyWords(300));

        List<String> first = snapshot(v);
        // Scroll, force redraws, and confirm the split did not shift. A
        // character-count estimate re-wrapped between passes, which is what
        // made the words appear to flicker.
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            v.scrollBy(17f);
            v.measure(
                    View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(w, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                    View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(h, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
            v.layout(0, 0, w, h);
        }
        assertEquals("segments changed while scrolling", first, snapshot(v));
    }

    private static List<String> snapshot(TeleprompterView v) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < v.segmentCount(); i++) out.add(v.segmentAt(i));
        return out;
    }

    @Test
    public void lastLineCanReachTheCentreLine() {
        Activity a = launch();
        TeleprompterView v = new TeleprompterView(a);
        int w = 900, h = 600;
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(w, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(h, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, w, h);
        v.setScript(manyWords(500));

        v.setScrollOffset(Float.MAX_VALUE);
        assertTrue("nothing scrollable", v.maxScroll() > 0f);
        float lh = v.lineHeight();
        // At full scroll the last segment must land on the centre line.
        float centreLine = h / 2f + lh * 0.36f;
        float lastBaseline = h / 2f - v.maxScroll()
                + (v.segmentCount() - 1) * lh;
        assertEquals("last line did not reach the centre line",
                centreLine, lastBaseline, 2f);
        // And it must be comfortably inside the viewport, not clipped.
        assertTrue("last line is below the viewport", lastBaseline < h);
        assertTrue("last line is above the viewport", lastBaseline > 0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void textIsHorizontallyCentred() {
        Activity a = launch();
        TeleprompterView v = new TeleprompterView(a);
        int w = 900, h = 600;
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(w, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(h, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, w, h);
        v.setScript(manyWords(50));

        android.graphics.Bitmap bmp = android.graphics.Bitmap
                .createBitmap(w, h, android.graphics.Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        android.graphics.Canvas c = new android.graphics.Canvas(bmp);
        v.draw(c);

        // Ink in the first 40px would mean the text hugs the left padding.
        int farLeft = inked(bmp, 0, 40);
        assertEquals("text is flush to the left edge", 0, farLeft);
        int farRight = inked(bmp, w - 40, w);
        assertEquals("text is flush to the right edge", 0, farRight);
        // And there should be ink somewhere in the middle band.
        assertTrue("nothing rendered", inked(bmp, w / 4, w - w / 4) > 0);

        // Symmetry: ink left of centre should roughly mirror ink right of it.
        // A left-aligned prompter shows a large, stable imbalance.
        int left = inked(bmp, 0, w / 2);
        int right = inked(bmp, w / 2, w);
        float skew = Math.abs(left - right) / (float) Math.max(1, left + right);
        assertTrue("ink is not balanced about the centre (skew=" + skew
                + ", left=" + left + ", right=" + right + ")", skew < 0.18f);
    }

    private static int inked(android.graphics.Bitmap b, int x0, int x1) {
        int n = 0;
        for (int x = Math.max(0, x0); x < Math.min(b.getWidth(), x1); x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < b.getHeight(); y += 2) {
                if ((b.getPixel(x, y) & 0xFF000000) != 0) n++;
            }
        }
        return n;
    }

    @Test
    public void studioShowsInlineControlsInsteadOfTuneMenu() {
        Activity a = launch();
        // Inflate the studio layout directly: this asserts the screen's
        // contract without depending on which fragment happens to be
        // on-screen after launch (a name modal or library can be showing).
        View root = android.view.LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);
        assertNotNullId(root, R.id.teleSizeValue);
        assertNotNullId(root, R.id.teleSpeedValue);
        assertNotNullId(root, R.id.teleWplValue);
        assertNotNullId(root, R.id.telePauseBtn);
        assertNotNullId(root, R.id.zoomValue);
        // The separate tuning entry point is gone from the studio screen.
        assertTrue("Tune button still present",
                findByText(root, "Tune") == null);
    }

    /** Depth-first search for a visible TextView with the given label. */
    private static View findByText(View v, String needle) {
        if (v instanceof TextView) {
            CharSequence cs = ((TextView) v).getText();
            if (cs != null
                    && needle.equals(cs.toString().trim())) {
                return v;
            }
        }
        if (v instanceof ViewGroup) {
            ViewGroup g = (ViewGroup) v;
            for (int i = 0; i < g.getChildCount(); i++) {
                View hit = findByText(g.getChildAt(i), needle);
                if (hit != null) return hit;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static void assertNotNullId(View root, int id) {
        if (root.findViewById(id) == null) {
            throw new AssertionError("missing view id " + id);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void teleValueStepsAndReports() {
        Activity a = launch();
        TeleValue tv = new TeleValue(a);
        tv.configure(10, 20, 1, 15, "");
        final int[] seen = {-1};
        tv.setOnValueChanged(v -> seen[0] = v);
        assertEquals(15, tv.getValue());
        tv.setValue(16, true);
        assertEquals(16, tv.getValue());
        assertEquals(16, seen[0]);
        // Clamped to the configured range.
        tv.setValue(999, true);
        assertEquals(20, tv.getValue());
        tv.setValue(-999, true);
        assertEquals(10, tv.getValue());
    }

    @Test
    public void zoomMinimumFollowsTimelineLength() {
        Activity a = launch();
        WaveformView wv = new WaveformView(a);
        int minShort = Math.round(wv.minimumZoom() * 100f);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4000; i++) wv.push(0.5f);
        int minLong = Math.round(wv.minimumZoom() * 100f);
        assertEquals("history did not grow", 4000, wv.historyCount());
        assertTrue("minimum zoom did not drop for a longer timeline",
                minLong < minShort);
        // And the floor must never be above the old fixed 0.5.
        assertTrue("minimum zoom exceeds the old cap",
                wv.minimumZoom() <= 0.5f);
    }
}
