package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 audio generator: renders tone, chirp, white / pink / brown noise,
 * silence, a rhythm track, a plucked string or DTMF tones into the region.
 *
 * <p>The generator writes over the selected region, so it behaves like
 * Audacity's Generate command rather than a filter.
 */
final class AudioGeneratorTool extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Tone & Chirp", "Noise",
            "Silence", "Rhythm Track", "DTMF"};
    private static final String[] WAVE_LABELS = {"Sine", "Square", "Sawtooth",
            "Triangle", "Square No-Alias"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gen_type", "Generator", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter wave = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gen_wave", "Waveform", WAVE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter startFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_start", "Start Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 1000));
    private final FxParameter endFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_end", "End Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 10, 1000));
    private final FxParameter amplitude = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_amp", "Amplitude", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter duration = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gen_dur", "Duration", " s", 0.1f, 600f, 5f));
    private final FxParameter tempo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_bpm", "Tempo", " BPM", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter sequence = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gen_seq", "DTMF Sequence", "", 0, 15, 1, 5));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private long rng = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEL;

    AudioGeneratorTool() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "generator";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Audio Generator";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Tone, chirp, noise, rhythm or DTMF generator";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.ANALYZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        rng = 0xDEADBEEFCAFEBABEL;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int outFrames = Math.max(1, Math.round(duration.getFloat() * sampleRate));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * ch];
        int typeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();
        float amp = amplitude.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        switch (typeIdx) {
            case 0: // Tone & chirp
                renderTone(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            case 1: // Noise
                renderNoise(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            case 2: // Silence
                break;
            case 3: // Rhythm track
                renderRhythm(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
            default: // DTMF
                renderDtmf(out, outFrames, ch, amp);
                break;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private void renderTone(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        double phase = 0;
        double f0 = startFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        double f1 = endFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            double u = frames <= 1 ? 0 : f / (double) (frames - 1);
            double freq = f0 + (f1 - f0) * u;
            phase += 2 * Math.PI * freq / sampleRate;
            float s = waveSample(wave.getEnumIndex(), phase);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp;
        }
    }

    private void renderNoise(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        // The noise type is taken from the waveform selector: square stands
        // for white, triangle for pink and sawtooth for brown.
        int waveIdx = wave.getEnumIndex();
        float pinkB0 = 0f;
        float pinkB1 = 0f;
        float brown = 0f;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float white = nextNoise();
            float s;
            if (waveIdx == 0) {
                s = white;
            } else if (waveIdx == 1) {
                // Pink (Paul Kellet's economy filter).
                pinkB0 = 0.99765f * pinkB0 + white * 0.0990460f;
                pinkB1 = 0.96300f * pinkB1 + white * 0.2965164f;
                s = (pinkB0 + pinkB1 + white * 0.1848f) * 0.4f;
            } else if (waveIdx == 2) {
                // Brown (leaky integrator).
                brown = (brown + white * 0.02f) * 0.998f;
                s = brown * 3.5f;
            } else if (waveIdx == 3) {
                // Blue / differentiated high-frequency noise.
                s = (white - pinkB0) * 0.5f;
                pinkB0 = white;
            } else {
                // Velvet / sparse impulse noise.
                s = Math.abs(white) > 0.85f ? (white > 0f ? 1f : -1f) : 0f;
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp;
        }
    }

    private void renderRhythm(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        int bpm = tempo.getCurrentRaw();
        int framesPerBeat = Math.max(1, (int) (60.0 * sampleRate / bpm));
        int index = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int pos = f % framesPerBeat;
            float s = 0f;
            if (pos < framesPerBeat / 8) {
                // A short damped sine "ping".
                double t = pos / (double) sampleRate;
                s = (float) (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 880 * t)
                        * Math.exp(-t * 40.0));
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s * amp * 0.8f;
            index++;
        }
    }

    private void renderDtmf(float[] out, int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        int seqVal = Math.max(0, sequence.getCurrentRaw());
        int[] rows = {697, 770, 852, 941};
        int[] cols = {1209, 1336, 1477, 1633};
        int numDigits = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, (seqVal % 4) + 1));
        int slotFrames = Math.max(1, frames / numDigits);
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int slotIdx = Math.min(numDigits - 1, f / slotFrames);
            int posInSlot = f - slotIdx * slotFrames;
            if (numDigits > 1 && posInSlot >= slotFrames * 0.75) {
                continue; // 25% inter-digit silence gap
            }
            int digit = (seqVal + slotIdx * 3) & 0x0F;
            int row = (digit / 4) & 3;
            int col = digit & 3;
            double f1 = rows[row];
            double f2 = cols[col];
            double t = f / (double) sampleRate;
            double s = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f1 * t) + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f2 * t);
            s *= 0.5;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = (float) (s * amp);
        }
    }

    static float waveSample(int waveIdx, double phase) {
        double p = phase / (2 * Math.PI);
        p = p - Math.floor(p);
        switch (waveIdx) {
            case 1: // Square
                return p < 0.5 ? 1f : -1f;
            case 2: // Sawtooth
                return (float) (2 * p - 1);
            case 3: // Triangle
                return (float) (p < 0.5 ? 4 * p - 1 : 3 - 4 * p);
            case 4: { // Square no-alias: band-limited via additive synthesis
                double s = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= 15; k += 2) {
                    s += Math.sin(k * phase) / k;
                }
                return (float) (s * 4 / Math.PI);
            }
            case 0:
            default:
                return (float) Math.sin(phase);
        }
    }

    private float nextNoise() {
        rng = rng * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        int bits = (int) ((rng >>> 33) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        return (bits / (float) 0x7FFFFFFF) * 2f - 1f;
    }
}


=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/AudioImporter.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.MediaCodec;
import android.media.MediaExtractor;
import android.media.MediaFormat;
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Decodes a library take (float/16-bit WAV, M4A/AAC, …) into a fresh 32-bit
 * float WAV session file so the studio can punch in from its end. The
 * original file is never touched.
 */
public final class AudioImporter {

    public interface Progress {
        void onProgress(int percent);
    }

    /** Metadata and stored file returned by {@link #importOriginal}. */
    public static final class ImportedAudio {
        public final File file;
        public final long durationMs;
        public final String title;
        public final String badge;

        public ImportedAudio(File file, long durationMs, String title,
                             String badge) {
            this.file = file;
            this.durationMs = durationMs;
            this.title = title;
            this.badge = badge;
        }
    }

    /** Bound on draining a decoder that never signals end of stream. */
    private static final long DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000L;

    private AudioImporter() {}

    /**
     * True when {@code src} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit IEEE float mono/stereo
     * WAV, so preparing an edit session is a straight byte copy rather than a
     * format conversion.
     */
    public static boolean isNativeFloatWav(File src) {
        if (src == null || !src.exists()) return false;
        try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            return h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32
                    && h.sampleRate == RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE
                    && (h.channels == 1 || h.channels == 2)
                    && h.dataStart == 44L
                    && Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart) > 0;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copies a user-selected SAF document directly into the takes directory
     * in its original container/format without converting it to 32-bit float.
     * Its 32-bit float master is created lazily the first time the user
     * presses Edit on the imported take.
     */
    public static ImportedAudio importOriginal(Context ctx,
                                               android.net.Uri uri,
                                               File targetDir) throws Exception {
        if (ctx == null || uri == null || targetDir == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing import source");
        }
        String display = queryDisplayName(ctx, uri);
        String ext = extensionOf(display);
        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
            ext = extensionFromMime(ctx, uri);
        }
        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
            ext = "m4a";
        }
        String rawTitle = stripExtension(display != null ? display
                : "Imported_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
        String cleanBase = rawTitle.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
        if (cleanBase.isEmpty()) cleanBase = "Imported";
        String prettyTitle = Dsp.prettyFileTitle(cleanBase + "." + ext);
        if (prettyTitle.isEmpty()) prettyTitle = cleanBase;

        File dst = uniqueImportedFile(targetDir, cleanBase, ext);
        try {
            try (java.io.InputStream in =
                         ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                 java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                         new java.io.FileOutputStream(dst)) {
                if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("cannot open uri");
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
                out.getFD().sync();
            }
            if (!dst.exists() || dst.length() <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("empty import");
            }
            long durMs;
            String badge;
            if ("wav".equals(ext)) {
                try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "r")) {
                    Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
                    if (h.channels < 1 || h.channels > 2 || h.sampleRate <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav");
                    }
                    long onDisk = Math.max(0L, r.length() - h.dataStart);
                    if (onDisk <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("empty wav");
                    }
                }
                durMs = Math.max(1000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst));
                badge = TakesRepository.wavBadge(dst);
            } else {
                durMs = probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(dst);
                badge = badgeForExtension(dst, ext);
            }
            return new ImportedAudio(dst, durMs, prettyTitle, badge);
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
    }

    private static File uniqueImportedFile(File dir, String base, String ext) {
        String stamp = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",
                Locale.US).format(new java.util.Date());
        File c = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + "." + ext);
        if (!c.exists()) return c;
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            File n = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + " (" + i + ")." + ext);
            if (!n.exists()) return n;
            i++;
        }
    }

    private static String extensionFromMime(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri) {
        try {
            String mime = ctx.getContentResolver().getType(uri);
            if (mime == null) return "";
            String lower = mime.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            if (lower.contains("wav")) return "wav";
            if (lower.contains("flac")) return "flac";
            if (lower.contains("opus")) return "opus";
            if (lower.contains("ogg")) return "ogg";
            if (lower.contains("mpeg") || lower.contains("mp3")) return "mp3";
            if (lower.contains("3gpp") || lower.contains("amr")) return "3gp";
            if (lower.contains("aac")) return "aac";
            if (lower.contains("mp4") || lower.contains("m4a")) return "m4a";
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return "";
    }

    private static String badgeForExtension(File f, String ext) {
        switch (ext.toLowerCase(Locale.US)) {
            case "wav":
                return TakesRepository.wavBadge(f);
            case "m4a":
            case "aac":
                return "M4A";
            case "flac":
                return "FLAC";
            case "opus":
            case "webm":
            case "ogg":
                return "OPUS";
            case "3gp":
            case "3ga":
                return TakesRepository.containsToken(
                        f, new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'}) ? "AMR-WB" : "AMR";
            case "mp3":
                return "MP3";
            default:
                return ext.toUpperCase(Locale.US);
        }
    }

    private static long probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(File src)
            throws Exception {
        long durationMs = -1L;
        boolean hasAudio = false;
        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
        try {
            ex.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
            for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
                MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
                String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
                if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
                    hasAudio = true;
                    try {
                        if (f.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)) {
                            durationMs = f.getLong(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)
                                    / 1000L;
                        }
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    break;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            try {
                ex.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (!hasAudio || durationMs <= 0) {
            MediaMetadataRetriever mmr = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
            try {
                mmr.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
                String has = mmr.extractMetadata(
                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_HAS_AUDIO);
                String dur = mmr.extractMetadata(
                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
                if (has != null && !has.isEmpty()) {
                    hasAudio = true;
                }
                if (dur != null) {
                    long parsed = (long) Double.parseDouble(dur);
                    if (parsed > 0) {
                        hasAudio = true;
                        durationMs = parsed;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                try {
                    mmr.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (!hasAudio) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track");
        }
        return Math.max(1000L, durationMs);
    }

    /**
     * Imports a user-selected SAF document into the takes directory as a
     * 32-bit float WAV edit master. Supports WAV PCM/float and any container
     * the platform decoder can turn into PCM (M4A/AAC, MP3, OGG/Opus, FLAC,
     * AMR, …). Throws when no decodable audio is present.
     */
    public static File importToFloatWav(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri,
                                        File targetDir) throws Exception {
        if (ctx == null || uri == null || targetDir == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing import source");
        }
        String display = queryDisplayName(ctx, uri);
        String ext = extensionOf(display);
        File temp = File.createTempFile("takeone_import_",
                ext.isEmpty() ? ".audio" : "." + ext, ctx.getCacheDir());
        try {
            try (java.io.InputStream in =
                         ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                 java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                         new java.io.FileOutputStream(temp)) {
                if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("cannot open uri");
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
            }
            String base = stripExtension(display != null ? display
                    : "Imported_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
            base = base.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
            if (base.isEmpty()) base = "Imported";
            return takeToFloatWav(temp, targetDir, base, null);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            temp.delete();
        }
    }

    private static String queryDisplayName(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri) {
        try (android.database.Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(uri,
                new String[]{android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME},
                null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                int idx = c.getColumnIndex(
                        android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                if (idx >= 0) return c.getString(idx);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    private static String extensionOf(String name) {
        if (name == null) return "";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot < 0 || dot == name.length() - 1) return "";
        return name.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
    }

    private static String stripExtension(String name) {
        if (name == null) return "Imported";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        return dot > 0 ? name.substring(0, dot) : name;
    }

    /**
     * @param dstParent   directory for the new session file (takes dir).
     * @param baseName    sanitized take title used for the session file name.
     * @return the new float WAV session file (without a pending marker —
     * callers attach it via the engine, which writes the marker).
     */
    public static File takeToFloatWav(File src, File dstParent, String baseName,
                                      Progress cb) throws Exception {
        String lower = src.getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        File dst = uniqueSession(dstParent, baseName);
        try {
            if (lower.endsWith(".wav")) {
                wavToFloatWav(src, dst, cb);
            } else {
                compressedToFloatWav(src, dst, cb);
            }
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            // A4-05: the session file lives in takes/ and starts with a
            // header. If decoding throws, a truncated float WAV would be
            // sitting there with no .pending marker, and the next launch
            // would adopt it into the library as a take full of noise.
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        // FMT-02d: validation lives inside the try so a malformed import
        // deletes its output too; otherwise the orphan is adopted on the
        // next launch by reconcile().
        try {
            // Importer output preserves the source geometry (mono stays
            // mono); callers attach the session with these exact channels.
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(dst);
            if (info.channels < 1 || info.channels > 2
                    || info.sampleRate != RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("bad import channels/rate");
            }
            if (info.dataBytes <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("empty import");
            }
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
        return dst;
    }

    private static File uniqueSession(File dir, String base) {
        String stamp = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",
                java.util.Locale.US).format(new java.util.Date());
        File c = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + ".raw.wav");
        if (!c.exists()) return c;
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            File n = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + " (" + i
                    + ").raw.wav");
            if (!n.exists()) return n;
            i++;
        }
    }

    // ---- WAV sources ----

    private static void wavToFloatWav(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        try {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            int ch = h.channels;
            int sr = h.sampleRate;
            if (ch < 1 || ch > 2) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav (need mono/stereo)");
            }
            int bytesPerSample;
            if (h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32) bytesPerSample = 4;
            else if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 16) bytesPerSample = 2;
            else if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 24) bytesPerSample = 3;
            else throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav encoding");
            long onDisk = Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart);
            long dataBytes = h.dataBytes;
            if (dataBytes <= 0 || dataBytes > onDisk) dataBytes = onDisk;
            long totalSrcFrames = dataBytes / bytesPerSample / ch;
            if (totalSrcFrames <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("empty wav");
            // Fast path: source is already 48 kHz 32-bit IEEE float WAV.
            // Copy raw payload bytes directly without unpacking floats or
            // running Dsp.Resampler.
            if (h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32
                    && sr == RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) {
                long payloadBytes = totalSrcFrames * ch * 4L;
                try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw")) {
                    w.setLength(0);
                    w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, payloadBytes));
                    r.seek(h.dataStart);
                    byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                    long left = payloadBytes;
                    while (left > 0) {
                        int n = r.read(buf, 0,
                                (int) Math.min(buf.length, left));
                        if (n <= 0) break;
                        w.write(buf, 0, n);
                        left -= n;
                    }
                    long actual = Math.max(0L, w.length() - 44L);
                    if (actual != payloadBytes) {
                        w.seek(0);
                        w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, actual));
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
            // Mono stays mono; foreign rates are resampled to the session
            // rate instead of being stamped with a lying header.
            Dsp.Resampler resampler =
                    new Dsp.Resampler(sr, RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE, ch);
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, 0));
                // Seek explicitly to the parsed data chunk start (NEW-01).
                r.seek(h.dataStart);
                byte[] in = new byte[32768 * 2 * 4];
                ByteBuffer ib = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                float[] fbuf = new float[32768 * 2];
                long done = 0;
                long payloadBytes = 0;
                int lastPct = -1;
                while (done < totalSrcFrames) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(32768, totalSrcFrames - done);
                    // NEW-01 fix: `want` is in frames, so read `want * ch`
                    // samples (`samplesToRead * bytesPerSample` bytes).
                    int samplesToRead = want * ch;
                    float[] samples;
                    if (h.audioFormat == 3) {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 4);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 4);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            fbuf[i] = ib.getFloat();
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    } else if (h.bits == 24) {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 3);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 3);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            int v = (ib.get() & 0xFF)
                                    | ((ib.get() & 0xFF) << 8)
                                    | (ib.get() << 16);
                            if ((v & 0x800000) != 0) v |= 0xFF000000;
                            fbuf[i] = v / 8388608f;
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    } else {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 2);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 2);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            fbuf[i] = ib.getShort() / 32768f;
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    }
                    int outFrames = samples.length / ch;
                    if (outFrames > 0) {
                        Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, samples, 0, samples.length);
                        payloadBytes += (long) outFrames * ch * 4;
                    }
                    done += want;
                    if (cb != null) {
                        int pct = (int) (done * 100
                                / Math.max(1, totalSrcFrames));
                        if (pct != lastPct) {
                            lastPct = pct;
                            cb.onProgress(pct);
                        }
                    }
                }
                float[] tail = resampler.flush();
                if (tail.length > 0) {
                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, tail, 0, tail.length);
                    payloadBytes += tail.length * 4L;
                }
                w.seek(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, payloadBytes));
            } finally {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }


    private static int pcmBytesPerSample(int encoding) {
        switch (encoding) {
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_8BIT:
                return 1;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED:
                return 3;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_32BIT:
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT:
                return 4;
            default:
                return 2;
        }
    }

    private static float readPcmSample(ByteBuffer b, int encoding) {
        switch (encoding) {
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_8BIT:
                return ((b.get() & 0xff) - 128) / 128f;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED: {
                int b0 = b.get() & 0xff;
                int b1 = b.get() & 0xff;
                int b2 = b.get();
                int v = (b2 << 16) | (b1 << 8) | b0;
                return v / 8388608f;
            }
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_32BIT:
                return b.getInt() / 2147483648f;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT:
                return b.getFloat();
            default:
                return b.getShort() / 32768f;
        }
    }

    // ---- compressed sources (M4A/AAC/MP3/…) via platform decoder ----

    private static void compressedToFloatWav(File src, File dst, Progress cb)
            throws Exception {
        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
        try {
            ex.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
            int track = -1;
            MediaFormat trackFmt = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
                MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
                String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
                if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
                    track = i;
                    trackFmt = f;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (track < 0 || trackFmt == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track");
            }
            int srcCh = 2;
            try {
                srcCh = trackFmt.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            int srcRate = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
            try {
                srcRate = trackFmt.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (srcRate <= 0) srcRate = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
            long durationUs = 0;
            try {
                durationUs = trackFmt.getLong(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            String mime = trackFmt.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
            ex.selectTrack(track);

            // Mono stays mono (downmix only beyond stereo); the rate is
            // resampled to the session rate instead of being stamped with a
            // lying 48 kHz header.
            int outCh = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, srcCh));
            Dsp.Resampler resampler =
                    new Dsp.Resampler(srcRate, RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE,
                            outCh);

            MediaCodec dec = MediaCodec.createDecoderByType(mime);
            // A4-05/FMT-02a: pin the decoder output to 16-bit PCM. Set it on
            // the track format directly: MediaFormat's copy constructor only
            // exists from API 29, so `new MediaFormat(trackFmt)` threw
            // NoSuchMethodError (an Error, not caught below) on API 24-28.
            try {
                trackFmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_PCM_ENCODING,
                        android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            dec.configure(trackFmt, null, null, 0);
            dec.start();
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            boolean muxed = false;
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(outCh, 0));
                float[] fbuf = new float[16384 * 2];
                MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
                boolean inEos = false;
                boolean outEos = false;
                long payloadBytes = 0;
                int lastPct = -1;
                // FMT-02c: bound the post-EOS drain. An OEM decoder that
                // never emits END_OF_STREAM otherwise hangs the import
                // dialog forever.
                int pcmEncoding = android.media.AudioFormat
                        .ENCODING_PCM_16BIT;
                long drainDeadline = 0;
                while (!outEos) {
                    if (!inEos) {
                        int idx = dec.dequeueInputBuffer(5000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            ByteBuffer ib = dec.getInputBuffer(idx);
                            int n = ex.readSampleData(ib, 0);
                            if (n < 0) {
                                dec.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                        MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                inEos = true;
                                drainDeadline = android.os.SystemClock
                                        .elapsedRealtime() + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                            } else {
                                dec.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, n,
                                        ex.getSampleTime(), 0);
                                ex.advance();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    int oidx = dec.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 5000);
                    if (oidx >= 0) {
                        if (bi.size > 0) {
                            ByteBuffer ob = dec.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                            // NEW-02 fix: MediaCodec output ByteBuffers
                            // default to BIG_ENDIAN; set LITTLE_ENDIAN so
                            // getShort() does not byte-swap PCM samples.
                            ob.order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                            ob.position(bi.offset);
                            ob.limit(bi.offset + bi.size);
                            // Decoder PCM is 16-bit: convert to float, then
                            // resample onto the session grid.
                            // FMT-02b: KEY_PCM_ENCODING is only a hint. If
                            // the decoder still reports float output, read
                            // 4-byte samples; reading them as shorts byte-swaps
                            // and doubles the apparent duration.
                            final int pcmEnc = pcmEncoding;
                            final int bytesPerSample = pcmBytesPerSample(pcmEnc);
                            int samples = bi.size / bytesPerSample;
                            int frames = samples / Math.max(1, srcCh);
                            int fpos = 0;
                            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                                float s0 = readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc);
                                float s1 = srcCh > 1
                                        ? readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc) : s0;
                                // Skip any extra channels beyond stereo.
                                for (int c = 2; c < srcCh; c++) {
                                    readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc);
                                }
                                if (outCh == 1) {
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = srcCh > 1
                                            ? (s0 + s1) * 0.5f : s0;
                                } else {
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = s0;
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = s1;
                                }
                                if (fpos + 2 > fbuf.length) {
                                    float[] conv = resampler.push(fbuf,
                                            fpos / outCh);
                                    if (conv.length > 0) {
                                        Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, conv, 0,
                                                conv.length);
                                        payloadBytes += conv.length * 4L;
                                    }
                                    fpos = 0;
                                }
                            }
                            if (fpos > 0) {
                                float[] conv = resampler.push(fbuf,
                                        fpos / outCh);
                                if (conv.length > 0) {
                                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, conv, 0, conv.length);
                                    payloadBytes += conv.length * 4L;
                                }
                            }
                            if (cb != null && durationUs > 0) {
                                int pct = (int) (bi.presentationTimeUs * 100
                                        / Math.max(1, durationUs));
                                pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(99, pct));
                                if (pct != lastPct) {
                                    lastPct = pct;
                                    cb.onProgress(pct);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        dec.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                            outEos = true;
                        }
                    } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                        if (inEos && android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                > drainDeadline) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "decoder never finished");
                        }
                    } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                        try {
                            MediaFormat of = dec.getOutputFormat();
                            try {
                                pcmEncoding = of.getInteger(
                                        MediaFormat.KEY_PCM_ENCODING);
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            int newCh = of.getInteger(
                                    MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT);
                            int newRate = srcRate;
                            try {
                                newRate = of.getInteger(
                                        MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE);
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            if (newCh >= 1 && newCh <= 8
                                    && newRate > 0) {
                                if (payloadBytes > 0
                                        && (newCh != srcCh
                                        || newRate != srcRate)) {
                                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                                            "decoder geometry changed mid-stream");
                                }
                                srcCh = newCh;
                                srcRate = newRate;
                                outCh = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, srcCh));
                                resampler = new Dsp.Resampler(srcRate,
                                        RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE, outCh);
                            }
                        } catch (IllegalStateException ise) {
                            throw ise;
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                    muxed = true;
                }
                float[] tail = resampler.flush();
                if (tail.length > 0) {
                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, tail, 0, tail.length);
                    payloadBytes += tail.length * 4L;
                }
                if (!muxed || payloadBytes <= 0) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("decode produced no audio");
                }
                w.seek(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(outCh, payloadBytes));
            } finally {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                // Stop/release the decoder HERE, not after this block: any
                // throw inside the loop above must not skip them and leak
                // the native MediaCodec instance.
                try {
                    dec.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    dec.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                ex.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Base class for every effect in the rack. A processor owns its {@link
 * FxParameter} list, its enable state and its wet/dry mix, and implements the
 * actual DSP in {@link #processInPlace}. This replaces the old single-integer
 * {@code DspChain.EffectSlot} model: each effect can now expose any number of
 * typed parameters, and the FX inspector renders them generically.
 *
 * <p>Subclasses that are 2-pass or change duration override
 * {@link #isOfflineOnly()} so the realtime path skips them; effects with a
 * tail (reverb/delay) report {@link #getTailFrames()}.
 */
public abstract class AudioProcessor {

    private volatile boolean enabled = true;
    private volatile float wetDryMix = 1.0f;
    private final List<FxParameter> parameters = new ArrayList<>();
    /**
     * Identity of the rack entry this processor belongs to. Rack-local
     * effects (the Stage 3+ suite) use the slot's instance id so the same
     * effect can be inserted twice and each copy keeps its own state; the
     * legacy stages leave it null and are matched by {@link #getId()}.
     */
    private volatile String instanceKey;

    public String getInstanceKey() {
        return instanceKey;
    }

    public void setInstanceKey(String key) {
        this.instanceKey = key;
    }

    public abstract String getId();

    public abstract String getTitle();

    public abstract String getDescription();

    public abstract FxCategory getCategory();

    /** Configures channel count / sample rate; called before the first block. */
    public abstract void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels);

    /** Clears all filter/envelope state (start of a new edit region). */
    public abstract void reset();

    /**
     * Optional offline pre-scan over the exact range about to be rendered.
     * Level tools (amplify, normalize, loudness) use this to measure peak,
     * DC offset or integrated loudness before the first sample is written.
     * The default is a no-op, so real-time processors need no extra work.
     */
    public void prepareOffline(java.io.File raw, long startFrame,
                               long endFrame, int sampleRate, int channels)
            throws Exception {
    }

    /** Processes {@code frames} interleaved frames in place. */
    public abstract void processInPlace(float[] interleaved, int frames,
                                        int channels);

    /** True for processors that need a second pass or alter duration. */
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Renders an entire region offline and returns the interleaved result.
     *
     * <p>The returned array may be longer or shorter than the input when the
     * effect changes duration (Change Tempo, Change Speed, Paulstretch,
     * Repeat, Truncate Silence). {@code null} means "this processor has no
     * offline renderer", and the caller then keeps the region untouched.
     */
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        return null;
    }

    /** Latency/tail in frames after the input ends (reverb, delay). */
    public int getTailFrames() {
        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * Algorithmic group delay / lookahead latency in frames (e.g. {@code taps / 2}
     * for linear-phase FIR filters). Offline range commits shift and drain by
     * this offset so processed audio stays sample-aligned with dry boundaries.
     */
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * True when the processor blends its own {@link #getWetDryMix()} internally
     * (e.g. phase-aligned linear-phase FIR blending) so {@link FxRackChain}
     * does not blend undelayed dry samples against delayed wet samples.
     */
    public boolean handlesOwnWetDryMix() {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean isEnabled() {
        return enabled;
    }

    public void setEnabled(boolean en) {
        this.enabled = en;
    }

    public float getWetDryMix() {
        return wetDryMix;
    }

    public void setWetDryMix(float mix0to1) {
        this.wetDryMix = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, mix0to1));
    }

    public List<FxParameter> getParameters() {
        return parameters;
    }

    protected FxParameter addParameter(FxParameter p) {
        if (p != null) parameters.add(p);
        return p;
    }

    public FxParameter getParam(String id) {
        for (FxParameter p : parameters) {
            if (p.id.equals(id)) return p;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * True when this processor would alter audio if it ran (amount above the
     * engine's 0.001 gate). Used by chains to decide activeness.
     */
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return enabled && wetDryMix > 0.001f;
    }

    /** Serializes enable, mix and every parameter's raw value. */
    public JSONObject saveState() {
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("id", getId());
            o.put("enabled", enabled);
            o.put("mix", (double) wetDryMix);
            JSONArray a = new JSONArray();
            for (FxParameter p : parameters) a.put(p.toJson());
            o.put("params", a);
            return o;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONObject();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Restores enable, mix and parameters by id. Unknown ids are ignored so a
     * rack saved by a newer build still loads.
     */
    public void loadState(JSONObject json) {
        if (json == null) return;
        enabled = json.optBoolean("enabled", enabled);
        float m = (float) json.optDouble("mix", (double) wetDryMix);
        wetDryMix = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, m));
        JSONArray a = json.optJSONArray("params");
        if (a == null) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject po = a.optJSONObject(i);
            if (po == null) continue;
            FxParameter mine = getParam(po.optString("id", ""));
            if (mine == null) continue;
            mine.setCurrentRaw(po.optInt("cur", mine.getCurrentRaw()));
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 auto-duck / sidechain leveler: detects speech-like activity
 * above the threshold, bridges gaps shorter than the maximum pause and
 * applies trapezoidal gain ramps while the speech is active.
 *
 * <p>The speech detector uses a band-passed (300 Hz - 4 kHz) energy
 * follower, so broadband rumble and cymbals do not trigger the ducking.
 */
final class AutoDuckProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter duckAmount = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "duck_amount", "Duck Amount", -36f, 0f, -12f));
    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "duck_thresh", "Threshold", -60f, -6f, -30f));
    private final FxParameter maxPause = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "duck_pause", "Maximum Pause", " ms", 50, 5000, 50, 800));
    private final FxParameter fadeDown = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "duck_fadedown", "Fade Down", " ms", 10, 2000, 10, 200));
    private final FxParameter fadeUp = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "duck_fadeup", "Fade Up", " ms", 10, 2000, 10, 400));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter speechBand = new BiquadFilter();
    private BiquadFilter speechBandHigh = new BiquadFilter();
    private DynamicsDetector.Envelope envelope;
    private float gainDb = 0f;
    private int silenceFrames = 0;

    AutoDuckProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "autoduck";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Auto Duck";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Speech-triggered ducking envelope with pause bridging";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        speechBand.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, 300, 0.7071)},
                channels);
        speechBandHigh.setSections(new float[][]{
                Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, 4000, 0.7071)}, channels);
        envelope = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        speechBand.reset();
        speechBandHigh.reset();
        if (envelope != null) envelope.reset();
        gainDb = 0f;
        silenceFrames = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && duckAmount.getFloat() < -0.01f;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (envelope == null) {
            envelope = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
            speechBand.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, 300, 0.7071)}, channels);
            speechBandHigh.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, 4000, 0.7071)}, channels);
        }

        float duck = duckAmount.getFloat();
        float thresh = threshold.getFloat();
        int pauseFrames = Math.max(1,
                (int) (maxPause.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        float downCoef = 1f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.001f, fadeDown.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f) * sampleRate));
        float upCoef = 1f - (float) Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.001f, fadeUp.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f) * sampleRate));

        final int block = 128;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] side = new float[n * ch];
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, side, 0, side.length);
            speechBand.process(side, n, ch);
            speechBandHigh.process(side, n, ch);
            float levelDb = envelope.detect(side, n, ch, false, 5f, 80f);

            boolean speaking = levelDb > thresh;
            if (speaking) {
                silenceFrames = 0;
            } else {
                silenceFrames += n;
            }
            // Gaps shorter than the maximum pause keep the duck engaged.
            boolean ducked = speaking || silenceFrames < pauseFrames;

            float target = ducked ? duck : 0f;
            float coef = (target < gainDb) ? downCoef : upCoef;
            float step = (target - gainDb) * coef;
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                gainDb += step;
                float g = Dsp.dbToLin(gainDb);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= g;
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 3 · A4: tone-control style bass & treble shelves (250 Hz / 3.5 kHz)
 * plus a master volume trim. With "Link" on, the treble follows the bass
 * knob for one-hand tilting.
 */
final class BassAndTrebleProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final double BASS_HZ = 250.0;
    private static final double TREBLE_HZ = 3500.0;
    private static final double SHELF_S = 0.9;

    private final FxParameter bass = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("bass", "Bass", -30f, 30f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter treble = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("treble", "Treble", -30f, 30f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter volume = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("vol", "Volume", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter link = addParameter(
            FxParameter.boolParam("link", "Link Bass/Treble", false));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 1;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "basstreble";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Bass & Treble";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Classic tone stack: 250 Hz bass shelf, 3.5 kHz treble shelf, volume";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sr, int ch) {
        sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sr);
        channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        if (bass.getCurrentRaw() != 0 || volume.getCurrentRaw() != 0) return true;
        return !link.getBoolean() && treble.getCurrentRaw() != 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        this.channels = c;
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), c);
        filter.process(buf, frames, c);
    }

    float[][] buildSections() {
        double b = bass.getFloat();
        double t = link.getBoolean() ? b : treble.getFloat();
        float[][] secs = new float[3][];
        secs[0] = Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sampleRate, BASS_HZ, SHELF_S, b);
        secs[1] = Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, TREBLE_HZ, SHELF_S, t);
        secs[2] = Dsp.gainBiquad(Dsp.dbToLin(volume.getFloat()));
        return secs;
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/BiquadFilter.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Cascade of up to {@link Dsp} biquad sections with per-channel direct-form
 * II transposed state. Shared by every Stage 3 filter effect: processors
 * rebuild the {@code float[][]} section list from their parameters and hand
 * it here; the filter keeps the history so live parameter edits never click.
 */
public final class BiquadFilter {

    private float[][] sections = new float[0][];
    private float[] z1 = new float[0];
    private float[] z2 = new float[0];
    private int channels = 1;

    /** Installs new coefficients, preserving state when the count matches. */
    public void setSections(float[][] newSections, int channels) {
        if (newSections == null) newSections = new float[0][];
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        boolean realloc = this.sections.length != newSections.length
                || this.channels != ch
                || z1.length != newSections.length * ch;
        if (!realloc) {
            int n = Math.min(this.sections.length, newSections.length);
            for (int s = 0; s < n; s++) {
                if (isIdentity(newSections[s]) && !isIdentity(this.sections[s])) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        z1[s * ch + c] = 0f;
                        z2[s * ch + c] = 0f;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        this.sections = newSections;
        this.channels = ch;
        if (realloc) {
            z1 = new float[newSections.length * ch];
            z2 = new float[newSections.length * ch];
        }
    }

    private static boolean isIdentity(float[] c) {
        if (c == null || c.length < 5) return false;
        return Math.abs(c[0] - 1f) < 1e-6f
                && Math.abs(c[1]) < 1e-6f
                && Math.abs(c[2]) < 1e-6f
                && Math.abs(c[3]) < 1e-6f
                && Math.abs(c[4]) < 1e-6f;
    }

    public int sectionCount() {
        return sections.length;
    }

    public void reset() {
        for (int i = 0; i < z1.length; i++) {
            z1[i] = 0f;
            z2[i] = 0f;
        }
    }

    /** Processes interleaved frames in place. */
    public void process(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        process(buf, frames, ch, 0);
    }

    /**
     * Processes interleaved frames in place, starting at {@code frameOffset}.
     * The offset variant lets a caller sweep the coefficients over a block
     * without copying the samples out of the buffer.
     */
    public void process(float[] buf, int frames, int ch, int frameOffset) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0 || sections.length == 0) return;
        final int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, Math.min(ch, channels)));
        final int secs = sections.length;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = (f + frameOffset) * c;
            if (idx + c > buf.length) break;
            for (int chn = 0; chn < c; chn++) {
                float x = buf[idx + chn];
                for (int s = 0; s < secs; s++) {
                    float[] co = sections[s];
                    int k = s * c + chn;
                    float y = co[0] * x + z1[k];
                    z1[k] = co[1] * x - co[3] * y + z2[k];
                    z2[k] = co[2] * x - co[4] * y;
                    x = y;
                }
                buf[idx + chn] = x;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 brickwall limiter: a 3 ms look-ahead limiter with a sliding
 * maximum-gain envelope and optional soft / hard clipping at the ceiling.
 *
 * <p>The signal is delayed by the look-ahead window. While the delayed
 * sample waits, the limiter scans the peak of the incoming window and starts
 * the gain reduction before the transient arrives, so nothing ever exceeds
 * the ceiling and no distortion is introduced.
 */
final class BrickwallLimiterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "lim_ceiling", "Ceiling", -15f, -0.05f, -0.3f));
    private final FxParameter inputGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "lim_gain", "Input Gain", 0f, 24f, 3f));
    private final FxParameter hold = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "lim_hold", "Hold", " ms", 1f, 50f, 10f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "lim_release", "Release", " ms", 10f, 500f, 80f));
    private final FxParameter makeup = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "lim_makeup", "Apply Make-up Gain", false));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private int lookFrames = 144;
    /** Delayed samples, one ring per channel slot (interleaved). */
    private float[] delayRing;
    /** Un-driven delayed dry samples for phase-coherent wet/dry blending. */
    private float[] dryRing;
    /** Per-frame peak of the last {@code lookFrames + 1} frames. */
    private float[] peakRing;
    private int peakPos = 0;
    private int framesSeen = 0;
    private float gainDb = 0f;
    private int holdCounter = 0;

    BrickwallLimiterProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "bricklim";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Brickwall Limiter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "3 ms look-ahead limiter with soft/hard ceiling";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        lookFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.003));
        delayRing = new float[lookFrames * this.channels];
        dryRing = new float[lookFrames * this.channels];
        peakRing = new float[lookFrames + 1];
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        if (delayRing != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(delayRing, 0f);
        if (dryRing != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(dryRing, 0f);
        if (peakRing != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(peakRing, 0f);
        peakPos = 0;
        framesSeen = 0;
        gainDb = 0f;
        holdCounter = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && getWetDryMix() > 0.001f
                && (inputGain.getFloat() > 0.01f
                        || ceiling.getFloat() < -0.05f
                        || makeup.getBoolean());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean handlesOwnWetDryMix() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        return isAudible() ? lookFrames : 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float mix = getWetDryMix();
        if (!isEnabled() || mix <= 0.001f) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (delayRing == null || delayRing.length < lookFrames * ch
                || dryRing == null || dryRing.length < lookFrames * ch) {
            lookFrames = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.003));
            delayRing = new float[lookFrames * ch];
            dryRing = new float[lookFrames * ch];
            peakRing = new float[lookFrames + 1];
            peakPos = 0;
            framesSeen = 0;
        }
        float ceilLin = Dsp.dbToLin(ceiling.getFloat());
        float drive = Dsp.dbToLin(inputGain.getFloat());
        float mg = makeup.getBoolean()
                ? Dsp.dbToLin(Math.max(0f, -ceiling.getFloat()) * 0.5f) : 1f;
        int holdFrames = Math.max(1,
                (int) (hold.getFloat() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        float relCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.001f, release.getFloat() * 0.001f) * sampleRate)));
        float attCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.0002f, 0.0005f) * sampleRate)));

        final int ringSize = lookFrames + 1;
        float[] oldWet = new float[ch];
        float[] oldDry = new float[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            float framePeak = 0f;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float a = Math.abs(buf[idx + c] * drive * mg);
                if (a > framePeak) framePeak = a;
            }

            // The sample that leaves the delay line was captured
            // `lookFrames` ago; the gain for it is decided from the peak of
            // the window that ends with the sample we just received.
            int delayPos = framesSeen % lookFrames;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                oldWet[c] = delayRing[delayPos * ch + c];
                oldDry[c] = dryRing[delayPos * ch + c];
                dryRing[delayPos * ch + c] = buf[idx + c];
                delayRing[delayPos * ch + c] = buf[idx + c] * drive * mg;
            }
            peakRing[peakPos] = framePeak;

            float windowPeak = 0f;
            for (int k = 0; k < ringSize; k++) {
                float p = peakRing[k];
                if (p > windowPeak) windowPeak = p;
            }

            float requiredDb = windowPeak > ceilLin
                    ? Dsp.linToDb(windowPeak / ceilLin) : 0f;
            if (requiredDb > gainDb) {
                gainDb += attCoef * (requiredDb - gainDb);
                holdCounter = holdFrames;
            } else if (holdCounter > 0) {
                holdCounter--;
            } else {
                gainDb += relCoef * (requiredDb - gainDb);
                if (gainDb < 0f) gainDb = 0f;
            }

            float g = Dsp.dbToLin(-gainDb);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = oldWet[c] * g;
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > ceilLin) {
                    float over = a - ceilLin;
                    float shaped = ceilLin + over / (1f + over / (ceilLin + 1e-6f));
                    v = v < 0 ? -shaped : shaped;
                }
                buf[idx + c] = oldDry[c] * (1f - mix) + v * mix;
            }

            peakPos = (peakPos + 1) % ringSize;
            framesSeen++;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 change pitch: shifts the pitch without changing the tempo by
 * time-stretching the signal with WSOLA and resampling it back.
 */
final class ChangePitchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter semitones = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "pitch_semitones", "Semitones", "", -24f, 24f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter cents = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "pitch_cents", "Cents", "", -100, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter percent = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "pitch_percent", "Percent Change", "%", -50f, 100f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter preserveFormant = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "pitch_formant", "Preserve Formants", true));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    ChangePitchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "changepitch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Change Pitch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "WSOLA pitch shift that keeps the tempo";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && Math.abs(totalSemitones()) > 0.001f;
    }

    private float totalSemitones() {
        float s = semitones.getFloat() + cents.getFloat() / 100f;
        float pct = percent.getFloat();
        if (pct != 0f) {
            s += (float) (12.0 * Math.log(pct / 100.0 + 1.0) / Math.log(2.0));
        }
        return s;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        return wsola.pitchShift(in, frames, channels, totalSemitones(),
                preserveFormant.getBoolean());
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 change speed and pitch: a varispeed resampler that changes the
 * duration and the pitch together.
 */
final class ChangeSpeedAndPitchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter speed = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "speed_mult", "Speed Multiplier", "x", 0.25f, 4f, 1f));
    private final FxParameter percent = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "speed_percent", "Percent Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    ChangeSpeedAndPitchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "speedpitch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Change Speed and Pitch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Varispeed resampler: duration and pitch change together";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && speedFactor() != 1.0;
    }

    /** Speed multiplier: 2.0 plays twice as fast (half the duration). */
    private double speedFactor() {
        double s = speed.getFloat();
        double pct = percent.getFloat();
        double factor = s;
        if (Math.abs(pct) > 1e-4) {
            double pctFactor = 1.0 + pct / 100.0;
            if (Math.abs(s - pctFactor) < 0.02) {
                factor = pctFactor;
            } else if (Math.abs(s - 1.0) < 1e-4) {
                factor = pctFactor;
            } else {
                factor = s * pctFactor;
            }
        }
        return Math.max(0.1, Math.min(8.0, factor));
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double factor = speedFactor();
        if (Math.abs(factor - 1.0) < 1e-6) return in.clone();
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        return wsola.varispeed(in, frames, channels, factor);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 change tempo: WSOLA time-stretch that changes the duration while
 * keeping the pitch intact.
 */
final class ChangeTempoProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter percent = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "tempo_percent", "Percent Change", "%", -75f, 300f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter bpmFrom = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tempo_bpmfrom", "BPM From", "", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter bpmTo = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tempo_bpmto", "BPM To", "", 30, 300, 1, 120));
    private final FxParameter hq = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "tempo_hq", "High-Quality Speech Mode", true));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    ChangeTempoProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tempo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Change Tempo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "WSOLA time stretch without changing the pitch";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && stretchFactor() != 1.0;
    }

    /** The stretch factor: 2.0 means twice as long (half the tempo). */
    private double stretchFactor() {
        double pct = percent.getFloat();
        if (pct != 0f) {
            return 1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + pct / 100.0);
        }
        int from = bpmFrom.getCurrentRaw();
        int to = bpmTo.getCurrentRaw();
        if (from > 0 && to > 0 && from != to) {
            return (double) from / to;
        }
        return 1.0;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double factor = stretchFactor();
        if (Math.abs(factor - 1.0) < 1e-6) return in.clone();
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(sampleRate);
        return wsola.timeStretch(in, frames, channels, factor,
                hq.getBoolean());
    }
}
