package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 chorus and flanger: a modulated delay line read with 4-point
 * cubic Hermite interpolation and a 90 degree stereo LFO offset.
 */
final class ChorusFlangerProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Chorus", "Flanger", "Doubler"};

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "ch_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter baseDelay = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ch_delay", "Base Delay", " ms", 1f, 35f, 18f));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ch_rate", "LFO Rate", " Hz", 0.05f, 8f, 0.8f));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ch_depth", "Modulation Depth", "%", 0, 100, 1, 45));
    private final FxParameter feedback = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ch_fb", "Feedback", "%", -90, 90, 1, 15));
    private final FxParameter mix = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ch_mix", "Wet/Dry Mix", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    /** One mono ring buffer per channel. */
    private float[][] ring = new float[2][];
    private int mask = 0;
    private int writePos = 0;
    private double lfoPhase = 0;
    private float[] feedbackState = new float[2];

    ChorusFlangerProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "chorus";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Chorus & Flanger";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Modulated delay with cubic Hermite fractional reads";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (float[] r : ring) {
            if (r != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(r, 0f);
        }
        writePos = 0;
        lfoPhase = 0;
        feedbackState[0] = feedbackState[1] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && mix.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public int getTailFrames() {
        return (int) (sampleRate * 0.1);
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        int size = 1;
        while (size < 8192) size <<= 1;
        if (ring[0] == null || ring[0].length != size) {
            ring[0] = new float[size];
            ring[1] = new float[size];
            mask = size - 1;
            writePos = 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
        int modeIdx = mode.getEnumIndex();
        double baseSec = baseDelay.getFloat() * 0.001;
        if (modeIdx == 1) {
            baseSec = Math.min(baseSec, 0.0025);
        } else if (modeIdx == 2) {
            // Doubler mode: vocal slapback doubling window (15..35 ms) with
            // subtle pitch micro-detune and zero feedback regeneration.
            baseSec = Math.max(0.015, baseSec);
        }
        double baseSamples = baseSec * sampleRate;
        double depthSamples = baseSamples * (depth.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0) * 0.9;
        if (modeIdx == 2) {
            depthSamples *= 0.25;
        }
        double rateHz = rate.getFloat();
        double lfoInc = rateHz / sampleRate;
        float wet = mix.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float dry = 1f - wet;
        double fb = (modeIdx == 2) ? 0.0 : (feedback.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0);
        // Two feedback paths meet here: the recursive state (one pole at fb)
        // and the ring regeneration, which writes half of the wet signal back.
        // Their combined loop gain is 0.5*fb*(1 + fb/(1-fb)), so it exceeds
        // unity for fb above 2/3 and the chorus diverges (historically into
        // non-finite samples at +90 %). Cap the coefficient with margin.
        fb = Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.6, fb));

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                int idx = f * ch + c;
                float in = buf[idx];
                // 90 degree offset between the channels.
                double lfo = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (lfoPhase + (c == 1 ? 0.25 : 0.0)));
                double readPos = writePos - baseSamples + lfo * depthSamples;
                float size = mask + 1;
                while (readPos < 0) readPos += size;
                while (readPos >= size) readPos -= size;
                float delayed = Dsp.hermiteInterp(ring[c], mask, (float) readPos);
                float wetSample = delayed + feedbackState[c] * (float) fb;
                if (!Float.isFinite(wetSample) || Math.abs(wetSample) > 1e3f) {
                    // Never let a bad state poison the rest of the render.
                    feedbackState[c] = 0f;
                    wetSample = Float.isFinite(delayed) ? delayed : 0f;
                }
                feedbackState[c] = wetSample;
                float writeBack = in + wetSample * (float) fb * 0.5f;
                buf[idx] = in * dry + wetSample * wet;
                ring[c][writePos & mask] = Float.isFinite(writeBack) ? writeBack : in;
            }
            lfoPhase += lfoInc;
            if (lfoPhase > 1.0) lfoPhase -= 1.0;
            writePos = (writePos + 1) & mask;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 3 · classic analog prototypes in one processor: Butterworth,
 * Chebyshev I, Chebyshev II (inverse) and Bessel, orders 1..10, low- or
 * high-pass, cutoff 20 Hz..20 kHz, ripple parameter for the Chebyshevs.
 * Cascade math lives in {@link Dsp} (verified against analytic responses).
 */
final class ClassicFiltersProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {
            "Butterworth", "Chebyshev I", "Chebyshev II", "Bessel"};
    static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Low-Pass", "High-Pass"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("type", "Type", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter order = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("order", "Order", "", 1, 10, 1, 4));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("freq", "Cutoff", " Hz", 20, 20000, 1, 1000));
    private final FxParameter ripple = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("ripple", "Ripple", " dB", 0.1f, 10f, 1f));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 1;
    private int lastTopologyKey = -1;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "classic";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Classic Filters";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Butterworth / Chebyshev I / Chebyshev II / Bessel, order 1-10";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sr, int ch) {
        sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sr);
        channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        this.channels = c;
        int topoKey = (type.getEnumIndex() << 4) | mode.getEnumIndex();
        if (lastTopologyKey != -1 && lastTopologyKey != topoKey) {
            filter.reset();
        }
        lastTopologyKey = topoKey;
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), c);
        filter.process(buf, frames, c);
    }

    float[][] buildSections() {
        int n = order.getCurrentRaw();
        double f = freq.getFloat();
        boolean hp = mode.getEnumIndex() == 1;
        switch (type.getEnumIndex()) {
            case 1:
                return Dsp.chebyshev1(n, ripple.getFloat(), sampleRate, f, hp);
            case 2:
                return Dsp.chebyshev2(n, ripple.getFloat(), sampleRate, f, hp);
            case 3:
                return Dsp.bessel(n, sampleRate, f, hp);
            default:
                return Dsp.butterworth(n, sampleRate, f, hp);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 de-clicker: detects isolated sample spikes by comparing the local
 * energy of a narrow window against its surrounding context and replaces the
 * offending samples with a cubic Hermite interpolation across the gap.
 */
final class ClickRemovalProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "click_thresh", "Threshold", "", 1, 900, 1, 200));
    private final FxParameter maxWidth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "click_width", "Max Spike Width", " ms", 1, 40, 1, 10));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;

    ClickRemovalProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "declick";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Click Removal";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Detects and repairs isolated digital clicks and pops";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        // The threshold is a percentage: a sample is a click when its
        // deviation from the linear prediction of its neighbours exceeds this
        // multiple of the local RMS.
        float thr = threshold.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        int maxSpike = Math.max(1,
                (int) (maxWidth.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        int halfWin = Math.max(1, Math.min(64, maxWidth.getCurrentRaw()));

        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            boolean[] bad = new boolean[frames];
            boolean any = false;
            int ctx = Math.max(16, halfWin * 2);
            for (int f = ctx; f < frames - ctx; f++) {
                double sum = 0;
                for (int k = -ctx; k <= ctx; k++) {
                    double v = buf[(f + k) * ch + c];
                    sum += v * v;
                }
                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sum / (2.0 * ctx + 1.0));
                float predicted = 0.5f * (buf[(f - halfWin) * ch + c]
                        + buf[(f + halfWin) * ch + c]);
                float residual = Math.abs(buf[f * ch + c] - predicted);
                float ratio = residual / Math.max(1e-6f, rms);
                if (ratio > thr) {
                    bad[f] = true;
                    any = true;
                }
            }
            if (!any) continue;
            int f = 0;
            while (f < frames) {
                if (!bad[f]) {
                    f++;
                    continue;
                }
                int start = Math.max(2, f - halfWin / 2);
                while (f < frames && bad[f]) f++;
                int end = Math.min(frames - 2, f + halfWin / 2);
                int width = end - start;
                if (width > maxSpike) continue;
                if (start < 1 || end >= frames - 1) continue;
                float y0 = buf[(start - 1) * ch + c];
                float y1 = buf[end * ch + c];
                // Derivative from the outer neighbours.
                float d0 = (buf[end * ch + c] - buf[(start - 2) * ch + c])
                        / Math.max(1, width + 1);
                float d1 = (buf[(end + 1) * ch + c] - buf[(start - 1) * ch + c])
                        / Math.max(1, width + 1);
                for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                    float t = (i - start + 1f) / (width + 1f);
                    // Cubic Hermite between the two boundary samples.
                    float t2 = t * t;
                    float t3 = t2 * t;
                    float h00 = 2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1;
                    float h10 = t3 - 2 * t2 + t;
                    float h01 = -2 * t3 + 3 * t2;
                    float h11 = t3 - t2;
                    buf[i * ch + c] = h00 * y0 + h10 * d0 * (width + 1)
                            + h01 * y1 + h11 * d1 * (width + 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 de-clipper: finds contiguous runs of samples that hit the
 * clipping threshold and reconstructs the missing crest with a cubic
 * Hermite spline between the unclipped shoulders.
 */
final class ClipFixProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "clip_thresh", "Clipping Threshold", "%", 80, 100, 1, 95));
    private final FxParameter headroom = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "clip_headroom", "Headroom", -18f, 0f, -6f));

    ClipFixProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "clipfix";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Clip Fix";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Cubic-spline de-clipper with headroom attenuation";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        float clipLevel = threshold.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;

        // Pass 1: find the clipped runs on the original signal.
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            int f = 0;
            while (f < frames) {
                float v = buf[f * ch + c];
                if (Math.abs(v) < clipLevel) {
                    f++;
                    continue;
                }
                int start = f;
                int sign = v >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
                while (f < frames && Math.abs(buf[f * ch + c]) >= clipLevel
                        && ((buf[f * ch + c] >= 0) == (sign > 0))) {
                    f++;
                }
                int end = f; // exclusive
                if (start < 1 || end >= frames - 1) continue;
                float y0 = buf[(start - 1) * ch + c];
                float y1 = buf[end * ch + c];
                // The slopes must be taken from OUTSIDE the clipped run:
                // inside it the signal is flat, so an inner difference would
                // report a zero slope and the spline would rebuild the very
                // plateau it is meant to replace.
                int p0 = Math.max(0, start - 3);
                int p1 = Math.min(frames - 1, end + 1);
                float d0 = (buf[(start - 1) * ch + c]
                        - buf[p0 * ch + c]) * 0.5f;
                float d1 = (buf[p1 * ch + c]
                        - buf[end * ch + c]) * 0.5f;
                int width = end - start;
                for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                    float t = (i - start + 1f) / (width + 1f);
                    float t2 = t * t;
                    float t3 = t2 * t;
                    float h00 = 2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1;
                    float h10 = t3 - 2 * t2 + t;
                    float h01 = -2 * t3 + 3 * t2;
                    float h11 = t3 - t2;
                    buf[i * ch + c] = h00 * y0 + h10 * d0 * (width + 1)
                            + h01 * y1 + h11 * d1 * (width + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        // Pass 2: the headroom is applied to the whole signal afterwards so
        // the restored crest ends up below the clipping level.
        float headroomGain = Dsp.dbToLin(headroom.getFloat());
        if (headroomGain != 1f) {
            int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * ch);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) buf[i] *= headroomGain;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 dynamics compressor: full log-domain gain computer with a
 * noise-floor freeze, RMS or peak detection, auto make-up and an optional
 * upward (expander-like) mode.
 *
 * <p>The transfer curve is the classic soft-knee shape:
 * {@code out = in + (1 - 1/ratio) * (in - threshold)} above the knee, with a
 * quadratic interpolation across the knee itself.
 */
final class CompressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] DETECT_LABELS = {"RMS", "Peak"};

    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "dyncomp_thresh", "Threshold", -60f, -1f, -18f));
    private final FxParameter noiseFloor = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "dyncomp_floor", "Noise Floor", -80f, -20f, -50f));
    private final FxParameter ratio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "dyncomp_ratio", "Ratio", ":1", 1.1f, 20f, 3f));
    private final FxParameter knee = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "dyncomp_knee", "Knee Width", 0f, 12f, 6f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "dyncomp_attack", "Attack Time", " ms", 0.5f, 250f, 12f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "dyncomp_release", "Release Time", " ms", 10f, 2500f, 180f));
    private final FxParameter detect = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "dyncomp_detect", "Detection Mode", DETECT_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter autoMakeup = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "dyncomp_makeup", "Auto Make-up Gain", true));
    private final FxParameter upward = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "dyncomp_upward", "Upward (Expand) Mode", false));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private DynamicsDetector.Envelope envelope;
    private float gainDb = 0f;
    private float makeupDb = 0f;
    private float avgReductionDb = 0f;

    CompressorProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "dyncomp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Compressor";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Soft-knee dynamics compressor with noise-floor freeze";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        envelope = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        if (envelope != null) envelope.reset();
        gainDb = 0f;
        makeupDb = 0f;
        avgReductionDb = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (ratio.getFloat() > 1.01f || upward.getBoolean());
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        if (envelope == null) envelope = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));

        float thresh = threshold.getFloat();
        float floorDb = noiseFloor.getFloat();
        float r = ratio.getFloat();
        float kneeDb = knee.getFloat();
        boolean rms = detect.getEnumIndex() == 0;
        float attMs = attack.getFloat();
        float relMs = release.getFloat();

        // Detection is done on 64-frame blocks so the ballistics are stable.
        final int block = 64;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float levelDb = envelope.detect(buf, offset, n, ch, rms, attMs,
                    relMs);

            float over = 0f;
            if (upward.getBoolean()) {
                // Upward mode expands below the threshold.
                if (levelDb < thresh) {
                    over = levelDb - thresh;
                }
            } else if (levelDb > thresh) {
                over = levelDb - thresh;
            }

            float targetGain;
            if (upward.getBoolean()) {
                if (over < 0f) {
                    float slope = 1f - 1f / Math.max(1.0001f, r);
                    targetGain = Math.max(-60f, slope * over);
                } else {
                    targetGain = 0f;
                }
            } else {
                targetGain = DynamicsDetector.softKneeGainDb(over, r, kneeDb);
            }

            float reduction = Math.max(0f, -targetGain);
            if (levelDb >= floorDb) {
                avgReductionDb += (reduction - avgReductionDb) * 0.002f;
            }
            makeupDb = (autoMakeup.getBoolean() && !upward.getBoolean())
                    ? Math.min(24f, avgReductionDb * 0.5f) : 0f;

            // Noise-floor freeze: attenuate make-up gain and apply gentle
            // downward floor damping when signal drops below floorDb.
            float floorScale = 1f;
            float floorAttenDb = 0f;
            if (levelDb < floorDb) {
                float below = floorDb - levelDb;
                floorScale = Math.max(0f, 1f - below / 12f);
                floorAttenDb = -Math.min(12f, below * 0.25f);
            }
            float target = targetGain + makeupDb * floorScale + floorAttenDb;
            float step = (target - gainDb) / n;
            FxTelemetry.publishGainReductionDb(targetGain);
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                gainDb += step;
                float g = Dsp.dbToLin(gainDb);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    buf[idx + c] *= g;
                }
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;

/**
 * One background conversion: a finalized raw take plus the format it must
 * become. Persisted as a JSON sidecar next to the raw file so a killed
 * process can resume on the next launch instead of losing the take.
 *
 * <p>States: {@code QUEUED} (waiting for the worker), {@code RUNNING},
 * {@code DONE}, {@code FAILED}, {@code CANCELLED}. Only QUEUED/RUNNING
 * sidecars are resurrected by {@link ConversionJobs#sweep}.
 */
public final class ConversionJob {

    public static final String QUEUED = "QUEUED";
    public static final String RUNNING = "RUNNING";
    public static final String DONE = "DONE";
    public static final String FAILED = "FAILED";
    public static final String CANCELLED = "CANCELLED";

    public final String jobId;
    /**
     * Library title. Not final: renaming a take while it converts updates
     * this so the finished file lands under the name the user chose. Read
     * from the worker thread, hence volatile.
     */
    public volatile String title;
    public final String rawPath;
    public final String partPath;
    public final String presetId;
    public final String formatId;
    public final int channels;
    public final int bitrate;
    public final long durationMs;
    public final long framesTotal;

    public volatile String state;
    public volatile int progress;
    public volatile long framesDone;
    public volatile long updatedAt;
    public volatile boolean cancelled;
    /** Transient UI status while capture is active; never persisted. */
    public volatile boolean paused;
    public volatile String error;
    /**
     * Unique immutable recording ID assigned when the recording is saved (or
     * inherited from the original recording when replacing). Links both the
     * converted library-visible take and its persistent 32-bit float master
     * {@code takes/.float32/rec_<recordingId>.f32.wav}.
     */
    public volatile long recordingId = -1;
    /**
     * Edit-replace lineage (BUG-02): when an edit punch-in is saved to the
     * background worker, the user's replace-vs-new choice travels with the
     * job so completion replaces the original take instead of duplicating.
     * {@code -1} = plain save (no lineage).
     */
    public volatile long replaceTakeId = -1;
    /** Original title to restore when replacing (null = keep job title). */
    public volatile String replaceTitle = null;
    /**
     * True when this conversion job was superseded by an Edit -> Replace save,
     * so the worker aborts it silently and deletes its raw file.
     */
    public volatile boolean superseded;

    public ConversionJob(String jobId, String title, String rawPath,
                         String partPath, String presetId, String formatId,
                         int channels, int bitrate, long durationMs,
                         long framesTotal) {
        this.jobId = jobId;
        this.title = title;
        this.rawPath = rawPath;
        this.partPath = partPath;
        this.presetId = presetId;
        this.formatId = formatId;
        this.channels = channels;
        this.bitrate = bitrate;
        this.durationMs = durationMs;
        this.framesTotal = framesTotal;
        this.state = QUEUED;
        this.progress = 0;
        this.framesDone = 0;
        this.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
    }

    /** Sidecar path for a raw file. */
    public static File sidecarFor(File raw) {
        return new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".conv.json");
    }

    /** Partial-output path for a raw file. */
    public static File partFor(File raw) {
        return new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part");
    }

    public File sidecar() {
        return new File(rawPath + ".conv.json");
    }

    public File tempSidecar() {
        return new File(rawPath + ".conv.json.tmp");
    }

    /**
     * Atomically persists the conversion sidecar: writes to `.conv.json.tmp`,
     * flushes + fsyncs the descriptor, then renames over `.conv.json` so a
     * process kill mid-write can never truncate or corrupt the live sidecar.
     */
    public synchronized void write() {
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("v", 1);
            o.put("jobId", jobId);
            o.put("title", title);
            o.put("rawPath", rawPath);
            o.put("partPath", partPath);
            o.put("presetId", presetId);
            o.put("formatId", formatId);
            o.put("channels", channels);
            o.put("bitrate", bitrate);
            o.put("durationMs", durationMs);
            o.put("framesTotal", framesTotal);
            o.put("state", state);
            o.put("progress", progress);
            o.put("framesDone", framesDone);
            o.put("updatedAt", updatedAt);
            o.put("error", error != null ? error : "");
            o.put("recordingId", recordingId);
            o.put("replaceTakeId", replaceTakeId);
            o.put("replaceTitle", replaceTitle != null ? replaceTitle : "");

            byte[] payload = o.toString().getBytes("UTF-8");
            File target = sidecar();
            File tmp = tempSidecar();
            File parent = target.getParentFile();
            if (parent != null && !parent.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                parent.mkdirs();
            }
            try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(tmp)) {
                out.write(payload);
                out.flush();
                try {
                    out.getFD().sync();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (!tmp.renameTo(target)) {
                // Fallback for filesystems where renameTo over an existing
                // destination fails: write directly only after tmp is safely
                // on disk so read() can recover from tmp if interrupted.
                try (FileOutputStream direct = new FileOutputStream(target)) {
                    direct.write(payload);
                    direct.flush();
                    try {
                        direct.getFD().sync();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                tmp.delete();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public static ConversionJob read(File sidecar) {
        ConversionJob primary = readSingleFile(sidecar);
        if (primary != null) return primary;
        if (sidecar != null) {
            File tmp = new File(sidecar.getAbsolutePath() + ".tmp");
            if (tmp.exists()) {
                ConversionJob recovered = readSingleFile(tmp);
                if (recovered != null) {
                    // Promote the valid tmp file into place.
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    tmp.renameTo(sidecar);
                    return recovered;
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static ConversionJob readSingleFile(File file) {
        if (file == null || !file.exists()) return null;
        try {
            byte[] buf = new byte[(int) Math.min(file.length(), 8192)];
            int n;
            try (FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(file)) {
                n = in.read(buf);
            }
            if (n <= 0) return null;
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject(new String(buf, 0, n, "UTF-8"));
            ConversionJob j = new ConversionJob(
                    o.optString("jobId", ""),
                    o.optString("title", ""),
                    o.optString("rawPath", ""),
                    o.optString("partPath", ""),
                    o.optString("presetId", "memo"),
                    o.optString("formatId", "auto"),
                    o.optInt("channels", 2),
                    o.optInt("bitrate", 128000),
                    o.optLong("durationMs", 0),
                    o.optLong("framesTotal", 0));
            if (j.jobId.isEmpty() || j.rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
            j.state = o.optString("state", QUEUED);
            j.progress = o.optInt("progress", 0);
            j.framesDone = o.optLong("framesDone", 0);
            j.updatedAt = o.optLong("updatedAt", 0);
            String err = o.optString("error", "");
            j.error = err.isEmpty() ? null : err;
            j.recordingId = o.optLong("recordingId", -1);
            j.replaceTakeId = o.optLong("replaceTakeId", -1);
            String rt = o.optString("replaceTitle", "");
            j.replaceTitle = rt.isEmpty() ? null : rt;
            return j;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public synchronized void deleteSidecar() {
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            sidecar().delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            tempSidecar().delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** Stable negative row id for library cards (Room ids are positive). */
    public long takeId() {
        long h = jobId.hashCode();
        long id = -(h + (long) Integer.MAX_VALUE + 2L);
        return id == 0 ? Long.MIN_VALUE : id;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet;

/**
 * Registry for background conversions: enqueue, cancel, observe, and recover.
 *
 * <p>Invariants the rest of the app relies on:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Raw files under conversion are <b>never written to</b> — only read.
 *       Punch-in edits copy bytes out, so an edit can never invalidate an
 *       in-flight conversion. The only invalidations are delete and
 *       replace, which cancel the job first.</li>
 *   <li>One active job per raw file. Enqueueing for the same raw returns the
 *       existing job instead of doubling the work.</li>
 *   <li>Every state change is persisted to the job sidecar <em>and</em>
 *       fanned out to {@link Listener}s, so the library, notifications and
 *       share warnings stay in sync whether the app is open or not.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class ConversionJobs {

    public interface Listener {
        void onJobsChanged();
    }

    public static final class SaveResult {
        /** True when the file is ready now (incremental output adopted). */
        public final boolean adopted;
        /** Unique immutable ID assigned to (or preserved for) this recording. */
        public final long recordingId;
        public final File file;
        public final String label;
        public final long durationMs;
        public final String title;
        /** Non-null when the save went to the background worker. */
        public final ConversionJob job;

        private SaveResult(boolean adopted, long recordingId, File file,
                           String label, long durationMs, String title,
                           ConversionJob job) {
            this.adopted = adopted;
            this.recordingId = recordingId;
            this.file = file;
            this.label = label;
            this.durationMs = durationMs;
            this.title = title;
            this.job = job;
        }

        static SaveResult adopted(long recordingId, File file, String label,
                                  long durationMs, String title) {
            return new SaveResult(true, recordingId, file, label, durationMs,
                    title, null);
        }

        static SaveResult background(ConversionJob job) {
            return new SaveResult(false, job.recordingId, null, null,
                    job.durationMs, job.title, job);
        }
    }

    private ConversionJobs() {}

    /**
     * How long a save may spend finishing the incremental encoder inline
     * before giving up and converting in the background. Kept small on
     * purpose: a budget overrun is paid as visible latency on the UI thread,
     * and a backlog that cannot drain inside it is handed to the worker
     * anyway.
     */
    private static final long ADOPT_DRAIN_BUDGET_MS = 350L;

    /**
     * Largest unencoded backlog still worth draining inline (~1.5s of audio),
     * which encodes in well under the budget above.
     */
    private static final long MAX_INLINE_TAIL_FRAMES =
            RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE * 3L / 2L;

    private static final Map<String, ConversionJob> ACTIVE = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Set<Listener> LISTENERS = new CopyOnWriteArraySet<>();
    /** rawPath -> finished library take id, for replace-after-completion. */
    private static final Map<String, Long> COMPLETED = new HashMap<>();
    /** rawPath -> immutable recordingId assigned when enqueued or saved. */
    private static final Map<String, Long> RAW_TO_RECORDING_ID = new HashMap<>();
    /**
     * raws with an in-flight reader. The worker defers its raw adoption/delete
     * while one is open, so an Edit on a converting card cannot have the file
     * pulled out from under AudioImporter mid-decode.
     */
    private static final Map<String, Integer> RAW_READERS =
            new HashMap<>();
    /** Synthetic (negative) take id -> raw path, for edit-replace lookup. */
    private static final Map<Long, String> NEG_TO_RAW = new HashMap<>();
    /**
     * rawPath -> latest user-chosen title from a rename requested while its
     * take was converting. Kept separately from {@link ConversionJob#title}
     * so a rename that arrives after the worker read the title but before the
     * finished take is visible can still be applied exactly once.
     */
    private static final Map<String, String> RENAMED_TITLES = new HashMap<>();

    public static synchronized void addListener(Listener l) {
        if (l != null) LISTENERS.add(l);
    }

    public static synchronized void removeListener(Listener l) {
        LISTENERS.remove(l);
    }

    private static void fireChanged() {
        for (Listener l : LISTENERS) {
            try {
                l.onJobsChanged();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public static synchronized List<ConversionJob> active() {
        return new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE.values());
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob get(String jobId) {
        return ACTIVE.get(jobId);
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob forRaw(String rawPath) {
        for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
            if (j.rawPath.equals(rawPath)) return j;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob forTakeId(long takeId) {
        for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
            if (j.takeId() == takeId) return j;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Resolves any positive {@link Take#id} or negative synthetic
     * {@link ConversionJob#takeId()} to its canonical positive immutable
     * recording ID.
     */
    public static synchronized long resolveRecordingId(long takeOrJobId) {
        if (takeOrJobId > 0) return takeOrJobId;
        if (takeOrJobId == -1) return -1L;
        ConversionJob job = forTakeId(takeOrJobId);
        if (job != null && job.recordingId > 0) {
            return job.recordingId;
        }
        String raw = job != null ? job.rawPath : NEG_TO_RAW.get(takeOrJobId);
        if (raw != null) {
            Long done = COMPLETED.get(raw);
            if (done != null && done > 0) return done;
            Long mapped = RAW_TO_RECORDING_ID.get(raw);
            if (mapped != null && mapped > 0) return mapped;
        }
        return -1L;
    }

    public static synchronized void noteCompletion(String rawPath, long takeId) {
        COMPLETED.put(rawPath, takeId);
        if (takeId > 0) {
            RAW_TO_RECORDING_ID.put(rawPath, takeId);
        }
    }

    public static synchronized Long completedTakeIdForRaw(String rawPath) {
        return COMPLETED.get(rawPath);
    }

    /**
     * Atomically records a rename for a take that was (or still is)
     * converting. Updates the active job and sidecar when the job is still in
     * flight, remembers the override by raw path so the worker handoff cannot
     * miss it, and renames the finished take when the job already completed
     * while the rename dialog was open.
     *
     * <p>The repository rename happens after this class's lock is released:
     * the worker can hold the repository lock while calling back into this
     * registry, so nesting those two locks in the other order could deadlock.
     */
    public static String renameConvertingOrCompleted(String jobId,
                                                     long syntheticTakeId,
                                                     String rawPath,
                                                     String newTitle) {
        String clean = newTitle != null ? newTitle.trim() : "";
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        final String effectiveRaw;
        final Long doneId;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            ConversionJob job = null;
            if (jobId != null && !jobId.isEmpty()) {
                job = ACTIVE.get(jobId);
            }
            if (job == null && syntheticTakeId < 0) {
                for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
                    if (j.takeId() == syntheticTakeId) {
                        job = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (job == null && rawPath != null && !rawPath.isEmpty()) {
                for (ConversionJob j : ACTIVE.values()) {
                    if (rawPath.equals(j.rawPath)) {
                        job = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            String eff = rawPath;
            if ((eff == null || eff.isEmpty()) && job != null) {
                eff = job.rawPath;
            }
            if ((eff == null || eff.isEmpty()) && syntheticTakeId < 0) {
                eff = NEG_TO_RAW.get(syntheticTakeId);
            }
            if (eff != null && !eff.isEmpty()) {
                RENAMED_TITLES.put(eff, clean);
            }
            if (job != null) {
                job.title = clean;
                if (job.replaceTitle != null) {
                    job.replaceTitle = clean;
                }
                job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
                job.write();
            }
            effectiveRaw = eff;
            doneId = (eff != null && !eff.isEmpty())
                    ? COMPLETED.get(eff) : null;
        }
        if (doneId != null) {
            TakesRepository.rename(doneId, clean);
        }
        fireChanged();
        return clean;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the most up-to-date title for {@code job}, honouring any rename
     * that arrived while the job was queued or running.
     */
    public static synchronized String latestTitle(ConversionJob job,
                                                  String fallback) {
        String cleanFallback = fallback != null ? fallback : "";
        if (job == null) return cleanFallback;
        String byRaw = RENAMED_TITLES.get(job.rawPath);
        if (byRaw != null && !byRaw.trim().isEmpty()) {
            job.title = byRaw.trim();
            return job.title;
        }
        if (job.title != null && !job.title.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return job.title.trim();
        }
        return cleanFallback;
    }

    /**
     * Takes and clears a pending rename override recorded by
     * {@link #renameConvertingOrCompleted}. The worker calls this after the
     * finished take is visible, then applies the result without holding this
     * class's lock.
     */
    public static synchronized String consumeRenamedTitle(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
        String renamed = RENAMED_TITLES.remove(rawPath);
        if (renamed == null || renamed.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        return renamed.trim();
    }

    /**
     * Reads a pending rename override without clearing it, so the worker can
     * decide which title a completion should carry while still honouring the
     * initial edit-replace title when no rename arrived.
     */
    public static synchronized String peekRenamedTitle(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty()) return null;
        String renamed = RENAMED_TITLES.get(rawPath);
        if (renamed == null || renamed.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        return renamed.trim();
    }

    public static synchronized void noteTakeRaw(long takeId, String rawPath) {
        NEG_TO_RAW.put(takeId, rawPath);
    }

    public static synchronized String rawForTakeId(long takeId) {
        return NEG_TO_RAW.get(takeId);
    }

    public static synchronized void forgetCompletion(String rawPath) {
        COMPLETED.remove(rawPath);
        RAW_TO_RECORDING_ID.remove(rawPath);
        RENAMED_TITLES.remove(rawPath);
    }

    /** Marks {@code rawPath} as being read. Pair every call with {@link #endRawRead}. */
    public static void beginRawRead(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            Integer n = RAW_READERS.get(rawPath);
            RAW_READERS.put(rawPath, n == null ? 1 : n + 1);
        }
    }

    private static final class DeferredMaster {
        final File finalFile;
        final long recordingId;

        DeferredMaster(File finalFile, long recordingId) {
            this.finalFile = finalFile;
            this.recordingId = recordingId;
        }
    }

    public static void endRawRead(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        boolean doDelete = false;
        DeferredMaster masterTarget = null;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            Integer n = RAW_READERS.get(rawPath);
            if (n == null) return;
            boolean lastReader;
            if (n <= 1) {
                RAW_READERS.remove(rawPath);
                lastReader = true;
            } else {
                RAW_READERS.put(rawPath, n - 1);
                lastReader = false;
            }
            if (lastReader && forRaw(rawPath) == null) {
                if (DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.remove(rawPath)) {
                    DEFERRED_RAW_MASTERS.remove(rawPath);
                    doDelete = true;
                } else {
                    masterTarget = DEFERRED_RAW_MASTERS.remove(rawPath);
                }
            }
        }
        if (doDelete) {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(rawPath).delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        } else if (masterTarget != null) {
            TakesRepository.adoptFloatMaster(
                    masterTarget.recordingId,
                    new File(rawPath),
                    masterTarget.finalFile);
        }
    }

    /** Raws whose deletion was deferred until their last reader finishes. */
    private static final java.util.Set<String> DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES =
            new java.util.HashSet<>();
    /** Raws whose move to .float32/ was deferred until their last reader finishes. */
    private static final java.util.Map<String, DeferredMaster> DEFERRED_RAW_MASTERS =
            new java.util.HashMap<>();

    /** True while some thread is decoding this raw. */
    public static synchronized boolean rawIsBeingRead(String rawPath) {
        return RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath);
    }

    /**
     * Deletes a finished conversion's raw immediately, unless a reader
     * (preview playback or edit import) still holds it open — then the
     * deletion is deferred to {@link #endRawRead} so the file can neither be
     * pulled out from under the reader nor leaked into reconcile().
     */
    public static void deleteOrDeferRaw(String rawPath) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            DEFERRED_RAW_MASTERS.remove(rawPath);
            if (RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath)) {
                DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.add(rawPath);
                return;
            }
        }
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(rawPath).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Preserves a finished conversion's 32-bit float raw as the persistent
     * float master linked to {@code recordingId} (and {@code finalFile}), or
     * deletes it if {@code finalFile} is already WAV32 / missing, deferring
     * until {@link #endRawRead} if a reader currently holds {@code rawPath}
     * open.
     */
    public static void completeOrDeferRawMaster(String rawPath, File finalFile,
                                                long recordingId) {
        if (rawPath == null) return;
        if (finalFile == null || !finalFile.exists()
                || AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(finalFile)) {
            deleteOrDeferRaw(rawPath);
            TakesRepository.deleteFloatMaster(recordingId, finalFile);
            return;
        }
        long effId = recordingId > 0 ? recordingId
                : TakesRepository.findIdByFile(finalFile);
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            if (RAW_READERS.containsKey(rawPath)) {
                DEFERRED_RAW_MASTERS.put(rawPath,
                        new DeferredMaster(finalFile, effId));
                return;
            }
        }
        TakesRepository.adoptFloatMaster(effId, new File(rawPath), finalFile);
    }

    public static void completeOrDeferRawMaster(String rawPath, File finalFile) {
        completeOrDeferRawMaster(rawPath, finalFile, -1L);
    }

    /**
     * Enqueues a background conversion for a finalized raw take. Returns the
     * existing job when one is already active for the same raw.
     */
    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs) {
        return enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, durationMs, -1, null);
    }

    /**
     * Same, carrying edit-replace lineage: when the job completes, the take
     * with {@code replaceTakeId} is replaced (under {@code replaceTitle})
     * instead of adding a duplicate.
     */
    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs,
                                                     long replaceTakeId,
                                                     String replaceTitle) {
        return enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, durationMs,
                replaceTakeId, replaceTitle, -1L);
    }

    public static synchronized ConversionJob enqueue(Context ctx, File raw,
                                                     String title,
                                                     RecordPreset preset,
                                                     SaveFormat format,
                                                     long durationMs,
                                                     long replaceTakeId,
                                                     String replaceTitle,
                                                     long explicitRecordingId) {
        ConversionJob existing = forRaw(raw.getAbsolutePath());
        if (existing != null) return existing;
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        // AUDIT-3-02 fix: read the geometry from the `raw` file itself.
        // The engine may be idle/cleared (dataBytes 0, channels back to its
        // 2 default) at enqueue time, which recorded framesTotal = 1 and the
        // wrong channel count for a mono take.
        int ch = Math.max(1, e.channels);
        long bytes = e.dataBytes;
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
            ch = Math.max(1, info.channels);
            bytes = info.dataBytes;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        long framesTotal = Math.max(1, bytes / 4 / ch);
        String jobTitle = (replaceTitle != null && !replaceTitle.trim().isEmpty())
                ? replaceTitle.trim()
                : (title != null ? title : "");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob(
                UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                jobTitle,
                raw.getAbsolutePath(),
                ConversionJob.partFor(raw).getAbsolutePath(),
                preset != null ? preset.id : RecordPreset.MEMO.id,
                format != null ? format.id : SaveFormat.AUTO.id,
                ch,
                preset != null ? preset.aacBitrate : 128000,
                Math.max(durationMs, 1000),
                framesTotal);
        long resolvedRecId = explicitRecordingId;
        if (resolvedRecId <= 0 && replaceTakeId != -1) {
            resolvedRecId = resolveRecordingId(replaceTakeId);
        }
        if (resolvedRecId <= 0) {
            resolvedRecId = TakesRepository.allocateId();
        }
        job.recordingId = resolvedRecId;
        job.replaceTakeId = replaceTakeId;
        job.replaceTitle = replaceTitle;
        RAW_TO_RECORDING_ID.put(raw.getAbsolutePath(), job.recordingId);
        NEG_TO_RAW.put(job.takeId(), raw.getAbsolutePath());
        ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
        job.write();
        if (ctx != null) {
            try {
                TrialAndBillingManager.get(ctx).onRecordingSaved(job.recordingId);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        fireChanged();
        return job;
    }

    /**
     * Cancels a job: stops the worker, deletes partial output and — when
     * {@code deleteRaw} — the raw take itself. The sidecar always goes.
     * When the raw is kept it gets its pending marker back, so the next
     * launch offers the usual continue/discard recovery instead of leaking
     * an invisible file.
     */
    public static synchronized boolean cancel(String jobId, boolean deleteRaw) {
        ConversionJob job = ACTIVE.get(jobId);
        if (job == null) return false;
        job.cancelled = true;
        job.state = ConversionJob.CANCELLED;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        job.write();
        ACTIVE.remove(jobId);
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(job.partPath).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        job.deleteSidecar();
        if (deleteRaw) {
            DEFERRED_RAW_DELETES.remove(job.rawPath);
            DEFERRED_RAW_MASTERS.remove(job.rawPath);
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(job.rawPath).delete();
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                new File(job.rawPath + ".pending").delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            forgetCompletion(job.rawPath);
        } else {
            try {
                File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
                if (raw.exists()) {
                    RecordingEngine.writePendingMarker(raw, job.title,
                            job.channels);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        fireChanged();
        return true;
    }

    /** Cancels by library card id (negative synthetic ids map to jobs). */
    public static synchronized boolean cancelByTakeId(long takeId,
                                                      boolean deleteRaw) {
        ConversionJob job = forTakeId(takeId);
        return job != null && cancel(job.jobId, deleteRaw);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves or cancels the source of an Edit -> Replace save BEFORE the
     * edited take is converted or adopted.
     *
     * <ul>
     *   <li>If {@code replaceTakeId < 0} and the original conversion job is
     *       still queued or running, cancels it immediately (marking it
     *       {@code superseded} and deleting its raw + part + sidecar) so the
     *       worker never wastes time finishing the obsolete original file,
     *       and returns {@code -1} because no finished library row exists to
     *       delete (while preserving its immutable recordingId in
     *       {@link #resolveRecordingId(long)}).</li>
     *   <li>If {@code replaceTakeId < 0} and the original conversion job
     *       already finished while the user was editing, returns the positive
     *       {@code Take.id} of that finished take so the replacement deletes
     *       it and reuses that same immutable ID.</li>
     * </ul>
     */
    public static long cancelForReplace(Context ctx, long replaceTakeId) {
        if (replaceTakeId >= 0) return replaceTakeId;
        String jobIdToCancel = null;
        Long finishedId;
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            ConversionJob srcJob = forTakeId(replaceTakeId);
            String srcRaw = srcJob != null ? srcJob.rawPath
                    : NEG_TO_RAW.get(replaceTakeId);
            long preservedRecId = (srcJob != null && srcJob.recordingId > 0)
                    ? srcJob.recordingId : -1L;
            if (srcJob != null) {
                srcJob.superseded = true;
                srcJob.cancelled = true;
                jobIdToCancel = srcJob.jobId;
                cancel(srcJob.jobId, true);
            }
            if (srcRaw != null && preservedRecId > 0) {
                RAW_TO_RECORDING_ID.put(srcRaw, preservedRecId);
            }
            finishedId = (srcRaw != null) ? COMPLETED.get(srcRaw) : null;
        }
        if (jobIdToCancel != null && ctx != null) {
            ConversionService.cancelJob(ctx, jobIdToCancel);
            ConversionService.onRecordingStateChanged();
        }
        return finishedId != null ? finishedId : -1L;
    }

    /**
     * Cancels any active background conversion job that was scheduled to
     * replace {@code deletedTakeId}. Prevents a replacement conversion from
     * resurrecting a take that the user deleted while the conversion was
     * still in flight.
     */
    public static void cancelForDeletedTargetTake(Context ctx, long deletedTakeId) {
        if (deletedTakeId < 0) return;
        List<String> jobsToCancel = new ArrayList<>();
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            for (ConversionJob j : new ArrayList<>(ACTIVE.values())) {
                if (j.replaceTakeId == deletedTakeId
                        || j.recordingId == deletedTakeId) {
                    j.superseded = true;
                    j.cancelled = true;
                    jobsToCancel.add(j.jobId);
                    cancel(j.jobId, true);
                }
            }
        }
        if (ctx != null) {
            for (String jid : jobsToCancel) {
                ConversionService.cancelJob(ctx, jid);
            }
            if (!jobsToCancel.isEmpty()) {
                ConversionService.onRecordingStateChanged();
            }
        }
    }

    static synchronized void updateProgress(ConversionJob job, int pct,
                                            long framesDone) {
        job.progress = pct;
        job.framesDone = framesDone;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if ((pct % 5) == 0 || pct >= 100) job.write();
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markRunning(ConversionJob job) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        job.write();
        if (!ACTIVE.containsKey(job.jobId)) ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markDone(ConversionJob job) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.DONE;
        job.progress = 100;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ACTIVE.remove(job.jobId);
        job.deleteSidecar();
        fireChanged();
    }

    static synchronized void markFailed(ConversionJob job, String error) {
        job.state = ConversionJob.FAILED;
        job.error = error;
        job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        ACTIVE.remove(job.jobId);
        job.deleteSidecar();
        fireChanged();
    }

    /**
     * Startup sweep: resurrect interrupted jobs, drop garbage. Returns the
     * jobs the worker should run. Stale sidecars (orphaned > 7 days) and
     * partial outputs without a sidecar are deleted.
     */
    public static synchronized List<ConversionJob> sweep(Context ctx) {
        List<ConversionJob> resume = new ArrayList<>();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File[] files;
        try {
            files = dir.listFiles();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            files = null;
        }
        if (files == null) return resume;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Set<String> liveParts = new HashSet<>();
        // A live capture owns a .part with no sidecar yet. Sweep used to
        // assume it only ran at cold start, but the service sweeps on every
        // start command, so this file was deleted out from under the running
        // StreamingEncoder mid-recording.
        File activeRaw = RecordingEngine.get().rawFile;
        if (activeRaw != null) {
            liveParts.add(ConversionJob.partFor(activeRaw).getAbsolutePath());
        }
        // Same protection for a session that is being written but not yet
        // finalized (a .pending marker sits beside it).
        for (File f : files) {
            if (f.isFile() && f.getName().endsWith(".pending")) {
                String rawName = f.getName().substring(0,
                        f.getName().length() - ".pending".length());
                liveParts.add(new File(dir, rawName + ".part")
                        .getAbsolutePath());
            }
        }
        for (File f : files) {
            if (f.isFile() && f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json.tmp")) {
                String mainName = f.getName().substring(
                        0, f.getName().length() - ".tmp".length());
                File mainSidecar = new File(dir, mainName);
                if (!mainSidecar.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    f.renameTo(mainSidecar);
                } else {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    f.delete();
                }
            }
        }
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !f.getName().endsWith(".conv.json")) continue;
            ConversionJob job = ConversionJob.read(f);
            if (job == null) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            liveParts.add(job.partPath);
            // Already tracked in memory (RUNNING or QUEUED): keep the live
            // instance. Replacing it reset progress to 0 and let the queue run
            // the same jobId twice, the second run reporting a false failure
            // because the raw was already gone.
            ConversionJob inMem = ACTIVE.get(job.jobId);
            if (inMem != null) {
                resume.add(inMem);
                continue;
            }
            boolean stale = now - job.updatedAt > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L;
            File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
            if (stale || !raw.exists()
                    || ConversionJob.DONE.equals(job.state)
                    || ConversionJob.FAILED.equals(job.state)
                    || ConversionJob.CANCELLED.equals(job.state)) {
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(job.partPath).delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
                continue;
            }
            if (job.recordingId <= 0) {
                job.recordingId = TakesRepository.allocateId();
            }
            job.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
            job.cancelled = false;
            job.write();
            RAW_TO_RECORDING_ID.put(job.rawPath, job.recordingId);
            NEG_TO_RAW.put(job.takeId(), job.rawPath);
            ACTIVE.put(job.jobId, job);
            resume.add(job);
        }
        // Partial outputs with no sidecar are crash garbage — except the one
        // a live capture may be writing right now (protected above).
        for (File f : files) {
            if (!f.isFile() || !f.getName().endsWith(".part")) continue;
            if (!liveParts.contains(f.getAbsolutePath())) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
            }
        }
        if (!resume.isEmpty()) fireChanged();
        return resume;
    }

    /**
     * The unified save dispatch: finalize the raw, then either adopt the
     * incremental output (fast path) or enqueue a background job. Never
     * blocks on conversion work beyond draining the incremental tail.
     */
    public static SaveResult dispatchSave(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                          SaveFormat format,
                                          StreamingEncoder.Progress cb) {
        return dispatchSave(ctx, preset, format, cb, -1, null);
    }

    /**
     * Same, carrying edit-replace lineage into the background job when the
     * fast path misses.
     */
    public static SaveResult dispatchSave(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                          SaveFormat format,
                                          StreamingEncoder.Progress cb,
                                          long replaceTakeId,
                                          String replaceTitle) {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        File raw = e.finalizeRawForSave();
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        }
        // Resolve the immutable recording ID before cancelling or deleting the
        // previous job/take so an Edit -> Replace always preserves the
        // original recording's immutable ID!
        long preservedRecordingId = (replaceTakeId != -1)
                ? resolveRecordingId(replaceTakeId) : -1L;
        // If replacing a take that is still converting (replaceTakeId < 0),
        // cancel the original conversion job immediately so we never convert
        // the original file first and then convert the edited file second.
        if (replaceTakeId < 0) {
            long finishedId = cancelForReplace(ctx, replaceTakeId);
            if (preservedRecordingId <= 0 && finishedId > 0) {
                preservedRecordingId = finishedId;
            }
            replaceTakeId = finishedId;
        }
        // If the original take already exists in the library (either because
        // the user edited a finished take, or because the converting take
        // finished while the user was editing in Studio), delete the previous
        // take and its file immediately before starting the new conversion!
        if (replaceTakeId > 0) {
            if (preservedRecordingId <= 0) {
                preservedRecordingId = replaceTakeId;
            }
            TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replaceTakeId);
            replaceTakeId = -1L;
        }
        final long recordingId = preservedRecordingId > 0
                ? preservedRecordingId : TakesRepository.allocateId();
        synchronized (ConversionJobs.class) {
            RAW_TO_RECORDING_ID.put(raw.getAbsolutePath(), recordingId);
        }
        if (ctx != null) {
            TrialAndBillingManager.get(ctx).onRecordingSaved(recordingId);
        }

        String title = (replaceTitle != null && !replaceTitle.trim().isEmpty())
                ? replaceTitle.trim()
                : (e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "");
        long dur = Math.max(e.durationMs(), 1000);
        StreamingEncoder sess = e.endStreamingDetach();
        SaveFormat eff = format.effective(preset);
        if (eff == SaveFormat.AUTO) eff = SaveFormat.M4A;
        // An enabled-but-unbaked FX chain invalidates the incremental output:
        // the pump encoded raw microphone frames, so its .part would ship
        // without a single effect. Drop it and let the worker convert the
        // FX-baked raw instead of silently losing the whole chain.
        boolean needsFxBake = e.isFxBakeRequired();
        if (needsFxBake) {
            if (sess != null) {
                try {
                    sess.abort();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                sess = null;
            }
            // Enqueue the background job FIRST so the Library shows the
            // converting card at 0% immediately instead of staying blank
            // while the full-file DSP bake runs.
            ConversionJob prequeued = enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format,
                    dur, replaceTakeId, replaceTitle, recordingId);
            try {
                if (ctx != null) {
                    DspChain.Config cfg = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
                    if (cfg != null && cfg.isActive()) {
                        FormatConverter.WavInfo info =
                                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4
                                / Math.max(1, info.channels);
                        if (totalFrames > 0) {
                            DspChain chain = new DspChain(info.channels, cfg);
                            EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, 0, totalFrames,
                                    chain, null);
                            e.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "dispatchSave fx bake failed: " + ex);
            }
            e.setFxBakeRequired(false);
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
            if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(0);
            return SaveResult.background(prequeued);
        }
        // framesEncoded() > 0 is NOT evidence that the pump kept up: a
        // format switch restarts the encoder from the top of the raw file, so
        // it reports progress after its first chunk while nearly the whole
        // take is still unencoded. Only drain inline when the real backlog is
        // tiny; otherwise skip straight to the worker with no stall at all.
        boolean canAdoptInline = sess != null && sess.healthy()
                && sess.matches(preset, format)
                && sess.framesEncoded() > 0
                && sess.unencodedFrames() <= MAX_INLINE_TAIL_FRAMES;
        if (canAdoptInline) {
            try {
                if (!sess.finish(ADOPT_DRAIN_BUDGET_MS)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("drain budget exceeded");
                }
                if (sess.finishedOk()) {
                    File part = sess.partFile();
                    // Same guard as the background path: a pass-through FLAC
                    // encoder hands back a near-full-size file under a
                    // lossless label. Fall through to the worker, which
                    // re-encodes as WAV24.
                    if (eff == SaveFormat.FLAC
                            && TakeSaver.flacLooksIneffective(part.length(),
                            raw.length())) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "flac ineffective; fallback to worker");
                    }
                    FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
                    File fin = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw,
                            eff.extension());
                    if (!part.renameTo(fin)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("adopt failed");
                    }
                    // Maintain the 32-bit float file in storage linked to
                    // recordingId (or delete raw if fin is already WAV32).
                    TakesRepository.adoptFloatMaster(recordingId, raw, fin);
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
                    return SaveResult.adopted(recordingId, fin,
                            TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, format), dur, title);
                }
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "stream adopt failed: " + ex);
            }
            // abort(), never a bare unlink: a timed-out finish() leaves the
            // pump running, and only abort() stops it. Enqueuing a job onto
            // the same part path while that thread still writes it corrupts
            // the container.
            sess.abort();
        } else if (sess != null) {
            sess.abort();
        }
        ConversionJob job = enqueue(ctx, raw, title, preset, format, dur,
                replaceTakeId, replaceTitle, recordingId);
        // The sidecar now exists, so recovery no longer needs the pending
        // marker. Keep it until this instant to close the finalize/enqueue
        // crash window.
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").delete();
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(0);
        return SaveResult.background(job);
    }
}

=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/ConversionService.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.PowerManager;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.concurrent.CancellationException;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque;

/**
 * Foreground host for background conversions. Keeps converting after the
 * user leaves the studio — or the app entirely — with one persistent
 * progress notification per service (latest job shown), a completion notice,
 * and a broadcast the library listens for.
 *
 * <p>Jobs run serially on a single worker thread: encoders contend badly,
 * and serial order makes progress reporting and cancellation exact. A kill
 * mid-job loses only the in-memory encoder state — the raw, the sidecar and
 * any WAV partial survive, and {@link ConversionJobs#sweep} requeues on the
 * next launch (or via {@code START_REDELIVER_INTENT}).
 */
public class ConversionService extends Service {

    public static final String ACTION_CONVERT =
            "com.example.hello.CONV_RUN";
    public static final String ACTION_CANCEL_JOB =
            "com.example.hello.CONV_CANCEL";

    public static final String EXTRA_JOB_ID = "job_id";

    /** Broadcast when a background conversion finishes (ok or not). */
    public static final String BROADCAST_CONVERSION_DONE =
            "com.example.hello.CONV_DONE";
    public static final String EXTRA_OK = "ok";
    public static final String EXTRA_TITLE = "title";
    public static final String EXTRA_LABEL = "label";
    public static final String EXTRA_MESSAGE = "message";

    private static final String CHANNEL = "takeone_converting";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 42;
    private static final int DONE_NOTIF_ID = 43;

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final Deque<String> queue = new ConcurrentLinkedDeque<>();
    private Thread worker;
    private volatile boolean workerAlive;
    private static volatile boolean running;
    /**
     * Process-wide lock ensuring that if ConversionService is destroyed and
     * recreated while a previous worker thread is still unwinding a codec
     * chunk, the new worker thread waits until the retiring thread exits
     * before touching any sidecar or `.part` file.
     */
    private static final Object WORKER_SERIAL_LOCK = new Object();
    /**
     * Set when the platform enforces the foreground-service time budget
     * (onTimeout). The worker parks instead of cancelling so every job
     * survives for the next launch. Reset whenever a worker starts.
     */
    private volatile boolean serviceTimedOut;

    /** Thrown from the progress callback to park the job on timeout. */
    private static final class PausedForTimeoutException extends RuntimeException {
        PausedForTimeoutException() {
            super("service time budget expired");
        }
    }
    private volatile ConversionJob current;
    /** Set when a startForegroundService() start still owes a foreground. */
    private volatile boolean pendingFg;
    /** Keeps the CPU awake while an encoder is pumping with the screen off. */
    private PowerManager.WakeLock wakeLock;

    /**
     * Starts (or re-kicks) the conversion service and arms the recovery
     * watchdog. Returns false when the platform rejected both start paths;
     * the job sidecar still exists, so the next app launch or watchdog pass
     * can recover it.
     */
    public static boolean startJob(Context ctx, String jobId) {
        boolean started = kick(ctx, jobId);
        ConversionWatchdog.arm(ctx);
        return started;
    }

    /**
     * Start path used by the watchdog: no re-arming, so the watchdog cannot
     * cancel itself while it is running. Package-private for tests.
     */
    static boolean kick(Context ctx, String jobId) {
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, ConversionService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_CONVERT);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID, jobId);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                ctx.startForegroundService(i);
            } else {
                ctx.startService(i);
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable first) {
            // Android 12+ blocks background FGS starts. The app is usually in
            // the foreground at save time, but a notification action or a
            // retry can land in the background; keep the sidecar and let the
            // watchdog retry with a temporary foreground allowance.
            try {
                ctx.startService(i);
                return true;
            } catch (Throwable second) {
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "conv start failed: " + first
                        + " / " + second);
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    /** True while a live service instance owns the conversion queue. */
    static boolean isRunning() {
        return running;
    }

    public static void cancelJob(Context ctx, String jobId) {
        ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.get(jobId);
        if (job != null) job.cancelled = true;
        Intent i = new Intent(ctx, ConversionService.class);
        i.setAction(ACTION_CANCEL_JOB);
        i.putExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID, jobId);
        try {
            ctx.startService(i);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        super.onCreate();
        running = true;
        ensureChannel();
        // Death-resume: rebuild the queue from sidecars before doing any
        // work, so a redelivered intent can never strand a job.
        for (ConversionJob job : ConversionJobs.sweep(this)) {
            enqueueIfNeeded(job.jobId);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Adds a job to the queue at most once, and never re-adds the job that is
     * currently executing. {@code queue.contains()} alone was not enough: the
     * running job had already been polled off the queue, so a sweep could
     * insert it again and run it a second time.
     */
    private void enqueueIfNeeded(String id) {
        if (id == null) return;
