        synchronized (this) {
            if (current != null && id.equals(current.jobId)) return;
            if (queue.contains(id)) return;
            if (ConversionJobs.get(id) == null) return;
            queue.addLast(id);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        if (intent == null) {
            pump();
            return START_REDELIVER_INTENT;
        }
        String a = intent.getAction();
        if (ACTION_CANCEL_JOB.equals(a)) {
            String id = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID);
            if (id != null) {
                ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.get(id);
                if (job != null) job.cancelled = true;
                queue.remove(id);
                if (current != null && id.equals(current.jobId)) {
                    current.cancelled = true;
                    Thread w = worker;
                    if (w != null) w.interrupt();
                } else {
                    // Queued but never started: drop it now.
                    ConversionJobs.cancel(id, false);
                }
            }
            if (queue.isEmpty() && current == null) {
                stopSelf();
            } else {
                refreshNotif();
            }
            return START_REDELIVER_INTENT;
        }
        // Started via startForegroundService(): the platform is now watching
        // for startForeground() before pump() decides what to do.
        pendingFg = true;
        // ACTION_CONVERT (or anything else): make sure the id is queued,
        // then pump. Sweep only when nothing is in flight: sweeping mid-run
        // used to re-queue the job that was already executing (its id had
        // been polled off the queue) and reset its state.
        if (queue.isEmpty() && current == null) {
            for (ConversionJob job : ConversionJobs.sweep(this)) {
                enqueueIfNeeded(job.jobId);
            }
        }
        if (intent.hasExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID)) {
            enqueueIfNeeded(intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID));
        }
        pump();
        return START_REDELIVER_INTENT;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        running = false;
        workerAlive = false;
        Thread w;
        synchronized (this) {
            w = worker;
            worker = null;
        }
        if (w != null) {
            w.interrupt();
        }
        // An unexpected destroy (OEM task-kill, FGS budget, process trim) must
        // leave a resumable QUEUED job rather than a RUNNING sidecar that no
        // worker will ever touch again.
        ConversionJob job = current;
        if (job != null && !job.cancelled
                && ConversionJob.RUNNING.equals(job.state)) {
            job.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
            job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
            job.write();
        }
        if (!serviceTimedOut && (job != null || !queue.isEmpty())) {
            // Service died with work still pending: make sure a watchdog pass
            // brings it back even if the user never reopens the app. A dataSync
            // budget timeout is deliberate and must not be retried in a loop.
            ConversionWatchdog.arm(this);
        }
        releaseWakeLock();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    /**
     * The user swiped the task away: persist the in-flight job as QUEUED
     * before the process can die, keeping its raw and partial output intact,
     * and make sure a watchdog pass brings it back.
     */
    @Override
    public void onTaskRemoved(Intent rootIntent) {
        ConversionJob job = current;
        if (job != null && !job.cancelled
                && ConversionJob.RUNNING.equals(job.state)) {
            job.paused = false;
            job.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
            job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
            job.write();
        }
        if (!serviceTimedOut) {
            ConversionWatchdog.arm(this);
        }
        super.onTaskRemoved(rootIntent);
    }

    // ---- wake lock ----

    /**
     * A foreground service keeps the process alive but does not keep the CPU
     * awake. Without a partial wake lock, a screen-off device can suspend the
     * conversion thread indefinitely, which is exactly the "background
     * converter stopped" symptom. Acquired for the life of the worker and
     * released in every exit path (process death releases it automatically).
     */
    private void acquireWakeLock() {
        try {
            PowerManager pm = (PowerManager) getSystemService(POWER_SERVICE);
            if (pm == null) return;
            if (wakeLock == null) {
                wakeLock = pm.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK,
                        "takeone:conversion");
                wakeLock.setReferenceCounted(false);
            }
            if (!wakeLock.isHeld()) wakeLock.acquire();
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "conv wake lock failed: " + t);
        }
    }

    private void releaseWakeLock() {
        try {
            if (wakeLock != null && wakeLock.isHeld()) wakeLock.release();
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- worker ----

    private synchronized void pump() {
        // A4-04: when this service was launched with startForegroundService()
        // the framework requires startForeground() within ~5s or it throws
        // ForegroundServiceDidNotStartInTimeException. Answer every start,
        // including one that finds a worker already running or an empty
        // queue (both used to return/stop without ever foregrounding).
        if (pendingFg) {
            pendingFg = false;
            if (!startFg(resolveCurrent())) return;
        }
        if (workerAlive) return;
        if (queue.isEmpty()) {
            ConversionWatchdog.cancel(this);
            stopSelf();
            return;
        }
        workerAlive = true;
        serviceTimedOut = false;
        acquireWakeLock();
        if (!startFg(resolveCurrent())) {
            workerAlive = false;
            releaseWakeLock();
            return;
        }
        worker = new Thread(() -> {
            // Encoding is never latency-critical. Run below UI, capture and
            // preview so a conversion cannot make the studio stutter.
            android.os.Process.setThreadPriority(
                    android.os.Process.THREAD_PRIORITY_BACKGROUND);
            workLoop();
        }, "takeone-conv");
        worker.start();
    }

    /** Android 15 dataSync budget expiry: stop cleanly instead of being killed. */
    @Override
    public void onTimeout(int startId, int fgsType) {
        // Pause, don't destroy: cancelling the job here would delete its
        // sidecar and .part, and clearing the queue would strand the other
        // QUEUED jobs with no worker. Flag the timeout and wake any parked
        // worker; the progress callback parks the current job as QUEUED so
        // the next launch resumes everything intact.
        serviceTimedOut = true;
        // onTimeout does not stop WorkManager's own chain; re-arm it so the
        // queued sidecars are resumed after the dataSync budget resets.
        ConversionWatchdog.retry(this);
        try {
            stopForeground(true);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        stopSelf();
        super.onTimeout(startId, fgsType);
    }

    /** Monitor that parks conversion while the microphone is capturing. */
    private static final Object CAPTURE_PAUSE_LOCK = new Object();

    /** Wakes a parked conversion immediately when capture pauses or stops. */
    public static void onRecordingStateChanged() {
        synchronized (CAPTURE_PAUSE_LOCK) {
            CAPTURE_PAUSE_LOCK.notifyAll();
        }
    }

    /**
     * True while the mic is actually capturing. A conversion yields briefly
     * per progress tick so a live take always wins CPU and codec contention,
     * but it keeps moving: an edit session or an open raw reader is safe
     * alongside the append-only raw, and final raw deletion is deferred until
     * the last reader closes.
     */
    private static boolean recordingInProgress() {
        try {
            return RecordingEngine.get().state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Parks conversion completely while the mic is capturing. The worker
     * keeps its exact in-memory position, so resuming after Pause/Stop is
     * immediate and never restarts the take.
     */
    private void paceForCapture(ConversionJob job) {
        if (!recordingInProgress()) return;
        synchronized (CAPTURE_PAUSE_LOCK) {
            try {
                while (workerAlive && !serviceTimedOut && recordingInProgress()
                        && (job == null || !job.cancelled)) {
                    if (job != null && !job.paused) {
                        job.paused = true;
                        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
                    }
                    CAPTURE_PAUSE_LOCK.wait(250L);
                }
            } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            } finally {
                if (job != null && job.paused) {
                    job.paused = false;
                    handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private ConversionJob resolveCurrent() {
        ConversionJob job = current;
        if (job == null) {
            String id = queue.peekFirst();
            if (id != null) job = ConversionJobs.get(id);
        }
        return job;
    }

    private void workLoop() {
        final Thread self = Thread.currentThread();
        try {
            synchronized (WORKER_SERIAL_LOCK) {
                while (workerAlive && worker == self && !self.isInterrupted()) {
                    String id;
                    synchronized (this) {
                        id = queue.pollFirst();
                    }
                    if (id == null) break;
                    ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.get(id);
                    if (job == null || job.cancelled) {
                        if (job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(id, false);
                        continue;
                    }
                    current = job;
                    runJob(job);
                    current = null;
                    if (serviceTimedOut || !workerAlive || worker != self) break;
                }
            }
        } finally {
            synchronized (this) {
                if (worker == self) {
                    worker = null;
                    workerAlive = false;
                    releaseWakeLock();
                    if (queue.isEmpty()) {
                        ConversionWatchdog.cancel(ConversionService.this);
                        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
                        try {
                            stopForeground(true);
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                        try {
                            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
                            if (nm != null) nm.cancel(NOTIF_ID);
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                        stopSelf();
                    } else {
                        pump();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void runJob(ConversionJob job) {
        Context app = getApplicationContext();
        ConversionJobs.markRunning(job);
        ConversionJobs.updateProgress(job, 0, 0);
        handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
        File raw = new File(job.rawPath);
        RecordPreset preset = RecordPreset.of(job.presetId);
        SaveFormat format = SaveFormat.of(job.formatId);
        try {
            if (!raw.exists()) throw new IllegalStateException("raw gone");
            if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
            if (!recordingInProgress()) {
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(60L);
                } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                }
            }
            final int[] lastReportedPct = {0};
            final long jobStartMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            TakeSaver.Progress cb = pct -> {
                if (serviceTimedOut) throw new PausedForTimeoutException();
                if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
                // Brief yield between chunks while the mic captures; editing
                // and reading never stop the job.
                paceForCapture(job);
                if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
                if (pct != lastReportedPct[0]) {
                    lastReportedPct[0] = pct;
                    ConversionJobs.updateProgress(job, pct,
                            pct * Math.max(1, job.framesTotal) / 100);
                    handler.post(this::refreshNotif);
                    long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - jobStartMs;
                    if (pct > 0 && pct < 100 && elapsed < 650L
                            && !recordingInProgress()) {
                        try {
                            Thread.sleep(16L);
                        } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        }
                    }
                }
            };
            TakeSaver.Result r;
            File part = new File(job.partPath);
            // A4-08: judge the partial by its bytes, not by job.framesDone,
            // which is only flushed every 5% of progress. A kill at 2% left a
            // perfectly resumable part that this gate threw away.
            String initialTitle = ConversionJobs.latestTitle(job, job.title);
            job.title = initialTitle;
            if (part.exists() && part.length() > 44
                    && isWavFormat(format.effective(preset))) {
                r = resumeWav(app, job, raw, part, preset, format, cb);
            } else {
                if (part.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    part.delete();
                }
                r = TakeSaver.convertRaw(app, raw, initialTitle, preset,
                        format, cb);
            }
            if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
            // A rename can arrive after encoding finished but before the
            // finished take is visible. It wins over every title captured
            // earlier; without one, the initial edit-replace title (or the
            // live job title, or the conversion result) stands as before.
            String renamed = ConversionJobs.peekRenamedTitle(job.rawPath);
            String liveTitle;
            if (renamed != null) {
                liveTitle = renamed;
            } else if (job.replaceTakeId != -1 && job.replaceTitle != null
                    && !job.replaceTitle.isEmpty()) {
                liveTitle = job.replaceTitle;
            } else if (job.title != null && !job.title.trim().isEmpty()) {
                liveTitle = job.title.trim();
            } else {
                liveTitle = r.title;
            }
            job.title = liveTitle;
            Take take;
            if (job.replaceTakeId != -1) {
                // Edit punch-in saved to the background worker: honour the
                // replace-vs-new choice made up front and preserve the
                // recording's immutable ID instead of duplicating.
                long targetId = job.replaceTakeId;
                if (targetId < 0) {
                    targetId = ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(app, targetId);
                }
                if (targetId > 0) {
                    TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(targetId);
                }
                long finalId = job.recordingId > 0 ? job.recordingId
                        : (targetId > 0 ? targetId : TakesRepository.allocateId());
                take = TakesRepository.addRecordingWithId(finalId,
                        r.file, r.durationMs, liveTitle, r.label);
            } else {
                long finalId = job.recordingId > 0
                        ? job.recordingId : TakesRepository.allocateId();
                take = TakesRepository.addRecordingWithId(finalId,
                        r.file, r.durationMs, liveTitle, r.label);
            }
            ConversionJobs.noteCompletion(job.rawPath, take.id);
            String lateRename = ConversionJobs.consumeRenamedTitle(job.rawPath);
            if (lateRename != null && !lateRename.equals(take.title)) {
                TakesRepository.rename(take.id, lateRename);
            } else if (renamed != null) {
                // Rename arrived while encoding: ensure the converted file on
                // disk also matches the user's renamed title.
                TakesRepository.rename(take.id, liveTitle);
            }
            File finalTakeFile = take.filePath != null
                    ? new File(take.filePath) : r.file;
            // Maintain the 32-bit float file in storage linked to take.id
            // (moving job.rawPath into .float32/rec_<take.id>.f32.wav, or
            // deleting it if finalTakeFile is already WAV32), deferring until
            // the last reader finishes if an Edit or preview holds it open.
            if (finalTakeFile == null || !finalTakeFile.getAbsolutePath()
                    .equals(job.rawPath)) {
                ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                        job.rawPath, finalTakeFile, take.id);
            }
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(job.rawPath + ".pending").delete();
            ConversionJobs.markDone(job);
            doneNotif(true, job.title, r.label, null);
            broadcast(true, job, r.label, null);
        } catch (PausedForTimeoutException paused) {
            // The platform reclaimed our foreground time mid-job. Park the
            // job as QUEUED with its sidecar and valid .part intact — never
            // delete — so the next launch resumes it. Tell the user why
            // progress stopped.
            job.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
            job.updatedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
            job.write();
            timeoutPausedNotif(job);
        } catch (CancellationException cancelled) {
            if (job.superseded) {
                // Replaced by an edit while converting: the replacement job
                // owns the take now. Abort silently — no failure notification,
                // no toast, no .pending marker — and drop the raw the
                // replacement no longer needs.
                ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true);
                return;
            }
            ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, false);
            doneNotif(false, job.title, null,
                    getString(R.string.conv_cancelled_msg, job.title));
            broadcast(false, job, null, "cancelled");
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // Catch Throwable, not Exception: a native codec aborting throws
            // an Error, which slipped past the old handler and left the job
            // stuck in RUNNING forever - the library card never resolved and
            // the service never stopped.
            if (job.cancelled) {
                // A superseded job whose raw vanished mid-encode lands here
                // instead of the CancellationException branch: still silent.
                if (job.superseded) {
                    ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true);
                    return;
                }
                // Lost a race with an explicit cancel (e.g. the raw was
                // deleted under us): the canceller owns the UX, stay quiet.
                ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, false);
                return;
            }
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(getApplicationContext(),
                    "convert worker THREW: " + t);
            android.util.Log.w("ConversionService",
                    "convert worker threw", t);
            ConversionJobs.markFailed(job, String.valueOf(t));
            // Keep the raw and re-arm its pending marker so the next launch
            // offers the usual continue/discard recovery for the take.
            RecordingEngine.writePendingMarker(raw, job.title, job.channels);
            doneNotif(false, job.title, null,
                    getString(R.string.convert_failed_msg, job.title));
            broadcast(false, job, null, String.valueOf(t));
        }
    }

    private static boolean isWavFormat(SaveFormat eff) {
        return eff == SaveFormat.WAV16 || eff == SaveFormat.WAV24
                || eff == SaveFormat.WAV32;
    }

    /**
     * Appends the remaining raw frames to a partial WAV from an interrupted
     * attempt, then patches the header. Byte-exact resume: the cheapest
     * possible "minimum reconversion".
     */
    private TakeSaver.Result resumeWav(Context app, ConversionJob job,
                                       File raw, File part,
                                       RecordPreset preset, SaveFormat format,
                                       TakeSaver.Progress cb) throws Exception {
        return resumeWavConvert(app, raw, part, preset, format, job, cb);
    }

    /**
     * Byte-exact WAV resume: appends frames [job.framesDone, end) to a
     * partial output, then finalizes. A resumed file is bit-identical to a
     * from-scratch conversion, which is what makes "minimum reconversion"
     * more than a slogan. Static + headless so unit tests can prove it.
     */
    static TakeSaver.Result resumeWavConvert(Context app, File raw, File part,
                                             RecordPreset preset,
                                             SaveFormat format,
                                             ConversionJob job,
                                             TakeSaver.Progress cb)
            throws Exception {
        SaveFormat eff = format.effective(preset);
        boolean w32 = eff == SaveFormat.WAV32;
        boolean w24 = eff == SaveFormat.WAV24;
        int pcmFormat = w32 ? 3 : 1;
        int bits = w32 ? 32 : (w24 ? 24 : 16);
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        int ch = Math.max(1, info.channels);
        int frameBytes = ch * (bits / 8);
        long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / ch;
        long expectLen = 44 + job.framesDone * frameBytes;
        if (!isWavHeaderValid(part, ch, info.sampleRate, pcmFormat, bits)) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            return TakeSaver.convertRaw(app, raw, job.title, preset, format, cb);
        }
        if (part.length() != expectLen) {
            // AUDIT-3-02 fix: `job.framesDone` is only a 5%-rounded estimate
            // while converting, so it almost never lines up with the chunked
            // bytes actually on disk. Adopt the real frame-aligned payload
            // instead of throwing away a perfectly good partial.
            long diskPayload = part.length() - 44;
            if (diskPayload > 0 && (diskPayload % frameBytes) == 0
                    && isWavHeaderValid(part, ch, info.sampleRate,
                    pcmFormat, bits)
                    && (diskPayload / frameBytes) <= totalFrames) {
                job.framesDone = diskPayload / frameBytes;
            } else {
                // Partial does not line up: restart cleanly.
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                part.delete();
                return TakeSaver.convertRaw(app, raw, job.title, preset,
                        format, cb);
            }
        }
        try {
            if (job.framesDone >= totalFrames) {
                patchWavHeader(part, info.channels, info.sampleRate,
                        w24, w32, totalFrames);
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
                return finishResumed(app, raw, part, job, eff, preset);
            }
        java.io.RandomAccessFile r = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "r");
        java.io.RandomAccessFile w = null;
        try {
            w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4;
            long doneSamples = job.framesDone * info.channels;
            w.seek(w.length());
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(65536, ch);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * 4];
            // Worst case (32-bit float / 24-bit packed: 4 bytes per sample).
            byte[] out = new byte[chunk * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            int[] ints = w24 ? new int[chunk] : null;
            java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = w24 ? null : java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asShortBuffer();
            int lastPct = -1;
            while (doneSamples < totalSamples) {
                if (job.cancelled) throw new CancellationException();
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunk, totalSamples - doneSamples);
                r.seek(info.dataStart + doneSamples * 4L);
                r.readFully(in, 0, want * 4);
                if (w32) {
                    w.write(in, 0, want * 4);
                } else if (w24) {
                    FormatConverter.toInt24(fb, want, ints);
                    int p = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < want; i++) {
                        int v = ints[i];
                        out[p++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
                        out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
                        out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
                    }
                    w.write(out, 0, want * 3);
                } else {
                    FormatConverter.toInt16(fb, want, sb);
                    w.write(out, 0, want * 2);
                }
                doneSamples += want;
                int pct = (int) (doneSamples * 100 / Math.max(1, totalSamples));
                if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(pct);
                if (pct != lastPct) {
                    lastPct = pct;
                    job.framesDone = doneSamples / Math.max(1, info.channels);
                }
            }
            patchWavHeader(part, info.channels, info.sampleRate,
                    w24, w32, totalFrames);
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
        return finishResumed(app, raw, part, job, eff, preset);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // A failed resume must not leave its part behind: the job's
            // sidecar is deleted on failure, so nothing could ever resume
            // this part again. Exception: an Android 15 FGS timeout leaves
            // a byte-valid resumable WAV part behind on purpose.
            boolean keepWavPart = t.getClass().getSimpleName().contains("Timeout")
                    && (eff == SaveFormat.WAV16 || eff == SaveFormat.WAV24
                    || eff == SaveFormat.WAV32);
            if (!keepWavPart) {
                try {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    part.delete();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (t instanceof Error) throw (Error) t;
            if (t instanceof Exception) throw (Exception) t;
            throw new IllegalStateException(t);
        }
    }

    private static TakeSaver.Result finishResumed(Context app, File raw,
                                                   File part,
                                                   ConversionJob job,
                                                   SaveFormat eff,
                                                   RecordPreset preset)
            throws Exception {
        // Same bar as a fresh conversion (NEW-03): never expose an
        // unvalidated container under a final extension.
        FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
        File fin = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw, "wav");
        if (!part.renameTo(fin)) throw new IllegalStateException("adopt");
        // AUDIT-3-01 fix: `fin` may be integer PCM16/PCM24 (audioFormat 1)
        // or raw float WAV32 (audioFormat 3), so `TakeSaver.durationOf(fin)`
        // cannot read it uniformly. Read duration via `Dsp.wavDurationMs`.
        long dur = Dsp.wavDurationMs(fin);
        if (dur <= 0) {
            dur = Math.max(TakeSaver.durationOf(raw),
                    Math.max(job.durationMs, 1000));
        }
        return new TakeSaver.Result(fin, eff.badge, Math.max(dur, 1000),
                job.title);
    }

    /** True when the partial carries a real RIFF/WAVE header. */
    private static boolean isWavHeaderValid(File part) {
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r =
                      new java.io.RandomAccessFile(part, "r")) {
            if (r.length() < 44) return false;
            byte[] h = new byte[12];
            r.readFully(h);
            return h[0] == 'R' && h[1] == 'I' && h[2] == 'F' && h[3] == 'F'
                    && h[8] == 'W' && h[9] == 'A' && h[10] == 'V'
                    && h[11] == 'E';
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * True when the partial is a real RIFF/WAVE file with exactly the geometry
     * a resume would append: expected PCM format, channels, rate and depth. A
     * stale part from a different bit depth or channel count whose byte size
     * happens to divide evenly must never be adopted.
     */
    private static boolean isWavHeaderValid(File part, int expectedCh,
                                            int expectedSr, int expectedFormat,
                                            int expectedBits) {
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile r =
                     new java.io.RandomAccessFile(part, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            return h.audioFormat == expectedFormat
                    && h.channels == expectedCh
                    && h.sampleRate == expectedSr && h.bits == expectedBits;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    // ---- notifications ----

    private void ensureChannel() {
        ensureChannel(this);
    }

    /** Package-private so the recovery watchdog can foreground itself. */
    static void ensureChannel(Context ctx) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return;
        try {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(
                    CHANNEL, ctx.getString(R.string.conv_channel),
                    NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ch.setDescription(ctx.getString(R.string.conv_channel_desc));
            nm.createNotificationChannel(ch);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Small ongoing notice used by the watchdog while it obtains a temporary
     * foreground allowance to restart a stranded conversion. It disappears
     * as soon as the worker finishes; the conversion service then owns the
     * real progress notification.
     */
    static Notification buildWatchdogNotif(Context ctx) {
        ensureChannel(ctx);
        androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(ctx, CHANNEL);
        b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_wave);
        b.setColor(0xFFFF9F0A);
        b.setContentTitle(ctx.getString(R.string.conv_watchdog_title));
        b.setContentText(ctx.getString(R.string.conv_watchdog_text));
        b.setCategory(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_PROGRESS);
        b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
        b.setOngoing(true);
        b.setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        b.setSilent(true);
        b.setShowWhen(false);
        try {
            Intent open = new Intent(ctx, MainActivity.class);
            PendingIntent content = PendingIntent.getActivity(ctx, 33, open,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
            b.setContentIntent(content);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {
            return b.build();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new Notification();
        }
    }

    private boolean startFg(ConversionJob job) {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, buildNotif(job),
                        android.content.pm.ServiceInfo
                                .FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_DATA_SYNC);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, buildNotif(job));
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this, "conv startForeground failed: " + e);
            try {
                stopSelf();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void refreshNotif() {
        try {
            if (!workerAlive) return;
            ConversionJob job = resolveCurrent();
            if (job == null && queue.isEmpty()) return;
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm != null) nm.notify(NOTIF_ID, buildNotif(job));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private Notification buildNotif(ConversionJob job) {
        String title;
        String text;
        String badge = null;
        int pct = -1;
        if (job != null) {
            pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, job.progress));
            badge = TakeSaver.labelFor(RecordPreset.of(job.presetId),
                    SaveFormat.of(job.formatId));
            title = getString(R.string.conv_notif_title, pct);
            text = getString(R.string.conv_notif_text, job.title, badge);
            if (job.paused) {
                text = getString(R.string.notif_paused_short, text);
            }
        } else {
            title = getString(R.string.conv_notif_idle_title);
            text = getString(R.string.conv_notif_idle_text);
        }
        Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
        PendingIntent content = null;
        try {
            content = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 30, open,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                            | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL);
        b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_wave);
        b.setColor(0xFFFF3B30);
        b.setColorized(false);
        if (badge != null) b.setSubText(badge);
        b.setContentTitle(title);
        b.setContentText(text);
        b.setCategory(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.CATEGORY_PROGRESS);
        b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
        b.setOngoing(true);
        b.setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        b.setSilent(true);
        b.setShowWhen(false);
        if (content != null) b.setContentIntent(content);
        if (pct >= 0) b.setProgress(100, pct, false);
        if (job != null) {
            Intent cancel = new Intent(this, ConversionService.class);
            cancel.setAction(ACTION_CANCEL_JOB);
            cancel.putExtra(EXTRA_JOB_ID, job.jobId);
            PendingIntent pi = null;
            try {
                pi = PendingIntent.getService(this, 31 + job.jobId.hashCode(),
                        cancel, PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                                | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (pi != null) {
                b.addAction(0, getString(R.string.conv_cancel), pi);
            }
        }
        try {
            return b.build();
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            return new Notification();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Tells the user the platform paused background conversion (time budget),
     * and that it resumes on next launch. Informational only: no take state
     * changes and no worker action.
     */
    private void timeoutPausedNotif(ConversionJob job) {
        try {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                    new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this,
                            CHANNEL);
            b.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_wave);
            b.setColor(0xFFFF9F0A);
            b.setContentTitle(getString(R.string.conv_timeout_title));
            b.setContentText(getString(R.string.conv_timeout_msg,
                    job.title != null ? job.title : ""));
            b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
            b.setAutoCancel(true);
            nm.notify(DONE_NOTIF_ID + (int) (System.currentTimeMillis() % 1000),
                    b.build());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void doneNotif(boolean ok, String title, String label, String msg) {
        try {
            NotificationManager nm = (NotificationManager)
                    getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
            if (nm == null) return;
            Intent open = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
            PendingIntent content = null;
            try {
                content = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 32, open,
                        PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
                                | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            boolean isCancel = "cancelled".equals(msg)
                    || (msg != null && msg.contains("cancelled"));
            androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder b =
                    new androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.Builder(this,
                            CHANNEL);
            b.setSmallIcon(ok ? R.drawable.ic_check : R.drawable.ic_wave);
            b.setColor(ok ? 0xFF34C759 : 0xFFFF3B30);
            if (label != null && !label.isEmpty()) b.setSubText(label);
            b.setContentTitle(ok ? getString(R.string.convert_done_title)
                    : (isCancel ? getString(R.string.conv_cancelled)
                            : getString(R.string.convert_failed_title)));
            b.setContentText(ok
                    ? getString(R.string.convert_done_msg, title, label)
                    : (msg != null ? msg : ""));
            b.setVisibility(androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC);
            b.setAutoCancel(true);
            if (content != null) b.setContentIntent(content);
            nm.notify(DONE_NOTIF_ID + (int) (System.currentTimeMillis() % 1000),
                    b.build());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // NOTE: Do NOT call handler.post(this::refreshNotif) here!
        // Posting refreshNotif after the final job finishes races with
        // stopForeground(true) and leaves a permanent "Conversion ready"
        // notification stuck in the notification shade.
    }

    private void broadcast(boolean ok, ConversionJob job, String label,
                           String message) {
        try {
            Intent b = new Intent(BROADCAST_CONVERSION_DONE);
            b.putExtra(EXTRA_OK, ok);
            b.putExtra(EXTRA_TITLE, job.title);
            b.putExtra("job_id", job.jobId);
            if (label != null) b.putExtra(EXTRA_LABEL, label);
            if (message != null) b.putExtra("message", message);
            b.setPackage(getPackageName());
            sendBroadcast(b);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // No bottom toast here: completion is surfaced by the stylized top
        // banner in the Library/Studio, never by a transient snackbar.
    }

    private static void patchWavHeader(File part, int ch, int sr, boolean w24,
                                       boolean w32, long frames)
            throws Exception {
        java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
        try {
            w.seek(0);
            w.write(w32 ? Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, sr, frames * ch * 4L)
                    : (w24 ? Dsp.wav24Header(ch, sr, frames * ch * 3L)
                    : Dsp.wav16Header(ch, sr, frames * ch * 2L)));
        } finally {
            try {
                w.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.work.ExistingWorkPolicy;
import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequest;
import androidx.work.WorkManager;

import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/**
 * Persisted safety net for background conversions.
 *
 * <p>The foreground service is the fast path. If it is killed by an OEM
 * battery manager, a process trim or a foreground-service budget, no app code
 * runs to restart it. This one-shot WorkManager request survives process
 * death and reboots; it re-arms itself while a sidecar is unfinished and
 * starts the service with a temporary foreground allowance. WorkManager is
 * also allowed to start a foreground service when the app itself is in the
 * background, which a plain alarm or broadcast cannot do on Android 12+.
 */
final class ConversionWatchdog {

    static final String UNIQUE = "takeone-conversion-watchdog";
    /** First pass after a save: long enough for the service to start itself. */
    static final long FIRST_DELAY_MINUTES = 2L;
    /** Later passes while a job is still unfinished. */
    static final long RETRY_DELAY_MINUTES = 15L;

    private ConversionWatchdog() {}

    static void arm(Context ctx) {
        schedule(ctx, FIRST_DELAY_MINUTES);
    }

    static void retry(Context ctx) {
        schedule(ctx, RETRY_DELAY_MINUTES);
    }

    /** Stops the chain once the queue has drained cleanly. */
    static void cancel(Context ctx) {
        if (ctx == null) return;
        try {
            WorkManager.getInstance(ctx.getApplicationContext())
                    .cancelUniqueWork(UNIQUE);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "conv watchdog cancel failed: " + t);
        }
    }

    private static void schedule(Context ctx, long delayMinutes) {
        if (ctx == null) return;
        try {
            OneTimeWorkRequest request =
                    new OneTimeWorkRequest.Builder(
                            ConversionWatchdogWorker.class)
                            .setInitialDelay(delayMinutes, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
                            .addTag(UNIQUE)
                            .build();
            WorkManager.getInstance(ctx.getApplicationContext())
                    .enqueueUniqueWork(UNIQUE, ExistingWorkPolicy.REPLACE,
                            request);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // WorkManager can be unavailable in stripped test environments;
            // the startup sweep on the next launch remains the fallback.
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "conv watchdog arm failed: " + t);
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/ConversionWatchdogWorker.java

package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Notification;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.os.Build;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.work.ForegroundInfo;
import androidx.work.Worker;
import androidx.work.WorkerParameters;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/**
 * Recovery pass for conversions whose service was killed in the background.
 * Sweeps sidecars, re-kicks every unfinished job, then re-arms itself until
 * the queue is empty. Runs as a short foreground worker so Android 12+
 * permits it to restart the conversion service from the background.
 */
public class ConversionWatchdogWorker extends Worker {

    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 93;

    public ConversionWatchdogWorker(@NonNull Context context,
                                    @NonNull WorkerParameters params) {
        super(context, params);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public Result doWork() {
        Context ctx = getApplicationContext();
        List<ConversionJob> pending;
        try {
            pending = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "conv watchdog sweep failed: " + t);
            ConversionWatchdog.retry(ctx);
            return Result.retry();
        }
        if (pending.isEmpty()) {
            ConversionWatchdog.cancel(ctx);
            return Result.success();
        }
        // The live service is already doing the work; promoting this worker
        // to foreground would only consume a second dataSync budget.
        if (ConversionService.isRunning()) return Result.success();
        goForeground(ctx);
        boolean kicked = false;
        for (ConversionJob job : pending) {
            if (job == null || job.cancelled) continue;
            // kick(), not startJob(): arming here would REPLACE this running
            // worker and could cancel it before it finishes.
            if (ConversionService.kick(ctx, job.jobId)) kicked = true;
        }
        // Stay armed: if this pass could not start the service, or the service
        // dies again, the next pass retries. The chain stops by itself when a
        // sweep finds no unfinished sidecars. Always return success here so
        // WorkManager's own backoff does not race this explicit schedule.
        ConversionWatchdog.retry(ctx);
        if (!kicked) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx,
                    "conv watchdog could not kick " + pending.size()
                            + " job(s)");
        }
        return Result.success();
    }

    private void goForeground(Context ctx) {
        try {
            Notification n = ConversionService.buildWatchdogNotif(ctx);
            ForegroundInfo info = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29
                    ? new ForegroundInfo(NOTIF_ID, n,
                            ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_DATA_SYNC)
                    : new ForegroundInfo(NOTIF_ID, n);
            setForegroundAsync(info).get(8, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "conv watchdog foreground failed: " + t);
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/CrashLog.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.Uri;

import androidx.core.content.FileProvider;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.io.StringWriter;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Last-resort diagnostics. The default uncaught-exception handler writes the
 * stack trace to {@code takeone-crash.txt} before delegating to the system
 * handler, and {@link #breadcrumb} appends lifecycle markers to
 * {@code takeone-breadcrumbs.txt} so a launch loop leaves a trail even when
 * the killer is native code (which no try/catch can observe).
 */
public final class CrashLog {

    private static final String CRASH_FILE = "takeone-crash.txt";
    private static final String CRUMB_FILE = "takeone-breadcrumbs.txt";
    private static final long MAX_CRUMB_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

    private static volatile boolean installed;

    private CrashLog() {}

    /** Idempotent. Call first in every process entry point. */
    public static void install(Context ctx) {
        if (installed) return;
        installed = true;
        final Context app;
        try {
            app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        breadcrumb(app, "process start");
        final Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler prev =
                Thread.getDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler();
        Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler((thread, err) -> {
            try {
                breadcrumb(app, "CRASH on " + thread.getName() + ": " + err);
                File f = new File(app.getFilesDir(), CRASH_FILE);
                FileWriter w = new FileWriter(f, false);
                try {
                    w.write(stamp() + " thread=" + thread.getName() + "\n");
                    StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
                    PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(sw);
                    try {
                        err.printStackTrace(pw);
                    } finally {
                        pw.close();
                    }
                    w.write(sw.toString());
                    w.write("\n--- breadcrumbs ---\n");
                    File crumbs = new File(app.getFilesDir(), CRUMB_FILE);
                    if (crumbs.exists()) {
                        java.io.FileInputStream in =
                                new java.io.FileInputStream(crumbs);
                        try {
                            byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
                            int n;
                            while ((n = in.read(buf)) != -1) {
                                w.write(new String(buf, 0, n, "UTF-8"));
                            }
                        } finally {
                            try {
                                in.close();
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                        }
                    }
                    // Flushed to the OS: process death doesn't lose it
                    // (only power loss would, and nothing can help that).
                    w.flush();
                } finally {
                    try {
                        w.close();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (prev != null) {
                    try {
                        prev.uncaughtException(thread, err);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /** Append one marker line (flushed; cheap enough for startup stages). */
    public static void breadcrumb(Context ctx, String mark) {
        if (ctx == null || mark == null) return;
        try {
            Context app = ctx.getApplicationContext();
            File f = new File(app.getFilesDir(), CRUMB_FILE);
            if (f.exists() && f.length() > MAX_CRUMB_BYTES) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                f.delete();
            }
            FileWriter w = new FileWriter(f, true);
            try {
                w.write(stamp() + " " + mark + "\n");
                w.flush();
            } finally {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** Crash report from a previous run, or null. */
    public static File recentCrash(Context ctx) {
        try {
            File f = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), CRASH_FILE);
            return f.exists() && f.length() > 0 ? f : null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Last convert/finalize stage that started but never reported back.
     * A native encoder death leaves "convert start opus" as the tail with no
     * matching end — the one trace a segfault cannot erase.
     *
     * @return e.g. "convert opus", "finalize", or null when everything closed.
     */
    public static String unterminatedStage(Context ctx) {
        try {
            File f = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), CRUMB_FILE);
            if (!f.exists()) return null;
            java.io.FileInputStream in = new java.io.FileInputStream(f);
            String tail;
            try {
                long len = f.length();
                long skip = Math.max(0, len - 8192);
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                in.skip(skip);
                byte[] buf = new byte[(int) Math.min(len, 8192) + 1];
                int n = in.read(buf);
                tail = n > 0 ? new String(buf, 0, n, "UTF-8") : "";
            } finally {
                try {
                    in.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            String pending = null;
            for (String line : tail.split("\n")) {
                int s = line.indexOf("convert start ");
                if (s >= 0) {
                    pending = "convert "
                            + line.substring(s + "convert start ".length()).trim();
                    continue;
                }
                if (line.contains("convert end")) {
                    pending = null;
                    continue;
                }
                if (pending != null && pending.startsWith("convert ")) {
                    // Switch lines carry the bare format id ("auto-switch
                    // flac->m4a") while pending holds the stage ("convert
                    // flac").
                    String fmt = pending.substring("convert ".length());
                    if (!fmt.isEmpty() && line.contains("auto-switch " + fmt)) {
                        pending = null;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (line.contains("finalize start")) {
                    pending = "finalize";
                    continue;
                }
                if (line.contains("finalize end")) {
                    pending = null;
                }
            }
            return pending;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static void clearCrash(Context ctx) {
        try {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(), CRASH_FILE).delete();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** Share intent for the crash report (email, chat, …). */
    public static void share(Context ctx, File crash) {
        try {
            Uri uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(ctx,
                    ctx.getPackageName() + ".fileprovider", crash);
            android.content.Intent i = new android.content.Intent(
                    android.content.Intent.ACTION_SEND);
            i.setType("text/plain");
            i.putExtra(android.content.Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri);
            i.putExtra(android.content.Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT,
                    "TakeOne crash report");
            i.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
            ctx.startActivity(android.content.Intent.createChooser(i,
                    "Share crash report"));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static String stamp() {
        try {
            return new SimpleDateFormat("MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.US)
                    .format(new Date());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "?";
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.LinearGradient;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.graphics.Shader;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.View;

/**
 * Slim vertical dBFS meter (-60..0&nbsp;dB).
 *
 * <p>Designed to live as a thin rail beside the timer: a rounded capsule
 * track with a soft glow at the fill head, a single continuous colour ramp
 * rather than hard colour bands, and a peak-hold tick that decays slowly.
 */
public class DbMeterView extends View {

    private static final float FLOOR_DB = -60f;

    private final Paint trackPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint fillPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint glowPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint peakPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final RectF rect = new RectF();

    private float level; // 0..1 smoothed
    private float peak;  // 0..1 peak-hold
    private float radius;

    public DbMeterView(Context context) {
        super(context);
        init();
    }

    public DbMeterView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        init();
    }

    private void init() {
        trackPaint.setColor(0xFF171B21);
        glowPaint.setColor(0x66FFFFFF);
        peakPaint.setColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
    }

    /** Push one 0..1 peak sample; call at the studio tick cadence. */
    public void setLevel(float v) {
        v = Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, v));
        // Fast attack so transients are not hidden, slow release so the bar
        // does not flicker between words.
        level = v > level ? v : level + (v - level) * 0.22f;
        peak = Math.max(v, peak - 0.010f);
        invalidate();
    }

    public void reset() {
        level = 0f;
        peak = 0f;
        invalidate();
    }

    private static float toDb(float v) {
        if (v <= 0.0001f) return FLOOR_DB;
        return Math.max(FLOOR_DB, 20f * (float) Math.log10(v));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        radius = Math.min(w / 2f, 6f);
        float inset = 0f;
        float top = inset;
        float bottom = h - inset;

        rect.set(0, top, w, bottom);
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, trackPaint);

        float db = toDb(level);
        float frac = (db - FLOOR_DB) / (0 - FLOOR_DB);
        float fillTop = bottom - frac * (bottom - top);
        if (fillTop >= bottom - 0.5f) return;

        // One smooth ramp across the full height: red at the top, amber
        // through the mids, green near the floor. No banding.
        fillPaint.setShader(new LinearGradient(0, top, 0, bottom,
                new int[]{0xFFFF453A, 0xFFFF9F0A, 0xFF34C759},
                new float[]{0f, 0.30f, 0.62f},
                Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
        rect.set(0, fillTop, w, bottom);
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, fillPaint);
        fillPaint.setShader(null);

        // Soft cap highlight at the fill head.
        glowPaint.setAlpha(70);
        float capH = Math.min(10f, Math.max(3f, h * 0.02f));
        rect.set(0, fillTop, w, fillTop + capH);
        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, radius, radius, glowPaint);
        glowPaint.setAlpha(255);

        float pdb = toDb(peak);
        float pfrac = (pdb - FLOOR_DB) / (0 - FLOOR_DB);
        float py = bottom - pfrac * (bottom - top);
        if (py > top && py < bottom) {
            peakPaint.setStrokeWidth(Math.max(1.5f, w * 0.16f));
            peakPaint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND);
            canvas.drawLine(w * 0.28f, py, w * 0.72f, py, peakPaint);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 split-band de-esser: a band-pass sidechain extracts sibilance
 * energy, compares it (in dB) against the broadband energy and attenuates
 * the sibilant band when the relative ratio crosses the threshold.
 *
 * <p>Because the detection is relative, quiet whispers and loud shouts are
 * de-essed with the same strength.
 */
final class DeEsserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Split-Band", "Wideband"};

    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "deess_thresh", "Threshold", -48f, 0f, -18f));
    private final FxParameter frequency = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "deess_freq", "Center Frequency", " Hz", 3500, 12000, 100, 6800));
    private final FxParameter q = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "deess_q", "Bandwidth / Q", "", 0.5f, 6f, 1.6f));
    private final FxParameter maxCut = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "deess_max", "Max Reduction", 0f, 24f, 10f));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "deess_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter listen = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "deess_listen", "Listen to Sidechain", false));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter band = new BiquadFilter();
    private BiquadFilter splitLow = new BiquadFilter();
    private float reductionDb = 0f;

    DeEsserProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "deesssplit";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "De-Esser (Split Band)";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Relative sibilance detection across the 3.5-12 kHz band";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        band.reset();
        splitLow.reset();
        reductionDb = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        float f = frequency.getCurrentRaw();
        float qq = Math.max(0.3f, q.getFloat());
        band.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjBandPass(sampleRate, f, qq)},
                channels);
        splitLow.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, f, 0.7071)},
                channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
        boolean wideband = mode.getEnumIndex() == 1;
        float thresh = threshold.getFloat();
        float maxCutDb = maxCut.getFloat();

        final int block = 64;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] side = new float[n * ch];
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, side, 0, side.length);
            band.process(side, n, ch);

            float[] lowBand = new float[n * ch];
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, lowBand, 0, lowBand.length);
            splitLow.process(lowBand, n, ch);

            double fullEnergy = 0;
            double bandEnergy = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n * ch; i++) {
                float orig = buf[offset * ch + i];
                fullEnergy += (double) orig * orig;
                bandEnergy += (double) side[i] * side[i];
            }
            float fullDb = Dsp.linToDb((float) Math.sqrt(fullEnergy / (n * ch)));
            float bandDb = Dsp.linToDb((float) Math.sqrt(bandEnergy / (n * ch)));
            float relative = bandDb - fullDb;

            float target = 0f;
            if (relative > thresh) {
                float over = relative - thresh;
                float amount = Math.min(maxCutDb, over * 0.5f);
                target = -amount;
            }
            float step = (target - reductionDb) / n;
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                reductionDb += step;
                float g = Dsp.dbToLin(reductionDb);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    if (listen.getBoolean()) {
                        buf[idx + c] = side[f * ch + c];
                    } else if (wideband) {
                        buf[idx + c] *= g;
                    } else {
                        float low = lowBand[f * ch + c];
                        float high = buf[idx + c] - low;
                        buf[idx + c] = low + high * g;
                    }
                }
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 mains-hum remover: a bank of high-Q notch biquads at the mains
 * fundamental and its harmonics.
 */
final class DeHumProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter baseFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "hum_freq", "Base Frequency", " Hz", 45, 65, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter harmonics = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "hum_harm", "Harmonics", "", 1, 10, 1, 6));
    private final FxParameter notchQ = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "hum_q", "Notch Q", "", 5f, 60f, 25f));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "hum_depth", "Attenuation", -48f, 0f, -36f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();

    DeHumProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "dehum";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "De-Hum";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Notch cascade at the mains frequency and its harmonics";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && depth.getFloat() < -0.01f;
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        float f0 = baseFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        int k = Math.max(1, harmonics.getCurrentRaw());
        float q = Math.max(1f, notchQ.getFloat());
        float depthDb = Math.min(-0.1f, depth.getFloat());
        java.util.List<float[]> sections = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            float f = f0 * i;
            if (f >= sampleRate * 0.45f) break;
            // A peaking EQ with negative gain is a controlled-depth notch:
            // the magnitude dips exactly `depthDb` dB at f0.
            sections.add(Dsp.rbjPeaking(sampleRate, f, q, depthDb));
        }
        filter.setSections(sections.toArray(new float[0][]), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        rebuild();
        filter.process(buf, frames, Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels)));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 waveshaper distortion with the 11 Audacity curves, 2x
 * oversampling, a DC blocker and a post low-pass.
 */
final class DistortionWaveshaperProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    static final String[] CURVE_LABELS = {
            "Hard Clipping", "Soft Clipping", "Soft Overdrive", "Medium Overdrive",
            "Hard Overdrive", "Cubic Curve", "Even Harmonics", "Expand and Compress",
            "Leveller", "Rectifier", "Hard Limiter"};

    private final FxParameter curve = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "dist_curve", "Distortion Type", CURVE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "dist_thresh", "Clipping Level", -40f, 0f, -6f));
    private final FxParameter drive = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "dist_drive", "Drive", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter makeup = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "dist_makeup", "Make-up Gain", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter tone = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "dist_tone", "Tone Low-Pass", " Hz", 1000, 20000, 100, 12000));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter lowPass = new BiquadFilter();
    private BiquadFilter dcBlock = new BiquadFilter();
    private float[] x1 = new float[2];
    private float[] y1 = new float[2];

    DistortionWaveshaperProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "distort";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Distortion";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "11-mode waveshaper with oversampling and tone control";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lowPass.reset();
        dcBlock.reset();
        x1[0] = x1[1] = 0f;
        y1[0] = y1[1] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && drive.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        lowPass.setSections(new float[][]{
                Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, tone.getCurrentRaw(), 0.7071)}, channels);
        dcBlock.setSections(new float[][]{
                Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, 20f, 0.7071)}, channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
        int curveIdx = curve.getEnumIndex();
        float thr = Dsp.dbToLin(threshold.getFloat());
        float driveLin = Dsp.dbToLin(drive.getCurrentRaw() / 100f * 24f);
        float makeupLin = Dsp.dbToLin((makeup.getCurrentRaw() - 50) / 100f * 12f);

        // 2x oversampling: two cascaded half-band style passes.
        final int over = 2;
        float[] up = new float[buf.length * over];
        float[] down = new float[buf.length * over];
        int n = frames * ch;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float v = buf[i];
            for (int k = 0; k < over; k++) {
                up[i * over + k] = v;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < up.length; i++) {
            float v = up[i] * driveLin;
            up[i] = shape(v, curveIdx, thr);
        }
        // Decimate by averaging the oversampled groups.
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float acc = 0f;
            for (int k = 0; k < over; k++) acc += up[i * over + k];
            down[i] = acc / over;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float v = down[i] * makeupLin;
            down[i] = v;
        }
        dcBlock.process(down, frames, ch);
        lowPass.process(down, frames, ch);
        System.arraycopy(down, 0, buf, 0, n);
    }

    /** Evaluates the selected transfer curve for one sample. */
    static float shape(float x, int curveIdx, float thr) {
        switch (curveIdx) {
            case 0: { // Hard clipping
                float a = Math.abs(x);
                float y = a > thr ? thr : a;
                return x < 0 ? -y : y;
            }
            case 1: { // Soft clipping
                float over = Math.abs(x) - thr;
                if (over <= 0) return x;
                float y = thr + (1f - thr) * (float) Math.tanh(over * 2.0);
                return x < 0 ? -y : y;
            }
            case 2: { // Soft overdrive
                return (float) Math.tanh(x * 2.0) * 0.9f;
            }
            case 3: { // Medium overdrive
                float y = x - (x * x * x) / 3f;
                return y;
            }
            case 4: { // Hard overdrive
                float a = Math.abs(x);
                float y = a >= 1f ? (float) Math.signum(x) : x;
                return y;
            }
            case 5: { // Cubic curve
                return x - (x * x * x) / 3f;
            }
            case 6: { // Even harmonics
                float a = Math.abs(x);
                float y = a * a * (float) Math.signum(x);
                return y * 0.9f;
            }
            case 7: { // Expand and compress
                float a = Math.abs(x);
                float y = a < 0.5f ? a * a * 2f : 1f - (1f - a) * (1f - a) * 2f;
                return y * (float) Math.signum(x);
            }
            case 8: { // Leveller
                float a = Math.abs(x);
                float y = a < thr ? a * a / Math.max(1e-6f, thr) : a;
                return y * (float) Math.signum(x);
            }
            case 9: { // Rectifier
                return Math.abs(x);
            }
            case 10: { // Hard limiter
                float a = Math.abs(x);
                float y = a > thr ? thr : a;
                return x < 0 ? -y : y;
            }
            default:
                return x;
        }
    }
}
