package com.example.hello;

import android.media.MediaCodec;
import android.media.MediaFormat;
import android.media.MediaMuxer;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * Converts the crash-safe 32-bit float WAV into the user's chosen format.
 * Progress is reported 0..100 so the UI can paint a live progress bar.
 */
public final class FormatConverter {

    /**
     * How long an encoder may take to flush after all input is queued. Some
     * OEM codecs never deliver END_OF_STREAM; without a deadline the convert
     * thread spins until the ANR killer takes the process.
     */
    private static final long DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000L;

    /**
     * Samples per bulk-conversion chunk. Large enough that per-chunk setup is
     * irrelevant next to the per-sample work.
     */
    private static final int CONV_CHUNK = 65536;

    /**
     * Clamped float samples to 16-bit PCM, written into {@code dst}.
     *
     * <p>Typed views plus absolute indexing replace per-sample
     * {@code ByteBuffer.getFloat/putShort}, which re-checked the buffer type
     * and byte-swapped on every element. This loop is the single hottest path
     * in a save, so it is worth doing once here rather than three times.
     *
     * <p>Rounding is half-away-from-zero, which is symmetric about silence;
     * the previous {@code Math.round} biased toward +inf and cost a
     * {@code long} intermediate per sample.
     */
    static int toInt16(java.nio.FloatBuffer src, int n,
                       java.nio.ShortBuffer dst) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float s = src.get(i);
            if (s > 1f) s = 1f;
            else if (s < -1f) s = -1f;
            float t = s * 32767f;
            dst.put(i, (short) (t >= 0f ? t + 0.5f : t - 0.5f));
        }
        return n;
    }

    /** Same clamp into 24-bit range, ready to be split into 3 bytes LE. */
    static int toInt24(java.nio.FloatBuffer src, int n, int[] dst) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float s = src.get(i);
            if (s > 1f) s = 1f;
            else if (s < -1f) s = -1f;
            float t = s * 8388607f;
            int v = (int) (t >= 0f ? t + 0.5f : t - 0.5f);
            dst[i] = v > 8388607 ? 8388607
                    : (v < -8388608 ? -8388608 : v);
        }
        return n;
    }

    public interface Progress {
        void onProgress(int percent);
    }

    private FormatConverter() {}

    /** Float WAV header view. Null when the file is not a float WAV. */
    public static final class WavInfo {
        public final int channels;
        public final int sampleRate;
        public final long dataBytes;
        public final long dataStart;

        WavInfo(int channels, int sampleRate, long dataBytes, long dataStart) {
            this.channels = channels;
            this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
            this.dataBytes = dataBytes;
            this.dataStart = dataStart;
        }
    }

    public static WavInfo readFloatWav(File src) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        try {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            long onDisk = Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart);
            long dataBytes = h.dataBytes;
            // Crash-safe: trust the bytes actually on disk over the header.
            if (dataBytes <= 0 || dataBytes > onDisk) dataBytes = onDisk;
            if (h.audioFormat != 3 || h.bits != 32 || h.channels < 1
                    || h.sampleRate <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("not 32-bit float wav");
            }
            return new WavInfo(h.channels, h.sampleRate, dataBytes,
                    h.dataStart);
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copies the internal 32-bit float WAV payload into a clean WAV32 master.
     *
     * <p>The samples are already in the destination encoding, so this is a
     * byte copy with a fresh 44-byte header — no float-to-int conversion and
     * no resampling. Extra RIFF chunks on an imported source are dropped so
     * the result has the same predictable geometry as the recording engine.
     */
    public static void toWav32(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4;
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        RandomAccessFile w = null;
        try {
            w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(info.channels, info.sampleRate,
                    info.dataBytes));
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(2048L, Math.min((long) CONV_CHUNK, totalSamples / 25L))
                    : CONV_CHUNK;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, info.channels);
            byte[] buf = new byte[chunk * 4];
            long done = 0;
            int lastPct = -1;
            while (done < totalSamples) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunk, totalSamples - done);
                r.readFully(buf, 0, want * 4);
                w.write(buf, 0, want * 4);
                done += want;
                if (cb != null) {
                    int pct = (int) (done * 100 / Math.max(1, totalSamples));
                    if (pct != lastPct) {
                        lastPct = pct;
                        cb.onProgress(pct);
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }

    /** 32-bit float WAV -> 16-bit PCM WAV. */
    public static void toWav16(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4;
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        RandomAccessFile w = null;
        try {
            w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(wav16Header(info.channels, info.sampleRate, 0));
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(2048L, Math.min((long) CONV_CHUNK, totalSamples / 25L))
                    : CONV_CHUNK;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, info.channels);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * 4];
            byte[] out = new byte[chunk * 2];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asShortBuffer();
            long done = 0;
            int lastPct = -1;
            while (done < totalSamples) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunk, totalSamples - done);
                r.readFully(in, 0, want * 4);
                toInt16(fb, want, sb);
                w.write(out, 0, want * 2);
                done += want;
                if (cb != null) {
                    int pct = (int) (done * 100 / Math.max(1, totalSamples));
                    if (pct != lastPct) {
                        lastPct = pct;
                        cb.onProgress(pct);
                    }
                }
            }
            long pcmBytes = totalSamples * 2;
            w.seek(0);
            w.write(wav16Header(info.channels, info.sampleRate, pcmBytes));
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
    }

    /** 32-bit float WAV -> M4A (AAC) via MediaCodec + MediaMuxer. */
    public static void toM4a(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        toM4a(src, dst, 128000, cb);
    }

    /**
     * Same with an explicit AAC bitrate (the presets range 64–320 kbps).
     * Tuned for speed: big input chunks, microsecond codec waits and
     * throttled progress so a minute of audio converts in seconds.
     */
    public static void toM4a(File src, File dst, int bitrate, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        encodeMuxed(src, dst, MediaFormat.MIMETYPE_AUDIO_AAC,
                Math.max(64000, Math.min(320000, bitrate)),
                MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_MPEG_4,
                android.media.MediaCodecInfo.CodecProfileLevel.AACObjectLC, cb);
    }

    /**
     * 32-bit float WAV -> 24-bit PCM WAV.
     *
     * <p>24-bit samples are not 4-byte aligned, so each one is assembled
     * byte-wise rather than through a typed {@link ByteBuffer} read.
     */
    public static void toWav24(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4;
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        RandomAccessFile w = null;
        try {
            w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wav24Header(info.channels, info.sampleRate, 0));
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(2048L, Math.min((long) CONV_CHUNK, totalSamples / 25L))
                    : CONV_CHUNK;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, info.channels);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * 4];
            byte[] out = new byte[chunk * 3];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            int[] ints = new int[chunk];
            long done = 0;
            int lastPct = -1;
            while (done < totalSamples) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(chunk, totalSamples - done);
                r.readFully(in, 0, want * 4);
                toInt24(fb, want, ints);
                int p = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < want; i++) {
                    int v = ints[i];
                    out[p++] = (byte) (v & 0xFF);
                    out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
                    out[p++] = (byte) ((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
                }
                w.write(out, 0, p);
                done += want;
                if (cb != null) {
                    int pct = (int) (done * 100 / Math.max(1, totalSamples));
                    if (pct != lastPct) {
                        lastPct = pct;
                        cb.onProgress(pct);
                    }
                }
            }
            long pcmBytes = totalSamples * 3;
            w.seek(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wav24Header(info.channels, info.sampleRate, pcmBytes));
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
    }

    /** Opus in Ogg on API 29+ (WebM fallback on API 24-28). */
    public static void toOpus(File src, File dst, int bitrate, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        int muxFmt = android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29
                ? MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_OGG
                : MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_WEBM;
        encodeMuxed(src, dst, "audio/opus",
                Math.max(32000, Math.min(256000, bitrate <= 0 ? 128000 : bitrate)),
                muxFmt, -1, cb);
    }

    /**
     * Shared float-WAV -> encoder -> muxer pipeline. Negative aacProfile skips
     * the AAC profile key (Opus/Vorbis don't take one).
     */
    private static void encodeMuxed(File src, File dst, String mime, int bitrate,
                                    int muxerFormat, int aacProfile,
                                    Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        final int ch = info.channels;
        final int sr = info.sampleRate;
        final long totalSamples = info.dataBytes / 4; // interleaved samples
        final long totalFrames = totalSamples / Math.max(1, ch);

        MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat(mime, sr, ch);
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BIT_RATE, bitrate);
        if (aacProfile >= 0) {
            fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_AAC_PROFILE, aacProfile);
        }
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 262144);

        MediaCodec enc = null;
        MediaMuxer muxer = null;
        boolean muxStarted = false;
        int samplesWritten = 0;
        int track = -1;
        MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        try {
            enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType(mime);
            enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
            enc.start();
            muxer = new MediaMuxer(dst.getAbsolutePath(), muxerFormat);
            r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(1024L, Math.min(16384L, totalFrames / 25L))
                    : 16384;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, ch);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * ch * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            long framesDone = 0;
            boolean inputEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            int lastPct = -1;
            long drainDeadline = 0;

            while (!outEos) {
                if (!inputEos) {
                    int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(2000);
                    if (idx >= 0) {
                        ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                        dstBuf.clear();
                        long framesLeft = totalFrames - framesDone;
                        // Never read more file bytes than the codec buffer fits.
                        int maxByBuf = dstBuf.remaining() / 2 / Math.max(1, ch);
                        int wantFrames = (int) Math.min(chunk,
                                Math.min(framesLeft, maxByBuf));
                        if (wantFrames <= 0 && framesLeft > 0) {
                            // Codec buffer unexpectedly small: retry next round.
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                        } else if (wantFrames <= 0) {
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                    MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                            inputEos = true;
                            // All audio is queued, so the progress bar is
                            // already at 100% from here on. What remains is
                            // draining the encoder, which some OEM codecs
                            // never finish: bound it, or the worker thread
                            // spins forever and the app is ANR-killed right
                            // after the bar completes.
                            drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                    + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                        } else {
                            int wantBytes = wantFrames * ch * 4;
                            r.readFully(in, 0, wantBytes);
                            int shorts = wantFrames * ch;
                            java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                    .asShortBuffer();
                            toInt16(fb, shorts, sb);
                            dstBuf.position(0);
                            dstBuf.limit(shorts * 2);
                            long pts = framesDone * 1_000_000L / sr;
                            enc.queueInputBuffer(
                                    idx, 0, shorts * 2, pts, 0);
                            framesDone += wantFrames;
                            if (cb != null) {
                                int pct = (int) (framesDone * 100
                                        / Math.max(1, totalFrames));
                                if (pct != lastPct) {
                                    lastPct = pct;
                                    cb.onProgress(pct);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 2000);
                if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                    if (inputEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                            > drainDeadline) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "encoder never finished");
                    }
                } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                    MediaFormat of = enc.getOutputFormat();
                    track = muxer.addTrack(of);
                    muxer.start();
                    muxStarted = true;
                } else if (oidx >= 0) {
                    ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                    if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                            && bi.size > 0 && muxStarted) {
                        ob.position(bi.offset);
                        ob.limit(bi.offset + bi.size);
                        muxer.writeSampleData(track, ob, bi);
                        samplesWritten++;
                    }
                    enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                    if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                        outEos = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
        } finally {
            if (r != null) {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (enc != null) {
                try {
                    enc.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    enc.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (muxer != null) {
                try {
                    // stop() with an empty track is undefined in the native
                    // muxer; only finalize it when samples actually landed.
                    if (muxStarted && samplesWritten > 0) muxer.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    muxer.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (dst.length() < 1024) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            dst.delete();
            throw new IllegalStateException("encode failed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Pure-Java sanity check on a finished conversion, run before the library
     * ever sees the file. Catches containers torn by a dying encoder or a
     * process kill (header written, trailer missing) without touching the
     * platform parser. Throws on anything invalid.
     */
    public static void validateFinal(File dst, SaveFormat fmt) throws Exception {
        if (dst == null || !dst.exists() || dst.length() < 64) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("output too small");
        }
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "r");
        try {
            byte[] head = new byte[12];
            r.readFully(head);
            switch (fmt) {
                case M4A:
                case AUTO:
                default:
                    // ISO base media: 'ftyp' at offset 4, and a 'moov' box
                    // somewhere (written last — its absence means teardown
                    // never finished).
                    if (head[4] != 'f' || head[5] != 't'
                            || head[6] != 'y' || head[7] != 'p') {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("not an mp4 container");
                    }
                    if (!containsBox(r, new byte[]{'m', 'o', 'o', 'v'})) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("mp4 truncated (no moov)");
                    }
                    break;
                case AMR_NB:
                case AMR_WB:
                    // A .3gp that merely has ftyp/moov can still contain no
                    // AMR sample entry. Require the exact sample description
                    // atom the chosen codec must have written.
                    if (head[4] != 'f' || head[5] != 't'
                            || head[6] != 'y' || head[7] != 'p') {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("not a 3gp container");
                    }
                    if (!containsBox(r, new byte[]{'m', 'o', 'o', 'v'})) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("3gp truncated (no moov)");
                    }
                    byte[] sampleEntry = fmt == SaveFormat.AMR_WB
                            ? new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'}
                            : new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'm', 'r'};
                    if (!containsBox(r, sampleEntry)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "3gp missing " + new String(sampleEntry)
                                        + " sample entry");
                    }
                    break;
                case OPUS:
                    // Accept RFC 7845 Ogg Opus ("OggS") on API 29+ or WebM
                    // EBML (0x1A45DFA3) on older devices.
                    boolean isOgg = head[0] == 'O' && head[1] == 'g'
                            && head[2] == 'g' && head[3] == 'S';
                    boolean isWebm = (head[0] & 0xFF) == 0x1A
                            && (head[1] & 0xFF) == 0x45
                            && (head[2] & 0xFF) == 0xDF
                            && (head[3] & 0xFF) == 0xA3;
                    if (!isOgg && !isWebm) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "not an ogg or webm opus container");
                    }
                    if (isWebm && !containsBox(r, new byte[]{0x1F, 0x43,
                            (byte) 0xB6, 0x75})) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "webm has no clusters (truncated)");
                    }
                    break;
                case FLAC: {
                    // Magic alone is not enough: a wrong metadata block type
                    // (0x90) or a 0 Hz sample rate produces a file every
                    // player rejects.
                    byte[] fh = new byte[42];
                    r.seek(0);
                    r.readFully(fh);
                    if (!FlacHeader.validHead(fh)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "flac streaminfo invalid");
                    }
                    break;
                }
                case WAV16:
                case WAV24:
                case WAV32:
                    // RIFF/WAVE; wavDurationMs() re-reads the header and
                    // rejects a bit depth it does not understand.
                    if (head[0] != 'R' || head[1] != 'I'
                            || head[2] != 'F' || head[3] != 'F'
                            || head[8] != 'W' || head[9] != 'A'
                            || head[10] != 'V' || head[11] != 'E') {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("not a wav container");
                    }
                    // A header with a zero data size is a conversion that
                    // died before writing any payload.
                    if (Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst) <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("wav has no audio");
                    }
                    if (fmt == SaveFormat.WAV32) {
                        Dsp.WavHeader wh = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
                        if (wh.audioFormat != 3 || wh.bits != 32) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "not a 32-bit float wav");
                        }
                    }
                    break;
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /** True when the 4-byte token occurs anywhere in the file. */
    private static boolean containsBox(RandomAccessFile r, byte[] token)
            throws Exception {
        byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
        int carry = 0;
        long left = r.length();
        r.seek(0);
        while (left > 0) {
            int n = (int) Math.min(buf.length, left);
            r.readFully(buf, 0, n);
            left -= n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (buf[i] == token[carry]) {
                    if (++carry == token.length) return true;
                } else {
                    carry = buf[i] == token[0] ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the exact byte length of a single RFC 4867 / 3GPP AMR frame
     * from its Table of Contents (ToC) header byte, so any multi-frame
     * MediaCodec output buffer can be split into 1-frame (20 ms) samples
     * matching damr.frames_per_sample = 1.
     */
    static int amrFrameBytes(byte tocByte, boolean wideband) {
        int ft = (tocByte >> 3) & 0x0F;
        if (wideband) {
            // 3GPP TS 26.201 AMR-WB frame sizes (including 1 ToC byte)
            final int[] wbSizes = {18, 24, 33, 37, 41, 47, 51, 59, 61, 6, 1,
                    1, 1, 1, 1, 1};
            return wbSizes[ft];
        } else {
            // 3GPP TS 26.101 AMR-NB frame sizes (including 1 ToC byte)
            final int[] nbSizes = {13, 14, 16, 18, 20, 21, 27, 32, 6, 7, 6,
                    6, 1, 1, 1, 1};
            return nbSizes[ft];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Writes an AMR MediaCodec output buffer to MediaMuxer as individual
     * 1-frame (20 ms) MP4 samples. This prevents multi-frame MP4 samples
     * that violate damr.frames_per_sample = 1 and fixes both the 0.28s/0.32s
     * decode truncation and the stts duration inflation.
     */
    static long writeAmrFramesSingle(MediaMuxer muxer, int track,
                                     ByteBuffer ob, MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi,
                                     boolean wideband, long nextFramePtsUs) {
        int pos = bi.offset;
        int end = bi.offset + bi.size;
        MediaCodec.BufferInfo singleBi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
        while (pos < end) {
            int frameLen = amrFrameBytes(ob.get(pos), wideband);
            if (frameLen <= 0 || pos + frameLen > end) {
                frameLen = end - pos;
            }
            ob.position(pos);
            ob.limit(pos + frameLen);
            singleBi.set(pos, frameLen, nextFramePtsUs,
                    (pos + frameLen >= end) ? bi.flags : 0);
            muxer.writeSampleData(track, ob, singleBi);
            nextFramePtsUs += 20_000L; // 20 ms per AMR frame
            pos += frameLen;
        }
        return nextFramePtsUs;
    }

    /**
     * AMR-NB (8 kHz) or AMR-WB (16 kHz) in a .3gp container. The 48 kHz float
     * capture is mixed to mono and properly decimated through a windowed-sinc
     * lowpass (no naive downsampling, so no aliasing whistle).
     *
     * <p>Fully streaming: a bounded chunk plus the decimator's ~17k-sample
     * window is all that is ever retained, so takes of any length convert
     * with constant memory and no duration cap.
     */
    public static void toAmr(File src, File dst, boolean wideband, Progress cb)
            throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        final int outRate = wideband ? 16000 : 8000;
        // AMR encoders require exact 20 ms frames: 160 samples at 8 kHz,
        // 320 at 16 kHz. Anything else produces a malformed .3gp.
        final int frameSamples = wideband ? 320 : 160;
        final int decim = Math.max(1, info.sampleRate / outRate);
        final double cutoff = (wideband ? 7000.0 : 3400.0) / info.sampleRate;
        final int taps = wideband ? 48 : 64;
        Dsp.FirDecimator decimator =
                new Dsp.FirDecimator(decim, Dsp.firLowpass(cutoff, taps));

        final int ch = info.channels;
        final long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, ch);
        final long expectOut = totalFrames / decim;
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        try {
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            String mime = wideband ? "audio/amr-wb" : "audio/3gpp";
            int bitrate = wideband ? 23850 : 12200;
            MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat(mime, outRate, 1);
            fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_BIT_RATE, bitrate);
            fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 32768);
            MediaCodec enc = null;
            MediaMuxer muxer = null;
            boolean muxStarted = false;
            int samplesWritten = 0;
            long nextOutPtsUs = 0L;
            int track = -1;
            MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(CONV_CHUNK, ch);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * ch * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            float[] mono = new float[chunk];
            // NEW-08 fix: removed unused `short[] decOut` allocation.
            // Encoder backlog: decimated shorts awaiting codec room.
            short[] pend = new short[32768];
            int pendLen = 0;
            long readFrames = 0;
            long fed = 0;
            boolean tailFlushed = false;
            boolean inEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            int lastPct = -1;
            long drainDeadline = 0;
            try {
                enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType(mime);
                enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
                enc.start();
                muxer = new MediaMuxer(
                        dst.getAbsolutePath(),
                        MediaMuxer.OutputFormat.MUXER_OUTPUT_3GPP);
                while (!outEos) {
                    if (!inEos) {
                        // 1) Produce more decimated samples while the backlog
                        // has room and the file has frames.
                        if (pendLen < pend.length / 2
                                && readFrames < totalFrames) {
                            int want = (int) Math.min(chunk,
                                    totalFrames - readFrames);
                            r.readFully(in, 0, want * ch * 4);
                            fb.clear();
                            fb.limit(want * ch);
                            if (ch == 2) {
                                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                    mono[f] = (fb.get(f * 2)
                                            + fb.get(f * 2 + 1)) * 0.5f;
                                }
                            } else if (ch > 2) {
                                float inv = 1f / ch;
                                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                    float sum = 0f;
                                    int base = f * ch;
                                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                                        sum += fb.get(base + c);
                                    }
                                    mono[f] = sum * inv;
                                }
                            } else {
                                for (int f = 0; f < want; f++) {
                                    mono[f] = fb.get(f);
                                }
                            }
                            int need = pendLen + want / decim + taps + 16;
                            if (need > pend.length) {
                                short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                        pend.length * 2, need)];
                                System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0, pendLen);
                                pend = bigger;
                            }
                            pendLen += decimator.push(mono, want, pend,
                                    pendLen);
                            readFrames += want;
                        } else if (readFrames >= totalFrames
                                && !tailFlushed) {
                            int need = pendLen + taps + 16;
                            if (need > pend.length) {
                                short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                        pend.length * 2, need)];
                                System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0, pendLen);
                                pend = bigger;
                            }
                            pendLen += decimator.flush(totalFrames, pend,
                                    pendLen);
                            // Zero-pad the final partial frame so every
                            // queued buffer is an exact AMR frame multiple.
                            int pad = (frameSamples - (pendLen % frameSamples))
                                    % frameSamples;
                            if (pad > 0) {
                                int padNeed = pendLen + pad;
                                if (padNeed > pend.length) {
                                    short[] bigger = new short[Math.max(
                                            pend.length * 2, padNeed)];
                                    System.arraycopy(pend, 0, bigger, 0,
                                            pendLen);
                                    pend = bigger;
                                }
                                java.util.Arrays.fill(pend, pendLen,
                                        pendLen + pad, (short) 0);
                                pendLen += pad;
                            }
                            tailFlushed = true;
                        }
                        // 2) Feed the encoder from the backlog.
                        int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(5000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            if (pendLen >= frameSamples) {
                                ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                                dstBuf.clear();
                                // Queue exactly 1 AMR frame (20 ms) per input
                                // buffer so each MediaCodec output packet is a
                                // single 20 ms frame matching damr.
                                int want = frameSamples;
                                java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                        .asShortBuffer();
                                sb.put(pend, 0, want);
                                dstBuf.position(0);
                                dstBuf.limit(want * 2);
                                long pts = fed * 1_000_000L / outRate;
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, want * 2, pts, 0);
                                fed += want;
                                System.arraycopy(pend, want, pend, 0,
                                        pendLen - want);
                                pendLen -= want;
                                if (cb != null) {
                                    int pct = (int) (fed * 100 / Math.max(
                                            1, expectOut));
                                    if (pct != lastPct) {
                                        lastPct = pct;
                                        cb.onProgress(
                                                Math.min(100, pct));
                                    }
                                }
                            } else if (tailFlushed && pendLen == 0) {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                        MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                inEos = true;
                                // Progress is already 100%; bound the drain.
                                drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                        + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                            } else {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    // Drain every output buffer the codec has ready, not just
                    // one per input buffer. The old single dequeue let the
                    // encoder fall behind and stall near EOS.
                    int drained = 0;
                    while (true) {
                        int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi,
                                drained == 0 ? 5000L : 0L);
                        if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                            if (inEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                    > drainDeadline) {
                                throw new IllegalStateException(
                                        "encoder never finished");
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                        if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                            if (!muxStarted) {
                                track = muxer.addTrack(enc.getOutputFormat());
                                muxer.start();
                                muxStarted = true;
                            }
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (oidx < 0) continue;
                        ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                                && bi.size > 0 && muxStarted) {
                            nextOutPtsUs = writeAmrFramesSingle(
                                    muxer, track, ob, bi, wideband,
                                    nextOutPtsUs);
                            samplesWritten++;
                        }
                        enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                        drained++;
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                            outEos = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
            } finally {
                if (enc != null) {
                    try { enc.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    try { enc.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                if (muxer != null) {
                    try {
                        if (muxStarted && samplesWritten > 0) muxer.stop();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    try { muxer.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
            }
            if (dst.length() < 512) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                dst.delete();
                throw new IllegalStateException("amr encode failed");
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    /**
     * FLAC stream-header writer, shared by the batch converter and the
     * incremental encoder so the two can never disagree on the layout.
     *
     * <p>Three defects lived here before: the metadata block header byte was
     * written as {@code 0x90} (type 16 = reserved, which makes Android's
     * FLACExtractor reject every saved file); the encoder's csd-0 buffer was
     * copied from offset 0 even though Android's FLAC encoder prefixes
     * STREAMINFO with {@code "fLaC"} and a block header, so the payload
     * contained a duplicated magic and a 0 Hz sample rate; and
     * {@code total_samples} stayed 0, breaking duration probing.
     */
    public static final class FlacHeader {

        public static final int STREAMINFO_LEN = 34;
        /** Byte offset of the 20-bit sample rate inside STREAMINFO. */
        private static final int SI_SAMPLE_RATE = 10;
        /** First byte of the 36-bit total-samples field (spans 13..17). */
        private static final int SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES = 13;

        private FlacHeader() {}

        /**
         * Pulls the 34-byte STREAMINFO out of an encoder csd-0 buffer,
         * tolerating the three shapes Android ships: bare STREAMINFO,
         * block-header-prefixed, or {@code "fLaC"}+block-header-prefixed.
         *
         * @return the 34 bytes, or null when the buffer holds none.
         */
        public static byte[] streamInfoFromCsd(ByteBuffer csd) {
            if (csd == null || csd.remaining() < STREAMINFO_LEN) return null;
            int start = csd.position();
            int skip = 0;
            if (csd.remaining() >= 42) {
                int p = csd.position();
                if (csd.get(p) == 'f' && csd.get(p + 1) == 'L'
                        && csd.get(p + 2) == 'a' && csd.get(p + 3) == 'C') {
                    // "fLaC" + [0x80 0x00 0x00 0x22] + STREAMINFO
                    skip = 8;
                }
            }
            if (skip == 0 && csd.remaining() >= 38
                    && (csd.get(csd.position()) & 0x7F) == 0
                    && csd.get(csd.position() + 1) == 0
                    && csd.get(csd.position() + 2) == 0
                    && (csd.get(csd.position() + 3) & 0xFF)
                    == STREAMINFO_LEN) {
                // block header + STREAMINFO
                skip = 4;
            }
            if (csd.remaining() - skip < STREAMINFO_LEN) return null;
            byte[] si = new byte[STREAMINFO_LEN];
            ByteBuffer view = csd.duplicate();
            view.position(view.position() + skip);
            view.get(si);
            csd.position(start);
            return si;
        }

        /** Writes {@code fLaC} + the last-STREAMINFO block header + payload. */
        public static void write(java.io.OutputStream out, byte[] si)
                throws Exception {
            out.write(new byte[]{'f', 'L', 'a', 'C'});
            // bit 7 = last-metadata-block, bits 6..0 = type 0 (STREAMINFO).
            out.write(0x80);
            out.write(0x00);
            out.write(0x00);
            out.write(STREAMINFO_LEN);
            out.write(si);
        }

        /**
         * Patches the 36-bit total-samples field so players can report a
         * duration. The encoder streams, so it leaves this at 0.
         *
         * <p>Layout: low 4 bits of STREAMINFO byte 13, then bytes 14..17.
         */
        public static void patchTotalSamples(RandomAccessFile r,
                                              long totalSamples)
                throws Exception {
            if (totalSamples <= 0 || totalSamples >= (1L << 36)) return;
            byte[] si = new byte[STREAMINFO_LEN];
            r.seek(8 + SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES - 1); // byte 12: keep its high bits
            r.readFully(si, SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES - 1, 5);
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES] = (byte) ((si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES] & 0xF0)
                    | ((totalSamples >>> 32) & 0x0F));
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES + 1] = (byte) (totalSamples >>> 24);
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES + 2] = (byte) (totalSamples >>> 16);
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES + 3] = (byte) (totalSamples >>> 8);
            si[SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES + 4] = (byte) totalSamples;
            r.seek(8 + SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES - 1);
            r.write(si, SI_TOTAL_SAMPLES - 1, 5);
        }

        /** Sample rate in Hz from a 34-byte STREAMINFO. */
        public static int sampleRate(byte[] si) {
            if (si == null || si.length < 21) return 0;
            return ((si[SI_SAMPLE_RATE] & 0xFF) << 12)
                    | ((si[SI_SAMPLE_RATE + 1] & 0xFF) << 4)
                    | ((si[SI_SAMPLE_RATE + 2] & 0xF0) >>> 4);
        }

        /**
         * Structural check on the first 42 bytes of a FLAC file: magic,
         * a STREAMINFO last-block header with the right length, no nested
         * magic, and a non-zero sample rate.
         */
        public static boolean validHead(byte[] head) {
            if (head == null || head.length < 42) return false;
            if (head[0] != 'f' || head[1] != 'L' || head[2] != 'a'
                    || head[3] != 'C') return false;
            if ((head[4] & 0x7F) != 0) return false;   // type must be 0
            if ((head[5] & 0xFF) != 0 || (head[6] & 0xFF) != 0
                    || (head[7] & 0xFF) != STREAMINFO_LEN) return false;
            if (head[8] == 'f' && head[9] == 'L' && head[10] == 'a'
                    && head[11] == 'C') return false;   // duplicated magic
            int rate = ((head[8 + SI_SAMPLE_RATE] & 0xFF) << 12)
                    | ((head[8 + SI_SAMPLE_RATE + 1] & 0xFF) << 4)
                    | ((head[8 + SI_SAMPLE_RATE + 2] & 0xF0) >>> 4);
            return rate > 0;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Lossless FLAC stream (probe-gated). Writes the encoder's STREAMINFO as
     * the file's metadata block followed by raw audio frames — playable
     * anywhere FLAC is supported.
     */
    public static void toFlac(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        WavInfo info = readFloatWav(src);
        final int ch = info.channels;
        final int sr = info.sampleRate;
        final long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, ch);

        MediaFormat fmt = MediaFormat.createAudioFormat("audio/flac", sr, ch);
        fmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_MAX_INPUT_SIZE, 262144);
        MediaCodec enc = null;
        java.io.FileOutputStream out = null;
        boolean ok = false;
        try {
            enc = MediaCodec.createEncoderByType("audio/flac");
            enc.configure(fmt, null, null, MediaCodec.CONFIGURE_FLAG_ENCODE);
            enc.start();
            out = new java.io.FileOutputStream(dst);
            // No magic here: FlacHeader.write() emits "fLaC" with the
            // STREAMINFO block once the encoder publishes its config.
            boolean wroteInfo = false;
            // Frames can precede the format change; hold them until the
            // STREAMINFO header is written so no audio is lost.
            java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream pending = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
            RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
            int baseChunk = cb != null
                    ? (int) Math.max(1024L, Math.min(16384L, totalFrames / 25L))
                    : 16384;
            int chunk = MemoryBudget.chunkFrames(baseChunk, ch);
            byte[] in = new byte[chunk * ch * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
            long framesDone = 0;
            boolean inEos = false;
            boolean outEos = false;
            int lastPct = -1;
            long drainDeadline = 0;
            try {
                r.seek(info.dataStart);
                while (!outEos) {
                    if (!inEos) {
                        int idx = enc.dequeueInputBuffer(5000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            ByteBuffer dstBuf = enc.getInputBuffer(idx);
                            dstBuf.clear();
                            long framesLeft = totalFrames - framesDone;
                            int maxByBuf = dstBuf.remaining() / 2 / Math.max(1, ch);
                            int wantFrames = (int) Math.min(chunk,
                                    Math.min(framesLeft, maxByBuf));
                            if (wantFrames <= 0 && framesLeft > 0) {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0, 0);
                            } else if (wantFrames <= 0) {
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                        MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                inEos = true;
                                // Progress is already 100%; bound the drain.
                                drainDeadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                        + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                            } else {
                                int wantBytes = wantFrames * ch * 4;
                                r.readFully(in, 0, wantBytes);
                                int shorts = wantFrames * ch;
                                java.nio.ShortBuffer sb = dstBuf
                                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                        .asShortBuffer();
                                toInt16(fb, shorts, sb);
                                dstBuf.position(0);
                                dstBuf.limit(shorts * 2);
                                long pts = framesDone * 1_000_000L / sr;
                                enc.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, shorts * 2, pts, 0);
                                framesDone += wantFrames;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    int oidx = enc.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 5000);
                    if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                        if (inEos && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                > drainDeadline) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "encoder never finished");
                        }
                    } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                        try {
                            MediaFormat of = enc.getOutputFormat();
                            if (!wroteInfo) {
                                byte[] si = FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(
                                        of.getByteBuffer("csd-0"));
                                if (si != null) {
                                    FlacHeader.write(out, si);
                                    wroteInfo = true;
                                    if (pending.size() > 0) {
                                        pending.writeTo(out);
                                        pending.reset();
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    } else if (oidx >= 0) {
                        ByteBuffer ob = enc.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG) == 0
                                && bi.size > 0) {
                            byte[] frame = new byte[bi.size];
                            ob.position(bi.offset);
                            ob.get(frame);
                            if (wroteInfo) {
                                out.write(frame);
                            } else {
                                pending.write(frame, 0, frame.length);
                            }
                        }
                        enc.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                            outEos = true;
                        }
                    }
                    if (cb != null) {
                        int pct = (int) (framesDone * 100 / Math.max(1, totalFrames));
                        if (pct != lastPct) {
                            lastPct = pct;
                            cb.onProgress(pct);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            out.flush();
            // The encoder streams, so STREAMINFO's total_samples is 0; patch
            // it now that the frame count is known.
            try {
                RandomAccessFile rr = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
                try {
                    FlacHeader.patchTotalSamples(rr, totalFrames);
                } finally {
                    rr.close();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            ok = wroteInfo && dst.length() > 1024;
            if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
        } finally {
            if (out != null) {
                try {
                    out.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (enc != null) {
                try {
                    enc.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    enc.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (!ok) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                dst.delete();
                throw new IllegalStateException("flac encode failed");
            }
        }
    }

    private static byte[] wav16Header(int ch, int sr, long pcmBytes) {
        return Dsp.wav16Header(ch, sr, pcmBytes);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 studio reverb: a Schroeder-Moorer / Freeverb-style network with
 * eight parallel low-pass feedback comb filters, four series all-pass
 * diffusers, a pre-delay line, damping and a mid/side width mixer.
 *
 * <p>The comb delays are mutually prime so the tail does not build obvious
 * resonances, and the right channel is offset by 23 samples to widen the
 * stereo image.
 */
final class FreeverbReverbProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int COMBS = 8;
    private static final int ALLPASS = 4;
    private static final int STEREO_SPREAD = 23;
    private static final int[] COMB_TUNING = {
            1116, 1188, 1277, 1356, 1422, 1491, 1557, 1617};
    private static final int[] ALLPASS_TUNING = {556, 441, 341, 225};

    private final FxParameter roomSize = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "rv_size", "Room Size", "%", 0, 100, 1, 55));
    private final FxParameter preDelay = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "rv_predelay", "Pre-Delay", " ms", 0, 200, 1, 15));
    private final FxParameter decay = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "rv_decay", "Reverberance", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter damping = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "rv_damping", "Damping", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter toneLow = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "rv_tonelo", "Tone Low", "%", -100, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter toneHigh = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "rv_tonehi", "Tone High", "%", -100, 100, 1, 0));
    private final FxParameter wetGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "rv_wet", "Wet Gain", -36f, 6f, -8f));
    private final FxParameter dryGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "rv_dry", "Dry Gain", -36f, 6f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter width = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "rv_width", "Stereo Width", "%", 0, 100, 1, 100));
    private final FxParameter wetOnly = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "rv_wetonly", "Wet Only", false));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private Comb[] combL = new Comb[COMBS];
    private Comb[] combR = new Comb[COMBS];
    private Allpass[] apL = new Allpass[ALLPASS];
    private Allpass[] apR = new Allpass[ALLPASS];
    private float[] preBuffer = new float[0];
    private int prePos = 0;
    private int preFrames = 0;
    private BiquadFilter toneLo = new BiquadFilter();
    private BiquadFilter toneHi = new BiquadFilter();
    private final float[] toneScratch = new float[2];

    FreeverbReverbProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "reverb";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Studio Reverb";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Freeverb-style stereo reverb with damping and width";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.SPATIAL;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int i = 0; i < COMBS; i++) {
            combL[i].reset();
            combR[i].reset();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < ALLPASS; i++) {
            apL[i].reset();
            apR[i].reset();
        }
        java.util.Arrays.fill(preBuffer, 0f);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && wetGain.getFloat() > -35.9f;
    }

    @Override
    public int getTailFrames() {
        // 4 seconds of tail at 48 kHz is enough for the longest decay.
        return (int) (sampleRate * 4.0);
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        float size = roomSize.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float scale = 0.7f + size * 1.6f;
        int spread = Math.max(1, Math.round(STEREO_SPREAD * scale));
        for (int i = 0; i < COMBS; i++) {
            int lenL = Math.max(8, (int) (COMB_TUNING[i] * scale));
            int lenR = lenL + spread;
            if (combL[i] == null) {
                combL[i] = new Comb(lenL);
                combR[i] = new Comb(lenR);
            } else {
                combL[i].resize(lenL);
                combR[i].resize(lenR);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < ALLPASS; i++) {
            int lenL = Math.max(8, (int) (ALLPASS_TUNING[i] * scale));
            int lenR = lenL + spread;
            if (apL[i] == null) {
                apL[i] = new Allpass(lenL);
                apR[i] = new Allpass(lenR);
            } else {
                apL[i].resize(lenL);
                apR[i].resize(lenR);
            }
        }
        preFrames = Math.max(0, (int) (preDelay.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        if (preBuffer.length < preFrames * 2) {
            preBuffer = new float[Math.max(1, preFrames * 2)];
        }
        float lo = toneLow.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float hi = toneHigh.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (lo != 0f) {
            toneLo.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sampleRate, 250f, 0.7071, lo * 12f)}, 2);
        } else {
            toneLo.setSections(new float[0][], channels);
        }
        if (hi != 0f) {
            toneHi.setSections(new float[][]{
                    Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, 4000f, 0.7071, hi * 12f)}, 2);
        } else {
            toneHi.setSections(new float[0][], channels);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();

        float damp = damping.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float decayPct = decay.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float feedback = 0.7f + decayPct * 0.28f;
        float wet = Dsp.dbToLin(wetGain.getFloat());
        float dry = wetOnly.getBoolean() ? 0f : Dsp.dbToLin(dryGain.getFloat());
        float widthPct = width.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float inL = buf[f * ch];
            float inR = ch > 1 ? buf[f * ch + 1] : inL;

            // Pre-delay.
            float pL = inL;
            float pR = inR;
            if (preFrames > 0 && preBuffer.length >= preFrames * 2) {
                pL = preBuffer[prePos * 2];
                pR = preBuffer[prePos * 2 + 1];
                preBuffer[prePos * 2] = inL;
                preBuffer[prePos * 2 + 1] = inR;
                prePos = (prePos + 1) % preFrames;
            }

            float wetL = 0f;
            float wetR = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < COMBS; i++) {
                wetL += combL[i].process(pL, feedback, damp);
                wetR += combR[i].process(pR, feedback, damp);
            }
            wetL /= COMBS;
            wetR /= COMBS;
            for (int i = 0; i < ALLPASS; i++) {
                wetL = apL[i].process(wetL);
                wetR = apR[i].process(wetR);
            }

            // Mid/side width control.
            float mid = (wetL + wetR) * 0.5f;
            float side = (wetL - wetR) * 0.5f * widthPct;
            wetL = mid + side;
            wetR = mid - side;

            if (toneLo.sectionCount() > 0 || toneHi.sectionCount() > 0) {
                toneScratch[0] = wetL;
                toneScratch[1] = wetR;
                toneLo.process(toneScratch, 1, 2);
                toneHi.process(toneScratch, 1, 2);
                wetL = toneScratch[0];
                wetR = toneScratch[1];
            }

            buf[f * ch] = dry * inL + wet * wetL;
            if (ch > 1) buf[f * ch + 1] = dry * inR + wet * wetR;
        }
    }

    /** Low-pass feedback comb filter. */
    private static final class Comb {
        private float[] buffer = new float[0];
        private int pos = 0;
        private float store = 0f;

        Comb(int len) {
            resize(len);
        }

        void resize(int len) {
            if (buffer.length != len) {
                buffer = new float[len];
                pos = 0;
                store = 0f;
            }
        }

        void reset() {
            java.util.Arrays.fill(buffer, 0f);
            pos = 0;
            store = 0f;
        }

        float process(float input, float feedback, float damp) {
            float output = buffer[pos];
            store = output * (1f - damp) + store * damp;
            buffer[pos] = input + store * feedback;
            pos = (pos + 1) % buffer.length;
            return output;
        }
    }

    /** Series all-pass diffuser. */
    private static final class Allpass {
        private float[] buffer = new float[0];
        private int pos = 0;

        Allpass(int len) {
            resize(len);
        }

        void resize(int len) {
            if (buffer.length != len) {
                buffer = new float[len];
                pos = 0;
            }
        }

        void reset() {
            java.util.Arrays.fill(buffer, 0f);
            pos = 0;
        }

        float process(float input) {
            float buffered = buffer[pos];
            float output = -input + buffered;
            buffer[pos] = input + buffered * 0.5f;
            pos = (pos + 1) % buffer.length;
            return output;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Coarse grouping for the FX rack, mirroring the eight effect-catalog
 * categories in the pro-audio roadmap (EQ/Filters, Dynamics, Restoration,
 * Spatial, Time, Creative, Timeline tools, Analyzers).
 */
public enum FxCategory {
    EQUALIZER("EQ & Filters"),
    DYNAMICS("Dynamics & Mastering"),
    RESTORATION("Noise Removal & Restoration"),
    SPATIAL("Delay, Reverb & Spatial"),
    TIME("Pitch, Speed & Time"),
    CREATIVE("Distortion, Modulation & Creative"),
    TOOLS("Fades & Timeline Tools"),
    ANALYZER("Generators & Analyzers");

    public final String label;

    FxCategory(String label) {
        this.label = label;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Locale;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Strongly typed, serializable parameter descriptor for an
 * {@link AudioProcessor}. A processor declares the parameters it exposes and
 * the FX inspector renders one control per parameter, so multi-knob effects
 * need no bespoke UI.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;Values are stored as integer &quot;raw&quot; counts so that stepping, clamping and
 * persistence are exact; {@link #getFloat()} rescales by
 * {@link #scaleDivisor} (e.g. raw 350 with divisor 100 is 3.50). Display
 * formatting is scale-aware (dB suffix, enum labels) and can be overridden
 * with a {@link ValueFormatter}.
 */
public final class FxParameter {

    public enum Type { FLOAT, INT, BOOLEAN, ENUM, ACTION, CURVE_NODES }

    public enum Scale { LINEAR, LOGARITHMIC, DECIBEL, PIECEWISE_FREQ }

    /** Optional display override; when set, {@link #formatDisplay()} uses it. */
    public interface ValueFormatter {
        String format(FxParameter p, int rawValue);
    }

    public final String id;
    public final String name;
    public final String unit;
    public final Type type;
    public final Scale scale;
    public final int minRaw;
    public final int maxRaw;
    public final int stepRaw;
    public final int defaultRaw;
    public final int scaleDivisor;
    public final String[] enumLabels;

    private volatile int currentRaw;
    private volatile ValueFormatter formatter;

    private FxParameter(String id, String name, String unit, Type type,
                        Scale scale, int minRaw, int maxRaw, int stepRaw,
                        int defaultRaw, int scaleDivisor, String[] enumLabels) {
        this.id = id;
        this.name = name;
        this.unit = unit == null ? "" : unit;
        this.type = type;
        this.scale = scale;
        this.minRaw = minRaw;
        this.maxRaw = maxRaw;
        this.stepRaw = Math.max(1, stepRaw);
        this.scaleDivisor = Math.max(1, scaleDivisor);
        this.enumLabels = enumLabels;
        this.defaultRaw = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, defaultRaw));
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(defaultRaw);
    }

    /** Integer parameter in {@code unit} (e.g. " Hz", "%"). */
    public static FxParameter intParam(String id, String name, String unit,
                                       int min, int max, int step, int def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, unit, Type.INT, Scale.LINEAR,
                min, max, step, def, 1, null);
    }
    /** Fractional parameter stored scaled by 100 (two decimal places). */
    public static FxParameter floatParam(String id, String name, String unit,
                                         float min, float max, float def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, unit, Type.FLOAT, Scale.LINEAR,
                Math.round(min * 100f), Math.round(max * 100f), 1,
                Math.round(def * 100f), 100, null);
    }

    /** Decibel parameter (displays a " dB" suffix). */
    public static FxParameter dbParam(String id, String name,
                                      float minDb, float maxDb, float defDb) {
        FxParameter p = new FxParameter(id, name, " dB", Type.FLOAT,
                Scale.DECIBEL, Math.round(minDb * 100f), Math.round(maxDb * 100f),
                1, Math.round(defDb * 100f), 100, null);
        return p;
    }

    public static FxParameter boolParam(String id, String name, boolean def) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.BOOLEAN, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, 1, 1, def ? 1 : 0, 1, null);
    }

    public static FxParameter enumParam(String id, String name,
                                        String[] labels, int defIndex) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.ENUM, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, Math.max(0, labels.length - 1), 1, defIndex, 1, labels);
    }

    /** One-shot command parameter (renders as a button, holds no value). */
    public static FxParameter actionParam(String id, String name) {
        return new FxParameter(id, name, "", Type.ACTION, Scale.LINEAR,
                0, 0, 1, 0, 1, null);
    }

    public int getCurrentRaw() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    /**
     * The step a control should use when the user drags or taps the value.
     *
     * <p>Fixed-point parameters are stored in raw counts ({@code scaleDivisor}
     * counts per display unit), so their storage granularity is far finer than
     * anything the user can read on the label. Dragging with the storage
     * granularity makes a one-decimal control (a Q of 25.0, a 0.1 dB
     * threshold) crawl: the value changes but the label barely moves, and
     * crossing the range takes hundreds of swipes.
     *
     * <p>The interaction step is therefore derived from the *displayed*
     * precision: one tenth of a display unit for fractional and decibel
     * parameters, one count for integer ones. That matches what the label
     * can actually show, so every drag tick produces a visible change.
     */
    public int interactionStepRaw() {
        int span = Math.max(0, maxRaw - minRaw);
        if (type == Type.INT) {
            return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, stepRaw));
        }
        if (scaleDivisor <= 1) {
            return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, stepRaw));
        }
        // One tenth of a display unit, in raw counts.
        int tenth = Math.max(1, scaleDivisor / 10);
        int step = Math.max(1, Math.max(stepRaw, tenth));
        // The step must never be coarser than the range itself, or a narrow
        // control could not reach its own bounds.
        return Math.max(1, Math.min(span, step));
    }

    public void setCurrentRaw(int raw) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(raw);
    }

    public void resetToDefault() {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(defaultRaw);
    }

    public int clampRaw(int raw) {
        int v = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, raw));
        if (type == Type.ENUM || type == Type.BOOLEAN || type == Type.ACTION) {
            return v;
        }
        if (stepRaw > 1 && v < maxRaw) {
            int steps = Math.round((v - minRaw) / (float) stepRaw);
            v = minRaw + steps * stepRaw;
            v = Math.max(minRaw, Math.min(maxRaw, v));
        }
        return v;
    }

    public float getFloat() {
        return currentRaw / (float) scaleDivisor;
    }

    public void setFloat(float v) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(Math.round(v * scaleDivisor));
    }

    public boolean getBoolean() {
        return currentRaw != 0;
    }

    public void setBoolean(boolean b) {
        this.currentRaw = b ? 1 : 0;
    }

    public int getEnumIndex() {
        return currentRaw;
    }

    public void setEnumIndex(int idx) {
        this.currentRaw = clampRaw(idx);
    }

    public String getEnumLabel() {
        return getEnumLabel(currentRaw);
    }

    public String getEnumLabel(int rawIndex) {
        if (enumLabels == null || rawIndex < 0
                || rawIndex >= enumLabels.length) {
            return "";
        }
        return enumLabels[rawIndex];
    }

    public void setValueFormatter(ValueFormatter f) {
        this.formatter = f;
    }

    /** Human readable value for the current raw setting. */
    public String formatDisplay() {
        return formatRaw(currentRaw);
    }

    /**
     * Stateless display formatter for an arbitrary {@code rawValue}. Safe to
     * call on shared prototype descriptors without mutating {@link #currentRaw}.
     */
    public String formatRaw(int rawValue) {
        int raw = clampRaw(rawValue);
        if (formatter != null) {
            return formatter.format(this, raw);
        }
        if (type == Type.BOOLEAN) {
            return raw != 0 ? "On" : "Off";
        }
        if (type == Type.ENUM) {
            return getEnumLabel(raw);
        }
        if (type == Type.ACTION) {
            return name;
        }
        if (scaleDivisor <= 1) {
            return unit.isEmpty() ? String.valueOf(raw)
                    : raw + unit;
        }
        double d = raw / (double) scaleDivisor;
        String num;
        if (scale == Scale.DECIBEL) {
            if (scaleDivisor >= 100 && (Math.abs(raw) % 10) != 0) {
                num = String.format(Locale.US, "%+.2f", d);
            } else {
                num = String.format(Locale.US, "%+.1f", d);
            }
        } else if (Math.abs(d) >= 10 || raw % scaleDivisor == 0) {
            num = trimTrailingZeros(String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", d));
        } else {
            num = trimTrailingZeros(String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", d));
        }
        return unit.isEmpty() ? num : num + unit;
    }

    private static String trimTrailingZeros(String s) {
        if (!s.contains(".")) return s;
        while (s.endsWith("0")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        if (s.endsWith(".")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        return s;
    }

    public JSONObject toJson() {
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("id", id);
            o.put("name", name);
            o.put("unit", unit);
            o.put("type", type.name());
            o.put("scale", scale.name());
            o.put("min", minRaw);
            o.put("max", maxRaw);
            o.put("step", stepRaw);
            o.put("def", defaultRaw);
            o.put("div", scaleDivisor);
            o.put("cur", currentRaw);
            if (enumLabels != null) {
                JSONArray a = new JSONArray();
                for (String l : enumLabels) a.put(l);
                o.put("enums", a);
            }
            return o;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONObject();
        }
    }

    /** Rebuilds a parameter from {@link #toJson()} output. */
    public static FxParameter fromJson(JSONObject o) {
        if (o == null) return null;
        String id = o.optString("id", "");
        String[] enums = null;
        JSONArray ea = o.optJSONArray("enums");
        if (ea != null && ea.length() > 0) {
            enums = new String[ea.length()];
            for (int i = 0; i < enums.length; i++) enums[i] = ea.optString(i, "");
        }
        Type t;
        Scale sc;
        try {
            t = Type.valueOf(o.optString("type", Type.INT.name()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            t = Type.INT;
        }
        try {
            sc = Scale.valueOf(o.optString("scale", Scale.LINEAR.name()));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            sc = Scale.LINEAR;
        }
        FxParameter p = new FxParameter(id, o.optString("name", ""),
                o.optString("unit", ""), t, sc,
                o.optInt("min", 0), o.optInt("max", 100),
                o.optInt("step", 1), o.optInt("def", 0),
                o.optInt("div", 1), enums);
        p.currentRaw = p.clampRaw(o.optInt("cur", p.defaultRaw));
        return p;
    }
}

=================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/FxPreviewPeaks.java
