package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 mastering tool: EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770-4 integrated loudness
 * normalization with a true-peak ceiling.
 *
 * <p>The measurement pass runs the ITU K-weighting filter (a +4 dB high shelf
 * at 1681.97 Hz followed by a 38.13 Hz RLB high-pass), integrates 400 ms
 * blocks with 75 % overlap and applies the absolute (-70 LUFS) and relative
 * (-10 LU) gates exactly as the recommendation describes. The render pass
 * then applies the resulting linear gain and soft-limits the peaks to the
 * chosen ceiling so the result never clips.
 */
final class LoudnessNormalizationProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Perceived Loudness (LUFS)",
            "RMS dBFS"};

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "loud_mode", "Normalization Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter target = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "loud_target", "Target Loudness", -70f, 0f, -16f));
    private final FxParameter dualMono = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "loud_dual", "Treat Mono as Dual-Mono", true));
    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "loud_ceiling", "True-Peak Ceiling", -3f, -0.1f, -1f));

    private float appliedGainDb = 0f;
    private float measuredLufs = -70f;
    private boolean scanned = false;
    // Real-time fallback state (no pre-scan available).
    private float realtimeLufs = -70f;
    private float realtimeGainDb = 0f;

    private BiquadFilter kWeight = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;

    LoudnessNormalizationProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "loudness";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Loudness Normalization (EBU R128)";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "K-weighted LUFS integration with a true-peak ceiling";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuildWeighting();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        kWeight.reset();
        scanned = false;
        realtimeLufs = -70f;
        realtimeGainDb = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    private void rebuildWeighting() {
        // BS.1770-4 K-weighting: high shelf +4 dB @1681.97 Hz, then the
        // RLB high-pass at 38.13 Hz.
        float[] shelf = Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, 1681.97, 0.7071, 4f);
        float[] hp = Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, 38.13, 0.5003);
        kWeight.setSections(new float[][]{shelf, hp}, channels);
    }

    /** Measured integrated loudness in LUFS (available after the scan). */
    public float getMeasuredLufs() {
        return measuredLufs;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(java.io.File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (raw == null) return;
        float[] sel = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        if (sel == null || sel.length == 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int frames = sel.length / ch;
        if (frames <= 0) return;

        this.sampleRate = sampleRate > 0 ? sampleRate : DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
        this.channels = ch;
        rebuildWeighting();

        float lufs;
        if (mode.getEnumIndex() == 1) {
            lufs = measureRmsDbfs(sel, frames, ch);
        } else {
            lufs = measureIntegratedLufs(sel, frames, ch);
        }
        measuredLufs = lufs;
        float t = target.getFloat();
        if (lufs <= -69.5f) {
            appliedGainDb = 0f;
        } else {
            appliedGainDb = t - lufs;
        }
        scanned = true;
    }

    /** Plain RMS level in dBFS over the whole selection. */
    private static float measureRmsDbfs(float[] sel, int frames, int ch) {
        double sum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                double v = sel[f * ch + c];
                sum += v * v;
                count++;
            }
        }
        if (count == 0) return -70f;
        return (float) (10 * Math.log10(sum / count));
    }

    /**
     * Integrated loudness per ITU-R BS.1770-4: K-weighted block energies on
     * 400 ms blocks with 75 % overlap, absolute gate at -70 LUFS, then a
     * relative gate 10 LU below the (ungated) mean.
     */
    private float measureIntegratedLufs(float[] sel, int frames, int ch) {
        int block = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.4));
        int step = Math.max(1, (int) (sampleRate * 0.1));
        float[] blockLufs = new float[Math.max(1, frames / step + 2)];
        int blockCount = 0;

        float[] scratch = new float[block * ch];
        for (int start = 0; start + block <= frames; start += step) {
            System.arraycopy(sel, start * ch, scratch, 0, block * ch);
            kWeight.reset();
            kWeight.process(scratch, block, ch);
            double sum = 0;
            for (int f = 0; f < block; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    double v = scratch[f * ch + c];
                    sum += v * v;
                }
            }
            double mean = sum / (block * (double) ch);
            if (ch == 1 && dualMono.getBoolean()) {
                mean *= 2.0;
            }
            double l = -0.691 + 10 * Math.log10(Math.max(1e-12, mean));
            if (blockCount < blockLufs.length) {
                blockLufs[blockCount++] = (float) l;
            }
        }
        if (blockCount == 0) return -70f;

        // Absolute gate at -70 LUFS.
        double gated = 0;
        int gatedCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < blockCount; i++) {
            if (blockLufs[i] > -70f) {
                gated += Math.pow(10, (blockLufs[i] + 0.691) / 10.0);
                gatedCount++;
            }
        }
        if (gatedCount == 0) return -70f;
        double ungated = -0.691 + 10 * Math.log10(gated / gatedCount);

        // Relative gate 10 LU below the ungated level.
        double rel = ungated - 10.0;
        gated = 0;
        gatedCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < blockCount; i++) {
            if (blockLufs[i] > -70f && blockLufs[i] > rel) {
                gated += Math.pow(10, (blockLufs[i] + 0.691) / 10.0);
                gatedCount++;
            }
        }
        if (gatedCount == 0) return (float) ungated;
        return (float) (-0.691 + 10 * Math.log10(gated / gatedCount));
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (!scanned) {
            float lufs = (mode.getEnumIndex() == 1)
                    ? measureRmsDbfs(buf, frames, ch)
                    : measureIntegratedLufs(buf, frames, ch);
            appliedGainDb = (lufs <= -69.5f) ? 0f : (target.getFloat() - lufs);
        }
        float gain = Dsp.dbToLin(appliedGainDb);
        if (gain == 1f) return;
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * ch);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) buf[i] *= gain;

        // True-peak ceiling: soft-limit anything that would exceed it.
        float ceilLin = Dsp.dbToLin(ceiling.getFloat());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            float v = buf[i];
            float a = Math.abs(v);
            if (a > ceilLin) {
                float over = a - ceilLin;
                // tanh-style soft knee above the ceiling.
                float shaped = ceilLin + over / (1f + over / (ceilLin + 1e-6f));
                buf[i] = v < 0 ? -shaped : shaped;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Real-time fallback: tracks a decaying K-weighted loudness estimate
     * and eases the gain towards {@code target - measured}. The ceiling is
     * still enforced, so the live preview can never clip.
     */
    private void runRealtime(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        float ceilLin = Dsp.dbToLin(ceiling.getFloat());
        float targetLufs = target.getFloat();
        final int block = 1024;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] weighted = new float[n * ch];
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, weighted, 0, weighted.length);
            kWeight.reset();
            kWeight.process(weighted, n, ch);
            double sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n * ch; i++) {
                sum += (double) weighted[i] * weighted[i];
            }
            double mean = sum / (n * (double) ch);
            if (ch == 1 && dualMono.getBoolean()) {
                mean *= 2.0;
            }
            float blockLufs = (float) (-0.691 + 10 * Math.log10(Math.max(1e-12, mean)));
            // The estimate decays so a loud passage does not pin the gain.
            realtimeLufs = Math.max(blockLufs, realtimeLufs - 0.05f);
            float wanted = targetLufs - realtimeLufs;
            realtimeGainDb += (wanted - realtimeGainDb) * 0.02f;
            float gain = Dsp.dbToLin(realtimeGainDb);
            for (int i = 0; i < n * ch; i++) {
                float v = buf[offset * ch + i] * gain;
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > ceilLin) {
                    float over = a - ceilLin;
                    float shaped = ceilLin + over / (1f + over / (ceilLin + 1e-6f));
                    v = v < 0 ? -shaped : shaped;
                }
                buf[offset * ch + i] = v;
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;
import android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator;
import android.widget.ImageView;

import androidx.activity.OnBackPressedCallback;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate;
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

public class MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private View fabWrap;
    private View fabHalo;
    private ImageView fabIcon;
    private View fabStopWrap;
    private boolean inStudio = false;
    private int fabIconRes = R.drawable.ic_mic;
    private boolean recoveryChecked;
    private long lastFabPress;
    private long lastStopPress;
    private OnBackPressedCallback backCallback;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES);
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main);

        fabWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
        fabHalo = findViewById(R.id.fabHalo);
        fabIcon = findViewById(R.id.fabIcon);
        fabStopWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabStopWrap);

        // Smooth press animation: shrink on touch-down, spring back on release.
        fabWrap.setOnTouchListener((v, event) -> {
            if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.9f).scaleY(0.9f).setDuration(120).start();
            } else if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                    || event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(160).start();
            }
            return false;
        });
        fabWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Debounced: one tap, one transition. Guards against double
            // delivery that used to start-then-instantly-pause takes.
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastFabPress < 400) return;
            lastFabPress = now;
            if (!inStudio) {
                pulseHalo();
                openStudio();
            } else {
                StudioFragment st = studio();
                if (st != null) st.onFabPressed();
            }
        });
        PressAnim.apply(fabStopWrap);
        fabStopWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastStopPress < 400) return;
            lastStopPress = now;
            StudioFragment st = studio();
            if (st != null) st.onStopPressed();
        });

        getOnBackPressedDispatcher().addCallback(this, backCallback =
                new OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            @Override
            public void handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (inStudio) {
                    StudioFragment st = studio();
                    if (st != null) {
                        st.onBackPressed();
                    } else {
                        exitStudio();
                    }
                } else {
                    Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
                    boolean consumed = f instanceof LibraryFragment
                            && ((LibraryFragment) f).onBackPressed();
                    if (!consumed) {
                        finish();
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        if (savedInstanceState != null) {
            inStudio = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("inStudio", false);
            recoveryChecked = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("recoveryChecked", false);
        } else {
            getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                    .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                    .commitAllowingStateLoss();
        }

        handleOpenStudioIntent(getIntent());
        // Library loads async (Room + disk reconcile). Recovery + first paint
        // wait for it so prompts see adopted orphans and pruned rows.
        TakesRepository.init(this);
        TrialAndBillingManager.get(this).connectAndSync();
        TakesRepository.onReady(() -> {
            if (!recoveryChecked) {
                recoveryChecked = true;
                fabWrap.post(this::checkUnfinishedTakes);
            } else {
                fabWrap.post(this::refreshLibraryIfShown);
            }
            maybeAnnounceRecovered();
            maybeHealCrashedEncoder();
            maybeShowCrashReport();
        });
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    /**
     * Self-healing after an encoder kills a save: the breadcrumbs name the
     * exact format that never finished. Step one rung down the reliability
     * ladder (exotic -> AAC -> pure-Java WAV) so the next recording can
     * actually save on this device.
     */
    private void maybeHealCrashedEncoder() {
        String stage;
        try {
            stage = CrashLog.unterminatedStage(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (stage == null || !stage.startsWith("convert ") || inStudio) return;
        String crashedId = stage.substring("convert ".length()).trim();
        SaveFormat crashed = SaveFormat.of(crashedId);
        SaveFormat current = SaveFormat.load(this);
        SaveFormat currentEff = current.effective(RecordPreset.load(this));
        // Only act while the user still has the killer selected: a manual
        // switch since the crash is respected, not overridden.
        if (currentEff != crashed) return;
        SaveFormat fallback = crashed.fallbackAfterCrash();
        if (fallback == null) return;
        try {
            fallback.save(this);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this,
                    "auto-switch " + crashed.id + "->" + fallback.id);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // A Java crash file already tells the story (breadcrumbs included):
        // don't stack a second dialog on top of its share prompt.
        boolean crashFile;
        try {
            crashFile = CrashLog.recentCrash(this) != null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            crashFile = false;
        }
        if (crashFile) return;
        final String from = crashed.badge;
        final String to = fallback.badge;
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_msg, from, to),
                        () -> { });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One surfacing of the previous run's crash log, with share + dismiss. */
    private void maybeShowCrashReport() {
        File crash = CrashLog.recentCrash(this);
        if (crash == null || inStudio) return;
        // Stale reports auto-expire: only a fresh crash nags, and sharing
        // clears it. Cancelling keeps it for the next launch (bounded by
        // the same freshness window).
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - crash.lastModified()
                > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L) {
            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
            return;
        }
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showConfirm(this,
                        getString(R.string.crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.crash_msg),
                        getString(R.string.crash_share),
                        R.drawable.ic_close, false,
                        () -> {
                            CrashLog.share(this, crash);
                            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
                        });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One summary popup when the startup sweep adopted orphaned files. */
    private void maybeAnnounceRecovered() {
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.lastReconcile();
        if (rr == null || rr.adopted <= 0 || inStudio) return;
        // Posted: dialogs need a resumed activity, and onReady can fire
        // synchronously inside onCreate after a rotation.
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(this, "Takes recovered");
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    void refreshLibraryIfShown() {
        try {
            Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
            if (f instanceof LibraryFragment && f.isAdded()) {
                ((LibraryFragment) f).refreshExternal();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @Override
    protected void onNewIntent(Intent intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent);
        setIntent(intent);
        handleOpenStudioIntent(intent);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (backCallback != null) backCallback.setEnabled(true);
        syncFabWithEngine();
        for (ConversionJob j : ConversionJobs.active()) {
            if (ConversionJob.QUEUED.equals(j.state)) {
                ConversionService.startJob(this, j.jobId);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSaveInstanceState(Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putBoolean("inStudio", inStudio);
        outState.putBoolean("recoveryChecked", recoveryChecked);
    }

    private void handleOpenStudioIntent(Intent intent) {
        if (intent == null) return;
        boolean open = intent.getBooleanExtra("open_studio", false)
                || "com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO".equals(intent.getAction());
        if (open && RecordingEngine.get().hasSession() && !inStudio) {
            openStudio();
        }
        try {
            intent.removeExtra("open_studio");
            intent.setAction(null);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public void openStudio() {
        inStudio = true;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out,
                        R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right)
                .replace(R.id.container, new StudioFragment(), "STU")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    public void openStudioWithRecovery(File rawFile) {
        // Crash recovery reopens directly in the recording state.
        openStudioWithSession(rawFile.getAbsolutePath(), true, -1, null);
    }

    /** Edit punch-in: session pre-loaded, timer correct, waits for mic tap. */
    public void openStudioWithEdit(File rawFile, long sourceId, String sourceTitle) {
        openStudioWithSession(rawFile.getAbsolutePath(), false, sourceId, sourceTitle);
    }

    private void openStudioWithSession(String rawPath, boolean autostart,
                                       long editSourceId, String editSourceTitle) {
        inStudio = true;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        StudioFragment f = new StudioFragment();
        Bundle b = new Bundle();
        b.putString("recover_raw", rawPath);
        b.putBoolean("autostart", autostart);
        if (editSourceId != -1) {
            b.putLong("edit_source_id", editSourceId);
            b.putString("edit_source_title", editSourceTitle);
        }
        f.setArguments(b);
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out,
                        R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right)
                .replace(R.id.container, f, "STU")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    public void exitStudio() {
        inStudio = false;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right,
                        R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out)
                .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    // ---- split record controls ----

    /**
     * Main FAB artwork morph (mic / pause / play) with a smooth shrink-swap-pop.
     * Scale-only: the old rotation accumulated 70° on every tap, visibly
     * twisting the icon over time. The split stop button is shown separately
     * while a take is active.
     */
    public void morphFabIcon(int resId) {
        if (fabIconRes == resId) return;
        fabIconRes = resId;
        fabIcon.animate().cancel();
        // Snap rotation back first so repeated morphs can never accumulate.
        fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
        fabIcon.animate()
                .scaleX(0.35f).scaleY(0.35f)
                .setDuration(110)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .withEndAction(() -> {
                    try {
                        fabIcon.setImageResource(resId);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
                    fabIcon.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(230)
                            .setInterpolator(new OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                            .start();
                })
                .start();
    }

    /** Show/hide the split stop button with a pop. */
    public void setStopVisible(boolean visible) {
        if (visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            PressAnim.pop(fabStopWrap);
        } else if (!visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.animate().cancel();
            fabStopWrap.animate()
                    .scaleX(0.4f).scaleY(0.4f)
                    .alpha(0f)
                    .setDuration(150)
                    .withEndAction(() -> {
                        fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleX(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleY(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setAlpha(1f);
                    })
                    .start();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Drive both FABs from the engine state. Called on studio transitions and
     * on resume so a background recording re-attaches its controls.
     */
    public void syncFabWithEngine() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        boolean active = inStudio && e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
        boolean paused = e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;
        if (active) {
            morphFabIcon(paused ? R.drawable.ic_play : R.drawable.ic_pause);
            setStopVisible(true);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(
                    getString(paused ? R.string.action_resume : R.string.action_pause));
        } else {
            morphFabIcon(inStudio ? R.drawable.ic_mic : R.drawable.ic_mic);
            setStopVisible(false);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(getString(R.string.cd_mic));
        }
    }

    /** Legacy hook: true once meant square-stop artwork; now drives split UI. */
    public void setFabStop(boolean stop) {
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    // ---- unfinished-take recovery (every app start) ----

    private void checkUnfinishedTakes() {
        // Never interrupt an attached studio session with its own UI.
        if (inStudio) return;
        // If the engine already holds a session (background recording), the
        // notification owns it — just offer to reopen the studio.
        if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()) {
            return;
        }
        List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> found;
        try {
            found = RecordingEngine.scanUnfinished(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (found == null || found.isEmpty()) return;
        promptRecovery(0, found);
    }

    private void promptRecovery(int index, List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> all) {
        if (index >= all.size()) return;
        RecordingEngine.Unfinished u = all.get(index);
        String dur = String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d",
                (u.durationMs / 60000), (u.durationMs / 1000) % 60);
        try {
            OptionsSheet.showTwoChoiceModal(this,
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_title),
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_msg, u.name, dur),
                    OptionsSheet.Item.danger(R.drawable.ic_trash,
                            "Discard", () -> {
                                boolean ok = RecordingEngine.deleteUnfinished(u.rawFile);
                                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, ok,
                                        ok ? "Take discarded" : "Delete failed",
                                        null,
                                        () -> promptRecovery(index + 1, all));
                            }),
                    OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_play,
                            "Continue", () -> {
                                try {
                                    RecordingEngine.get().attachExisting(
                                            getApplicationContext(),
                                            u.rawFile, u.name, u.channels,
                                            RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(u.rawFile));
                                } catch (Exception e) {
                                    OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                                            "Open failed", null);
                                    promptRecovery(index + 1, all);
                                    return;
                                }
                                openStudioWithRecovery(u.rawFile);
                            }));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private StudioFragment studio() {
        Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("STU");
        return (f instanceof StudioFragment && f.isVisible()) ? (StudioFragment) f : null;
    }

    private void pulseHalo() {
        fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1.22f).scaleY(1.22f).setDuration(150)
                .withEndAction(() -> fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(220).start())
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Adaptive chunk sizing for offline audio work.
 *
 * <p>The converters used to allocate their maximum (64K-frame float buffers,
 * up to ~650 KB per pass) regardless of how much headroom the process had.
 * On a low-RAM device, or while a recording, the FX preview and the library
 * are all live, those allocations were exactly the ones that pushed the heap
 * into repeated GC pauses. The budget below keeps the per-pass buffer inside
 * a fraction of the free heap, while never going below a useful chunk size.
 *
 * <p>This is deliberately framework-free so it behaves the same in
 * Robolectric and on device: the size is a hint, not a contract, and the
 * encoder loops already handle any positive chunk.
 */
final class MemoryBudget {

    /** Small enough to be safe on a 128 MB heap, large enough to amortise. */
    private static final long MIN_BUDGET_BYTES = 256L * 1024L;
    /** Never ask for bigger buffers than the original tuned constants. */
    private static final long MAX_BUDGET_BYTES = 4L * 1024L * 1024L;
    /** Use at most this fraction of the currently free heap per pass. */
    private static final long HEAP_DIVISOR = 16L;

    private MemoryBudget() {}

    /**
     * Number of frames to allocate this pass. {@code desired} is the tuned
     * constant; {@code channels} scales the float input buffer, which is the
     * dominant allocation.
     */
    static int chunkFrames(int desired, int channels) {
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int wanted = Math.max(1, desired);
        try {
            Runtime rt = Runtime.getRuntime();
            long used = rt.totalMemory() - rt.freeMemory();
            long free = Math.max(0L, rt.maxMemory() - used);
            long budget = Math.max(MIN_BUDGET_BYTES,
                    Math.min(MAX_BUDGET_BYTES, free / HEAP_DIVISOR));
            int fits = (int) Math.min(Integer.MAX_VALUE,
                    budget / (4L * ch));
            return Math.max(2_048, Math.min(wanted, Math.max(1, fits)));
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            return wanted;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.media.MicrophoneInfo;
import android.os.Build;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Capability check for true stereo capture. Counts physical microphones via
 * {@link AudioManager#getMicrophones()} (API 28+) so a stereo preset can
 * fall back to mono — with a warning — instead of recording dual-mono or
 * silence on single-mic hardware.
 */
public final class MicSupport {

    private MicSupport() {}

    /**
     * @return number of physical microphones, or -1 when the platform cannot
     * tell (below API 28 or query failed). Callers treat -1 as "try stereo,
     * fall back silently if the hardware refuses".
     */
    public static int physicalMicCount(AudioManager am) {
        if (am == null || Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 28) return -1;
        try {
            List<MicrophoneInfo> mics = am.getMicrophones();
            if (mics == null) return -1;
            return mics.size();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    public static boolean stereoLikely(AudioManager am) {
        int n = physicalMicCount(am);
        return n < 0 || n >= 2;
    }

    /** True only when we positively know dual mics are absent. */
    public static boolean dualAbsent(AudioManager am) {
        return physicalMicCount(am) == 1;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 configurable multi-echo delay: a regular multi-tap delay, a
 * bouncing-ball pattern or its reverse, with per-echo level scaling and a
 * high-cut damping filter on the feedback path.
 */
final class MultiDelayProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] TYPE_LABELS = {"Regular", "Bouncing Ball",
            "Reverse Bouncing Ball"};

    private final FxParameter type = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "md_type", "Delay Type", TYPE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter level = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "md_level", "Delay Level", -24f, 1f, -6f));
    private final FxParameter delayTime = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "md_time", "Delay Time", " ms", 10, 3000, 10, 300));
    private final FxParameter echoes = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "md_echoes", "Number of Echoes", "", 1, 30, 1, 5));
    private final FxParameter highCut = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "md_hicut", "High-Cut Damping", " Hz", 1000, 20000, 100, 8000));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private float[] delayLine = new float[0];
    private int delayFrames = 0;
    private int writePos = 0;
    private BiquadFilter damp = new BiquadFilter();

    MultiDelayProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "multidelay";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Multi-Echo Delay";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Regular, bouncing-ball or reverse multi-tap echo";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.SPATIAL;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        if (delayLine != null) java.util.Arrays.fill(delayLine, 0f);
        writePos = 0;
        damp.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public int getTailFrames() {
        return delayFrames * 4;
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        delayFrames = Math.max(1,
                (int) (delayTime.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate));
        int taps = Math.max(1, echoes.getCurrentRaw());
        int need = Math.max(delayFrames * (taps + 2), delayFrames * 2 + 1);
        if (delayLine.length < need * channels) {
            delayLine = new float[need * channels];
            writePos = 0;
        }
        damp.setSections(new float[][]{
                Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, highCut.getCurrentRaw(), 0.7071)},
                channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
        int taps = Math.max(1, echoes.getCurrentRaw());
        float levelLin = Dsp.dbToLin(level.getFloat());
        int typeIdx = type.getEnumIndex();
        int maxFrames = delayLine.length / ch;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int base = f * ch;
            float inL = buf[base];
            float inR = ch > 1 ? buf[base + 1] : inL;
            float wetL = 0f;
            float wetR = 0f;
            float ampSum = 0f;
            for (int k = 1; k <= taps; k++) {
                int offset;
                float amp;
                if (typeIdx == 0) {
                    offset = delayFrames * k;
                    amp = (float) Math.pow(levelLin, k);
                } else if (typeIdx == 1) {
                    // Bouncing ball: shortening intervals as echoes decay.
                    double ratio = 1.0 - Math.pow(0.82, k);
                    offset = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(delayFrames * taps * ratio));
                    amp = (float) Math.pow(levelLin, k);
                } else {
                    // Reverse bouncing ball: expanding intervals with rising level.
                    offset = delayFrames * k;
                    amp = (float) Math.pow(levelLin, (taps - k + 1));
                }
                ampSum += Math.abs(amp);
                if (offset >= maxFrames) offset = maxFrames - 1;
                int pos = (writePos - offset + maxFrames) % maxFrames;
                wetL += delayLine[pos * ch] * amp;
                if (ch > 1) wetR += delayLine[pos * ch + 1] * amp;
            }
            // Damping on the feedback path.
            float[] dampBuf = new float[ch];
            dampBuf[0] = wetL;
            if (ch > 1) dampBuf[1] = wetR;
            damp.process(dampBuf, 1, ch);
            wetL = dampBuf[0];
            wetR = ch > 1 ? dampBuf[1] : wetL;

            // Tap levels above 0 dB with many echoes sum to far more than full
            // scale (30 taps at +1 dB reach ~+50 dB). Keep the decay shape but
            // keep the wet sum bounded, so the repeats cannot swamp the mix.
            if (ampSum > 1f) {
                float scale = 1f / ampSum;
                wetL *= scale;
                wetR *= scale;
            }

            float outL = inL + wetL;
            float outR = inR + wetR;
            if (!Float.isFinite(outL) || Math.abs(outL) > 1e4f) {
                outL = inL;
                wetL = 0f;
            }
            if (!Float.isFinite(outR) || Math.abs(outR) > 1e4f) {
                outR = inR;
                wetR = 0f;
            }
            buf[base] = outL;
            if (ch > 1) buf[base + 1] = outR;

            // The delay line is the feedback path: its loop gain is the sum of
            // the tap amplitudes. With a level above 0 dB and many echoes that
            // sum exceeds unity and the repeats compound without bound, so the
            // stored signal is attenuated to keep the loop stable while the
            // audible taps keep the requested level.
            float regen = ampSum > 0.9f ? 0.9f / ampSum : 1f;
            float storeL = inL + wetL * regen;
            float storeR = inR + wetR * regen;
            delayLine[writePos * ch] = Float.isFinite(storeL) ? storeL : 0f;
            if (ch > 1) {
                delayLine[writePos * ch + 1] = Float.isFinite(storeR) ? storeR : 0f;
            }
            writePos = (writePos + 1) % (delayLine.length / ch);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 three-band vocal leveler: a Linkwitz-Riley 4th-order crossover
 * (24 dB/oct) splits the signal into low / mid / high bands, each band gets
 * its own soft-knee compressor, and the three are summed back phase-coherently.
 */
final class MultibandCompressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter lowXover = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "mb_lowx", "Low/Mid Crossover", " Hz", 80, 800, 10, 220));
    private final FxParameter highXover = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "mb_highx", "Mid/High Crossover", " Hz", 1500, 8000, 100, 3500));
    private final FxParameter lowThresh = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_lowt", "Low Threshold", -60f, 0f, -24f));
    private final FxParameter midThresh = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_midt", "Mid Threshold", -60f, 0f, -18f));
    private final FxParameter highThresh = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_hight", "High Threshold", -60f, 0f, -20f));
    private final FxParameter lowRatio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "mb_lowr", "Low Ratio", ":1", 1f, 10f, 2f));
    private final FxParameter midRatio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "mb_midr", "Mid Ratio", ":1", 1f, 10f, 3f));
    private final FxParameter highRatio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "mb_highr", "High Ratio", ":1", 1f, 10f, 2.5f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "mb_attack", "Attack", " ms", 1f, 100f, 15f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "mb_release", "Release", " ms", 40f, 1200f, 200f));
    private final FxParameter lowGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_lowg", "Low Band Gain", -12f, 12f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter midGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_midg", "Mid Band Gain", -12f, 12f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter highGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "mb_highg", "High Band Gain", -12f, 12f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter amount = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "mb_amount", "Amount", "%", 0, 100, 1, 40));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter lowPass = new BiquadFilter();
    private BiquadFilter highPass = new BiquadFilter();
    private DynamicsDetector.Envelope envLow;
    private DynamicsDetector.Envelope envMid;
    private DynamicsDetector.Envelope envHigh;
    private float gainLow = 0f;
    private float gainMid = 0f;
    private float gainHigh = 0f;

    MultibandCompressorProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "mbcomp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Multiband Compressor";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "3-band Linkwitz-Riley vocal leveler";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuildCrossover();
        envLow = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
        envMid = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
        envHigh = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lowPass.reset();
        highPass.reset();
        if (envLow != null) envLow.reset();
        if (envMid != null) envMid.reset();
        if (envHigh != null) envHigh.reset();
        gainLow = gainMid = gainHigh = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled() || getWetDryMix() <= 0.001f) return false;
        if (Math.abs(lowGain.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || Math.abs(midGain.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || Math.abs(highGain.getFloat()) > 0.01f) {
            return true;
        }
        return amount.getFloat() > 0
                && (lowRatio.getFloat() > 1.01f
                || midRatio.getFloat() > 1.01f
                || highRatio.getFloat() > 1.01f);
    }

    /**
     * Linkwitz-Riley 4th order: two cascaded Butterworth 2nd-order sections
     * give 24 dB/oct with an allpass-like phase relationship between the
     * complementary bands.
     */
    private void rebuildCrossover() {
        float lx = lowXover.getCurrentRaw();
        float hx = Math.max(lx + 50f, highXover.getCurrentRaw());
        float[][] lp1 = Dsp.butterworth(2, sampleRate, lx, false);
        float[][] lp2 = Dsp.butterworth(2, sampleRate, lx, false);
        float[][] hp1 = Dsp.butterworth(2, sampleRate, hx, true);
        float[][] hp2 = Dsp.butterworth(2, sampleRate, hx, true);
        float[][] lp = new float[][]{lp1[0], lp2[0]};
        float[][] hp = new float[][]{hp1[0], hp2[0]};
        lowPass.setSections(lp, channels);
        highPass.setSections(hp, channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuildCrossover();
        if (envLow == null) {
            envLow = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
            envMid = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
            envHigh = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(sampleRate);
        }

        float attMs = attack.getFloat();
        float relMs = release.getFloat();
        float gLowLin = Dsp.dbToLin(lowGain.getFloat());
        float gMidLin = Dsp.dbToLin(midGain.getFloat());
        float gHighLin = Dsp.dbToLin(highGain.getFloat());

        float[] low = new float[frames * ch];
        float[] midHigh = new float[frames * ch];
        float[] high = new float[frames * ch];
        float[] mid = new float[frames * ch];
        System.arraycopy(buf, 0, low, 0, low.length);
        lowPass.process(low, frames, ch);
        for (int i = 0; i < midHigh.length; i++) midHigh[i] = buf[i] - low[i];
        System.arraycopy(midHigh, 0, high, 0, high.length);
        highPass.process(high, frames, ch);
        for (int i = 0; i < mid.length; i++) mid[i] = midHigh[i] - high[i];

        final int block = 64;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float lvlLow = envLow.detect(low, offset, n, ch, false, attMs, relMs);
            float lvlMid = envMid.detect(mid, offset, n, ch, false, attMs, relMs);
            float lvlHigh = envHigh.detect(high, offset, n, ch, false, attMs, relMs);

            float amt = amount.getFloat() / 100f;
            float tLow = amt * DynamicsDetector.softKneeGainDb(
                    lvlLow - lowThresh.getFloat(), lowRatio.getFloat(), 6f);
            float tMid = amt * DynamicsDetector.softKneeGainDb(
                    lvlMid - midThresh.getFloat(), midRatio.getFloat(), 6f);
            float tHigh = amt * DynamicsDetector.softKneeGainDb(
                    lvlHigh - highThresh.getFloat(), highRatio.getFloat(), 6f);

            FxTelemetry.publishGainReductionDb(Math.min(tLow, Math.min(tMid, tHigh)));
            float stepLow = (tLow - gainLow) / n;
            float stepMid = (tMid - gainMid) / n;
            float stepHigh = (tHigh - gainHigh) / n;
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                gainLow += stepLow;
                gainMid += stepMid;
                gainHigh += stepHigh;
                float gl = Dsp.dbToLin(gainLow) * gLowLin;
                float gm = Dsp.dbToLin(gainMid) * gMidLin;
                float gh = Dsp.dbToLin(gainHigh) * gHighLin;
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    buf[idx + c] = low[idx + c] * gl + mid[idx + c] * gm
                            + high[idx + c] * gh;
                }
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 noise gate / downward expander with a hysteresis state machine
 * (closed, attack, open, hold, release), a sidechain high-pass so low
 * rumble cannot false-trigger the gate, and a configurable level reduction
 * range.
 */
final class NoiseGateExpanderProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] MODE_LABELS = {"Gate", "Downward Expander"};

    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "gate_mode", "Mode", MODE_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter threshold = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_thresh", "Threshold", -96f, -6f, -42f));
    private final FxParameter hysteresis = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_hyst", "Hysteresis", 0f, 12f, 4f));
    private final FxParameter range = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "gate_range", "Level Reduction", -100f, 0f, -24f));
    private final FxParameter ratio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_ratio", "Ratio", ":1", 1.2f, 10f, 2.5f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_attack", "Attack", " ms", 0.5f, 250f, 8f));
    private final FxParameter hold = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_hold", "Hold", " ms", 0f, 1000f, 60f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "gate_release", "Release", " ms", 10f, 3000f, 220f));
    private final FxParameter sidechainHpf = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_hpf", "Sidechain HPF", " Hz", 20, 2000, 10, 120));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter scFilter = new BiquadFilter();
    private DynamicsDetector.PeakHold peakHold;
    private float gainDb = 0f;
    private boolean open = false;
    private int holdCounter = 0;

    NoiseGateExpanderProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "gateexp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Gate / Expander";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Hysteresis gate and downward expander with sidechain HPF";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        peakHold = new DynamicsDetector.PeakHold();
        rebuildSidechain();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scFilter.reset();
        if (peakHold != null) peakHold.reset();
        gainDb = 0f;
        open = false;
        holdCounter = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && range.getFloat() < -0.01f;
    }

    private void rebuildSidechain() {
        float f = Math.max(20f, sidechainHpf.getCurrentRaw());
        scFilter.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjHighPass(sampleRate, f, 0.7071)},
                channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuildSidechain();
        if (peakHold == null) peakHold = new DynamicsDetector.PeakHold();

        float thresh = threshold.getFloat();
        float hyst = hysteresis.getFloat();
        float rangeDb = range.getFloat();
        boolean expander = mode.getEnumIndex() == 1;
        float expRatio = ratio.getFloat();
        float attCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.0005f, attack.getFloat() * 0.001f) * sampleRate)));
        float relCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (Math.max(0.001f, release.getFloat() * 0.001f) * sampleRate)));
        float holdMs = hold.getFloat();
        int holdFrames = Math.max(0,
                (int) (holdMs * 0.001f * sampleRate));

        final int block = 32;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] side = new float[n * ch];
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, side, 0, side.length);
            scFilter.process(side, n, ch);
            float levelDb = Dsp.linToDb(peakOf(side, n, ch));
            float detectDb = peakHold.update(levelDb, n,
                    holdMs, sampleRate);

            if (!open) {
                if (detectDb > thresh + hyst) {
                    open = true;
                    holdCounter = holdFrames;
                }
            } else {
                if (detectDb < thresh - hyst) {
                    if (holdCounter > 0) {
                        holdCounter -= n;
                    } else {
                        open = false;
                    }
                } else {
                    holdCounter = holdFrames;
                }
            }

            float target;
            if (expander) {
                target = open ? 0f : DynamicsDetector.expanderGainDb(
                        detectDb, thresh, rangeDb, expRatio);
            } else {
                target = open ? 0f : rangeDb;
            }
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                float coef = (target > gainDb) ? attCoef : relCoef;
                gainDb += coef * (target - gainDb);
                float g = Dsp.dbToLin(gainDb);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= g;
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }

    private static float peakOf(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        float peak = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < frames * ch; i++) {
            float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
            if (a > peak) peak = a;
        }
        return peak;
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/NoiseSuppressionProcessor.java

package com.example.hello;

import org.json.JSONArray;

/**
 * Professional spectral noise suppressor with a learned noise profile.
 *
 * <p>Workflow: the user selects a noise-only region of the take and taps
 * <em>Learn from selection</em> in the FX rack; {@link #learnProfile(float[], int)}
 * averages the short-time spectrum of that region into a per-bin noise power
 * profile which is persisted with the slot. Applying the effect then performs
 * overlap-add spectral subtraction against that profile, so hiss, hum and room
 * tone are attenuated far more musically than the old percentage-driven
 * three-band gate, while loud voice bins pass through untouched.
 *
 * <p>When no profile has been learned the processor falls back to an adaptive
 * per-bin minimum tracker, so presets still denoise out of the box. The stage
 * is a fixed-latency STFT processor: {@link #FFT_SIZE} frames of algorithmic
 * delay, reported through {@link #getLatencyFrames()} so offline range commits
 * prime and drain it exactly.
 */
final class NoiseSuppressionProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    static final int FFT_SIZE = 2048;
    static final int HOP = 512;
    static final int BINS = FFT_SIZE / 2 + 1;

    private static final float OLA_SCALE = 2f / 3f;
    private static final float POWER_FLOOR = 1e-14f;

    private static final float[] WINDOW = buildWindow();

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "amt", "Intensity", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter smooth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "smooth", "Smoothing", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));

    private final float[][] inHist = {
            new float[FFT_SIZE], new float[FFT_SIZE]};
    private final float[][] ola = {
            new float[FFT_SIZE], new float[FFT_SIZE]};
    private final float[][] re = {
            new float[FFT_SIZE], new float[FFT_SIZE]};
    private final float[][] im = {
            new float[FFT_SIZE], new float[FFT_SIZE]};
    private final float[] gainPrev = new float[BINS];
    private final float[] noiseEst = new float[BINS];

    private float[][] outQ = {new float[0], new float[0]};
    private int outCount = 0;
    private int histFill = 0;
    private long inputConsumed = 0L;
    private long genuinePopped = 0L;
    private boolean noiseInit = false;

    private volatile float[] profile;

    NoiseSuppressionProcessor() {
        java.util.Arrays.fill(gainPrev, 1f);
    }

    private static float[] buildWindow() {
        float[] w = new float[FFT_SIZE];
        for (int i = 0; i < FFT_SIZE; i++) {
            w[i] = (float) (0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(
                    2.0 * Math.PI * i / FFT_SIZE));
        }
        return w;
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "noise";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Noise Suppression Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Learned-profile spectral denoiser: analyze a noise-only "
                + "selection, then apply";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean handlesOwnWetDryMix() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                && getWetDryMix() > 0.001f;
    }

    @Override
    public int getLatencyFrames() {
        return isAudible() ? FFT_SIZE : 0;
    }

    /**
     * The spectral stage has no decaying tail: its FFT_SIZE is the analysis
     * latency, which is already reported by {@link #getLatencyFrames()} and
     * compensated by the offline range commit. Reporting it as a tail too
     * would make the engine flush a phantom decay after every apply.
     */
    @Override
    public int getTailFrames() {
        return 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            java.util.Arrays.fill(inHist[c], 0f);
            java.util.Arrays.fill(ola[c], 0f);
        }
        java.util.Arrays.fill(gainPrev, 1f);
        java.util.Arrays.fill(noiseEst, 0f);
        noiseInit = false;
        histFill = 0;
        outCount = 0;
        inputConsumed = 0L;
        genuinePopped = 0L;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    /** Installs (or clears with {@code null}) a learned noise power profile. */
    void setNoiseProfile(float[] p) {
        profile = (p != null && p.length == BINS) ? p : null;
    }

    float[] getNoiseProfile() {
        return profile;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        final float mix = getWetDryMix();
        if (amt.getCurrentRaw() <= 0 || mix <= 0.001f) return;

        ensureOutCapacity(outCount + frames + 2 * HOP);
        int off = 0;
        while (off < frames) {
            int take = Math.min(FFT_SIZE - histFill, frames - off);
            if (take > 0) {
                for (int f = 0; f < take; f++) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                        inHist[c][histFill + f] = buf[(off + f) * ch + c];
                    }
                }
                histFill += take;
                off += take;
                inputConsumed += take;
            }
            if (histFill < FFT_SIZE) continue;

            processFrame(ch, mix);

            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                System.arraycopy(inHist[c], HOP, inHist[c], 0,
                        FFT_SIZE - HOP);
            }
            histFill = FFT_SIZE - HOP;
        }

        long ready = Math.max(0L, inputConsumed - FFT_SIZE);
        int readyInQueue = (int) Math.min(outCount,
                Math.max(0L, ready - genuinePopped));
        int give = Math.min(frames, readyInQueue);
        for (int f = 0; f < give; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                buf[f * ch + c] = outQ[c][f];
            }
        }
        for (int f = give; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                buf[f * ch + c] = 0f;
            }
        }
        genuinePopped += give;
        if (give > 0) {
            int left = outCount - give;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                System.arraycopy(outQ[c], give, outQ[c], 0, left);
            }
            outCount = left;
        }
    }

    private void processFrame(int ch, float mix) {
        final float amt01 = amt.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        final float smooth01 = smooth.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        final float overSub = 1f + 2f * amt01;
        final float floorGain = Dsp.dbToLin(-(6.0 + 24.0 * amt01));
        final float floorSq = floorGain * floorGain;
        final float[] prof = profile;

        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            java.util.Arrays.fill(im[c], 0f);
            for (int n = 0; n < FFT_SIZE; n++) {
                re[c][n] = inHist[c][n] * WINDOW[n];
            }
            Dsp.fft(re[c], im[c], false);
        }

        for (int k = 0; k <= BINS - 1; k++) {
            float pow = 0f;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                pow += re[c][k] * re[c][k] + im[c][k] * im[c][k];
            }
            pow /= ch;

            float pn;
            if (prof != null) {
                pn = Math.max(POWER_FLOOR, prof[k]);
            } else {
                if (!noiseInit) {
                    noiseEst[k] = Math.max(POWER_FLOOR, pow);
                } else {
                    // Symmetric slow tracker: converged on stationary noise it
                    // sits at the mean bin power, which is exactly what the
                    // subtraction expects (a minimum tracker would bias far
                    // below the mean and leave the noise almost untouched).
                    float track = 0.01f + 0.04f * smooth01;
                    noiseEst[k] += track * (pow - noiseEst[k]);
                    if (noiseEst[k] < POWER_FLOOR) noiseEst[k] = POWER_FLOOR;
                }
                pn = Math.max(POWER_FLOOR, noiseEst[k]);
            }

            float snr = pow / pn;
            float g2 = 1f - overSub / Math.max(snr, 1e-6f);
            float g = (float) Math.sqrt(Math.max(g2, floorSq));
            g = Math.min(1f, g);

            float prev = gainPrev[k];
            float mem = g < prev ? (0.95f - 0.75f * smooth01)
                    : (0.55f + 0.40f * smooth01);
            float gOut = prev * mem + g * (1f - mem);
            gainPrev[k] = gOut;

            re[0][k] *= gOut;
            im[0][k] *= gOut;
            if (ch > 1) {
                re[1][k] *= gOut;
                im[1][k] *= gOut;
            }
            if (k > 0 && k < BINS - 1) {
                int m = FFT_SIZE - k;
                re[0][m] *= gOut;
                im[0][m] *= gOut;
                if (ch > 1) {
                    re[1][m] *= gOut;
                    im[1][m] *= gOut;
                }
            }
        }
        noiseInit = true;

        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            Dsp.fft(re[c], im[c], true);
            for (int n = 0; n < FFT_SIZE; n++) {
                ola[c][n] += re[c][n] * WINDOW[n] * OLA_SCALE;
            }
        }

        for (int n = 0; n < HOP; n++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float wet = ola[c][n];
                float dry = inHist[c][n];
                outQ[c][outCount + n] = mix * wet + (1f - mix) * dry;
            }
        }
        outCount += HOP;

        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            System.arraycopy(ola[c], HOP, ola[c], 0, FFT_SIZE - HOP);
            java.util.Arrays.fill(ola[c], FFT_SIZE - HOP, FFT_SIZE, 0f);
        }
    }

    private void ensureOutCapacity(int capacity) {
        if (outQ[0].length >= capacity) return;
        float[][] grown = {new float[capacity], new float[capacity]};
        if (outCount > 0) {
            System.arraycopy(outQ[0], 0, grown[0], 0, outCount);
            System.arraycopy(outQ[1], 0, grown[1], 0, outCount);
        }
        outQ = grown;
    }

    /**
     * Learns a per-bin noise power profile from interleaved samples of a
     * noise-only selection. Returns {@code null} when the selection is too
     * short for one full analysis frame.
     */
    static float[] learnProfile(float[] interleaved, int channels) {
        if (interleaved == null || interleaved.length == 0) return null;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int totalFrames = interleaved.length / ch;
        if (totalFrames < FFT_SIZE) return null;

        float[] acc = new float[BINS];
        float[] re = new float[FFT_SIZE];
        float[] im = new float[FFT_SIZE];
        int frameCount = 0;
        for (int start = 0; start + FFT_SIZE <= totalFrames; start += HOP) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                java.util.Arrays.fill(im, 0f);
                for (int n = 0; n < FFT_SIZE; n++) {
                    re[n] = interleaved[(start + n) * ch + c] * WINDOW[n];
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, false);
                for (int k = 0; k < BINS; k++) {
                    acc[k] += re[k] * re[k] + im[k] * im[k];
                }
            }
            frameCount++;
        }
        if (frameCount == 0) return null;

        float inv = 1f / (frameCount * ch);
        for (int k = 0; k < BINS; k++) {
            acc[k] = Math.max(POWER_FLOOR, acc[k] * inv);
        }
        float[] smoothProfile = new float[BINS];
        smoothProfile[0] = acc[0];
        smoothProfile[BINS - 1] = acc[BINS - 1];
        for (int k = 1; k < BINS - 1; k++) {
            smoothProfile[k] = (acc[k - 1] + 2f * acc[k] + acc[k + 1]) * 0.25f;
        }
        return smoothProfile;
    }

    static JSONArray profileToJson(float[] p) {
        JSONArray a = new JSONArray();
        if (p == null) return a;
        for (float v : p) {
            a.put(Math.round(Dsp.linToDb(v) * 10f));
        }
        return a;
    }

    static float[] profileFromJson(JSONArray a) {
        // Profiles are serialised through the same dB helpers by both
        // profiled effects, so accept the stored bin count instead of
        // assuming this processor's BINS (Spectral Noise Reduction learns a
        // 1024-point profile). The owning processor validates the length when
        // the profile is installed.
        if (a == null || a.length() == 0) return null;
        float[] p = new float[a.length()];
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length(); i++) {
            p[i] = Dsp.dbToLin(a.optInt(i, -1200) / 10.0);
        }
        return p;
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/NormalizeProcessor.java

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 level tool: peak / RMS normalization with DC-offset removal.
 *
 * <p>The offline pass measures the per-channel mean and peak of the range
 * (optionally removing the DC offset before measuring the peak), then the
 * render pass subtracts the offset and applies the exact gain. When the
 * stereo channels are linked the quieter channel dictates the gain so the
 * image stays balanced.
 */
final class NormalizeProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter target = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "norm_target", "Target Peak", -60f, 0f, -1f));
    private final FxParameter removeDc = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_dc", "Remove DC Offset", true));
    private final FxParameter normalizePeak = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_peak", "Normalize Peak", true));
    private final FxParameter independent = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_indep", "Independent Channels", false));
    private final FxParameter normalizeRms = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "norm_rms", "Normalize RMS", false));

    private float[] dcOffset = new float[2];
    private float[] gainLin = new float[]{1f, 1f};
    private boolean scanned = false;
    // Real-time fallback state (no pre-scan available).
    private float[] realtimePeak = new float[2];
    private float[] realtimeGain = new float[]{1f, 1f};
    private float[] dcState = new float[2];
    private float[] prevIn = new float[2];

    NormalizeProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "normalize";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Normalize";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Peak or RMS normalization with DC-offset removal";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        scanned = false;
        gainLin[0] = 1f;
        gainLin[1] = 1f;
        dcOffset[0] = 0f;
        dcOffset[1] = 0f;
        realtimePeak[0] = realtimePeak[1] = 0f;
        realtimeGain[0] = realtimeGain[1] = 1f;
        dcState[0] = dcState[1] = 0f;
        prevIn[0] = prevIn[1] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(java.io.File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (raw == null) return;
        float[] sel = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        if (sel == null || sel.length == 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int frames = sel.length / ch;
        if (frames <= 0) return;

        double[] mean = new double[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) mean[c] += sel[f * ch + c];
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) mean[c] /= frames;

        float[] peak = new float[ch];
        double[] sumSq = new double[ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = sel[f * ch + c] - (float) mean[c];
                float a = Math.abs(v);
                if (a > peak[c]) peak[c] = a;
                sumSq[c] += (double) v * v;
            }
        }
        float[] rms = new float[ch];
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            rms[c] = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq[c] / frames);
        }

        float targetLin = Dsp.dbToLin(target.getFloat());
        float[] g = new float[ch];
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            if (normalizeRms.getBoolean()) {
                g[c] = rms[c] > 1e-9f ? targetLin / rms[c] : 1f;
            } else if (normalizePeak.getBoolean()) {
                g[c] = peak[c] > 1e-9f ? targetLin / peak[c] : 1f;
            } else {
                g[c] = 1f;
            }
        }
        if (!independent.getBoolean()) {
            float min = g[0];
            for (int c = 1; c < ch; c++) min = Math.min(min, g[c]);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) g[c] = min;
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
            gainLin[c] = g[c];
            dcOffset[c] = removeDc.getBoolean() ? (float) mean[c] : 0f;
        }
        scanned = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        if (!scanned) {
            // Compute exact DC offset, peak and RMS on the buffer when no
            // offline file pre-scan was run (e.g. unit matrix or live block).
            double[] mean = new double[ch];
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) mean[c] += buf[f * ch + c];
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) mean[c] /= frames;
            float[] peak = new float[ch];
            double[] sumSq = new double[ch];
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float v = buf[f * ch + c] - (float) mean[c];
                    float a = Math.abs(v);
                    if (a > peak[c]) peak[c] = a;
                    sumSq[c] += (double) v * v;
                }
            }
            float targetLin = Dsp.dbToLin(target.getFloat());
            float[] g = new float[ch];
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq[c] / frames);
                if (normalizeRms.getBoolean()) {
                    g[c] = rms > 1e-9f ? targetLin / rms : 1f;
                } else if (normalizePeak.getBoolean()) {
                    g[c] = peak[c] > 1e-9f ? targetLin / peak[c] : 1f;
                } else {
                    g[c] = 1f;
                }
            }
            if (!independent.getBoolean()) {
                float min = g[0];
                for (int c = 1; c < ch; c++) min = Math.min(min, g[c]);
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) g[c] = min;
            }
            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                int idx = f * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float dc = removeDc.getBoolean() ? (float) mean[c] : 0f;
                    buf[idx + c] = (buf[idx + c] - dc) * g[c];
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                float v = buf[idx + c] - dcOffset[c];
                buf[idx + c] = v * gainLin[c];
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Real-time fallback: tracks a decaying peak estimate per channel and
     * eases the gain towards {@code target / peak}. The DC offset is
     * removed with a one-pole high-pass so it works without a pre-scan.
     */
    private void runRealtime(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        float targetLin = Dsp.dbToLin(target.getFloat());
        final int block = 64;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] peak = new float[ch];
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float v = buf[(offset + f) * ch + c];
                    float a = Math.abs(v);
                    if (a > peak[c]) peak[c] = a;
                }
            }
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                // The peak estimate decays so a transient does not pin the
                // gain down for the rest of the take.
                realtimePeak[c] = Math.max(peak[c], realtimePeak[c] * 0.9995f);
                float target = realtimePeak[c] > 1e-6f
                        ? targetLin / realtimePeak[c] : 1f;
                if (!normalizePeak.getBoolean() && !normalizeRms.getBoolean()) {
                    target = 1f;
                }
                realtimeGain[c] += (target - realtimeGain[c]) * 0.05f;
            }
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float v = buf[idx + c];
                    // One-pole DC blocker.
                    dcState[c] = 0.995f * (dcState[c] + v - prevIn[c]);
                    prevIn[c] = v;
                    float out = removeDc.getBoolean() ? dcState[c] : v;
                    buf[idx + c] = out * realtimeGain[c];
                }
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 3 · surgical notch for hum (50/60 Hz) and resonances. RBJ notch
 * with an adjustable Q; deep null exactly at the tuned frequency.
 */
final class NotchFilterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] PRESET_LABELS = {"Custom", "50 Hz hum", "60 Hz hum"};

    private final FxParameter preset = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("preset", "Quick Pick", PRESET_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("freq", "Frequency", " Hz", 20, 20000, 1, 60));
    private final FxParameter q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("q", "Q", "", 0.1f, 30f, 5f));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 1;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "notch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Notch Filter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Surgical null for mains hum and ringing resonances";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sr, int ch) {
        sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sr);
        channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        this.channels = c;
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), c);
        filter.process(buf, frames, c);
    }

    /**
     * Applies the hum quick-picks when the frequency matches the preset, or
     * honours the user's explicit frequency dial if scrubbed away from 50/60 Hz.
     */
    float[][] buildSections() {
        int p = preset.getEnumIndex();
        double dialHz = freq.getFloat();
        double f;
        if (p == 1) {
            f = 50.0;
        } else if (p == 2) {
            f = 60.0;
        } else {
            f = dialHz;
        }
        return new float[][]{Dsp.rbjNotch(sampleRate, f, q.getFloat())};
    }
}
