/**
 * Centered modal dialogs (overlaying the current screen) replacing the old
 * bottom sheets. Sort options appear as distinct pills, rename is a centered
 * input modal, deletes ask for confirmation, and every success/failure gets
 * its own styled popup. All dialogs pop/scale in and out and cap their width
 * cleanly in landscape mode.
 */
public final class OptionsSheet {

    /** Maximum width in dp for standard centered dialogs (save/discard/confirm/etc.). */
    public static final int MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP = 380;
    /** Maximum width in dp for the 2-pane landscape Recording Settings dialog. */
    public static final int MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP = 620;

    private OptionsSheet() {}

    private static Dialog activeTopPopup;
    private static final Handler TOP_POPUP_HANDLER =
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    /**
     * Enforces at most two words on stylized top popup titles so banners
     * stay scannable at a glance.
     */
    static String compactTwoWords(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        String clean = text.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        String[] parts = clean.split(" ");
        if (parts.length <= 2) return clean;
        return parts[0] + " " + parts[1];
    }

    public static final class Item {
        public final int icon;
        public final String label;
        public final String sub;
        public final boolean destructive;
        public final boolean checked;
        public final Runnable action;

        public Item(int icon, String label, boolean destructive, boolean checked,
                    Runnable action) {
            this(icon, label, null, destructive, checked, action);
        }

        public Item(int icon, String label, String sub, boolean destructive,
                    boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            this.icon = icon;
            this.label = label;
            this.sub = sub;
            this.destructive = destructive;
            this.checked = checked;
            this.action = action;
        }

        public static Item of(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, false, false, action);
        }

        public static Item danger(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, true, false, action);
        }

        /** Two-line row: title + smaller spec line (presets, save formats). */
        public static Item detail(String label, String sub, boolean checked,
                                  Runnable action) {
            return new Item(0, label, sub, false, checked, action);
        }

        /** Two-line row with a leading icon. */
        public static Item detail(int icon, String label, String sub,
                                  boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, sub, false, checked, action);
        }
    }

    public static void showOptions(Context ctx, String title, String subtitle,
                                   List<Item> items) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_options, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle);
        titleView.setText(title);
        TextView subView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSubtitle);
        if (subtitle != null && !subtitle.isEmpty()) {
            subView.setText(subtitle);
            subView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        LinearLayout container = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogOptions);
        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(ctx);
        for (int i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
            final Item item = items.get(i);
            View pillWrap = new FrameLayout(ctx);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams wrapLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            if (i > 0) wrapLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
            pillWrap.setLayoutParams(wrapLp);

            View row = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_pill_row, (FrameLayout) pillWrap, false);
            row.setBackgroundResource(item.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            TextView label = row.findViewById(R.id.pillLabel);
            label.setText(item.label);
            if (item.destructive) {
                label.setTextColor(0xFFFF3B30);
            } else if (item.checked) {
                label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            }
            TextView sub = row.findViewById(R.id.pillSub);
            if (sub != null) {
                if (item.sub != null && !item.sub.isEmpty()) {
                    sub.setText(item.sub);
                    sub.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                } else {
                    sub.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                }
            }
            ImageView iconView = row.findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (item.icon != 0) {
                iconView.setImageResource(item.icon);
            } else {
                iconView.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_wave);
            }
            iconView.setAlpha(item.checked ? 1f : 0.8f);
            iconView.setColorFilter(item.destructive
                    ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFFF2F4F7);
            iconView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            ImageView check = row.findViewById(R.id.pillCheck);
            check.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
            check.setVisibility(item.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.96f).scaleY(0.96f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                    dialog.dismiss();
                    if (item.action != null) item.action.run();
                }).start();
            });
            ((FrameLayout) pillWrap).addView(row);
            container.addView(pillWrap);

            // Staggered entrance: each pill slides up + fades in.
            row.setAlpha(0f);
            row.setTranslationY(dp(ctx, 14));
            row.animate()
                    .alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setStartDelay(60 + i * 55L)
                    .setDuration(260)
                    .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
        }

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
    }

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams flp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        flp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
        formatPane.addView(formatHintView, flp);

        android.widget.GridLayout grid = new android.widget.GridLayout(ctx);
        grid.setColumnCount(3);
        grid.setUseDefaultMargins(false);
        formatPane.addView(grid, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        for (Chip chip : state.formats()) {
            final Chip c = chip;
            LinearLayout cell = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            cell.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            cell.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cell.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int hPad = dp(ctx, 5);
            int vPadCell = dp(ctx, isLand ? 6 : 7);
            cell.setPadding(hPad, vPadCell, hPad, vPadCell);
            cell.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 44));

            TextView name = new TextView(ctx);
            name.setText(c.label);
            name.setTextSize(isLand ? 11 : 12);
            name.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            name.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            name.setSingleLine(true);
            name.setEllipsize(android.text.TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
            cell.addView(name);

            TextView size = new TextView(ctx);
            size.setText(c.size);
            size.setTextSize(9.5f);
            size.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            size.setSingleLine(true);
            size.setAlpha(0.85f);
            cell.addView(size);

            android.widget.GridLayout.LayoutParams glp =
                    new android.widget.GridLayout.LayoutParams();
            glp.width = 0;
            glp.columnSpec = android.widget.GridLayout.spec(
                    android.widget.GridLayout.UNDEFINED, 1f);
            int m = dp(ctx, 3);
            glp.setMargins(m, m, m, m);
            cell.setLayoutParams(glp);
            grid.addView(cell);
            chipViews.add(cell);
            chipNames.add(name);
            chipSizes.add(size);
            PressAnim.apply(cell);
            cell.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (c.action != null) c.action.run();
                rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                        pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                        formatHintView);
            });
        }

        TextView done = new TextView(ctx);
        done.setText(doneLabel);
        done.setTextSize(14);
        done.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
        done.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        done.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        done.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        done.setMinHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 46));
        int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 9 : 12);
        done.setPadding(dp(ctx, 16), vPad, dp(ctx, 16), vPad);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams blp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        blp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 10 : 14);
        root.addView(done, blp);
        PressAnim.apply(done);
        done.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        dialog.setContentView(scroll);
        rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                formatHintView);
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog,
                isLand ? MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP : MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
        dialog.show();
    }

    private static TextView sectionLabel(Context ctx, String text, int topMarginDp) {
        TextView tv = new TextView(ctx);
        tv.setText(text);
        tv.setTextSize(10);
        tv.setLetterSpacing(0.1f);
        tv.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = dp(ctx, topMarginDp);
        tv.setLayoutParams(lp);
        return tv;
    }

    private static void rebindSettings(SettingsState state,
                                       java.util.List<View> pillRows,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> pillLabels,
                                       java.util.List<ImageView> pillChecks,
                                       java.util.List<Integer> pillColors,
                                       java.util.List<View> chipViews,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> chipNames,
                                       java.util.List<TextView> chipSizes,
                                       TextView hintView) {
        java.util.List<Item> presets;
        java.util.List<Chip> formats;
        try {
            presets = state.presets();
            formats = state.formats();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pillRows.size() && i < presets.size(); i++) {
            Item it = presets.get(i);
            pillRows.get(i).setBackgroundResource(it.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            pillLabels.get(i).setTextColor(it.checked
                    ? 0xFFF2F4F7 : pillColors.get(i));
            pillChecks.get(i).setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
            pillChecks.get(i).setVisibility(
                    it.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
            ImageView dot = pillRows.get(i).findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (dot != null) dot.setColorFilter(it.icon != 0
                    ? (it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF9AA4B2)
                    : (it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < chipViews.size() && i < formats.size(); i++) {
            Chip c = formats.get(i);
            chipViews.get(i).setBackgroundResource(c.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int col = c.checked ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF;
            chipNames.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setText(c.size);
            chipNames.get(i).setText(c.label);
        }
        try {
            hintView.setText(state.formatHint());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- centered rename / input modal ----

    public static void showInput(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                 String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback) {
        showInputInternal(ctx, title, initial, saveLabel, callback, null, false);
    }

    private static void showInputInternal(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                          String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback,
                                          Runnable onCancel, boolean allowSame) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_input, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        EditText input = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogInput);
        TextView error = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogError);
        input.setText(initial == null ? "" : initial);
        input.setHint(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_hint));
        try {
            input.setSelection(input.getText().length());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView save = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSave);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        save.setText(saveLabel);
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(save);

        final boolean[] settled = {false};
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
        });
        try {
            dialog.setOnCancelListener(d -> {
                if (!settled[0] && onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        save.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String text = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (text.isEmpty()) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_empty_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            if (!allowSame && text.equals(initial != null ? initial.trim() : "")) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_same_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (callback != null) callback.onSave(text);
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        if (dialog.getWindow() != null) {
            dialog.getWindow().setSoftInputMode(
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                            | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
        }
        dialog.show();
        input.post(() -> {
            input.requestFocus();
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.showSoftInput(input, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT);
        });
    }

    // ---- confirm delete modal ----

    public static void showConfirm(Context ctx, String title, String message,
                                   String confirmLabel, boolean danger,
                                   Runnable onConfirm) {
        showConfirm(ctx, title, message, confirmLabel,
                danger ? R.drawable.ic_trash : R.drawable.ic_check, danger, onConfirm);
    }

    public static void showConfirm(Context ctx, String title, String message,
                                   String confirmLabel, int iconRes,
                                   boolean danger, Runnable onConfirm) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_confirm, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogMessage)).setText(message);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon);
        icon.setImageResource(iconRes);
        View iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() instanceof View
                ? (View) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() : null;

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView confirm = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogConfirm);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        confirm.setText(confirmLabel);
        if (danger) {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
            confirm.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        } else {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        }
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(confirm);

        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());
        confirm.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            v.animate().scaleX(0.94f).scaleY(0.94f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                if (onConfirm != null) onConfirm.run();
            }).start();
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        if (iconBg != null) PressAnim.pop(iconBg);
    }

    // ---- success / failure result popup ----

    public static void showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message) {
        showResult(ctx, success, title, message, null);
    }

    /** @return the shown dialog, so callers/tests can drive or dismiss it. */
    public static android.app.Dialog showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message,
                                  Runnable onOk) {
        if (activeTopPopup != null) {
            try {
                if (activeTopPopup.isShowing()) activeTopPopup.dismiss();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            activeTopPopup = null;
        }
        TOP_POPUP_HANDLER.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);

        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_result, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        FrameLayout iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIconBg);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIcon);
        iconBg.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_icon_danger);
        icon.setImageResource(success ? R.drawable.ic_check : R.drawable.ic_close);
        icon.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle))
                .setText(compactTwoWords(title));
        TextView msg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultMessage);
        if (msg != null) {
            msg.setText("");
            msg.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
        TextView ok = root.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        if (ok != null) {
            ok.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        final boolean[] fired = {false};
        final Runnable fire = () -> {
            if (fired[0]) return;
            fired[0] = true;
            if (onOk != null) {
                try {
                    onOk.run();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        };
        if (ok != null) {
            ok.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                fire.run();
            });
        }
        root.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            dialog.dismiss();
            fire.run();
        });
        dialog.setOnDismissListener(dd -> {
            if (activeTopPopup == dialog) activeTopPopup = null;
            fire.run();
        });

        dialog.setCancelable(true);
        styleAsTopPopup(dialog);
        activeTopPopup = dialog;
        dialog.show();
        styleAsTopPopup(dialog);
        root.setTranslationY(-dp(ctx, 24));
        root.setAlpha(0f);
        root.animate()
                .translationY(0f)
                .alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(220)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .start();
        PressAnim.pop(iconBg);

        TOP_POPUP_HANDLER.postDelayed(() -> {
            try {
                if (dialog.isShowing()) dialog.dismiss();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }, 1600L);
        return dialog;
    }

    /** Lightweight, non-blocking 2-word confirmation banner at the top. */
    public static void showTopPopup(Context ctx, String title, String ignoredMessage) {
        showResult(ctx, true, compactTwoWords(title), null, null);
    }

    public static void showTopPopup(Context ctx, String twoWordTitle) {
        showResult(ctx, true, compactTwoWords(twoWordTitle), null, null);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    /**
     * Anchors a dialog at the top edge as a floating banner: no dim, no
     * outside-touch blocking, full width with a small inset.
     */
    public static void styleAsTopPopup(Dialog dialog) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND);
        w.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL);
        w.setDimAmount(0f);
        w.setGravity(Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);
        w.setWindowAnimations(R.style.TopPopupAnim);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        lp.width = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL;
        lp.x = 0;
        lp.y = dp(ctx, 16);
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) decor.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    public static void styleAsCentered(Dialog dialog) {
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog, MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
    }

    public static void styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(Dialog dialog, int maxWidthDp) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        DisplayMetrics dm = ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        boolean isLand = dm.widthPixels > dm.heightPixels;
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.setDimAmount(0.62f);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        int cappedDp = Math.min(maxWidthDp, isLand ? 380 : 330);
        int maxW = dp(ctx, cappedDp);
        lp.width = Math.min(Math.round(dm.widthPixels * 0.84f), maxW);
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.CENTER;
        lp.horizontalMargin = 0f;
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) {
            int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 8 : 16);
            decor.setPadding(0, vPad, 0, vPad);
        }
    }

    private static void hideKeyboard(Context ctx, View v) {
        try {
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(v.getWindowToken(), 0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void shake(View v) {
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate()
                .translationX(14f).setDuration(55)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(-12f).setDuration(55)
                        .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(8f).setDuration(55)
                                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(0f)
                                        .setDuration(80).start()).start()).start())
                .start();
    }

    private static int dp(Context ctx, int dp) {
        return Math.round(dp * ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Stage 3 · A1: Fairlight-style 6-band parametric EQ. Band 1 is a low cut
 * (12/24/36/48 dB per octave), bands 2 and 5 switch between bell and shelf,
 * bands 3 and 4 are bells, band 6 is a high cut. Every knob drives a
 * recomputed biquad cascade; the primary "Output" knob is the rack dial.
 */
final class ParametricEq6BandProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] CUT_LABELS = {
            "12 dB/oct", "24 dB/oct", "36 dB/oct", "48 dB/oct"};
    private static final String[] SHELF_LABELS = {"Bell", "Shelf"};

    private final FxParameter out = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("out", "Output", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b1f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b1f", "Low Cut", " Hz", 20, 500, 1, 80));
    private final FxParameter b1s = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("b1s", "Low Cut Slope", CUT_LABELS, 1));
    private final FxParameter b2t = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("b2t", "Band 2 Type", SHELF_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter b2f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b2f", "Band 2 Freq", " Hz", 40, 1000, 1, 350));
    private final FxParameter b2g = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("b2g", "Band 2 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b2q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("b2q", "Band 2 Q", "", 0.1f, 12f, 0.7f));
    private final FxParameter b3f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b3f", "Band 3 Freq", " Hz", 100, 2000, 1, 800));
    private final FxParameter b3g = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("b3g", "Band 3 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b3q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("b3q", "Band 3 Q", "", 0.1f, 12f, 0.7f));
    private final FxParameter b4f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b4f", "Band 4 Freq", " Hz", 500, 8000, 1, 2500));
    private final FxParameter b4g = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("b4g", "Band 4 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b4q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("b4q", "Band 4 Q", "", 0.1f, 12f, 0.7f));
    private final FxParameter b5t = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("b5t", "Band 5 Type", SHELF_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter b5f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b5f", "Band 5 Freq", " Hz", 1000, 16000, 1, 6500));
    private final FxParameter b5g = addParameter(
            FxParameter.dbParam("b5g", "Band 5 Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter b5q = addParameter(
            FxParameter.floatParam("b5q", "Band 5 Q", "", 0.1f, 12f, 0.7f));
    private final FxParameter b6f = addParameter(
            FxParameter.intParam("b6f", "High Cut", " Hz", 4000, 20000, 1, 20000));
    private final FxParameter b6s = addParameter(
            FxParameter.enumParam("b6s", "High Cut Slope", CUT_LABELS, 1));

    private final BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 1;

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "eq6";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "6-Band Parametric EQ";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Console EQ: low/high cut plus four musical bell/shelf bands";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sr, int ch) {
        sampleRate = Math.max(8000, sr);
        channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        filter.reset();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        if (!isEnabled()) return false;
        return b1f.getCurrentRaw() > 20 || b6f.getCurrentRaw() < 20000
                || out.getCurrentRaw() != 0
                || Math.abs(b2g.getFloat()) >= 0.01f
                || Math.abs(b3g.getFloat()) >= 0.01f
                || Math.abs(b4g.getFloat()) >= 0.01f
                || Math.abs(b5g.getFloat()) >= 0.01f;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int c = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, ch));
        this.channels = c;
        filter.setSections(buildSections(), c);
        filter.process(buf, frames, c);
    }

    private static final float[] IDENTITY = {1f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f};
    private static final int LOW_SLOTS = 8;
    private static final int HIGH_SLOTS = 8;

    /** Cascade with fixed slots so changing a band never shifts biquad state. */
    float[][] buildSections() {
        // Keep the public design view empty while every band/output is flat;
        // the chain skips an inaudible processor, so no delay lines exist to
        // preserve. As soon as any stage is audible the fixed-slot layout is
        // returned, which is what keeps live band edits from shifting state.
        if (!isAudible()) return new float[0][];
        double sr = sampleRate;
        float[][] secs = new float[LOW_SLOTS + 4 + HIGH_SLOTS + 1][];
        int lowN = b1f.getCurrentRaw() > 20
                ? orderForSlope(b1s.getEnumIndex()) : 0;
        float[][] low = lowN > 0
                ? Dsp.butterworth(lowN, sr, b1f.getFloat(), true)
                : new float[0][];
        for (int i = 0; i < LOW_SLOTS; i++) {
            secs[i] = i < low.length ? low[i] : IDENTITY;
        }
        secs[LOW_SLOTS] = bandSection(b2t.getEnumIndex() == 1, false,
                b2f.getFloat(), b2g.getFloat(), b2q.getFloat());
        secs[LOW_SLOTS + 1] = bandSection(false, false,
                b3f.getFloat(), b3g.getFloat(), b3q.getFloat());
        secs[LOW_SLOTS + 2] = bandSection(false, false,
                b4f.getFloat(), b4g.getFloat(), b4q.getFloat());
        secs[LOW_SLOTS + 3] = bandSection(b5t.getEnumIndex() == 1, true,
                b5f.getFloat(), b5g.getFloat(), b5q.getFloat());
        int highOff = LOW_SLOTS + 4;
        int highN = b6f.getCurrentRaw() < 20000
                ? orderForSlope(b6s.getEnumIndex()) : 0;
        float[][] high = highN > 0
                ? Dsp.butterworth(highN, sr, b6f.getFloat(), false)
                : new float[0][];
        for (int i = 0; i < HIGH_SLOTS; i++) {
            secs[highOff + i] = i < high.length ? high[i] : IDENTITY;
        }
        secs[highOff + HIGH_SLOTS] = Dsp.gainBiquad(Dsp.dbToLin(out.getFloat()));
        return secs;
    }

    private float[] bandSection(boolean shelf, boolean highShelf,
                                double f, double g, double q) {
        if (Math.abs(g) < 0.01) return IDENTITY;
        if (shelf) {
            return highShelf ? Dsp.rbjHighShelf(sampleRate, f, 1.0, g)
                    : Dsp.rbjLowShelf(sampleRate, f, 1.0, g);
        }
        return Dsp.rbjPeaking(sampleRate, f, q, g);
    }

    private static int orderForSlope(int slopeIndex) {
        switch (slopeIndex) {
            case 0: return 2;
            case 1: return 4;
            case 2: return 6;
            default: return 8;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.view.MotionEvent;

/**
 * Interactive canvas for the 6-band parametric EQ. All six bands have a
 * draggable handle: bands 2-5 move in both frequency and gain, while the
 * low-cut (band 1) and high-cut (band 6) handles move horizontally to set
 * their corner frequency. The graph therefore always exposes six band
 * handles, not only the four bell/shelf bands.
 */
final class ParametricEqView extends EqCurveView {

    private static final String[] FREQ_IDS = {
            "b1f", "b2f", "b3f", "b4f", "b5f", "b6f"};
    /** Null for bands 1 and 6, which are cuts without a gain parameter. */
    private static final String[] GAIN_IDS = {
            null, "b2g", "b3g", "b4g", "b5g", null};

    private final ParametricEq6BandProcessor scratch;
    private int active = -1;

    ParametricEqView(Context ctx, DspChain.EffectSlot slot, Runnable onMutated) {
        super(ctx, slot, 18f, onMutated);
        AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor("eq6");
        scratch = (ParametricEq6BandProcessor) p;
        scratch.prepare(DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE, 2);
        syncFromSlot();
    }

    @Override
    protected void syncFromSlot() {
        for (FxParameter param : scratch.getParameters()) {
            int raw = "out".equals(param.id)
                    ? slot.value
                    : extra(param.id, param.defaultRaw);
            param.setCurrentRaw(param.clampRaw(raw));
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected float responseDb(float f) {
        return (float) Dsp.cascadeMagDb(scratch.buildSections(), f,
                DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE);
    }

    private FxParameter param(String id) {
        for (FxParameter p : scratch.getParameters()) {
            if (p.id.equals(id)) return p;
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDrawHandles(Canvas canvas, int w, int h) {
        float zero = yForDb(0, h);
        for (int i = 0; i < FREQ_IDS.length; i++) {
            FxParameter fq = param(FREQ_IDS[i]);
            if (fq == null) continue;
            float x = xForFreq(fq.getCurrentRaw(), w);
            boolean cut = GAIN_IDS[i] == null;
            float y = zero;
            if (!cut) {
                FxParameter gn = param(GAIN_IDS[i]);
                if (gn == null) continue;
                y = yForDb(gn.getCurrentRaw() / 100f, h);
            }
            if (i == active) {
                handle.setColor(0xFF4EA1FF);
            } else if (cut) {
                handle.setColor(0xFFFFB020);
            } else {
                handle.setColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            }
            float radius = cut ? 8 * density : 7 * density;
            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, radius, handle);
            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, 3 * density, grid);
            if (cut) {
                String num = i == 0 ? "1" : "6";
                label.setColor(0xFF0B0D10);
                label.setTextAlign(android.graphics.Paint.Align.CENTER);
                label.setTextSize(9 * density);
                canvas.drawText(num, x, y + 3 * density, label);
            }
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent e) {
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        switch (e.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN: {
                syncFromSlot();
                active = nearestHandle(e.getX(), e.getY(), w, h);
                if (active >= 0) {
                    disallowParentIntercept(true);
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                if (active < 0) return false;
                FxParameter fq = param(FREQ_IDS[active]);
                if (fq == null) return false;
                int freq = Math.round(freqForX(e.getX(), w));
                fq.setCurrentRaw(fq.clampRaw(freq));
                putExtra(FREQ_IDS[active], fq.getCurrentRaw());
                String gainId = GAIN_IDS[active];
                if (gainId != null) {
                    FxParameter gn = param(gainId);
                    if (gn != null) {
                        int gain = Math.round(dbForY(e.getY(), h) * 100f);
                        gn.setCurrentRaw(gn.clampRaw(gain));
                        putExtra(gainId, gn.getCurrentRaw());
                    }
                }
                if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
                onMutated.run();
                invalidate();
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL: {
                if (active < 0) return false;
                disallowParentIntercept(false);
                commitActive(active);
                active = -1;
                invalidate();
                return true;
            }
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    private int nearestHandle(float x, float y, int w, int h) {
        int best = -1;
        float bestD = 30 * density;
        float zero = yForDb(0, h);
        for (int i = 0; i < FREQ_IDS.length; i++) {
            FxParameter fq = param(FREQ_IDS[i]);
            if (fq == null) continue;
            float hx = xForFreq(fq.getCurrentRaw(), w);
            float hy = zero;
            String gainId = GAIN_IDS[i];
            if (gainId != null) {
                FxParameter gn = param(gainId);
                if (gn == null) continue;
                hy = yForDb(gn.getCurrentRaw() / 100f, h);
            }
            float d = (float) Math.hypot(hx - x, hy - y);
            if (d < bestD) {
                bestD = d;
                best = i;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private void commitActive(int idx) {
        if (idx >= 0 && idx < FREQ_IDS.length) {
            FxParameter fq = param(FREQ_IDS[idx]);
            if (fq != null) {
                putExtra(FREQ_IDS[idx], fq.getCurrentRaw());
            }
            String gainId = GAIN_IDS[idx];
            if (gainId != null) {
                FxParameter gn = param(gainId);
                if (gn != null) putExtra(gainId, gn.getCurrentRaw());
            }
        }
        if (!slot.enabled) slot.enabled = true;
        onMutated.run();
    }

    /** Number of draggable band handles exposed by the canvas (six). */
    static int bandCount() {
        return FREQ_IDS.length;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 Paulstretch: extreme ambient time stretching. A large-window STFT
 * preserves the bin amplitudes but replaces the phases with random angles
 * at every synthesis hop, then blends the frames with a
 * {@code (1 - x^2)^1.25} raised-cosine overlap.
 */
final class PaulstretchProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter factor = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "paul_factor", "Stretch Factor", "x", 1.5f, 100f, 8f));
    private final FxParameter resolution = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "paul_res", "Time Resolution", " s", 0.05f, 1f, 0.25f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private long rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;

    PaulstretchProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "paulstretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Paulstretch";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Extreme random-phase ambient time stretch";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TIME;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        rng = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15L;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && factor.getFloat() > 1.01f;
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        double stretch = factor.getFloat();
        if (Math.abs(stretch - 1.0) < 1e-6) return in.clone();

        int targetWin = Math.max(512, (int) Math.round(resolution.getFloat() * sampleRate));
        int fftSize = 1024;
        while (fftSize < targetWin && fftSize < 8192) fftSize <<= 1;
        int outHop = fftSize / 2;
        double inStep = outHop / Math.max(0.1, stretch);
        int outFrames = Math.max(1, (int) Math.round(frames * stretch));
        float[] out = new float[outFrames * channels];
        float[] win = new float[fftSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
            float x = (2.0f * i / (fftSize - 1)) - 1.0f;
            win[i] = (float) Math.pow(Math.max(0.0, 1.0 - x * x), 1.25);
        }

        int bins = fftSize / 2 + 1;
        float[] re = new float[fftSize];
        float[] im = new float[fftSize];
        float[] mag = new float[bins];

        for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
            double inPos = 0.0;
            int outPos = 0;
            while (outPos < outFrames) {
                int baseIn = (int) Math.round(inPos);
                for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
                    int src = baseIn + i;
                    float s = (src >= 0 && src < frames) ? in[src * channels + c] : 0f;
                    re[i] = s * win[i];
                    im[i] = 0f;
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, false);
                for (int b = 0; b < bins; b++) {
                    mag[b] = (float) Math.sqrt(re[b] * re[b] + im[b] * im[b]);
                }
                for (int b = 0; b < bins; b++) {
                    float p = (float) (nextRandom() * Math.PI * 2.0);
                    re[b] = (float) (mag[b] * Math.cos(p));
                    im[b] = (float) (mag[b] * Math.sin(p));
                    int mirror = fftSize - b;
                    if (mirror < fftSize) {
                        re[mirror] = re[b];
                        im[mirror] = -im[b];
                    }
                }
                Dsp.fft(re, im, true);
                for (int i = 0; i < fftSize && outPos + i < outFrames; i++) {
                    out[(outPos + i) * channels + c] += re[i] * win[i] * 0.85f;
                }
                inPos += inStep;
                outPos += outHop;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private double nextRandom() {
        rng = rng * 6364136223846793005L + 1442695040888963407L;
        int bits = (int) ((rng >>> 33) & 0x7FFFFFFF);
        return bits / (double) 0x7FFFFFFF;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 multi-stage all-pass phaser with an LFO sweep, feedback and an
 * output gain trim.
 */
final class PhaserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int[] STAGE_OPTIONS = {2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 24};

    private final FxParameter stages = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "ph_stages", "Stages", new String[]{"2", "4", "6", "8", "10", "12",
                    "16", "24"}, 1));
    private final FxParameter mix = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_mix", "Dry/Wet", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "ph_rate", "LFO Frequency", " Hz", 0.05f, 4f, 0.4f));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_phase", "LFO Start Phase", " deg", 0, 355, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 1, 70));
    private final FxParameter feedback = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "ph_fb", "Feedback", "%", -95, 95, 1, 30));
    private final FxParameter outputGain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "ph_gain", "Output Gain", -18f, 18f, 0f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private final float[][] stageState = new float[2][24];
    private double lfoPhase = 0;
    private final float[] fbState = new float[2];

    PhaserProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "phaser";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Phaser";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Multi-stage all-pass phaser with LFO and feedback";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            java.util.Arrays.fill(stageState[c], 0f);
            fbState[c] = 0f;
        }
        lfoPhase = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && mix.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int n = STAGE_OPTIONS[Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGE_OPTIONS.length - 1,
                stages.getEnumIndex()))];
        float wet = mix.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float dry = 1f - wet;
        double rateHz = rate.getFloat();
        double depthPct = depth.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0;
        double fb = feedback.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0;
        double phase0 = phase.getCurrentRaw() / 360.0;
        float gain = Dsp.dbToLin(outputGain.getFloat());
        double lfoInc = rateHz / sampleRate;

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            double sweep = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (lfoPhase + phase0));
            double freq = 200.0 + sweep * depthPct * 4000.0;
            double tanA = Math.tan(Math.PI * freq / sampleRate);
            double coef = (1.0 - tanA) / (1.0 + tanA);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                int idx = f * ch + c;
                float drySample = buf[idx];
                float out = drySample + fbState[c];
                float ap = (float) coef;
                for (int s = 0; s < n; s++) {
                    float t = ap * out + stageState[c][s];
                    stageState[c][s] = out - ap * t;
                    out = t;
                }
                fbState[c] = out * (float) fb;
                buf[idx] = (drySample * dry + out * wet) * gain;
            }
            lfoPhase += lfoInc;
            if (lfoPhase > 1.0) lfoPhase -= 1.0;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 5 plosive and breath suppressor: a dynamic low-shelf filter that
 * only engages when the sub-140 Hz energy exceeds the mid-band vowel
 * energy, so chest voice stays intact while 'P' and 'B' mic blasts are
 * tamed.
 */
final class PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter sensitivity = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "plosive_sens", "Plosive Cut Sensitivity", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter breath = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "plosive_breath", "Breath Attenuation", 0f, 24f, 8f));
    private final FxParameter lowFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "plosive_freq", "Plosive Band", " Hz", 60, 200, 10, 120));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int channels = 2;
    private BiquadFilter lowBand = new BiquadFilter();
    private BiquadFilter midBand = new BiquadFilter();
    private float gainDb = 0f;

    PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "plosive";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Plosive & Breath Suppressor";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Dynamic sub-140 Hz plosive tamer with breath attenuation";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        this.channels = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lowBand.reset();
        midBand.reset();
        gainDb = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (sensitivity.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                || breath.getFloat() > 0.01f);
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        float f = lowFreq.getCurrentRaw();
        lowBand.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjLowPass(sampleRate, f, 0.7071)},
                channels);
        midBand.setSections(new float[][]{Dsp.rbjBandPass(sampleRate, 1000, 1.0f)},
                channels);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        rebuild();
        float sens = sensitivity.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        float breathDb = breath.getFloat();

        final int block = 64;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int n = Math.min(block, frames - offset);
            float[] low = new float[n * ch];
            float[] mid = new float[n * ch];
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, low, 0, low.length);
            System.arraycopy(buf, offset * ch, mid, 0, mid.length);
            lowBand.process(low, n, ch);
            midBand.process(mid, n, ch);
            double lowE = 0;
            double midE = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n * ch; i++) {
                lowE += (double) low[i] * low[i];
                midE += (double) mid[i] * mid[i];
            }
            float lowDb = Dsp.linToDb((float) Math.sqrt(lowE / (n * ch)));
            float midDb = Dsp.linToDb((float) Math.sqrt(midE / (n * ch)));

            float target = 0f;
            float excess = lowDb - midDb - 4f;
            if (excess > 0f) {
                target = -Math.min(24f, excess) * sens;
            }
            boolean isBreath = breathDb > 0.01f && midDb < -42f && lowDb < -36f;
            float breathLin = isBreath ? Dsp.dbToLin(-breathDb) : 1f;
            float step = (target - gainDb) / n;
            for (int f = 0; f < n; f++) {
                gainDb += step;
                float g = Dsp.dbToLin(gainDb);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    int local = f * ch + c;
                    float high = buf[idx + c] - low[local];
                    buf[idx + c] = (high + low[local] * g) * breathLin;
                }
            }
            offset += n;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Stage 7 spectrum analyser: computes a Welch periodogram over a region and
 * reports the dominant peak frequency together with the nearest musical
 * note.
 *
 * <p>The analysis is pure maths (no Android dependency) so it can be unit
 * tested; the dialog that presents it lives in the studio UI.
 */
final class PlotSpectrumDialog {

    private PlotSpectrumDialog() {}

    /** Result of a spectrum analysis. */
    static final class Result {
        /** Average power per bin (length fftSize / 2 + 1). */
        final float[] power;
        final int fftSize;
        final int sampleRate;
        /** Frequency of the strongest bin in Hz. */
        final float peakHz;
        /** The strongest bin's magnitude in dBFS. */
        final float peakDb;
        /** Nearest equal-tempered note name, e.g. "A4". */
        final String peakNote;
        /** True when the peak bin is close enough to the note to name it. */
        final boolean noteIsClose;

        Result(float[] power, int fftSize, int sampleRate, float peakHz,
               float peakDb, String peakNote, boolean noteIsClose) {
            this.power = power;
            this.fftSize = fftSize;
            this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
            this.peakHz = peakHz;
            this.peakDb = peakDb;
            this.peakNote = peakNote;
            this.noteIsClose = noteIsClose;
        }
    }

    /** Analyses the given interleaved region. */
    static Result analyze(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, int sampleRate,
                          int fftSize) {
        int n = Math.max(64, Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(64, fftSize)));
        float[] power = StftProcessor.welchSpectrum(buf, frames, channels, n, 1f);
        int peakBin = 0;
        float peak = 0f;
        for (int b = 1; b < power.length; b++) {
            if (power[b] > peak) {
                peak = power[b];
                peakBin = b;
            }
        }
        float hz = peakBin * (float) sampleRate / n;
        float db = Dsp.linToDb((float) Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.0, peak)));
        String[] noteInfo = nearestNote(hz);
        return new Result(power, n, sampleRate, hz, db, noteInfo[0],
                Boolean.parseBoolean(noteInfo[1]));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the nearest equal-tempered note name and whether the input is
     * within 25 cents of it.
     */
    static String[] nearestNote(float hz) {
        if (hz <= 0f) return new String[]{"—", "false"};
        // MIDI note number: A4 (440 Hz) is note 69.
        double midi = 12.0 * (Math.log(hz / 440.0) / Math.log(2.0)) + 69.0;
        int rounded = (int) Math.round(midi);
        double cents = (midi - rounded) * 100.0;
        int index = ((rounded % 12) + 12) % 12;
        int octave = rounded / 12 - 1;
        String name = NOTE_NAMES[index] + octave;
        boolean close = Math.abs(cents) <= 25.0;
        return new String[]{name, String.valueOf(close)};
    }

    /** Equal-tempered note names, index 0 = C. */
    private static final String[] NOTE_NAMES = {"C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F",
            "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"};

    /** Human-readable summary used by the studio dialog. */
    static String summarize(Result r) {
        return String.format(Locale.US,
                "Peak: %.1f Hz (%s) • %.1f dBFS • FFT %d @ %d Hz",
                r.peakHz, r.peakNote, r.peakDb, r.fftSize, r.sampleRate);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.PathInterpolator;

/**
 * Restrained press feedback for every tappable view.
 *
 * The effect is deliberately shallow — a small scale dip plus a barely-there
 * alpha change — and every transition runs on a falloff curve so the motion
 * decays quickly instead of flashing. Nothing here changes layout, so it can
 * safely coexist with the selection scale driven by the adapter.
 */
public final class PressAnim {

    /** Fast lift-off, long settle: the "falloff" easing used on release. */
    private static final PathInterpolator FALLOFF =
            new PathInterpolator(0.2f, 0f, 0f, 1f);
    /** Opposite curve for pressing in: moves a little, then eases. */
    private static final PathInterpolator SETTLE_IN =
            new PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0f, 0.6f, 1f);

    private PressAnim() {}

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void apply(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    // A disabled or non-clickable chip must not give press
                    // feedback: that is what made disabled actions look tappable.
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(0.97f).scaleY(0.97f)
                            .alpha(0.9f)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .alpha(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false; // let click listeners still fire
        });
    }

    public static void applyAll(View... views) {
        if (views == null) return;
        for (View v : views) apply(v);
    }

    /**
     * Gentler variant for elements that already have their own emphasis
     * (icons, chips): scales a touch and never dips alpha, so there is no
     * visible flash — just a soft give.
     */
    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void applySoft(View v, final float pressedScale) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(pressedScale).scaleY(pressedScale)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Small confirmation pop for icons — a light nudge on the same falloff
     * curve. Used instead of a hard overshoot so nothing flashes.
     */
    public static void nudge(View v, float peak) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate().scaleX(peak).scaleY(peak)
                .setDuration(90).setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate()
                        .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(260).setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN).start())
                .start();
    }

    /** One-shot entrance pop used for dialog icons. */
    public static void pop(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setScaleX(0.6f);
        v.setScaleY(0.6f);
        v.setAlpha(0f);
        v.animate()
                .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(280)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional compressor / leveler: stereo-linked RMS + peak detection,
 * soft-knee gain computer, auto makeup and independent attack/release.
 * The primary "Compression" control keeps the legacy threshold curve so old
 * presets still sit at the same operating point; Ratio and Knee refine it.
 */
final class ProCompressorProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int BLOCK = 16;

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "amt", "Compression", "%", 0, 100, 1, 40));
    private final FxParameter ratio = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "comp_ratio", "Ratio", ":1", 1.0f, 12.0f, 6.0f));
    private final FxParameter attack = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "comp_attack", "Attack", " ms", 1, 100, 1, 10));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "comp_release", "Release", " ms", 40, 600, 5, 160));
    private final FxParameter knee = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "comp_knee", "Knee", " dB", 0, 18, 1, 6));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float envDb = -120f;
    private float gainCur = 1f;

    ProCompressorProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "comp";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Compressor Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Soft-knee leveler with ratio, attack, release and knee";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        envDb = -120f;
        gainCur = 1f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        final float amount = amt.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (amount <= 0.001f || !isEnabled()) return;

        final float threshDb = -2f - 21f * amount;
        final float effRatio = 1f + (ratio.getCurrentRaw() / 100f - 1f) * amount;
        final float slope = effRatio > 0.01f ? 1f - 1f / effRatio : 0.99f;
        final float kneeDb = knee.getCurrentRaw();
        final float makeupDb = -threshDb * slope * 0.5f;
        float attMs = attack.getCurrentRaw();
        float relMs = release.getCurrentRaw();
        final float aAtt = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-BLOCK
                / (attMs * 0.001 * sampleRate)));
        final float aRel = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-BLOCK
                / (relMs * 0.001 * sampleRate)));

        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - offset);
            float peak = 0f;
            float sumSq = 0f;
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + c];
                    peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(x));
                    sumSq += x * x;
                }
            }
            float rms = (float) Math.sqrt(sumSq / (blk * ch));
            float det = Math.max(peak, rms * 1.15f);
            float inDb = DspChain.fastLinToDb(det);
            float a = inDb > envDb ? aAtt : aRel;
            envDb += a * (inDb - envDb);

            float over = envDb - threshDb;
            float gainDb;
            if (over <= -kneeDb * 0.5f) {
                gainDb = 0f;
            } else if (kneeDb > 0f && over < kneeDb * 0.5f) {
                float t = over + kneeDb * 0.5f;
                gainDb = -slope * t * t / (2f * kneeDb);
            } else {
                gainDb = -slope * over;
            }
            FxTelemetry.publishGainReductionDb(gainDb);
            float target = DspChain.fastDbToLin(gainDb + makeupDb);
            float step = (target - gainCur) / blk;

            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                gainCur += step;
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    buf[idx + c] *= gainCur;
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional de-esser: a 4th-order sibilance sidechain (two cascaded
 * constant-peak band-passes) drives smooth, programme-dependent gain
 * reduction. Band centre and width are adjustable, and the reduction can be
 * applied to the sibilance band only (split mode) or to the whole signal
 * (broadband mode).
 *
 * <p>The detector compares band energy to full-band energy, so it follows a
 * quiet close-mic take and a loud take equally well without a fixed level
 * threshold. Stereo channels share one gain so the image stays stable.
 */
final class ProDeEsserProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int BLOCK = 16;
    private static final float INV_BLOCK = 1.0f / BLOCK;
    private static final float EPS = 1e-12f;

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "amt", "Reduction", "%", 0, 100, 1, 45));
    private final FxParameter freq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "deess_freq", "Frequency", " Hz", 4500, 9500, 100, 6800));
    private final FxParameter width = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "deess_width", "Width", " Q", 0.6f, 3.0f, 1.5f));
    private final FxParameter mode = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "deess_mode", "Mode", new String[]{"Split band", "Broadband"}, 0));

    private final float[][] b0 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] a1 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] a2 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] z1 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] z2 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[] scratchSib = new float[BLOCK * 2];

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int cachedFreq = -1;
    private int cachedWidth = -1;
    private int cachedRate = -1;

    private float sibEnv = 1e-7f;
    private float fullEnv = 1e-6f;
    private float cutCur = 0f;
    private float cutTarget = 0f;

    ProDeEsserProcessor() {
        updateCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "deess";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "De-Esser Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "4th-order adaptive sibilance control, split or broadband";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        updateCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
                z1[c][s] = 0f;
                z2[c][s] = 0f;
            }
        }
        sibEnv = 1e-7f;
        fullEnv = 1e-6f;
        cutCur = 0f;
        cutTarget = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && amt01() > 0.001f;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private float amt01() {
        return amt.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        final float amount = amt01();
        if (amount <= 0.001f) return;
        updateCoefficients();
        final boolean broadband = mode.getCurrentRaw() != 0;
        final float maxCutDb = 6f + 18f * amount;
        final float threshDb = -3.0f - 18.0f * amount;
        final float aSibAtt = blockCoef(0.0015f);
        final float aSibRel = blockCoef(0.080f);
        final float aFullAtt = blockCoef(0.010f);
        final float aFullRel = blockCoef(0.150f);

        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - offset);

            float sibEnergy = 0f;
            float fullEnergy = 0f;
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                int sIdx = f * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + c];
                    float sib = bandPass(x, c);
                    scratchSib[sIdx + c] = sib;
                    sibEnergy += sib * sib;
                    fullEnergy += x * x;
                }
            }
            float invN = 1.0f / (blk * ch);
            sibEnv += (sibEnergy * invN > sibEnv ? aSibAtt : aSibRel)
                    * (sibEnergy * invN - sibEnv);
            fullEnv += (fullEnergy * invN > fullEnv ? aFullAtt : aFullRel)
                    * (fullEnergy * invN - fullEnv);

            float ratioDb = 0.5f * DspChain.fastLinToDb(sibEnv + EPS)
                    - 0.5f * DspChain.fastLinToDb(fullEnv + 1e-9f);
            float wantCut = 0f;
            if (ratioDb > threshDb && fullEnv > 1e-7f) {
                float overDb = Math.min(maxCutDb,
                        (ratioDb - threshDb) * 1.4f);
                wantCut = 1f - DspChain.fastDbToLin(-overDb);
            }
            float alpha = wantCut > cutTarget ? 0.50f : 0.12f;
            cutTarget += alpha * (wantCut - cutTarget);
            float dCut = (cutTarget - cutCur) * INV_BLOCK;

            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                cutCur += dCut;
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                int sIdx = f * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    if (broadband) {
                        buf[idx + c] *= 1f - cutCur;
                    } else {
                        buf[idx + c] -= cutCur * scratchSib[sIdx + c];
                    }
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }

    /** One biquad stage; the second stage is run right after in bandPass. */
    private float bandPass(float x, int c) {
        float y = b0[c][0] * x + z1[c][0];
        z1[c][0] = -a1[c][0] * y + z2[c][0];
        z2[c][0] = -b0[c][0] * x - a2[c][0] * y;
        float z = b0[c][1] * y + z1[c][1];
        z1[c][1] = -a1[c][1] * z + z2[c][1];
        z2[c][1] = -b0[c][1] * y - a2[c][1] * z;
        return z;
    }

    private float blockCoef(float seconds) {
        return (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-BLOCK / (seconds * sampleRate)));
    }

    private void updateCoefficients() {
        int hz = Math.max(4500, Math.min(9500, freq.getCurrentRaw()));
        int wRaw = width.clampRaw(width.getCurrentRaw());
        if (hz == cachedFreq && wRaw == cachedWidth
                && sampleRate == cachedRate) {
            return;
        }
        cachedFreq = hz;
        cachedWidth = wRaw;
        cachedRate = sampleRate;
        double q = wRaw / 100.0;
        double w0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / sampleRate;
        double cos = Math.cos(w0);
        double sin = Math.sin(w0);
        double alpha = sin / (2.0 * q);
        double a0Inv = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);
        float nb0 = (float) (alpha * a0Inv);
        float na1 = (float) (-2.0 * cos * a0Inv);
        float na2 = (float) ((1.0 - alpha) * a0Inv);
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
                b0[c][s] = nb0;
                a1[c][s] = na1;
                a2[c][s] = na2;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional downward expander / room gate: a key-filtered peak detector
 * with 3 dB hysteresis, an adjustable hold time and a smooth release. The
 * threshold is driven by the familiar "Threshold" percentage, while Range,
 * Hold and Release refine the behaviour without touching preset values.
 *
 * <p>The key path is high-passed at 80 Hz so desk rumble and plosives do not
 * hold the gate open. Stereo channels share one detector and one gain.
 */
final class ProGateProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int BLOCK = 16;

    private final FxParameter amt = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "amt", "Threshold", "%", 0, 100, 1, 40));
    private final FxParameter range = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_range", "Range", " dB", 6, 40, 1, 20));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_release", "Release", " ms", 40, 400, 5, 160));
    private final FxParameter hold = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "gate_hold", "Hold", " ms", 0, 200, 5, 40));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float env = 0f;
    private float gainCur = 1f;
    private boolean open = false;
    private int holdLeft = 0;
    private float keyLp = 0f;

    private float attackCoef = 0.01f;
    private float releaseCoef = 0.0002f;
    private float decayCoef = 0.999f;
    private int holdSamples = 0;

    ProGateProcessor() {
        recalcCoefs();
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "gate";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Room Gate Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Expander with hysteresis, hold and musical release";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.RESTORATION;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        recalcCoefs();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        env = 0f;
        gainCur = 1f;
        open = false;
        holdLeft = 0;
        keyLp = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && amt.getCurrentRaw() > 0
                && range.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    void setLegacyAmount(int pct) {
        amt.setCurrentRaw(pct);
    }

    private void recalcCoefs() {
        attackCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0 / (0.002 * sampleRate)));
        float relSec = Math.max(1, release.getCurrentRaw()) * 0.001f;
        releaseCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0 / (relSec * sampleRate)));
        decayCoef = (float) Math.exp(-BLOCK / (0.060 * sampleRate));
        holdSamples = Math.round(hold.getCurrentRaw() * 0.001f * sampleRate);
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        final float amount = amt.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
        if (amount <= 0.001f || !isEnabled()) return;
        recalcCoefs();

        final float openDb = -52f + 34f * amount + 1.5f;
        final float closeDb = -52f + 34f * amount - 1.5f;
        final float openLin = DspChain.fastDbToLin(openDb);
        final float closeLin = DspChain.fastDbToLin(closeDb);
        final float floorGain = DspChain.fastDbToLin(-range.getCurrentRaw());
        final float keyCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(
                -2.0 * Math.PI * 80.0 / sampleRate));

        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - offset);
            float peak = 0f;
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                float mono = ch == 1 ? buf[idx]
                        : 0.5f * (buf[idx] + buf[idx + 1]);
                keyLp += keyCoef * (mono - keyLp);
                peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(mono - keyLp));
            }
            env = Math.max(peak, env * decayCoef);

            if (env >= openLin) {
                open = true;
                holdLeft = holdSamples;
            } else if (open) {
                if (env < closeLin) {
                    holdLeft -= blk;
                    if (holdLeft <= 0) open = false;
                } else {
                    holdLeft = holdSamples;
                }
            }

            float target = open ? 1f : floorGain;
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                float a = target > gainCur ? attackCoef : releaseCoef;
                gainCur += a * (target - gainCur);
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    buf[idx + c] *= gainCur;
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }
}
