package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional low-cut filter: a 4th-order (or 2nd-order) Butterworth
 * high-pass with a selectable slope, sample-rate-aware coefficients and
 * click-free coefficient glides while the cutoff is scrubbed.
 *
 * <p>The 24 dB/oct mode is built from two cascaded 2nd-order sections with
 * Q = 0.5412 and Q = 1.3066, the classic Butterworth pairing. Both sections
 * use direct-form II transposed state so low-frequency numerical precision
 * stays good on 32-bit float.
 */
final class ProHpfProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int BLOCK = 16;

    private final FxParameter cutoff = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "cutoff", "Cutoff", " Hz", 40, 160, 1, 80));
    private final FxParameter slope = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "slope", "Slope", new String[]{"12 dB/oct", "24 dB/oct"}, 1));

    private final float[] target = new float[10];
    private final float[] cur = new float[10];
    private boolean coefDirty = true;

    private final float[][] s1 = new float[2][2];
    private final float[][] s2 = new float[2][2];

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private int cachedHz = -1;
    private int cachedSlope = -1;
    private int cachedRate = -1;

    ProHpfProcessor() {
        updateTarget();
        snapCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "hpf";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Low-Cut Filter Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Butterworth rumble & plosive filter, 12 or 24 dB/octave";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        updateTarget();
        snapCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            s1[c][0] = s1[c][1] = 0f;
            s2[c][0] = s2[c][1] = 0f;
        }
        updateTarget();
        snapCoefficients();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    /** Mirrors the legacy {@code hpfOn} flag: any cutoff above 0 enables it. */
    void setLegacyState(boolean on, int cutoffHz) {
        cutoff.setCurrentRaw(on ? Math.max(40, Math.min(160, cutoffHz)) : 80);
        updateTarget();
        snapCoefficients();
        setEnabled(on);
    }

    boolean isOn() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        updateTarget();
        final boolean steep = slope.getCurrentRaw() != 0;
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - offset);
            glideCoefficients();

            final float b0 = cur[0], b1 = cur[1], b2 = cur[2];
            final float a1 = cur[3], a2 = cur[4];
            final float c0 = cur[5], c1 = cur[6], c2 = cur[7];
            final float ca1 = cur[8], ca2 = cur[9];
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + c];
                    float y = b0 * x + s1[c][0];
                    s1[c][0] = b1 * x - a1 * y + s2[c][0];
                    s2[c][0] = b2 * x - a2 * y;
                    if (steep) {
                        float z = c0 * y + s1[c][1];
                        s1[c][1] = c1 * y - ca1 * z + s2[c][1];
                        s2[c][1] = c2 * y - ca2 * z;
                        y = z;
                    }
                    buf[idx + c] = y;
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }

    private void glideCoefficients() {
        if (!coefDirty) return;
        boolean settled = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < target.length; i++) {
            float d = target[i] - cur[i];
            if (Math.abs(d) > 1e-7f) {
                cur[i] += d * 0.35f;
                settled = false;
            } else {
                cur[i] = target[i];
            }
        }
        if (settled) coefDirty = false;
    }

    private void snapCoefficients() {
        System.arraycopy(target, 0, cur, 0, target.length);
        coefDirty = false;
    }

    private void updateTarget() {
        int hz = Math.max(40, Math.min(160, cutoff.getCurrentRaw()));
        int sl = slope.getCurrentRaw() != 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (hz == cachedHz && sl == cachedSlope && sampleRate == cachedRate) {
            return;
        }
        cachedHz = hz;
        cachedSlope = sl;
        cachedRate = sampleRate;

        double w0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / sampleRate;
        double cos = Math.cos(w0);
        double sin = Math.sin(w0);
        double q1 = sl == 1 ? 0.541196100146197 : 0.707106781186548;
        double q2 = 1.306562964876377;
        writeSection(0, cos, sin, q1);
        if (sl == 1) {
            writeSection(5, cos, sin, q2);
        } else {
            // Unity numerator; the section is skipped in the sample loop.
            target[5] = 1f;
            target[6] = 0f;
            target[7] = 0f;
            target[8] = 0f;
            target[9] = 0f;
        }
        coefDirty = true;
    }

    private void writeSection(int at, double cos, double sin, double q) {
        double alpha = sin / (2.0 * q);
        double a0Inv = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);
        target[at] = (float) ((1.0 + cos) * 0.5 * a0Inv);
        target[at + 1] = (float) (-(1.0 + cos) * a0Inv);
        target[at + 2] = target[at];
        target[at + 3] = (float) (-2.0 * cos * a0Inv);
        target[at + 4] = (float) ((1.0 - alpha) * a0Inv);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional brickwall ceiling limiter: zero-latency peak detection with
 * 4x inter-sample interpolation, programme-dependent release and an
 * adjustable ceiling. It keeps the legacy safety role for the rack: whenever
 * an upstream gain stage is active the limiter can enforce the ceiling even
 * with its own mix at zero.
 */
final class ProLimiterProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int DECIM = 16;

    private final FxParameter drive = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "drive", "Drive", "%", 0, 100, 1, 50));
    private final FxParameter ceiling = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "limiter_ceiling", "Ceiling", -6f, 0f, -0.2f));
    private final FxParameter release = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "limiter_release", "Release", " ms", 20, 500, 5, 80));

    private volatile boolean safetyOn = false;

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private float gainCur = 1f;
    private final float[] prev = new float[2];

    ProLimiterProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "limiter";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Brickwall Limiter Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "True-peak ceiling, drive and programme release";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        gainCur = 1f;
        prev[0] = prev[1] = 0f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (drive01() > 0.001f || safetyOn);
    }

    void setLegacyState(int drivePct, boolean safety) {
        drive.setCurrentRaw(drivePct);
        this.safetyOn = safety;
    }

    boolean isSafetyOn() {
        return safetyOn;
    }

    private float drive01() {
        return drive.getCurrentRaw() / 100f;
    }

    private float ceilingLin() {
        return DspChain.fastDbToLin(ceiling.getCurrentRaw() / 100f);
    }

    /**
     * Unity-gain ceiling pass used when the limiter's wet/dry mix is below
     * 1.0 while upstream gain stages still need peak protection.
     */
    void enforceSafetyCeiling(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float c = ceilingLin();
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * Math.max(1,
                Math.min(2, channels)));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            buf[i] = softCeiling(buf[i], c);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled()) return;
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        final int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        final float lAmt = drive01();
        if (lAmt <= 0.001f && !safetyOn) return;

        final float c = ceilingLin();
        final float driveLin = lAmt > 0.001f
                ? DspChain.fastDbToLin(lAmt * 10.5f) : 1.0f;
        final float relSec = Math.max(1, release.getCurrentRaw()) * 0.001f;
        final float relCoef = (float) (1.0 - Math.exp(-1.0
                / (relSec * sampleRate)));

        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(DECIM, frames - offset);
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                float peak = 0f;
                for (int cc = 0; cc < ch; cc++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + cc] * driveLin;
                    float p = prev[cc];
                    float tp = Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(p));
                    tp = Math.max(tp, Math.abs(0.25f * x + 0.75f * p));
                    tp = Math.max(tp, Math.abs(0.5f * x + 0.5f * p));
                    tp = Math.max(tp, Math.abs(0.75f * x + 0.25f * p));
                    peak = Math.max(peak, tp);
                }
                float desired = peak > c ? c / peak : 1f;
                if (desired < gainCur) {
                    gainCur = desired;
                } else {
                    gainCur += relCoef * (desired - gainCur);
                }
                for (int cc = 0; cc < ch; cc++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + cc] * driveLin;
                    prev[cc] = x;
                    buf[idx + cc] = softCeiling(x * gainCur, c);
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }

    private static float softCeiling(float y, float c) {
        float ay = Math.abs(y);
        float knee = c * 0.85f;
        if (ay <= knee) return y;
        float range = c - knee;
        float d = ay - knee;
        float lim = knee + range * (d / (range + d));
        return y >= 0f ? lim : -lim;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Professional tone stage: musical low/high shelves built from RBJ biquads
 * with adjustable corner frequencies. Warmth defaults to 180 Hz and presence
 * to 3.5 kHz, so existing presets keep their character while secondary
 * controls let the engineer move the shelves to suit the voice.
 *
 * <p>The warmth and presence halves can be processed separately around a
 * compressor (the rack's split-tone ordering), each with its own mix weight.
 */
final class ProToneProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final int BLOCK = 16;

    private final FxParameter warmth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "warmth", "Warmth", "%", 0, 100, 1, 40));
    private final FxParameter presence = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "presence", "Presence", "%", 0, 100, 1, 45));
    private final FxParameter warmthFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "warmth_freq", "Warmth Freq", " Hz", 120, 300, 5, 180));
    private final FxParameter presenceFreq = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "presence_freq", "Presence Freq", " Hz", 2500, 6000, 50, 3500));

    private final float[] warmTarget = new float[5];
    private final float[] warmCur = new float[5];
    private final float[] presTarget = new float[5];
    private final float[] presCur = new float[5];

    private final float[] warmZ1 = new float[2];
    private final float[] warmZ2 = new float[2];
    private final float[] presZ1 = new float[2];
    private final float[] presZ2 = new float[2];

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private volatile float warmthSlotMix = 1f;
    private volatile float presenceSlotMix = 1f;
    private float cachedWarmMix = -1f;
    private float cachedPresMix = -1f;
    private int cachedWarmFreq = -1;
    private int cachedWarmRaw = -1;
    private int cachedPresFreq = -1;
    private int cachedPresRaw = -1;
    private int cachedRate = -1;
    private int cachedPresRate = -1;

    ProToneProcessor() {
        updateTargets(0f, 0f);
        snapAll();
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tone";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Warmth & Presence Pro";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Musical low/high shelves with movable corners";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.EQUALIZER;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
        cachedRate = -1;
        cachedPresRate = -1;
        updateTargets(1f, 1f);
        snapAll();
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            warmZ1[c] = warmZ2[c] = 0f;
            presZ1[c] = presZ2[c] = 0f;
        }
        cachedWarmMix = cachedPresMix = -1f;
        updateTargets(1f, 1f);
        snapAll();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled()
                && getWetDryMix() > 0.001f
                && ((warmth.getCurrentRaw() > 0 && warmthSlotMix > 0.001f)
                        || (presence.getCurrentRaw() > 0 && presenceSlotMix > 0.001f));
    }

    void setLegacyAmounts(int warmthPct, int presencePct) {
        warmth.setCurrentRaw(warmthPct);
        presence.setCurrentRaw(presencePct);
    }

    void setWarmthSlotMix(float mix) {
        this.warmthSlotMix = clampMix(mix);
    }

    void setPresenceSlotMix(float mix) {
        this.presenceSlotMix = clampMix(mix);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean handlesOwnWetDryMix() {
        return warmthSlotMix < 0.999f || presenceSlotMix < 0.999f;
    }

    void processWarmthOnly(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, float mix) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float m = clampMix(mix);
        if (m <= 0f) return;
        float[] dry = m < 1f ? buf.clone() : null;
        updateTargets(1f, 0f);
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        processBand(buf, frames, ch, warmCur, warmTarget, warmZ1, warmZ2);
        blendDryWet(buf, dry, frames * ch, m);
    }

    void processPresenceOnly(float[] buf, int frames, int channels, float mix) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        float m = clampMix(mix);
        if (m <= 0f) return;
        float[] dry = m < 1f ? buf.clone() : null;
        updateTargets(0f, 1f);
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        processBand(buf, frames, ch, presCur, presTarget, presZ1, presZ2);
        blendDryWet(buf, dry, frames * ch, m);
    }

    private static void blendDryWet(float[] wet, float[] dry, int n, float mix) {
        if (dry == null || mix >= 1f) return;
        float d = 1f - mix;
        int count = Math.min(Math.min(n, wet.length), dry.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) wet[i] = dry[i] * d + wet[i] * mix;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (!isEnabled() || buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        updateTargets(warmthSlotMix, presenceSlotMix);
        if (warmth.getCurrentRaw() > 0 && warmthSlotMix > 0.001f) {
            processBand(buf, frames, ch, warmCur, warmTarget,
                    warmZ1, warmZ2);
        }
        if (presence.getCurrentRaw() > 0 && presenceSlotMix > 0.001f) {
            processBand(buf, frames, ch, presCur, presTarget,
                    presZ1, presZ2);
        }
    }

    private static float clampMix(float mix) {
        if (mix <= 0f) return 0f;
        return Math.min(1f, mix);
    }

    private void processBand(float[] buf, int frames, int ch,
                             float[] cur, float[] target,
                             float[] z1, float[] z2) {
        int offset = 0;
        while (offset < frames) {
            int blk = Math.min(BLOCK, frames - offset);
            glide(cur, target);
            float b0 = cur[0], b1 = cur[1], b2 = cur[2];
            float a1 = cur[3], a2 = cur[4];
            for (int f = 0; f < blk; f++) {
                int idx = (offset + f) * ch;
                for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
                    float x = buf[idx + c];
                    float y = b0 * x + z1[c];
                    z1[c] = b1 * x - a1 * y + z2[c];
                    z2[c] = b2 * x - a2 * y;
                    buf[idx + c] = y;
                }
            }
            offset += blk;
        }
    }

    private void glide(float[] cur, float[] target) {
        for (int i = 0; i < cur.length; i++) {
            float d = target[i] - cur[i];
            if (Math.abs(d) > 1e-7f) {
                cur[i] += d * 0.35f;
            } else {
                cur[i] = target[i];
            }
        }
    }

    private void snapAll() {
        System.arraycopy(warmTarget, 0, warmCur, 0, 5);
        System.arraycopy(presTarget, 0, presCur, 0, 5);
    }

    private void updateTargets(float warmMix, float presMix) {
        float wMix = clampMix(warmMix);
        float pMix = clampMix(presMix);
        int wf = Math.max(120, Math.min(300, warmthFreq.getCurrentRaw()));
        int pf = Math.max(2500, Math.min(6000, presenceFreq.getCurrentRaw()));
        int warmRaw = warmth.getCurrentRaw();
        int presRaw = presence.getCurrentRaw();
        if (wMix != cachedWarmMix || wf != cachedWarmFreq
                || warmRaw != cachedWarmRaw || sampleRate != cachedRate) {
            cachedWarmMix = wMix;
            cachedWarmFreq = wf;
            cachedWarmRaw = warmRaw;
            cachedRate = sampleRate;
            writeShelf(warmTarget, true, wf,
                    warmth.getCurrentRaw() / 100f * 9f * wMix);
        }
        if (pMix != cachedPresMix || pf != cachedPresFreq
                || presRaw != cachedPresRaw || sampleRate != cachedPresRate) {
            cachedPresMix = pMix;
            cachedPresFreq = pf;
            cachedPresRaw = presRaw;
            cachedPresRate = sampleRate;
            writeShelf(presTarget, false, pf,
                    presence.getCurrentRaw() / 100f * 10f * pMix);
        }
    }

    private void writeShelf(float[] out, boolean low, int hz, float gainDb) {
        double a = Math.pow(10.0, gainDb / 40.0);
        double w0 = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / sampleRate;
        double cos = Math.cos(w0);
        double sin = Math.sin(w0);
        double alpha = sin / Math.sqrt(2.0);
        double sqrtA = Math.sqrt(a);
        double b0, b1, b2, a0, a1, a2;
        if (low) {
            b0 = a * ((a + 1) - (a - 1) * cos + 2 * sqrtA * alpha);
            b1 = 2 * a * ((a - 1) - (a + 1) * cos);
            b2 = a * ((a + 1) - (a - 1) * cos - 2 * sqrtA * alpha);
            a0 = (a + 1) + (a - 1) * cos + 2 * sqrtA * alpha;
            a1 = -2 * ((a - 1) + (a + 1) * cos);
            a2 = (a + 1) + (a - 1) * cos - 2 * sqrtA * alpha;
        } else {
            b0 = a * ((a + 1) + (a - 1) * cos + 2 * sqrtA * alpha);
            b1 = -2 * a * ((a - 1) + (a + 1) * cos);
            b2 = a * ((a + 1) + (a - 1) * cos - 2 * sqrtA * alpha);
            a0 = (a + 1) - (a - 1) * cos + 2 * sqrtA * alpha;
            a1 = 2 * ((a - 1) - (a + 1) * cos);
            a2 = (a + 1) - (a - 1) * cos - 2 * sqrtA * alpha;
        }
        double inv = 1.0 / a0;
        out[0] = (float) (b0 * inv);
        out[1] = (float) (b1 * inv);
        out[2] = (float) (b2 * inv);
        out[3] = (float) (a1 * inv);
        out[4] = (float) (a2 * inv);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Plays a 32-bit float WAV straight through {@link AudioTrack} with:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>Live dBFS Meter Level ({@link #level})</b>: Computes the real-time
 *       post-FX peak amplitude of every played chunk so {@link DbMeterView}
 *       shows live dBFS readings while previewing!</li>
 *   <li><b>Zero Playhead Jerk</b>: {@link #positionFrames()} tracks the
 *       monotonic hardware speaker head ({@code startFramePos + head}).</li>
 *   <li><b>Speaker Pre-Warming</b>: {@link #warmUpSpeaker(int)} primes a
 *       low-latency {@link AudioTrack} for instant start.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class RawFloatPlayer {

    public interface Listener {
        /** Called once when playback stops: true = reached the end. */
        void onDone(boolean completed);
    }

    private static final Object WARM_LOCK = new Object();
    private static AudioTrack warmTrack;
    private static int warmChannels;
    private static volatile boolean warmingSpeaker;

    /**
     * Pre-warms the hardware speaker sink on a background thread when the user
     * starts scrolling the waveform so pressing Resume/Preview plays immediately.
     */
    public static void warmUpSpeaker(final int channels) {
        final int ch = channels == 1 ? 1 : 2;
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null && warmChannels == ch
                    && warmTrack.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                return;
            }
            if (warmingSpeaker) return;
            warmingSpeaker = true;
        }
        new Thread(() -> {
            AudioTrack built = null;
            try {
                built = createLowLatencyTrack(ch, 32768);
                if (built.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                    built.play();
                    float[] silence = new float[128 * ch];
                    built.write(silence, 0, silence.length, AudioTrack.WRITE_NON_BLOCKING);
                    built.stop();
                    built.flush();
                } else {
                    built.release();
                    built = null;
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                if (built != null) {
                    try { built.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored2) {}
                    built = null;
                }
            }
            synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
                warmingSpeaker = false;
                if (built != null) {
                    if (warmTrack != null) {
                        try { warmTrack.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                    }
                    warmTrack = built;
                    warmChannels = ch;
                }
            }
        }, "takeone-speaker-warm").start();
    }

    public static void releaseWarmSpeaker() {
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null) {
                try { warmTrack.stop(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                try { warmTrack.release(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                warmTrack = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private static AudioTrack obtainTrack(int channels, int desiredBytes) {
        synchronized (WARM_LOCK) {
            if (warmTrack != null && warmChannels == channels
                    && warmTrack.getState() == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                AudioTrack t = warmTrack;
                warmTrack = null;
                return t;
            }
        }
        return createLowLatencyTrack(channels, desiredBytes);
    }

    private static AudioTrack createLowLatencyTrack(int channels, int desiredBytes) {
        int mask = channels == 2 ? AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_STEREO
                : AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO;
        int minBytes = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE,
                mask, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT);
        if (minBytes <= 0) minBytes = 8192;
        int bufBytes = Math.max(minBytes, Math.min(32768, desiredBytes));
        AudioAttributes attrs = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                .build();
        AudioFormat af = new AudioFormat.Builder()
                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT)
                .setSampleRate(RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE)
                .setChannelMask(mask)
                .build();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            try {
                return new AudioTrack.Builder()
                        .setAudioAttributes(attrs)
                        .setAudioFormat(af)
                        .setBufferSizeInBytes(bufBytes)
                        .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
                        .setPerformanceMode(AudioTrack.PERFORMANCE_MODE_LOW_LATENCY)
                        .build();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
        return new AudioTrack(attrs, af, bufBytes, AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM, 0);
    }

    private final File file;
    private final int channels;
    private final long dataStart;
    private final long totalFrames;
    private final Listener listener;

    private Thread thread;
    private volatile boolean stop;
    private volatile boolean paused;
    private volatile long startFramePos;
    private volatile long framePos;
    private volatile long maxReportedFrame;
    private volatile long playStartedRealtimeMs;
    private volatile AudioTrack activeTrack;
    private volatile long generation;
    private volatile DspChain dspChain;
    private volatile long stopAtFrame = -1;

    /**
     * Real-time peak amplitude (0..1) of the audio currently playing through
     * the speaker (including live DspChain FX), driving DbMeterView during preview!
     */
    public volatile float level = 0f;

    public void setDspChain(DspChain chain) {
        this.dspChain = chain;
    }

    public RawFloatPlayer(File file, Listener listener) throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(file);
        if (info.channels < 1 || info.channels > 2) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("bad channels");
        }
        this.file = file;
        this.channels = info.channels;
        this.dataStart = info.dataStart;
        this.totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / info.channels;
        if (totalFrames <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    public long durationMs() {
        return totalFrames * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    public synchronized void play() {
        playFrom(framePos);
    }

    public synchronized void playFrom(long frame) {
        stopLocked();
        stop = false;
        paused = false;
        stopAtFrame = -1;
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, frame));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        generation++;
        thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
        thread.start();
    }

    /** Play a specific frame range `[startFrame, endFrame)` (e.g. selection preview). */
    public synchronized void playRange(long startFrame, long endFrame) {
        stopLocked();
        stop = false;
        paused = false;
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, startFrame));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        stopAtFrame = (endFrame > framePos && endFrame <= totalFrames)
                ? endFrame : -1;
        generation++;
        thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
        thread.start();
    }

    public synchronized void pause() {
        long cur = positionFrames();
        paused = true;
        stopLocked();
        framePos = cur;
        startFramePos = cur;
        maxReportedFrame = cur;
        level = 0f;
    }

    public synchronized void stop() {
        stopLocked();
        framePos = 0;
        startFramePos = 0;
        maxReportedFrame = 0;
        level = 0f;
    }

    public long positionFrames() {
        long limit = (stopAtFrame > 0 && stopAtFrame <= totalFrames)
                ? stopAtFrame : totalFrames;
        if (!stop && !paused) {
            AudioTrack t = activeTrack;
            if (t != null) {
                try {
                    long head = t.getPlaybackHeadPosition() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
                    if (head > 0) {
                        long pos = Math.min(limit, startFramePos + head);
                        if (pos > maxReportedFrame) maxReportedFrame = pos;
                        return maxReportedFrame;
                    }
                    long elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - playStartedRealtimeMs;
                    if (elapsed > 160L && framePos > startFramePos) {
                        long sim = Math.min(limit,
                                startFramePos + (elapsed * RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE / 1000L));
                        if (sim > maxReportedFrame) maxReportedFrame = sim;
                        return maxReportedFrame;
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            return maxReportedFrame;
        }
        return maxReportedFrame > 0 ? maxReportedFrame : framePos;
    }

    public long positionMs() {
        return positionFrames() * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
    }

    public synchronized void seekToMs(long ms) {
        long f = ms * RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE / 1000L;
        boolean wasPlaying = thread != null && !paused;
        stopLocked();
        framePos = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalFrames, f));
        startFramePos = framePos;
        maxReportedFrame = framePos;
        if (wasPlaying) {
            stop = false;
            paused = false;
            playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            generation++;
            thread = new Thread(this::run, "takeone-raw-preview");
            thread.start();
        }
    }

    private synchronized void stopLocked() {
        generation++;
        stop = true;
        paused = true;
        level = 0f;
        AudioTrack t = activeTrack;
        if (t != null) {
            try {
                t.pause();
                t.flush();
                t.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        Thread th = thread;
        thread = null;
        if (th != null) {
            try {
                th.join(800);
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void run() {
        final long gen = generation;
        boolean completed = false;
        AudioTrack track = null;
        RandomAccessFile r = null;
        ConversionJobs.beginRawRead(file.getAbsolutePath());
        try {
            long limitFrame = (stopAtFrame > 0 && stopAtFrame <= totalFrames)
                    ? stopAtFrame : totalFrames;
            long framesToPlay = Math.max(1L, limitFrame - startFramePos);
            int spanBytes = (int) Math.min(32768L, framesToPlay * channels * 4L);
            track = obtainTrack(channels, spanBytes);
            if (track.getState() != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) return;
            r = new RandomAccessFile(file, "r");
            float[] buf = new float[1024 * channels];
            byte[] raw = new byte[buf.length * 4];
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            playStartedRealtimeMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            track.play();
            activeTrack = track;
            long writtenFrames = 0;
            DspChain preChain = this.dspChain;
            if (preChain != null && preChain.isActive()) {
                try {
                    preChain.reset();
                    preChain.prepareOffline(file, startFramePos, limitFrame,
                            RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE, channels);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (preChain != null && preChain.isActive()
                    && !preChain.offlineProcessors().isEmpty()) {
                float[] offlineBuf = preChain.renderRegionOfflineAndInPlace(
                        file, startFramePos, limitFrame,
                        RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE);
                if (offlineBuf != null && offlineBuf.length > 0) {
                    int outFrames = offlineBuf.length / channels;
                    int curOut = 0;
                    while (!stop && curOut < outFrames) {
                        int want = Math.min(1024, outFrames - curOut);
                        int totalSamples = want * channels;
                        System.arraycopy(offlineBuf, curOut * channels,
                                buf, 0, totalSamples);
                        FxTelemetry.push(buf, want, channels);
                        float chunkPeak = 0f;
                        for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                            float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                            if (a > chunkPeak) chunkPeak = a;
                        }
                        this.level = Math.min(1f, chunkPeak);
                        int written = 0;
                        while (written < totalSamples && !stop) {
                            int n = track.write(buf, written,
                                    totalSamples - written,
                                    AudioTrack.WRITE_BLOCKING);
                            if (n <= 0) break;
                            written += n;
                        }
                        curOut += want;
                        writtenFrames += want;
                        framePos = startFramePos + Math.round(
                                (double) curOut / Math.max(1, outFrames)
                                        * (limitFrame - startFramePos));
                    }
                    if (!stop) {
                        framePos = limitFrame;
                    }
                }
            }
            while (!stop && framePos < limitFrame) {
                int want = (int) Math.min(1024, limitFrame - framePos);
                r.seek(dataStart + framePos * channels * 4L);
                r.readFully(raw, 0, want * channels * 4);
                fb.clear();
                fb.limit(want * channels);
                fb.get(buf, 0, want * channels);
                DspChain chain = this.dspChain;
                if (chain != null && chain.isActive()) {
                    chain.processInPlace(buf, want);
                }
                FxTelemetry.push(buf, want, channels);
                // Compute post-FX peak level for the dBFS meter during preview!
                float chunkPeak = 0f;
                int totalSamples = want * channels;
                for (int i = 0; i < totalSamples; i++) {
                    float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                    if (a > chunkPeak) chunkPeak = a;
                }
                this.level = Math.min(1f, chunkPeak);

                int written = 0;
                while (written < totalSamples && !stop) {
                    int n = track.write(buf, written,
                            totalSamples - written,
                            AudioTrack.WRITE_BLOCKING);
                    if (n <= 0) break;
                    written += n;
                }
                framePos += want;
                writtenFrames += want;
            }
            if (!stop && framePos >= limitFrame && writtenFrames > 0) {
                long drainStart = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                long maxDrainMs = Math.min(1500L,
                        (writtenFrames * 1000L / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) + 350L);
                long lastHead = -1;
                long lastAdvanceAt = drainStart;
                while (!stop) {
                    long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                    if (now - drainStart >= maxDrainMs) break;
                    long head = 0;
                    try {
                        head = track.getPlaybackHeadPosition() & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    if (head >= writtenFrames) break;
                    if (head != lastHead) {
                        lastHead = head;
                        lastAdvanceAt = now;
                    } else if (now - lastAdvanceAt > 180L) {
                        break;
                    }
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(12);
                    } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!stop) {
                    maxReportedFrame = limitFrame;
                    completed = true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            this.level = 0f;
            activeTrack = null;
            if (track != null) {
                try {
                    track.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    track.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (r != null) {
                try {
                    r.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            ConversionJobs.endRawRead(file.getAbsolutePath());
            if (gen == generation && listener != null) {
                try {
                    listener.onDone(completed);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.media.MediaRecorder;

/**
 * The three recording presets. Each one is a distinct capture geometry —
 * mono vs stereo, processed mic vs unprocessed — so none overlaps another.
 * Containers live in {@link SaveFormat}: "Raw Studio" as a preset was just
 * Music-plus-WAV, and "Voice vs Standard" was one mono capture at two
 * bitrates, so both collapsed away. Everything is locked to 48&nbsp;kHz so
 * AudioFlinger never has to resample, and Music uses the UNPROCESSED source
 * to bypass AGC ducking and effects.
 */
public enum RecordPreset {
    MEMO("memo", R.string.preset_memo, R.string.preset_memo_sub,
            "MEMO 96k", 1, 96000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC),
    PODCAST("podcast", R.string.preset_podcast, R.string.preset_podcast_sub,
            "POD 256k", 2, 256000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC),
    MUSIC("music", R.string.preset_music, R.string.preset_music_sub,
            "MUS 320k", 2, 320000, MediaRecorder.AudioSource.UNPROCESSED, true);

    public final String id;
    public final int titleRes;
    public final int subRes;
    /** Short badge text, e.g. "MUS 320k". */
    public final String shortLabel;
    /** 1 = mono, 2 = stereo (before any mono fallback). */
    public final int channels;
    /** AAC bitrate for the save conversion. */
    public final int aacBitrate;
    public final int audioSource;
    /**
     * True when the capture should be kept lossless by default. Only the
     * unprocessed stereo master qualifies: AAC is transparent for speech but
     * discards real detail in a music take, so AUTO saves Music as 32-bit
     * float WAV (WAV32) rather than squeezing it through a lossy codec.
     */
    public final boolean autoSavesLossless;

    RecordPreset(String id, int titleRes, int subRes, String shortLabel,
                 int channels, int aacBitrate, int audioSource) {
        this(id, titleRes, subRes, shortLabel, channels, aacBitrate,
                audioSource, false);
    }

    RecordPreset(String id, int titleRes, int subRes, String shortLabel,
                 int channels, int aacBitrate, int audioSource,
                 boolean autoSavesLossless) {
        this.id = id;
        this.titleRes = titleRes;
        this.subRes = subRes;
        this.shortLabel = shortLabel;
        this.channels = channels;
        this.aacBitrate = aacBitrate;
        this.audioSource = audioSource;
        this.autoSavesLossless = autoSavesLossless;
    }

    public boolean wantsStereo() {
        return channels == 2;
    }

    public boolean wantsUnprocessed() {
        return audioSource == MediaRecorder.AudioSource.UNPROCESSED;
    }

    public static RecordPreset of(String id) {
        if (id != null) {
            for (RecordPreset p : values()) {
                if (p.id.equals(id)) return p;
            }
            // Retired presets map to their closest surviving capture.
            if ("voice".equals(id) || "standard".equals(id)) return MEMO;
            if ("raw".equals(id)) return MUSIC;
        }
        return MEMO;
    }

    public static RecordPreset[] all() {
        return values();
    }

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY = "rec_preset";

    public static RecordPreset load(Context ctx) {
        try {
            SharedPreferences p = ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            return of(p.getString(KEY, MEMO.id));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return MEMO;
        }
    }

    public void save(Context ctx) {
        try {
            ctx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putString(KEY, id).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}
