        title.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        title.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        title.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
        root.addView(title);

        android.widget.EditText searchBox = new android.widget.EditText(ctx);
        searchBox.setHint("Search effects (e.g. noise, de-ess, warm)...");
        searchBox.setHintTextColor(0xFF5D6672);
        searchBox.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        searchBox.setTextSize(13.5f);
        searchBox.setSingleLine(true);
        searchBox.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
        int sPad = Math.round(10 * density);
        searchBox.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams sLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        sLp.topMargin = Math.round(10 * density);
        root.addView(searchBox, sLp);

        android.widget.ScrollView listScroll = new android.widget.ScrollView(ctx);
        android.widget.LinearLayout listCol = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        listCol.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        listScroll.addView(listCol);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams scLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        Math.round(240 * density));
        scLp.topMargin = Math.round(10 * density);
        root.addView(listScroll, scLp);

        // Category filter chips: the catalog now spans eight families, so a
        // search box alone is not enough to find an effect quickly.
        final FxCategory[] categories = {
                null, FxCategory.EQUALIZER, FxCategory.DYNAMICS,
                FxCategory.RESTORATION, FxCategory.SPATIAL, FxCategory.TIME,
                FxCategory.CREATIVE, FxCategory.TOOLS, FxCategory.ANALYZER};
        final String[] categoryLabels = {
                "All", "EQ & Filters", "Dynamics", "Restoration",
                "Spatial", "Pitch & Time", "Creative", "Tools", "Analyzers"};
        final FxCategory[] selected = {null};
        final android.widget.HorizontalScrollView chipScroll =
                new android.widget.HorizontalScrollView(ctx);
        chipScroll.setHorizontalScrollBarEnabled(false);
        android.widget.LinearLayout chipRow =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
        chipRow.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        chipScroll.addView(chipRow);
        android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams chipLp =
                new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        chipLp.topMargin = Math.round(8 * density);
        root.addView(chipScroll, chipLp);
        final android.widget.TextView[] chipViews =
                new android.widget.TextView[categories.length];

        Runnable populateList = () -> {
            String q = searchBox.getText().toString().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            FxCategory filter = selected[0];
            listCol.removeAllViews();
            // The catalog is listed alphabetically so a long effect list stays
            // navigable.
            java.util.List<DspChain.EffectType> catalog =
                    new java.util.ArrayList<>(java.util.Arrays.asList(
                            DspChain.EffectType.values()));
            java.util.Collections.sort(catalog,
                    new java.util.Comparator<DspChain.EffectType>() {
                        @Override
                        public int compare(DspChain.EffectType a,
                                           DspChain.EffectType b) {
                            return a.title.compareToIgnoreCase(b.title);
                        }
                    });
            for (DspChain.EffectType t : catalog) {
                if (filter != null
                        && DspChain.categoryOf(t) != filter) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (!q.isEmpty()
                        && !t.title.toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(q)
                        && !t.description.toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(q)) {
                    continue;
                }
                android.widget.LinearLayout row = new android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx);
                row.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
                row.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
                android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams rLp =
                        new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                rLp.topMargin = Math.round(6 * density);

                TextView rTitle = new TextView(ctx);
                rTitle.setText(t.title);
                rTitle.setTextSize(13.5f);
                rTitle.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
                rTitle.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                        "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));

                TextView rSub = new TextView(ctx);
                rSub.setText(t.description);
                rSub.setTextSize(11f);
                rSub.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);

                row.addView(rTitle);
                row.addView(rSub);
                PressAnim.applySoft(row, 0.97f);
                row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    if (!isAdded() || dspConfig == null) return;
                    if (dspSubRangeBaked) lastEditWasSubRangeBake = true;
                    dspBakedToRaw = false;
                    dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                    dspConfig.addOrFocusSlot(t);
                    dspConfig.save(ctx);
                    if (livePreviewDsp != null) {
                        livePreviewDsp.updateConfig(dspConfig);
                    }
                    refreshFxPreviewPeaks();
                    rebuildFxRackList();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    d.dismiss();
                });
                listCol.addView(row, rLp);
            }
        };

        for (int i = 0; i < categories.length; i++) {
            final int index = i;
            TextView chip = makeFxChip(ctx, categoryLabels[i], density);
            chipViews[i] = chip;
            android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams clp =
                    new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            clp.rightMargin = Math.round(5 * density);
            chipRow.addView(chip, clp);
            chip.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                selected[0] = categories[index];
                for (int k = 0; k < chipViews.length; k++) {
                    boolean on = k == index;
                    chipViews[k].setTextColor(on ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF);
                    chipViews[k].setBackgroundResource(on
                            ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                            : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
                }
                populateList.run();
            });
        }
        // "All" starts selected.
        chipViews[0].setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        chipViews[0].setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected);
        populateList.run();

        searchBox.addTextChangedListener(new android.text.TextWatcher() {
            @Override public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int c, int a) {}
            @Override public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int b, int c) {
                populateList.run();
            }
            @Override public void afterTextChanged(android.text.Editable s) {}
        });

        TextView cancelBtn = new TextView(ctx);
        cancelBtn.setText(R.string.cancel);
        cancelBtn.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
        cancelBtn.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        cancelBtn.setTextSize(13.5f);
        cancelBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);
        cancelBtn.setPadding(sPad, sPad, sPad, sPad);
        cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> d.dismiss());
        root.addView(cancelBtn, sLp);

        d.setContentView(root);
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(d);
        d.show();
    }


    /**
     * Applies enabled effects from the FX rack to the selected audio region
     * when a selection is active, or to the entire take when no region is
     * selected. Works identically on both the normal recording and the
     * Select & Replace sub-editor recording.
     */
    private boolean commitDspFx() {
        if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return false;
        if (replaceModeArmed) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Disable Replace mode before applying effects",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        stopStudioPreview();
        if (dspConfig == null) return false;
        dspConfig.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        if (!dspConfig.isActive()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Enable at least one effect (checkmark) first",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        // Apply works on the selection when there is one and on the WHOLE TAKE
        // otherwise — the old forced "enable selection first" return aborted
        // silently and made the full-take branch below unreachable.
        if (waveform == null) return false;
        // In effects mode the target is the region that was selected before
        // the rack opened, so re-selecting a range (to learn a noise profile,
        // say) cannot silently change what Stop commits to.
        boolean hadSel = fxPanelOpen
                ? fxApplyTargetHasSelection
                : waveform.hasSelection();
        File raw = engine.rawFile;
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) return false;
        if (!hadSel && dspBakedToRaw && !dspSubRangeBaked) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                    "Effects already applied to entire take (tap Undo or adjust a parameter first)",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        boolean peaksPushed = false;
        try {
            // Config.isActive() can disagree with the processor chain (e.g. a
            // Stage 3 slot whose parameters are neutral); probe the real chain
            // BEFORE any undo bookkeeping so an inaudible rack never pushes a
            // waveform peak snapshot without a matching audio snapshot.
            try {
                FormatConverter.WavInfo preInfo =
                        FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                DspChain probeChain = new DspChain(preInfo.channels, dspConfig);
                if (!probeChain.isActive()) {
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                            "Adjust an effect parameter away from 0 dB first",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return false;
            }
            EditEngine.UndoJournal uj = activeUndoJournal();
            // If a sub-selection was just baked with this exact rack — even if
            // a knob tweak has since cleared dspSubRangeBaked — restore the
            // pre-sub-bake snapshot first so the selected region is not baked
            // twice!
            if (!hadSel && (dspSubRangeBaked || lastEditWasSubRangeBake)
                    && uj != null && uj.canUndo()) {
                if (uj.undo(raw)) {
                    waveform.popUndoPeaks();
                    engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                    dspBakedToRaw = false;
                    dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                    lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
                }
            }
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
            long totalFrames = info.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, info.channels);
            if (totalFrames <= 0) return false;
            long start = 0L;
            long end = totalFrames;
            if (hadSel) {
                float startFrac = fxPanelOpen
                        ? fxApplyTargetStart
                        : waveform.selectionStartFraction();
                float endFrac = fxPanelOpen
                        ? fxApplyTargetEnd
                        : waveform.selectionEndFraction();
                start = Math.round(startFrac * totalFrames);
                end = Math.round(endFrac * totalFrames);
                if (end <= start) {
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                            "Select a valid audio region first",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    return false;
                }
            }
            // The file is about to change: stop the live region render and
            // drop its dry baseline so the reloaded bars become the new truth.
            fxPreviewGeneration++;
            handler.removeCallbacks(fxPreviewRefresh);
            waveform.clearFxRegionPeaks();
            waveform.recordUndoPeaks();
            peaksPushed = true;
            DspChain chain = new DspChain(info.channels, dspConfig);
            // Duration-changing tools (Change Tempo, Change Speed, Repeat,
            // Truncate Silence, ...) render the region offline and rewrite the
            // file, so they take a different path than the in-place chain.
            // They run first; the in-place chain then processes whatever
            // region came out of them.
            java.util.List<AudioProcessor> offline =
                    chain.offlineProcessors();
            if (!offline.isEmpty()) {
                long regionEnd = end;
                boolean firstOffline = true;
                for (AudioProcessor proc : offline) {
                    FormatConverter.WavInfo curInfo = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                    long curTotalBefore = curInfo.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, curInfo.channels);
                    long newTotal = EditEngine.applyLengthChangingEffectToRange(
                            raw, start, regionEnd, proc, firstOffline ? uj : null);
                    if (newTotal < 0) {
                        if (firstOffline) {
                            waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                        } else if (uj != null && uj.canUndo()) {
                            uj.undo(raw);
                            waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                        }
                        peaksPushed = false;
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                "This effect could not be applied here",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        return false;
                    }
                    firstOffline = false;
                    regionEnd = start + (newTotal - (curTotalBefore - regionEnd));
                }
                // The offline pass rewrote the region: run the remaining
                // in-place processors over the new boundaries.
                if (chain.hasInPlaceProcessors()) {
                    DspChain inPlace = new DspChain(info.channels, dspConfig);
                    inPlace.clearOfflineProcessors();
                    EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, start, regionEnd, inPlace, null);
                }
                engine.abortStreaming();
                engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
                long newTotalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long nextCursor = Math.min(newTotalFrames, Math.max(0L, regionEnd));
                engine.seekCursorFrame(nextCursor);
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = hadSel;
                lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
                waveform.reloadFullFromWavSync(raw);
                waveform.syncFramesPerBar(newTotalFrames);
                if (newTotalFrames > 0) {
                    waveform.setPlayheadFraction(
                            nextCursor / (float) newTotalFrames);
                }
                refreshZoomValue();
                if (timerText != null) {
                    timerText.setText(formatTimer(engine.cursorMs()));
                }
                resetFxRackAfterApply();
                waveform.clearSelection();
                syncFxBakeRequired();
                OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Effects applied");
                paint();
                paintFxPanelControls();
                return true;
            }
            boolean snapshotRecorded =
                    EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, start, end, chain, uj);
            if (!snapshotRecorded) {
                waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
                peaksPushed = false;
            }
            lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
            // The raw now carries the chain for the applied range: the
            // incremental pump must not keep encoding unprocessed audio, and
            // neither preview nor save may process these samples a second time.
            engine.abortStreaming();
            engine.dataBytes = RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw);
            if (!hadSel) {
                // Whole take baked: mark it so preview (livePreviewDsp) and
                // save never process these samples a second time.
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = false;
                waveform.reloadSelectionPeaksFromWav(raw, 0f, 1f);
            } else {
                waveform.reloadSelectionPeaksFromWav(raw,
                        fxPanelOpen ? fxApplyTargetStart
                                : waveform.selectionStartFraction(),
                        fxPanelOpen ? fxApplyTargetEnd
                                : waveform.selectionEndFraction());
                // Only the selected region was baked. The raw file now carries
                // that bake, so preview/save must not process it again even
                // though the rest of the take remains dry.
                dspBakedToRaw = true;
                dspSubRangeBaked = true;
            }
            // Apply is the single commit point: the raw file and waveform now
            // carry the processed audio, so start a fresh, blank rack. Keeping
            // the old slots enabled would leave the UI implying the effects
            // are still pending and invite a second bake.
            resetFxRackAfterApply();
            syncFxBakeRequired();
            waveform.clearSelection();
            OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Effects applied");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            if (peaksPushed && waveform != null) waveform.discardTopUndoPeaks();
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "FX failed",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return false;
        }
        paint();
        paintFxPanelControls();
        return true;
    }

    /** Preserves the user's FX rack after a bake while marking the audio committed. */
    private void resetFxRackAfterApply() {
        if (dspConfig == null) return;
        try {
            dspConfig.save(requireContext());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (livePreviewDsp != null) {
            livePreviewDsp.updateConfig(dspConfig);
        }
        refreshFxPreviewPeaks();
        rebuildFxRackList();
    }

    private void paint() {
        if (getView() == null || !isAdded()) return;
        syncFxBakeRequired();
        // A capture paused outside the studio (call, notification, mic
        // disconnect) must park the prompter too — and a resume must
        // release it — even though no studio button was involved.
        if (lastPaintedState == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                && engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            setTelePaused(true);
        } else if (lastPaintedState == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED
                && engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            setTelePaused(false);
        }
        lastPaintedState = engine.state;
        lastPaintedName = String.valueOf(displayName());
        boolean hasSession = engine.hasSession();
        boolean rec = engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
        boolean paused = engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;

        String name = displayName();
        if (name != null) {
            statusText.setText(name);
            takeNameView.setText(name);
        } else {
            statusText.setText(R.string.studio_ready);
            takeNameView.setText(nextTakeName());
        }

        stateLabel.setText(!hasSession ? getString(R.string.studio_ready)
                : rec ? getString(R.string.studio_recording)
                : paused ? getString(R.string.studio_paused)
                : getString(R.string.studio_ready));
        statusText.setAlpha(name != null ? 1f : 0.7f);

        if (!hasSession) {
            hintText.setText(name != null
                    ? getString(R.string.studio_tap_to_start)
                    : getString(R.string.studio_hint));
        } else if (rec) {
            hintText.setText(R.string.studio_recording_hint);
        } else if (paused) {
            hintText.setText(R.string.studio_paused_hint);
        } else {
            hintText.setText(editSourceId != -1
                    ? getString(R.string.studio_tap_to_start)
                    : getString(R.string.studio_recovered));
        }

        // Unfinalised indicator: the pending marker means raw 32-bit float
        // bytes are streamed but the take is not finalised yet.
        boolean unfin = hasSession && isUnfinalised();
        draftBadge.setVisibility(unfin ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

        TrialAndBillingManager billing =
                TrialAndBillingManager.get(requireContext());
        billing.setActiveStudioSourceId(editSourceId);
        formatBadge.setText(preset.shortLabel + " → "
                + TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, saveFormat));
        formatBadge.setEnabled(!saving);
        formatBadge.setClickable(!saving);
        formatBadge.setAlpha(saving ? 0.35f : 1f);
        settingsName.setText(preset.titleRes);
        settingsSub.setText(preset.shortLabel + " → "
                + TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, saveFormat));
        settingsRow.setEnabled(!saving);
        settingsRow.setClickable(!saving);
        settingsRow.setAlpha(saving ? 0.45f : 1f);
        setTeleActive(telePanel.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE);

        statusDot.setBackgroundResource(rec ? R.drawable.dot_live : R.drawable.bg_round_btn);
        if (rec) startDotPulse(); else stopDotPulse();
        statusDot.setAlpha(rec ? 1f : 0.35f);
        paintEditorStrip();

        syncStudioFabIcon();
    }

    private boolean isUnfinalised() {
        try {
            File raw = engine.rawFile;
            if (raw == null) return false;
            return new File(raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".pending").exists();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void startDotPulse() {
        stopDotPulse();
        statusDot.setAlpha(1f);
        dotPulse = ObjectAnimator.ofFloat(statusDot, View.ALPHA, 1f, 0.25f);
        dotPulse.setDuration(700);
        dotPulse.setRepeatCount(ObjectAnimator.INFINITE);
        dotPulse.setRepeatMode(ObjectAnimator.REVERSE);
        dotPulse.start();
    }

    private void stopDotPulse() {
        if (dotPulse != null) {
            dotPulse.cancel();
            dotPulse = null;
        }
    }

    // ---- files ----

    private String nextTakeName() {
        // A take still converting is not in the repository yet, so counting
        // rows alone handed the next recording the same "Take N" as the one
        // already encoding. Count those and never reuse a live title.
        List<Take> existing = TakesRepository.all();
        List<ConversionJob> converting = ConversionJobs.active();
        int n = existing.size() + converting.size() + 1;
        while (true) {
            String candidate = "Take " + n;
            boolean taken = false;
            for (Take t : existing) {
                if (candidate.equalsIgnoreCase(t.title)) { taken = true; break; }
            }
            if (!taken) {
                for (ConversionJob j : converting) {
                    if (candidate.equalsIgnoreCase(j.title)) { taken = true; break; }
                }
            }
            if (!taken) return candidate;
            n++;
        }
    }

    private static String prettyBase(File f) {
        return f.getName().replaceFirst("\\.[^.]+$", "").replace('_', ' ');
    }

    /** Centisecond timer (one more decimal place than before). */
    static String formatTimer(long ms) {
        return TimeFmt.formatTimer(ms);
    }

    private MainActivity activity() {
        return (MainActivity) requireActivity();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

/** A single recorded take. filePath is null for built-in demo takes. */
public class Take {
    public final long id;
    public String title;
    public long durationMs;
    public long timestamp;
    public String dateLabel;
    public String sizeLabel;
    public String format;
    public boolean favorite;
    public String filePath;
    /** Where the take came from: recorded | imported | edited | demo | recovered. */
    public String origin;
    /** Last playback position, so long takes resume where they stopped. */
    public long lastPositionMs;
    /** Phase-2 marker payload (JSON), reserved so the schema never migrates. */
    public String markersJson;
    /**
     * Transient background-conversion state. Never persisted: converting
     * takes live only in the library list while their job runs.
     */
    public boolean converting;
    /** 0..100 conversion progress for {@link #converting} takes. */
    public int convProgress;
    /** Target container label (e.g. "M4A") for converting takes. */
    public String convFormat = "";
    /** Conversion job id for converting takes. */
    public String convJobId = "";
    /** Raw 32-bit float source kept until conversion finishes. */
    public String convRawPath = "";

    public Take(long id, String title, long durationMs, long timestamp,
                String sizeLabel, String format, boolean favorite, String filePath) {
        this.id = id;
        this.title = title;
        this.durationMs = durationMs;
        this.timestamp = timestamp;
        this.dateLabel = formatDate(timestamp);
        this.sizeLabel = sizeLabel;
        this.format = format;
        this.favorite = favorite;
        this.filePath = filePath;
        this.origin = "recorded";
        this.lastPositionMs = 0;
        this.markersJson = null;
    }

    public boolean hasFile() {
        return filePath != null && new java.io.File(filePath).exists();
    }

    public static String formatDuration(long ms) {
        long totalSec = ms / 1000;
        long m = totalSec / 60;
        long s = totalSec % 60;
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d", m, s);
    }

    public static String formatDate(long timestamp) {
        try {
            return new SimpleDateFormat("MMM d • h:mm a", Locale.US).format(new Date(timestamp));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
}

@Dao
public interface TakeDao {
    @Query("SELECT * FROM takes ORDER BY timestamp DESC")
    List<TakeEntity> allOrdered();

    @Query("SELECT * FROM takes WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1")
    TakeEntity byId(long id);

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    void upsert(TakeEntity e);

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    void upsertAll(List<TakeEntity> es);

    void deleteById(long id);

    @Query("DELETE FROM takes WHERE id IN (:ids)")
    void deleteByIds(List<Long> ids);

    @Query("UPDATE takes SET lastPositionMs = :pos WHERE id = :id")
    void updatePosition(long id, long pos);

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM takes")
    int count();
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.room.Database;
import androidx.room.Room;
import androidx.room.RoomDatabase;
import androidx.room.migration.Migration;
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase;

@Database(entities = {TakeEntity.class}, version = 1, exportSchema = true)
public abstract class TakeDatabase extends RoomDatabase {
    private static final String NAME = "takeone-library.db";
    private static volatile TakeDatabase instance;

    /**
     * Forward migration scaffold for future schema updates (v1 -> v2).
     * Keeps all existing `takes` rows, titles, favorites, and markers intact.
     */
    public static final Migration MIGRATION_1_2 = new Migration(1, 2) {
        @Override
        public void migrate(@NonNull SupportSQLiteDatabase database) {
            // Example for future v2 columns:
            // database.execSQL("ALTER TABLE takes ADD COLUMN folderId INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0");
        }
    };

    public abstract TakeDao takes();

    public static TakeDatabase get(Context ctx) {
        TakeDatabase db = instance;
        if (db == null) {
            synchronized (TakeDatabase.class) {
                db = instance;
                if (db == null) {
                    db = Room.databaseBuilder(ctx.getApplicationContext(),
                                    TakeDatabase.class, NAME)
                            .addMigrations(MIGRATION_1_2)
                            .fallbackToDestructiveMigrationOnDowngrade()
                            .build();
                    instance = db;
                }
            }
        }
        return db;
    }

    /** Test-only in-memory instance (Robolectric). */
    public static TakeDatabase inMemory(Context ctx) {
        return Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(ctx, TakeDatabase.class)
                .allowMainThreadQueries()
                .build();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import androidx.room.ColumnInfo;
import androidx.room.Entity;
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey;

/**
 * Persisted library row. The in-memory {@link Take} stays the UI model;
 * this is its durable mirror so the library survives process death.
 */
@Entity(tableName = "takes")
public class TakeEntity {
    @PrimaryKey
    public long id;

    public String title;
    public long durationMs;
    public long timestamp;
    public String dateLabel;
    public String sizeLabel;
    public String format;
    public boolean favorite;
    public String filePath;

    /** recorded | imported | edited | demo | recovered. */
    public String origin;

    @ColumnInfo(defaultValue = "0")
    public long lastPositionMs;

    /** Phase-2 marker payload (JSON); reserved so the schema never migrates. */
    public String markersJson;

    public static TakeEntity fromTake(Take t) {
        TakeEntity e = new TakeEntity();
        e.id = t.id;
        e.title = t.title;
        e.durationMs = t.durationMs;
        e.timestamp = t.timestamp;
        e.dateLabel = t.dateLabel;
        e.sizeLabel = t.sizeLabel;
        e.format = t.format;
        e.favorite = t.favorite;
        e.filePath = t.filePath;
        e.origin = t.origin != null ? t.origin : "recorded";
        e.lastPositionMs = t.lastPositionMs;
        e.markersJson = t.markersJson;
        return e;
    }

    public Take toTake() {
        // Old installs can hold null columns; the library dereferences
        // title/format on the main thread (filter, sort), so normalize here
        // instead of trusting history.
        Take t = new Take(id, title != null ? title : "Take", durationMs, timestamp,
                sizeLabel, format != null ? format : "M4A", favorite, filePath);
        t.origin = origin != null ? origin : "recorded";
        t.lastPositionMs = lastPositionMs;
        t.markersJson = markersJson;
        return t;
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.File;

/**
 * Single home for the stop/save pipeline: finalize the raw 32-bit float
 * capture, convert to the requested container, delete the raw on success.
 * Both the studio and the notification save path funnel through here so the
 * two can never drift apart.
 */
public final class TakeSaver {

    public interface Progress {
        void onProgress(int percent);
    }

    public static final class Result {
        public final File file;
        public final String label;
        public final long durationMs;
        public final String title;

        Result(File file, String label, long durationMs, String title) {
            this.file = file;
            this.label = label;
            this.durationMs = durationMs;
            this.title = title;
        }
    }

    private TakeSaver() {}

    /**
     * If a FLAC save comes out larger than this fraction of the float raw
     * file, the encoder is not compressing and WAV24 is the better answer.
     * Real FLAC lands far below this; only a pass-through lands above.
     */
    private static final double FLAC_MIN_RATIO = 0.9d;

    /**
     * True when a "compressed" FLAC save came out no smaller than the float
     * source, i.e. the encoder passed frames through instead of compressing.
     * Exposed for the unit test; real-encoder behaviour is covered on device.
     */
    static boolean flacLooksIneffective(long flacBytes, long rawBytes) {
        if (rawBytes <= 0) return false;
        return flacBytes > rawBytes * FLAC_MIN_RATIO;
    }

    /** Short UI label for a (preset, save-format) pair, e.g. "M4A". */
    public static String labelFor(RecordPreset preset, SaveFormat save) {
        return save.effective(preset).badge;
    }

    public static Result finalizeAndConvert(Context ctx, RecordPreset preset,
                                            SaveFormat save, Progress cb)
            throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "finalize start");
        File raw = e.finalizeRaw();
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "finalize end");
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        // Duration comes from the raw capture (compressed outputs carry no
        // PCM length of their own).
        long dur = Math.max(durationOf(raw), 1000);
        String title = e.takeName != null ? e.takeName : "";
        Result r = convertRaw(ctx, raw, title, preset, save, cb);
        // The raw float capture was scratch; remove it unless the result
        // somehow landed on the same path.
        if (r.file == null
                || !r.file.getAbsolutePath().equals(raw.getAbsolutePath())) {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
        return r;
    }

    /**
     * Converts an already-finalized raw take without touching the engine
     * session. Used by the background conversion worker; the caller owns the
     * raw lifecycle (delete on success, keep for recovery on failure).
     *
     * <p>NEW-03 fix: encodes into {@link ConversionJob#partFor(File)}
     * ({@code raw.wav.part}) first, validates the container, and only renames
     * to {@link #uniqueFinal(File, String)} at the very end. That way a
     * process kill or native encoder crash mid-conversion never leaves a
     * half-written {@code .m4a}/{@code .wav} in {@code takes/} for startup
     * reconcile to adopt as a corrupt take, and WAV conversions interrupted
     * by process death leave a real {@code .part} file for
     * {@link ConversionService#resumeWavConvert} to resume.
     */
    public static Result convertRaw(Context ctx, File raw, String title,
                                    RecordPreset preset, SaveFormat save,
                                    Progress cb) throws Exception {
        if (raw == null || !raw.exists()) throw new IllegalStateException("empty");
        long dur = Math.max(durationOf(raw), 1000);
        SaveFormat eff = save.effective(preset);
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start " + eff.id);
        File part = ConversionJob.partFor(raw);
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        part.delete();
        File fin = null;
        try {
            switch (eff) {
                case WAV16:
                    FormatConverter.toWav16(raw, part, pct -> post(cb, pct));
                    break;
                case WAV24:
                    FormatConverter.toWav24(raw, part, pct -> post(cb, pct));
                    break;
                case WAV32:
                    FormatConverter.toWav32(raw, part, pct -> post(cb, pct));
                    break;
                case AMR_NB:
                    FormatConverter.toAmr(raw, part, false, pct -> post(cb, pct));
                    break;
                case AMR_WB:
                    FormatConverter.toAmr(raw, part, true, pct -> post(cb, pct));
                    break;
                case FLAC:
                    FormatConverter.toFlac(raw, part, pct -> post(cb, pct));
                    break;
                case OPUS:
                    FormatConverter.toOpus(raw, part, preset.aacBitrate,
                            pct -> post(cb, pct));
                    break;
                case M4A:
                case AUTO:
                default:
                    FormatConverter.toM4a(raw, part, preset.aacBitrate,
                            pct -> post(cb, pct));
                    break;
            }
            // A FLAC encoder that doesn't actually compress would silently
            // hand back a near-full-size file under a lossless-compressed
            // label. Some devices do that, so measure rather than trust: fall
            // back to 24-bit WAV, which is lossless by definition.
            if (eff == SaveFormat.FLAC && flacLooksIneffective(part.length(),
                    raw.length())) {
                long bloated = part.length();
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                part.delete();
                FormatConverter.toWav24(raw, part, null);
                eff = SaveFormat.WAV24;
                CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "flac ineffective ("
                        + bloated + " bytes), fell back to wav24");
            }
            // Validate the finished .part container before exposing it under a
            // real audio extension in takes/.
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(part, eff);
            // Report 100% BEFORE the rename: post() can throw
            // CancellationException (via awaitRecordingIdle), and past this
            // point fin exists on disk — a cancel here must not leave a
            // converted file behind that reconcile() would later adopt.
            post(cb, 100);
            fin = uniqueFinal(raw, eff.extension());
            if (!part.renameTo(fin)) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("adopt part failed");
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            // Preserve the .part on an Android 15 FGS timeout for resumable
            // WAV formats so the restarted job can pick up where it stopped.
            boolean keepWavPart = t.getClass().getSimpleName().contains("Timeout")
                    && (eff == SaveFormat.WAV16 || eff == SaveFormat.WAV24
                    || eff == SaveFormat.WAV32);
            if (!keepWavPart && part.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                part.delete();
            }
            if (fin != null && fin.exists()) {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                fin.delete();
            }
            // A4-01: close the stage even on failure/cancel. Without this an
            // unterminated "convert start" makes maybeHealCrashedEncoder()
            // blame a native codec crash on the next launch and downgrade
            // the save format for no reason. Catch Throwable, not Exception:
            // native codec failures throw Error, which must not bypass the
            // cleanup and breadcrumb below.
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert end " + eff.id + " (failed)");
            if (t instanceof Error) throw (Error) t;
            if (t instanceof Exception) throw (Exception) t;
            throw new IllegalStateException(t);
        }
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert end " + eff.id);
        return new Result(fin, eff.badge, dur, title);
    }

    private static void post(Progress cb, int pct) {
        if (cb == null) return;
        try {
            cb.onProgress(pct);
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            // Cancellation (and only cancellation — normal progress
            // callbacks never throw) must propagate so a cancelled
            // background job stops at the next progress tick instead of
            // running to completion.
            throw e;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    static long durationOf(File f) {
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(f);
            long samples = info.dataBytes / 4 / Math.max(1, info.channels);
            return samples * 1000L / Math.max(1, info.sampleRate);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return 1000;
        }
    }

    static File uniqueFinal(File raw, String ext) {
        File dir = raw.getParentFile();
        String name = raw.getName();
        String base = name.endsWith(".raw.wav")
                ? name.substring(0, name.length() - ".raw.wav".length())
                : name.replaceFirst("\\.[^.]+$", "");
        File c = new File(dir, base + "." + ext);
        if (!c.exists()) return c;
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            File n = new File(dir, base + " (" + i + ")." + ext);
            if (!n.exists()) return n;
            i++;
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.animation.ValueAnimator;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.SeekBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public class TakesAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<TakesAdapter.Vh> {

    public interface Listener {
        void onCardClick(Take take);
        void onCardLongPress(Take take);
        void onPlay(Take take);
        void onFavorite(Take take);
        void onRename(Take take);
        void onExport(Take take);
        void onEdit(Take take);
        void onDelete(Take take);
        void onCancelConversion(Take take);
        void onSeek(Take take, long posMs);
    }

    private final Listener listener;
    private List<Take> takes = new ArrayList<>();
    private long expandedId = -1;
    private long playingId = -1;
    private boolean paused = false;
    private boolean selectionMode = false;
    private Set<Long> selected = new HashSet<>();
    private final Map<Long, Long> progressMap = new HashMap<>();

    /** Selected cards shrink so multi-select reads at a glance. */
    private static final float SEL_SCALE = 0.92f;
    /** SeekBar resolution — high enough that progress looks continuous. */
    private static final int SCRUB_MAX = 10000;

    public TakesAdapter(Listener listener) {
        this.listener = listener;
        setHasStableIds(true);
    }

    @Override
    public long getItemId(int position) {
        // Stable ids make RecyclerView query this against its own (possibly
        // stale) position bookkeeping while a rebind is in flight. A
        // converting card that disappears on completion shortens the list, and
        // the out-of-range read used to crash the app right as the user was
        // looking at the finished take.
        if (position < 0 || position >= takes.size()) {
            return RecyclerView.NO_ID;
        }
        return takes.get(position).id;
    }

    public void setTakes(List<Take> takes) {
        setTakesAndState(takes, playingId, paused, selected, selectionMode);
    }

    /**
     * Applies list and playback/selection state in a single pass, so a refresh
     * never issues {@code notifyDataSetChanged()} followed by
     * {@code notifyItemChanged()} in the same UI turn. Under
     * {@code setHasStableIds(true)} with an id that just changed sign (a
     * converting card becoming its finished Room take) that pairing is what
     * drove RecyclerView into an inconsistent-adapter-state crash.
     */
    public void setTakesAndState(List<Take> takes, long playingId,
                                 boolean paused, Set<Long> selected,
                                 boolean selectionMode) {
        // An expanded converting card (negative id) is replaced by a real
        // take when its job finishes. Hand the open state over so the card the
        // user opened stays open instead of silently snapping shut.
        if (expandedId < 0) {
            String rawPath = ConversionJobs.rawForTakeId(expandedId);
            Long completed = rawPath != null
                    ? ConversionJobs.completedTakeIdForRaw(rawPath) : null;
            if (completed != null) expandedId = completed;
        }
        this.takes = takes;
        this.playingId = playingId;
        this.paused = paused;
        this.selected = selected;
        this.selectionMode = selectionMode;
        // Drop stale expanded refs that are no longer visible.
        boolean expAlive = false;
        for (Take t : takes) {
            if (t.id == expandedId) expAlive = true;
        }
        if (!expAlive) expandedId = -1;
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    /**
     * Keeps a recycled or failing holder from animating a view that is no
     * longer attached: a running height animator calling requestLayout() on a
     * detached holder corrupts RecyclerView's layout pass.
     */
    @Override
    public void onViewRecycled(@NonNull Vh h) {
        cancelHolderAnimations(h);
        super.onViewRecycled(h);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onFailedToRecycleView(@NonNull Vh h) {
        cancelHolderAnimations(h);
        return super.onFailedToRecycleView(h);
    }

    private void cancelHolderAnimations(Vh h) {
        if (h == null) return;
        Object pending = h.expanded.getTag();
        if (pending instanceof ValueAnimator) {
            ((ValueAnimator) pending).cancel();
        }
        h.expanded.setTag(null);
        h.expanded.getLayoutParams().height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        h.expanded.setAlpha(1f);
        h.cardRoot.animate().cancel();
        h.cardRoot.setScaleX(1f);
        h.cardRoot.setScaleY(1f);
        h.playBtn.animate().cancel();
        h.fav.animate().cancel();
        h.chevron.animate().cancel();
    }

    public void setExpandedId(long id) {
        long old = expandedId;
        expandedId = id;
        notifyForId(old);
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    public long getExpandedId() {
        return expandedId;
    }

    public void collapseAll() {
        long old = expandedId;
        expandedId = -1;
        notifyForId(old);
    }

    public void setPlayingId(long id) {
        long old = playingId;
        playingId = id;
        notifyForId(old);
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    public void setPaused(boolean p) {
        paused = p;
        notifyForId(playingId);
    }

    /** Single-notify reset of the playing state (avoids double-rebind flicker). */
    public void clearPlaying() {
        long old = playingId;
        playingId = -1;
        paused = false;
        notifyForId(old);
    }

    /**
     * Smoothly expands {@code id} (and smoothly collapses any previously
     * expanded card) using the same height/alpha transition as tapping the
     * card body, without triggering a full ViewHolder rebind.
     */
    public void expandDirectIfNeeded(RecyclerView rv, long id) {
        if (rv == null) {
            setExpandedId(id);
            return;
        }
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder curVh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (expandedId == id) {
            if (curVh instanceof Vh) {
                Vh h = (Vh) curVh;
                if (h.expanded.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) return;
                animateExpand(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            }
            return;
        }
        toggleExpandedDirect(rv, id);
    }

    /**
     * Updates the playing/paused state and repaints the play/pause button icon
     * directly on visible ViewHolder(s) without notifyItemChanged(), so an
     * in-flight smooth expand animation is never interrupted or snapped.
     */
    public void paintPlayState(RecyclerView rv, long newPlayingId,
                               boolean isPaused) {
        long oldPlayingId = this.playingId;
        this.playingId = newPlayingId;
        this.paused = isPaused;
        if (rv == null) {
            notifyForId(oldPlayingId);
            notifyForId(newPlayingId);
            return;
        }
        if (oldPlayingId != -1 && oldPlayingId != newPlayingId) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder oldVh =
                    rv.findViewHolderForItemId(oldPlayingId);
            if (oldVh instanceof Vh) {
                ((Vh) oldVh).play.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_play);
            } else {
                notifyForId(oldPlayingId);
            }
        }
        if (newPlayingId != -1) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder newVh =
                    rv.findViewHolderForItemId(newPlayingId);
            if (newVh instanceof Vh) {
                ((Vh) newVh).play.setImageResource(isPaused
                        ? R.drawable.ic_play : R.drawable.ic_pause);
            } else {
                notifyForId(newPlayingId);
            }
        }
    }

    public void refreshItem(long id) {
        notifyForId(id);
    }

    /** Update only the heart artwork, no rebind (no flicker on favorite taps). */
    public void paintFavorite(RecyclerView rv, long id, boolean fav) {
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            h.fav.setImageResource(fav ? R.drawable.ic_heart_filled : R.drawable.ic_heart);
            h.fav.setAlpha(fav ? 1f : 0.55f);
        }
    }

    /** Toggle the expanded section with a smooth height + fade animation. */
    public void toggleExpandedDirect(RecyclerView rv, long id) {
        boolean expand = expandedId != id;
        // Smoothly collapse any previously open card.
        if (expandedId != -1 && expandedId != id) {
            RecyclerView.ViewHolder oldVh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(expandedId);
            if (oldVh instanceof Vh) {
                Vh old = (Vh) oldVh;
                animateCollapse(old.expanded, old.chevron);
            }
        }
        expandedId = expand ? id : -1;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            // Drop any stuck pressed/focus glow on the scrubber when it (re)appears.
            h.scrubber.setPressed(false);
            h.scrubber.clearFocus();
            h.scrubber.jumpDrawablesToCurrentState();
            if (expand) {
                Take t = findTake(id);
                if (t != null) {
                    h.totalTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs));
                    if (t.id != playingId) {
                        h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(0));
                        if (!h.tracking) h.scrubber.setProgress(0);
                    } else {
                        // A4-12: re-expanding the card that is playing (even
                        // paused) reset its readout to 00:00 while the audio
                        // kept its position.
                        long pos = progressMap != null && progressMap
                                .containsKey(t.id)
                                ? progressMap.get(t.id) : 0L;
                        h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(pos));
                        if (!h.tracking) {
                            h.scrubber.setProgress((int) Math.min(SCRUB_MAX,
                                    pos * SCRUB_MAX / Math.max(1L, t.durationMs)));
                        }
                    }
                    h.btnExport.setVisibility((t.hasFile() || t.converting)
                            ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                }
                animateExpand(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            } else {
                animateCollapse(h.expanded, h.chevron);
            }
        }
    }

    private void animateExpand(final View expanded, final View ignored) {
        // Cancel any in-flight height animation.
        Object tag = expanded.getTag();
        if (tag instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) tag).cancel();
        expanded.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        expanded.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(
                        ((View) expanded.getParent()).getWidth(),
                        View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(0, View.MeasureSpec.UNSPECIFIED));
        final int targetH = expanded.getMeasuredHeight();
        expanded.getLayoutParams().height = 0;
        expanded.setAlpha(0f);
        expanded.requestLayout();
        ValueAnimator anim = ValueAnimator.ofInt(0, targetH);
        anim.setDuration(300);
        anim.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.3f));
        anim.addUpdateListener(a -> {
            int val = (int) a.getAnimatedValue();
            expanded.getLayoutParams().height = val;
            expanded.setAlpha(Math.min(1f, val / (float) Math.max(1, targetH)));
            expanded.requestLayout();
        });
        anim.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationEnd(android.animation.Animator animation) {
                expanded.getLayoutParams().height =
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
                expanded.setAlpha(1f);
                expanded.requestLayout();
                expanded.setTag(null);
            }
        });
        expanded.setTag(anim);
        anim.start();
    }

    private void animateCollapse(final View expanded, final View ignored) {
        if (expanded.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) return;
        Object tag = expanded.getTag();
        if (tag instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) tag).cancel();
        final int startH = expanded.getHeight() > 0
                ? expanded.getHeight() : expanded.getMeasuredHeight();
        if (startH <= 0) {
            expanded.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }
        ValueAnimator anim = ValueAnimator.ofInt(startH, 0);
        anim.setDuration(240);
        anim.setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f));
        anim.addUpdateListener(a -> {
            int val = (int) a.getAnimatedValue();
            expanded.getLayoutParams().height = val;
            expanded.setAlpha(val / (float) Math.max(1, startH));
            expanded.requestLayout();
        });
        anim.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void onAnimationEnd(android.animation.Animator animation) {
                expanded.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                expanded.getLayoutParams().height =
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
                expanded.setAlpha(1f);
                expanded.requestLayout();
                expanded.setTag(null);
            }
        });
        expanded.setTag(anim);
        anim.start();
    }

    /** True while the user is actively dragging this take's scrubber. */
    public boolean isTracking(long id, RecyclerView rv) {
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = rv.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        return vh instanceof Vh && ((Vh) vh).tracking;
    }

    private Take findTake(long id) {
        for (Take t : takes) {
            if (t.id == id) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public void setSelection(Set<Long> selected, boolean mode) {
        Set<Long> copy = new HashSet<>(selected);
        boolean modeChanged = this.selectionMode != mode;
        boolean contentChanged = !this.selected.equals(copy);
        this.selected = copy;
        this.selectionMode = mode;
        // Any change — mode flip, single toggle, or select-all — rebinds every
        // visible row, so badges, backgrounds and the shrink always converge
        // on the tapped state in one pass. No walk-then-rebind double driver,
        // so effects can never land a tap late or on the wrong card.
        if (modeChanged || contentChanged) {
            notifyDataSetChanged();
        }
    }

    private void applySelectionScale(Vh h, boolean isSel) {
        float target = isSel ? SEL_SCALE : 1f;
        View card = h.cardRoot;
        // Stateless: always converge from the ACTUAL current scale to the
        // target. No remembered per-view state, so rapid taps, recycling and
        // mode exits can never desync — every bind ends exactly at target,
        // gliding when there is distance to cover, snapping when already home.
        card.animate().cancel();
        if (Math.abs(card.getScaleX() - target) < 0.002f
                && Math.abs(card.getScaleY() - target) < 0.002f) {
            card.setScaleX(target);
            card.setScaleY(target);
            return;
        }
        card.animate()
                .scaleX(target).scaleY(target)
                .setDuration(160)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }

    private void notifyForId(long id) {
        if (id == -1) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < takes.size(); i++) {
            if (takes.get(i).id == id) {
                notifyItemChanged(i);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private void pressBounce(View v) {
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.setScaleX(0.94f);
        v.setScaleY(0.94f);
        v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(180)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                .start();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public Vh onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
                .inflate(R.layout.item_take, parent, false);
        Vh holder = new Vh(v);
        // Press feedback on everything tappable (scrubber excluded — it drags).
        // Icons get the softer variant so they give without flashing; the card
        // uses a ripple foreground so it never fights the selection scale.
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.fav, 0.9f);
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.chevron, 0.88f);
        PressAnim.applySoft(holder.playBtn, 0.92f);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnRename);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnExport);
        PressAnim.apply(holder.btnDelete);
        return holder;
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull Vh h, int position) {
        Take t = takes.get(position);
        boolean expanded = t.id == expandedId;
        boolean playing = t.id == playingId;
        boolean isSel = selectionMode && selected.contains(t.id);

        h.cardRoot.setBackgroundResource(isSel ? R.drawable.bg_card_selected : R.drawable.bg_card);
        h.selectBadge.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        h.selectBadge.setImageResource(isSel ? R.drawable.ic_checked : R.drawable.bg_select_ring);
        h.selectBadge.setColorFilter(isSel ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672);
        h.selectBadge.setAlpha(isSel ? 1f : 0.5f);

        // Deterministic selection shrink. Every bind converges the card to the
        // exact scale its selection state demands, so recycled holders can
        // never carry a stale size.
        applySelectionScale(h, isSel);

        h.title.setText(t.title);
        if (t.converting) {
            h.meta.setText(h.itemView.getContext().getString(
                    R.string.conv_card_status, t.convFormat, t.convProgress));
        } else {
            h.meta.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs) + "  •  " + t.dateLabel + "  •  " + t.sizeLabel);
        }
        h.formatBadge.setText(t.format);
        h.play.setImageResource((playing && !paused) ? R.drawable.ic_pause : R.drawable.ic_play);
        h.play.setContentDescription(h.itemView.getContext().getString(R.string.cd_play));

        // Professional heart: outline idle, filled red favorite, with a pop on tap.
        // Converting rows have no stored row to favorite: hide the control.
        h.fav.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
        h.fav.setImageResource(t.favorite ? R.drawable.ic_heart_filled : R.drawable.ic_heart);
        h.fav.setAlpha(t.favorite ? 1f : 0.55f);
        h.fav.setColorFilter(null);

        // Header edit shortcut (replaces the old expand chevron; tapping the
        // card itself still expands/collapses, so nothing is lost).
        h.chevron.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_pencil);
        h.chevron.setRotation(0f);
        h.chevron.setAlpha((t.hasFile() || t.converting) ? 0.85f : 0.35f);
        h.chevron.setContentDescription(
                h.itemView.getContext().getString(R.string.cd_edit));
        // Reset any mid-animation height leftovers from recycled holders.
        Object pending = h.expanded.getTag();
        if (pending instanceof ValueAnimator) ((ValueAnimator) pending).cancel();
        h.expanded.setTag(null);
        h.expanded.getLayoutParams().height = ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        h.expanded.setAlpha(1f);
        h.expanded.setVisibility(expanded ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        // Detach first: setProgress() on a rebound holder fires the PREVIOUS
        // take's listener, which wrote the old take's position (and seeked it).
        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(null);
        if (expanded) {
            h.totalTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(t.durationMs));
            long shown = playing ? progressMap.getOrDefault(t.id, 0L) : 0L;
            if (!h.tracking) {
                h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(shown));
                h.scrubber.setProgress(t.durationMs <= 0 ? 0
                        : (int) (shown * SCRUB_MAX / t.durationMs));
            }
        }
        // Conversion chrome is bound on every pass — expanding only animates
        // visibility, it never rebinds, so expanded-only state set here
        // would otherwise show whatever a recycled holder carried. The
        // progress stays visible even collapsed so conversions read at a
        // glance; only rename is ever hidden (no stored row to rename).
        h.btnExport.setVisibility((t.hasFile() || t.converting)
                ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        // Renaming is a pure metadata change, so it is safe while the take
        // converts: the worker inserts the finished file under this title.
        h.btnRename.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        h.convStatus.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        h.convProgress.setVisibility(t.converting ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (t.converting) {
            h.convStatus.setText(h.itemView.getContext().getString(
                    R.string.conv_card_status, t.convFormat, t.convProgress));
            h.convProgress.setProgress(t.convProgress);
        }

        h.cardRoot.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onCardClick(t));
        h.cardRoot.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
            listener.onCardLongPress(t);
            return true;
        });
        h.playBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            v.animate().cancel();
            v.setScaleX(0.9f);
            v.setScaleY(0.9f);
            v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(200)
                    .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                    .start();
            listener.onPlay(t);
        });
        h.fav.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Soft nudge on a falloff curve — no hard overshoot, no flash.
            PressAnim.nudge(v, 1.14f);
            listener.onFavorite(t);
        });
        h.chevron.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onEdit(t);
        });
        h.btnRename.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onRename(t);
        });
        h.btnExport.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            listener.onExport(t);
        });
        h.btnDelete.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pressBounce(v);
            if (t.converting) listener.onCancelConversion(t);
            else listener.onDelete(t);
        });

        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(null);
        h.scrubber.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener() {
            @Override
            public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar s, int progress, boolean fromUser) {
                if (fromUser && h.tracking) {
                    long pos = t.durationMs * progress / SCRUB_MAX;
                    h.curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(pos));
                }
            }

            @Override public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar s) {
                h.tracking = true;
            }

            @Override public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar s) {
                h.tracking = false;
                long pos = t.durationMs * s.getProgress() / SCRUB_MAX;
                listener.onSeek(t, pos);
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return takes.size();
    }

    /** Direct conversion-progress paint without rebind. */
    public void paintConvProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, int pct,
                                  String status) {
        int clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
        Take t = findTake(id);
        if (t != null) {
            t.convProgress = clamped;
            if (status != null) t.dateLabel = status;
        }
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            Vh h = (Vh) vh;
            if (h.convProgress != null) {
                h.convProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                h.convProgress.setProgress(clamped);
            }
            if (status != null) {
                if (h.convStatus != null) h.convStatus.setText(status);
                if (h.meta != null) h.meta.setText(status);
            }
        } else {
            notifyForId(id);
        }
    }

    /** Direct progress paint without rebind (called ~10x/sec while playing). */
    public void paintProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, long posMs) {
        if (id != -1) progressMap.put(id, posMs);
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh) {
            ((Vh) vh).applyProgress(posMs);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Set the stored position for a take (e.g. 0 when (re)starting playback)
     * so a rebind never snaps to a stale near-end value. Also paints it live
     * when the holder is visible and the user isn't dragging.
     */
    public void setProgress(RecyclerView list, long id, long posMs) {
        progressMap.put(id, posMs);
        if (list == null) return;
        RecyclerView.ViewHolder vh = list.findViewHolderForItemId(id);
        if (vh instanceof Vh && !((Vh) vh).tracking) {
            ((Vh) vh).applyProgress(posMs);
        }
    }

    public class Vh extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final View cardRoot;
        final ImageView selectBadge;
        final View playBtn;
        final ImageView play;
        final TextView title;
        final TextView meta;
        final TextView formatBadge;
        final ImageView fav;
        final ImageView chevron;
        final LinearLayout expanded;
        final TextView curTime;
        final TextView totalTime;
        final SeekBar scrubber;
        final View btnRename;
        final View btnExport;
        final View btnDelete;
        final TextView convStatus;
        final android.widget.ProgressBar convProgress;
        boolean tracking = false;

        Vh(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            cardRoot = itemView.findViewById(R.id.cardRoot);
            selectBadge = itemView.findViewById(R.id.selectBadge);
            playBtn = itemView.findViewById(R.id.playBtn);
            play = itemView.findViewById(R.id.playIcon);
            title = itemView.findViewById(R.id.takeTitle);
            meta = itemView.findViewById(R.id.takeMeta);
            formatBadge = itemView.findViewById(R.id.formatBadge);
            fav = itemView.findViewById(R.id.favIcon);
            chevron = itemView.findViewById(R.id.chevron);
            expanded = itemView.findViewById(R.id.expanded);
            curTime = itemView.findViewById(R.id.curTime);
            totalTime = itemView.findViewById(R.id.totalTime);
            scrubber = itemView.findViewById(R.id.scrubber);
            btnRename = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnRename);
            btnExport = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnExport);
            btnDelete = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnDelete);
            convStatus = itemView.findViewById(R.id.convStatus);
            convProgress = itemView.findViewById(R.id.convProgress);
        }

        void applyProgress(long posMs) {
            int pos = getBindingAdapterPosition();
            if (pos == RecyclerView.NO_POSITION || pos < 0
                    || pos >= takes.size()) {
                return;
            }
            Take t = takes.get(pos);
            progressMap.put(t.id, posMs);
            if (tracking) return;
            if (t.durationMs > 0 && scrubber != null) {
                // Clamp so completion always lands exactly on the end.
                int p = (int) (posMs * SCRUB_MAX / t.durationMs);
                scrubber.setProgress(Math.min(p, SCRUB_MAX));
            }
            if (curTime != null) curTime.setText(Take.formatDuration(posMs));
        }
    }
}
