package com.example.hello;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.app.Dialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable;
import android.text.InputType;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.Window;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Three-way value control: minus, value, plus.
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>Tap</b> minus/plus to step the value.</li>
 *   <li><b>Double-tap the value</b> to type an exact number.</li>
 *   <li><b>Tap and scroll left/right</b> anywhere on the control to scrub the
 *       value continuously, without lifting off.</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * A single tap deliberately does nothing: no popup list and no keyboard.
 * Used for teleprompter text size / speed / words-per-line, the FX rack and
 * waveform zoom, so the same muscle memory applies everywhere.
 */
public class TeleValue extends LinearLayout {

    public interface OnValueChanged {
        void onValueChanged(int value);
    }

    /**
     * Continuous scrub notifications. Unlike {@link OnValueChanged}, these fire
     * while the finger is still down; the final committed value is reported
     * through {@link #onScrubFinished(int)} rather than the discrete listener.
     */
    public interface OnScrubListener {
        void onScrubValueChanged(int value);
        void onScrubFinished(int value);
    }

    private static final int DOUBLE_TAP_MS = 280;

    private int min;
    private int max = 100;
    private int step = 1;
    private int value;
    private String unit = "";

    public interface StepRule {
        int stepFor(int currentValue, int direction);
    }

    /**
     * Optional presentation override so a consumer can render dB, Hz or ratio
     * labels without subclassing. When unset, the numeric value is joined
     * with the configured unit.
     */
    public interface ValueFormatter {
        String formatValueText(int value);
    }

    private int valueScale = 1;
    private StepRule stepRule;
    private ValueFormatter valueFormatter;
    private Runnable paywallInterceptor;

    public void setValueFormatter(ValueFormatter formatter) {
        this.valueFormatter = formatter;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    /**
     * When non-null, marks this control as locked by the paywall on subsequent
     * recordings: visually dimmed ({@code alpha = 0.35f}) while keeping its
     * minus, plus, and value buttons clickable so any tap or scrub opens the
     * paywall immediately.
     */
    public void setPaywallInterceptor(Runnable interceptor) {
        this.paywallInterceptor = interceptor;
        setAlpha(interceptor != null ? 0.35f : 1f);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    /**
     * Fixed-point divisor for high-resolution controls (e.g. 100 for basis
     * points where 10000 = 100% and 92 = 0.92%). Default is 1 (integer).
     */
    public void setValueScale(int scale) {
        this.valueScale = Math.max(1, scale);
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    public int getValueScale() {
        return valueScale;
    }

    public void setStepRule(StepRule rule) {
        this.stepRule = rule;
    }

    private int effectiveStep(int fromValue, int dir) {
        if (stepRule != null) {
            return Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(fromValue, dir));
        }
        return Math.max(1, step);
    }

    private String formatNumberPart(int v) {
        if (valueScale <= 1) {
            return String.valueOf(v);
        }
        if (v % valueScale == 0) {
            return String.valueOf(v / valueScale);
        }
        double d = v / (double) valueScale;
        if (Math.abs((long) v) >= 10L * valueScale) {
            String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", d);
            if (s.endsWith(".0")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 2);
            return s;
        }
        String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", d);
        while (s.contains(".") && (s.endsWith("0") || s.endsWith("."))) {
            if (s.endsWith(".")) {
                s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
                break;
            }
            s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        }
        return s;
    }

    private String formatValueText(int v) {
        if (valueFormatter != null) {
            return valueFormatter.formatValueText(v);
        }
        String num = formatNumberPart(v);
        return unit.isEmpty() ? num : num + unit;
    }

    private OnValueChanged listener;
    private OnScrubListener scrubListener;

    private TextView caption;
    private LinearLayout controlRow;
    private boolean stacked;
    private TextView minus;
    private TextView plus;
    private TextView label;

    private float downX;
    private boolean scrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubEnabled;
    private float downY;
    private int activePointerId = -1;
    private boolean movedBeyondSlop;
    private int dragStartValue;
    private float dragStartPos;
    private long lastTapAt = -DOUBLE_TAP_MS - 1;
    private boolean compact;
    private Dialog keyboardDialog;

    public TeleValue(Context context) {
        this(context, null);
    }

    /** Required for XML inflation; without it the studio screen crashes. */
    public TeleValue(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        build(context);
    }

    private void build(Context ctx) {
        setOrientation(VERTICAL);
        setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);

        caption = new TextView(ctx);
        caption.setTextSize(8.5f);
        caption.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        caption.setTextColor(0xFF8A93A0);
        caption.setSingleLine(true);
        caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        addView(caption, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        row.setOrientation(HORIZONTAL);
        row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
        row.setPadding(dp(ctx, 2), 0, dp(ctx, 2), 0);
        controlRow = row;

        minus = button(ctx, "−");
        plus = button(ctx, "+");

        label = new TextView(ctx);
        label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        label.setTextSize(12);
        label.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        label.setSingleLine(true);
        label.setMaxLines(1);
        label.setContentDescription("value");
        // The system long-press listener is intentionally not used: Android
        // would schedule the keyboard as soon as the finger rests, even if the
        // user then begins a scrub. A value hold is detected below instead.
        label.setLongClickable(false);

        row.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                        LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
        row.addView(label, lp);
        row.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));

        addView(row, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dp(ctx, 26)));

        minus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, -1);
            int next = value - s;
            // If stepping down lands within one step of min, snap to min.
            if (value > min && next < min) next = min;
            setValue(next, true);
        });
        plus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, 1);
            setValue(value + s, true);
        });

        // A single tap is intentionally inert when unlocked. Only a double-tap
        // opens the exact-value keyboard; when paywall-locked, any tap opens
        // the paywall.
        label.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (scrubbing || movedBeyondSlop) return;
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
            if (now - lastTapAt < DOUBLE_TAP_MS) {
                lastTapAt = 0;
                showKeyboardInput();
            } else {
                lastTapAt = now;
            }
        });
    }

    private void updateStepperButtons() {
        if (minus == null || plus == null) return;
        if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
            minus.setEnabled(true);
            minus.setClickable(true);
            minus.setAlpha(1f);
            plus.setEnabled(true);
            plus.setClickable(true);
            plus.setAlpha(1f);
            return;
        }
        boolean canDec = value > min;
        boolean canInc = value < max;
        minus.setEnabled(canDec);
        minus.setClickable(canDec);
        minus.setAlpha(canDec ? 1f : 0.35f);
        plus.setEnabled(canInc);
        plus.setClickable(canInc);
        plus.setAlpha(canInc ? 1f : 0.35f);
    }

    private void clearChildPress() {
        if (minus != null) {
            minus.cancelLongPress();
            minus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (plus != null) {
            plus.cancelLongPress();
            plus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.cancelLongPress();
            label.setPressed(false);
        }
    }

    private TextView button(Context ctx, String glyph) {
        TextView t = new TextView(ctx);
        t.setText(glyph);
        t.setTextSize(15);
        t.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        t.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        t.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_round_btn);
        t.setContentDescription(glyph.equals("+") ? "increase" : "decrease");
        return t;
    }

    public boolean isStacked() {
        return stacked;
    }

    /** Small name shown above the stepper, so controls need no external label. */
    public void setCaption(String s) {
        if (caption == null) return;
        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) {
            caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        } else {
            caption.setText(s);
            caption.setVisibility(VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Stacks minus/value/plus vertically for a narrow rail, such as waveform
     * zoom. Gesture handling is unchanged: a horizontal scrub still adjusts
     * the value, while taps retain their four behaviours.
     */
    public void setStacked(boolean stacked) {
        if (controlRow == null || minus == null || label == null || plus == null) {
            return;
        }
        this.stacked = stacked;
        int button = dp(getContext(), 26);
        int height = dp(getContext(), 24);
        controlRow.setOrientation(stacked ? VERTICAL : HORIZONTAL);
        controlRow.setGravity(stacked ? Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
                : Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        controlRow.removeAllViews();
        if (stacked) {
            // The row must wrap its content: it was built for a single 24dp
            // horizontal strip, which would crush a vertical stack to 2px.
            // High-resolution labels ("0.92%") also need a slightly more
            // compact text size to fit cleanly inside the 40dp rail.
            // Plus sits on top, minus at the bottom, matching the drag
            // direction (up increases, down decreases).
            label.setTextSize(10.5f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(getContext(), 20)));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        } else {
            label.setTextSize(12f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, height));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(0,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    /**
     * Compacts the control for dense FX cards: smaller caption, label and
     * stepper buttons without changing its gestures. Ignored in stacked mode
     * because that rail already has its own sizing.
     */
    public void setCompact(boolean compact) {
        this.compact = compact;
        Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (caption != null) {
            caption.setTextSize(compact ? 8f : 8.5f);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.setTextSize(compact ? 11f : 12f);
        }
        if (!stacked && controlRow != null
                && minus != null && plus != null) {
            int size = dp(ctx, compact ? 22 : 26);
            minus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            plus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            if (controlRow.getLayoutParams() instanceof LayoutParams) {
                LayoutParams rp = (LayoutParams)
                        controlRow.getLayoutParams();
                rp.height = size;
                controlRow.setLayoutParams(rp);
            }
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean isCompact() {
        return compact;
    }

    /** Values the wheel may show when {@code step > 1}, padded to range. */
    private int[] steppedValues() {
        java.util.ArrayList<Integer> out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (stepRule != null) {
            int cur = min;
            out.add(cur);
            while (cur < max) {
                int s = Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(cur, 1));
                int next = (cur == min && s > 1)
                        ? ((cur / s) + 1) * s
                        : cur + s;
                if (next <= cur) next = cur + 1;
                if (next >= max) {
                    out.add(max);
                    break;
                }
                out.add(next);
                cur = next;
            }
        } else {
            int rem = ((min % step) + step) % step;
            int first = (rem == 0) ? min : Math.min(max, min + (step - rem));
            if (first > min && (valueScale > 1 || min < 0)) {
                out.add(min);
            }
            for (int v = first; v <= max; v += step) {
                out.add(v);
            }
            if (!out.isEmpty() && out.get(out.size() - 1) < max) {
                out.add(max);
            }
            if (out.isEmpty()) {
                for (int v = min; v <= max; v++) out.add(v);
            }
        }
        int[] arr = new int[out.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) arr[i] = out.get(i);
        return arr;
    }

    private String[] steppedLabels() {
        int[] vals = steppedValues();
        String[] out = new String[vals.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
            out[i] = formatValueText(vals[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Test hook: the wheel labels for the configured step. */
    String[] steppedLabelsForTest() {
        return steppedLabels();
    }

    public void configure(int min, int max, int step, int value, String unit) {
        this.min = min;
        this.max = max;
        this.step = Math.max(1, step);
        this.unit = unit == null ? "" : unit;
        setValue(value, false);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    public void setOnValueChanged(OnValueChanged l) {
        listener = l;
    }

    public void setOnScrubListener(OnScrubListener l) {
        scrubListener = l;
    }

    /**
     * Allows vertical drags to scrub the value (drag up increases), reported
     * through the same {@link OnScrubListener} as horizontal scrubs. Off by
     * default so a vertical pass over an unrelated control stays inert.
     */
    public void setVerticalScrub(boolean enabled) {
        verticalScrubEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public int getValue() {
        return value;
    }

    public int getMin() {
        return min;
    }

    private int clamp(int v) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
    }

    public void setValue(int v, boolean notify) {
        int nv = clamp(v);
        String formatted = formatValueText(nv);
        if (nv == value && label != null
                && formatted.contentEquals(label.getText())) {
            updateStepperButtons();
            return;
        }
        value = nv;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatted);
        }
        updateStepperButtons();
        if (notify && listener != null) listener.onValueChanged(value);
    }

    // ---- keyboard ----

    private String captionTitle() {
        CharSequence cap = caption != null ? caption.getText() : null;
        if (cap != null && cap.length() > 0) {
            return cap.toString();
        }
        return getContext().getString(R.string.tele_value_picker);
    }

    private static void styleModalWindow(Dialog dialog) {
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(dialog);
    }

    /** Overridable presentation hook so gesture routing is unit-testable. */
    protected void showKeyboardInput() {
        final Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (keyboardDialog != null && keyboardDialog.isShowing()) return;
        try {
            final Dialog d = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
            keyboardDialog = d;
            d.setOnDismissListener(dd -> {
                if (keyboardDialog == d) keyboardDialog = null;
            });
            d.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

            int pad = dp(ctx, 20);
            LinearLayout box = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            box.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            box.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 21) {
                box.setElevation(dp(ctx, 16));
            }
            box.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

            TextView title = new TextView(ctx);
            title.setText(captionTitle());
            title.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            title.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            title.setTextSize(18);
            title.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            box.addView(title, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

            TextView sub = new TextView(ctx);
            sub.setText(formatValueText(min) + " – " + formatValueText(max));
            sub.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            sub.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            sub.setTextSize(12);
            LayoutParams subLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            subLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
            box.addView(sub, subLp);

            LinearLayout inputBox = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            inputBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            inputBox.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
            inputBox.setPadding(dp(ctx, 14), dp(ctx, 2),
                    dp(ctx, 14), dp(ctx, 2));
            LayoutParams ibLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            ibLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 16);

            final EditText input = new EditText(ctx);
            input.setBackground(null);
            input.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            input.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            input.setHintTextColor(0xFF5D6672);
            input.setTextSize(16);
            input.setSingleLine(true);
            input.setMaxLines(1);
            // Signed keyboards appear only for ranges that can go negative
            // (e.g. a -24..+24 dB trim), so every existing positive-only
            // control keeps its familiar keypad.
            int inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER;
            if (min < 0) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_SIGNED;
            }
            if (valueScale > 1) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_DECIMAL;
            }
            input.setInputType(inputType);
            input.setText(formatNumberPart(value));
            input.setSelectAllOnFocus(true);
            inputBox.addView(input, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(ctx, 50)));
            box.addView(inputBox, ibLp);

            LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            LayoutParams rowLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rowLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 14);

            TextView cancelBtn = new TextView(ctx);
            cancelBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
            cancelBtn.setTextSize(14);
            cancelBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            cancelBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cancelBtn.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            cancelBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);

            TextView okBtn = new TextView(ctx);
            okBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.settings_done));
            okBtn.setTextSize(14);
            okBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            okBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            okBtn.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
            okBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);

            LayoutParams half = new LayoutParams(0, dp(ctx, 48), 1f);
            half.rightMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            LayoutParams half2 = new LayoutParams(0, dp(ctx, 48), 1f);
            half2.leftMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            row.addView(cancelBtn, half);
            row.addView(okBtn, half2);
            box.addView(row, rowLp);
            PressAnim.apply(cancelBtn);
            PressAnim.apply(okBtn);

            d.setContentView(box);
            input.setImeOptions(android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                    .IME_ACTION_DONE);
            input.setOnEditorActionListener((v2, actionId, ev) -> {
                if (actionId == android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                        .IME_ACTION_DONE) {
                    commitTyped(input);
                    d.dismiss();
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            });
            cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> d.dismiss());
            okBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                commitTyped(input);
                d.dismiss();
            });
            styleModalWindow(d);
            Window w = d.getWindow();
            if (w != null) {
                w.setSoftInputMode(WindowManager.LayoutParams
                        .SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                        | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
            }
            d.setOnShowListener(dd -> input.requestFocus());
            d.show();
            input.post(() -> {
                android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager imm =
                        (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager) ctx
                                .getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
                if (imm != null) {
                    imm.showSoftInput(input,
                            android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager
                                    .SHOW_IMPLICIT);
                }
            });
            // Back / outside-tap dismisses WITHOUT committing: cancelling
            // must never mutate the value.
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            keyboardDialog = null;
        }
    }

    /** Parses and commits the typed value exactly once. */
    private void commitTyped(EditText input) {
        try {
            String raw = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (raw.isEmpty()) return;
            int v = valueScale > 1
                    ? (int) Math.round(Double.parseDouble(raw) * valueScale)
                    : Integer.parseInt(raw);
            setValue(v, true);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    /**
     * Horizontal scrubs are intercepted here rather than in an
     * {@code OnTouchListener}: the minus, value and plus children are all
     * clickable, so they consume ACTION_DOWN and the parent would never see
     * the gesture at all.
     *
     * <p>Only a clean tap reaches the children. Motion beyond touch slop is
     * consumed here, so a scrolling finger can never turn into a value change
     * or a stray double-tap.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                downX = ev.getX();
                downY = ev.getY();
                activePointerId = eventPointerId(ev, 0);
                movedBeyondSlop = false;
                scrubbing = false;
                verticalScrubbing = false;
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN:
                // A second finger invalidates tap and double-tap semantics.
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                clearChildPress();
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                int pointerIndex = ev.findPointerIndex(activePointerId);
                if (pointerIndex < 0) return true;
                float x = ev.getX(pointerIndex);
                float y = ev.getY(pointerIndex);
                float dx = x - downX;
                float dy = y - downY;
                float slop = ViewConfiguration.get(getContext())
                        .getScaledTouchSlop();
                if (!movedBeyondSlop
                        && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > slop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = true;
                    clearChildPress();
                }
                if (!scrubbing && !verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Claim the gesture once its direction is clear. A
                    // vertical move is consumed so it cannot become a tap
                    // when the finger lifts — unless vertical scrubbing is
                    // enabled, in which case it drives the value.
                    if (!movedBeyondSlop) {
                        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
                    }
                    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
                        scrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        dragStartPos = x;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else if (verticalScrubEnabled) {
                        verticalScrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        // Anchor at the current position like horizontal
                        // scrub does: anchoring at the touch-down point
                        // makes the value jump by the slop distance.
                        dragStartPos = y;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                    return true;
                }
                if (verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Drag upward increases the value, drag downward decreases it,
                    // matching the direction the finger moves away from the
                    // starting point.
                    int delta = (int) Math.round((dragStartPos - y)
                            / dp(getContext(), 7));
                    int s = effectiveStep(dragStartValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
                    setLiveValue(dragStartValue + delta * s);
                    return true;
                }
                int delta = (int) Math.round((x - dragStartPos)
                        / dp(getContext(), 7));
                scrubTo(dragStartValue, delta);
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP: {
                int lifted = eventPointerId(ev, ev.getActionIndex());
                if (lifted == activePointerId) {
                    return finishInterruptedGesture();
                }
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
                    scrubbing = false;
                    verticalScrubbing = false;
                    if (getParent() != null) {
                        getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
                    }
                    if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                        paywallInterceptor.run();
                        return true;
                    }
                    // A scrub reports through the scrub listener only. The
                    // discrete listener remains reserved for +/- and keyboard
                    // commits.
                    if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
                    performClick();
                    return true;
                }
                if (movedBeyondSlop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = false;
                    return true;
                }
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            default:
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
        }
    }

    private boolean finishInterruptedGesture() {
        activePointerId = -1;
        if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
            scrubbing = false;
            verticalScrubbing = false;
            if (getParent() != null) {
                getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
            }
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
            performClick();
        }
        movedBeyondSlop = true;
        return true;
    }

    private static int eventPointerId(MotionEvent ev, int pointerIndex) {
        try {
            return ev.getPointerId(pointerIndex);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    private void setLiveValue(int v) {
        int before = value;
        setValue(v, false);
        if (value != before && scrubListener != null) {
            scrubListener.onScrubValueChanged(value);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies a scrub delta measured in 7dp ticks. Without a step rule this
     * is one fixed step per tick; with a piecewise rule (e.g. zoom) each
     * tick steps from the running value so bracket boundaries are honored
     * instead of extrapolating a single step across the whole drag.
     */
    private void scrubTo(int startValue, int delta) {
        if (delta == 0) {
            setLiveValue(startValue);
            return;
        }
        if (stepRule == null) {
            int s = effectiveStep(startValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
            setLiveValue(startValue + delta * s);
            return;
        }
        int dir = delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
        int v = startValue;
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.abs(delta); i++) {
            v += effectiveStep(v, dir);
        }
        setLiveValue(v);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        scrubbing = false;
        verticalScrubbing = false;
        movedBeyondSlop = false;
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    private static int dp(Context c, int v) {
        return Math.round(v * c.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.LinearGradient;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.PorterDuff;
import android.graphics.PorterDuffXfermode;
import android.graphics.Shader;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Teleprompter surface.
 *
 * <p>Renders the script itself rather than an EditText so it can wrap strictly
 * to what actually fits, centre every line, and fade the copy out linearly
 * towards the top and bottom so the performer's eye is pulled to the opaque
 * centre line.
 *
 * <p>The script is split once into <b>segments</b> — one segment per display
 * line. Rendering then draws only the {@link #visibleLineCount()} segments that
 * fall inside the viewport, padded with empty segments at both ends, so the
 * last line of the script still reaches the centre line and never scrolls off
 * past the end.
 */
public class TeleprompterView extends View {

    /** Line height as a fraction of the rendered text size. */
    private static final float LINE_HEIGHT_EM = 1.5f;

    private final Paint textPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint maskPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);

    /** One entry per display line. Never null; blank lines are "". */
    private final List<String> segments = new ArrayList<>();

    private String script = "";
    private float textSizePx = 44f;
    private int wordsPerLine = TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE;
    private int textColor = 0xFFF2F4F7;
    private boolean mirror;

    private float fadePx = 0f;

    /**
     * Downward shift of the reading centre, in pixels. The control chrome
     * overlays the top of the panel, so the brightest line must sit at the
     * middle of the *visible* area — not the middle of the view.
     */
    private float centerShiftPx = 0f;

    private float scrollOffset = 0f;
    private float maxScroll = 0f;

    /** Cache key for the wrap, so scrolling never re-wraps the script. */
    private int wrapWidth = -1;
    private int wrapHeight = -1;
    private float wrapSizePx = -1f;
    private int wrapWpl = -1;

    public TeleprompterView(Context context) {
        super(context);
        init();
    }

    public TeleprompterView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        init();
    }

    private void init() {
        textPaint.setTextAlign(Paint.Align.CENTER);
        textPaint.setSubpixelText(true);
        textPaint.setLinearText(true);
        setWillNotDraw(false);
        // Without this the view never receives touch events for dragging.
        setClickable(true);
        setFocusable(true);
    }

    public void setTextColor(int color) {
        textColor = color;
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setMirror(boolean m) {
        mirror = m;
        invalidate();
    }

    public void setScript(String text) {
        script = text == null ? "" : text;
        // A new script always starts at the top; preserving an old fractional
        // line across unrelated content would show an arbitrary position.
        scrollOffset = 0f;
        wrapWidth = -1; // force a re-split
        rewrap();
        invalidate();
    }

    public String getScript() {
        return script;
    }

    public void setTextSizePx(float px) {
        if (px > 0f && Math.abs(px - textSizePx) > 0.5f) {
            float linePosition = linePosition();
            textSizePx = px;
            rewrap();
            restoreLinePosition(linePosition);
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public float getTextSizePx() {
        return textSizePx;
    }

    /** Size actually being drawn. Kept while live scrubbing commits go through
     * {@link #setTextSizePx(float)} on every move. */
    public float renderedTextSizePx() {
        return textSizePx;
    }

    /**
     * Shifts the reading centre down so the focused line lands in the middle
     * of the visible area when chrome overlays the top of the panel.
     */
    public void setCenterShiftPx(float px) {
        float clamped = Math.max(0f, px);
        if (Math.abs(clamped - centerShiftPx) > 0.5f) {
            centerShiftPx = clamped;
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public void setWordsPerLine(int wpl) {
        int w = Math.max(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE, wpl);
        if (w != wordsPerLine) {
            float linePosition = linePosition();
            wordsPerLine = w;
            rewrap();
            restoreLinePosition(linePosition);
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public int getWordsPerLine() {
        return wordsPerLine;
    }

    /**
     * Words actually shown on a wrapped line. The requested count is clamped
     * to the measured width during {@link #rewrap()}, so callers must use this
     * value—not the requested value—when converting reading speed into pixels.
     */
    public int effectiveWordsPerLine() {
        int width = getWidth();
        if (width <= 0) {
            return Math.max(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                    Math.min(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, wordsPerLine));
        }
        float pad = getPaddingLeft() + getPaddingRight();
        return TeleMath.wordsPerLine(Math.round(Math.max(1f, width - pad)),
                textSizePx, wordsPerLine);
    }

    public float lineHeight() {
        return renderedTextSizePx() * LINE_HEIGHT_EM;
    }

    /** Current scroll position measured in lines, independent of text size. */
    private float linePosition() {
        float lh = lineHeight();
        return lh > 0f ? scrollOffset / lh : 0f;
    }

    private void restoreLinePosition(float linePosition) {
        setScrollOffset(linePosition * lineHeight());
    }

    /** How many display lines fit in the viewport right now. */
    public int visibleLineCount() {
        int h = getHeight();
        if (h <= 0) return 0;
        return (int) Math.ceil(h / lineHeight());
    }

    /** Number of segments the script was split into. */
    public int segmentCount() {
        return segments.size();
    }

    public String segmentAt(int i) {
        return (i < 0 || i >= segments.size()) ? "" : segments.get(i);
    }

    public float contentHeight() {
        return Math.max(0, segments.size()) * lineHeight();
    }

    public float maxScroll() {
        return maxScroll;
    }

    public float scrollOffset() {
        return scrollOffset;
    }

    public void setScrollOffset(float px) {
        float clamped = Math.max(0f, Math.min(maxScroll, px));
        if (Math.abs(clamped - scrollOffset) > 0.0005f) {
            scrollOffset = clamped;
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public void scrollBy(float dy) {
        setScrollOffset(scrollOffset + dy);
    }

    public void rewind() {
        setScrollOffset(0f);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSizeChanged(int w, int h, int oldw, int oldh) {
        super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh);
        fadePx = h * 0.44f;
        // Height feeds the scroll bounds, so the cached split is only reusable
        // when the height is unchanged too.
        rewrap();
    }

    /**
     * Splits the script into display-line segments.
     *
     * <p>Widths are measured with {@link Paint#measureText} rather than
     * estimated from a character count. That matters: an estimate makes the
     * same words wrap differently between layout passes, which is what makes
     * the prompter look like it is flickering when you scroll.
     */
    private void rewrap() {
        int width = getWidth();
        if (width <= 0 || script.trim().isEmpty()) {
            if (segments.size() != 0 || !script.trim().isEmpty()) {
                segments.clear();
            }
            wrapWidth = width;
            wrapHeight = getHeight();
            wrapSizePx = textSizePx;
            wrapWpl = wordsPerLine;
            recomputeMaxScroll();
            return;
        }
        // Nothing changed — keep the existing split so scrolling is stable.
        // The bounds are still recomputed below because they depend on height,
        // which is not part of the split itself.
        if (width == wrapWidth && getHeight() == wrapHeight
                && textSizePx == wrapSizePx && wordsPerLine == wrapWpl
                && !segments.isEmpty()) {
            recomputeMaxScroll();
            return;
        }

        textPaint.setTextSize(textSizePx);
        float padL = getPaddingLeft();
        float padR = getPaddingRight();
        float avail = Math.max(1f, width - padL - padR);

        int wpl = TeleMath.wordsPerLine(Math.round(avail), textSizePx,
                wordsPerLine);

        segments.clear();
        String space = " ";
        float spaceW = textPaint.measureText(space);
        for (String paragraph : script.split("\\n", -1)) {
            String trimmed = paragraph.trim();
            if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {
                segments.add("");
                continue;
            }
            String[] words = trimmed.split("\\s+");
            int i = 0;
            while (i < words.length) {
                StringBuilder line = new StringBuilder(words[i]);
                float lineW = textPaint.measureText(words[i]);
                int take = 1;
                while (i + take < words.length && take < wpl) {
                    float nextW = lineW + spaceW
                            + textPaint.measureText(words[i + take]);
                    if (nextW > avail) break;
                    line.append(space).append(words[i + take]);
                    lineW = nextW;
                    take++;
                }
                segments.add(line.toString());
                i += take;
            }
        }

        wrapWidth = width;
        wrapHeight = getHeight();
        wrapSizePx = textSizePx;
        wrapWpl = wordsPerLine;
        recomputeMaxScroll();
    }

    /**
     * Scroll bounds. The last segment must be able to reach the centre line,
     * otherwise the tail of the script scrolls past the bottom and the panel
     * goes blank.
     *
     * <p>First baseline is {@code h/2 - scrollOffset} and segment k sits at
     * {@code h/2 - scrollOffset + k*lh}. Requiring the final segment
     * (k = n-1) to land on the centre line gives
     * {@code scrollOffset = (n-1)*lh - centreOffset}.
     */
    private void recomputeMaxScroll() {
        int h = getHeight();
        if (h <= 0 || segments.isEmpty()) {
            maxScroll = 0f;
            return;
        }
        float lh = lineHeight();
        float centreOffset = lh * 0.36f;
        float total = contentHeight();
        maxScroll = Math.max(0f, total - lh - centreOffset);
        if (scrollOffset > maxScroll) scrollOffset = maxScroll;
    }

    /**
     * Baseline for the beginning of the visible window.
     *
     * <p>The absolute baseline of segment {@code absoluteIndex} is always
     * {@code centreY - scrollOffset + absoluteIndex * lineHeight}. When
     * only the visible window is drawn, its first segment is therefore not at
     * the nominal first baseline: the window start must retain
     * {@code firstSegment * lineHeight}. Omitting that term is what used to
     * make every line snap upward by one full line each time scrolling crossed
     * a line boundary.
     */
    static float windowStartBaseline(float centreY, float scrollOffset,
                                     int firstSegment, float lineHeight) {
        return centreY - scrollOffset + firstSegment * lineHeight;
    }

    /**
     * First segment to draw for a scroll position: one line above the top
     * edge, so the uppermost line slides smoothly out of the panel instead
     * of popping out of existence while still well inside it.
     */
    static int drawStartForScroll(float centreY, float scrollOffset,
                                  float lineHeight) {
        return (int) Math.floor((scrollOffset - centreY) / lineHeight) - 1;
    }

    /**
     * How many segments to draw starting at {@code drawFrom} (whose baseline
     * is {@code drawBaseline}) so the window reaches past the bottom edge
     * with one line of margin.
     */
    static int drawCountForScroll(float drawBaseline, float lineHeight,
                                  int viewHeight) {
        int n = (int) Math.ceil(
                (viewHeight + lineHeight - drawBaseline) / lineHeight) + 1;
        return Math.max(0, n);
    }

    /**
     * Returns exactly {@code visibleLines} segments starting at
     * {@code firstSegment}, substituting {@code ""} for any index outside the
     * script.
     */
    static String[] windowForScroll(List<String> segments, int visibleLines,
                                    int firstSegment) {
        if (visibleLines <= 0) return new String[0];
        String[] out = new String[visibleLines];
        for (int i = 0; i < visibleLines; i++) {
            int idx = firstSegment + i;
            // Empty segments at both ends instead of crashing.
            out[i] = (idx < 0 || idx >= segments.size()) ? "" : segments.get(idx);
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);
        int w = getWidth();
        int h = getHeight();
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

        float lh = lineHeight();
        int count = visibleLineCount();

        // Reading centre: the middle of the visible area, pushed down when
        // chrome overlays the top of the panel.
        float centreY = h / 2f + centerShiftPx;
        int drawFrom;
        float drawBaseline;
        int drawCount;
        if (segments.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        if (totalLinesFits(count)) {
            drawFrom = 0;
            drawBaseline = centreY - (segments.size() - 1) * lh / 2f
                    + lh * 0.36f;
            drawCount = segments.size();
        } else {
            // The window starts at the top edge — not one line above the
            // reading centre. Starting at the scroll position only drew a
            // single line above the centre, so every line vanished abruptly
            // a couple of lines above the middle instead of travelling up
            // to the top of the panel.
            drawFrom = drawStartForScroll(centreY, scrollOffset, lh);
            drawBaseline = windowStartBaseline(centreY, scrollOffset,
                    drawFrom, lh);
            drawCount = drawCountForScroll(drawBaseline, lh, h);
        }
        String[] window = windowForScroll(segments, drawCount, drawFrom);

        int save = canvas.save();
        if (mirror) {
            canvas.translate(w, 0);
            canvas.scale(-1f, 1f);
        }
        int layer = canvas.saveLayer(0, 0, w, h, null);

        textPaint.setColor(textColor);
        textPaint.setTextSize(renderedTextSizePx());
        textPaint.setTextAlign(Paint.Align.CENTER);
        textPaint.setShader(null);
        textPaint.setXfermode(null);

        float centreX = w / 2f;
        float baseline = drawBaseline;
        float baselineAlphaFloor = 0.30f;
        for (String line : window) {
            // Fade is symmetric about the reading centre, not the view
            // centre, so the brightest line is always the middle one.
            float a = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(baseline - centerShiftPx, h, fadePx);
            if (!line.isEmpty() && a > 0.01f) {
                textPaint.setAlpha(Math.round(255f
                        * Math.max(baselineAlphaFloor, a)));
                canvas.drawText(line, centreX, baseline, textPaint);
            }
            baseline += lh;
        }
        textPaint.setAlpha(255);

        maskPaint.setXfermode(new PorterDuffXfermode(PorterDuff.Mode.DST_IN));
        // Opaque band follows the reading centre: 30% of the height each
        // side, clamped into the view.
        float opaqueTop = Math.max(0f, (centreY - h * 0.30f) / h);
        float opaqueBottom = Math.min(1f, (centreY + h * 0.30f) / h);
        maskPaint.setShader(new LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h,
                new int[]{0x00000000, 0xFF000000, 0xFF000000, 0x00000000},
                new float[]{0f, opaqueTop, opaqueBottom, 1f},
                Shader.TileMode.CLAMP));
        canvas.drawRect(0, 0, w, h, maskPaint);
        maskPaint.setShader(null);
        maskPaint.setXfermode(null);
        canvas.restoreToCount(layer);
        canvas.restoreToCount(save);
    }

    /**
     * True when the whole script is shorter than the viewport.
     */
    private boolean totalLinesFits(int count) {
        return segments.size() <= 1 && scrollOffset <= 0.01f;
    }

    // ---- dragging the script by hand ----

    private float downX;
    private float downY;
    private float lastTouchY;
    private int activePointer = -1;
    private boolean dragging;

    /** True only while the user's finger is actively dragging the script. */
    public boolean isDragging() {
        return dragging;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        dragging = false;
        activePointer = -1;
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event) {
        if (maxScroll() <= 0f) {
            // Nothing to scroll: let taps through, but do not claim drags.
            return super.onTouchEvent(event);
        }
        switch (event.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                activePointer = event.getPointerId(0);
                downX = event.getX();
                downY = event.getY();
                lastTouchY = event.getY();
                dragging = false;
                if (getParent() != null) {
                    getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                }
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                int idx = event.findPointerIndex(activePointer);
                if (idx < 0) return true;
                float y = event.getY(idx);
                float dy = y - lastTouchY;
                // A4-11: the horizontal term used event.getX() - event.getX(0),
                // which is always 0, so any horizontal swipe with a little
                // vertical movement started a scroll. Compare against the
                // recorded downX instead.
                if (!dragging && Math.abs(y - downY) > touchSlopPx()
                        && Math.abs(y - downY)
                        > Math.abs(event.getX(idx) - downX)) {
                    dragging = true;
                    // Re-anchor so the first frames of travel do not jump by
                    // the slop that was just crossed.
                    lastTouchY = y;
                }
                if (dragging) {
                    // Drag down moves the text down, i.e. back through the script.
                    scrollBy(-dy);
                    lastTouchY = y;
                }
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                activePointer = -1;
                if (!dragging) performClick();
                dragging = false;
                if (getParent() != null) {
                    getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
                }
                return true;
            default:
                return true;
        }
    }

    private float touchSlopPx() {
        return getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density * 8f;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performClick() {
        return super.performClick();
    }

    private String[] windowOf(int count, int from) {
        return windowForScroll(segments, count, from);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Centisecond timer rendering shared by the studio and the notification.
 * Pure Java so it is unit-testable on plain JUnit.
 */
public final class TimeFmt {

    private TimeFmt() {}

    /** 00:00.00 style, with hundredths of a second. */
    public static String formatTimer(long ms) {
        if (ms < 0) ms = 0;
        long cs = (ms % 1000) / 10;
        long s = (ms / 1000) % 60;
        long m = (ms / 60000);
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d.%02d", m, s, cs);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 7 timeline utility: invert the polarity, reverse the region in
 * time, or repeat it a number of times.
 */
final class TimelineUtilityProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] ACTION_LABELS = {"Invert", "Reverse", "Repeat"};

    private final FxParameter action = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "tl_action", "Action", ACTION_LABELS, 0));
    private final FxParameter repeats = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tl_repeats", "Number of Repeats", "", 1, 50, 1, 2));

    TimelineUtilityProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "timeline";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Timeline Utility";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Invert polarity, reverse the region or repeat it";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.TOOLS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOfflineOnly() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Offline-only effect: it is rendered through
     * {@link #processOfflineRegion} instead of the realtime chain.
     */
    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        // No realtime path: the realtime rack skips offline-only processors.
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled();
    }

    @Override
    public float[] processOfflineRegion(float[] in, int frames, int channels) {
        if (in == null || frames <= 0) return in;
        switch (action.getEnumIndex()) {
            case 0: { // Invert
                float[] out = in.clone();
                int n = Math.min(out.length, frames * channels);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = -out[i];
                return out;
            }
            case 1: { // Reverse
                float[] out = new float[frames * channels];
                for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                    int src = frames - 1 - f;
                    for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
                        out[f * channels + c] = in[src * channels + c];
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }
            default: { // Repeat
                int count = Math.max(1, repeats.getCurrentRaw());
                float[] out = new float[frames * channels * count];
                for (int r = 0; r < count; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(in, 0, out, r * frames * channels,
                            frames * channels);
                }
                return out;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 6 tremolo: multiplies the amplitude with an LFO of the selected
 * shape.
 */
final class TremoloProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private static final String[] WAVEFORMS = {"Sine", "Triangle", "Sawtooth",
            "Inverse Sawtooth", "Square"};

    private final FxParameter waveform = addParameter(FxParameter.enumParam(
            "tr_wave", "Waveform", WAVEFORMS, 0));
    private final FxParameter phase = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tr_phase", "Starting Phase", " deg", 0, 355, 5, 0));
    private final FxParameter depth = addParameter(FxParameter.intParam(
            "tr_depth", "Depth", "%", 0, 100, 1, 40));
    private final FxParameter rate = addParameter(FxParameter.floatParam(
            "tr_rate", "Frequency", " Hz", 0.1f, 40f, 4f));

    private int sampleRate = DspChain.SAMPLE_RATE;
    private double lfoPhase = 0;

    TremoloProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "tremolo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Tremolo";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Amplitude modulation with five LFO waveforms";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.CREATIVE;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        if (sampleRate > 0) this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        lfoPhase = 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && depth.getCurrentRaw() > 0;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int ch = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels));
        int n = frames * ch;
        double inc = rate.getFloat() / sampleRate;
        double phase0 = phase.getCurrentRaw() / 360.0;
        double depthPct = depth.getCurrentRaw() / 100.0;
        int wave = waveform.getEnumIndex();

        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float lfo = lfoValue(wave, lfoPhase + phase0);
            float gain = 1f - (float) depthPct
                    + (float) depthPct * (0.5f * (1f + lfo));
            int idx = f * ch;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[idx + c] *= gain;
            lfoPhase += inc;
            if (lfoPhase > 1.0) lfoPhase -= 1.0;
        }
    }

    /** LFO value in -1..1 for the selected shape. */
    static float lfoValue(int waveform, double phase) {
        double p = phase - Math.floor(phase);
        switch (waveform) {
            case 1: { // Triangle
                return (float) (p < 0.5 ? 4 * p - 1 : 3 - 4 * p);
            }
            case 2: { // Sawtooth
                return (float) (2 * p - 1);
            }
            case 3: { // Inverse sawtooth
                return (float) (1 - 2 * p);
            }
            case 4: { // Square
                return p < 0.5 ? 1f : -1f;
            }
            case 0:
            default: {
                return (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * p);
            }
        }
    }
}
