<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- Scrim behind the overlaid prompter controls so the chrome stays legible
     over the script without hiding it. -->
<shape xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- Auto Backup (Android 6+): library metadata + prefs travel, bulky
     device-local audio never does. Users re-add recordings via export.
     Crash breadcrumbs stay on-device too: restoring a stale crash report
     or unterminated breadcrumb would fire a false crash dialog or encoder
     downgrade on the new device. -->
<full-backup-content>
    <exclude domain="external" path="takes" />
    <exclude domain="file" path="takes" />
    <exclude domain="file" path="takeone-crash.txt" />
    <exclude domain="file" path="takeone-breadcrumbs.txt" />
</full-backup-content>

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/AudioImportFixTest.java
=================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * NEW-01 regression on plain JUnit/Robolectric (no MediaCodec needed for the
 * WAV path): stereo imports must not crash, must honour the data chunk
 * offset, and must preserve geometry and pitch.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class AudioImportFixTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    private static android.content.Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    private static File makeWav(File f, int ch, int rate, int frames,
                                int format, int bits) throws Exception {
        float[] s = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            float v = (float) (0.4 * Math.sin(i * 0.05));
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) s[i * ch + c] = v;
        }
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            if (format == 3) {
                w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, rate,
                        (long) frames * ch * 4));
                Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, s, 0, s.length);
            } else {
                w.write(Dsp.wavPcmHeader(ch, rate, bits,
                        (long) frames * ch * bits / 8));
                byte[] raw = new byte[frames * ch * bits / 8];
                java.nio.ByteBuffer bb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                        .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                for (float v : s) {
                    if (bits == 24) {
                        int q = Math.round(v * 8388607f);
                        bb.put((byte) (q & 0xFF));
                        bb.put((byte) ((q >> 8) & 0xFF));
                        bb.put((byte) ((q >> 16) & 0xFF));
                    } else {
                        bb.putShort((short) Math.round(v * 32767f));
                    }
                }
                w.write(raw);
            }
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static double pitchHz(File wav) throws Exception {
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(wav);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(wav, "r");
        try {
            int ch = info.channels;
            long frames = info.dataBytes / 4 / ch;
            int n = (int) Math.min(frames, 48000);
            byte[] raw = new byte[n * ch * 4];
            r.seek(info.dataStart);
            r.readFully(raw);
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            int crossings = 0;
            float prev = fb.get(0);
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                float cur = fb.get(i * ch);
                if ((prev <= 0f && cur > 0f) || (prev >= 0f && cur < 0f)) {
                    crossings++;
                }
                prev = cur;
            }
            return crossings / 2.0 / (n / (double) info.sampleRate);
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void payloadBytesOfSkipsLeadingChunks() throws Exception {
        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), "pay.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            java.nio.ByteBuffer le = java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(8)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
            w.write(new byte[]{'R', 'I', 'F', 'F', 0, 0, 0, 0,
                    'W', 'A', 'V', 'E'});
            w.write(new byte[]{'J', 'U', 'N', 'K'});
            le.clear();
            le.putInt(8);
            w.write(le.array(), 0, 4);
            w.write(new byte[8]);
            w.write(new byte[]{'f', 'm', 't', ' ', 16, 0, 0, 0});
            java.nio.ByteBuffer fmt = java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(16)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
            fmt.putShort((short) 3);
            fmt.putShort((short) 1);
            fmt.putInt(48000);
            fmt.putInt(48000 * 4);
            fmt.putShort((short) 4);
            fmt.putShort((short) 32);
            w.write(fmt.array());
            w.write(new byte[]{'d', 'a', 't', 'a'});
            le.clear();
            le.putInt(100 * 4);
            w.write(le.array(), 0, 4);
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, new float[100], 0, 100);
            // Patch the RIFF size.
            w.seek(4);
            le.clear();
            le.putInt((int) (w.length() - 8));
            w.write(le.array(), 0, 4);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        // 12 (riff) + 16 (junk) + 24 (fmt) + 8 (data hdr) + 400 (payload).
        assertEquals(f.length() - 60, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(f));
        assertEquals(0, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(
                new File(tmp.getRoot(), "missing.wav")));
    }

    @Test
    public void stereoFloatWavImportsWithoutUnderflow() throws Exception {
        File src = makeWav(new File(tmp.getRoot(), "st.wav"), 2, 48000,
                48000, 3, 32);
        File out = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(src,
                RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx()), "Stereo", null);
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(out);
            assertEquals(2, info.channels);
            assertEquals(48000, info.sampleRate);
            assertEquals(48000L * 2 * 4, info.dataBytes);
            // ~382 Hz sine (0.05 rad/sample @48k); must survive intact.
            assertEquals(382.0, pitchHz(out), 6.0);
        } finally {
            out.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void stereoPcm16WavImportsWithRightScale() throws Exception {
        File src = makeWav(new File(tmp.getRoot(), "st16.wav"), 2, 48000,
                24000, 1, 16);
        File out = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(src,
                RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx()), "Stereo16", null);
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(out);
            assertEquals(2, info.channels);
            assertEquals(24000L * 2 * 4, info.dataBytes);
            assertEquals(382.0, pitchHz(out), 6.0);
        } finally {
            out.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void wavWithLeadingJunkChunkImports() throws Exception {
        // data chunk sits past a JUNK chunk: the old code read chunk bytes
        // as audio (and never sought to dataStart).
        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), "junky.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            java.nio.ByteBuffer le = java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(8)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
            w.write(new byte[]{'R', 'I', 'F', 'F', 0, 0, 0, 0,
                    'W', 'A', 'V', 'E'});
            w.write(new byte[]{'J', 'U', 'N', 'K'});
            le.clear();
            le.putInt(16);
            w.write(le.array(), 0, 4);
            w.write(new byte[16]);
            w.write(new byte[]{'f', 'm', 't', ' ', 16, 0, 0, 0});
            java.nio.ByteBuffer fmt = java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(16)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
            fmt.putShort((short) 3);
            fmt.putShort((short) 1);
            fmt.putInt(48000);
            fmt.putInt(48000 * 4);
            fmt.putShort((short) 4);
            fmt.putShort((short) 32);
            w.write(fmt.array());
            w.write(new byte[]{'d', 'a', 't', 'a'});
            le.clear();
            le.putInt(4800 * 4);
            w.write(le.array(), 0, 4);
            float[] s = new float[4800];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4800; i++) {
                s[i] = (float) (0.4 * Math.sin(i * 0.05));
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, s, 0, s.length);
            // Patch the RIFF size.
            w.seek(4);
            le.clear();
            le.putInt((int) (w.length() - 8));
            w.write(le.array(), 0, 4);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        File out = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(f,
                RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx()), "Junky", null);
        try {
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(out);
            assertEquals(1, info.channels);
            assertEquals(4800L * 4, info.dataBytes);
            assertEquals(382.0, pitchHz(out), 8.0);
        } finally {
            out.delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.MotionEvent;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * AUDIT-4 regression tests for the fixes that are observable off-device:
 * crash-healer breadcrumbs (A4-01), importer cleanup (A4-05), trash restore
 * path reporting (A4-09), script clearing (A4-10), prompter drag axis (A4-11),
 * importer header re-injection (A4-13) and the A4-06 init merge.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class Audit4FixTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    private android.content.Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    // ---- A4-01: a failed conversion must close the breadcrumb stage ----

    @Test
    public void failedConversionTerminatesTheStage() throws Exception {
        File dir = tmp.newFolder();
        File garbage = new File(dir, "bad.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(garbage, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(new byte[200]); // not a WAV
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        boolean threw = false;
        try {
            TakeSaver.convertRaw(ctx(), garbage, "Audit4",
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, null);
        } catch (Exception expected) {
            threw = true;
        }
        assertTrue("garbage raw must fail", threw);
        // The healer keys off an unterminated "convert start" line.
        assertNull("convert stage left open after a failure",
                CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx()));
    }

    // ---- A4-05: a failed import must not leave a session file behind ----

    @Test
    public void failedImportLeavesNoSessionFile() throws Exception {
        File bad = new File(tmp.newFolder(), "broken.m4a");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(bad, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(new byte[64]); // not a decodable container
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        int before = countSessionFiles(takes);
        boolean threw = false;
        try {
            AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(bad, takes, "Audit4 Import", null);
        } catch (Exception expected) {
            threw = true;
        }
        assertTrue("a corrupt container must fail the import", threw);
        assertEquals("orphan session file left for reconcile to adopt",
                before, countSessionFiles(takes));
    }

    private static int countSessionFiles(File dir) {
        File[] all = dir.listFiles();
        if (all == null) return 0;
        int n = 0;
        for (File f : all) {
            String s = f.getName();
            if (f.isFile() && s.endsWith(".wav") && !s.endsWith(".pending")
                    && !s.endsWith(".part")) {
                n++;
            }
        }
        return n;
    }

    // ---- A4-09: restore reports where the file actually landed ----

    @Test
    public void restoreFromTrashReportsRealPath() throws Exception {
        File takes = tmp.newFolder("takes");
        File audio = new File(takes, "song.m4a");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(audio, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[128]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        File trashed = Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, audio);
        assertNotNull("trash move failed", trashed);
        assertFalse(audio.exists());

        // Take the destination: the restore must uniquify and say where.
        File squatter = new File(takes, "song.m4a");
        RandomAccessFile w2 = new RandomAccessFile(squatter, "rw");
        try {
            w2.write(new byte[10]);
        } finally {
            w2.close();
        }

        File back = Dsp.restoreFromTrash(trashed, new File(takes, "song.m4a"));
        assertNotNull("restore returned null", back);
        // The destination was taken, so the restore must uniquify and the
        // caller must be told the real name.
        assertFalse("restore overwrote the existing take",
                back.getName().equals("song.m4a"));
        assertTrue("unexpected restored name: " + back.getName(),
                back.getName().startsWith("song"));
        assertEquals("restore must not clobber the existing file",
                10, squatter.length());
        assertTrue("restored file missing", back.exists());
        assertEquals(128, back.length());
        assertNull("missing source must return null",
                Dsp.restoreFromTrash(new File(takes, "ghost.m4a"),
                        new File(takes, "ghost2.m4a")));
    }

    // ---- A4-10: an empty script is a valid (clearing) save ----

    @Test
    public void editorSavesEmptyScriptAndFiresOnce() {
        Activity a = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        final String[] seen = new String[3];
        final int[] calls = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = TeleDialogs.showEditor(a, "old script", 120,
                text -> {
                    if (calls[0] < 3) seen[calls[0]] = text;
                    calls[0]++;
                }, null);
        View save = d.findViewById(R.id.teleSaveBtn);
        assertNotNull("no save button", save);
        View input = d.findViewById(R.id.teleEditorInput);
        assertNotNull("no editor field", input);
        ((android.widget.EditText) input).setText("");
        a.runOnUiThread(save::performClick);
        org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals("empty script must be savable (it clears the prompter)",
                1, calls[0]);
        assertEquals("", seen[0]);
    }

    // ---- A4-11: a horizontal swipe must not scroll the script ----

    private TeleprompterView prompter() {
        Activity a = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        TeleprompterView v = new TeleprompterView(a);
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(900, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(600,
                        View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, 900, 600);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 400; i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(' ');
            sb.append("word").append(i);
        }
        v.setScript(sb.toString());
        v.setScrollOffset(v.lineHeight() * 10f);
        return v;
    }

    private static MotionEvent ev(int action, float x, float y) {
        long t = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        return MotionEvent.obtain(t, t, action, x, y, 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void horizontalSwipeDoesNotScroll() {
        TeleprompterView v = prompter();
        float before = v.scrollOffset();
        v.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 450f, 300f));
        // Mostly sideways, a little vertical.
        v.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 400f, 306f));
        v.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 300f, 312f));
        v.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 300f, 312f));
        assertEquals("a horizontal swipe scrolled the script",
                before, v.scrollOffset(), 0.5f);
    }

    @Test
    public void verticalDragScrolls() {
        TeleprompterView v = prompter();
        float before = v.scrollOffset();
        v.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 450f, 300f));
        v.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 452f, 200f));
        v.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 450f, 120f));
        v.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 450f, 120f));
        assertTrue("a vertical drag did not scroll the script",
                v.scrollOffset() > before);
    }

    // ---- A4-13: sniffed header bytes are never dropped ----

    @Test
    public void importerWrapperReplaysEveryHeaderByte() throws Exception {
        // The sniffed magic bytes are re-injected in front of a stream that
        // has already consumed them, exactly as readDocx()/readPlain() see it.
        byte[] payload = {'h', 'e', 'l', 'l', 'o'};
        File f = tmp.newFile("sniff.bin");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(payload);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        java.io.InputStream raw = new java.io.FileInputStream(f);
        java.io.InputStream wrapped =
                ScriptImporter.wrapForTest(raw, new byte[]{'P', 'K', 3, 4});
        try {
            // One byte at a time: the old headDone flag dropped the rest.
            assertEquals('P', wrapped.read());
            assertEquals('K', wrapped.read());
            assertEquals(3, wrapped.read());
            assertEquals(4, wrapped.read());
            // Then the real payload continues.
            assertEquals('h', wrapped.read());
            assertEquals('e', wrapped.read());
            wrapped.close();
        } finally {
            try {
                raw.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void importerWrapperServesBulkAndMixedReads() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("sniff2.bin");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[]{'x', 'y', 'z'});
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        java.io.InputStream raw = new java.io.FileInputStream(f);
        java.io.InputStream wrapped =
                ScriptImporter.wrapForTest(raw, new byte[]{'P', 'K', 3, 4});
        try {
            byte[] two = new byte[2];
            assertEquals("bulk read returned short", 2,
                    wrapped.read(two, 0, 2));
            assertEquals('P', two[0]);
            assertEquals('K', two[1]);
            // Mixed access: one single byte, then a bulk read that must
            // continue from byte 3 of the header, not from the source.
            assertEquals(3, wrapped.read());
            byte[] rest = new byte[4];
            int n = wrapped.read(rest, 0, 4);
            assertEquals("mixed read returned short", 4, n);
            assertEquals(4, rest[0] & 0xFF);
            assertEquals('x', rest[1] & 0xFF);
            wrapped.close();
        } finally {
            try {
                raw.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    // ---- A4-14: picker labels honour the step ----

    @Test
    public void pickerLabelsUseConfiguredStep() {
        Activity a = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        TeleValue tv = new TeleValue(a);
        tv.configure(40, 400, 5, 120, "");
        String[] labels = tv.steppedLabelsForTest();
        assertTrue("too few labels: " + labels.length, labels.length > 10);
        assertEquals("40", labels[0]);
        assertEquals("45", labels[1]);
        assertEquals("50", labels[2]);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Job registry rules: one job per raw, stable card ids, cancel cleanup, and
 * the startup sweep resurrecting interrupted jobs while dropping garbage.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConversionJobsTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void takeIdsAreNegativeAndStable() {
        ConversionJob a = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob b = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("take id must be negative", a.takeId() < 0);
        assertEquals("take id must be stable", a.takeId(), b.takeId());
        ConversionJob c = new ConversionJob("job-2", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("different jobs must differ", c.takeId() != a.takeId());
    }

    @Test
    public void sidecarRoundTrip() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobtest.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-9", "Title",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.progress = 42;
        job.framesDone = 100000;
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals("job-9", back.jobId);
            assertEquals("Title", back.title);
            assertEquals(42, back.progress);
            assertEquals(100000, back.framesDone);
            assertEquals(1, back.channels);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void enqueueDedupesAndCancelCleans() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Job Test", 2);
        try {
            ConversionJob first = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            ConversionJob second = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            assertTrue("same raw must return the same job",
                    first.jobId.equals(second.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar missing", first.sidecar().exists());
            assertTrue("not active",
                    ConversionJobs.forRaw(engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())
                            != null);
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.cancel(first.jobId, false));
            assertNull("still active after cancel",
                    ConversionJobs.get(first.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar survived cancel", !first.sidecar().exists());
        } finally {
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsAndCleans() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "sweep.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-sweep", "Sweep",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.write();
        File orphanPart = new File(dir, "orphan.wav.part");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(orphanPart, "rw").close();
        try {
            List<ConversionJob> resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean found = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep")) found = true;
            }
            assertTrue("interrupted job was not resurrected", found);
            assertTrue("orphan part survived", !orphanPart.exists());
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
            assertTrue("raw survived cancel", !raw.exists());
        } finally {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                orphanPart.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            job.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void replaceLineageSurvivesSidecar() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobreplace.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-rep", "Edit",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.replaceTakeId = 12345L;
        job.replaceTitle = "Original";
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals(12345L, back.replaceTakeId);
            assertEquals("Original", back.replaceTitle);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
        // Old sidecars without the keys default to "no lineage".
        ConversionJob plain = new ConversionJob("job-plain", "T",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertEquals(-1L, plain.replaceTakeId);
        assertNull(plain.replaceTitle);
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsEveryJob() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw1 = new File(dir, "sweep1.wav");
        File raw2 = new File(dir, "sweep2.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw1, "rw").close();
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw2, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob j1 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-1", "One",
                raw1.getAbsolutePath(), raw1.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob j2 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-2", "Two",
                raw2.getAbsolutePath(), raw2.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        j1.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        j2.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
        j1.write();
        j2.write();
        try {
            List<ConversionJob> resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean f1 = false, f2 = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-1")) f1 = true;
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-2")) f2 = true;
            }
            assertTrue("first job lost", f1);
            assertTrue("second job lost (only first resumed)", f2);
        } finally {
            try {
                raw1.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                raw2.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            j1.deleteSidecar();
            j2.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-1", true);
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-2", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void cancelUnknownReturnsFalse() {
        assertFalse(ConversionJobs.cancel("no-such-job", false));
        assertFalse(ConversionJobs.cancelByTakeId(-123456789L, false));
    }

    @Test
    public void cancelForReplacePositiveIdPassesThrough() {
        assertEquals(42L, ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(ctx(), 42L));
    }

    @Test
    public void cancelForReplaceUnknownNegativeReturnsMinusOne() {
        assertEquals(-1L,
                ConversionJobs.cancelForReplace(ctx(), -987654321L));
    }

    @Test
    public void renameActiveJobUpdatesReplaceTitle() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        String session = "Rename Replace " + System.nanoTime();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), session, 2);
        ConversionJob job = null;
        try {
            job = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile, session,
                    RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000,
                    4242L, "Original");
            String applied = ConversionJobs.renameConvertingOrCompleted(
                    job.jobId, job.takeId(), job.rawPath, "Renamed");
            assertEquals("Renamed", applied);
            assertEquals("Renamed", job.title);
            assertEquals("Renamed", job.replaceTitle);
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals("Renamed", back.title);
            assertEquals("Renamed", back.replaceTitle);
        } finally {
            if (job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void completionMapRoundTrip() {
        ConversionJobs.noteCompletion("/tmp/a.wav", 4242L);
        assertEquals(Long.valueOf(4242L),
                ConversionJobs.completedTakeIdForRaw("/tmp/a.wav"));
        ConversionJobs.forgetCompletion("/tmp/a.wav");
        assertTrue(ConversionJobs.completedTakeIdForRaw("/tmp/a.wav") == null);
    }

    @Test
    public void dispatchSaveWithoutStreamingEnqueuesJob() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Dispatch", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r = null;
        try {
            // No streaming session: must take the background path.
            assertTrue(engine.streaming() == null);
            r = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO,
                    SaveFormat.M4A, null);
            assertTrue(!r.adopted);
            assertTrue(r.job != null);
            assertTrue(r.job.sidecar().exists());
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.get(r.job.jobId) != null);
        } finally {
            if (r != null && r.job != null) {
                ConversionJobs.cancel(r.job.jobId, true);
            }
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
        assertTrue(ConversionJobs.get(
                r != null && r.job != null ? r.job.jobId : "?") == null);
    }

    @Test

    @Test
    public void dispatchSaveReplaceCancelsActiveConversionAndDeletesPreviousFileImmediately()
            throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // Case 1: Original take is still converting when user edits and chooses Replace
        File origRaw = new File(dir, "orig_conv_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(origRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 48000L * 2 * 4));
            w.write(new byte[48000 * 2 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJob origJob = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), origRaw,
                "Original Take", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
        long origSyntheticId = origJob.takeId();
        assertTrue("original job must be active",
                ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId) != null);

        // User edits in Studio and chooses a different format (OPUS) + Replace
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r1 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.OPUS, null,
                origSyntheticId, "Original Take");
        try {
            assertNull("original conversion must be cancelled immediately",
                    ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId));
            assertFalse("original raw must be deleted immediately",
                    origRaw.exists());
            assertFalse("original sidecar must be deleted immediately",
                    origJob.sidecar().exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must start immediately", r1.job);
            assertEquals("Original Take", r1.job.title);
            assertEquals("opus", r1.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r1.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r1.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r1.job.jobId, true);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }

        // Case 2: Original conversion finished (or was already a finished file)
        // before user clicked Replace -> must delete old file & Take immediately
        // before the new conversion runs!
        File finishedFile = new File(dir, "orig_done_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(finishedFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take oldTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                finishedFile, 1000, "Finished Take", "M4A");
        String finishedRawPath = new File(dir, "orig_done_raw.wav").getAbsolutePath();
        long finishedSyntheticId = -777777L;
        ConversionJobs.noteTakeRaw(finishedSyntheticId, finishedRawPath);
        ConversionJobs.noteCompletion(finishedRawPath, oldTake.id);

        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session 2", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r2 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.FLAC, null,
                finishedSyntheticId, "Finished Take");
        try {
            assertNull("old Take row must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    TakesRepository.find(oldTake.id));
            assertFalse("old file on disk must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    finishedFile.exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must be enqueued immediately", r2.job);
            assertEquals("Finished Take", r2.job.title);
            assertEquals("flac", r2.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r2.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r2.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r2.job.jobId, true);
            ConversionJobs.forgetCompletion(finishedRawPath);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void persistentFloatMasterLifecycleForRecordingsImportsAndCleanup()
            throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // 1) Recorded take saved as M4A: raw 32-bit float file is maintained in .float32/
        File recRaw = new File(dir, "rec_float_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(recRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        File recFinal = new File(dir, "rec_float_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(recFinal, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take recTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                recFinal, 1000, "Recorded Take", "M4A");
        ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                recRaw.getAbsolutePath(), recFinal);
        assertFalse("original scratch raw path must be moved out of takes/",
                recRaw.exists());
        File recMaster = TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(recFinal);
        assertNotNull(recMaster);
        assertTrue("persistent 32-bit float master must exist in .float32/",
                recMaster.exists());
        assertEquals("resolveFloatMaster must return the persistent float32 file",
                recMaster.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(recFinal).getAbsolutePath());
        assertTrue("resolved master must be a native 32-bit float WAV",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(recFinal)));

        // 2) Recorded take saved as WAV32: already 32-bit float -> no redundant copy in .float32/
        File wav32Raw = new File(dir, "rec_w32_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav32Raw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        File wav32Final = new File(dir, "rec_w32_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav32Final, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                wav32Raw.getAbsolutePath(), wav32Final);
        assertFalse("wav32 raw must be deleted to avoid duplicate files",
                wav32Raw.exists());
        assertFalse("wav32 final must not create a redundant .float32 copy",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(wav32Final).exists());
        assertEquals(wav32Final.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(wav32Final).getAbsolutePath());
        wav32Final.delete();

        // 3) Imported recording: no float32 file until first Edit, then persisted on first Edit
        File impFile = new File(dir, "imp_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(impFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wav16Header(1, 48000, 4800L * 2));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 2]);
        }
        Take impTake = TakesRepository.addImported(
                impFile, 1000, "Imported Take", "WAV");
        assertEquals("imported", impTake.origin);
        assertFalse("imported file must not have a float32 master before first edit",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
        assertFalse("16-bit imported file is not native float32 yet",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(impFile)));

        // Simulate first Edit press on the imported take
        File firstEditSession = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(
                impFile, dir, "Imported_Take", null);
        TakesRepository.saveFloatMasterCopy(firstEditSession, impFile);
        firstEditSession.delete();
        assertTrue("float32 master must be created and persisted on first edit",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
        assertTrue("subsequent edits must resolve directly to native float32 master",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(impFile)));

        // 3b) Renaming a converted library-visible recording renames the disk
        // file while keeping its immutable ID and .float32/rec_<id>.f32.wav link intact!
        long recImmutableId = recTake.id;
        assertEquals("rec_" + recImmutableId + ".f32.wav", recMaster.getName());
        TakesRepository.rename(recImmutableId, "Renamed Chorus Vocal");
        Take afterRename = TakesRepository.find(recImmutableId);
        assertNotNull(afterRename);
        assertEquals("Renamed Chorus Vocal", afterRename.title);
        File renamedDiskFile = new File(afterRename.filePath);
        assertTrue("renamed converted file must exist on disk",
                renamedDiskFile.exists());
        assertTrue("renamed file name must reflect new title",
                renamedDiskFile.getName().startsWith("Renamed_Chorus_Vocal"));
        assertEquals("ID-linked float32 master must still resolve after rename",
                recMaster.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(
                        recImmutableId, renamedDiskFile).getAbsolutePath());

        // 4) Replace & Delete clean up both the main file and the .float32 master
        assertTrue(TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(recTake.id));
        assertFalse("replaced take file must be deleted", renamedDiskFile.exists());
        assertFalse("replaced take float32 master must be deleted",
                recMaster.exists());

        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(impTake.id);
        assertFalse("deleted imported file must be removed", impFile.exists());
        assertFalse("deleted imported float32 master must be removed",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impTake.id, impFile).exists());
    }

    @Test
    public void firstRecordingAllowsAllEditsAfterSavingAndReplacingWhileSecondBlocks()
            throws Exception {
        for (Take t : new java.util.ArrayList<>(TakesRepository.all())) {
            TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(t.id);
        }
        for (ConversionJob j : new java.util.ArrayList<>(ConversionJobs.active())) {
            ConversionJobs.cancel(j.jobId, true);
        }
        ctx().getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().clear().commit();

        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = TrialAndBillingManager.get(ctx());
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(-1L);
        assertTrue("Fresh first recording must allow all features",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(-1L));

        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File f1 = new File(dir, "first_take_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f1, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take firstTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(f1, 2000L, "First Take", "M4A");
        assertEquals(firstTake.id, mgr.getFreeRecordingId());

        // Editing the first recording after saving it once MUST still be allowed
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(firstTake.id);
        assertTrue("Editing first recording after saving once must be allowed",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(firstTake.id));

        // Replacing the first recording preserves its immutable ID and keeps edits allowed
        File f1Replaced = new File(dir, "first_take_rep_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f1Replaced, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take replacedFirst = TakesRepository.replaceRecording(
                firstTake.id, f1Replaced, 2500L, "First Take Edited", "M4A");
        assertEquals("Immutable ID must be preserved on Replace",
                firstTake.id, replacedFirst.id);
        assertTrue("Editing first recording after Replace must still be allowed",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(replacedFirst.id));

        // Starting a 2nd recording (-1) or editing a 2nd recording must be blocked
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(-1L);
        assertFalse("Starting a 2nd recording must be gated by paywall",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(-1L));

        File f2 = new File(dir, "second_take_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f2, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take secondTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(f2, 2000L, "Second Take", "M4A");
        assertFalse("Editing 2nd recording must be gated by paywall",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(secondTake.id));
        assertTrue("Editing 1st recording must still be allowed even after 2nd recording exists",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(replacedFirst.id));

        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replacedFirst.id);
        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(secondTake.id);
    }

    @Test
    public void formatConversionReportsGranularProgressCallbacks() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "prog_test_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        int samples = 48000; // 1 second mono
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, samples * 4L));
            w.write(new byte[samples * 4]);
        }
        File out = new File(dir, "prog_test_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        java.util.List<Integer> ticks = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try {
            FormatConverter.toWav16(raw, out, ticks::add);
            assertTrue("Expected multiple granular progress updates for 1s audio, got " + ticks.size(),
                    ticks.size() >= 10);
            assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(100), ticks.get(ticks.size() - 1));
        } finally {
            raw.delete();
            out.delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * WAV resume is byte-exact: a conversion interrupted halfway and resumed
 * must produce a file identical to an uninterrupted conversion. That is the
 * mechanism behind "minimum reconversion".
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConversionResumeTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    private File makeRaw(String name, int frames) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), name);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(11);
            byte[] chunk = new byte[65536];
            long left = (long) frames * 2 * 4;
            while (left > 0) {
                int n = (int) Math.min(chunk.length, left);
                rnd.nextBytes(chunk);
                w.write(chunk, 0, n);
                left -= n;
            }
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static byte[] slurp(File f) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            byte[] out = new byte[(int) r.length()];
            r.readFully(out);
            return out;
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void resumedWav16IsByteIdentical() throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-src.wav", 48000);
        try {
            // Uninterrupted reference conversion.
            TakeSaver.Result full = TakeSaver.convertRaw(ctx(), raw,
                    "Resume", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, null);
            byte[] expect;
            try {
                expect = slurp(full.file);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                full.file.delete();
            }
            // Interrupted attempt: convert the first 12000 frames by hand
            // into a partial file, exactly as the pump would leave it
            // (12000 stereo frames = 24000 samples).
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume.part");
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(Dsp.wav16Header(2, 48000, 0));
                RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "r");
                try {
                    byte[] in = new byte[12000 * 2 * 4];
                    byte[] out = new byte[12000 * 2 * 2];
                    java.nio.FloatBuffer fb =
                            java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                    .asFloatBuffer();
                    java.nio.ShortBuffer sb =
                            java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                    .asShortBuffer();
                    r.seek(44);
                    r.readFully(in);
                    FormatConverter.toInt16(fb, 12000 * 2, sb);
                    w.write(out);
                } finally {
                    r.close();
                }
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-1", "Resume",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "memo", "wav16", 2, 96000, 1000, 48000);
            job.framesDone = 12000;
            TakeSaver.Result resumed = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                    job, null);
            byte[] got;
            try {
                got = slurp(resumed.file);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                resumed.file.delete();
            }
            assertEquals("resumed length differs",
                    expect.length, got.length);
            assertTrue("resumed bytes differ",
                    Arrays.equals(expect, got));
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void resumedWav32IsByteIdentical() throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-src32.wav", 48000);
        try {
            TakeSaver.Result full = TakeSaver.convertRaw(ctx(), raw,
                    "Resume32", RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV32, null);
            byte[] expect;
            try {
                expect = slurp(full.file);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                full.file.delete();
            }
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume32.part");
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            int doneFrames = 12000;
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 0));
                RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "r");
                try {
                    byte[] in = new byte[doneFrames * 2 * 4];
                    r.seek(44);
                    r.readFully(in);
                    w.write(in);
                } finally {
                    r.close();
                }
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-32", "Resume32",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "music", "wav32", 2, 384000, 1000, 48000);
            job.framesDone = doneFrames;
            TakeSaver.Result resumed = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MUSIC, SaveFormat.WAV32,
                    job, null);
            byte[] got;
            try {
                got = slurp(resumed.file);
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(resumed.file, SaveFormat.WAV32);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                resumed.file.delete();
            }
            assertEquals("resumed length differs", expect.length, got.length);
            assertTrue("resumed bytes differ", Arrays.equals(expect, got));
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void misalignedPartialRestartsCleanly() throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-src2.wav", 48000);
        try {
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume2.part");
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            try {
                // Garbage length: cannot line up with any frame count.
                w.write(new byte[100]);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-2", "Resume",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "memo", "wav16", 2, 96000, 1000, 48000);
            job.framesDone = 12000;
            TakeSaver.Result r = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                    job, null);
            try {
                assertTrue(r.file.length() > 1000);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                r.file.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    /**
     * AUDIT-3-01: a resumed WAV16/WAV24 take is integer PCM, so the duration
     * must come from a PCM-aware reader. Before the fix every resumed take
     * landed in the library as 00:01.
     */
    @Test
    public void resumedWavKeepsRealDuration() throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-dur.wav", 48000 * 3);
        try {
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume-dur.part");
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-dur", "Dur",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "memo", "wav16", 2, 96000, 1000, 144000);
            job.framesDone = 144000; // already fully encoded
            TakeSaver.Result r = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                    job, null);
            try {
                assertTrue("resumed take duration " + r.durationMs
                                + "ms (expected ~3000)",
                        r.durationMs > 2500L && r.durationMs < 3500L);
                assertEquals(3000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(r.file));
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                r.file.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    /**
     * AUDIT-3-02(b): `job.framesDone` is only a 5%-rounded estimate while a
     * conversion runs, so it must not be trusted over a valid, frame-aligned
     * partial already on disk.
     */
    @Test
    public void resumeAdoptsFrameAlignedPartialDespiteStaleFramesDone()
            throws Exception {
        File raw = makeRaw("resume-est.wav", 48000);
        try {
            File part = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "resume-est.part");
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            part.delete();
            int doneFrames = 12000;
            // Fill the partial with a marker value that a fresh conversion
            // could never produce, so "was the partial adopted?" is directly
            // observable in the result.
            final short MARK = 9999;
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(part, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(Dsp.wav16Header(2, 48000, 0));
                byte[] out = new byte[doneFrames * 2 * 2];
                java.nio.ShortBuffer sb =
                        java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(out)
                                .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                                .asShortBuffer();
                for (int i = 0; i < doneFrames * 2; i++) sb.put(i, MARK);
                w.write(out);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            // Deliberately wrong (rounded) estimate, as saved by updateProgress.
            ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("resume-est", "Est",
                    raw.getAbsolutePath(), part.getAbsolutePath(),
                    "memo", "wav16", 2, 96000, 1000, 48000);
            job.framesDone = 11900; // != 12000 on disk
            TakeSaver.Result r = ConversionService.resumeWavConvert(
                    ctx(), raw, part, RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16,
                    job, null);
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(r.file, SaveFormat.WAV16);
                assertEquals(1000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(r.file));
                // The marker must survive at the very front: proof the
                // on-disk partial was adopted instead of being discarded.
                RandomAccessFile r2 =
                        new RandomAccessFile(r.file, "r");
                short first;
                try {
                    byte[] head = new byte[8];
                    r2.seek(44);
                    r2.readFully(head);
                    first = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(head)
                            .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                            .getShort(0);
                } finally {
                    r2.close();
                }
                assertEquals("stale estimate discarded the partial",
                        MARK, first);
            } finally {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                r.file.delete();
            }
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }

    /**
     * AUDIT-3-02(a): enqueue must read geometry from the raw file, not from
     * an idle engine (which reports dataBytes 0 -> framesTotal 1).
     */
    @Test
    public void enqueueReadsGeometryFromRawFile() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        File raw = makeRaw("enqueue-geom.wav", 48000);
        try {
            ConversionJob job = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), raw,
                    "Geom", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.WAV16, 1000);
            assertEquals("channels must come from the raw header",
                    2, job.channels);
            assertEquals("framesTotal must come from the raw header",
                    48000L, job.framesTotal);
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.cancel(job.jobId, true));
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            raw.delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;

import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Drives the library adapter through appear/progress/disappear of a
 * converting card exactly like the live jobs listener does, catching
 * RecyclerView bookkeeping crashes without an emulator round trip.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConvertingCardsBindTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private static class NopListener implements TakesAdapter.Listener {
        public void onCardClick(Take take) {}
        public void onCardLongPress(Take take) {}
        public void onPlay(Take take) {}
        public void onFavorite(Take take) {}
        public void onRename(Take take) {}
        public void onExport(Take take) {}
        public void onEdit(Take take) {}
        public void onDelete(Take take) {}
        public void onCancelConversion(Take take) {}
        public void onSeek(Take take, long posMs) {}
    }

    private static Take roomTake(long id, String title) {
        return new Take(id, title, 60_000L, System.currentTimeMillis(),
                "1.0 MB", "M4A", false, "/tmp/" + title + ".m4a");
    }

    private static Take convertingTake(long id) {
        Take t = new Take(id, "Converting", 60_000L,
                System.currentTimeMillis(), "", "M4A", false, "");
        t.converting = true;
        t.convProgress = 10;
        t.convFormat = "M4A";
        t.convJobId = "job-x";
        t.convRawPath = "/tmp/x.wav";
        t.dateLabel = "Converting to M4A • 10%";
        return t;
    }

    @Test
    public void appearProgressDisappearSurvivesLayouts() {
        Activity a = activity();
        RecyclerView rv = new RecyclerView(a);
        a.setContentView(rv);
        rv.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(a));
        TakesAdapter adapter = new TakesAdapter(new NopListener());
        rv.setAdapter(adapter);

        List<Take> room = new ArrayList<>();
        room.add(roomTake(101, "One"));
        room.add(roomTake(102, "Two"));
        room.add(roomTake(103, "Three"));

        layout(rv);
        adapter.setTakes(new ArrayList<>(room));
        layout(rv);

        // Job appears: converting card pinned at top.
        Take conv = convertingTake(-4294967297L);
        List<Take> withConv = new ArrayList<>();
        withConv.add(conv);
        withConv.addAll(room);
        adapter.setTakes(withConv);
        layout(rv);

        // Progress ticks: direct paints + field updates, like the listener.
        for (int pct = 20; pct <= 90; pct += 10) {
            conv.convProgress = pct;
            adapter.paintConvProgress(rv, conv.id, pct, "Converting");
            layout(rv);
        }

        // Job completes: card gone, finished row on top.
        List<Take> done = new ArrayList<>();
        done.add(roomTake(104, "Converting"));
        done.addAll(room);
        adapter.setTakes(done);
        layout(rv);

        assertTrue("survived all layouts", rv.getChildCount() > 0);
    }

    private static void layout(RecyclerView rv) {
        rv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(320, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(640, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        rv.layout(0, 0, 320, 640);
    }
}

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;

/** Parser for the breadcrumb trail: finds stages that never closed. */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class CrashLogTest {

    private void clearCrumbs(Context ctx) {
        File f = new File(ctx.getApplicationContext().getFilesDir(),
                "takeone-breadcrumbs.txt");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void unterminatedConvertIsFound() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        clearCrumbs(ctx);
        assertNull(CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "finalize start");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "finalize end");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start opus");
        assertEquals("convert opus", CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert end opus");
        assertNull(CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void autoSwitchConsumesPending() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        clearCrumbs(ctx);
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start flac");
        assertEquals("convert flac", CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "auto-switch flac->m4a");
        assertNull(CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
    }

    @Test
    public void laterSuccessClearsEarlierStart() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        clearCrumbs(ctx);
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start m4a");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert end m4a");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert start wav16");
        CrashLog.breadcrumb(ctx, "convert end wav16");
        assertNull(CrashLog.unterminatedStage(ctx));
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/DspAudioFixTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.junit.Assert.fail;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Regression tests for the audit fixes: RIFF chunk scanning (BUG-06),
 * streaming resampling (BUG-01), bit-exact chunked decimation (BUG-03),
 * little-endian sample I/O (BUG-09) and waveform peak loading (BUG-04).
 */
public class DspAudioFixTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    // ---- BUG-06: chunk walker ----

    private static void writeChunk(RandomAccessFile w, String id, byte[] payload)
            throws Exception {
        w.write(new byte[]{(byte) id.charAt(0), (byte) id.charAt(1),
                (byte) id.charAt(2), (byte) id.charAt(3)});
        ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.allocate(4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.putInt(payload.length);
        w.write(b.array());
        w.write(payload);
        if ((payload.length & 1) == 1) w.write(0); // word alignment
    }

    @Test
    public void parseWavHeaderFindsDataAfterJunk() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("junky.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[]{'R', 'I', 'F', 'F', 0, 0, 0, 0,
                    'W', 'A', 'V', 'E'});
            writeChunk(w, "JUNK", new byte[16]);
            ByteBuffer fmt = ByteBuffer.allocate(16)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
            fmt.putShort((short) 3);
            fmt.putShort((short) 1);
            fmt.putInt(48000);
            fmt.putInt(48000 * 4);
            fmt.putShort((short) 4);
            fmt.putShort((short) 32);
            writeChunk(w, "fmt ", fmt.array());
            writeChunk(w, "LIST", new byte[12]);
            byte[] pcm = new byte[480 * 4];
            ByteBuffer.wrap(pcm).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
                    .asFloatBuffer().put(new float[480]);
            writeChunk(w, "data", pcm);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        Dsp.WavHeader h;
        try {
            h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
        assertEquals(3, h.audioFormat);
        assertEquals(1, h.channels);
        assertEquals(48000, h.sampleRate);
        assertEquals(32, h.bits);
        // 12 (riff) + 24 (junk) + 24 (fmt) + 20 (list) + 8 (data hdr).
        assertEquals(88, h.dataStart);
        assertEquals(480 * 4L, h.dataBytes);
        // Duration must agree through the scanner too.
        assertEquals(10L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(f));
    }

    @Test
    public void parseWavHeaderRejectsNonWav() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("nope.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[100]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            fail("non-wav parsed");
        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    // ---- BUG-01: resampler ----

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, int rate, double freq,
                                float amp) {
        float[] s = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float v = (float) (amp * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * f / rate));
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) s[f * ch + c] = v;
        }
        return s;
    }

    private static float[] concat(float[]... parts) {
        int n = 0;
        for (float[] p : parts) n += p.length;
        float[] out = new float[n];
        int p = 0;
        for (float[] part : parts) {
            System.arraycopy(part, 0, out, p, part.length);
            p += part.length;
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Zero-crossing pitch estimate on channel 0. */
    private static double pitchHz(float[] s, int ch, int rate) {
        int crossings = 0;
        int n = s.length / ch;
        float prev = s[0];
        for (int f = 1; f < n; f++) {
            float cur = s[f * ch];
            if ((prev <= 0f && cur > 0f) || (prev >= 0f && cur < 0f)) {
                crossings++;
            }
            prev = cur;
        }
        double seconds = (double) n / rate;
        return crossings / 2.0 / seconds;
    }

    @Test
    public void resamplerUpsamplePreservesDurationAndPitch() {
        // 8 kHz AMR-geometry mono -> 48 kHz session, fed in uneven chunks.
        float[] in = sine(8000, 1, 8000, 440.0, 0.5f);
        Dsp.Resampler r = new Dsp.Resampler(8000, 48000, 1);
        float[] a = r.push(in, 1000);
        float[] b = r.push(java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(in, 1000, 4000), 3000);
        float[] c = r.push(java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(in, 4000, 8000), 4000);
        float[] tail = r.flush();
        float[] out = concat(a, b, c, tail);
        assertEquals(48000, out.length, 4);
        assertEquals(440.0, pitchHz(out, 1, 48000), 3.0);
        float peak = 0f;
        for (float v : out) {
            if (Float.isNaN(v)) fail("NaN in resampled output");
            peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v));
        }
        assertEquals(0.5f, peak, 0.06f);
    }

    @Test
    public void resamplerChunkingMatchesOneShot() {
        float[] in = sine(4410, 2, 44100, 440.0, 0.4f);
        Dsp.Resampler one = new Dsp.Resampler(44100, 48000, 2);
        float[] o1 = concat(one.push(in, 4410), one.flush());
        Dsp.Resampler two = new Dsp.Resampler(44100, 48000, 2);
        float[] p1 = two.push(java.util.Arrays.copyOf(in, 2000), 1000);
        float[] p2 = two.push(
                java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(in, 2000, 8820), 3410);
        float[] o2 = concat(p1, p2, two.flush());
        assertArrayEquals(o1, o2, 0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void resamplerDownsampleKillsAliases() {
        // 96 kHz stereo: 440 Hz tone + 30 kHz tone above the 24 kHz Nyquist.
        int frames = 9600;
        float[] in = new float[frames * 2];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float v = (float) (0.4 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440 * f / 96000)
                    + 0.4 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 30000 * f / 96000));
            in[f * 2] = v;
            in[f * 2 + 1] = v;
        }
        Dsp.Resampler r = new Dsp.Resampler(96000, 48000, 2);
        float[] out = concat(r.push(in, frames), r.flush());
        int outFrames = out.length / 2;
        assertEquals(4800, outFrames, 4);
        // Skip the FIR leading-edge transient (first 128 frames): any
        // finite filter rings while its delay line fills, which is normal
        // and inaudible, but it would pollute a crossing count.
        int skip = 128;
        float[] steady = java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(out,
                skip * 2, out.length);
        int steadyFrames = outFrames - skip;
        assertEquals(440.0, pitchHz(steady, 2, 48000), 5.0);
        // Fit the 440 Hz amplitude delay-independently (any FIR delays by
        // its group delay): quadrature correlation gives the true passband
        // gain, and the residual proves the 30 kHz alias is (nearly) gone.
        double ss = 0, sc = 0, cc = 0, ys = 0, yc = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < steadyFrames; f++) {
            double ph = 2 * Math.PI * 440 * (f + skip) / 48000;
            double s = Math.sin(ph);
            double c = Math.cos(ph);
            double y = steady[f * 2];
            ss += s * s;
            sc += s * c;
            cc += c * c;
            ys += y * s;
            yc += y * c;
        }
        double det = ss * cc - sc * sc;
        double ampA = (ys * cc - yc * sc) / det;
        double ampB = (ss * yc - sc * ys) / det;
        double amp = Math.sqrt(ampA * ampA + ampB * ampB);
        assertEquals(0.4, amp, 0.05);
        double resid = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < steadyFrames; f++) {
            double ph = 2 * Math.PI * 440 * (f + skip) / 48000;
            double d = steady[f * 2]
                    - (ampA * Math.sin(ph) + ampB * Math.cos(ph));
            resid += d * d;
        }
        assertTrue("alias leaked, residual rms="
                        + Math.sqrt(resid / steadyFrames),
                Math.sqrt(resid / steadyFrames) < 0.06);
    }

    @Test
    public void resamplerPassthroughIsIdentity() {
        float[] in = sine(1000, 2, 48000, 440.0, 0.3f);
        Dsp.Resampler r = new Dsp.Resampler(48000, 48000, 2);
        assertArrayEquals(in, r.push(in, 1000), 0f);
        assertEquals(0, r.flush().length);
    }

    // ---- BUG-03: chunked decimation is bit-exact vs batch ----

    @Test
    public void firDecimatorMatchesBatchExactly() {
        Random rnd = new Random(1234);
        int frames = 4800;
        int decim = 6;
        int taps = 64;
        float[] fir = Dsp.firLowpass(3400.0 / 48000, taps);
        float[] mono = new float[frames];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            mono[i] = rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f;
        }
        // Batch reference: the old whole-file loop, verbatim math.
        int delay = taps / 2;
        int half = taps / 2;
        int outLen = frames / decim;
        short[] expect = new short[outLen];
        for (int o = 0; o < outLen; o++) {
            float acc = 0f;
            int center = o * decim - delay;
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                int i1 = center + k;
                int i2 = center + taps - 1 - k;
                float s1 = (i1 >= 0 && i1 < frames) ? mono[i1] : 0f;
                float s2 = (i2 >= 0 && i2 < frames) ? mono[i2] : 0f;
                acc += s1 * fir[k] + s2 * fir[taps - 1 - k];
            }
            if (acc > 1f) acc = 1f;
            else if (acc < -1f) acc = -1f;
            expect[o] = (short) (acc * 32767f);
        }
        // Streamed: odd-sized pushes plus a flush.
        Dsp.FirDecimator dec = new Dsp.FirDecimator(decim, fir);
        short[] got = new short[outLen + 64];
        int p = 0;
        p += dec.push(mono, 1000, got, p);
        float[] rest = java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(mono, 1000, frames);
        p += dec.push(rest, frames - 1000, got, p);
        p += dec.flush(frames, got, p);
        assertEquals("output count " + p + " != batch " + outLen,
                outLen, p);
        assertArrayEquals(expect, java.util.Arrays.copyOf(got, p));
    }

    @Test
    public void firDecimatorOutputCountMatchesBatchRule() {
        // Non-multiple length: total outputs must be totalIn/decim.
        Dsp.FirDecimator dec =
                new Dsp.FirDecimator(6, Dsp.firLowpass(3400.0 / 48000, 64));
        int total = 25 * 6 + 3;
        float[] zeros = new float[total];
        short[] out = new short[total];
        int p = dec.push(zeros, total, out, 0);
        p += dec.flush(total, out, p);
        assertEquals(total / 6, p);
    }

    // ---- BUG-09: little-endian I/O ----

    @Test
    public void writeFloatsLERoundTrips() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("le.wav");
        float[] vals = {0f, 1f, -1f, 0.5f, -0.25f, 1e-7f, 3.14159f, -2.5f};
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, vals, 0, vals.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            byte[] raw = new byte[vals.length * 4];
            r.readFully(raw);
            java.nio.FloatBuffer fb = ByteBuffer.wrap(raw)
                    .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).asFloatBuffer();
            for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
                assertEquals("sample " + i, vals[i], fb.get(), 0f);
            }
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    // ---- BUG-04: peak loading ----

    @Test
    public void loadPeaksReflectsEnvelope() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("env.wav");
        int frames = 48000;
        float[] s = new float[frames * 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            float amp = i < frames / 2 ? 0.5f : 0.1f;
            float v = amp * (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05);
            s[i * 2] = v;
            s[i * 2 + 1] = v * 0.5f;
        }
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, s, 0, s.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        float[] peaks = Dsp.loadPeaks(f, 8192);
        assertTrue("no peaks", peaks.length > 10);
        float first = 0f, second = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < peaks.length / 2; i++) {
            first = Math.max(first, peaks[i]);
        }
        for (int i = peaks.length / 2; i < peaks.length; i++) {
            second = Math.max(second, peaks[i]);
        }
        assertEquals(0.5f, first, 0.06f);
        assertEquals(0.1f, second, 0.03f);
    }
}
