package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

public class DspBugFixesTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static boolean changed(float[] a, float[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || a.length != b.length) return true;
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(a[i] - b[i]) > 1e-4f) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static File writeWav(File dir, String name, float[] data, int ch) throws Exception {
        dir.mkdirs();
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, SR, data.length * 4L));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, data, 0, data.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    // Amplify: amp_peak ("New Peak") must have an effect even with amp_gain 0.
    @Test
    public void amplifyNewPeakAttenuatesSignal() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "dspfixamp");
        float[] buf = sine(2400, 1, 440, 0.8f);
        File wav = writeWav(dir, "amp.wav", buf, 1);
        AmplifyProcessor p = new AmplifyProcessor();
        p.getParam("amp_gain").setFloat(0f);
        p.getParam("amp_peak").setFloat(-6f); // target peak ~0.5
        p.getParam("amp_clip").setBoolean(false);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.prepareOffline(wav, 0, 2400, SR, 1);
        assertTrue("Amplify must be audible when newPeak is set",
                p.isAudible());
        float[] copy = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(copy, 2400, 1);
        assertTrue("Amplify with newPeak did not change the signal",
                changed(buf, copy));
        // Peak must not exceed the -6 dBFS target (with small tolerance).
        float pk = 0f;
        for (float v : copy) pk = Math.max(pk, Math.abs(v));
        assertTrue("Amplify exceeded newPeak target: " + pk,
                pk <= Dsp.dbToLin(-6f) * 1.05f);
    }

    // Brickwall limiter: release must not zero gainDb on the first post-hold sample.
    @Test
    public void brickwallLimiterRespectsRelease() {
        BrickwallLimiterProcessor p = new BrickwallLimiterProcessor();
        p.getParam("lim_gain").setFloat(12f);
        p.getParam("lim_ceiling").setFloat(-1f);
        p.getParam("lim_release").setFloat(200f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] buf = sine(SR / 2, 1, 200, 0.95f);
        float[] orig = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(buf, SR / 2, 1);
        assertTrue("Brickwall limiter produced no change", changed(orig, buf));
    }

    // ChangeTempo: +25% tempo must shorten the output (stretch < 1).
    @Test
    public void changeTempoPositivePercentShortens() {
        ChangeTempoProcessor t = new ChangeTempoProcessor();
        t.getParam("tempo_percent").setFloat(25f);
        t.prepare(SR, 2);
        float[] src = sine(9600, 2, 440, 0.5f);
        float[] out = t.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Tempo +25% did not shorten output: " + out.length,
                out.length < src.length);
    }

    // SlidingStretch: inverted sign fix -> positive initial tempo shortens.
    @Test
    public void slidingStretchPositiveTempoShortens() {
        SlidingStretchProcessor s = new SlidingStretchProcessor();
        s.getParam("slide_init").setFloat(40f);
        s.getParam("slide_final").setFloat(40f);
        s.prepare(SR, 2);
        float[] src = sine(9600, 2, 440, 0.5f);
        float[] out = s.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Sliding stretch did not change length", out.length != src.length);
    }

    // Paulstretch: output length matches stretch and is not mostly zeros.
    @Test
    public void paulstretchProducesNonZeroOutput() {
        PaulstretchProcessor p = new PaulstretchProcessor();
        p.getParam("paul_factor").setFloat(4f);
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        float[] src = sine(9600, 2, 440, 0.5f);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertEquals("Paulstretch output length mismatch",
                (int) Math.round(9600 * 4f), out.length / 2);
        // RMS must not be tiny (no 83-96% dead zeros).
        double sum = 0;
        for (float v : out) sum += (double) v * v;
        double rms = Math.sqrt(sum / out.length);
        assertTrue("Paulstretch output is mostly zeros, rms=" + rms, rms > 0.05);
    }

    // Repair: output must stay bounded (no +41 dBFS blow-up).
    @Test
    public void repairDoesNotBlowUp() {
        RepairProcessor r = new RepairProcessor();
        r.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 1, 300, 0.5f);
        for (int i = 1200; i < 1240; i++) buf[i] = 0f;
        float inPeak = 0f;
        for (float v : buf) inPeak = Math.max(inPeak, Math.abs(v));
        r.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 1);
        float outPeak = 0f;
        for (float v : buf) outPeak = Math.max(outPeak, Math.abs(v));
        assertTrue("Repair blew up: peak " + outPeak, outPeak <= inPeak * 2f + 0.1f);
    }

    // StereoImaging on mono must not be a no-op.
    @Test
    public void stereoImagingWorksOnMono() {
        StereoImagingProcessor s = new StereoImagingProcessor();
        s.getParam("st_width").setCurrentRaw(150);
        s.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 1, 440, 0.5f);
        float[] orig = buf.clone();
        s.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 1);
        assertTrue("Stereo imaging on mono produced no change",
                changed(orig, buf));
    }

    // ClickRemoval: click_width controls removal (spike removed).
    @Test
    public void clickRemovalRemovesSpike() {
        ClickRemovalProcessor c = new ClickRemovalProcessor();
        c.getParam("click_thresh").setCurrentRaw(200);
        c.getParam("click_width").setCurrentRaw(10);
        c.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 1, 500, 0.3f);
        buf[2400] = 0.95f;
        buf[2401] = -0.9f;
        float[] orig = buf.clone();
        c.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 1);
        assertTrue("Click removal produced no change", changed(orig, buf));
        assertTrue("Spike not reduced", Math.abs(buf[2400]) < 0.9f);
    }

    // ProDeEsser: threshold calibration triggers on sibilance.
    @Test
    public void proDeEsserModifiesSibilance() {
        ProDeEsserProcessor d = new ProDeEsserProcessor();
        d.getParam("amt").setCurrentRaw(45);
        d.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] buf = new float[4800];
        for (int f = 0; f < 4800; f++) {
            buf[f] = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 6800 * f / SR) * 0.5);
        }
        float[] orig = buf.clone();
        d.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 1);
        assertTrue("Pro de-esser produced no change", changed(orig, buf));
    }

    // ParametricEq6Band: labels renamed (Low/High Cut Slope).
    @Test
    public void parametricEqCutSlopeLabels() {
        ParametricEq6BandProcessor p = new ParametricEq6BandProcessor();
        assertEquals("Low Cut Slope", p.getParam("b1s").name);
        assertEquals("High Cut Slope", p.getParam("b6s").name);
    }

    // AudioGenerator: noise wave indices map to distinct types (no crash, output differs).
    @Test
    public void audioGeneratorNoiseTypesDiffer() {
        AudioGeneratorTool g1 = new AudioGeneratorTool();
        g1.getParam("gen_type").setEnumIndex(1); // Noise
        g1.getParam("gen_wave").setEnumIndex(0); // White
        g1.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] o1 = g1.processOfflineRegion(new float[1024], 1024, 1);

        AudioGeneratorTool g2 = new AudioGeneratorTool();
        g2.getParam("gen_type").setEnumIndex(1);
        g2.getParam("gen_wave").setEnumIndex(4); // Velvet
        g2.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] o2 = g2.processOfflineRegion(new float[1024], 1024, 1);
        assertTrue("Different noise types produced identical output",
                changed(o1, o2));
    }

    // Phaser/Tremolo/Wahwah: LFO phase maxRaw is 355 (not 360).
    @Test
    public void lfoPhaseMaxRawIs355() {
        assertEquals(355, new PhaserProcessor().getParam("ph_phase").maxRaw);
        assertEquals(355, new TremoloProcessor().getParam("tr_phase").maxRaw);
        assertEquals(355, new WahwahProcessor().getParam("wah_phase").maxRaw);
    }

    // Compressor: noise floor freezes make-up below floor.
    @Test
    public void compressorNoiseFloorFreezesMakeup() {
        CompressorProcessor c = new CompressorProcessor();
        c.getParam("dyncomp_thresh").setFloat(-18f);
        c.getParam("dyncomp_ratio").setFloat(4f);
        c.getParam("dyncomp_floor").setFloat(-40f);
        c.prepare(SR, 1);
        // Very quiet signal below floor: must not be boosted.
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 1, 500, 0.0005f);
        float[] orig = buf.clone();
        c.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 1);
        // Should not increase peak.
        float pkOrig = 0f, pkAfter = 0f;
        for (float v : orig) pkOrig = Math.max(pkOrig, Math.abs(v));
        for (float v : buf) pkAfter = Math.max(pkAfter, Math.abs(v));
        assertTrue("Compressor boosted below-floor noise: " + pkOrig + " -> " + pkAfter,
                pkAfter <= pkOrig * 1.5f + 1e-4f);
    }

    // LoudnessNormalization: loud_mode selects RMS vs LUFS.
    @Test
    public void loudnessModeSelectsMeasurement() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "dspfixloud");
        float[] buf = sine(96000, 1, 1000, 0.1f);
        File wav = writeWav(dir, "loud.wav", buf, 1);

        LoudnessNormalizationProcessor lufs = new LoudnessNormalizationProcessor();
        lufs.getParam("loud_mode").setEnumIndex(0); // LUFS
        lufs.getParam("loud_target").setFloat(-16f);
        lufs.prepare(SR, 1);
        lufs.prepareOffline(wav, 0, 96000, SR, 1);
        float[] c1 = buf.clone();
        lufs.processInPlace(c1, 96000, 1);
        assertTrue("LUFS mode produced no change", changed(buf, c1));

        LoudnessNormalizationProcessor rms = new LoudnessNormalizationProcessor();
        rms.getParam("loud_mode").setEnumIndex(1); // RMS dBFS
        rms.getParam("loud_target").setFloat(-16f);
        rms.prepare(SR, 1);
        rms.prepareOffline(wav, 0, 96000, SR, 1);
        float[] c2 = buf.clone();
        rms.processInPlace(c2, 96000, 1);
        assertTrue("RMS mode produced no change", changed(buf, c2));
    }

    // Normalize: norm_rms and norm_indep honored in non-scanned path.
    @Test
    public void normalizeHonorsRmsAndIndependent() {
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 2, 440, 0.1f);
        // add DC offset
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) buf[i] += 0.2f;
        NormalizeProcessor p = new NormalizeProcessor();
        p.getParam("norm_target").setFloat(-6f);
        p.getParam("norm_rms").setBoolean(true);
        p.getParam("norm_peak").setBoolean(false);
        p.getParam("norm_indep").setBoolean(true);
        p.getParam("norm_dc").setBoolean(true);
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        // not scanned -> uses new exact path
        float[] copy = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(copy, 4800, 2);
        double mean = 0;
        for (float v : copy) mean += v;
        mean /= copy.length;
        assertTrue("DC not removed", Math.abs(mean) < 0.02);
    }

    // Amplify isAudible: true when amp_peak non-zero even amp_gain zero.
    @Test
    public void amplifyIsAudibleOnPeakOnly() {
        AmplifyProcessor p = new AmplifyProcessor();
        p.getParam("amp_gain").setFloat(0f);
        p.getParam("amp_peak").setFloat(-3f);
        assertTrue("Amplify not audible with peak-only setting", p.isAudible());
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 2 DSP chain: fast-math accuracy, inactive no-op guarantee,
 * bounded active processing, badge text and persisted configuration.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class DspChainTest {

    @After
    public void clearTakeonePrefs() {
        ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext()
                .getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().clear().commit();
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
    }


    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, float amp) {
        float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) Math.sin(f * 0.03) * amp;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return buf;
    }

    @Test
    public void fastMathSanity() {
        assertEquals(0.0f, DspChain.fastLinToDb(1.0f), 0.5f);
        assertEquals(-20.0f, DspChain.fastLinToDb(0.1f), 1.0f);
        assertEquals(1.0f, DspChain.fastDbToLin(0f), 0.05f);
        assertEquals(0.0f, DspChain.fastDbToLin(-140f), 0.0f);
        float rt = DspChain.fastDbToLin(DspChain.fastLinToDb(0.25f));
        assertEquals(0.25f, rt, 0.03f);
    }

    @Test
    public void inactiveChainIsBitIdenticalNoOp() {
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, new DspChain.Config());
        assertFalse(chain.isActive());
        float[] buf = sine(1024, 2, 0.7f);
        float[] before = buf.clone();
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 1024);
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("touched @" + i, before[i], buf[i], 0.0f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void polishChainStaysBoundedAndAudible() {
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, DspChain.Config.voicePolish());
        assertTrue(chain.isActive());
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 2, 0.9f);
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 4800);
        float peak = 0f;
        boolean changed = false;
        float[] orig = sine(4800, 2, 0.9f);
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            assertTrue("non-finite @" + i, Float.isFinite(buf[i]));
            peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(buf[i]));
            if (Math.abs(buf[i] - orig[i]) > 1e-4f) changed = true;
        }
        assertTrue("silenced, peak=" + peak, peak > 0.05f);
        assertTrue("unbounded, peak=" + peak, peak <= 1.0f);
        assertTrue("chain did nothing", changed);
    }

    @Test
    public void monoChainWorks() {
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(1, DspChain.Config.voicePolish());
        float[] buf = sine(512, 1, 0.5f);
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 512);
        for (float v : buf) assertTrue(Float.isFinite(v));
    }

    @Test
    public void badgeSummaries() {
        assertEquals("FX Off", new DspChain.Config().badgeSummary());
        assertEquals("FX • Polish", DspChain.Config.voicePolish()
                .badgeSummary());
        assertEquals("FX • Custom",
                new DspChain.Config(false, 30, 0, 0).badgeSummary());
    }

    @Test
    public void configPersists() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        DspChain.Config c = new DspChain.Config(true, 50, 45, 40);
        c.save(ctx);
        DspChain.Config back = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
        assertTrue(back.hpfEnabled);
        assertEquals(50, back.noisePct);
        assertEquals(45, back.deEssPct);
        assertEquals(40, back.compPct);
    }

    @Test
    public void threeModesSwitchInterchangeably() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        DspChain.Config c = new DspChain.Config();
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_OFF, c.mode);
        assertFalse(c.isActive());

        // 1) Off -> Noise Suppression
        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION, c.mode);
        assertTrue(c.isActive());
        assertEquals(50, c.noisePct);
        assertEquals(45, c.deEssPct);
        assertEquals(40, c.compPct);

        // 2) Noise Suppression -> Custom (previously broken!)
        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, c.mode);
        assertTrue(c.isActive());
        assertEquals("FX • Custom", c.badgeSummary());

        // Adjust a custom slider and switch back to Noise Suppression, then Custom
        c.noisePct = 75;
        c.onManualAdjustment();
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, c.mode);

        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_NOISE_SUPPRESSION, c.mode);
        assertEquals(50, c.noisePct);

        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, c.mode);
        assertEquals(75, c.noisePct);

        // 3) Custom -> Off -> Custom
        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_OFF);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_OFF, c.mode);
        assertFalse(c.isActive());

        c.applyMode(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, c.mode);
        assertEquals(75, c.noisePct);

        c.save(ctx);
        DspChain.Config loaded = DspChain.Config.load(ctx);
        assertEquals(DspChain.Config.MODE_CUSTOM, loaded.mode);
        assertEquals(75, loaded.noisePct);
    }

    @Test
    public void proFxRackPresetsCheckmarksAndDeletionWork() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.PODCAST_BROADCAST);
        assertTrue(cfg.isActive());
        assertTrue(cfg.enabledSlotCount() >= 5);

        // Unchecking all slots disables processing
        for (DspChain.EffectSlot s : cfg.slots) {
            s.enabled = false;
        }
        cfg.syncLegacyFieldsFromSlots();
        assertFalse(cfg.isActive());

        // Adding a single slot enables it
        DspChain.EffectSlot added = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.WARMTH_BODY);
        assertTrue(added.enabled);
        assertTrue(cfg.isActive());

        // Deleting the slot removes it from the rack
        cfg.removeSlot(added);
        assertFalse(cfg.isActive());
    }

    @Test
    public void allEightEffectsModifySignalWhenEnabled() {
        for (DspChain.EffectType type : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            // The Stages 4-7 families need their own engagement (level tools
            // need a pre-scan, the time tools render offline), so they are
            // covered by their own suites.
            if (!type.isLegacyStage() && !type.isStage3Suite()) continue;
            DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
            cfg.applyPreset(DspChain.Preset.CLEAR_ALL);
            DspChain.EffectSlot slot = cfg.addOrFocusSlot(type);
            if (!type.isLegacyStage()) {
                // The Stage 3 suite defaults to a flat response; dial in a
                // setting that must move the ~229 Hz probe tone. A flat slot
                // is intentionally NOT active (it must not arm save-time
                // baking or push undo state), so assert only after dialing.
                String pid = DspChain.primaryParamId(type);
                if ("out".equals(pid) || "bass".equals(pid)) {
                    slot.value = 300;
                } else if ("gain".equals(pid)) {
                    slot.value = 600;
                } else {
                    slot.value = 229;
                }
            }
            assertTrue("Effect " + type.id + " should be active", cfg.isActive());

            DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
            // A loud sustained tone keeps the physical noise gate fully open
            // (envelope >> threshold), which is gate-correct — feed the gate
            // a quiet tone below its threshold instead.
            float amp = (type == DspChain.EffectType.ROOM_GATE) ? 0.003f : 0.5f;
            // The de-esser only processes the 4.5–9.5 kHz sibilance band BY
            // DESIGN, so a low tone never moves it — feed it a bright 6 kHz
            // sibilant tone instead.
            float[] buf;
            if (type == DspChain.EffectType.DE_ESSER) {
                buf = new float[4800 * 2];
                for (int f = 0; f < 4800; f++) {
                    float s = (float) Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 6000.0
                            * f / 48000.0) * amp;
                    buf[f * 2] = s;
                    buf[f * 2 + 1] = s;
                }
            } else {
                buf = sine(4800, 2, amp);
            }
            float[] orig = buf.clone();
            chain.processInPlace(buf, 4800);
            boolean modified = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
                if (Math.abs(buf[i] - orig[i]) > 1e-4f) {
                    modified = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            assertTrue("Effect " + type.id + " produced no audio change", modified);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.Arrays;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 2 splice helpers: raised-cosine crossfades, edge fades and
 * zero-crossing snap that keep Trim/Cut/Punch-In click-free.
 */
public class DspSpliceTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    @Test
    public void crossfadeBlendsOneToZero() {
        int frames = Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES;
        float[] out = new float[frames];
        float[] in = new float[frames];
        float[] dst = new float[frames];
        Arrays.fill(out, 1f);
        Dsp.crossfadeFrames(out, 0, in, 0, dst, 0, frames, 1);
        assertTrue("head=" + dst[0], dst[0] > 0.99f);
        assertTrue("tail=" + dst[frames - 1], dst[frames - 1] < 0.01f);
        assertTrue("mid=" + dst[frames / 2],
                Math.abs(dst[frames / 2] - 0.5f) < 0.02f);
        for (int f = 1; f < frames; f++) {
            assertTrue("not monotonic at " + f, dst[f] <= dst[f - 1] + 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void crossfadeStereoTracksMonoPerChannel() {
        int frames = 64;
        int ch = 2;
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        float[] in = new float[frames * ch];
        float[] dst = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i += 2) {
            out[i] = 1f;
            out[i + 1] = 0.5f;
        }
        Dsp.crossfadeFrames(out, 0, in, 0, dst, 0, frames, ch);
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            assertEquals(dst[f * 2] * 0.5f, dst[f * 2 + 1], 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeInAndOutShapeEdges() {
        int frames = 240;
        float[] up = new float[frames];
        Arrays.fill(up, 1f);
        Dsp.applyFadeInPlace(up, 0, frames, 1, true);
        assertTrue("fade-in head=" + up[0], up[0] < 0.01f);
        assertTrue("fade-in tail=" + up[frames - 1], up[frames - 1] > 0.99f);
        float[] down = new float[frames];
        Arrays.fill(down, 1f);
        Dsp.applyFadeInPlace(down, 0, frames, 1, false);
        assertTrue("fade-out head=" + down[0], down[0] > 0.99f);
        assertTrue("fade-out tail=" + down[frames - 1],
                down[frames - 1] < 0.01f);
    }

    private File loudWithGap(int frames, int gapStart, int gapEnd)
            throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("snap.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, (long) frames * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                buf[i] = (i >= gapStart && i < gapEnd) ? 0f
                        : (float) Math.sin(i * 0.3) * 0.9f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void snapHoldsPositionInSilence() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File f = loudWithGap(frames, 2000, 2800);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            // Target inside the silent gap: every candidate has zero energy,
            // so the closest frame to the target must win.
            assertEquals(2400L,
                    Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, 2400L, frames, 240));
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void snapPrefersNearbyZeroCrossing() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File f = loudWithGap(frames, 2000, 2800);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            // Target just outside the gap: a true zero crossing 4 frames
            // away must beat the silent gap 100 frames away.
            long snapped = Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, 1900L,
                    frames, 240);
            assertTrue("snapped=" + snapped,
                    snapped >= 1660 && snapped <= 2140);
            r.seek(44L + snapped * 4);
            byte[] b = new byte[4];
            r.readFully(b);
            float v = java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(b)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getFloat();
            assertTrue("energy=" + v, Math.abs(v) < 0.1f);
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void snapClampsEdges() throws Exception {
        int frames = 4800;
        File f = loudWithGap(frames, 2000, 2800);
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            assertEquals(0, Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, 0, frames, 240));
            assertEquals(0, Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, -5, frames, 240));
            assertEquals(frames,
                    Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1, frames, frames, 240));
            assertEquals(frames, Dsp.snapToZeroCrossing(r, 44L, 1,
                    frames + 100, frames, 240));
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Locale;

public class DspTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    // ---- sanitize ----

    @Test
    public void sanitizeBasics() {
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.sanitize(null));
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.sanitize("   "));
        // Every illegal char becomes its own underscore (no collapsing).
        assertEquals("a_b_c_______", Dsp.sanitize("a/b\\c:*?\"<>|"));
        assertEquals("Hello World", Dsp.sanitize("  Hello   World  "));
    }

    @Test
    public void sanitizeTruncates() {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) sb.append('x');
        assertTrue(Dsp.sanitize(sb.toString()).length() <= 60);
    }

    // ---- prettyFileTitle ----

    @Test
    public void prettyStripsStampAndExt() {
        assertEquals("Take My Song",
                Dsp.prettyFileTitle("Take_My_Song_20261011_101500.wav"));
        assertEquals("Take My Song",
                Dsp.prettyFileTitle("Take_My_Song_20261011_101500 (2).m4a"));
        assertEquals("Voice Memo", Dsp.prettyFileTitle("Voice_Memo.m4a"));
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.prettyFileTitle(null));
    }

    // ---- sizeLabel ----

    @Test
    public void sizeLabelMatchesHistory() {
        assertEquals("0.1 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(0));
        assertEquals("4.1 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel((long) (4.1 * 1024 * 1024)));
    }

    // ---- WAV headers ----

    private static int u16(byte[] h, int off) {
        return ByteBuffer.wrap(h).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getShort(off) & 0xFFFF;
    }

    private static int s32(byte[] h, int off) {
        return ByteBuffer.wrap(h).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getInt(off);
    }

    @Test
    public void floatHeaderFields() {
        byte[] h = Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 1000);
        assertEquals('R', h[0]);
        assertEquals('W', h[8]);
        assertEquals('d', h[36]);
        assertEquals(3, u16(h, 20)); // IEEE float
        assertEquals(2, u16(h, 22));
        assertEquals(48000, s32(h, 24));
        assertEquals(32, u16(h, 34));
        assertEquals(1000, s32(h, 40));
        assertEquals(44, h.length);
    }

    @Test
    public void wav16HeaderFields() {
        byte[] h = Dsp.wav16Header(1, 16000, 500);
        assertEquals(1, u16(h, 20)); // PCM
        assertEquals(1, u16(h, 22));
        assertEquals(16000, s32(h, 24));
        assertEquals(16, u16(h, 34));
        assertEquals(500, s32(h, 40));
        // blockAlign = channels * bytesPerSample
        assertEquals(2, u16(h, 32));
    }

    @Test
    public void wav24HeaderFields() {
        byte[] h = Dsp.wav24Header(2, 48000, 900);
        assertEquals('R', h[0]);
        assertEquals('W', h[8]);
        assertEquals('d', h[36]);
        assertEquals(1, u16(h, 20)); // integer PCM, not float
        assertEquals(2, u16(h, 22));
        assertEquals(48000, s32(h, 24));
        assertEquals(24, u16(h, 34));
        // 2 channels * 3 bytes = 6 byte frames; byte rate = rate * align.
        assertEquals(6, u16(h, 32));
        assertEquals(48000 * 6, s32(h, 28));
        assertEquals(900, s32(h, 40));
        assertEquals(44, h.length);
    }

    @Test
    public void pcmHeaderRejectsOddDepth() {
        // Only 16 and 24 are writable; anything else would produce a header
        // no editor could open.
        try {
            Dsp.wavPcmHeader(1, 48000, 20, 100);
            org.junit.Assert.fail("expected rejection of 20-bit PCM");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
            // correct
        }
    }

    // ---- FIR ----

    @Test
    public void firUnityGainAndSymmetric() {
        float[] h = Dsp.firLowpass(3400.0 / 48000.0, 64);
        assertEquals(64, h.length);
        double sum = 0;
        for (float v : h) sum += v;
        assertEquals(1.0, sum, 1e-6);
        for (int i = 0; i < h.length / 2; i++) {
            assertEquals(h[i], h[h.length - 1 - i], 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    // ---- wavDurationMs ----

    private File writeWav(boolean isFloat, int ch, int sr, int frames) throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile(isFloat ? "a.wav" : "b.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        byte[] hdr = isFloat ? Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, sr, (long) frames * ch * 4)
                : Dsp.wav16Header(ch, sr, (long) frames * ch * 2);
        w.write(hdr);
        w.write(new byte[frames * ch * (isFloat ? 4 : 2)]);
        w.close();
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationFloatStereo() throws Exception {
        // 48000 frames stereo @48k = exactly 1 second.
        assertEquals(1000, Dsp.wavDurationMs(writeWav(true, 2, 48000, 48000)));
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationPcm16Mono8k() throws Exception {
        assertEquals(2000, Dsp.wavDurationMs(writeWav(false, 1, 8000, 16000)));
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationPcm24() throws Exception {
        // 24-bit must resolve to the same duration as the equivalent file,
        // or every WAV24 export would show a wrong length in the library.
        File f = tmp.newFile("c24.wav");
        int frames = 24000; // 0.5s @ 48 kHz stereo
        byte[] h = Dsp.wav24Header(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 3);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(h);
            w.write(new byte[frames * 2 * 3]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        assertEquals(500, Dsp.wavDurationMs(f));
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationRejectsGarbage() throws Exception {
        File f = tmp.newFile("x.wav");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        w.write(new byte[10]);
        w.close();
        assertEquals(-1, Dsp.wavDurationMs(f));
        assertEquals(-1, Dsp.wavDurationMs(new File(tmp.getRoot(), "nope.wav")));
    }

    // ---- trash ----

    private File writeBytes(File f, int len) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        w.write(new byte[len]);
        w.close();
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void trashRoundTrip() throws Exception {
        File takes = tmp.newFolder("takes");
        File src = writeBytes(new File(takes, "song.wav"), 100);
        File trashed = Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, src);
        assertTrue(trashed != null && trashed.exists());
        assertTrue(!src.exists());
        assertEquals(100, trashed.length());
        File back = new File(takes, "song.wav");
        assertTrue(Dsp.restoreFromTrashOk(trashed, back));
        assertTrue(back.exists() && !trashed.exists());
    }

    @Test
    public void trashUniquifies() throws Exception {
        File takes = tmp.newFolder("takes2");
        File a = writeBytes(new File(takes, "same.wav"), 10);
        File t1 = Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, a);
        File b = writeBytes(new File(takes, "same.wav"), 10);
        File t2 = Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, b);
        assertTrue(t1 != null && t2 != null && !t1.equals(t2));
    }

    @Test
    public void trashMoveMissingIsNull() throws Exception {
        File takes = tmp.newFolder("takes3");
        assertTrue(Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, new File(takes, "ghost.wav")) == null);
        assertTrue(Dsp.moveToTrash(takes, null) == null);
        assertTrue(!Dsp.restoreFromTrashOk(new File(takes, "ghost.wav"),
                new File(takes, "x.wav")));
    }

    @Test
    public void pruneTrashKeepsFreshKillsOld() throws Exception {
        File trash = tmp.newFolder("trash");
        File fresh = writeBytes(new File(trash, "fresh.wav"), 1000);
        File old = writeBytes(new File(trash, "old.wav"), 2000);
        assertTrue(old.setLastModified(System.currentTimeMillis() - 8L * 24 * 3600_000L));
        long freed = Dsp.pruneTrash(trash, 7L * 24 * 3600_000L);
        assertEquals(2000, freed);
        assertTrue(fresh.exists());
        assertTrue(!old.exists());
        assertEquals(0, Dsp.pruneTrash(null, 1));
    }

    @Test
    public void sanitizeNullAndBlank() {
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.sanitize(null));
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.sanitize("   "));
        // Illegal-only names become underscores, not the fallback.
        assertEquals("___", Dsp.sanitize("///"));
    }

    @Test
    public void prettyFileTitleNull() {
        assertEquals("Take", Dsp.prettyFileTitle(null));
        // No basename before the extension survives as-is.
        assertEquals(".wav", Dsp.prettyFileTitle(".wav"));
    }

    @Test
    public void sizeLabelBoundaries() {
        assertEquals("0.1 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(0));
        assertEquals("0.1 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(1024));
        // 1 MiB = 1048576 bytes -> 10 tenths -> "1.0 MB".
        assertEquals("1.0 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(1048576));
        assertEquals("5.6 MB", Dsp.sizeLabel(5824512L));
    }

    @Test
    public void wavDurationMissingFileIsNegative() {
        assertEquals(-1, Dsp.wavDurationMs(new File(tmp.getRoot(), "nope.wav")));
    }

    @Test
    public void firLengthMatchesTaps() {
        float[] fir = Dsp.firLowpass(0.1, 32);
        assertEquals(32, fir.length);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.junit.Assert.fail;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Roadmap Phase 3 splice engine: trim keeps exactly the selection, cut
 * removes it with a crossfaded bridge, undo restores byte-identical audio,
 * and DSP range commits preserve file geometry.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class EditEngineTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    /** DC 0.5 mono: every frame has identical energy, so zero-crossing snap
     * lands exactly on the requested frame and lengths are deterministic. */
    private File dcRaw(String name, int frames) throws Exception {
        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), name);
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, (long) frames * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(buf, 0.5f);
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private static byte[] bytesOf(File f) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            byte[] b = new byte[(int) r.length()];
            r.readFully(b);
            return b;
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    private static float sampleAt(File f, int frame) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
        try {
            r.seek(44L + (long) frame * 4);
            byte[] b = new byte[4];
            r.readFully(b);
            return java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(b)
                    .order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).getFloat();
        } finally {
            r.close();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void cropKeepsExactlyTheSelection() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("crop.wav", 48000);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        long kept = EditEngine.cropToSelection(raw, 4800, 9600, undo);
        assertEquals(4800L * 4, kept);
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        assertEquals(4800L * 4, info.dataBytes);
        assertEquals(4800, info.dataBytes / 4 / info.channels);
        // Interior untouched by the 5 ms edge fades stays at DC level.
        assertEquals(0.5f, sampleAt(raw, 2400), 0.01f);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
    }

    @Test
    public void cropRejectsTooShortSelection() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("short.wav", 48000);
        try {
            EditEngine.cropToSelection(raw, 100, 200,
                    new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot()));
            fail("expected IllegalArgumentException");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void deleteRemovesSelectionWithBridge() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("cut.wav", 48000);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        long kept = EditEngine.deleteSelection(raw, 4800, 9600, undo);
        // 4800 deleted frames + 240 crossfade-bridge frames are consumed.
        assertEquals((48000L - 4800 - Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES) * 4, kept);
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        assertEquals(kept, info.dataBytes);
        // DC spliced to DC stays DC across the cut boundary.
        assertEquals(0.5f, sampleAt(raw, 4700), 0.02f);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
    }

    @Test
    public void deleteRejectsWholeTake() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("whole.wav", 48000);
        try {
            EditEngine.deleteSelection(raw, 0, 48000,
                    new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot()));
            fail("expected IllegalArgumentException");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void undoRestoresByteIdenticalAudio() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("undo.wav", 48000);
        byte[] before = bytesOf(raw);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        EditEngine.cropToSelection(raw, 4800, 9600, undo);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
        assertTrue(undo.undo(raw));
        assertFalse(undo.canUndo());
        byte[] after = bytesOf(raw);
        assertEquals(before.length, after.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < before.length; i++) {
            if (before[i] != after[i]) fail("byte differs at " + i);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void undoJournalIsBoundedToTenStepsAndSupportsRedo() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("bounded.wav", 48000);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) undo.recordSnapshot(raw);
        assertEquals(10, undo.undoDepth());
        assertFalse(undo.canRedo());
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) assertTrue(undo.undo(raw));
        assertFalse(undo.canUndo());
        assertEquals(10, undo.redoDepth());
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) assertTrue(undo.redo(raw));
        assertFalse(undo.canRedo());
        assertEquals(10, undo.undoDepth());
        // Recording a new snapshot clears the redo stack
        assertTrue(undo.undo(raw));
        assertTrue(undo.canRedo());
        assertTrue(undo.recordSnapshot(raw));
        assertFalse(undo.canRedo());
    }

    @Test
    public void inactiveDspRangeIsNoOpWithoutSnapshot() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("noop.wav", 48000);
        byte[] before = bytesOf(raw);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, 0, 4800,
                new DspChain(1, new DspChain.Config()), undo);
        assertFalse(undo.canUndo());
        byte[] after = bytesOf(raw);
        assertEquals(before.length, after.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < before.length; i++) {
            if (before[i] != after[i]) fail("byte differs at " + i);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void activeDspRangeKeepsGeometry() throws Exception {
        File raw = dcRaw("dsp.wav", 48000);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(raw, 0, 4800,
                new DspChain(1, DspChain.Config.voicePolish()), undo);
        FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
        assertEquals(48000L * 4, info.dataBytes);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
        float mid = sampleAt(raw, 2400);
        assertTrue("non-finite " + mid, Float.isFinite(mid));
        assertTrue("unbounded " + mid, Math.abs(mid) <= 1.0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void variableLengthSelectAndReplaceHandlesShorterAndLongerSegments()
            throws Exception {
        // 1) Create 48,000-frame take (1.0s @ 48 kHz mono)
        File raw = dcRaw("replace_var.wav", 48000);
        File tail = new File(tmp.getRoot(), "replace_var.reptail");
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo = new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        undo.recordSnapshot(raw);

        // Save tail [30000, 48000) (18,000 frames) for replacing [10000, 30000)
        long savedTailFrames = EditEngine.saveTailFrom(raw, 30000, tail);
        assertEquals(18000L, savedTailFrames);

        // Case A: Shorter replacement — user records 5,000 frames starting at 10,000
        // (so replaceEndFrame = 15,000 instead of 30,000)
        long newBytesShort = EditEngine.spliceTailAfterReplace(raw, 15000, tail);
        long expectedFramesShort = 15000L + 18000L - Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES;
        assertEquals(expectedFramesShort * 4L, newBytesShort);

        // Restore via Undo and test Case B: Longer replacement (35,000 frames
        // recorded from 10,000 -> replaceEndFrame = 45,000)
        assertTrue(undo.undo(raw));
        EditEngine.saveTailFrom(raw, 30000, tail);
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw")) {
            raf.seek(44L + 10000L * 4L);
            float[] longerRec = new float[35000];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(longerRec, 0.75f);
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, longerRec, 0, longerRec.length);
            raf.seek(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 45000L * 4L));
        }
        long newBytesLong = EditEngine.spliceTailAfterReplace(raw, 45000, tail);
        long expectedFramesLong = 45000L + 18000L - Dsp.CROSSFADE_FRAMES;
        assertEquals(expectedFramesLong * 4L, newBytesLong);
        assertEquals(0.75f, sampleAt(raw, 25000), 0.01f);
        assertEquals(0.5f, sampleAt(raw, (int) expectedFramesLong - 1000), 0.01f);
    }

    @Test
    public void applyDspChangesOnlyTheCommittedRange() throws Exception {
        // 440 Hz sine: voice polish must audibly reshape it, but only
        // inside the committed range — the rest stays bit-identical.
        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), "sine.wav");
        int frames = 48000;
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, (long) frames * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(
                        i * 2 * Math.PI * 440 / 48000) * 0.7f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        byte[] before = bytesOf(f);
        EditEngine.UndoJournal undo =
                new EditEngine.UndoJournal(tmp.getRoot());
        EditEngine.applyDspToRange(f, 0, 4800,
                new DspChain(1, DspChain.Config.voicePolish()), undo);
        byte[] after = bytesOf(f);
        assertEquals(before.length, after.length);
        assertTrue(undo.canUndo());
        int changed = 0;
        for (int i = 44; i < 44 + 4800 * 4; i++) {
            if (before[i] != after[i]) changed++;
        }
        assertTrue("FX changed nothing in range", changed > 4800);
        for (int i = 44 + 4800 * 4; i < after.length; i++) {
            if (before[i] != after[i]) fail("touched outside range at " + i);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * EditLink stash contract (NEW-06): both the studio pre-prompt and the
 * notification save path rely on save/match/id/title/clear.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class EditLinkTest {

    private android.content.Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void saveMatchAndClearBehave() {
        EditLink.clear(ctx());
        assertFalse(EditLink.matches(ctx(), "/takes/a.wav"));
        EditLink.save(ctx(), 42L, "Original", "/takes/a.wav");
        assertTrue(EditLink.matches(ctx(), "/takes/a.wav"));
        assertFalse(EditLink.matches(ctx(), "/takes/b.wav"));
        assertFalse(EditLink.matches(ctx(), null));
        assertEquals(42L, EditLink.id(ctx()));
        assertEquals("Original", EditLink.title(ctx()));
        EditLink.clear(ctx());
        assertFalse(EditLink.matches(ctx(), "/takes/a.wav"));
        assertEquals(-1L, EditLink.id(ctx()));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Stage 3 EQ suite: verifies the analog prototypes really land on their
 * textbook cutoffs after bilinear transform (edge attenuation, ripple bounds,
 * stopband depth), checks the RBJ biquads, and smoke-tests every processor in
 * the suite plus its DspChain integration.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class EqSuiteTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static double mag(float[][] sections, double f) {
        return Dsp.cascadeMagDb(sections, f, SR);
    }

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double freq, float amp) {
        float[] buf = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * f / SR) * amp;
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) buf[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return buf;
    }

    private static void assertFiniteBounded(float[] buf, float bound) {
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            assertTrue("non-finite @" + i, Float.isFinite(buf[i]));
            assertTrue("unbounded @" + i + " = " + buf[i],
                    Math.abs(buf[i]) <= bound);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- prototypes

    @Test
    public void butterworthEdgeIsMinusThreeDbBothDirections() {
        for (int order : new int[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8}) {
            assertEquals("LP order " + order, -3.01,
                    mag(Dsp.butterworth(order, SR, 1000, false), 1000), 0.2);
            assertEquals("HP order " + order, -3.01,
                    mag(Dsp.butterworth(order, SR, 1000, true), 1000), 0.2);
        }
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(Dsp.butterworth(4, SR, 1000, false), 100), 0.1);
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(Dsp.butterworth(4, SR, 1000, true), 10000), 0.1);
        assertTrue(mag(Dsp.butterworth(8, SR, 1000, false), 10000) < -100);
    }

    @Test
    public void chebyshev1RippleAndEdge() {
        for (double ripple : new double[]{0.5, 1, 3}) {
            for (int order : new int[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8}) {
                float[][] lp = Dsp.chebyshev1(order, ripple, SR, 1000, false);
                float[][] hp = Dsp.chebyshev1(order, ripple, SR, 1000, true);
                assertEquals("LP n" + order + " r" + ripple, -ripple,
                        mag(lp, 1000), 0.35);
                assertEquals("HP n" + order + " r" + ripple, -ripple,
                        mag(hp, 1000), 0.35);
                double lo = 1e9, hi = -1e9;
                for (int i = 0; i <= 240; i++) {
                    double f = 20 * Math.pow(50.0, i / 240.0);
                    double g = mag(lp, f);
                    lo = Math.min(lo, g);
                    hi = Math.max(hi, g);
                }
                assertTrue("ripple peak too high: " + hi, hi <= 0.15);
                assertTrue("ripple floor too low: " + lo, lo >= -ripple - 0.3);
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void chebyshev2EdgeAndStopband() {
        for (double ripple : new double[]{1, 3}) {
            for (int order : new int[]{2, 3, 4, 5, 8}) {
                float[][] lp = Dsp.chebyshev2(order, ripple, SR, 1000, false);
                float[][] hp = Dsp.chebyshev2(order, ripple, SR, 1000, true);
                assertEquals("LP n" + order + " r" + ripple, -ripple,
                        mag(lp, 1000), 0.35);
                assertEquals("HP n" + order + " r" + ripple, -ripple,
                        mag(hp, 1000), 0.35);
                assertEquals("LP passband flat", 0.0, mag(lp, 100), 0.3);
                assertEquals("HP passband flat", 0.0, mag(hp, 10000), 0.3);
            }
        }
        // Type II stopbands are equiripple at -r dB, but its transmission
        // zeros sit exactly on the jw axis: check the notches directly.
        float[][] lp = Dsp.chebyshev2(4, 1.0, SR, 1000, false);
        float[][] hp = Dsp.chebyshev2(4, 1.0, SR, 1000, true);
        double w0 = 2.0 * SR * Math.tan(Math.PI * 1000.0 / SR);
        double lpNotch = invPrewarp(w0 / Math.cos(Math.PI / 8));
        double hpNotch = invPrewarp(w0 * Math.cos(Math.PI / 8));
        assertTrue("LP notch " + mag(lp, lpNotch), mag(lp, lpNotch) < -40);
        assertTrue("HP notch " + mag(hp, hpNotch), mag(hp, hpNotch) < -40);
    }

    private static double invPrewarp(double omega) {
        return Math.atan(omega / (2.0 * SR)) * SR / Math.PI;
    }

    @Test
    public void besselEdgeIsMinusThreeDb() {
        for (int order = 1; order <= 10; order++) {
            assertEquals("LP order " + order, -3.01,
                    mag(Dsp.bessel(order, SR, 1000, false), 1000), 0.45);
            assertEquals("HP order " + order, -3.01,
                    mag(Dsp.bessel(order, SR, 1000, true), 1000), 0.45);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void rbjBiquadsHitTheirTargets() {
        float[][] peak = {Dsp.rbjPeaking(SR, 1000, 1.0, 6.0)};
        assertEquals(6.0, mag(peak, 1000), 0.05);
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(peak, 50), 0.05);
        float[][] notch = {Dsp.rbjNotch(SR, 1000, 8.0)};
        assertTrue("notch depth " + mag(notch, 1000), mag(notch, 1000) < -40);
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(notch, 50), 0.05);
        float[][] lowShelf = {Dsp.rbjLowShelf(SR, 250, 0.707, 6.0)};
        assertEquals(6.0, mag(lowShelf, 40), 0.1);
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(lowShelf, 12000), 0.15);
        float[][] highShelf = {Dsp.rbjHighShelf(SR, 3500, 0.707, -6.0)};
        assertEquals(-6.0, mag(highShelf, 22000), 0.1);
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(highShelf, 60), 0.15);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- processors

    @Test
    public void parametricEq6RunsAndResponds() {
        ParametricEq6BandProcessor p = (ParametricEq6BandProcessor)
                FxRackChain.createProcessor("eq6");
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        p.getParam("b3g").setCurrentRaw(600);
        p.getParam("b3f").setCurrentRaw(1000);
        assertEquals(6.0, mag(p.buildSections(), 1000), 0.3);
        // Far from every band (only untouched 0 dB bells remain there).
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(p.buildSections(), 12000), 0.2);
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 2, 1000, 0.5f);
        p.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 2);
        assertFiniteBounded(buf, 8f);
    }

    @Test
    public void graphicEqBandsShape() {
        GraphicEqProcessor p = (GraphicEqProcessor)
                FxRackChain.createProcessor("geq");
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        p.getParam("g3").setCurrentRaw(-600);
        assertEquals(-6.0, mag(p.buildSections(), 250), 0.6);
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(p.buildSections(), 4000), 0.3);
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 2, 250, 0.5f);
        p.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 2);
        assertFiniteBounded(buf, 8f);
    }

    @Test
    public void clearingOneBandDoesNotLeakItsBiquadState() {
        BiquadFilter filter = new BiquadFilter();
        filter.setSections(new float[][]{
                Dsp.rbjPeaking(SR, 1000, 1.0, 6.0)}, 1);
        float[] loud = sine(512, 1, 1000, 0.5f);
        filter.process(loud, 512, 1);

        filter.setSections(new float[][]{{1f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f}}, 1);
        float[] silence = new float[4];
        filter.process(silence, 4, 1);
        for (float v : silence) {
            assertEquals("removed band leaked filter state", 0f, v, 1e-6f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void filterCurveEqDesignsAndConvolves() {
        FilterCurveEqProcessor p = (FilterCurveEqProcessor)
                FxRackChain.createProcessor("fcurve");
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        p.getParam("pg0").setCurrentRaw(1200);
        float[] buf = sine(4096, 2, 100, 0.5f);
        float peak = 0f;
        p.processInPlace(buf, 4096, 2);
        for (float v : buf) {
            assertTrue(Float.isFinite(v));
            peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v));
        }
        assertTrue("filter-curve EQ silenced the signal", peak > 0.2f);
        assertTrue("filter-curve EQ blew up: " + peak, peak < 4f);
    }

    @Test
    public void slopeFilterOrderMatchesSlope() {
        SlopeFilterProcessor hp = new SlopeFilterProcessor(true);
        hp.prepare(SR, 2);
        hp.getParam("freq").setCurrentRaw(1000);
        hp.getParam("slope").setEnumIndex(4);
        float[][] sections = hp.buildSections();
        assertEquals(3, sections.length);
        assertEquals(-3.01, mag(sections, 1000), 0.3);
        // Butterworth is -3 dB at fc and rolls off *below* fc for a HPF.
        assertTrue(mag(sections, 500) < -25);
    }

    @Test
    public void notchFilterKillsHum() {
        NotchFilterProcessor p = (NotchFilterProcessor)
                FxRackChain.createProcessor("notch");
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        assertTrue(mag(p.buildSections(), 60) < -30);
        assertEquals(0.0, mag(p.buildSections(), 1000), 0.2);
    }

    @Test
    public void shelfAndBassTrebleRun() {
        ShelfFilterProcessor s = (ShelfFilterProcessor)
                FxRackChain.createProcessor("shelf");
        s.prepare(SR, 2);
        s.getParam("gain").setCurrentRaw(600);
        assertEquals(6.0, mag(s.buildSections(), 30), 0.5);

        BassAndTrebleProcessor bt = (BassAndTrebleProcessor)
                FxRackChain.createProcessor("basstreble");
        bt.prepare(SR, 2);
        bt.getParam("bass").setCurrentRaw(600);
        bt.getParam("treble").setCurrentRaw(-600);
        assertEquals(6.0, mag(bt.buildSections(), 30), 0.4);
        assertTrue(mag(bt.buildSections(), 15000) < -4);
        float[] buf = sine(4800, 2, 1000, 0.5f);
        bt.processInPlace(buf, 4800, 2);
        assertFiniteBounded(buf, 8f);
    }

    @Test
    public void classicFiltersServeEveryFamily() {
        ClassicFiltersProcessor p = (ClassicFiltersProcessor)
                FxRackChain.createProcessor("classic");
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        p.getParam("freq").setCurrentRaw(1000);
        p.getParam("order").setCurrentRaw(4);
        for (int type = 0; type <= 3; type++) {
            p.getParam("type").setEnumIndex(type);
            double edge = type == 0 || type == 3 ? -3.01 : -1.0;
            assertEquals("type " + type, edge, mag(p.buildSections(), 1000),
                    type == 3 ? 0.45 : 0.35);
        }
        p.getParam("type").setEnumIndex(0);
        p.getParam("mode").setEnumIndex(1);
        assertEquals("HP mode", -3.01, mag(p.buildSections(), 1000), 0.3);
        assertTrue(mag(p.buildSections(), 250) < -20);
    }

    @Test
    public void enabledSuiteSlotActivatesChain() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        assertTrue(!cfg.isActive());
        DspChain.EffectSlot slot =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.PARAMETRIC_EQ6);
        slot.enabled = true;
        slot.value = 300;
        assertTrue(cfg.isActive());
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        assertTrue(chain.isActive());

    }

    @Test

        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        DspChain.EffectSlot slot =
                cfg.addOrFocusSlot(DspChain.EffectType.GRAPHIC_EQ);
        slot.enabled = false;
        assertNotNull(slot);
        assertTrue(!cfg.isActive());
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        float[] buf = sine(1024, 2, 440, 0.5f);
        float[] before = buf.clone();
        chain.processInPlace(buf, 1024);
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            assertEquals("touched @" + i, before[i], buf[i], 0f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void suitePrimaryParamsHaveDisplayMetadata() {
        String[] ids = {"eq6", "geq", "fcurve", "basstreble", "highpass",
                "lowpass", "notch", "shelf", "classic"};

                    FxRackChain.createProcessor(id));

                DspChain.primaryParamId(DspChain.EffectType.PARAMETRIC_EQ6));
        assertEquals("bass",
                DspChain.primaryParamId(DspChain.EffectType.BASS_TREBLE));
        assertEquals("freq",
                DspChain.primaryParamId(DspChain.EffectType.NOTCH_FILTER));
        assertEquals("gain",
                DspChain.primaryParamId(DspChain.EffectType.SHELF_FILTER));
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;
import static org.junit.Assert.fail;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;

/**
 * FLAC stream-header correctness (FMT-01) and container validation (FMT-03).
 *
 * <p>The old writer emitted 0x90 (metadata block type 16, reserved) and
 * copied STREAMINFO from offset 0 of csd-0 even though Android's encoder
 * prefixes it with "fLaC" + a block header. The result was a file every
 * Android extractor rejected.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class FlacHeaderTest {

    /** 34-byte STREAMINFO describing 48 kHz / 2ch / 32-bit. */
    private static byte[] streamInfo(int sampleRate, int channels) {
        byte[] si = new byte[34];
        ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(si).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
        b.putShort((short) 4096);    // min block size
        b.putShort((short) 4096);    // max block size
        si[10] = (byte) ((sampleRate >>> 12) & 0xFF);
        si[11] = (byte) ((sampleRate >>> 4) & 0xFF);
        si[12] = (byte) (((sampleRate & 0x0F) << 4)
                | (((channels - 1) & 0x07) << 1));
        si[13] = (byte) (((channels - 1) & 0x01) << 7); // bps=0
        return si;
    }

    @Test
    public void writesStreamInfoHeaderNotReservedType() throws Exception {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, si);
        byte[] f = out.toByteArray();

        assertEquals(42, f.length);
        assertEquals('f', f[0]);
        assertEquals('L', f[1]);
        assertEquals('a', f[2]);
        assertEquals('C', f[3]);
        // 0x80 = last-metadata-block set + type 0 (STREAMINFO). Never 0x90.
        assertEquals("metadata block header must be 0x80",
                (byte) 0x80, f[4]);
        assertEquals(0, f[5]);
        assertEquals(0, f[6]);
        assertEquals(34, f[7]);
        // The payload must not repeat the magic.
        assertFalse(f[8] == 'f' && f[9] == 'L' && f[10] == 'a'
                && f[11] == 'C');
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(
                java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(f, 8, 42)));
        assertTrue(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(f));
    }

    @Test
    public void extractsStreamInfoFromAllCsdShapes() {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        // Shape 1: bare STREAMINFO.
        ByteBuffer bare = ByteBuffer.allocate(34).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN);
        bare.put(si).flip();
        assertNotNull(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(bare));
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(bare)));

        // Shape 2: block header + STREAMINFO (38 bytes).
        ByteBuffer hdr = ByteBuffer.allocate(38);
        hdr.put(new byte[]{(byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34}).put(si).flip();
        byte[] got2 = FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(hdr);
        assertNotNull(got2);
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(got2));

        // Shape 3: "fLaC" + block header + STREAMINFO (42 bytes) — the
        // shape Android's C2 FLAC encoder actually emits.
        ByteBuffer full = ByteBuffer.allocate(42);
        full.put(new byte[]{'f', 'L', 'a', 'C', (byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34})
                .put(si).flip();
        byte[] got3 = FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(full);
        assertNotNull("42-byte csd-0 was not understood", got3);
        assertEquals(48000, FormatConverter.FlacHeader.sampleRate(got3));
        // Crucially the sample rate must not be 0 (a 'fLaC'-prefixed buffer
        // read from offset 0 would decode garbage here).
        assertEquals(0, got3.length == 0 ? -1 : 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void csdPositionIsNotConsumed() {
        byte[] si = streamInfo(48000, 2);
        ByteBuffer full = ByteBuffer.allocate(42);
        full.put(new byte[]{'f', 'L', 'a', 'C', (byte) 0x80, 0, 0, 34})
                .put(si).flip();
        int before = full.position();
        FormatConverter.FlacHeader.streamInfoFromCsd(full);
        assertEquals("csd-0 position must be restored", before,
                full.position());
    }

    @Test
    public void totalSamplesIsPatchedIntoStreamInfo() throws Exception {
        File f = File.createTempFile("flac", ".flac");
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, streamInfo(48000, 2));
            try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
                w.write(out.toByteArray());
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.patchTotalSamples(w, 96000L);
            }
            try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r")) {
                byte[] h = new byte[42];
                r.readFully(h);
                // 36-bit field: low nibble of file byte 21, then 22..25.
                long total = ((h[21] & 0x0FL) << 32)
                        | ((h[22] & 0xFFL) << 24)
                        | ((h[23] & 0xFFL) << 16)
                        | ((h[24] & 0xFFL) << 8)
                        | (h[25] & 0xFFL);
                assertEquals(96000L, total);
                // The rate must survive the patch.
                assertEquals(48000, ((h[18] & 0xFF) << 12)
                        | ((h[19] & 0xFF) << 4) | ((h[20] & 0xF0) >>> 4));
            }
        } finally {
            //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validHeadRejectsReservedTypeAndZeroRate() {
        byte[] good;
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            FormatConverter.FlacHeader.write(out, streamInfo(48000, 2));
            good = out.toByteArray();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            fail(e.toString());
            return;
        }
        assertTrue(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(good));

        byte[] reserved = good.clone();
        reserved[4] = (byte) 0x90;
        assertFalse("0x90 must be rejected",
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(reserved));

        byte[] zeroRate = good.clone();
        zeroRate[18] = 0;
        zeroRate[19] = 0;
        zeroRate[20] &= (byte) 0x0F;
        assertFalse("0 Hz sample rate must be rejected",
                FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(zeroRate));

        byte[] shortLen = good.clone();
        shortLen[7] = 33;
        assertFalse(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(shortLen));

        assertFalse(FormatConverter.FlacHeader.validHead(new byte[10]));
        assertNull(null);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Cross-stage catalogue contract: every effect in the "+ Add Effect" list
 * must have a registered processor, a primary parameter that matches the
 * slot's dial range, a category, and must survive a JSON round-trip.
 */
public class FxCatalogTest {

    @Test
    public void everyEffectTypeHasARegisteredProcessor() {
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(t.id);
            assertNotNull("No processor registered for " + t.id + " ("
                    + t.title + ")", p);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void everyNonLegacyEffectHasAPrimaryParameterInRange() {
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            if (t.isLegacyStage()) continue;
            String primary = DspChain.primaryParamId(t);
            assertNotNull("No primary param for " + t.id, primary);
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(t.id);
            FxParameter fp = p.getParam(primary);
            assertNotNull("Primary param " + primary + " missing on " + t.id,
                    fp);
            assertEquals("Dial range mismatch for " + t.id,
                    fp.minRaw, t.minVal);
            assertEquals("Dial range mismatch for " + t.id,
                    fp.maxRaw, t.maxVal);
            assertEquals("Default mismatch for " + t.id,
                    fp.defaultRaw, t.defaultVal);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void everyEffectBelongsToACategory() {
        Set<FxCategory> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            FxCategory c = DspChain.categoryOf(t);
            assertNotNull("No category for " + t.id, c);
            seen.add(c);
        }
        // The whole catalog must cover the eight families.
        assertEquals("Not every category is represented", 8, seen.size());
    }

    @Test
    public void onlyNoiseToolsRequireALearnedProfile() {
        Set<DspChain.EffectType> expected = new HashSet<>();
        expected.add(DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_SUPPRESSION);
        expected.add(DspChain.EffectType.SPECTRAL_NOISE_REDUCTION);
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            assertEquals("Learn flag mismatch for " + t.id,
                    expected.contains(t), t.requiresLearnedProfile());
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void effectIdsAreUnique() {
        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : DspChain.EffectType.values()) {
            assertTrue("Duplicate effect id " + t.id, ids.add(t.id));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void newEffectsJoinTheRack() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR, true, -1800, true));
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB, true, 55, true));
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_TEMPO, true, 5000, true));

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        // The rack always carries the seven legacy stages plus one
        // processor per non-legacy slot.
        assertEquals("Wrong rack size", 7 + 3, chain.getRack().size());
        assertTrue("Compressor missing from the rack",
                chain.getRack().indexOf("dyncomp") >= 0);
        assertTrue("Reverb missing from the rack",
                chain.getRack().indexOf("reverb") >= 0);
        assertTrue("Tempo processor missing from the rack",
                chain.getRack().indexOf("tempo") >= 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void neutralEffectsDoNotCountAsAnActiveRack() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        // Amplify at 0 dB does nothing.
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.AMPLIFY, true, 0, false));
        assertFalse("A neutral effect must not arm the rack", cfg.isActive());

        // The same effect at +6 dB does.
        cfg.slots.get(0).value = 600;
        assertTrue("An engaged effect must arm the rack", cfg.isActive());
    }

    @Test
    public void offlineEffectsAreSeparatedFromTheRealtimeChain() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_TEMPO, true, 5000, false));
        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        assertEquals("Offline processors not detected",
                1, chain.offlineProcessors().size());
        assertFalse("Offline-only chain must not report in-place processors",
                chain.hasInPlaceProcessors());
        chain.clearOfflineProcessors();
        assertEquals("Offline processors not cleared",
                0, chain.offlineProcessors().size());
    }
}
