package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Stage 4 suite: EBU R128 loudness integration, brickwall limiting, DC
 * offset removal, soft-knee compressor accuracy and the two-pass level tools.
 */
public class Stage4DynamicsTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static float peak(float[] buf) {
        float p = 0f;
        for (float v : buf) p = Math.max(p, Math.abs(v));
        return p;
    }

    private static double rmsDb(float[] buf) {
        double sum = 0;
        for (float v : buf) sum += (double) v * v;
        return 10 * Math.log10(Math.max(1e-12, sum / buf.length));
    }

    /** Writes a float WAV and returns the file. */
    private static File writeWav(File dir, String name, float[] data, int ch)
            throws Exception {
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, SR, data.length * 4L));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, data, 0, data.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void loudnessMeasuresOneKhzSineNearExpectedLufs() {
        // A 1 kHz sine at -20 dBFS has an integrated loudness of roughly
        // -20.0 LUFS (K-weighting adds about +0 dB at 1 kHz).
        int frames = SR * 2;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 1000, 0.1f);
        LoudnessNormalizationProcessor p = new LoudnessNormalizationProcessor();
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] copy = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(copy, frames, 1);
        // Without a pre-scan the processor falls back to its real-time
        // loudness follower, so it must still move the signal.
        assertTrue("Real-time loudness follower did not act",
                Math.abs(peak(copy) - peak(buf)) > 1e-4f);

        // The measurement path is exercised through the analyzer helper,
        // which uses the same K-weighting coefficients.
        float measured = AudioDiagnosticsTool.integratedLufs(buf, frames, 1, SR);
        assertTrue("LUFS should be near -20, was " + measured,
                measured > -23f && measured < -17f);
    }

    @Test
    public void loudnessNormalizerAppliesGainToHitTheTarget() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "stage4loud");
        dir.mkdirs();
        int frames = SR;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 1000, 0.05f);
        File wav = writeWav(dir, "loud.wav", buf, 1);

        LoudnessNormalizationProcessor p = new LoudnessNormalizationProcessor();
        p.getParam("loud_target").setFloat(-16f);
        p.getParam("loud_dual").setBoolean(false);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.prepareOffline(wav, 0, frames, SR, 1);

        float[] copy = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(copy, frames, 1);
        float after = AudioDiagnosticsTool.integratedLufs(copy, frames, 1, SR);
        assertTrue("Target -16 LUFS not reached: " + after,
                Math.abs(after - (-16f)) < 1.5f);
    }

    @Test
    public void brickwallLimiterNeverExceedsTheCeiling() {
        int frames = SR / 2;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 200, 0.95f);
        BrickwallLimiterProcessor p = new BrickwallLimiterProcessor();
        p.getParam("lim_gain").setFloat(12f);
        p.getParam("lim_ceiling").setFloat(-0.3f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, 1);
        float ceiling = Dsp.dbToLin(-0.3f);
        // Allow a hair of interpolation overshoot.
        assertTrue("Peak " + peak(buf) + " exceeds ceiling " + ceiling,
                peak(buf) <= ceiling * 1.02f);
    }

    @Test
    public void normalizeRemovesDcOffsetAndHitsTheTargetPeak() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "stage4norm");
        dir.mkdirs();
        int frames = 4800;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 300, 0.4f);
        // Add a +0.2 DC offset.
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) buf[i] += 0.2f;
        File wav = writeWav(dir, "norm.wav", buf, 1);

        NormalizeProcessor p = new NormalizeProcessor();
        p.getParam("norm_target").setFloat(-1f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.prepareOffline(wav, 0, frames, SR, 1);

        float[] copy = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(copy, frames, 1);
        // The DC offset is gone.
        double mean = 0;
        for (float v : copy) mean += v;
        mean /= copy.length;
        assertTrue("DC offset not removed: " + mean, Math.abs(mean) < 0.01);
        // The peak sits at the -1 dBFS target.
        float target = Dsp.dbToLin(-1f);
        assertTrue("Peak " + peak(copy) + " vs target " + target,
                Math.abs(peak(copy) - target) < 0.02f);
    }

    @Test
    public void compressorSoftKneeTransferCurveIsAccurate() {
        DynamicsDetector.Envelope env = new DynamicsDetector.Envelope(SR);
        // Threshold -18 dB, ratio 3:1, 6 dB knee.
        float knee = 6f;
        float ratio = 3f;
        float over = 12f; // 12 dB above the threshold
        // A 12 dB over-threshold level with a 6 dB knee is fully in the
        // linear ratio region: 12 dB over, compressed by 2/3 -> -8 dB.
        float reduction = DynamicsDetector.softKneeGainDb(over, ratio, knee);
        assertTrue("Expected about -8 dB, was " + reduction,
                Math.abs(reduction + 8f) < 0.01f);

        // Below the knee the gain computer must be transparent.
        assertEquals(0f, DynamicsDetector.softKneeGainDb(-10f, ratio, knee),
                0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void compressorReducesGainAboveTheThreshold() {
        int frames = SR / 4;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 500, 0.5f);
        CompressorProcessor p = new CompressorProcessor();
        p.getParam("dyncomp_thresh").setFloat(-18f);
        p.getParam("dyncomp_ratio").setFloat(4f);
        p.getParam("dyncomp_attack").setFloat(5f);
        p.getParam("dyncomp_release").setFloat(80f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        double before = rmsDb(buf);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, 1);
        double after = rmsDb(buf);
        assertTrue("Compressor did not reduce the level: " + before + " -> "
                + after, after < before);
    }

    @Test
    public void gateAttenuatesBelowTheThreshold() {
        int frames = SR / 4;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 500, 0.005f); // about -46 dBFS
        NoiseGateExpanderProcessor p = new NoiseGateExpanderProcessor();
        p.getParam("gate_thresh").setFloat(-42f);
        p.getParam("gate_range").setFloat(-24f);
        p.getParam("gate_hpf").setCurrentRaw(120);
        // Keep the release short enough that the 250 ms probe reaches the
        // full range; the gate's release parameter is covered separately.
        p.getParam("gate_release").setFloat(20f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        double before = rmsDb(buf);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, 1);
        double after = rmsDb(buf);
        assertTrue("Gate did not attenuate: " + before + " -> " + after,
                after < before - 10f);
    }

    @Test
    public void amplifyNeverClipsWhenClippingIsNotAllowed() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "stage4amp");
        dir.mkdirs();
        int frames = 2400;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 440, 0.8f);
        File wav = writeWav(dir, "amp.wav", buf, 1);

        AmplifyProcessor p = new AmplifyProcessor();
        p.getParam("amp_gain").setFloat(12f);
        p.getParam("amp_peak").setFloat(0f);
        p.getParam("amp_clip").setBoolean(false);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.prepareOffline(wav, 0, frames, SR, 1);

        float[] copy = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(copy, frames, 1);
        assertTrue("Amplify clipped: " + peak(copy), peak(copy) <= 1.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void everyStage4EffectIsRegisteredAndHasItsPrimaryParam() {
        DspChain.EffectType[] types = {
                DspChain.EffectType.AMPLIFY,
                DspChain.EffectType.NORMALIZE,
                DspChain.EffectType.LOUDNESS_NORMALIZATION,
                DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR,
                DspChain.EffectType.MULTIBAND_COMPRESSOR,
                DspChain.EffectType.BRICKWALL_LIMITER_STAGE4,
                DspChain.EffectType.NOISE_GATE_EXPANDER,
                DspChain.EffectType.DEESSER_SPLIT,
                DspChain.EffectType.AUTO_DUCK};
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : types) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(t.id);
            assertNotNull("Processor missing for " + t.id, p);
            String primary = DspChain.primaryParamId(t);
            assertNotNull("No primary param for " + t.id, primary);
            assertNotNull("Primary param " + primary + " missing on " + t.id,
                    p.getParam(primary));
            assertEquals("Wrong category for " + t.id,
                    p.getCategory(), DspChain.categoryOf(t));
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

/**
 * Every Stage 4-7 effect must actually change the audio when it is enabled
 * and dialled in.
 *
 * <p>Each family needs its own engagement, so the test drives them the way
 * a user would: the level tools are given a pre-scanned file, the dynamics
 * tools are fed a loud tone, the restoration tools are fed the damage they
 * are meant to repair, and the time tools are rendered through their
 * offline renderer.
 */
public class Stage4to7AudioChangeTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static boolean changed(float[] orig, float[] out) {
        for (int i = 0; i < orig.length; i++) {
            if (Math.abs(orig[i] - out[i]) > 1e-4f) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Runs a processor in place and asserts it altered the signal. */
    private static void assertModifies(String label, AudioProcessor p,
                                       float[] buf, int frames, int ch) {
        assertNotNull(label, p);
        float[] orig = buf.clone();
        p.prepare(SR, ch);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, ch);
        assertTrue(label + " produced no audio change", changed(orig, buf));
    }

    @Test
    public void stage4LevelToolsChangeTheSignal() {
        // Amplify: +6 dB of gain.
        AmplifyProcessor amp = new AmplifyProcessor();
        amp.getParam("amp_gain").setFloat(6f);
        assertModifies("Amplify", amp, sine(4800, 2, 440, 0.3f), 4800, 2);

        // Normalize: a target of -6 dBFS on a -20 dBFS signal must lift it.
        NormalizeProcessor norm = new NormalizeProcessor();
        norm.getParam("norm_target").setFloat(-6f);
        assertModifies("Normalize", norm, sine(4800, 2, 440, 0.1f), 4800, 2);

        // Loudness: a -16 LUFS target on a quiet signal must lift it.
        LoudnessNormalizationProcessor loud = new LoudnessNormalizationProcessor();
        loud.getParam("loud_target").setFloat(-16f);
        assertModifies("Loudness", loud, sine(48000, 2, 1000, 0.1f), 48000, 2);
    }

    @Test
    public void stage4DynamicsToolsChangeTheSignal() {
        CompressorProcessor comp = new CompressorProcessor();
        comp.getParam("dyncomp_thresh").setFloat(-24f);
        comp.getParam("dyncomp_ratio").setFloat(4f);
        assertModifies("Compressor", comp, sine(9600, 2, 500, 0.5f), 9600, 2);

        MultibandCompressorProcessor mb = new MultibandCompressorProcessor();
        mb.getParam("mb_amount").setCurrentRaw(60);
        assertModifies("Multiband Compressor", mb, sine(9600, 2, 500, 0.5f),
                9600, 2);

        BrickwallLimiterProcessor lim = new BrickwallLimiterProcessor();
        lim.getParam("lim_gain").setFloat(12f);
        assertModifies("Brickwall Limiter", lim, sine(9600, 2, 200, 0.9f),
                9600, 2);

        NoiseGateExpanderProcessor gate = new NoiseGateExpanderProcessor();
        gate.getParam("gate_thresh").setFloat(-30f);
        gate.getParam("gate_range").setFloat(-24f);
        assertModifies("Gate", gate, sine(9600, 2, 500, 0.005f), 9600, 2);

        DeEsserProcessor deess = new DeEsserProcessor();
        deess.getParam("deess_thresh").setFloat(-30f);
        float[] sib = new float[9600 * 2];
        for (int f = 0; f < 9600; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 6800 * f / SR) * 0.5);
            sib[f * 2] = s;
            sib[f * 2 + 1] = s;
        }
        assertModifies("De-Esser", deess, sib, 9600, 2);

        AutoDuckProcessor duck = new AutoDuckProcessor();
        duck.getParam("duck_amount").setFloat(-18f);
        assertModifies("Auto Duck", duck, sine(9600, 2, 800, 0.3f), 9600, 2);
    }

    @Test
    public void stage5RestorationToolsChangeTheSignal() {
        SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor nr = new SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor();
        nr.getParam("snr_reduction").setFloat(18f);
        float[] noisy = sine(9600, 2, 1000, 0.4f);
        java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(3);
        for (int i = 0; i < noisy.length; i++) {
            noisy[i] += (rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f) * 0.02f;
        }
        assertModifies("Spectral Noise Reduction", nr, noisy, 9600, 2);

        ClickRemovalProcessor click = new ClickRemovalProcessor();
        float[] withClick = sine(4800, 2, 500, 0.3f);
        withClick[2400] = 0.95f;
        withClick[2401] = -0.9f;
        assertModifies("Click Removal", click, withClick, 4800, 2);

        ClipFixProcessor clipfix = new ClipFixProcessor();
        float[] clipped = sine(4800, 2, 400, 1.0f);
        for (int i = 0; i < clipped.length; i++) {
            clipped[i] = Math.max(-0.95f, Math.min(0.95f, clipped[i]));
        }
        assertModifies("Clip Fix", clipfix, clipped, 4800, 2);

        RepairProcessor repair = new RepairProcessor();
        float[] gapped = sine(4800, 2, 300, 0.5f);
        for (int i = 1200; i < 1240; i++) gapped[i] = 0f;
        assertModifies("Repair", repair, gapped, 4800, 2);

        DeHumProcessor hum = new DeHumProcessor();
        float[] withHum = sine(9600, 2, 1000, 0.3f);
        for (int f = 0; f < 9600; f++) {
            withHum[f * 2] += (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 50 * f / SR) * 0.3);
            withHum[f * 2 + 1] += (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 50 * f / SR) * 0.3);
        }
        assertModifies("De-Hum", hum, withHum, 9600, 2);

        PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor plosive =
                new PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor();
        plosive.getParam("plosive_sens").setCurrentRaw(100);
        float[] blast = sine(9600, 2, 1000, 0.3f);
        for (int f = 1000; f < 1400; f++) {
            blast[f * 2] += (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 90 * f / SR) * 0.8);
            blast[f * 2 + 1] += (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 90 * f / SR) * 0.8);
        }
        assertModifies("Plosive Suppressor", plosive, blast, 9600, 2);
    }

    @Test
    public void stage6SpatialToolsChangeTheSignal() {
        FreeverbReverbProcessor rev = new FreeverbReverbProcessor();
        rev.getParam("rv_wet").setFloat(0f);
        assertModifies("Reverb", rev, sine(9600, 2, 800, 0.4f), 9600, 2);

        MultiDelayProcessor delay = new MultiDelayProcessor();
        delay.getParam("md_time").setCurrentRaw(50);
        assertModifies("Multi-Echo Delay", delay, sine(9600, 2, 800, 0.4f),
                9600, 2);

        EchoProcessor echo = new EchoProcessor();
        echo.getParam("echo_time").setCurrentRaw(50);
        assertModifies("Echo", echo, sine(9600, 2, 800, 0.4f), 9600, 2);

        StereoImagingProcessor stereo = new StereoImagingProcessor();
        stereo.getParam("st_width").setCurrentRaw(150);
        float[] wide = new float[4800 * 2];
        for (int f = 0; f < 4800; f++) {
            wide[f * 2] = 0.5f;
            wide[f * 2 + 1] = -0.5f;
        }
        assertModifies("Stereo Imaging", stereo, wide, 4800, 2);

        DistortionWaveshaperProcessor dist = new DistortionWaveshaperProcessor();
        dist.getParam("dist_drive").setCurrentRaw(80);
        assertModifies("Distortion", dist, sine(9600, 2, 800, 0.6f), 9600, 2);

        PhaserProcessor phaser = new PhaserProcessor();
        phaser.getParam("ph_mix").setCurrentRaw(100);
        assertModifies("Phaser", phaser, sine(9600, 2, 500, 0.5f), 9600, 2);

        ChorusFlangerProcessor chorus = new ChorusFlangerProcessor();
        chorus.getParam("ch_mix").setCurrentRaw(100);
        assertModifies("Chorus", chorus, sine(9600, 2, 500, 0.5f), 9600, 2);

        TremoloProcessor trem = new TremoloProcessor();
        trem.getParam("tr_depth").setCurrentRaw(90);
        assertModifies("Tremolo", trem, sine(9600, 2, 500, 0.5f), 9600, 2);

        WahwahProcessor wah = new WahwahProcessor();
        wah.getParam("wah_depth").setCurrentRaw(90);
        assertModifies("Wahwah", wah, sine(9600, 2, 500, 0.5f), 9600, 2);

        VocoderProcessor voc = new VocoderProcessor();
        assertModifies("Vocoder", voc, sine(9600, 2, 500, 0.5f), 9600, 2);
    }

    @Test
    public void stage7OfflineToolsChangeTheSignal() {
        float[] src = sine(9600, 2, 440, 0.5f);

        ChangePitchProcessor pitch = new ChangePitchProcessor();
        pitch.getParam("pitch_semitones").setFloat(7f);
        pitch.prepare(SR, 2);
        float[] out = pitch.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Change Pitch produced no audio change",
                changed(src, out));

        ChangeTempoProcessor tempo = new ChangeTempoProcessor();
        tempo.getParam("tempo_percent").setFloat(25f);
        tempo.prepare(SR, 2);
        out = tempo.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Change Tempo produced no audio change", changed(src, out));

        ChangeSpeedAndPitchProcessor speed = new ChangeSpeedAndPitchProcessor();
        speed.getParam("speed_mult").setFloat(1.5f);
        speed.prepare(SR, 2);
        out = speed.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Change Speed produced no audio change", changed(src, out));

        SlidingStretchProcessor slide = new SlidingStretchProcessor();
        slide.getParam("slide_init").setFloat(40f);
        slide.getParam("slide_final").setFloat(-40f);
        slide.prepare(SR, 2);
        out = slide.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Sliding Stretch produced no audio change", changed(src, out));

        PaulstretchProcessor paul = new PaulstretchProcessor();
        paul.getParam("paul_factor").setFloat(4f);
        paul.prepare(SR, 2);
        out = paul.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Paulstretch produced no audio change", changed(src, out));

        FadeProcessor fade = new FadeProcessor();
        fade.getParam("fade_type").setEnumIndex(1);
        fade.getParam("fade_len").setCurrentRaw(50);
        // The fade tail must carry energy: a 440 Hz tone at this length
        // ends near a zero crossing, so use a frequency that does not.
        float[] fadeSrc = sine(9600, 2, 300, 0.5f);
        fade.prepare(SR, 2);
        out = fade.processOfflineRegion(fadeSrc, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Fade produced no audio change", changed(fadeSrc, out));

        TimelineUtilityProcessor timeline = new TimelineUtilityProcessor();
        timeline.getParam("tl_action").setEnumIndex(0);
        timeline.prepare(SR, 2);
        out = timeline.processOfflineRegion(src, 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Invert produced no audio change", changed(src, out));

        TruncateSilenceProcessor trunc = new TruncateSilenceProcessor();
        trunc.getParam("ts_thresh").setFloat(-40f);
        // The minimum silence is 100 ms here, so the 100 ms pause below
        // qualifies for truncation, and it is shortened to 50 ms.
        trunc.getParam("ts_min").setCurrentRaw(100);
        trunc.getParam("ts_trunc").setCurrentRaw(50);
        trunc.prepare(SR, 2);
        float[] withPause = sine(9600, 2, 440, 0.5f);
        for (int f = 4800; f < 9600; f++) {
            withPause[f * 2] = 0f;
            withPause[f * 2 + 1] = 0f;
        }
        out = trunc.processOfflineRegion(withPause, 9600, 2);
        // The pause was silent, so the visible change is the length: the
        // 100 ms pause must have been shortened to 50 ms.
        assertTrue("Truncate Silence did not shorten the pause: "
                        + (out.length / 2) + " frames",
                out.length / 2 < 9600);

        AudioGeneratorTool gen = new AudioGeneratorTool();
        gen.getParam("gen_start").setCurrentRaw(1000);
        gen.getParam("gen_end").setCurrentRaw(1000);
        gen.prepare(SR, 2);
        out = gen.processOfflineRegion(new float[9600 * 2], 9600, 2);
        assertTrue("Audio Generator produced no audio", changed(src, out));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.json.JSONObject;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Persistence contract for the Stage 4-7 effects: a rack that carries the
 * new dynamics, spatial and time tools must survive a JSON round-trip with
 * every processor and every parameter intact.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class Stage4to7PersistenceTest {

    @Test
    public void newEffectsRoundTripThroughTheRackJson() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.DYNAMIC_COMPRESSOR, true, -1800, true));
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB, true, 55, true));
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_TEMPO, true, 5000, true));

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        assertEquals("Wrong rack size", 7 + 3, chain.getRack().size());

        JSONObject json = chain.getRack().toJson();
        assertTrue("Rack JSON is empty", json.length() > 0);
        FxRackChain restored = FxRackChain.fromJson(2, json);
        assertEquals("Round trip lost processors",
                chain.getRack().size(), restored.size());

        AudioProcessor comp = restored.getProcessor(restored.indexOf("dyncomp"));
        assertNotNull("Compressor lost", comp);
        assertEquals("Compressor threshold lost", -1800,
                comp.getParam("dyncomp_thresh").getCurrentRaw());
    }

    @Test
    public void stage7ParametersSurviveTheRoundTrip() {
        DspChain.Config cfg = new DspChain.Config();
        cfg.slots.clear();
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_PITCH, true, 1200, true));
        cfg.slots.get(0).extraParams.put("pitch_cents", 25);
        cfg.slots.add(new DspChain.EffectSlot(
                DspChain.EffectType.TRUNCATE_SILENCE, true, -4000, true));
        cfg.slots.get(1).extraParams.put("ts_min", 250);

        DspChain chain = new DspChain(2, cfg);
        FxRackChain restored = FxRackChain.fromJson(2, chain.getRack().toJson());
        AudioProcessor pitch =
                restored.getProcessor(restored.indexOf("changepitch"));
        assertNotNull("Pitch processor lost", pitch);
        assertEquals("Semitones lost", 1200,
                pitch.getParam("pitch_semitones").getCurrentRaw());
        assertEquals("Cents lost", 25,
                pitch.getParam("pitch_cents").getCurrentRaw());
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Stage 5 suite: STFT reconstruction fidelity, spectral noise reduction,
 * de-clicker, de-clipper, LPC repair, hum removal and plosive suppression.
 */
public class Stage5RestorationTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static double snrDb(float[] ref, float[] test) {
        double sig = 0;
        double noise = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < ref.length; i++) {
            sig += (double) ref[i] * ref[i];
            double d = ref[i] - test[i];
            noise += d * d;
        }
        if (noise < 1e-30) return 300.0;
        return 10 * Math.log10(sig / noise);
    }

    private static File writeWav(File dir, String name, float[] data, int ch)
            throws Exception {
        File f = new File(dir, name);
        try (RandomAccessFile raf = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw")) {
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(ch, SR, data.length * 4L));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(raf, data, 0, data.length);
        }
        return f;
    }

    @Test
    public void stftReconstructsTheSignalAboveOneHundredDbSnr() {
        int frames = 8192;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 1000, 0.5f);
        StftProcessor stft = new StftProcessor(1024, 4) {
            @Override
            protected void processSpectrum(float[] re, float[] im,
                                           int binCount, int channel) {
                // Identity: the overlap-add must reproduce the input.
            }
        };
        float[] out = buf.clone();
        stft.process(out, frames, 1);
        double snr = snrDb(buf, out);
        assertTrue("STFT round trip SNR only " + snr + " dB", snr > 110.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void spectralNoiseReductionAttenuatesStationaryNoise() {
        int frames = 16384;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 1000, 0.4f);
        // Add white noise at -40 dBFS.
        java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(7);
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            buf[i] += (rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f) * 0.01f;
        }
        SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor p = new SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor();
        p.getParam("snr_reduction").setFloat(24f);
        p.getParam("snr_sensitivity").setFloat(6f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(out, frames, 1);
        // The tone must survive while the broadband floor drops.
        double before = rmsOf(buf, frames);
        double after = rmsOf(out, frames);
        assertTrue("Noise floor not reduced: " + before + " -> " + after,
                after < before * 0.75);
    }

    private static double rmsOf(float[] buf, int frames) {
        double sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) sum += (double) buf[i] * buf[i];
        return Math.sqrt(sum / frames);
    }

    @Test
    public void clickRemovalRepairsAnIsolatedSpike() {
        int frames = 4800;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 500, 0.3f);
        // Plant a single large click.
        buf[2400] = 0.95f;
        ClickRemovalProcessor p = new ClickRemovalProcessor();
        p.getParam("click_thresh").setCurrentRaw(200);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(out, frames, 1);
        // The click must be gone: the repaired sample sits near the
        // neighbouring sine samples again.
        float peakBefore = Math.abs(buf[2400]);
        float peakAfter = Math.abs(out[2400]);
        assertTrue("Click not repaired: " + peakBefore + " -> " + peakAfter,
                peakAfter < peakBefore * 0.5f);
    }

    @Test
    public void clipFixRestoresAClippedCrest() {
        int frames = 4800;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 400, 1.0f);
        // Hard-clip the waveform at 0.95.
        for (int i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
            buf[i] = Math.max(-0.95f, Math.min(0.95f, buf[i]));
        }
        int clipped = 0;
        for (float v : buf) if (Math.abs(v) >= 0.9499f) clipped++;
        assertTrue("Test signal was not clipped", clipped > 10);

        ClipFixProcessor p = new ClipFixProcessor();
        p.getParam("clip_headroom").setFloat(0f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(out, frames, 1);
        // The reconstructed crest must exceed the flat clipped plateau.
        float max = 0f;
        for (float v : out) max = Math.max(max, Math.abs(v));
        assertTrue("Crest not restored, peak " + max, max > 0.97f);

        // With headroom the whole signal is scaled down afterwards.
        ClipFixProcessor p2 = new ClipFixProcessor();
        p2.getParam("clip_headroom").setFloat(-6f);
        p2.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out2 = buf.clone();
        p2.processInPlace(out2, frames, 1);
        float max2 = 0f;
        for (float v : out2) max2 = Math.max(max2, Math.abs(v));
        assertTrue("Headroom not applied: " + max2, max2 < 0.55f);
    }

    @Test
    public void lpcRepairInterpolatesAGapWithoutLeavingSilence() {
        int frames = 2048;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 300, 0.5f);
        // Punch a 32-sample hole.
        for (int i = 1000; i < 1032; i++) buf[i] = 0f;
        RepairProcessor p = new RepairProcessor();
        p.getParam("repair_order").setCurrentRaw(16);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(out, frames, 1);
        double energy = 0;
        for (int i = 1000; i < 1032; i++) energy += (double) out[i] * out[i];
        assertTrue("Gap was not repaired", energy > 1e-4);
    }

    @Test
    public void deHumRemovesTheMainsHum() {
        int frames = 16384;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 1000, 0.3f);
        // Add 50 Hz hum at the same level as the tone.
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            buf[f] += (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 50 * f / SR) * 0.3);
        }
        DeHumProcessor p = new DeHumProcessor();
        p.getParam("hum_freq").setCurrentRaw(50);
        p.getParam("hum_harm").setCurrentRaw(3);
        p.getParam("hum_depth").setFloat(-40f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(out, frames, 1);

        double humBefore = goertzel(buf, 2000, 8000, 50);
        double humAfter = goertzel(out, 2000, 8000, 50);
        assertTrue("Hum not removed: " + humBefore + " -> " + humAfter,
                humAfter < humBefore * 0.2);
    }

    private static double goertzel(float[] buf, int from, int len, double hz) {
        double w = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / SR;
        double coeff = 2.0 * Math.cos(w);
        double s0 = 0;
        double s1 = 0;
        double s2 = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < from + len && i < buf.length; i++) {
            s0 = buf[i] + coeff * s1 - s2;
            s2 = s1;
            s1 = s0;
        }
        double real = s1 - s2 * Math.cos(w);
        double imag = s2 * Math.sin(w);
        return Math.hypot(real, imag) / (len / 2.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void plosiveSuppressorTamesSubBassBursts() {
        int frames = 9600;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 1000, 0.3f);
        // A low-frequency blast.
        for (int f = 1000; f < 1400; f++) {
            buf[f] += (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 90 * f / SR) * 0.8);
        }
        PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor p =
                new PlosiveBreathSuppressorProcessor();
        p.getParam("plosive_sens").setCurrentRaw(100);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(out, frames, 1);
        double before = 0;
        double after = 0;
        for (int f = 1000; f < 1400; f++) {
            before += (double) buf[f] * buf[f];
            after += (double) out[f] * out[f];
        }
        assertTrue("Plosive not tamed: " + before + " -> " + after,
                after < before);
    }

    @Test
    public void spectralLearnedProfileUsesTheProcessingPowerScale() {
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(48000, 1, 0x5eedL, 0.02f);
        float[] profile = SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor.learnProfile(
                noise, 1);
        assertNotNull(profile);
        // The profile is installed directly as the per-bin floor, so it must
        // stay on the raw STFT power scale instead of being normalised to a
        // mean of 1.0 (which would over-suppress quiet noise).
        assertEquals(513, profile.length);
        double mean = 0;
        for (float v : profile) {
            assertTrue("Non-positive bin " + v, v > 0f);
            mean += v;
        }
        mean /= profile.length;
        assertTrue("Profile was normalised: mean " + mean,
                mean > 1e-6 && mean < 0.5);
    }

    @Test
    public void spectralLearnedProfileSuppressesNoiseAndKeepsTheTone() {
        float[] noise = whiteNoise(96000, 1, 0xabcdeL, 0.02f);
        float[] profile = SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor.learnProfile(
                java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(noise, 0, 24000), 1);
        assertNotNull(profile);

        SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor p =
                new SpectralNoiseReductionProcessor();
        p.getParam("snr_reduction").setFloat(18f);
        p.getParam("snr_sensitivity").setFloat(0f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.setNoiseProfile(profile);
        float[] wet = noise.clone();
        p.processInPlace(wet, 96000, 1);
        double reductionDb = 20.0 * Math.log10(
                rms(noise, 24000, 72000) / Math.max(1e-12,
                        rms(wet, 24000, 72000)));
        assertTrue("Learned profile reduced only " + reductionDb + " dB",
                reductionDb > 6.0);

        float[] tone = sine(48000, 1, 1000, 0.5f);
        float[] toneOut = tone.clone();
        p.reset();
        p.processInPlace(toneOut, 48000, 1);
        double toneDelta = 20.0 * Math.log10(
                rms(toneOut, 4800, 43200) / rms(tone, 4800, 43200));
        assertTrue("Learned profile changed the tone by " + toneDelta
                + " dB", Math.abs(toneDelta) < 2.0);
    }

    private static double rms(float[] buf, int from, int len) {
        double sum = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < from + len && i < buf.length; i++) {
            sum += (double) buf[i] * buf[i];
        }
        return Math.sqrt(sum / Math.max(1, len));
    }

    private static float[] whiteNoise(int frames, int ch, long seed,
                                      float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(seed);
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
            out[i] = (rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f) * amp;
        }
        return out;
    }

    @Test
    public void everyStage5EffectIsRegisteredAndHasItsPrimaryParam() {
        DspChain.EffectType[] types = {
                DspChain.EffectType.SPECTRAL_NOISE_REDUCTION,
                DspChain.EffectType.CLICK_REMOVAL,
                DspChain.EffectType.CLIP_FIX,
                DspChain.EffectType.REPAIR,
                DspChain.EffectType.DE_HUM,
                DspChain.EffectType.PLOSIVE_SUPPRESSOR};
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : types) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(t.id);
            assertNotNull("Processor missing for " + t.id, p);
            String primary = DspChain.primaryParamId(t);
            assertNotNull("No primary param for " + t.id, primary);
            assertNotNull("Primary param " + primary + " missing on " + t.id,
                    p.getParam(primary));
            assertEquals("Wrong category for " + t.id,
                    p.getCategory(), DspChain.categoryOf(t));
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/Stage6SpatialTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

/**
 * Stage 6 suite: reverb tail decay, delay tap timing, mid/side width,
 * oversampled waveshaper aliasing and the modulation effects.
 */
public class Stage6SpatialTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static float peak(float[] buf) {
        float p = 0f;
        for (float v : buf) p = Math.max(p, Math.abs(v));
        return p;
    }

    @Test
    public void reverbTailKeepsRingingAfterTheInputStops() {
        int frames = SR / 4;
        float[] buf = new float[frames];
        // A short burst at the start.
        for (int f = 0; f < 240; f++) {
            buf[f] = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 800 * f / SR) * 0.6);
        }
        FreeverbReverbProcessor p = new FreeverbReverbProcessor();
        p.getParam("rv_size").setCurrentRaw(80);
        p.getParam("rv_decay").setCurrentRaw(80);
        p.getParam("rv_wet").setFloat(0f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, 1);
        // The tail must still be audible well after the burst ended.
        float late = 0f;
        for (int f = frames - 4800; f < frames; f++) late = Math.max(late,
                Math.abs(buf[f]));
        assertTrue("Reverb tail died immediately", late > 0.001f);
        assertTrue("Reverb reports no tail", p.getTailFrames() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void echoDelayTapArrivesAtTheRequestedTime() {
        int frames = SR / 2;
        float[] buf = new float[frames];
        // A single impulse at frame 0.
        buf[0] = 1f;
        EchoProcessor p = new EchoProcessor();
        p.getParam("echo_time").setCurrentRaw(100); // 100 ms
        p.getParam("echo_decay").setFloat(0.5f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, 1);
        int expected = (int) (SR * 0.1);
        float atTap = buf[expected];
        float beforeTap = buf[expected - 100];
        assertTrue("Echo tap missing at " + expected + " (" + atTap + ")",
                atTap > 0.4f);
        assertTrue("Echo arrived too early", beforeTap < 0.1f);
    }

    @Test
    public void stereoWidthZeroCollapsesToMono() {
        int frames = 480;
        float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
        // Partially correlated content: a common mid signal plus a side
        // signal, so collapsing the width must keep the mid and drop the
        // side.
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            buf[f * 2] = 0.4f;
            buf[f * 2 + 1] = 0.2f;
        }
        StereoImagingProcessor p = new StereoImagingProcessor();
        p.getParam("st_width").setCurrentRaw(0);
        p.getParam("st_pan").setCurrentRaw(0);
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, 2);
        // Both channels now carry the mid signal only.
        assertEquals(buf[0], buf[1], 0.0001f);
        assertTrue("Mono content was lost", Math.abs(buf[0]) > 0.2f);
    }

    @Test
    public void stereoWidthTwoHundredWidensTheImage() {
        int frames = 480;
        float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
        // Out-of-phase content: the side signal dominates, so widening it
        // must spread the channels apart.
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            buf[f * 2] = 0.5f;
            buf[f * 2 + 1] = -0.5f;
        }
        StereoImagingProcessor p = new StereoImagingProcessor();
        p.getParam("st_width").setCurrentRaw(200);
        p.getParam("st_pan").setCurrentRaw(0);
        p.prepare(SR, 2);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, 2);
        assertTrue("Width did not widen the image",
                Math.abs(buf[0] - buf[1]) > 1.5f);
    }

    @Test
    public void waveshaperDoesNotAliasASteepSine() {
        int frames = 16384;
        // A 3 kHz tone hard-clipped at 48 kHz folds energy from the 7th
        // harmonic (21 kHz) and above back into the audible band. The 2x
        // oversampled path must keep those products out.
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 3000, 0.8f);
        DistortionWaveshaperProcessor p = new DistortionWaveshaperProcessor();
        p.getParam("dist_drive").setCurrentRaw(100);
        p.getParam("dist_curve").setEnumIndex(0); // Hard clipping
        p.getParam("dist_tone").setCurrentRaw(20000);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = buf.clone();
        p.processInPlace(out, frames, 1);

        // An aliased 7th harmonic would appear at 48 - 21 = 27 kHz, which
        // folds to 21 kHz in the analysis band. Measure an empty region
        // instead: 18 kHz is not a harmonic of 3 kHz, so any energy there is
        // pure aliasing.
        double alias = goertzel(out, 0, frames, 18000);
        double fundamental = goertzel(out, 0, frames, 3000);
        assertTrue("Aliasing is too strong: " + alias + " vs " + fundamental,
                alias < fundamental * 0.5);
    }

    private static double goertzel(float[] buf, int from, int len, double hz) {
        double w = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / SR;
        double coeff = 2.0 * Math.cos(w);
        double s0 = 0;
        double s1 = 0;
        double s2 = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < from + len && i < buf.length; i++) {
            s0 = buf[i] + coeff * s1 - s2;
            s2 = s1;
            s1 = s0;
        }
        double real = s1 - s2 * Math.cos(w);
        double imag = s2 * Math.sin(w);
        return Math.hypot(real, imag) / (len / 2.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void tremoloModulatesTheAmplitude() {
        int frames = SR / 2;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 500, 0.5f);
        TremoloProcessor p = new TremoloProcessor();
        p.getParam("tr_depth").setCurrentRaw(100);
        p.getParam("tr_rate").setFloat(10f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        p.processInPlace(buf, frames, 1);
        // The amplitude must vary over the buffer.
        float min = Float.MAX_VALUE;
        float max = -Float.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float a = Math.abs(buf[f]);
            min = Math.min(min, a);
            max = Math.max(max, a);
        }
        assertTrue("Tremolo did not modulate: " + min + ".." + max,
                max - min > 0.2f);
    }

    @Test
    public void phaserAndChorusChangeTheSignal() {
        int frames = 8192;
        float[] phaserIn = sine(frames, 1, 500, 0.5f);
        float[] phaserOut = phaserIn.clone();
        PhaserProcessor ph = new PhaserProcessor();
        ph.getParam("ph_mix").setCurrentRaw(100);
        ph.prepare(SR, 1);
        ph.processInPlace(phaserOut, frames, 1);
        assertTrue("Phaser did not alter the signal",
                !java.util.Arrays.equals(phaserIn, phaserOut));

        float[] chorusIn = sine(frames, 1, 500, 0.5f);
        float[] chorusOut = chorusIn.clone();
        ChorusFlangerProcessor ch = new ChorusFlangerProcessor();
        ch.getParam("ch_mix").setCurrentRaw(100);
        ch.prepare(SR, 1);
        ch.processInPlace(chorusOut, frames, 1);
        assertTrue("Chorus did not alter the signal",
                !java.util.Arrays.equals(chorusIn, chorusOut));
    }

    @Test
    public void everyStage6EffectIsRegisteredAndHasItsPrimaryParam() {
        DspChain.EffectType[] types = {
                DspChain.EffectType.FREEVERB_REVERB,
                DspChain.EffectType.MULTI_DELAY,
                DspChain.EffectType.ECHO,
                DspChain.EffectType.STEREO_IMAGING,
                DspChain.EffectType.DISTORTION,
                DspChain.EffectType.PHASER,
                DspChain.EffectType.CHORUS_FLANGER,
                DspChain.EffectType.TREMOLO,
                DspChain.EffectType.WAHWAH,
                DspChain.EffectType.VOCODER};
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : types) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(t.id);
            assertNotNull("Processor missing for " + t.id, p);
            String primary = DspChain.primaryParamId(t);
            assertNotNull("No primary param for " + t.id, primary);
            assertNotNull("Primary param " + primary + " missing on " + t.id,
                    p.getParam(primary));
            assertEquals("Wrong category for " + t.id,
                    p.getCategory(), DspChain.categoryOf(t));
        }
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Stage 7 suite: WSOLA duration scaling without pitch drift, pitch shifting
 * without a duration change, silence truncation, fades, the timeline tools,
 * the generator and the analysers.
 */
public class Stage7TimeToolsTest {

    private static final int SR = 48000;

    private static float[] sine(int frames, int ch, double hz, float amp) {
        float[] out = new float[frames * ch];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
            float s = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * hz * f / SR) * amp);
            for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) out[f * ch + c] = s;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static double goertzel(float[] buf, int from, int len, double hz) {
        double w = 2.0 * Math.PI * hz / SR;
        double coeff = 2.0 * Math.cos(w);
        double s0 = 0;
        double s1 = 0;
        double s2 = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < from + len && i < buf.length; i++) {
            s0 = buf[i] + coeff * s1 - s2;
            s2 = s1;
            s1 = s0;
        }
        double real = s1 - s2 * Math.cos(w);
        double imag = s2 * Math.sin(w);
        return Math.hypot(real, imag) / (len / 2.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void wsolaChangesDurationWithoutDriftingThePitch() {
        int frames = SR / 2;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 440, 0.5f);
        WsolaTimePitchProcessor wsola = new WsolaTimePitchProcessor(SR);
        float[] stretched = wsola.timeStretch(buf, frames, 1, 2.0);
        int outFrames = stretched.length;
        assertTrue("Duration did not double: " + outFrames,
                Math.abs(outFrames - frames * 2) < frames / 10);
        // The fundamental must still be at 440 Hz.
        double fundamental = goertzel(stretched, 2000, 8000, 440);
        double neighbour = goertzel(stretched, 2000, 8000, 880);
        assertTrue("Pitch drifted: 440 Hz at " + fundamental
                + " vs 880 Hz at " + neighbour, fundamental > neighbour * 2.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void changePitchShiftsTheFundamentalAndKeepsTheDuration() {
        int frames = SR / 2;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 440, 0.5f);
        ChangePitchProcessor p = new ChangePitchProcessor();
        p.getParam("pitch_semitones").setFloat(12f); // one octave up
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        assertEquals("Duration changed", frames, out.length);
        double up = goertzel(out, 2000, 8000, 880);
        double original = goertzel(out, 2000, 8000, 440);
        assertTrue("Pitch did not shift: 880 Hz at " + up
                + " vs 440 Hz at " + original, up > original * 2.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void changeTempoScalesTheDuration() {
        int frames = SR / 4;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 440, 0.5f);
        ChangeTempoProcessor p = new ChangeTempoProcessor();
        p.getParam("tempo_percent").setFloat(100f); // twice as fast -> half as long
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        int outFrames = out.length;
        assertTrue("Duration did not halve: " + outFrames,
                Math.abs(outFrames - frames / 2) < frames / 10);
    }

    @Test
    public void changeSpeedAndPitchChangesBoth() {
        int frames = SR / 4;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 440, 0.5f);
        ChangeSpeedAndPitchProcessor p = new ChangeSpeedAndPitchProcessor();
        p.getParam("speed_mult").setFloat(2f);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        int outFrames = out.length;
        assertTrue("Duration did not halve: " + outFrames,
                Math.abs(outFrames - frames / 2) < frames / 10);
        double up = goertzel(out, 2000, 8000, 880);
        double original = goertzel(out, 2000, 8000, 440);
        assertTrue("Pitch did not shift", up > original * 2.0);
    }

    @Test
    public void truncateSilenceRemovesThePause() {
        int frames = SR;
        float[] buf = new float[frames];
        // 0.5 s of tone, 0.5 s of silence.
        for (int f = 0; f < SR / 2; f++) {
            buf[f] = (float) (Math.sin(2.0 * Math.PI * 440 * f / SR) * 0.5);
        }
        TruncateSilenceProcessor p = new TruncateSilenceProcessor();
        p.getParam("ts_thresh").setFloat(-40f);
        p.getParam("ts_min").setCurrentRaw(400);
        p.getParam("ts_action").setEnumIndex(0);
        p.getParam("ts_trunc").setCurrentRaw(100);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        int outFrames = out.length;
        assertTrue("Silence was not truncated: " + outFrames,
                outFrames < frames * 0.9);
        assertTrue("Too much was removed: " + outFrames,
                outFrames > frames * 0.5);
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeInRampsFromSilenceToFullLevel() {
        int frames = 4800;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 440, 0.8f);
        FadeProcessor p = new FadeProcessor();
        p.getParam("fade_type").setEnumIndex(0); // Fade In
        p.getParam("fade_len").setCurrentRaw(50);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        assertTrue("Fade did not start at silence",
                Math.abs(out[0]) < 0.01f);
        // The fade covers the first half of the region, so the level must
        // reach full strength by the end of the fade window.
        int fadeEnd = frames / 2;
        float peakAtFadeEnd = 0f;
        for (int f = fadeEnd - 200; f < fadeEnd; f++) {
            peakAtFadeEnd = Math.max(peakAtFadeEnd, Math.abs(out[f]));
        }
        assertTrue("Fade did not reach full level: " + peakAtFadeEnd,
                peakAtFadeEnd > 0.7f);
    }

    @Test
    public void timelineUtilityInvertsReversesAndRepeats() {
        int frames = 1000;
        float[] buf = new float[frames];
        for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) buf[f] = f / (float) frames;

        TimelineUtilityProcessor p = new TimelineUtilityProcessor();
        p.getParam("tl_action").setEnumIndex(0); // Invert
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] inverted = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        assertEquals(-buf[0], inverted[0], 0.0001f);

        p.getParam("tl_action").setEnumIndex(1); // Reverse
        float[] reversed = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        assertEquals(buf[0], reversed[frames - 1], 0.0001f);

        p.getParam("tl_action").setEnumIndex(2); // Repeat
        p.getParam("tl_repeats").setCurrentRaw(3);
        float[] repeated = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        assertEquals(frames * 3, repeated.length);
        assertEquals(buf[10], repeated[frames + 10], 0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void generatorRendersAToneIntoTheRegion() {
        int frames = 24000;
        float[] buf = new float[frames];
        AudioGeneratorTool p = new AudioGeneratorTool();
        p.getParam("gen_type").setEnumIndex(0);
        p.getParam("gen_wave").setEnumIndex(0);
        p.getParam("gen_start").setCurrentRaw(1000);
        p.getParam("gen_end").setCurrentRaw(1000);
        p.getParam("gen_amp").setCurrentRaw(50);
        p.prepare(SR, 1);
        float[] out = p.processOfflineRegion(buf, frames, 1);
        double tone = goertzel(out, 4000, 16000, 1000);
        assertTrue("Generator did not render the tone: " + tone, tone > 0.1);
    }

    @Test
    public void plotSpectrumFindsThePeakBinAndNote() {
        int frames = 16384;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 440, 0.5f);
        PlotSpectrumDialog.Result r =
                PlotSpectrumDialog.analyze(buf, frames, 1, SR, 4096);
        assertTrue("Peak frequency off: " + r.peakHz,
                Math.abs(r.peakHz - 440f) < 20f);
        assertEquals("A4", r.peakNote);
        assertTrue("Note should be close", r.noteIsClose);
    }

    @Test
    public void diagnosticsReportPeakRmsAndClipping() {
        // The loudness integration needs at least one 400 ms block.
        int frames = SR * 2;
        float[] buf = sine(frames, 1, 1000, 0.5f);
        // A run of four clipped samples.
        for (int i = 100; i < 104; i++) buf[i] = 1.0f;
        AudioDiagnosticsTool.Report rep =
                AudioDiagnosticsTool.analyze(buf, frames, 1, SR, 3);
        assertTrue("Peak not reported", rep.peakDbfs > -1f);
        assertTrue("RMS not reported", rep.rmsDbfs < 0f);
        assertTrue("Clipped run not detected", rep.clippedRuns >= 1);
        assertTrue("LUFS not reported", rep.integratedLufs > -70f);
        assertNotNull(rep.summary());
    }

    @Test
    public void everyStage7EffectIsRegisteredAndHasItsPrimaryParam() {
        DspChain.EffectType[] types = {
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_PITCH,
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_TEMPO,
                DspChain.EffectType.CHANGE_SPEED_AND_PITCH,
                DspChain.EffectType.SLIDING_STRETCH,
                DspChain.EffectType.PAULSTRETCH,
                DspChain.EffectType.FADE,
                DspChain.EffectType.TIMELINE_UTILITY,
                DspChain.EffectType.TRUNCATE_SILENCE,
                DspChain.EffectType.SPECTRAL_EDIT,
                DspChain.EffectType.AUDIO_GENERATOR};
        for (DspChain.EffectType t : types) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(t.id);
            assertNotNull("Processor missing for " + t.id, p);
            String primary = DspChain.primaryParamId(t);
            assertNotNull("No primary param for " + t.id, primary);
            assertNotNull("Primary param " + primary + " missing on " + t.id,
                    p.getParam(primary));
            assertEquals("Wrong category for " + t.id,
                    p.getCategory(), DspChain.categoryOf(t));
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void offlineEffectsAreMarkedOfflineOnly() {
        String[] offlineIds = {"changepitch", "tempo", "speedpitch",
                "slidestretch", "paulstretch", "fade", "timeline", "truncsil",
                "generator"};
        for (String id : offlineIds) {
            AudioProcessor p = FxRackChain.createProcessor(id);
            assertNotNull(id, p);
            assertTrue(id + " must be offline-only", p.isOfflineOnly());
            assertNotNull(id + " must render offline",
                    p.processOfflineRegion(new float[16], 4, 1));
        }
    }

    public void landscapeDialogsAreBoundedAndEditorKeepSaveImportVisible() {

        assertNotNull(input);

        assertEquals(View.VISIBLE, saveBtn.getVisibility());
        assertEquals(View.VISIBLE, importBtn.getVisibility());
        assertTrue("editor input height in landscape must fit screen: " + input.getLayoutParams().height,
                input.getLayoutParams().height <= Math.round(140 * density));
        ed.dismiss();

        // 2) Standard save/discard/confirm dialogs must be width-capped in landscape.
        OptionsSheet.showConfirm(a, "Save?", "Msg", "Save", false, () -> {});
        Dialog confirm = ShadowDialog.getLatestDialog();
        assertNotNull(confirm);
        int winW = confirm.getWindow().getAttributes().width;
        assertTrue("confirm dialog too wide in landscape: " + winW,
                winW > 0 && winW <= Math.round(OptionsSheet.MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP * density) + 2);
        confirm.dismiss();

        // 3) Recording settings dialog splits horizontally (left = presets, right = formats) in landscape.
        OptionsSheet.showRecordingSettings(a, "Recording settings", "Preset", "Hint",
                "Save as", new OptionsSheet.SettingsState() {
                    @Override public List<OptionsSheet.Item> presets() {

                        c.add(OptionsSheet.Chip.of("Auto", "0.7 MB/min", true, () -> {}));
                        return c;
                    }
                    @Override public String formatHint() { return "Auto"; }
                }, "Done");
        Dialog settings = ShadowDialog.getLatestDialog();
        assertNotNull(settings);
        LinearLayout split = settings.findViewById(R.id.dialogOptions);
        assertNotNull(split);
        assertEquals("landscape preset selector should split horizontally",
                LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL, split.getOrientation());
        settings.dismiss();
    }

                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);

                        + studioRoot.getPaddingBottom() + ", need>="

                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);
        LinearLayout preset = root.findViewById(R.id.settingsRow);

        assertEquals("teleprompter pill height changed", pill,
                toggle.getLayoutParams().height);
        assertEquals("pills are not aligned", Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL,
                preset.getGravity() & Gravity.VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK);
        assertEquals("pills are not aligned", Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL,
                toggle.getGravity() & Gravity.VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK);
        assertEquals("pills have different widths",
                preset.getLayoutParams().width, toggle.getLayoutParams().width);
    }

    @Test
    public void zoomControlStacksVertically() {
        Activity a = activity();
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);
        TeleValue zoom = root.findViewById(R.id.zoomValue);
        assertTrue("zoom control missing", zoom != null);

        zoom.setStacked(true);
        assertTrue("zoom control is not stacked", zoom.isStacked());
        ViewGroup row = (ViewGroup) zoom.getChildAt(1);
        assertEquals("zoom controls are not vertical",
                LinearLayout.VERTICAL, ((LinearLayout) row).getOrientation());
        assertEquals("stacked row is still locked to the horizontal height",
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                row.getLayoutParams().height);
        assertTrue("zoom control is too wide for the waveform rail",
                zoom.getLayoutParams().width
                        <= Math.round(48f * a.getResources()
                                .getDisplayMetrics().density));
    }

    @Test
    public void prompterChromeOverlaysScript() {
        Activity a = activity();
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(a)
                .inflate(R.layout.fragment_studio, null, false);
        FrameLayout panel = root.findViewById(R.id.telePanel);
        assertTrue("prompter panel missing", panel != null);
        assertTrue("script is not the bottom overlay layer",
                panel.getChildAt(0) instanceof TeleprompterView);
        assertTrue("controls do not overlay the script",
                panel.getChildCount() >= 2);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Before;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TakeDaoTest {

    private TakeDatabase db;

    @Before
    public void open() {
        Context ctx = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
        db = TakeDatabase.inMemory(ctx);
    }

    @After
    public void close() {
        try {
            db.close();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private TakeEntity row(long id, String title) {
        TakeEntity e = new TakeEntity();
        e.id = id;
        e.title = title;
        e.durationMs = 1000;
        e.timestamp = id;
        e.dateLabel = "d";
        e.sizeLabel = "0.1 MB";
        e.format = "M4A";
        e.favorite = false;
        e.filePath = null;
        e.origin = "recorded";
        e.lastPositionMs = 0;
        e.markersJson = null;
        return e;
    }

    @Test
    public void upsertAndReadBack() {
        db.takes().upsert(row(1, "Hello"));
        TakeEntity got = db.takes().byId(1);
        assertEquals("Hello", got.title);
        assertEquals("recorded", got.origin);
    }

    @Test
    public void replaceOnConflict() {
        db.takes().upsert(row(1, "Old"));
        db.takes().upsert(row(1, "New"));
        assertEquals("New", db.takes().byId(1).title);
        assertEquals(1, db.takes().count());
    }

    @Test
    public void orderedNewestFirst() {
        db.takes().upsertAll(Arrays.asList(row(1, "Old"), row(2, "New")));
        List<TakeEntity> all = db.takes().allOrdered();
        assertEquals(2, all.size());
        assertEquals(2, all.get(0).id);
    }

    @Test
    public void updatePosition() {
        db.takes().upsert(row(5, "Long"));
        db.takes().updatePosition(5, 12345);
        assertEquals(12345, db.takes().byId(5).lastPositionMs);
    }

    @Test
    public void deleteByIds() {
        db.takes().upsertAll(Arrays.asList(row(1, "A"), row(2, "B")));
        db.takes().deleteByIds(Arrays.asList(1L));
        assertNull(db.takes().byId(1));
        assertEquals("B", db.takes().byId(2).title);
    }

    @Test
    public void takeRoundTripKeepsPhase0Fields() {
        Take t = new Take(9, "T", 2000, 1000, "0.2 MB", "WAV", true, "/x.wav");
        t.origin = "edited";
        t.lastPositionMs = 500;
        t.markersJson = "{\"m\":[]}";
        db.takes().upsert(TakeEntity.fromTake(t));
        Take back = db.takes().byId(9).toTake();
        assertEquals("edited", back.origin);
        assertEquals(500, back.lastPositionMs);
        assertEquals("{\"m\":[]}", back.markersJson);
        assertTrue(back.favorite);
    }

    @Test
    public void entityDefaultsAreSane() {
        Take t = new Take(3, "T", 1, 1, "s", "M4A", false, null);
        TakeEntity e = TakeEntity.fromTake(t);
        assertEquals("recorded", e.origin);
        assertFalse(e.favorite);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * Save-pipeline file rules: unique output names and duration fallbacks.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TakeSaverTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void uniqueFinalCollisionsNumberUp() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "uniq");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        dir.mkdirs();
        File raw = new File(dir, "Take.wav");
        new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        File first = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw, "m4a");
        assertEquals("Take.m4a", first.getName());
        // Occupy the first name: the next call must uniquify.
        new RandomAccessFile(first, "rw").close();
        File second = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw, "m4a");
        assertEquals("Take (2).m4a", second.getName());
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        first.delete();
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        raw.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void rawScratchKeepsFirstWavSaveClean() throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "uniqraw");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        dir.mkdirs();
        File raw = new File(dir, "Take_20261024_065622.raw.wav");
        new RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        File fin = TakeSaver.uniqueFinal(raw, "wav");
        assertEquals("Take_20261024_065622.wav", fin.getName());
        assertTrue(!fin.getName().contains("(2)"));
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        raw.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void durationOfGarbageFallsBack() throws Exception {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "nodur.bin");
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(new byte[100]);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        assertEquals(1000, TakeSaver.durationOf(f));
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
    }

    @Test
    public void durationOfMissingFallsBack() {
        File f = new File(ctx().getCacheDir(), "missing.wav");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        assertEquals(1000, TakeSaver.durationOf(f));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

public class TakeTest {

    @Test
    public void formatDuration() {
        assertEquals("00:00", Take.formatDuration(0));
        assertEquals("00:44", Take.formatDuration(44_000));
        assertEquals("04:12", Take.formatDuration(252_000));
        assertEquals("12:05", Take.formatDuration(725_000));
    }

    @Test
    public void formatDateNeverEmpty() {
        String d = Take.formatDate(System.currentTimeMillis());
        assertTrue(d != null && !d.isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    public void defaults() {
        Take t = new Take(7, "X", 1000, 0, "0.1 MB", "M4A", false, null);
        assertEquals("recorded", t.origin);
        assertEquals(0, t.lastPositionMs);
        assertTrue(t.markersJson == null);
    }

    @Test
    public void hasFileReflectsDisk() throws Exception {
        java.io.File f = new java.io.File(
                System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "hasfile.bin");
        // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
        f.delete();
        Take missing = new Take(1, "X", 0, 0, "", "M4A", false,
                f.getAbsolutePath());
        assertFalse(missing.hasFile());
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "rw").close();
        try {
            assertTrue(missing.hasFile());
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
        Take nopath = new Take(2, "X", 0, 0, "", "M4A", false, null);
        assertFalse(nopath.hasFile());
    }

    @Test
    public void convertingDefaultsOff() {
        Take t = new Take(3, "X", 0, 0, "", "M4A", false, null);
        assertFalse(t.converting);
        assertEquals(0, t.convProgress);
        assertEquals("", t.convFormat);
        assertEquals("", t.convJobId);
        assertEquals("", t.convRawPath);
    }

    @Test
    public void entityNullsNormalize() {
        // Legacy rows can hold null columns; the library dereferences
        // title/format on the main thread, so toTake must never pass nulls.
        TakeEntity e = new TakeEntity();
        e.id = 99;
        e.title = null;
        e.format = null;
        Take t = e.toTake();
        assertTrue(t.title != null && !t.title.isEmpty());
        assertTrue(t.format != null && !t.format.isEmpty());
        // Lower-casing (filter) and comparison (sort) must not throw.
        assertTrue(t.title.toLowerCase().length() >= 0);
        assertTrue(t.title.compareToIgnoreCase("zzz") != 0);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Opens the teleprompter dialogs for real.
 *
 * <p>This exists because a dialog that inflates and binds fine can still
 * throw the moment it shows — the framework rejects
 * {@code requestWindowFeature()} once content is attached, which is exactly
 * how the tuner and editor were crashing.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TeleDialogsTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    @Test
    public void inlineSettingsSurviveFullRangeSweep() {
        // The dead tuner sheet is gone; its replacement is the inline
        // TeleValue controls, which commit through these setters. Sweep the
        // full ranges the way a scrub would, including the extreme ends.
        android.app.Activity a = activity();
        for (int wpm = TeleSettings.MIN_WPM; wpm <= TeleSettings.MAX_WPM;
                wpm += 40) {
            TeleSettings.setWordsPerMinute(a, wpm);
        }
        for (int sp = TeleMath.MIN_TEXT_SP; sp <= TeleMath.MAX_TEXT_SP;
                sp += 4) {
            TeleSettings.setTextSize(a, sp);
        }
        for (int wpl = TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE;
                wpl <= TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE; wpl++) {
            TeleSettings.setWordsPerLine(a, wpl);
        }
        TeleSettings got = TeleSettings.load(a);
        assertEquals(TeleSettings.MAX_WPM, got.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_TEXT_SP, got.textSizeSp);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, got.wordsPerLine);
    }

    @Test
    public void wplControlSpansFullRangeLive() {
        TeleValue tv = new TeleValue(activity());
        tv.configure(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, 1, 5, "");
        final int[] seen = {-1};
        tv.setOnValueChanged(v -> seen[0] = v);
        tv.setValue(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, true);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, seen[0]);
        tv.setValue(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE, true);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE, seen[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void editorOpensImportAndSaves() {
        final boolean[] imported = {false};
        final String[] saved = {null};
        android.app.Dialog d = TeleDialogs.showEditor(activity(),
                "hello world\nsecond line", 120,
                text -> saved[0] = text,
                () -> imported[0] = true);

        // The import button must actually fire the hook when tapped.
        View importBtn = d.findViewById(R.id.teleImportBtn);
        assertTrue("no import button", importBtn != null);
        importBtn.performClick();
        assertTrue("import hook never fired", imported[0]);

        // Save commits explicitly.
        View saveBtn = d.findViewById(R.id.teleSaveBtn);
        assertTrue("no save button", saveBtn != null);
        saveBtn.performClick();
        assertEquals("saved=" + saved[0], "hello world\nsecond line", saved[0]);
        // Closing without saving keeps whatever was last committed.
        d.dismiss();
    }

    @Test
    public void editorSavesEmptyScriptOnceToClear() {
        // A4-10: an empty script is a legitimate state — it clears the
        // prompter. The old code refused to commit it, so a script could
        // never be cleared once set.
        final String[] saved = {null};
        final int[] calls = {0};
        android.app.Dialog d = TeleDialogs.showEditor(activity(), "   ", 120,
                text -> {
                    if (calls[0] == 0) saved[0] = text;
                    calls[0]++;
                }, null);
        d.findViewById(R.id.teleSaveBtn).performClick();
        org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowLooper.idleMainLooper();
        assertEquals("empty script must commit", 1, calls[0]);
        assertEquals("", saved[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void editorHandlesEmptyAndHugeScripts() {
        TeleDialogs.showEditor(activity(), "", 120, text -> { }, null);
        StringBuilder big = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 20000; i++) {
            big.append("word").append(i).append(' ');
        }
        TeleDialogs.showEditor(activity(), big.toString(), 120,
                text -> { }, null);
        assertEquals(20000, TeleMath.wordCount(big.toString()));
    }
}
