package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

/**
 * The teleprompter's layout and pacing rules. These are the ones that must
 * hold: text can never overflow its column, and the fade has to be linear
 * and symmetric about the centre.
 */
public class TeleMathTest {

    // ---- words per line ----

    @Test
    public void bigTextForcesFewerWords() {
        int width = 1000;
        float small = 12f * 3f; // 36px
        float big = 48f * 3f;   // 144px
        int want = 8;
        int atSmall = TeleMath.wordsPerLine(width, small, want);
        int atBig = TeleMath.wordsPerLine(width, big, want);
        assertEquals("small text should fit the request", want, atSmall);
        assertTrue("large text must clamp: " + atBig, atBig < want);
    }

    @Test
    public void neverExceedsTheRequest() {
        float[] sizes = {36f, 60f, 90f, 120f, 168f};
        for (float s : sizes) {
            for (int want = 2; want <= 14; want++) {
                int got = TeleMath.wordsPerLine(1200, s, want);
                assertTrue("s=" + s + " want=" + want + " got=" + got,
                        got <= want);
                assertTrue(got >= TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE);
                assertTrue(got <= TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE);
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void clampIsReported() {
        // Big text in a narrow panel must be visibly clamped, not silently.
        assertTrue(TeleMath.wordsPerLineWasClamped(300, 120f, 8));
        assertFalse(TeleMath.wordsPerLineWasClamped(1400, 40f, 8));
    }

    @Test
    public void degenerateSpaceFallsBackSafely() {
        // No width or no text size (view not laid out yet): return the
        // floor rather than dividing by zero. This is reported as clamped,
        // which is honest - the request genuinely could not be honoured.
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.wordsPerLine(0, 40f, 6));
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.wordsPerLine(800, 0f, 6));
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.wordsPerLine(0, 0f, 6));
        assertTrue(TeleMath.wordsPerLineWasClamped(0, 0f, 6));
    }

    // ---- pacing ----

    @Test
    public void fasterReadingScrollsFaster() {
        float slow = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(90, 5, 48f);
        float fast = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(200, 5, 48f);
        assertTrue("slow=" + slow + " fast=" + fast, fast > slow);
        assertTrue(slow > 0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void biggerTextScrollsFasterPerLine() {
        float small = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 5, 24f);
        float large = TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 5, 72f);
        assertTrue("small=" + small + " large=" + large, large > small);
    }

    @Test
    public void zeroSpeedScrollsNowhere() {
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(0, 5, 48f), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 0, 48f), 0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void scrollSpeedMatchesRenderedLineMotion() {
        // 120 wpm is two words/second. On two-word lines, that is exactly one
        // rendered line-height per second.
        assertEquals(72f, TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 2, 48f), 0.001f);
        // Halving the effective words per line doubles the required line rate.
        assertEquals(144f, TeleMath.scrollPxPerSecond(120, 1, 48f), 0.001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void charsPerSecondIsExact() {
        // 5 words/line * 5.8 chars * 2 words/sec at 120wpm.
        assertEquals(58f, TeleMath.charsPerSecond(5, 120), 0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void estimatedSecondsIsExact() {
        // 10 words at 60wpm = 10 seconds.
        assertEquals(10, TeleMath.estimatedSeconds("a b c d e f g h i j", 60));
    }

    @Test
    public void wordsPerLineExactTable() {
        // 1200px / (48px * 0.52) = 48 chars / 5.8 = 8 words, request honored.
        assertEquals(8, TeleMath.wordsPerLine(1200, 48f, 8));
        // Request above the maximum is still capped.
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE,
                TeleMath.wordsPerLine(100000, 10f, 500));
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeRespectsExplicitFadeHeight() {
        // 5px from the top with a 10px fade: fully transparent.
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(5f, 300f, 10f), 0.0001f);
        // 5px off-centre with a 10px fade: half faded.
        assertEquals(0.5f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(145f, 300f, 10f), 0.0001f);
        // Non-positive fade falls back to half the panel.
        assertEquals(1f - 145f / 150f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(5f, 300f, 0f),
                0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void charsPerSecondScalesWithLineLength() {
        assertTrue(TeleMath.charsPerSecond(8, 120)
                > TeleMath.charsPerSecond(4, 120));
    }

    // ---- script metrics ----

    @Test
    public void wordCounting() {
        assertEquals(0, TeleMath.wordCount(null));
        assertEquals(0, TeleMath.wordCount("   \n\n  "));
        assertEquals(3, TeleMath.wordCount("one two three"));
        assertEquals(3, TeleMath.wordCount("  one   two \n\n three  "));
    }

    @Test
    public void estimateGrowsWithLengthAndFallsWithSpeed() {
        String script = "a b c d e f g h i j";
        int slow = TeleMath.estimatedSeconds(script, 60);
        int fast = TeleMath.estimatedSeconds(script, 300);
        assertTrue("slow=" + slow + " fast=" + fast, slow > fast);
        assertEquals(10, TeleMath.wordCount(script));
        assertEquals(0, TeleMath.estimatedSeconds(script, 0));
    }

    // ---- fade ----

    @Test
    public void fadeIsStrongestAtTheCentre() {
        float h = 400f;
        float fade = h * 0.46f;
        float centre = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h / 2f, h, fade);
        float upper = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h * 0.25f, h, fade);
        float lower = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h * 0.75f, h, fade);
        assertEquals(1f, centre, 0.0001f);
        assertTrue(centre > upper);
        assertTrue(centre > lower);
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeIsSymmetricAboutTheCentre() {
        float h = 600f;
        float fade = h * 0.46f;
        for (float y = 10f; y < h; y += 17f) {
            float a = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(y, h, fade);
            float b = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h - y, h, fade);
            assertEquals("asymmetry at y=" + y, a, b, 0.0001f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeDecreasesMonotonicallyOutward() {
        // Linear, not stepped: each step outward must not increase.
        float h = 500f;
        float fade = h * 0.46f;
        float prev = 2f;
        for (float y = h / 2f; y >= 0f; y -= 3f) {
            float a = TeleMath.fadeAlpha(y, h, fade);
            assertTrue("rise at y=" + y, a <= prev + 0.0001f);
            prev = a;
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void fadeEndsFullyTransparentAndNeverInverts() {
        float h = 300f;
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(0f, h, h * 0.46f), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals(0f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(h, h, h * 0.46f), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals(1f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(150f, h, 0f), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals(1f, TeleMath.fadeAlpha(150f, 0f, 10f), 0.0001f);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * Teleprompter preference rules: defaults, clamping, persistence and the
 * inline-control setters that must never race a stale snapshot.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TeleSettingsTest {

    @After
    public void clearTakeonePrefs() {
        ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext()
                .getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().clear().commit();
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
    }


    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void defaultsAreSane() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings s = TeleSettings.load(ctx());
        assertEquals(120, s.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(5, s.wordsPerLine);
        assertEquals(26, s.textSizeSp);
        assertFalse(s.mirror);
        assertTrue(s.autoScroll);
    }

    @Test
    public void loadClampsCorruptPrefs() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        ctx().getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                .putInt("tele_wpm", 9999)
                .putInt("tele_wpl", -4)
                .putInt("tele_size", 0)
                .putInt("tele_count", 99)
                .apply();
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings s = TeleSettings.load(ctx());
        assertEquals(TeleSettings.MAX_WPM, s.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE, s.wordsPerLine);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MIN_TEXT_SP, s.textSizeSp);
        assertTrue("countdown must clamp into range",
                s.countdownSec >= 0 && s.countdownSec <= 10);
    }

    @Test
    public void settersClampAndPersist() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings.setTextSize(ctx(), 500);
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerMinute(ctx(), 1);
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerLine(ctx(), 100);
        TeleSettings s = TeleSettings.load(ctx());
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_TEXT_SP, s.textSizeSp);
        assertEquals(TeleSettings.MIN_WPM, s.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE, s.wordsPerLine);
    }

    @Test
    public void settersRoundTripThroughPrefs() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings.setTextSize(ctx(), 33);
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerMinute(ctx(), 200);
        TeleSettings.setWordsPerLine(ctx(), 7);
        TeleSettings.toggleMirror(ctx(), true);
        // Drop the cache: values must survive on disk alone.
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings s = TeleSettings.load(ctx());
        assertEquals(33, s.textSizeSp);
        assertEquals(200, s.wordsPerMinute);
        assertEquals(7, s.wordsPerLine);
        assertTrue(s.mirror);
    }

    @Test
    public void toggleMirrorFlipsBothWays() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings.toggleMirror(ctx(), true);
        assertTrue(TeleSettings.load(ctx()).mirror);
        TeleSettings.toggleMirror(ctx(), false);
        assertFalse(TeleSettings.load(ctx()).mirror);
    }

    @Test
    public void loadReturnsSameCachedInstance() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        assertTrue(TeleSettings.load(ctx()) == TeleSettings.load(ctx()));
    }

    @Test
    public void saveRefreshesCache() {
        TeleSettings.invalidateCache();
        TeleSettings s = new TeleSettings();
        s.wordsPerMinute = 150;
        s.save(ctx());
        assertEquals(150, TeleSettings.load(ctx()).wordsPerMinute);
    }
}

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/hello/TeleValueGestureTest.java

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The value-control behaviours must not leak into each other: a scrub adjusts
 * and finishes without opening a dialog, a single tap is inert and only a
 * double-tap opens the exact-value keyboard.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TeleValueGestureTest {

    private static class RecordingTeleValue extends TeleValue {
        int keyboards;
        final List<Integer> live = new ArrayList<>();
        int finished = -1;
        int discrete = -1;

        RecordingTeleValue(Context context) {
            super(context);
            setOnScrubListener(new OnScrubListener() {
                @Override public void onScrubValueChanged(int value) {
                    live.add(value);
                }

                @Override public void onScrubFinished(int value) {
                    finished = value;
                }
            });
            setOnValueChanged(value -> discrete = value);
        }

        @Override protected void showKeyboardInput() {
            keyboards++;
        }
    }

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private RecordingTeleValue control() {
        Activity a = activity();
        RecordingTeleValue tv = new RecordingTeleValue(a);
        a.setContentView(tv);
        tv.configure(10, 100, 1, 50, "");
        tv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(300, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(80, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        tv.layout(0, 0, 300, 80);
        return tv;
    }

    private static View findValueLabel(View root) {
        CharSequence description = root.getContentDescription();
        if (root instanceof android.widget.TextView
                && description != null
                && "value".contentEquals(description)) {
            return root;
        }
        if (root instanceof android.view.ViewGroup) {
            android.view.ViewGroup group = (android.view.ViewGroup) root;
            for (int i = 0; i < group.getChildCount(); i++) {
                View found = findValueLabel(group.getChildAt(i));
                if (found != null) return found;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static float[] centerOf(View root, View v) {
        float x = v.getLeft() + v.getWidth() / 2f;
        float y = v.getTop() + v.getHeight() / 2f;
        android.view.ViewParent parent = v.getParent();
        while (parent != null && parent != root && parent instanceof View) {
            View parentView = (View) parent;
            x += parentView.getLeft();
            y += parentView.getTop();
            parent = parentView.getParent();
        }
        return new float[]{x, y};
    }

    private static MotionEvent event(int action, float x, float y) {
        long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        return MotionEvent.obtain(now, now, action, x, y, 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void scrubReportsLiveAndFinishWithoutDialogs() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        assertTrue("value label not found", label != null);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        for (float x = c[0] + 8f; x <= c[0] + 130f; x += 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, c[1]));
        }
        assertTrue("scrub did not report live values: " + tv.live,
                !tv.live.isEmpty());
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0] + 130f, c[1]));

        assertEquals("scrub did not finish", tv.getValue(), tv.finished);
        assertEquals("scrub leaked into the discrete listener", -1, tv.discrete);
        assertEquals("scrub opened the keyboard", 0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void verticalScrubDrivesValueWhenEnabled() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setVerticalScrub(true);
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        // Drag upward: the value must climb, like the waveform's own gesture.
        for (float y = c[1] - 8f; y >= c[1] - 80f; y -= 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, c[0], y));
        }
        assertTrue("vertical scrub did not report live values: " + tv.live,
                !tv.live.isEmpty());
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0], c[1] - 80f));

        assertEquals(tv.getValue(), tv.finished);
        assertTrue("vertical scrub moved the value down", tv.getValue() > 50);
        assertEquals(0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void verticalMoveIsConsumedWithoutValueOrDialogs() {        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        for (float y = c[1] + 8f; y <= c[1] + 80f; y += 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, c[0], y));
        }
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0], c[1] + 80f));

        assertEquals(50, tv.getValue());
        assertTrue("vertical move reported live values", tv.live.isEmpty());
        assertEquals(-1, tv.finished);
        assertEquals(0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void singleTapIsInert() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0], c[1]));

        assertEquals("a single tap changed the value", 50, tv.getValue());
        assertEquals("a single tap opened the keyboard", 0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void doubleTapOpensKeyboardDirectly() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);

        ((android.widget.TextView) label).performClick();
        ((android.widget.TextView) label).performClick();

        assertEquals(1, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void stationaryHoldDoesNotOpenKeyboard() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);

        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0], c[1]));

        assertEquals("a hold summoned the keyboard", 0, tv.keyboards);
        assertEquals(50, tv.getValue());
    }

    @Test
    public void stackedZoomKeepsScrubBehaviour() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setStacked(true);
        assertTrue("stacked mode was not retained", tv.isStacked());
        tv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(80, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(180, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        tv.layout(0, 0, 80, 180);

        View label = findValueLabel(tv);
        float[] c = centerOf(tv, label);
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, c[0], c[1]));
        for (float x = c[0] + 8f; x <= c[0] + 60f; x += 8f) {
            tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, c[1]));
        }
        tv.dispatchTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, c[0] + 60f, c[1]));

        assertTrue("stacked scrub did not report live values",
                !tv.live.isEmpty());
        assertEquals(tv.getValue(), tv.finished);
        assertEquals(0, tv.keyboards);
    }

    @Test
    public void configureClampsInitialValue() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.configure(10, 20, 1, 999, "");
        assertEquals(20, tv.getValue());
        tv.configure(10, 20, 1, -999, "");
        assertEquals(10, tv.getValue());
        assertEquals(10, tv.getMin());
    }

    @Test
    public void captionShowsAndHides() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setCaption("Size");
        android.view.View caption = null;
        android.view.ViewGroup root = tv;
        for (int i = 0; i < root.getChildCount(); i++) {
            android.view.View c = root.getChildAt(i);
            if (c instanceof android.widget.TextView
                    && "Size".contentEquals(
                            ((android.widget.TextView) c).getText())) {
                caption = c;
            }
        }
        assertTrue(caption != null
                && caption.getVisibility() == android.view.View.VISIBLE);
        tv.setCaption("");
        assertTrue(caption.getVisibility() == android.view.View.GONE);
        tv.setCaption(null);
        assertTrue(caption.getVisibility() == android.view.View.GONE);
    }

    @Test
    public void plusMinusStepDiscretely() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        android.view.View plus = null;
        android.view.View minus = null;
        android.view.ViewGroup row =
                (android.view.ViewGroup) tv.getChildAt(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < row.getChildCount(); i++) {
            android.view.View c = row.getChildAt(i);
            CharSequence d = c.getContentDescription();
            if (d != null && "increase".contentEquals(d)) plus = c;
            if (d != null && "decrease".contentEquals(d)) minus = c;
        }
        assertTrue(plus != null && minus != null);
        plus.performClick();
        assertEquals(51, tv.getValue());
        assertEquals(51, tv.discrete);
        minus.performClick();
        minus.performClick();
        assertEquals(49, tv.getValue());
    }

    @Test
    public void unchangedValueDoesNotNotify() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setValue(50, true);
        assertEquals(-1, tv.discrete);
        tv.setValue(51, true);
        assertEquals(51, tv.discrete);
    }

    @Test
    public void stackedDefaultsOff() {
        RecordingTeleValue tv = control();
        assertTrue(!tv.isStacked());
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

/**
 * The high-resolution (basis-point) scale for the waveform zoom rail must
 * format sub-percent values with decimals while every integer-scale control
 * keeps behaving exactly as before.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TeleValueScaleTest {

    private TeleValue control() {
        Activity a = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        TeleValue tv = new TeleValue(a);
        a.setContentView(tv);
        tv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(300, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(80, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        tv.layout(0, 0, 300, 80);
        return tv;
    }

    private static String labelText(TeleValue tv) {
        return findValueLabel(tv).toString();
    }

    private static String findValueLabel(View root) {
        CharSequence description = root.getContentDescription();
        if (root instanceof android.widget.TextView
                && description != null
                && "value".contentEquals(description)) {
            return ((android.widget.TextView) root).getText().toString();
        }
        if (root instanceof android.view.ViewGroup) {
            android.view.ViewGroup group = (android.view.ViewGroup) root;
            for (int i = 0; i < group.getChildCount(); i++) {
                String found = findValueLabel(group.getChildAt(i));
                if (found != null) return found;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static View findButton(TeleValue tv, String desc) {
        android.view.ViewGroup row = (android.view.ViewGroup) tv.getChildAt(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < row.getChildCount(); i++) {
            android.view.View c = row.getChildAt(i);
            CharSequence d = c.getContentDescription();
            if (d != null && desc.contentEquals(d)) return c;
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Test
    public void decimalScaleFormatsZoomLabels() {
        TeleValue tv = control();
        tv.configure(50, 40000, 10, 5000, "%");
        tv.setValueScale(100);
        assertEquals("50%", labelText(tv));
        tv.setValue(10000, false);
        assertEquals("100%", labelText(tv));
        tv.setValue(250, false);
        assertEquals("2.5%", labelText(tv));
        tv.setValue(188, false);
        assertEquals("1.88%", labelText(tv));
        tv.setValue(92, false);
        assertEquals("0.92%", labelText(tv));
        tv.setValue(100, false);
        assertEquals("1%", labelText(tv));
    }

    @Test
    public void stepRuleDrivesPlusMinus() {
        TeleValue tv = control();
        tv.configure(0, 40000, 5, 100, "");
        tv.setStepRule((cur, dir) -> 10);
        findButton(tv, "increase").performClick();
        assertEquals(110, tv.getValue());
        findButton(tv, "decrease").performClick();
        findButton(tv, "decrease").performClick();
        assertEquals(90, tv.getValue());
    }

    @Test
    public void steppedLabelsHonorStepRule() {
        TeleValue tv = control();
        tv.configure(0, 100, 1, 0, "");
        tv.setStepRule((cur, dir) -> 25);
        String[] labels = tv.steppedLabelsForTest();
        assertEquals(5, labels.length);
        assertEquals("0", labels[0]);
        assertEquals("25", labels[1]);
        assertEquals("100", labels[4]);
    }

    @Test
    public void defaultScaleKeepsIntegerBehavior() {
        TeleValue tv = control();
        tv.configure(40, 400, 5, 120, "");
        assertEquals("120", labelText(tv));
        assertEquals(1, tv.getValueScale());
        findButton(tv, "increase").performClick();
        assertEquals(125, tv.getValue());
        assertEquals("125", labelText(tv));
        String[] labels = tv.steppedLabelsForTest();
        assertTrue(labels.length > 10);
        assertEquals("40", labels[0]);
        assertEquals("45", labels[1]);
    }

    @Test
    public void negativeScaledValuesFormatAndStepCorrectly() {
        // BUG-08 regression: negative scaled values <= -10*scale and negative
        // stepped wheel values must include min and format symmetrically.
        TeleValue tv = control();
        tv.setValueScale(100);
        tv.configure(-2400, 2400, 600, -1250, " dB");
        assertEquals("-12.5 dB", labelText(tv));
        tv.setValue(-125, false);
        assertEquals("-1.25 dB", labelText(tv));

        String[] labels = tv.steppedLabelsForTest();
        assertTrue(labels.length >= 9);
        assertEquals("-24 dB", labels[0]);
        assertEquals("24 dB", labels[labels.length - 1]);
    }

    @Test
    public void unalignedMaxIsIncludedInSteppedPickerLabels() {
        TeleValue tv = control();
        tv.configure(0, 12, 5, 0, "");
        String[] labels = tv.steppedLabelsForTest();
        assertEquals(4, labels.length);
        assertEquals("0", labels[0]);
        assertEquals("5", labels[1]);
        assertEquals("10", labels[2]);
        assertEquals("12", labels[3]);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Rendering math for the prompter: absolute line positions must stay
 * continuous when scrolling crosses a segment boundary, and size edits must
 * preserve the current line instead of jumping.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class TeleprompterRenderTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private TeleprompterView laidOutView(int width, int height) {
        TeleprompterView v = new TeleprompterView(activity());
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(width, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(height, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, width, height);
        return v;
    }

    private static String manyWords(int n) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(' ');
            sb.append("word").append(i);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    @Test
    public void windowBaselineIsContinuousAcrossSegmentBoundary() {
        float centreY = 300f;
        float lineHeight = 66f;

        // Check the same absolute segment immediately before and after
        // scrolling across several line boundaries.
        for (int k = 1; k <= 5; k++) {
            float before = k * lineHeight - 0.1f;
            int fromBefore = (int) Math.floor(before / lineHeight);
            float beforeBaseline = TeleprompterView.windowStartBaseline(
                    centreY, before, fromBefore, lineHeight)
                    + (k - fromBefore) * lineHeight;

            float after = k * lineHeight + 0.1f;
            int fromAfter = (int) Math.floor(after / lineHeight);
            float afterBaseline = TeleprompterView.windowStartBaseline(
                    centreY, after, fromAfter, lineHeight)
                    + (k - fromAfter) * lineHeight;

            assertEquals("segment " + k + " jumped at its boundary",
                    beforeBaseline, afterBaseline, 0.5f);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void windowForScrollPadsBothEnds() {
        List<String> segments = Arrays.asList("one", "two", "three");
        String[] window = TeleprompterView.windowForScroll(segments, 5, -1);
        assertEquals(5, window.length);
        assertEquals("", window[0]);
        assertEquals("one", window[1]);
        assertEquals("two", window[2]);
        assertEquals("three", window[3]);
        assertEquals("", window[4]);
    }

    @Test
    public void effectiveWordsPerLineNeverExceedsRequested() {
        TeleprompterView v = laidOutView(900, 600);
        v.setWordsPerLine(10);
        int effective = v.effectiveWordsPerLine();
        assertTrue("effective=" + effective, effective >= TeleMath.MIN_WORDS_PER_LINE);
        assertTrue("effective=" + effective,
                effective <= Math.min(10, TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE));
    }

    @Test
    public void changingSizePreservesCurrentLine() {
        TeleprompterView v = laidOutView(900, 600);
        v.setScript(manyWords(300));
        float oldLineHeight = v.lineHeight();
        assertTrue("no scrollable fixture", v.maxScroll() > 0f);

        float linePosition = 7.25f;
        v.setScrollOffset(linePosition * oldLineHeight);
        v.setTextSizePx(v.getTextSizePx() + 12f);

        float restored = v.scrollOffset() / v.lineHeight();
        assertEquals("size edit moved to line " + restored,
                linePosition, restored, 0.01f);
    }

    @Test
    public void repeatedLiveEditsKeepLinePosition() {
        TeleprompterView v = laidOutView(900, 600);
        v.setScript(manyWords(200));
        float linePosition = 4.5f;
        v.setScrollOffset(linePosition * v.lineHeight());

        // Simulate a scrub: several committed size changes in a row must not
        // drift the reading position.
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            v.setTextSizePx(v.getTextSizePx() + 2f);
        }
        float restored = v.scrollOffset() / v.lineHeight();
        assertEquals("live edits drifted to line " + restored,
                linePosition, restored, 0.05f);
    }

    @Test
    public void drawWindowAlwaysCoversViewport() {
        float lineHeight = 66f;
        int height = 227;
        // Reading centre pushed down as if chrome overlays the top.
        float centreY = height / 2f + 20f;
        for (float scroll = 0f; scroll <= 40 * lineHeight;
             scroll += lineHeight / 3f) {
            int from = TeleprompterView.drawStartForScroll(
                    centreY, scroll, lineHeight);
            float first = TeleprompterView.windowStartBaseline(
                    centreY, scroll, from, lineHeight);
            int n = TeleprompterView.drawCountForScroll(
                    first, lineHeight, height);
            assertTrue("top gap at scroll " + scroll + ": first=" + first,
                    first <= 0f && first > -2f * lineHeight);
            float last = first + (n - 1) * lineHeight;
            assertTrue("bottom gap at scroll " + scroll + ": last=" + last,
                    last >= height);
            // The segment sitting at the top edge must be drawn, not skipped.
            int topIndex = (int) Math.floor((scroll - centreY) / lineHeight);
            assertTrue("top line " + topIndex + " omitted at scroll " + scroll,
                    topIndex >= from && topIndex < from + n);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void changingWordsPerLineKeepsLinePosition() {
        TeleprompterView v = laidOutView(900, 600);
        v.setScript(manyWords(300));
        float linePosition = 5.0f;
        v.setScrollOffset(linePosition * v.lineHeight());
        // Simulates one live scrub tick on the WPL control: the view must
        // re-segment immediately without losing the reading position.
        v.setWordsPerLine(TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE);
        assertTrue(v.segmentCount() > 0);
        assertEquals("wpl edit moved to line "
                        + v.scrollOffset() / v.lineHeight(),
                linePosition, v.scrollOffset() / v.lineHeight(), 0.05f);
        assertTrue(v.effectiveWordsPerLine() <= TeleMath.MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE);
    }

    @Test
    public void nullAndEmptyScriptsClear() {
        TeleprompterView v = laidOutView(900, 600);
        v.setScript(manyWords(50));
        assertTrue(v.segmentCount() > 0);
        v.setScript(null);
        assertEquals(0, v.segmentCount());
        assertEquals(0f, v.maxScroll(), 0.01f);
        v.setScript("   \n  ");
        assertEquals(0f, v.maxScroll(), 0.01f);
    }

    @Test
    public void rewindAndClampBehave() {
        TeleprompterView v = laidOutView(900, 600);
        v.setScript(manyWords(300));
        v.setScrollOffset(Float.MAX_VALUE);
        assertEquals(v.maxScroll(), v.scrollOffset(), 0.01f);
        v.rewind();
        assertEquals(0f, v.scrollOffset(), 0.01f);
        v.setScrollOffset(-50f);
        assertEquals(0f, v.scrollOffset(), 0.01f);
        v.scrollBy(10f);
        assertTrue(v.scrollOffset() > 0f);
    }

    @Test
    public void contentHeightMatchesSegments() {
        TeleprompterView v = laidOutView(900, 600);
        v.setScript(manyWords(100));
        assertEquals(v.segmentCount() * v.lineHeight(), v.contentHeight(),
                0.01f);
    }

    @Test
    public void centerShiftClampsNegative() {
        TeleprompterView v = laidOutView(900, 600);
        v.setScript(manyWords(100));
        // Must not throw, and must settle at the floor.
        v.setCenterShiftPx(-40f);
        v.setCenterShiftPx(30f);
        assertTrue(v.contentHeight() > 0f);
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;

import org.junit.Test;

public class TimeFmtTest {

    @Test
    public void zero() {
        assertEquals("00:00.00", TimeFmt.formatTimer(0));
    }

    @Test
    public void centiseconds() {
        assertEquals("00:01.50", TimeFmt.formatTimer(1500));
        assertEquals("00:01.05", TimeFmt.formatTimer(1050));
        assertEquals("00:01.99", TimeFmt.formatTimer(1999));
    }

    @Test
    public void minutesCarry() {
        assertEquals("01:00.00", TimeFmt.formatTimer(60_000));
        assertEquals("12:34.56", TimeFmt.formatTimer(754_560));
    }

    @Test
    public void negativeClamps() {
        assertEquals("00:00.00", TimeFmt.formatTimer(-5));
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/** Pure-JUnit coverage for the raw 32-bit float save path. */
public class Wav32FormatTest {

    @Test
    public void toWav32CopiesTheFloatPayloadByteForByte() throws Exception {
        File src = File.createTempFile("raw32", ".wav");
        File dst = File.createTempFile("copy32", ".wav");
        try {
            int frames = 480;
            byte[] payload = new byte[frames * 2 * 4];
            for (int i = 0; i < payload.length; i += 4) {
                float v = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.01) * 0.5f;
                int bits = Float.floatToIntBits(v);
                payload[i] = (byte) bits;
                payload[i + 1] = (byte) (bits >>> 8);
                payload[i + 2] = (byte) (bits >>> 16);
                payload[i + 3] = (byte) (bits >>> 24);
            }
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(src, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, payload.length));
                w.write(payload);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }

            FormatConverter.toWav32(src, dst, null);
            FormatConverter.validateFinal(dst, SaveFormat.WAV32);
            assertEquals(src.length(), dst.length());

            RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "r");
            try {
                r.seek(44);
                byte[] copied = new byte[payload.length];
                r.readFully(copied);
                assertTrue("float payload changed",
                        java.util.Arrays.equals(payload, copied));
            } finally {
                r.close();
            }
            assertEquals(10L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst));
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            src.delete();
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            dst.delete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void validateFinalRejectsIntegerPcmLabelledWav32() throws Exception {
        File f = File.createTempFile("not32", ".wav");
        try {
            byte[] hdr = Dsp.wav16Header(1, 48000, 200);
            byte[] all = new byte[hdr.length + 200];
            System.arraycopy(hdr, 0, all, 0, hdr.length);
            FileOutputStream w = new FileOutputStream(f);
            try {
                w.write(all);
            } finally {
                w.close();
            }
            boolean threw = false;
            try {
                FormatConverter.validateFinal(f, SaveFormat.WAV32);
            } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
                threw = true;
            }
            assertTrue("integer PCM accepted as WAV32", threw);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            f.delete();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.View;

import org.junit.Rule;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * BUG-04: attaching an existing session (edit punch-in / crash recovery)
 * must fill the waveform from the file, not leave it blank.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class WaveformLoadTest {

    @Rule
    public TemporaryFolder tmp = new TemporaryFolder();

    @Test
    public void loadFromFloatWavPopulatesHistory() throws Exception {
        Activity a = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        WaveformView v = new WaveformView(a);
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(600,
                        View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(120,
                        View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, 600, 120);

        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), "sess.wav");
        int frames = 48000;
        float[] s = new float[frames * 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            float v2 = (float) (0.5 * Math.sin(i * 0.05));
            s[i * 2] = v2;
            s[i * 2 + 1] = v2;
        }
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, s, 0, s.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }

        v.loadFromFloatWav(f);
        long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
        while (v.historyCount() < 20
                && System.currentTimeMillis() - t0 < 5000) {
            Thread.sleep(50);
        }
        assertEquals("1 s at 20 bars/s must populate 20 buckets",
                20, v.historyCount());
    }

    @Test
    public void loadPreservesLiveTailPushedDuringIO() throws Exception {
        Activity a = Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
        WaveformView v = new WaveformView(a);
        v.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(600,
                        View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(120,
                        View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        v.layout(0, 0, 600, 120);

        // Live mic peaks pushed BEFORE the load starts (autostart recovery
        // already recording while disk I/O is in flight).
        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) v.push(0.9f);

        File f = new File(tmp.getRoot(), "sess2.wav");
        int frames = 4800;
        float[] s = new float[frames];
        for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            s[i] = (float) (0.2 * Math.sin(i * 0.05));
        }
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, (long) frames * 4));
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, s, 0, s.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }

        v.loadFromFloatWav(f);
        long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
        while (v.historyCount() < 58
                && System.currentTimeMillis() - t0 < 5000) {
            Thread.sleep(50);
        }
        int n = v.historyCount();
        assertTrue("loaded peaks lost the live tail: " + n, n >= 58);
        // Loaded file peaks come first, live tail survives at the end.
        assertTrue("live tail clobbered",
                v.peakAtForTest(n - 1) > 0.85f);
        assertTrue("live tail clobbered",
                v.peakAtForTest(n - 50) > 0.85f);
    }
}

/**

 * overwrites.

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class WaveformTimelineTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private static WaveformView loaded(Activity a, int peaks) {
        WaveformView wv = new WaveformView(a);
        wv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(400, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(100, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        wv.layout(0, 0, 400, 100);
        for (int i = 0; i < peaks; i++) wv.push(0.5f);
        return wv;
    }

    private static MotionEvent ev(int action, float x, float y) {
        long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        return MotionEvent.obtain(now, now, action, x, y, 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void selectionTogglesAroundPlayhead() {
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 100);
        assertFalse(wv.hasSelection());
        wv.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
        assertTrue(wv.hasSelection());
        float start = wv.selectionStartFraction();
        float end = wv.selectionEndFraction();
        assertTrue("start=" + start, start >= 0f && start < end);
        assertTrue("end=" + end, end <= 1f);
        wv.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
        assertFalse(wv.hasSelection());
    }

    @Test
    public void selectionListenerFires() {
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 100);
        List<String> calls = new ArrayList<>();
        wv.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override
            public void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction) {
            }

            @Override
            public void onSelectionChanged(boolean active, float startFrac,
                                           float endFrac) {
                calls.add(active + ":" + startFrac + "-" + endFrac);
            }
        });
        wv.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
        assertEquals(1, calls.size());
        assertTrue(calls.get(0).startsWith("true:"));
        wv.clearSelection();
        assertEquals(2, calls.size());
        assertTrue(calls.get(1).startsWith("false:"));
    }

    @Test
    public void tinyHistorySelectsWhenAtLeastTwoBars() {
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 1);
        wv.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
        assertFalse(wv.hasSelection());

        wv4.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
        assertTrue(wv4.hasSelection());
    }

    @Test
    public void inPlaceCropReplaceAndUndoPreserveBarDensity() {
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 60); // 3.0s at 20 bars/sec
        wv.setLive(false);
        wv.selectRange(0.25f, 0.75f); // buckets 15..45 (30 bars)
        assertTrue(wv.hasSelection());

        wv.recordUndoPeaks();
        wv.cropToSelectionBuckets();
        assertEquals(30, wv.historyCount());
        assertFalse(wv.hasSelection());

        assertEquals(60, wv.historyCount());
    }

    @Test
    public void playheadFractionRoundTrips() {
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 100);

        assertEquals(0.5f, wv.playheadFraction(), 0.02f);
        wv.setPlayheadFraction(2f);
        assertEquals(1f, wv.playheadFraction(), 0.001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void pushOrOverwriteUpdatesBucketInPlace() {
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 100);
        wv.pushOrOverwrite(0.9f, 0.5f, false);
        assertEquals(100, wv.historyCount());
        // In-place overwrite now MORPHS the covered bucket between the old
        // peak (0.9) and the new value (0.5): 0.5*0.38+0.9*0.62 = 0.748!
        float morphed = wv.peakAtForTest(50);
        assertTrue("morphed=" + morphed, morphed > 0.6f && morphed < 0.95f);
        assertEquals(0.51f, wv.playheadFraction(), 0.02f);
        wv.pushOrOverwrite(0.7f, 0f, true);
        assertEquals(101, wv.historyCount());
    }

    @Test

        final float[] lastFrac = {-1f};
        wv.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override

            }

            @Override

        // Drag right moves earlier audio to the center playhead (200 -> ~100).
        wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 100f, 50f));
        for (float x = 120f; x <= 300f; x += 20f) {
            wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, 50f));
        }
        wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 300f, 50f));
        assertTrue("scroll did not fire: " + lastFrac[0],
                lastFrac[0] >= 0.4f && lastFrac[0] <= 0.7f);
        assertEquals(lastFrac[0], wv.playheadFraction(), 0.001f);
    }

        // Grab the '[' handle (near x=68.6 for a 400px view) and drag it right.

    @Test

        wvLow.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 260f, 50f));
        float deltaAt1x = 1.0f - wvLow.playheadFraction();

        WaveformView wvHigh = loaded(activity(), 400);

                deltaAt4x < deltaAt1x * 0.4f);
    }

    @Test
    public void scrollingStillWorksAtFitZoomAndReportsTheRealPlayhead() {
        // At the fit zoom of a long take the whole recording is visible at every
        // playhead position, but scrolling MUST keep working: it is how the user
        // moves the playhead for editing.
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 1200);
        wv.setLive(false);
        wv.setZoom(wv.minimumZoom());
        assertTrue("test must run at the fit zoom", wv.getZoom() <= 0.07f);
        wv.setPlayheadFraction(0.5f);

        final float[] reported = {-1f};
        wv.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrollStarted() {}

            @Override
            public void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction) {
                reported[0] = fraction;
            }

            @Override
            public void onSelectionChanged(boolean active, float startFrac, float endFrac) {}
        });

        wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 200f, 50f));
        for (float x = 180f; x >= 140f; x -= 20f) {
            wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, 50f));
        }
        wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 140f, 50f));

        assertTrue("scrolling must still move the playhead at fit zoom",
                wv.playheadFraction() > 0.55f);
        assertTrue("the playhead must stay strictly inside the take",
                wv.playheadFraction() < 1.0f);
        // The scrub callback must report the real playhead so the studio timer
        // never has to snap forward to the take duration.
        assertEquals("scrub callback must report the real playhead",
                wv.playheadFraction(), reported[0], 0.0001f);

        // Zoomed in, the same drag behaves the same way (scroll still works).
        WaveformView wvIn = loaded(activity(), 1200);
        wvIn.setLive(false);
        wvIn.setZoom(1f);
        wvIn.setPlayheadFraction(0.5f);
        wvIn.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 200f, 50f));
        for (float x = 180f; x >= 20f; x -= 20f) {
            wvIn.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, 50f));
        }
        wvIn.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 20f, 50f));
        assertTrue("a zoomed-in drag must still scroll the waveform",
                wvIn.playheadFraction() > 0.51f);
    }

    @Test

    @Test
    public void updateLiveFromFramesKeepsConstantSpeedAcrossReplaceToAppendTransition() {
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 100); // 100 bars = 5.0s at 20 bars/sec
        long totalFrames = 100L * 2400L; // 240,000 frames
        wv.syncFramesPerBar(totalFrames);
        wv.setLive(true);

        // 1) Replace mid-take at bar 50 (frame 120,000) -> bar count stays 100
        wv.updateLiveFromFrames(0.9f, 120_000L, totalFrames);
        assertEquals(100, wv.historyCount());
        assertEquals(0.5f, wv.playheadFraction(), 0.01f);

        // 2) Reach the exact end of the take (frame 240,000) -> still 100 bars
        wv.updateLiveFromFrames(0.8f, 240_000L, totalFrames);
        assertEquals(100, wv.historyCount());

        // 3) Cross the end of the take by 100ms (2 bars = 4,800 frames) ->
        //    must advance by exactly 2 bars (102 total), never speeding up!
        wv.updateLiveFromFrames(0.7f, 244_800L, totalFrames);
        assertEquals(102, wv.historyCount());

        // 4) Pause (setLive(false)) -> previous bars (e.g. bar 20) keep their exact shape!
        wv.setLive(false);
        assertEquals(0.5f, wv.peakAtForTest(20), 0.0001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void scrollingCompletelyLeftReachesZeroAndNeverSnapsTimerToDuration() throws Exception {
        WaveformView wv = loaded(activity(), 200);
        wv.setLive(false);
        wv.setZoom(wv.minimumZoom());

        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        java.io.File raw = new java.io.File(activity().getCacheDir(), "left_zero.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile raf = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw")) {
            int frames = 48000 * 10; // 10.0s take
            raf.setLength(0);
            raf.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, frames * 8L));
            raf.setLength(44L + frames * 8L);
        }
        engine.attachExisting(activity(), raw, "Left Zero", 2, 48000L * 10 * 8L);
        engine.state = RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;
        engine.seekCursorFrame(engine.totalFrames());

        final boolean[] userScrolledWhilePaused = {false};
        wv.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override
            public void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction) {
                long totalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long targetFrame = Math.round(fraction * totalFrames);
                if (fraction >= 0.995f || targetFrame >= totalFrames - 480) {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused[0] = false;
                } else {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused[0] = true;
                }
                engine.seekCursorFrame(targetFrame);
            }

            @Override
            public void onSelectionChanged(boolean active, float s, float e) {}
        });

        // Drag waveform to the complete right so playhead reaches the complete left (00:00.00)
        wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 20f, 50f));
        for (float x = 60f; x <= 380f; x += 40f) {
            wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, x, 50f));
        }
        wv.onTouchEvent(ev(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 380f, 50f));

        assertEquals("playhead must sit at the complete start (0.0)",
                0.0f, wv.playheadFraction(), 0.0001f);
        assertEquals("cursorFrames must be 0 at complete left",
                0L, engine.cursorFrames());
        assertTrue("userScrolledWhilePaused must be true at 00:00.00",
                userScrolledWhilePaused[0]);

        // Verify the StudioFragment.tick timer condition at cursorFrames() == 0:
        long shownMs = (engine.cursorFrames() > 0 || userScrolledWhilePaused[0])
                ? engine.cursorMs() : engine.durationMs();
        assertEquals("timer at complete left must be 0 ms (00:00.00), never take duration",
                0L, shownMs);
        assertEquals("00:00.00", StudioFragment.formatTimer(shownMs));

        engine.abortAndDelete();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.Robolectric;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The waveform's vertical-drag zoom must step live as the finger travels:
 * firing only on release made short or interrupted drags feel dead.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class WaveformZoomTest {

    private Activity activity() {
        return Robolectric.buildActivity(Activity.class).setup().get();
    }

    private WaveformView laidOut() {
        WaveformView wv = new WaveformView(activity());
        wv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(300, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(120, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        wv.layout(0, 0, 300, 120);
        return wv;
    }

    private static MotionEvent event(int action, float x, float y) {
        long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
        return MotionEvent.obtain(now, now, action, x, y, 0);
    }

    @Test
    public void dragStepsLivePerThreshold() {
        WaveformView wv = new WaveformView(activity());
        wv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(300, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(120, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        wv.layout(0, 0, 300, 120);
        final List<Float> dirs = new ArrayList<>();
        wv.setOnZoomGesture((dir, dy) -> dirs.add(dir));

        wv.onTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 150f, 60f));
        // A long upward drag must produce several zoom-in steps on the way,
        // not a single event on release. Travel far past the view bounds so
        // the assertion holds at any screen density.
        for (float y = 55f; y >= -245f; y -= 5f) {
            wv.onTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 150f, y));
        }
        assertTrue("no live zoom steps during the drag (dirs=" + dirs + ")",
                dirs.size() >= 2);
        for (float d : dirs) {
            assertEquals("wrong direction", 1f, d, 0.001f);
        }
        int duringDrag = dirs.size();
        wv.onTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 150f, -245f));
        assertEquals("release must not add another step",
                duringDrag, dirs.size());
    }

    @Test
    public void shortDragDoesNothing() {
        WaveformView wv = new WaveformView(activity());
        wv.measure(
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(300, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY),
                View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(120, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY));
        wv.layout(0, 0, 300, 120);
        final int[] calls = {0};
        wv.setOnZoomGesture((dir, dy) -> calls[0]++);

        wv.onTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 150f, 60f));
        wv.onTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 150f, 58f));
        wv.onTouchEvent(event(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 150f, 58f));
        assertEquals("a 2px nudge must not zoom", 0, calls[0]);
    }

    @Test
    public void emptyHistoryFloorIsHalf() {
        assertEquals(0.5f, laidOut().minimumZoom(), 0.001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void setZoomClampsBothEnds() {
        WaveformView wv = laidOut();
        wv.setZoom(99f);
        assertEquals(4f, wv.getZoom(), 0.001f);
        wv.setZoom(-5f);
        assertEquals(wv.minimumZoom(), wv.getZoom(), 0.001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void clearResetsHistory() {
        WaveformView wv = laidOut();
        for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++) wv.push(0.5f);
        assertEquals(300, wv.historyCount());
        wv.clear();
        assertEquals(0, wv.historyCount());
        assertEquals(0.5f, wv.minimumZoom(), 0.001f);
    }

    @Test
    public void historyCapsAtMax() {
        WaveformView wv = laidOut();
        for (int i = 0; i < 9000; i++) wv.push(0.5f);
        assertTrue("count=" + wv.historyCount(),
                wv.historyCount() <= 8192);
        assertTrue(wv.minimumZoom() < 0.5f);
        // The floor covers all of MAX_HISTORY (75/8192 = 0.92%).
        assertTrue(wv.minimumZoom() >= 0.005f);
    }

    @Test
    public void minimumZoomReachesWholeHistory() {
        WaveformView wv = laidOut();
        for (int i = 0; i < 8192; i++) wv.push(0.5f);
        // 75/8192 = 0.92%: the old 2% floor could only fit ~45% of this.
        assertTrue("min=" + wv.minimumZoom(),
                wv.minimumZoom() < 0.02f);
        assertTrue("min=" + wv.minimumZoom(),
                wv.minimumZoom() >= 0.005f);
    }

    @Test
    public void parkedAtMinimumFollowsHistoryGrowth() {
        WaveformView wv = laidOut();
        for (int i = 0; i < 4000; i++) wv.push(0.5f);
        wv.setZoom(wv.minimumZoom());
        assertTrue(wv.isFollowingMinZoom());
        float before = wv.getZoom();
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) wv.push(0.5f);
        assertTrue("zoom did not track the sinking floor",
                wv.getZoom() < before);
        assertEquals(wv.minimumZoom(), wv.getZoom(), 0.0001f);
    }
}

#!/bin/sh

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/subprojects/plugins/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && pwd -P ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 "-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
# Exercises the real MediaCodec/MediaMuxer path ON THIS PHONE and reports
# which save format kills the app. No network, no ssh required.
#
#   bash run_diag.sh <IP:PORT> <PAIR_IP:PAIR_PORT>
# Both values are shown in Settings > Developer options > Wireless debugging.
set -u

# Locate this script's folder even if invoked from elsewhere.
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null && pwd)"
if [ ! -f "$DIR/app-debug.apk" ]; then
  DIR="$(find /storage /mnt/sdcard /sdcard "$HOME" -maxdepth 6 -name 'app-debug-androidTest.apk' 2>/dev/null | head -1 | xargs -r dirname)"
fi
[ -z "${DIR:-}" ] && { echo "ERROR: can't locate the APKs"; exit 1; }
cd "$DIR" || exit 1
echo "== working in $DIR"

IPPORT="${1:-}"; PAIR="${2:-}"
if [ -z "$IPPORT" ] || [ -z "$PAIR" ]; then
  echo "usage: bash run_diag.sh <IP:PORT> <PAIR_IP:PAIR_PORT>"
  echo "(both shown under Settings > Developer options > Wireless debugging)"
  exit 1
fi

if ! command -v adb >/dev/null; then
  echo "== installing android-tools"
  pkg install -y android-tools || pkg install -y adb || { echo "ERROR: adb unavailable"; exit 1; }
fi
adb version | head -1

echo "== pairing $PAIR"
adb pair "$PAIR" 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "== connecting $IPPORT"
adb connect "$IPPORT" 2>&1 | tail -2
adb wait-for-device || { echo "ERROR: adb never connected"; exit 1; }
echo "== device: $(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r') / Android $(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r') (API $(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'))"

echo "== installing APKs"
adb install -r -t app-debug.apk 2>&1 | tail -1
adb install -r -t app-debug-androidTest.apk 2>&1 | tail -1

echo "== running every encoder (this is the test)"
adb logcat -c
timeout 900 adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.example.hello.EncodeFormatsTest \
  com.example.hello.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner 2>&1

echo "== FORMAT RESULTS"
adb logcat -d -s ENCFMT:* 2>&1 | grep -E "PASS|Exception|Error" | tail -40
echo "== CRASH BUFFER"
adb logcat -d -b crash 2>&1 | tail -60
echo "== DONE"

=================================================================================
TAKEONE DSP PIPELINE & PARAMETER BUG FIXES (17 MODIFIED JAVA FILES)
Base Commit: 5f6c767 (branch: verify/fx-matrix)
=================================================================================

OVERVIEW OF FIXES INCLUDED IN THIS FILE
---------------------------------------
1. EditEngine.java & FxPreviewPeaks.java (Two-Pass Pre-Scan State + Offline Mix Tail)
   - Root cause: EditEngine.applyDspToRange() and FxPreviewPeaks.renderRegion()
     called chain.reset() immediately AFTER chain.prepareOffline(), wiping out
     scanned = true on AmplifyProcessor, NormalizeProcessor, and
     LoudnessNormalizationProcessor before processInPlace() ran.
   - Fix: Call chain.reset() BEFORE chain.prepareOffline(). Also call
     prepareOffline() in FxPreviewPeaks.render(), and scale the post-common tail
     by mix in EditEngine.applyLengthChangingEffectToRange() when mix < 0.999f.

2. AmplifyProcessor.java (amp_peak and amp_clip)
   - Root cause: When scanned was false (or when amp_gain was 0 dB while amp_peak
     was adjusted), amp_peak ("New Peak") and amp_clip ("Allow Clipping") had
     zero effect.
   - Fix: Compute effective gain from both amp_gain and amp_peak ceiling in both
     two-pass (prepareOffline) and single-pass (processInPlace) paths, and mark
     isAudible() true when either amp_gain or amp_peak is non-zero.

3. NormalizeProcessor.java (norm_rms, norm_indep, and +13.68 dBFS overshoot)
   - Root cause: Wiping scanned = false forced NormalizeProcessor into
     runRealtime(), whose decaying peak tracker boosted room noise by +40 dB
     (overshooting Take 2 to +13.68 dBFS) and ignored norm_rms and norm_indep.
   - Fix: Preserve scanned = true from prepareOffline(), and compute exact per-
     channel DC offset, Peak, and RMS with independent/linked channel support
     when !scanned.

4. LoudnessNormalizationProcessor.java (loud_mode LUFS vs. RMS dBFS)
   - Root cause: When !scanned, processInPlace() fell back to runRealtime(),
     which ignored loud_mode ("Perceived Loudness (LUFS)" vs. "RMS dBFS").
   - Fix: Preserve scanned = true from prepareOffline(), and evaluate
     measureRmsDbfs() vs. measureIntegratedLufs() according to loud_mode when
     !scanned.

5. BrickwallLimiterProcessor.java (lim_release 100% dead code)
   - Root cause: gainDb stores positive attenuation in dB (applied via
     Dsp.dbToLin(-gainDb)), but the release branch had an inverted sign clamp
     `if (gainDb > 0f) gainDb = 0f;`, zeroing gainDb on the very first sample
     after holdCounter expired and bypassing relCoef (lim_release).
   - Fix: Change the clamp to `if (gainDb < 0f) gainDb = 0f;`.

6. CompressorProcessor.java (dyncomp_floor "Noise Floor" no-op)
   - Root cause: In downward compression, targetGain is always <= 0 dB (and 0 dB
     below threshold), so `if (levelDb < floorDb && targetGain > -0.01f)
     targetGain = 0f;` was a no-op while makeupDb still boosted noise below
     floorDb.
   - Fix: Freeze avgReductionDb accumulation and attenuate makeupDb when
     levelDb < floorDb.

7. ChangeTempoProcessor.java & SlidingStretchProcessor.java (Inverted % Tempo Sign)
   - Root cause: WsolaTimePitchProcessor.timeStretch(in, frames, channels, rate)
     sets outFrames = frames * rate (rate = 2.0 means twice as long / half
     tempo). ChangeTempoProcessor.stretchFactor() returned `1.0 + pct / 100.0`
     for tempo_percent (making +25% tempo 25% longer/slower instead of faster,
     opposite to bpmFrom/bpmTo). SlidingStretchProcessor had the same inversion
     on slide_init and slide_final.
   - Fix: Use `1.0 / Math.max(0.20, 1.0 + pct / 100.0)` in both processors.

8. PaulstretchProcessor.java (outHop >> fftSize leaving 83%-96% dead zeros)
   - Root cause: fftSize was hardcoded to 4096 (85 ms) while hop = resolution *
     sampleRate (12,000) and outHop = hop * stretch (24,000..96,000), leaving
     83%-96% of the output buffer as zeros (-27.7 dB RMS loss), and window
     coordinate x ran over [0, 1] instead of symmetric [-1, 1].
   - Fix: Derive power-of-two fftSize from resolution (paul_res), set synthesis
     outHop = fftSize / 2 (50% overlap-add), advance input by inStep = outHop /
     stretch, and compute symmetric window x = 2*i/(fftSize - 1) - 1 in [-1, 1].

9. RepairProcessor.java (LPC +41.06 dBFS blow-up and repair_len clamp)
   - Root cause: lpcCoefficients() used unwindowed, unbiased autocorrelation
     r[k] = sum / (n - k), which is not guaranteed positive-definite and caused
     Levinson-Durbin recursion to generate unstable poles (113.05 peak on
     Take 2). Also, line 182 clamped `Math.min(maxFrames / 2, 16)`, making
     repair_len invariant across 1..50 ms in spike-repair mode.
   - Fix: Apply a Hann window, use biased autocorrelation `r[k] = sum / n` with
     diagonal loading, clamp reflection coefficients |k| <= 0.98, bound output
     to the local context peak, and scale the repair window with maxFrames.

10. ClickRemovalProcessor.java, ProDeEsserProcessor.java, StereoImagingProcessor.java,
    ParametricEq6BandProcessor.java, AudioGeneratorTool.java, PhaserProcessor.java,
    TremoloProcessor.java, WahwahProcessor.java
    - ClickRemovalProcessor: Scale prediction/context span and bridge window with
      click_width so click_width (1..40 ms) actively controls spike removal.
    - ProDeEsserProcessor: Calibrate threshDb = -3.0f - 18.0f * amount so default
      Reduction = 45% triggers on natural vocal sibilance in Take 2.
    - StereoImagingProcessor: Add mono-compatible imaging projection when ch == 1
      instead of returning immediately on `if (ch < 2) return;`.
    - ParametricEq6BandProcessor: Rename b1s to "Low Cut Slope" and b6s to
      "High Cut Slope" to eliminate the duplicate "Cut Slope" UI control label.
    - AudioGeneratorTool: Map all 5 gen_wave enum indices to distinct noise
      types (White, Pink, Brown, Blue, Velvet) when gen_type == "Noise".
    - PhaserProcessor / TremoloProcessor / WahwahProcessor: Set LFO phase maxRaw
      to 355 deg (step 5 deg) so maxRaw does not alias onto 0 deg (360 mod 360).

package com.example.hello;

/**
 * Stage 4 level tool: linear gain with an automatic non-clipping peak
 * pre-scan.
 *
 * &lt;p&gt;The offline pass measures the true peak of the range first
 * ({@link #prepareOffline}); the render pass then applies the gain, clamped
 * so the result never exceeds {@code newPeakDbFS} unless the user explicitly
 * allows clipping.
 */
final class AmplifyProcessor extends AudioProcessor {

    private final FxParameter gain = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "amp_gain", "Amplification", -50f, 50f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter newPeak = addParameter(FxParameter.dbParam(
            "amp_peak", "New Peak", -50f, 12f, 0f));
    private final FxParameter allowClip = addParameter(FxParameter.boolParam(
            "amp_clip", "Allow Clipping", false));

    private float appliedGainDb = 0f;
    private float measuredPeakDb = -120f;
    private boolean scanned = false;

    AmplifyProcessor() {
    }

    @Override
    public String getId() {
        return "amplify";
    }

    @Override
    public String getTitle() {
        return "Amplify";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDescription() {
        return "Linear gain with an automatic non-clipping peak scan";
    }

    @Override
    public FxCategory getCategory() {
        return FxCategory.DYNAMICS;
    }

    @Override
    public void prepare(int sampleRate, int channels) {
    }

    @Override
    public void reset() {
        appliedGainDb = 0f;
        scanned = false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAudible() {
        return isEnabled() && (Math.abs(gain.getFloat()) > 0.01f
                || Math.abs(newPeak.getFloat()) > 0.01f);
    }

    private float computeEffectiveGainDb(float peakDb) {
        float requested = gain.getFloat();
        float ceiling = newPeak.getFloat();
        float maxAllowed = ceiling - peakDb;
        if (Math.abs(requested) <= 0.01f && Math.abs(ceiling) > 0.01f) {
            requested = maxAllowed;
        }
        if (!allowClip.getBoolean() && requested > maxAllowed) {
            requested = maxAllowed;
        }
        return requested;
    }

    /**
     * Scans the range for its true peak so the render pass can clamp the
     * requested gain to a non-clipping value.
     */
    @Override
    public void prepareOffline(java.io.File raw, long startFrame, long endFrame,
                               int sampleRate, int channels) throws Exception {
        if (raw == null) return;
        float[] sel = EditEngine.readFloatSelection(raw, startFrame, endFrame);
        if (sel == null || sel.length == 0) return;
        float peak = 0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
            float a = Math.abs(sel[i]);
            if (a > peak) peak = a;
        }
        measuredPeakDb = Dsp.linToDb(Math.max(1e-6f, peak));
        appliedGainDb = computeEffectiveGainDb(measuredPeakDb);
        scanned = true;
    }

    @Override
    public void processInPlace(float[] buf, int frames, int channels) {
        if (buf == null || frames <= 0) return;
        int n = Math.min(buf.length, frames * Math.max(1, Math.min(2, channels)));
        float db;
        if (scanned) {
            db = appliedGainDb;
        } else {
            float peak = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                float a = Math.abs(buf[i]);
                if (a > peak) peak = a;
            }
            db = computeEffectiveGainDb(Dsp.linToDb(Math.max(1e-6f, peak)));
        }
        if (Math.abs(db) <= 1e-4f) return;
        float g = Dsp.dbToLin(db);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) buf[i] *= g;
    }
}
