================================================================================
package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.MediaCodec;
import android.media.MediaExtractor;
import android.media.MediaFormat;
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Decodes a library take (float/16-bit WAV, M4A/AAC, …) into a fresh 32-bit
 * float WAV session file so the studio can punch in from its end. The
 * original file is never touched.
 */
public final class AudioImporter {

    public interface Progress {
        void onProgress(int percent);
    }

    /** Metadata and stored file returned by {@link #importOriginal}. */
    public static final class ImportedAudio {
        public final File file;
        public final long durationMs;
        public final String title;
        public final String badge;

        public ImportedAudio(File file, long durationMs, String title,
                             String badge) {
            this.file = file;
            this.durationMs = durationMs;
            this.title = title;
            this.badge = badge;
        }
    }

    /** Bound on draining a decoder that never signals end of stream. */
    private static final long DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000L;

    private AudioImporter() {}

    /**
     * True when {@code src} is already a 48 kHz 32-bit IEEE float mono/stereo
     * WAV, so preparing an edit session is a straight byte copy rather than a
     * format conversion.
     */
    public static boolean isNativeFloatWav(File src) {
        if (src == null || !src.exists()) return false;
        try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r")) {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            return h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32
                    && h.sampleRate == RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE
                    && (h.channels == 1 || h.channels == 2)
                    && h.dataStart == 44L
                    && Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart) > 0;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Copies a user-selected SAF document directly into the takes directory
     * in its original container/format without converting it to 32-bit float.
     * Its 32-bit float master is created lazily the first time the user
     * presses Edit on the imported take.
     */
    public static ImportedAudio importOriginal(Context ctx,
                                               android.net.Uri uri,
                                               File targetDir) throws Exception {
        if (ctx == null || uri == null || targetDir == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing import source");
        }
        String display = queryDisplayName(ctx, uri);
        String ext = extensionOf(display);
        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
            ext = extensionFromMime(ctx, uri);
        }
        if (ext.isEmpty()) {
            ext = "m4a";
        }
        String rawTitle = stripExtension(display != null ? display
                : "Imported_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
        String cleanBase = rawTitle.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
        if (cleanBase.isEmpty()) cleanBase = "Imported";
        String prettyTitle = Dsp.prettyFileTitle(cleanBase + "." + ext);
        if (prettyTitle.isEmpty()) prettyTitle = cleanBase;

        File dst = uniqueImportedFile(targetDir, cleanBase, ext);
        try {
            try (java.io.InputStream in =
                         ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                 java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                         new java.io.FileOutputStream(dst)) {
                if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("cannot open uri");
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
                out.getFD().sync();
            }
            if (!dst.exists() || dst.length() <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("empty import");
            }
            long durMs;
            String badge;
            if ("wav".equals(ext)) {
                try (RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "r")) {
                    Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
                    if (h.channels < 1 || h.channels > 2 || h.sampleRate <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav");
                    }
                    long onDisk = Math.max(0L, r.length() - h.dataStart);
                    if (onDisk <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("empty wav");
                    }
                }
                durMs = Math.max(1000L, Dsp.wavDurationMs(dst));
                badge = TakesRepository.wavBadge(dst);
            } else {
                durMs = probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(dst);
                badge = badgeForExtension(dst, ext);
            }
            return new ImportedAudio(dst, durMs, prettyTitle, badge);
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
    }

    private static File uniqueImportedFile(File dir, String base, String ext) {
        String stamp = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",
                Locale.US).format(new java.util.Date());
        File c = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + "." + ext);
        if (!c.exists()) return c;
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            File n = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + " (" + i + ")." + ext);
            if (!n.exists()) return n;
            i++;
        }
    }

    private static String extensionFromMime(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri) {
        try {
            String mime = ctx.getContentResolver().getType(uri);
            if (mime == null) return "";
            String lower = mime.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
            if (lower.contains("wav")) return "wav";
            if (lower.contains("flac")) return "flac";
            if (lower.contains("opus")) return "opus";
            if (lower.contains("ogg")) return "ogg";
            if (lower.contains("mpeg") || lower.contains("mp3")) return "mp3";
            if (lower.contains("3gpp") || lower.contains("amr")) return "3gp";
            if (lower.contains("aac")) return "aac";
            if (lower.contains("mp4") || lower.contains("m4a")) return "m4a";
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return "";
    }

    private static String badgeForExtension(File f, String ext) {
        switch (ext.toLowerCase(Locale.US)) {
            case "wav":
                return TakesRepository.wavBadge(f);
            case "m4a":
            case "aac":
                return "M4A";
            case "flac":
                return "FLAC";
            case "opus":
            case "webm":
            case "ogg":
                return "OPUS";
            case "3gp":
            case "3ga":
                return TakesRepository.containsToken(
                        f, new byte[]{'s', 'a', 'w', 'b'}) ? "AMR-WB" : "AMR";
            case "mp3":
                return "MP3";
            default:
                return ext.toUpperCase(Locale.US);
        }
    }

    private static long probeCompressedDurationAndValidate(File src)
            throws Exception {
        long durationMs = -1L;
        boolean hasAudio = false;
        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
        try {
            ex.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
            for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
                MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
                String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
                if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
                    hasAudio = true;
                    try {
                        if (f.containsKey(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)) {
                            durationMs = f.getLong(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION)
                                    / 1000L;
                        }
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    break;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            try {
                ex.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (!hasAudio || durationMs <= 0) {
            MediaMetadataRetriever mmr = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
            try {
                mmr.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
                String has = mmr.extractMetadata(
                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_HAS_AUDIO);
                String dur = mmr.extractMetadata(
                        MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
                if (has != null && !has.isEmpty()) {
                    hasAudio = true;
                }
                if (dur != null) {
                    long parsed = (long) Double.parseDouble(dur);
                    if (parsed > 0) {
                        hasAudio = true;
                        durationMs = parsed;
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                try {
                    mmr.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (!hasAudio) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track");
        }
        return Math.max(1000L, durationMs);
    }

    /**
     * Imports a user-selected SAF document into the takes directory as a
     * 32-bit float WAV edit master. Supports WAV PCM/float and any container
     * the platform decoder can turn into PCM (M4A/AAC, MP3, OGG/Opus, FLAC,
     * AMR, …). Throws when no decodable audio is present.
     */
    public static File importToFloatWav(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri,
                                        File targetDir) throws Exception {
        if (ctx == null || uri == null || targetDir == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing import source");
        }
        String display = queryDisplayName(ctx, uri);
        String ext = extensionOf(display);
        File temp = File.createTempFile("takeone_import_",
                ext.isEmpty() ? ".audio" : "." + ext, ctx.getCacheDir());
        try {
            try (java.io.InputStream in =
                         ctx.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                 java.io.FileOutputStream out =
                         new java.io.FileOutputStream(temp)) {
                if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("cannot open uri");
                byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                int n;
                while ((n = in.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
            }
            String base = stripExtension(display != null ? display
                    : "Imported_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
            base = base.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").trim();
            if (base.isEmpty()) base = "Imported";
            return takeToFloatWav(temp, targetDir, base, null);
        } finally {
            // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            temp.delete();
        }
    }

    private static String queryDisplayName(Context ctx, android.net.Uri uri) {
        try (android.database.Cursor c = ctx.getContentResolver().query(uri,
                new String[]{android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME},
                null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                int idx = c.getColumnIndex(
                        android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                if (idx >= 0) return c.getString(idx);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    private static String extensionOf(String name) {
        if (name == null) return "";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (dot < 0 || dot == name.length() - 1) return "";
        return name.substring(dot + 1).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
    }

    private static String stripExtension(String name) {
        if (name == null) return "Imported";
        int dot = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        return dot > 0 ? name.substring(0, dot) : name;
    }

    /**
     * @param dstParent   directory for the new session file (takes dir).
     * @param baseName    sanitized take title used for the session file name.
     * @return the new float WAV session file (without a pending marker —
     * callers attach it via the engine, which writes the marker).
     */
    public static File takeToFloatWav(File src, File dstParent, String baseName,
                                      Progress cb) throws Exception {
        String lower = src.getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.US);
        File dst = uniqueSession(dstParent, baseName);
        try {
            if (lower.endsWith(".wav")) {
                wavToFloatWav(src, dst, cb);
            } else {
                compressedToFloatWav(src, dst, cb);
            }
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            // A4-05: the session file lives in takes/ and starts with a
            // header. If decoding throws, a truncated float WAV would be
            // sitting there with no .pending marker, and the next launch
            // would adopt it into the library as a take full of noise.
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        // FMT-02d: validation lives inside the try so a malformed import
        // deletes its output too; otherwise the orphan is adopted on the
        // next launch by reconcile().
        try {
            // Importer output preserves the source geometry (mono stays
            // mono); callers attach the session with these exact channels.
            FormatConverter.WavInfo info = FormatConverter.readFloatWav(dst);
            if (info.channels < 1 || info.channels > 2
                    || info.sampleRate != RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("bad import channels/rate");
            }
            if (info.dataBytes <= 0) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("empty import");
            }
        } catch (Exception | Error e) {
            try {
                if (dst.exists()) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    dst.delete();
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            throw e;
        }
        if (cb != null) cb.onProgress(100);
        return dst;
    }

    private static File uniqueSession(File dir, String base) {
        String stamp = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",
                java.util.Locale.US).format(new java.util.Date());
        File c = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + ".raw.wav");
        if (!c.exists()) return c;
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            File n = new File(dir, base + "_" + stamp + " (" + i
                    + ").raw.wav");
            if (!n.exists()) return n;
            i++;
        }
    }

    // ---- WAV sources ----

    private static void wavToFloatWav(File src, File dst, Progress cb) throws Exception {
        RandomAccessFile r = new RandomAccessFile(src, "r");
        try {
            Dsp.WavHeader h = Dsp.parseWavHeader(r);
            int ch = h.channels;
            int sr = h.sampleRate;
            if (ch < 1 || ch > 2) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav (need mono/stereo)");
            }
            int bytesPerSample;
            if (h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32) bytesPerSample = 4;
            else if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 16) bytesPerSample = 2;
            else if (h.audioFormat == 1 && h.bits == 24) bytesPerSample = 3;
            else throw new IllegalStateException("unsupported wav encoding");
            long onDisk = Math.max(0, r.length() - h.dataStart);
            long dataBytes = h.dataBytes;
            if (dataBytes <= 0 || dataBytes > onDisk) dataBytes = onDisk;
            long totalSrcFrames = dataBytes / bytesPerSample / ch;
            if (totalSrcFrames <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("empty wav");
            // Fast path: source is already 48 kHz 32-bit IEEE float WAV.
            // Copy raw payload bytes directly without unpacking floats or
            // running Dsp.Resampler.
            if (h.audioFormat == 3 && h.bits == 32
                    && sr == RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE) {
                long payloadBytes = totalSrcFrames * ch * 4L;
                try (RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw")) {
                    w.setLength(0);
                    w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, payloadBytes));
                    r.seek(h.dataStart);
                    byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
                    long left = payloadBytes;
                    while (left > 0) {
                        int n = r.read(buf, 0,
                                (int) Math.min(buf.length, left));
                        if (n <= 0) break;
                        w.write(buf, 0, n);
                        left -= n;
                    }
                    long actual = Math.max(0L, w.length() - 44L);
                    if (actual != payloadBytes) {
                        w.seek(0);
                        w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, actual));
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
            // Mono stays mono; foreign rates are resampled to the session
            // rate instead of being stamped with a lying header.
            Dsp.Resampler resampler =
                    new Dsp.Resampler(sr, RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE, ch);
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, 0));
                // Seek explicitly to the parsed data chunk start (NEW-01).
                r.seek(h.dataStart);
                byte[] in = new byte[32768 * 2 * 4];
                ByteBuffer ib = ByteBuffer.wrap(in)
                        .order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                float[] fbuf = new float[32768 * 2];
                long done = 0;
                long payloadBytes = 0;
                int lastPct = -1;
                while (done < totalSrcFrames) {
                    int want = (int) Math.min(32768, totalSrcFrames - done);
                    // NEW-01 fix: `want` is in frames, so read `want * ch`
                    // samples (`samplesToRead * bytesPerSample` bytes).
                    int samplesToRead = want * ch;
                    float[] samples;
                    if (h.audioFormat == 3) {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 4);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 4);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            fbuf[i] = ib.getFloat();
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    } else if (h.bits == 24) {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 3);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 3);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            int v = (ib.get() & 0xFF)
                                    | ((ib.get() & 0xFF) << 8)
                                    | (ib.get() << 16);
                            if ((v & 0x800000) != 0) v |= 0xFF000000;
                            fbuf[i] = v / 8388608f;
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    } else {
                        r.readFully(in, 0, samplesToRead * 2);
                        ib.clear();
                        ib.limit(samplesToRead * 2);
                        for (int i = 0; i < samplesToRead; i++) {
                            fbuf[i] = ib.getShort() / 32768f;
                        }
                        samples = resampler.push(fbuf, want);
                    }
                    int outFrames = samples.length / ch;
                    if (outFrames > 0) {
                        Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, samples, 0, samples.length);
                        payloadBytes += (long) outFrames * ch * 4;
                    }
                    done += want;
                    if (cb != null) {
                        int pct = (int) (done * 100
                                / Math.max(1, totalSrcFrames));
                        if (pct != lastPct) {
                            lastPct = pct;
                            cb.onProgress(pct);
                        }
                    }
                }
                float[] tail = resampler.flush();
                if (tail.length > 0) {
                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, tail, 0, tail.length);
                    payloadBytes += tail.length * 4L;
                }
                w.seek(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(ch, payloadBytes));
            } finally {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                r.close();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }


    private static int pcmBytesPerSample(int encoding) {
        switch (encoding) {
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_8BIT:
                return 1;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED:
                return 3;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_32BIT:
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT:
                return 4;
            default:
                return 2;
        }
    }

    private static float readPcmSample(ByteBuffer b, int encoding) {
        switch (encoding) {
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_8BIT:
                return ((b.get() & 0xff) - 128) / 128f;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_24BIT_PACKED: {
                int b0 = b.get() & 0xff;
                int b1 = b.get() & 0xff;
                int b2 = b.get();
                int v = (b2 << 16) | (b1 << 8) | b0;
                return v / 8388608f;
            }
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_32BIT:
                return b.getInt() / 2147483648f;
            case android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT:
                return b.getFloat();
            default:
                return b.getShort() / 32768f;
        }
    }

    // ---- compressed sources (M4A/AAC/MP3/…) via platform decoder ----

    private static void compressedToFloatWav(File src, File dst, Progress cb)
            throws Exception {
        MediaExtractor ex = new MediaExtractor();
        try {
            ex.setDataSource(src.getAbsolutePath());
            int track = -1;
            MediaFormat trackFmt = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < ex.getTrackCount(); i++) {
                MediaFormat f = ex.getTrackFormat(i);
                String mime = f.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
                if (mime != null && mime.startsWith("audio/")) {
                    track = i;
                    trackFmt = f;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (track < 0 || trackFmt == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("no audio track");
            }
            int srcCh = 2;
            try {
                srcCh = trackFmt.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            int srcRate = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
            try {
                srcRate = trackFmt.getInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (srcRate <= 0) srcRate = RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE;
            long durationUs = 0;
            try {
                durationUs = trackFmt.getLong(MediaFormat.KEY_DURATION);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            String mime = trackFmt.getString(MediaFormat.KEY_MIME);
            ex.selectTrack(track);

            // Mono stays mono (downmix only beyond stereo); the rate is
            // resampled to the session rate instead of being stamped with a
            // lying 48 kHz header.
            int outCh = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, srcCh));
            Dsp.Resampler resampler =
                    new Dsp.Resampler(srcRate, RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE,
                            outCh);

            MediaCodec dec = MediaCodec.createDecoderByType(mime);
            // A4-05/FMT-02a: pin the decoder output to 16-bit PCM. Set it on
            // the track format directly: MediaFormat's copy constructor only
            // exists from API 29, so `new MediaFormat(trackFmt)` threw
            // NoSuchMethodError (an Error, not caught below) on API 24-28.
            try {
                trackFmt.setInteger(MediaFormat.KEY_PCM_ENCODING,
                        android.media.AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            dec.configure(trackFmt, null, null, 0);
            dec.start();
            RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(dst, "rw");
            boolean muxed = false;
            try {
                w.setLength(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(outCh, 0));
                float[] fbuf = new float[16384 * 2];
                MediaCodec.BufferInfo bi = new MediaCodec.BufferInfo();
                boolean inEos = false;
                boolean outEos = false;
                long payloadBytes = 0;
                int lastPct = -1;
                // FMT-02c: bound the post-EOS drain. An OEM decoder that
                // never emits END_OF_STREAM otherwise hangs the import
                // dialog forever.
                int pcmEncoding = android.media.AudioFormat
                        .ENCODING_PCM_16BIT;
                long drainDeadline = 0;
                while (!outEos) {
                    if (!inEos) {
                        int idx = dec.dequeueInputBuffer(5000);
                        if (idx >= 0) {
                            ByteBuffer ib = dec.getInputBuffer(idx);
                            int n = ex.readSampleData(ib, 0);
                            if (n < 0) {
                                dec.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, 0, 0,
                                        MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM);
                                inEos = true;
                                drainDeadline = android.os.SystemClock
                                        .elapsedRealtime() + DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS;
                            } else {
                                dec.queueInputBuffer(idx, 0, n,
                                        ex.getSampleTime(), 0);
                                ex.advance();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    int oidx = dec.dequeueOutputBuffer(bi, 5000);
                    if (oidx >= 0) {
                        if (bi.size > 0) {
                            ByteBuffer ob = dec.getOutputBuffer(oidx);
                            // NEW-02 fix: MediaCodec output ByteBuffers
                            // default to BIG_ENDIAN; set LITTLE_ENDIAN so
                            // getShort() does not byte-swap PCM samples.
                            ob.order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                            ob.position(bi.offset);
                            ob.limit(bi.offset + bi.size);
                            // Decoder PCM is 16-bit: convert to float, then
                            // resample onto the session grid.
                            // FMT-02b: KEY_PCM_ENCODING is only a hint. If
                            // the decoder still reports float output, read
                            // 4-byte samples; reading them as shorts byte-swaps
                            // and doubles the apparent duration.
                            final int pcmEnc = pcmEncoding;
                            final int bytesPerSample = pcmBytesPerSample(pcmEnc);
                            int samples = bi.size / bytesPerSample;
                            int frames = samples / Math.max(1, srcCh);
                            int fpos = 0;
                            for (int f = 0; f < frames; f++) {
                                float s0 = readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc);
                                float s1 = srcCh > 1
                                        ? readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc) : s0;
                                // Skip any extra channels beyond stereo.
                                for (int c = 2; c < srcCh; c++) {
                                    readPcmSample(ob, pcmEnc);
                                }
                                if (outCh == 1) {
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = srcCh > 1
                                            ? (s0 + s1) * 0.5f : s0;
                                } else {
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = s0;
                                    fbuf[fpos++] = s1;
                                }
                                if (fpos + 2 > fbuf.length) {
                                    float[] conv = resampler.push(fbuf,
                                            fpos / outCh);
                                    if (conv.length > 0) {
                                        Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, conv, 0,
                                                conv.length);
                                        payloadBytes += conv.length * 4L;
                                    }
                                    fpos = 0;
                                }
                            }
                            if (fpos > 0) {
                                float[] conv = resampler.push(fbuf,
                                        fpos / outCh);
                                if (conv.length > 0) {
                                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, conv, 0, conv.length);
                                    payloadBytes += conv.length * 4L;
                                }
                            }
                            if (cb != null && durationUs > 0) {
                                int pct = (int) (bi.presentationTimeUs * 100
                                        / Math.max(1, durationUs));
                                pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(99, pct));
                                if (pct != lastPct) {
                                    lastPct = pct;
                                    cb.onProgress(pct);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        dec.releaseOutputBuffer(oidx, false);
                        if ((bi.flags & MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM) != 0) {
                            outEos = true;
                        }
                    } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_TRY_AGAIN_LATER) {
                        if (inEos && android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                                > drainDeadline) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException(
                                    "decoder never finished");
                        }
                    } else if (oidx == MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED) {
                        try {
                            MediaFormat of = dec.getOutputFormat();
                            try {
                                pcmEncoding = of.getInteger(
                                        MediaFormat.KEY_PCM_ENCODING);
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            int newCh = of.getInteger(
                                    MediaFormat.KEY_CHANNEL_COUNT);
                            int newRate = srcRate;
                            try {
                                newRate = of.getInteger(
                                        MediaFormat.KEY_SAMPLE_RATE);
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            if (newCh >= 1 && newCh <= 8
                                    && newRate > 0) {
                                if (payloadBytes > 0
                                        && (newCh != srcCh
                                        || newRate != srcRate)) {
                                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                                            "decoder geometry changed mid-stream");
                                }
                                srcCh = newCh;
                                srcRate = newRate;
                                outCh = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, srcCh));
                                resampler = new Dsp.Resampler(srcRate,
                                        RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE, outCh);
                            }
                        } catch (IllegalStateException ise) {
                            throw ise;
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                    muxed = true;
                }
                float[] tail = resampler.flush();
                if (tail.length > 0) {
                    Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, tail, 0, tail.length);
                    payloadBytes += tail.length * 4L;
                }
                if (!muxed || payloadBytes <= 0) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("decode produced no audio");
                }
                w.seek(0);
                w.write(RecordingEngine.wavHeader(outCh, payloadBytes));
            } finally {
                try {
                    w.close();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                // Stop/release the decoder HERE, not after this block: any
                // throw inside the loop above must not skip them and leak
                // the native MediaCodec instance.
                try {
                    dec.stop();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    dec.release();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                ex.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }
}

public class LibraryFragment extends Fragment implements TakesAdapter.Listener {

    /** A4-12: focus holder for library playback; released in stopPlayback(). */
    private android.media.AudioManager playAudioManager;
    private android.media.AudioFocusRequest playFocusRequest;
    private android.media.AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener
            playFocusListener;

    /**
     * Lazily created (so its body can post to {@code handler}, which is
     * declared later in this class) listener that pauses library playback
     * when a call or another app takes audio focus.
     */
    private android.media.AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener
            playFocusListener() {
        if (playFocusListener == null) {
            playFocusListener = focus -> {
                if (focus == android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS
                        || focus == android.media.AudioManager
                                .AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT
                        || focus == android.media.AudioManager
                                .AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK) {
                    handler.post(this::pausePlayback);
                }
            };
        }
        return playFocusListener;
    }

    private static final int PLAY_FOCUS =
            android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK;

    /**
     * A4-12: library playback never asked for focus, so it could duck or
     * bleed into a live microphone take. Request transient-may-duck focus and
     * refuse while the studio is actually capturing.
     *
     * @return false when playback should not start.
     */
    private boolean acquirePlaybackFocus() {
        try {
            if (RecordingEngine.get().state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
                // Playing back through the speaker straight into an open mic.
                return false;
            }
            if (playAudioManager == null) {
                playAudioManager = (android.media.AudioManager)
                        requireContext().getApplicationContext()
                                .getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            }
            if (playAudioManager == null) return true;
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                playFocusRequest = new android.media.AudioFocusRequest.Builder(
                        PLAY_FOCUS)
                        .setAudioAttributes(new android.media.AudioAttributes
                                .Builder()
                                .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes
                                        .USAGE_MEDIA)
                                .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes
                                        .CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                                .build())
                        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(playFocusListener(),
                                handler)
                        .build();
                return playAudioManager.requestAudioFocus(playFocusRequest)
                        == android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
            }
            //noinspection deprecation
            return playAudioManager.requestAudioFocus(playFocusListener(),
                    android.media.AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC,
                    PLAY_FOCUS)
                    == android.media.AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    private void releasePlaybackFocus() {
        try {
            if (playAudioManager == null) return;
            if (playFocusRequest != null) {
                if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                    playAudioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(
                            playFocusRequest);
                }
                playFocusRequest = null;
            } else {
                //noinspection deprecation
                playAudioManager.abandonAudioFocus(playFocusListener());
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** A4-08: jobs cancelled by the user; their done-broadcast is not a failure. */
    private final Set<String> cancelledJobs =
            java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(
                    new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Boolean>());

    private enum Filter { ALL, FAV, DAY, WEEK, SHORT, WAV, FLAC, OPUS, AMR, M4A }
    private enum Sort { NEWEST, OLDEST, NAME, LONGEST, SHORTEST }

    private TakesAdapter adapter;
    private RecyclerView list;
    private TextView subtitle;
    private LinearLayout emptyState;
    private TextView emptyTitle;
    private TextView emptySub;
    private LinearLayout searchBar;
    private EditText searchInput;
    private ImageView searchClear;
    private LinearLayout normalHeader;
    private LinearLayout selectionBar;
    private TextView selCount;
    private TextView selAll;
    private ImageView selExport;
    private ImageView selDelete;
    private TextView[] chips;
    private Filter[] chipFilters;

    private String query = "";
    private Filter filter = Filter.ALL;
    private Sort sort = Sort.NEWEST;
    private List<Take> visible = new ArrayList<>();

    private final Set<Long> selection = new HashSet<>();
    private boolean selectionMode = false;

    // Playback: real file via MediaPlayer, raw preview via AudioTrack,
    // demo takes via simulated clock. No popups.
    /** Progress repaint cadence — 100ms + fine SeekBar steps = smooth motion. */
    private static final long PROGRESS_MS = 100;
    private MediaPlayer player;
    private long playingId = -1;
    private boolean playPaused = false;
    private boolean simMode = false;
    private boolean rawMode = false;
    private RawFloatPlayer rawPlayer;
    private long simBase = 0;
    private long simStartedAt = 0;
    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private BroadcastReceiver convReceiver;

    private long lastBackPress = 0;

    private ActivityResultLauncher<Uri> openTreeLauncher;
    private ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> openImportLauncher;
    private List<Take> pendingExportTakes;

    @Override
    public void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        openTreeLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
                new ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocumentTree(), uri -> {
                    List<Take> takes = pendingExportTakes;
                    pendingExportTakes = null;
                    if (uri == null || takes == null || takes.isEmpty()) return;
                    try {
                        requireContext().getContentResolver().takePersistableUriPermission(
                                uri, Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION
                                        | Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    exportTakesToFolder(takes, uri);
                });
        openImportLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
                new ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument(), uri -> {
                    if (uri != null) importAudio(uri);
                });
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container,
                             @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        return inflater.inflate(R.layout.fragment_library, container, false);
    }

    @Override
    public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View v, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        sort = loadSort();

        subtitle = v.findViewById(R.id.librarySubtitle);
        list = v.findViewById(R.id.takesList);
        emptyState = v.findViewById(R.id.emptyState);
        emptyTitle = v.findViewById(R.id.emptyTitle);
        emptySub = v.findViewById(R.id.emptySub);
        searchBar = v.findViewById(R.id.searchBar);
        searchInput = v.findViewById(R.id.searchInput);
        searchClear = v.findViewById(R.id.searchClear);
        normalHeader = v.findViewById(R.id.normalHeader);
        selectionBar = v.findViewById(R.id.selectionBar);
        selCount = v.findViewById(R.id.selCount);
        selAll = v.findViewById(R.id.selAll);
        selExport = v.findViewById(R.id.selExport);
        selDelete = v.findViewById(R.id.selDelete);

        chips = new TextView[]{
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipAll), v.findViewById(R.id.chipFav),
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipDay), v.findViewById(R.id.chipWeek),
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipShort), v.findViewById(R.id.chipWav),
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipFlac), v.findViewById(R.id.chipOpus),
                v.findViewById(R.id.chipAmr), v.findViewById(R.id.chipM4a)};
        chipFilters = new Filter[]{Filter.ALL, Filter.FAV, Filter.DAY, Filter.WEEK,
                Filter.SHORT, Filter.WAV, Filter.FLAC, Filter.OPUS, Filter.AMR,
                Filter.M4A};
        for (int i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
            final Filter f = chipFilters[i];
            chips[i].setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (filter == f) return;
                filter = f;
                paintChipsAnimated();
                view.animate().cancel();
                view.setScaleX(0.9f);
                view.setScaleY(0.9f);
                view.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(180).start();
                refresh();
            });
        }

        adapter = new TakesAdapter(this);
        list.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(requireContext()));
        // No item animations at all. The animator cannot survive a stable-id
        // sign flip (converting card -> finished take): it keeps animating a
        // holder that is never rebound, and change animations on top of
        // notifyDataSetChanged() also flickered cards on ordinary updates.
        list.setItemAnimator(null);
        list.setAdapter(adapter);

        v.findViewById(R.id.searchToggle).setOnClickListener(view -> toggleSearch());
        v.findViewById(R.id.sortBtn).setOnClickListener(this::showSortMenu);
        View importBtn = v.findViewById(R.id.importBtn);
        if (importBtn != null) {
            importBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (openImportLauncher != null) {
                    openImportLauncher.launch(new String[]{
                            "audio/*", "application/ogg"});
                }
            });
        }

        // Press feedback on every tappable header / selection control.
        PressAnim.apply(v.findViewById(R.id.searchToggle));
        PressAnim.apply(v.findViewById(R.id.sortBtn));
        if (importBtn != null) PressAnim.apply(importBtn);
        PressAnim.apply(v.findViewById(R.id.selClose));
        PressAnim.apply(selAll);
        PressAnim.apply(selExport);
        PressAnim.apply(selDelete);
        PressAnim.apply(searchClear);
        for (TextView chip : chips) PressAnim.apply(chip);

        searchInput.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int c, int a) {}
            @Override public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int st, int b, int c) {
                query = s.toString().trim().toLowerCase();
                searchClear.setVisibility(query.isEmpty() ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
                refresh();
            }
            @Override public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
        });
        searchInput.setOnEditorActionListener((tv, actionId, event) -> {
            if (actionId == EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_SEARCH) {
                hideKeyboard();
                searchInput.clearFocus();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        });
        searchClear.setOnClickListener(view -> searchInput.setText(""));

        v.findViewById(R.id.selClose).setOnClickListener(view -> exitSelection());
        selAll.setOnClickListener(view -> toggleSelectAll());
        selDelete.setOnClickListener(view -> deleteSelected());
        selExport.setOnClickListener(view -> showMassExportOptions());

        paintChips();
        refresh();

        // Registered LAST, on purpose. TakesRepository.onReady runs its
        // callback SYNCHRONOUSLY when the library is already loaded, and this
        // is reached on every return from the studio (repo is loaded) and on
        // any cold start where the load finished first. Registering before
        // the adapter exists meant refresh() ran with a null adapter and
        // NPE'd the whole process on the main thread.
        TakesRepository.init(requireContext());
        TakesRepository.onReady(() -> {
            if (isAdded() && getView() != null) refresh();
        });
    }

    private final TakesRepository.Listener repoListener = () -> {
        try {
            if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
            handler.post(() -> {
                if (!isAdded() || getView() == null || adapter == null) return;
                refreshImmediate();
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    };

    @Override
    public void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        TakesRepository.addListener(repoListener);
        ConversionJobs.addListener(jobsListener);
        registerConvReceiver();
        refresh();
    }

    @Override
    public void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        pauseForBackground();
        TakesRepository.removeListener(repoListener);
        ConversionJobs.removeListener(jobsListener);
        unregisterConvReceiver();
    }

    /**
     * Last live-job set that triggered a structural refresh. Must be declared
     * before {@link #jobsListener}, which reads it during initialization.
     */
    private String lastStructuralSig = "";

    private final ConversionJobs.Listener jobsListener = () -> {
        try {
            if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
            handler.post(() -> {
                if (!isAdded() || getView() == null || adapter == null) return;
                // Structural change (job added/finished/cancelled) needs a
                // full rebind; bare progress ticks only repaint their rows.
                Set<Long> shown = new HashSet<>();
                for (Take t : visible) {
                    if (t.converting) shown.add(t.id);
                }
                Set<Long> live = new HashSet<>();
                for (ConversionJob j : ConversionJobs.active()) {
                    live.add(j.takeId());
                }
                if (!shown.equals(live)) {
                    // A conversion finishing is not a routine structural tick:
                    // the raw it was previewing from is gone, so tear the
                    // preview down first and skip the 500ms debounce that
                    // would otherwise leave a dead, clickable card on screen.
                    //
                    // Only act on a real transition, though. This condition can
                    // hold continuously (a job whose card the active filter
                    // hides, or a job left QUEUED with no worker), and
                    // refreshing on every progress tick then rebinds the whole
                    // list hundreds of times: the UI thread never goes idle,
                    // which starves accessibility queries. One refresh per
                    // distinct set of live jobs is the whole requirement.
                    String sig = new java.util.TreeSet<>(live).toString();
                    if (!sig.equals(lastStructuralSig)) {
                        lastStructuralSig = sig;
                        if (rawMode && playingId != -1) {
                            Take cur = findVisible(playingId);
                            if (cur != null && cur.converting
                                    && ConversionJobs.forTakeId(
                                            playingId) == null) {
                                stopPlayback();
                            }
                        }
                        refreshImmediate();
                    }
                    return;
                }
                lastStructuralSig = "";
                for (Take t : visible) {
                    if (!t.converting) continue;
                    ConversionJob j = ConversionJobs.forTakeId(t.id);
                    if (j == null) continue;
                    int pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, j.progress));
                    if (pct == t.convProgress) continue;
                    t.convProgress = pct;
                    String status = null;
                    try {
                        status = getString(R.string.conv_card_status,
                                t.convFormat, pct);
                        t.dateLabel = status;
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    // Direct holder paint: no notify calls on the progress
                    // hot path, so rapid ticks can never race a layout pass.
                    // Off-screen rows pick the values up on their next bind.
                    if (adapter != null && list != null) {
                        try {
                            adapter.paintConvProgress(list, t.id, pct, status);
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                }
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    };

    private void registerConvReceiver() {
        if (convReceiver != null) return;
        try {
            convReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
                @Override
                public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                    String action = intent.getAction();
                    if (RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE.equals(action)) {
                        handler.post(() -> {
                            if (!isAdded()) return;
                            refreshImmediate();
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!ConversionService.BROADCAST_CONVERSION_DONE.equals(
                            action)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    boolean ok = intent.getBooleanExtra(
                            ConversionService.EXTRA_OK, false);
                    String jobId = intent.getStringExtra(
                            ConversionService.EXTRA_JOB_ID);
                    String msg = intent.getStringExtra(
                            ConversionService.EXTRA_MESSAGE);
                    handler.post(() -> {
                        if (!isAdded()) return;
                        // Stop only when this job's own raw preview ends; an
                        // unrelated completed conversion must not interrupt
                        // playback of another take's raw.
                        if (rawMode && jobId != null) {
                            Take cur = findVisible(playingId);
                            if (cur != null && jobId.equals(cur.convJobId)) {
                                stopPlayback();
                            }
                        }
                        requestStructuralRefresh();
                        if (ok) {
                            // Studio already shows the 2-word "Take saved"
                            // banner; never add a bottom snackbar here.
                        } else if ("cancelled".equals(msg)
                                || (jobId != null
                                        && cancelledJobs.remove(jobId))) {
                            // The user cancelled this one (in-app or from the
                            // notification shade); it is not a failure and
                            // must not claim the raw was kept.
                        } else {
                            OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                                    "Save failed", null);
                        }
                    });
                }
            };
            IntentFilter f = new IntentFilter(
                    ConversionService.BROADCAST_CONVERSION_DONE);
            f.addAction(RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE);
            androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.registerReceiver(
                    requireContext(), convReceiver, f,
                    androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            convReceiver = null;
        }
    }

    private void unregisterConvReceiver() {
        if (convReceiver == null) return;
        try {
            requireContext().unregisterReceiver(convReceiver);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        convReceiver = null;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroyView() {
        stopPlayback();
        super.onDestroyView();
    }

    // ---- search ----

    private void toggleSearch() {
        if (searchBar.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
            closeSearch();
        } else {
            searchBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            searchBar.setAlpha(0f);
            searchBar.setTranslationY(-18f);
            searchBar.animate().cancel();
            searchBar.animate()
                    .alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setDuration(260)
                    .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
            searchInput.requestFocus();
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    requireContext().getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.showSoftInput(searchInput, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT);
        }
    }

    private void closeSearch() {
        hideKeyboard();
        try {
            searchInput.clearFocus();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (searchBar.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) return;
        searchBar.animate().cancel();
        searchBar.animate()
                .alpha(0f).translationY(-14f)
                .setDuration(190)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.AccelerateInterpolator())
                .withEndAction(() -> {
                    searchBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    searchBar.setAlpha(1f);
                    searchBar.setTranslationY(0f);
                })
                .start();
        if (!query.isEmpty()) searchInput.setText("");
    }

    private boolean isSearchOpen() {
        return searchBar != null && searchBar.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE;
    }

    private void hideKeyboard() {
        InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                requireContext().getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
        if (imm != null && getView() != null) {
            imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(getView().getWindowToken(), 0);
        }
    }

    // ---- filtering / sorting ----

    private void paintChips() {
        for (int i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
            boolean active = chipFilters[i] == filter;
            chips[i].setBackgroundResource(active
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected : R.drawable.bg_chip);
            chips[i].setTextColor(active ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF);
            chips[i].setAlpha(1f);
        }
    }

    private void paintChipsAnimated() {
        for (int i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
            boolean active = chipFilters[i] == filter;
            chips[i].setBackgroundResource(active
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected : R.drawable.bg_chip);
            chips[i].setTextColor(active ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF);
            if (active) {
                chips[i].animate().cancel();
                chips[i].setScaleX(0.92f);
                chips[i].setScaleY(0.92f);
                chips[i].animate()
                        .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(220)
                        .setInterpolator(
                                new android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator(2.2f))
                        .start();
            }
        }
    }

    private void showSortMenu(View anchor) {
        // Press bounce on the anchor for tactile feedback.
        anchor.animate().cancel();
        anchor.setScaleX(0.85f);
        anchor.setScaleY(0.85f);
        anchor.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(180).start();

        Sort[] values = Sort.values();
        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Sort s : values) {
            final Sort option = s;
            items.add(new OptionsSheet.Item(sortIcon(option),
                    sortLabel(option), false, option == sort,
                    () -> {
                        sort = option;
                        saveSort();
                        refresh();
                        OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "List sorted");
                    }));
        }
        int total = TakesRepository.all().size();
        OptionsSheet.showOptions(requireContext(),
                getString(R.string.sort_by),
                getString(R.string.sort_subtitle, total),
                items);
    }

    private int sortIcon(Sort s) {
        switch (s) {
            case NAME: return R.drawable.ic_pencil;
            case LONGEST: return R.drawable.ic_wave;
            case SHORTEST: return R.drawable.ic_scissors;
            default: return R.drawable.ic_sort;
        }
    }

    private String sortLabel(Sort s) {
        switch (s) {
            case OLDEST: return getString(R.string.sort_oldest);
            case NAME: return getString(R.string.sort_name);
            case LONGEST: return getString(R.string.sort_longest);
            case SHORTEST: return getString(R.string.sort_shortest);
            default: return getString(R.string.sort_newest);
        }
    }

    private Sort loadSort() {
        try {
            int ord = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getInt("sort", 0);
            Sort[] all = Sort.values();
            if (ord >= 0 && ord < all.length) return all[ord];
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return Sort.NEWEST;
    }

    private void saveSort() {
        try {
            SharedPreferences p = requireContext()
                    .getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            p.edit().putInt("sort", sort.ordinal()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Copies the picked document directly into the takes directory in its
     * original format and registers it as an imported take. Its 32-bit float
     * file is created lazily the first time the user presses Edit.
     */
    private void importAudio(Uri uri) {
        final Context appCtx = requireContext().getApplicationContext();
        new Thread(() -> {
            File out = null;
            try {
                File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(appCtx);
                AudioImporter.ImportedAudio imp =
                        AudioImporter.importOriginal(appCtx, uri, dir);
                out = imp.file;
                TakesRepository.addImported(
                        imp.file, imp.durationMs, imp.title, imp.badge);
            } catch (Exception | Error e) {
                if (out != null) {
                    // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                    out.delete();
                }
                out = null;
            }
            final File imported = out;
            handler.post(() -> {
                if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
                refresh();
                if (imported != null) {
                    OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(requireContext(), "Audio imported");
                } else {
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(requireContext(), false,
                            "Import failed", null);
                }
            });
        }, "takeone-import").start();
    }

    /** External refresh (e.g. MainActivity after library init). */
    public void refreshExternal() {
        if (isAdded() && getView() != null) refresh();
    }

    private void refresh() {
        // Defensive: refresh() is reachable from lifecycle callbacks that can
        // fire before onViewCreated has built the adapter (and from a queued
        // repository callback racing a destroyed view). Never let a render
        // helper take the process down.
        if (adapter == null || getView() == null) return;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        List<Take> converting = convertingCards();
        List<Take> shownConverting = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Take t : converting) {
            if (passesFilter(t, now)) shownConverting.add(t);
        }
        List<Take> out = new ArrayList<>(shownConverting);
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (!passesFilter(t, now)) continue;
            out.add(t);
        }
        Comparator<Take> cmp;
        switch (sort) {
            case OLDEST: cmp = (a, b) -> Long.compare(a.timestamp, b.timestamp); break;
            case NAME: cmp = (a, b) -> a.title.compareToIgnoreCase(b.title); break;
            case LONGEST: cmp = (a, b) -> Long.compare(b.durationMs, a.durationMs); break;
            case SHORTEST: cmp = (a, b) -> Long.compare(a.durationMs, b.durationMs); break;
            default: cmp = (a, b) -> Long.compare(b.timestamp, a.timestamp); break;
        }
        // Active conversions pin to the top in job order; the library sort
        // applies to finished takes only.
        List<Take> finished = new ArrayList<>(out.subList(shownConverting.size(),
                out.size()));
        Collections.sort(finished, cmp);
        out = new ArrayList<>(shownConverting);
        out.addAll(finished);
        visible = out;

        Set<Long> alive = new HashSet<>();
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) alive.add(t.id);
        selection.retainAll(alive);
        if (selectionMode && selection.isEmpty()) selectionMode = false;

        // A finished conversion replaces a synthetic card (negative id) with
        // its real take (positive id). Under stable ids RecyclerView treats
        // that as a remove+insert and runs overlapping remove/add/move
        // animations against a holder that is never rebound, which is what
        // took the process down. Structural changes are rare and the list
        // rebinds in one pass anyway.
        if (rawMode && playingId != -1) {
            Take cur = findVisible(playingId);
            if (cur != null && cur.converting
                    && ConversionJobs.forTakeId(playingId) == null) {
                stopPlayback();
            }
        }
        adapter.setTakesAndState(out, playingId, playPaused,
                selection, selectionMode);

        int total = TakesRepository.all().size();
        boolean scoped = !query.isEmpty() || filter != Filter.ALL;
        int conv = shownConverting.size();
        // A4-12: converting cards are synthetic rows that live outside the
        // Room set, so counting them made "3 of 2 takes" appear.
        String base = scoped
                ? getString(R.string.search_count, out.size() - conv, total)
                : getString(R.string.take_count, total);
        subtitle.setText(base + "  •  " + sortLabel(sort)
                + (conv > 0 ? "  •  " + getString(R.string.conv_active, conv)
                        : ""));

        boolean empty = out.isEmpty();
        list.setVisibility(empty ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
        emptyState.setVisibility(empty ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (empty) {
            if (total == 0) {
                emptyTitle.setText(R.string.library_empty_title);
                emptySub.setText(R.string.library_empty_sub);
            } else {
                emptyTitle.setText(R.string.no_matches);
                emptySub.setText(query.isEmpty()
                        ? getString(R.string.no_matches_sub, "")
                        : getString(R.string.no_matches_sub, query));
            }
        }
        paintSelectionBar();
    }

    /**
     * Coalesced full rebind for structural job changes. Back-to-back dataset
     * swaps (appear → progress → disappear) must never stack overlapping
     * layout passes, so requests inside the window collapse into one.
     */
    private long lastStructuralMs = 0;
    /** Structural refresh with no debounce, for completion/cancellation. */
    private void refreshImmediate() {
        structuralPending = false;
        lastStructuralMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (isAdded() && getView() != null) refresh();
    }

    private boolean structuralPending = false;
    private static final long STRUCTURAL_MIN_GAP_MS = 500;

    private void requestStructuralRefresh() {
        long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (now - lastStructuralMs < STRUCTURAL_MIN_GAP_MS) {
            if (structuralPending) return;
            structuralPending = true;
            long wait = STRUCTURAL_MIN_GAP_MS - (now - lastStructuralMs);
            handler.postDelayed(() -> {
                structuralPending = false;
                lastStructuralMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
                if (isAdded() && getView() != null) refresh();
            }, wait);
            return;
        }
        lastStructuralMs = now;
        refresh();
    }

    /**
     * Whether a row (finished take or converting card) survives the active
     * filter chip and search query. Converting cards carry the job title in
     * {@code title} and the target container in {@code format}, so the same
     * predicate applies to both.
     */
    private boolean passesFilter(Take t, long now) {
        switch (filter) {
            case FAV: if (!t.favorite) return false; break;
            case DAY: if (now - t.timestamp > 24L * 3600_000L) return false; break;
            case WEEK: if (now - t.timestamp > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L) return false; break;
            case SHORT: if (t.durationMs >= 5L * 60_000L) return false; break;
            case WAV:
                if (t.format == null
                        || !t.format.toUpperCase(Locale.US)
                        .startsWith("WAV")) return false;
                break;
            case FLAC:
                if (!"FLAC".equalsIgnoreCase(t.format)) return false;
                break;
            case OPUS:
                if (!"OPUS".equalsIgnoreCase(t.format)) return false;
                break;
            case AMR:
                if (t.format == null
                        || !t.format.toUpperCase(Locale.US)
                        .startsWith("AMR")) return false;
                break;
            case M4A: if (!"M4A".equalsIgnoreCase(t.format)) return false; break;
            default: break;
        }
        if (!query.isEmpty() && (t.title == null
                || !t.title.toLowerCase().contains(query))) return false;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Synthetic cards for active background conversions. They are never
     * persisted (no Room row, stable negative ids) and always pin above
     * finished takes so conversions are visible at a glance.
     */
    private List<Take> convertingCards() {
        List<Take> cards = new ArrayList<>();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (ConversionJob job : ConversionJobs.active()) {
            String target;
            try {
                target = TakeSaver.labelFor(
                        RecordPreset.of(job.presetId),
                        SaveFormat.of(job.formatId));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                target = "";
            }
            String size;
            try {
                size = Dsp.sizeLabel(new File(job.rawPath).length());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                size = "";
            }
            Take t = new Take(job.takeId(), job.title, job.durationMs, now,
                    size, target, false, "");
            t.converting = true;
            t.convProgress = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, job.progress));
            t.convFormat = target;
            t.convJobId = job.jobId;
            t.convRawPath = job.rawPath;
            t.dateLabel = getString(R.string.conv_card_status, target,
                    t.convProgress);
            ConversionJobs.noteTakeRaw(t.id, job.rawPath);
            cards.add(t);
        }
        return cards;
    }

    /** Jumps to the top where active-conversion cards live. */
    private void scrollToConversions() {
        try {
            if (list != null) list.scrollToPosition(0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- selection ----

    private void enterSelection(Take take) {
        if (take.converting) return; // converting takes cannot be selected
        selectionMode = true;
        selection.add(take.id);
        adapter.collapseAll();
        adapter.setSelection(selection, true);
        paintSelectionBar();
    }

    private void exitSelection() {
        selectionMode = false;
        selection.clear();
        adapter.setSelection(selection, false);
        paintSelectionBar();
    }

    private void toggleSelection(Take take) {
        if (take.converting) return; // converting takes cannot be selected
        if (selection.contains(take.id)) selection.remove(take.id);
        else selection.add(take.id);
        if (selection.isEmpty()) {
            exitSelection();
            return;
        }
        // setSelection rebinds on content change, so the tapped card (and only
        // the tapped card) animates — badges, border and shrink together.
        adapter.setSelection(selection, true);
        paintSelectionBar();
    }

    private void toggleSelectAll() {
        // AUDIT-3-03 fix: exclude active converting cards (`t.converting`),
        // matching `enterSelection` and `toggleSelection`. Including them
        // made the count comparison never true and selected a card that
        // refuses selection.
        List<Take> selectable = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Take t : visible) {
            if (!t.converting) selectable.add(t);
        }
        boolean allSel = !selectable.isEmpty()
                && selection.size() == selectable.size();
        selection.clear();
        if (!allSel) {
            for (Take t : selectable) selection.add(t.id);
        }
        if (selection.isEmpty()) {
            exitSelection();
            return;
        }
        adapter.setSelection(selection, true);
        paintSelectionBar();
    }

    private void paintSelectionBar() {
        boolean showSel = selectionMode;
        if (showSel && selectionBar.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            normalHeader.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            selectionBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            selectionBar.setAlpha(0f);
            selectionBar.setTranslationY(-12f);
            selectionBar.animate().cancel();
            selectionBar.animate().alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setDuration(240)
                    .setInterpolator(
                            new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
        } else if (!showSel && normalHeader.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            selectionBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            normalHeader.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            normalHeader.setAlpha(0f);
            normalHeader.setTranslationY(-12f);
            normalHeader.animate().cancel();
            normalHeader.animate().alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setDuration(240)
                    .setInterpolator(
                            new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
        } else {
            normalHeader.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
            selectionBar.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        }
        if (!selectionMode) return;
        selCount.setText(getString(R.string.selected_count, selection.size()));
        // Pop the count on every change so selection feels alive.
        selCount.setScaleX(0.85f);
        selCount.setScaleY(0.85f);
        selCount.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(180).start();
        boolean hasFile = false;
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (selection.contains(t.id) && t.hasFile()) {
                hasFile = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        selExport.setAlpha(hasFile ? 1f : 0.35f);
        selExport.setClickable(hasFile);
        selDelete.setAlpha(selection.isEmpty() ? 0.35f : 1f);
    }

    // ---- playback (silent: no popups) ----

    @Override
    public void onPlay(Take take) {
        if (selectionMode) {
            toggleSelection(take);
            return;
        }
        // Focus is acquired inside startRawPreview()/startPlayback(), AFTER
        // stopPlayback(): acquiring here and then stopping releases the focus
        // before the new player ever starts. The toggle branches below are
        // pause/resume of an already-focused player.
        if (take.converting) {
            startRawPreview(take);
            return;
        }
        if (playingId == take.id) {
            adapter.expandDirectIfNeeded(list, take.id);
            if (playPaused) resumePlayback();
            else pausePlayback();
            return;
        }
        // Long takes resume where they stopped; short ones restart.
        long resume = take.lastPositionMs;
        if (resume < 10_000 || resume > take.durationMs - 10_000) resume = 0;
        startPlayback(take, resume);
    }

    /**
     * Previews the stored raw of a take that is still converting. The final
     * file does not exist yet; the raw is a valid float WAV and plays
     * straight through AudioTrack.
     */
    private void startRawPreview(Take take) {
        if (playingId == take.id && rawMode) {
            adapter.expandDirectIfNeeded(list, take.id);
            if (playPaused) resumePlayback();
            else pausePlayback();
            return;
        }
        stopPlayback();
        if (!acquirePlaybackFocus()) {
            snackText(getString(R.string.playback_busy));
            return;
        }
        File raw = new File(take.convRawPath);
        if (!raw.exists()) {
            releasePlaybackFocus();
            snackText(getString(R.string.edit_no_audio));
            return;
        }
        try {
            final long id = take.id;
            rawPlayer = new RawFloatPlayer(raw, completed -> handler.post(() -> {
                // Pause/seek completions report completed=false: only a real
                // end-of-stream should snap the scrubber and tear down.
                if (!completed) return;
                if (playingId == id && rawMode) {
                    Take t = findVisible(id);
                    if (t != null) {
                        adapter.paintProgress(list, id, t.durationMs);
                    }
                    stopPlayback();
                    refresh();
                }
            }));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            rawPlayer = null;
            releasePlaybackFocus();
            snackText(getString(R.string.edit_no_audio));
            return;
        }
        rawMode = true;
        playingId = take.id;
        playPaused = false;
        adapter.setProgress(list, take.id, 0);
        adapter.expandDirectIfNeeded(list, take.id);
        adapter.paintPlayState(list, playingId, false);
        rawPlayer.play();
        handler.post(progressTick);
        snackText(getString(R.string.conv_preview_hint, take.convFormat));
    }

    private Take findVisible(long id) {
        for (Take t : visible) {
            if (t.id == id) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void startPlayback(Take take, long startPos) {
        stopPlayback();
        if (take.hasFile()) {
            if (!acquirePlaybackFocus()) {
                snackText(getString(R.string.playback_busy));
                return;
            }
            try {
                player = new MediaPlayer();
                player.setDataSource(take.filePath);
                player.prepare();
                if (startPos > 0) {
                    try {
                        player.seekTo((int) Math.min(startPos, player.getDuration()));
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }
                final long id = take.id;
                player.setOnCompletionListener(mp -> {
                    // Loop while the user is still scrubbing; otherwise finish.
                    if (adapter.isTracking(id, list)) {
                        try {
                            mp.seekTo(0);
                            mp.start();
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            completePlayback(id);
                        }
                    } else {
