import java.util.List;

/**
 * Centered modal dialogs (overlaying the current screen) replacing the old
 * bottom sheets. Sort options appear as distinct pills, rename is a centered
 * input modal, deletes ask for confirmation, and every success/failure gets
 * its own styled popup. All dialogs pop/scale in and out and cap their width
 * cleanly in landscape mode.
 */
public final class OptionsSheet {

    /** Maximum width in dp for standard centered dialogs (save/discard/confirm/etc.). */
    public static final int MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP = 380;
    /** Maximum width in dp for the 2-pane landscape Recording Settings dialog. */
    public static final int MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP = 620;

    private OptionsSheet() {}

    private static Dialog activeTopPopup;
    private static final Handler TOP_POPUP_HANDLER =
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    /**
     * Enforces at most two words on stylized top popup titles so banners
     * stay scannable at a glance.
     */
    static String compactTwoWords(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        String clean = text.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "";
        String[] parts = clean.split(" ");
        if (parts.length <= 2) return clean;
        return parts[0] + " " + parts[1];
    }

    public static final class Item {
        public final int icon;
        public final String label;
        public final String sub;
        public final boolean destructive;
        public final boolean checked;
        public final Runnable action;

        public Item(int icon, String label, boolean destructive, boolean checked,
                    Runnable action) {
            this(icon, label, null, destructive, checked, action);
        }

        public Item(int icon, String label, String sub, boolean destructive,
                    boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            this.icon = icon;
            this.label = label;
            this.sub = sub;
            this.destructive = destructive;
            this.checked = checked;
            this.action = action;
        }

        public static Item of(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, false, false, action);
        }

        public static Item danger(int icon, String label, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, true, false, action);
        }

        /** Two-line row: title + smaller spec line (presets, save formats). */
        public static Item detail(String label, String sub, boolean checked,
                                  Runnable action) {
            return new Item(0, label, sub, false, checked, action);
        }

        /** Two-line row with a leading icon. */
        public static Item detail(int icon, String label, String sub,
                                  boolean checked, Runnable action) {
            return new Item(icon, label, sub, false, checked, action);
        }
    }

    /** One save-format toggle chip inside the unified recording dialog. */
    public static final class Chip {
        public final String label;
        /** Approximate storage per minute, e.g. "17 MB/min". */
        public final String size;
        public final boolean checked;
        public final Runnable action;

        public Chip(String label, String size, boolean checked,
                    Runnable action) {
            this.label = label;
            this.size = size;
            this.checked = checked;
            this.action = action;
        }

        public static Chip of(String label, String size, boolean checked,
                              Runnable action) {
            return new Chip(label, size, checked, action);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Live state behind the unified recording dialog. Lists are re-queried
     * after every tap so checkmarks follow the actual selection; order must
     * be stable across calls.
     */
    public interface SettingsState {
        java.util.List&lt;Item&gt; presets();
        java.util.List&lt;Chip&gt; formats();
        String formatHint();
    }

    public interface SaveCallback {
        void onSave(String text);
    }

    /** Input modal that also reports when the user backs out / cancels. */
    public static void showInputWithCancel(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                           String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback,
                                           Runnable onCancel) {
        showInputInternal(ctx, title, initial, saveLabel, callback, onCancel, false);
    }

    /**
     * Same, but {@code allowSame} skips the "already the current name" error so
     * accepting the suggested default is one tap.
     */
    public static void showInputWithCancel(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                           String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback,
                                           Runnable onCancel, boolean allowSame) {
        showInputInternal(ctx, title, initial, saveLabel, callback, onCancel, allowSame);
    }

    // ---- centered pill options (sort, export, …) ----

    public static void show(Context ctx, String title, List&lt;Item&gt; items) {
        showOptions(ctx, title, null, items);
    }

    public static void showOptions(Context ctx, String title, String subtitle,
                                   List&lt;Item&gt; items) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_options, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle);
        titleView.setText(title);
        TextView subView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSubtitle);
        if (subtitle != null && !subtitle.isEmpty()) {
            subView.setText(subtitle);
            subView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        LinearLayout container = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogOptions);
        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(ctx);
        for (int i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
            final Item item = items.get(i);
            View pillWrap = new FrameLayout(ctx);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams wrapLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            if (i > 0) wrapLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
            pillWrap.setLayoutParams(wrapLp);

            View row = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_pill_row, (FrameLayout) pillWrap, false);
            row.setBackgroundResource(item.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            TextView label = row.findViewById(R.id.pillLabel);
            label.setText(item.label);
            if (item.destructive) {
                label.setTextColor(0xFFFF3B30);
            } else if (item.checked) {
                label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            }
            TextView sub = row.findViewById(R.id.pillSub);
            if (sub != null) {
                if (item.sub != null && !item.sub.isEmpty()) {
                    sub.setText(item.sub);
                    sub.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                } else {
                    sub.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                }
            }
            ImageView iconView = row.findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (item.icon != 0) {
                iconView.setImageResource(item.icon);
            } else {
                iconView.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_wave);
            }
            iconView.setAlpha(item.checked ? 1f : 0.8f);
            iconView.setColorFilter(item.destructive
                    ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFFF2F4F7);
            iconView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            ImageView check = row.findViewById(R.id.pillCheck);
            check.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
            check.setVisibility(item.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.96f).scaleY(0.96f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                    dialog.dismiss();
                    if (item.action != null) item.action.run();
                }).start();
            });
            ((FrameLayout) pillWrap).addView(row);
            container.addView(pillWrap);

            // Staggered entrance: each pill slides up + fades in.
            row.setAlpha(0f);
            row.setTranslationY(dp(ctx, 14));
            row.animate()
                    .alpha(1f).translationY(0f)
                    .setStartDelay(60 + i * 55L)
                    .setDuration(260)
                    .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                    .start();
        }

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
    }

    /**
     * Two primary choices rendered side by side, with the redundant bottom
     * Cancel button removed. Used by the Back/Stop/Edit/Trim modals.
     */
    public static Dialog showTwoChoiceModal(Context ctx, String title,
                                            String subtitle,
                                            Item first, Item second) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_options, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        TextView titleView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle);
        titleView.setText(title != null ? title : "");
        TextView subView = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSubtitle);
        if (subtitle != null && !subtitle.isEmpty()) {
            subView.setText(subtitle);
            subView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        View scroll = root.findViewById(R.id.optScroll);
        if (scroll != null) scroll.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        if (cancel != null) cancel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        LinearLayout row = root.findViewById(R.id.optHorizontalRow);
        row.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        row.removeAllViews();

        Item[] pair = new Item[]{first, second};
        for (int i = 0; i < pair.length; i++) {
            Item item = pair[i];
            if (item == null) continue;
            TextView btn = new TextView(ctx);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    0, dp(ctx, 46), 1f);
            if (i > 0) lp.setMarginStart(dp(ctx, 10));
            btn.setLayoutParams(lp);
            btn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            btn.setText(item.label);
            btn.setTextSize(14f);
            btn.setTypeface(btn.getTypeface(), android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            btn.setPadding(dp(ctx, 10), 0, dp(ctx, 10), 0);
            if (item.icon != 0) {
                btn.setCompoundDrawablesRelativeWithIntrinsicBounds(
                        item.icon, 0, 0, 0);
                btn.setCompoundDrawablePadding(dp(ctx, 6));
            }
            if (item.destructive) {
                btn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_danger);
                btn.setTextColor(0xFFFF3B30);
            } else {
                btn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
                btn.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
            }
            PressAnim.apply(btn);
            btn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                if (item.action != null) item.action.run();
            });
            row.addView(btn);
        }

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        return dialog;
    }

    // ---- unified recording settings: presets + format toggles ----

    /**
     * One dialog for everything that shapes the next take:
     * - In portrait mode: split vertically in half (presets on top, save
     *   formats below).
     * - In landscape mode: split in half side-by-side (left pane = presets,
     *   right pane = save formats), matching the 2-pane Studio UI so all
     *   options fit cleanly without overflowing.
     */
    public static void showRecordingSettings(Context ctx, String title,
                                             String presetLabel, String presetHint,
                                             String formatLabel, SettingsState state,
                                             String doneLabel) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

        DisplayMetrics dm = ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        boolean isLand = dm.widthPixels > dm.heightPixels;

        android.widget.ScrollView scroll = new android.widget.ScrollView(ctx);
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 21) root.setElevation(dp(ctx, 16));
        int pad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 14 : 18);
        root.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
        scroll.addView(root,
                new android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams(
                        android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        android.widget.ScrollView.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        TextView titleView = new TextView(ctx);
        titleView.setText(title);
        titleView.setTextSize(isLand ? 16 : 18);
        titleView.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
        titleView.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        titleView.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        root.addView(titleView);

        // Two-pane container: HORIZONTAL 50/50 split in landscape, VERTICAL split in portrait
        LinearLayout splitContainer = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        splitContainer.setId(R.id.dialogOptions);
        splitContainer.setOrientation(isLand ? LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL : LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams splitLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        splitLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 6 : 8);
        root.addView(splitContainer, splitLp);

        LinearLayout presetPane = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        presetPane.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams presetPaneLp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        if (isLand) presetPaneLp.rightMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
        splitContainer.addView(presetPane, presetPaneLp);

        View divider = new View(ctx);
        divider.setBackgroundColor(0x22FFFFFF);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams dlp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 1), LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(ctx, 1));
        if (!isLand) {
            dlp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 10);
            dlp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 2);
        }
        splitContainer.addView(divider, dlp);

        LinearLayout formatPane = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        formatPane.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams formatPaneLp = isLand
                ? new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                : new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        if (isLand) formatPaneLp.leftMargin = dp(ctx, 8);
        splitContainer.addView(formatPane, formatPaneLp);

        // Populate Left / Top Half: Recording Presets
        presetPane.addView(sectionLabel(ctx, presetLabel, isLand ? 2 : 6));
        if (presetHint != null && !presetHint.isEmpty()) {
            TextView hint = new TextView(ctx);
            hint.setText(presetHint);
            hint.setTextSize(10.5f);
            hint.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams hlp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            hlp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 2);
            presetPane.addView(hint, hlp);
        }

        LayoutInflater inflater = LayoutInflater.from(ctx);
        java.util.List<View> pillRows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<TextView> pillLabels = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<ImageView> pillChecks = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        java.util.List<Integer> pillDefaultColors = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<View> chipViews = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<TextView> chipNames = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final java.util.List<TextView> chipSizes = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        final TextView formatHintView = new TextView(ctx);
        formatHintView.setTextSize(10.5f);
        formatHintView.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        for (Item item : state.presets()) {
            final Item it = item;
            View row = inflater.inflate(R.layout.dialog_pill_row, presetPane, false);
            row.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 44 : 50));
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams rlp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rlp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 5 : 6);
            presetPane.addView(row, rlp);
            TextView label = row.findViewById(R.id.pillLabel);
            label.setText(it.label);
            if (isLand) label.setTextSize(13);
            TextView sub = row.findViewById(R.id.pillSub);
            if (sub != null) {
                if (it.sub != null && !it.sub.isEmpty()) {
                    sub.setText(it.sub);
                    if (isLand) sub.setTextSize(10.5f);
                    sub.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                } else {
                    sub.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                }
            }
            ImageView dot = row.findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (it.icon != 0) {
                dot.setImageResource(it.icon);
                dot.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
            } else {
                dot.setImageResource(R.drawable.bg_thumb);
                int inset = dp(ctx, 5);
                dot.setPadding(inset, inset, inset, inset);
            }
            dot.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            ImageView check = row.findViewById(R.id.pillCheck);
            pillRows.add(row);
            pillLabels.add(label);
            pillChecks.add(check);
            pillDefaultColors.add(label.getTextColors().getDefaultColor());
            PressAnim.apply(row);
            row.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (it.action != null) it.action.run();
                rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                        pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                        formatHintView);
            });
        }

        // Populate Right / Bottom Half: Save Formats
        formatPane.addView(sectionLabel(ctx, formatLabel, isLand ? 2 : 8));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams flp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        flp.bottomMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
        formatPane.addView(formatHintView, flp);

        android.widget.GridLayout grid = new android.widget.GridLayout(ctx);
        grid.setColumnCount(3);
        grid.setUseDefaultMargins(false);
        formatPane.addView(grid, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
        for (Chip chip : state.formats()) {
            final Chip c = chip;
            LinearLayout cell = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            cell.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            cell.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cell.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int hPad = dp(ctx, 5);
            int vPadCell = dp(ctx, isLand ? 6 : 7);
            cell.setPadding(hPad, vPadCell, hPad, vPadCell);
            cell.setMinimumHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 44));

            TextView name = new TextView(ctx);
            name.setText(c.label);
            name.setTextSize(isLand ? 11 : 12);
            name.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            name.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            name.setSingleLine(true);
            name.setEllipsize(android.text.TextUtils.TruncateAt.END);
            cell.addView(name);

            TextView size = new TextView(ctx);
            size.setText(c.size);
            size.setTextSize(9.5f);
            size.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            size.setSingleLine(true);
            size.setAlpha(0.85f);
            cell.addView(size);

            android.widget.GridLayout.LayoutParams glp =
                    new android.widget.GridLayout.LayoutParams();
            glp.width = 0;
            glp.columnSpec = android.widget.GridLayout.spec(
                    android.widget.GridLayout.UNDEFINED, 1f);
            int m = dp(ctx, 3);
            glp.setMargins(m, m, m, m);
            cell.setLayoutParams(glp);
            grid.addView(cell);
            chipViews.add(cell);
            chipNames.add(name);
            chipSizes.add(size);
            PressAnim.apply(cell);
            cell.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (c.action != null) c.action.run();
                rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                        pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                        formatHintView);
            });
        }

        TextView done = new TextView(ctx);
        done.setText(doneLabel);
        done.setTextSize(14);
        done.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
        done.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        done.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        done.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        done.setMinHeight(dp(ctx, isLand ? 40 : 46));
        int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 9 : 12);
        done.setPadding(dp(ctx, 16), vPad, dp(ctx, 16), vPad);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams blp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        blp.topMargin = dp(ctx, isLand ? 10 : 14);
        root.addView(done, blp);
        PressAnim.apply(done);
        done.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

        dialog.setContentView(scroll);
        rebindSettings(state, pillRows, pillLabels, pillChecks,
                pillDefaultColors, chipViews, chipNames, chipSizes,
                formatHintView);
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog,
                isLand ? MAX_SETTINGS_LAND_WIDTH_DP : MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
        dialog.show();
    }

    private static TextView sectionLabel(Context ctx, String text, int topMarginDp) {
        TextView tv = new TextView(ctx);
        tv.setText(text);
        tv.setTextSize(10);
        tv.setLetterSpacing(0.1f);
        tv.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
        lp.topMargin = dp(ctx, topMarginDp);
        tv.setLayoutParams(lp);
        return tv;
    }

    private static void rebindSettings(SettingsState state,
                                       java.util.List&lt;View&gt; pillRows,
                                       java.util.List&lt;TextView&gt; pillLabels,
                                       java.util.List&lt;ImageView&gt; pillChecks,
                                       java.util.List&lt;Integer&gt; pillColors,
                                       java.util.List&lt;View&gt; chipViews,
                                       java.util.List&lt;TextView&gt; chipNames,
                                       java.util.List&lt;TextView&gt; chipSizes,
                                       TextView hintView) {
        java.util.List&lt;Item&gt; presets;
        java.util.List&lt;Chip&gt; formats;
        try {
            presets = state.presets();
            formats = state.formats();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pillRows.size() && i < presets.size(); i++) {
            Item it = presets.get(i);
            pillRows.get(i).setBackgroundResource(it.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_pill_option_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_pill_option);
            pillLabels.get(i).setTextColor(it.checked
                    ? 0xFFF2F4F7 : pillColors.get(i));
            pillChecks.get(i).setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);
            pillChecks.get(i).setVisibility(
                    it.checked ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
            ImageView dot = pillRows.get(i).findViewById(R.id.pillIcon);
            if (dot != null) dot.setColorFilter(it.icon != 0
                    ? (it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF9AA4B2)
                    : (it.checked ? 0xFFFF3B30 : 0xFF5D6672));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < chipViews.size() && i < formats.size(); i++) {
            Chip c = formats.get(i);
            chipViews.get(i).setBackgroundResource(c.checked
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected
                    : R.drawable.bg_chip);
            int col = c.checked ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0xFF9AA3AF;
            chipNames.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setTextColor(col);
            chipSizes.get(i).setText(c.size);
            chipNames.get(i).setText(c.label);
        }
        try {
            hintView.setText(state.formatHint());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- centered rename / input modal ----

    public static void showInput(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                 String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback) {
        showInputInternal(ctx, title, initial, saveLabel, callback, null, false);
    }

    private static void showInputInternal(Context ctx, String title, String initial,
                                          String saveLabel, SaveCallback callback,
                                          Runnable onCancel, boolean allowSame) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_input, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        EditText input = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogInput);
        TextView error = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogError);
        input.setText(initial == null ? "" : initial);
        input.setHint(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_hint));
        try {
            input.setSelection(input.getText().length());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView save = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogSave);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        save.setText(saveLabel);
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(save);

        final boolean[] settled = {false};
        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
        });
        try {
            dialog.setOnCancelListener(d -> {
                if (!settled[0] && onCancel != null) onCancel.run();
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        save.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String text = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (text.isEmpty()) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_empty_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            if (!allowSame && text.equals(initial != null ? initial.trim() : "")) {
                error.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.rename_same_error));
                error.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                shake(input);
                return;
            }
            hideKeyboard(ctx, input);
            settled[0] = true;
            dialog.dismiss();
            if (callback != null) callback.onSave(text);
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        if (dialog.getWindow() != null) {
            dialog.getWindow().setSoftInputMode(
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                            | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
        }
        dialog.show();
        input.post(() -> {
            input.requestFocus();
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.showSoftInput(input, InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT);
        });
    }

    // ---- confirm delete modal ----

    public static void showConfirm(Context ctx, String title, String message,
                                   String confirmLabel, boolean danger,
                                   Runnable onConfirm) {
        showConfirm(ctx, title, message, confirmLabel,
                danger ? R.drawable.ic_trash : R.drawable.ic_check, danger, onConfirm);
    }

    public static void showConfirm(Context ctx, String title, String message,
                                   String confirmLabel, int iconRes,
                                   boolean danger, Runnable onConfirm) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_confirm, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogTitle)).setText(title);
        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogMessage)).setText(message);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon);
        icon.setImageResource(iconRes);
        View iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() instanceof View
                ? (View) root.findViewById(R.id.dialogIcon).getParent() : null;

        TextView cancel = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogCancel);
        TextView confirm = root.findViewById(R.id.dialogConfirm);
        cancel.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
        confirm.setText(confirmLabel);
        if (danger) {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
            confirm.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
        } else {
            confirm.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);
        }
        PressAnim.apply(cancel);
        PressAnim.apply(confirm);

        cancel.setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());
        confirm.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            v.animate().scaleX(0.94f).scaleY(0.94f).setDuration(70).withEndAction(() -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                if (onConfirm != null) onConfirm.run();
            }).start();
        });

        styleAsCentered(dialog);
        dialog.show();
        if (iconBg != null) PressAnim.pop(iconBg);
    }

    // ---- success / failure result popup ----

    public static void showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message) {
        showResult(ctx, success, title, message, null);
    }

    /** @return the shown dialog, so callers/tests can drive or dismiss it. */
    public static android.app.Dialog showResult(Context ctx, boolean success,
                                  String title, String message,
                                  Runnable onOk) {
        if (activeTopPopup != null) {
            try {
                if (activeTopPopup.isShowing()) activeTopPopup.dismiss();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            activeTopPopup = null;
        }
        TOP_POPUP_HANDLER.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);

        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
        dialog.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);
        View root = LayoutInflater.from(ctx).inflate(R.layout.dialog_result, null);
        dialog.setContentView(root);

        FrameLayout iconBg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIconBg);
        ImageView icon = root.findViewById(R.id.resultIcon);
        iconBg.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_icon_danger);
        icon.setImageResource(success ? R.drawable.ic_check : R.drawable.ic_close);
        icon.setColorFilter(0xFFFF3B30);

        ((TextView) root.findViewById(R.id.resultTitle))
                .setText(compactTwoWords(title));
        TextView msg = root.findViewById(R.id.resultMessage);
        if (msg != null) {
            msg.setText("");
            msg.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
        TextView ok = root.findViewById(R.id.resultOk);
        if (ok != null) {
            ok.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        final boolean[] fired = {false};
        final Runnable fire = () -> {
            if (fired[0]) return;
            fired[0] = true;
            if (onOk != null) {
                try {
                    onOk.run();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        };
        if (ok != null) {
            ok.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                dialog.dismiss();
                fire.run();
            });
        }
        root.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            dialog.dismiss();
            fire.run();
        });
        dialog.setOnDismissListener(dd -> {
            if (activeTopPopup == dialog) activeTopPopup = null;
            fire.run();
        });

        dialog.setCancelable(true);
        styleAsTopPopup(dialog);
        activeTopPopup = dialog;
        dialog.show();
        styleAsTopPopup(dialog);
        root.setTranslationY(-dp(ctx, 24));
        root.setAlpha(0f);
        root.animate()
                .translationY(0f)
                .alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(220)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .start();
        PressAnim.pop(iconBg);

        TOP_POPUP_HANDLER.postDelayed(() -> {
            try {
                if (dialog.isShowing()) dialog.dismiss();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }, 1600L);
        return dialog;
    }

    /** Lightweight, non-blocking 2-word confirmation banner at the top. */
    public static void showTopPopup(Context ctx, String title, String ignoredMessage) {
        showResult(ctx, true, compactTwoWords(title), null, null);
    }

    public static void showTopPopup(Context ctx, String twoWordTitle) {
        showResult(ctx, true, compactTwoWords(twoWordTitle), null, null);
    }

    // ---- helpers ----

    /**
     * Anchors a dialog at the top edge as a floating banner: no dim, no
     * outside-touch blocking, full width with a small inset.
     */
    public static void styleAsTopPopup(Dialog dialog) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND);
        w.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL);
        w.setDimAmount(0f);
        w.setGravity(Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);
        w.setWindowAnimations(R.style.TopPopupAnim);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        lp.width = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL;
        lp.x = 0;
        lp.y = dp(ctx, 16);
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) decor.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    public static void styleAsCentered(Dialog dialog) {
        styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(dialog, MAX_DIALOG_WIDTH_DP);
    }

    public static void styleAsCenteredWithMaxWidth(Dialog dialog, int maxWidthDp) {
        Window w = dialog.getWindow();
        if (w == null) return;
        Context ctx = dialog.getContext();
        DisplayMetrics dm = ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        boolean isLand = dm.widthPixels > dm.heightPixels;
        w.setBackgroundDrawable(new ColorDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT));
        w.setDimAmount(0.62f);
        WindowManager.LayoutParams lp = w.getAttributes();
        int cappedDp = Math.min(maxWidthDp, isLand ? 380 : 330);
        int maxW = dp(ctx, cappedDp);
        lp.width = Math.min(Math.round(dm.widthPixels * 0.84f), maxW);
        lp.height = WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT;
        lp.gravity = Gravity.CENTER;
        lp.horizontalMargin = 0f;
        w.setAttributes(lp);
        View decor = w.getDecorView();
        if (decor != null) {
            int vPad = dp(ctx, isLand ? 8 : 16);
            decor.setPadding(0, vPad, 0, vPad);
        }
    }

    private static void hideKeyboard(Context ctx, View v) {
        try {
            InputMethodManager imm = (InputMethodManager)
                    ctx.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
            if (imm != null) imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(v.getWindowToken(), 0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void shake(View v) {
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate()
                .translationX(14f).setDuration(55)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(-12f).setDuration(55)
                        .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(8f).setDuration(55)
                                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate().translationX(0f)
                                        .setDuration(80).start()).start()).start())
                .start();
    }

    private static int dp(Context ctx, int dp) {
        return Math.round(dp * ctx.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/MainActivity.java

package com.example.hello;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;
import android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator;
import android.widget.ImageView;

import androidx.activity.OnBackPressedCallback;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate;
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

public class MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private View fabWrap;
    private View fabHalo;
    private ImageView fabIcon;
    private View fabStopWrap;
    private boolean inStudio = false;
    private int fabIconRes = R.drawable.ic_mic;
    private boolean recoveryChecked;
    private long lastFabPress;
    private long lastStopPress;
    private OnBackPressedCallback backCallback;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        CrashLog.install(this);
        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES);
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main);

        fabWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabWrap);
        fabHalo = findViewById(R.id.fabHalo);
        fabIcon = findViewById(R.id.fabIcon);
        fabStopWrap = findViewById(R.id.fabStopWrap);

        // Smooth press animation: shrink on touch-down, spring back on release.
        fabWrap.setOnTouchListener((v, event) -> {
            if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                v.animate().scaleX(0.9f).scaleY(0.9f).setDuration(120).start();
            } else if (event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP
                    || event.getAction() == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                v.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).setDuration(160).start();
            }
            return false;
        });
        fabWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Debounced: one tap, one transition. Guards against double
            // delivery that used to start-then-instantly-pause takes.
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastFabPress < 400) return;
            lastFabPress = now;
            if (!inStudio) {
                pulseHalo();
                openStudio();
            } else {
                StudioFragment st = studio();
                if (st != null) st.onFabPressed();
            }
        });
        PressAnim.apply(fabStopWrap);
        fabStopWrap.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            long now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
            if (now - lastStopPress < 400) return;
            lastStopPress = now;
            StudioFragment st = studio();
            if (st != null) st.onStopPressed();
        });

        getOnBackPressedDispatcher().addCallback(this, backCallback =
                new OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            @Override
            public void handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (inStudio) {
                    StudioFragment st = studio();
                    if (st != null) {
                        st.onBackPressed();
                    } else {
                        exitStudio();
                    }
                } else {
                    Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
                    boolean consumed = f instanceof LibraryFragment
                            && ((LibraryFragment) f).onBackPressed();
                    if (!consumed) {
                        finish();
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        if (savedInstanceState != null) {
            inStudio = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("inStudio", false);
            recoveryChecked = savedInstanceState.getBoolean("recoveryChecked", false);
        } else {
            getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                    .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                    .commitAllowingStateLoss();
        }

        handleOpenStudioIntent(getIntent());
        // Library loads async (Room + disk reconcile). Recovery + first paint
        // wait for it so prompts see adopted orphans and pruned rows.
        TakesRepository.init(this);
        TrialAndBillingManager.get(this).connectAndSync();
        TakesRepository.onReady(() -> {
            if (!recoveryChecked) {
                recoveryChecked = true;
                fabWrap.post(this::checkUnfinishedTakes);
            } else {
                fabWrap.post(this::refreshLibraryIfShown);
            }
            maybeAnnounceRecovered();
            maybeHealCrashedEncoder();
            maybeShowCrashReport();
        });
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    /**
     * Self-healing after an encoder kills a save: the breadcrumbs name the
     * exact format that never finished. Step one rung down the reliability
     * ladder (exotic -> AAC -> pure-Java WAV) so the next recording can
     * actually save on this device.
     */
    private void maybeHealCrashedEncoder() {
        String stage;
        try {
            stage = CrashLog.unterminatedStage(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (stage == null || !stage.startsWith("convert ") || inStudio) return;
        String crashedId = stage.substring("convert ".length()).trim();
        SaveFormat crashed = SaveFormat.of(crashedId);
        SaveFormat current = SaveFormat.load(this);
        SaveFormat currentEff = current.effective(RecordPreset.load(this));
        // Only act while the user still has the killer selected: a manual
        // switch since the crash is respected, not overridden.
        if (currentEff != crashed) return;
        SaveFormat fallback = crashed.fallbackAfterCrash();
        if (fallback == null) return;
        try {
            fallback.save(this);
            CrashLog.breadcrumb(this,
                    "auto-switch " + crashed.id + "->" + fallback.id);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // A Java crash file already tells the story (breadcrumbs included):
        // don't stack a second dialog on top of its share prompt.
        boolean crashFile;
        try {
            crashFile = CrashLog.recentCrash(this) != null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            crashFile = false;
        }
        if (crashFile) return;
        final String from = crashed.badge;
        final String to = fallback.badge;
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.convert_crash_msg, from, to),
                        () -> { });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One surfacing of the previous run's crash log, with share + dismiss. */
    private void maybeShowCrashReport() {
        File crash = CrashLog.recentCrash(this);
        if (crash == null || inStudio) return;
        // Stale reports auto-expire: only a fresh crash nags, and sharing
        // clears it. Cancelling keeps it for the next launch (bounded by
        // the same freshness window).
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - crash.lastModified()
                > 7L * 24 * 3600_000L) {
            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
            return;
        }
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showConfirm(this,
                        getString(R.string.crash_title),
                        getString(R.string.crash_msg),
                        getString(R.string.crash_share),
                        R.drawable.ic_close, false,
                        () -> {
                            CrashLog.share(this, crash);
                            CrashLog.clearCrash(this);
                        });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    /** One summary popup when the startup sweep adopted orphaned files. */
    private void maybeAnnounceRecovered() {
        TakesRepository.ReconcileResult rr = TakesRepository.lastReconcile();
        if (rr == null || rr.adopted <= 0 || inStudio) return;
        // Posted: dialogs need a resumed activity, and onReady can fire
        // synchronously inside onCreate after a rotation.
        fabWrap.post(() -> {
            if (inStudio) return;
            try {
                OptionsSheet.showTopPopup(this, "Takes recovered");
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    void refreshLibraryIfShown() {
        try {
            Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("LIB");
            if (f instanceof LibraryFragment && f.isAdded()) {
                ((LibraryFragment) f).refreshExternal();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @Override
    protected void onNewIntent(Intent intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent);
        setIntent(intent);
        handleOpenStudioIntent(intent);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (backCallback != null) backCallback.setEnabled(true);
        syncFabWithEngine();
        for (ConversionJob j : ConversionJobs.active()) {
            if (ConversionJob.QUEUED.equals(j.state)) {
                ConversionService.startJob(this, j.jobId);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onSaveInstanceState(Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putBoolean("inStudio", inStudio);
        outState.putBoolean("recoveryChecked", recoveryChecked);
    }

    private void handleOpenStudioIntent(Intent intent) {
        if (intent == null) return;
        boolean open = intent.getBooleanExtra("open_studio", false)
                || "com.example.hello.OPEN_STUDIO".equals(intent.getAction());
        if (open && RecordingEngine.get().hasSession() && !inStudio) {
            openStudio();
        }
        try {
            intent.removeExtra("open_studio");
            intent.setAction(null);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public void openStudio() {
        inStudio = true;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out,
                        R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right)
                .replace(R.id.container, new StudioFragment(), "STU")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    public void openStudioWithRecovery(File rawFile) {
        // Crash recovery reopens directly in the recording state.
        openStudioWithSession(rawFile.getAbsolutePath(), true, -1, null);
    }

    /** Edit punch-in: session pre-loaded, timer correct, waits for mic tap. */
    public void openStudioWithEdit(File rawFile, long sourceId, String sourceTitle) {
        openStudioWithSession(rawFile.getAbsolutePath(), false, sourceId, sourceTitle);
    }

    private void openStudioWithSession(String rawPath, boolean autostart,
                                       long editSourceId, String editSourceTitle) {
        inStudio = true;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        StudioFragment f = new StudioFragment();
        Bundle b = new Bundle();
        b.putString("recover_raw", rawPath);
        b.putBoolean("autostart", autostart);
        if (editSourceId != -1) {
            b.putLong("edit_source_id", editSourceId);
            b.putString("edit_source_title", editSourceTitle);
        }
        f.setArguments(b);
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out,
                        R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right)
                .replace(R.id.container, f, "STU")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    public void exitStudio() {
        inStudio = false;
        syncFabWithEngine();
        getSupportFragmentManager().beginTransaction()
                .setCustomAnimations(R.anim.fade_in, R.anim.slide_out_right,
                        R.anim.slide_in_right, R.anim.fade_out)
                .replace(R.id.container, new LibraryFragment(), "LIB")
                .commitAllowingStateLoss();
    }

    // ---- split record controls ----

    /**
     * Main FAB artwork morph (mic / pause / play) with a smooth shrink-swap-pop.
     * Scale-only: the old rotation accumulated 70° on every tap, visibly
     * twisting the icon over time. The split stop button is shown separately
     * while a take is active.
     */
    public void morphFabIcon(int resId) {
        if (fabIconRes == resId) return;
        fabIconRes = resId;
        fabIcon.animate().cancel();
        // Snap rotation back first so repeated morphs can never accumulate.
        fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
        fabIcon.animate()
                .scaleX(0.35f).scaleY(0.35f)
                .setDuration(110)
                .setInterpolator(new DecelerateInterpolator(1.4f))
                .withEndAction(() -> {
                    try {
                        fabIcon.setImageResource(resId);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    fabIcon.setRotation(0f);
                    fabIcon.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(230)
                            .setInterpolator(new OvershootInterpolator(2f))
                            .start();
                })
                .start();
    }

    /** Show/hide the split stop button with a pop. */
    public void setStopVisible(boolean visible) {
        if (visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            PressAnim.pop(fabStopWrap);
        } else if (!visible && fabStopWrap.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
            fabStopWrap.animate().cancel();
            fabStopWrap.animate()
                    .scaleX(0.4f).scaleY(0.4f)
                    .alpha(0f)
                    .setDuration(150)
                    .withEndAction(() -> {
                        fabStopWrap.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleX(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setScaleY(1f);
                        fabStopWrap.setAlpha(1f);
                    })
                    .start();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Drive both FABs from the engine state. Called on studio transitions and
     * on resume so a background recording re-attaches its controls.
     */
    public void syncFabWithEngine() {
        RecordingEngine e = RecordingEngine.get();
        boolean active = inStudio && e.hasSession()
                && (e.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                || e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED);
        boolean paused = e.state == RecordingEngine.State.PAUSED;
        if (active) {
            morphFabIcon(paused ? R.drawable.ic_play : R.drawable.ic_pause);
            setStopVisible(true);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(
                    getString(paused ? R.string.action_resume : R.string.action_pause));
        } else {
            morphFabIcon(inStudio ? R.drawable.ic_mic : R.drawable.ic_mic);
            setStopVisible(false);
            fabWrap.setContentDescription(getString(R.string.cd_mic));
        }
    }

    /** Legacy hook: true once meant square-stop artwork; now drives split UI. */
    public void setFabStop(boolean stop) {
        syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    // ---- unfinished-take recovery (every app start) ----

    private void checkUnfinishedTakes() {
        // Never interrupt an attached studio session with its own UI.
        if (inStudio) return;
        // If the engine already holds a session (background recording), the
        // notification owns it — just offer to reopen the studio.
        if (RecordingEngine.get().hasSession()) {
            return;
        }
        List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> found;
        try {
            found = RecordingEngine.scanUnfinished(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (found == null || found.isEmpty()) return;
        promptRecovery(0, found);
    }

    private void promptRecovery(int index, List<RecordingEngine.Unfinished> all) {
        if (index >= all.size()) return;
        RecordingEngine.Unfinished u = all.get(index);
        String dur = String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d",
                (u.durationMs / 60000), (u.durationMs / 1000) % 60);
        try {
            OptionsSheet.showTwoChoiceModal(this,
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_title),
                    getString(R.string.unfinished_msg, u.name, dur),
                    OptionsSheet.Item.danger(R.drawable.ic_trash,
                            "Discard", () -> {
                                boolean ok = RecordingEngine.deleteUnfinished(u.rawFile);
                                OptionsSheet.showResult(this, ok,
                                        ok ? "Take discarded" : "Delete failed",
                                        null,
                                        () -> promptRecovery(index + 1, all));
                            }),
                    OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_play,
                            "Continue", () -> {
                                try {
                                    RecordingEngine.get().attachExisting(
                                            getApplicationContext(),
                                            u.rawFile, u.name, u.channels,
                                            RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(u.rawFile));
                                } catch (Exception e) {
                                    OptionsSheet.showResult(this, false,
                                            "Open failed", null);
                                    promptRecovery(index + 1, all);
                                    return;
                                }
                                openStudioWithRecovery(u.rawFile);
                            }));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private StudioFragment studio() {
        Fragment f = getSupportFragmentManager().findFragmentByTag("STU");
        return (f instanceof StudioFragment && f.isVisible()) ? (StudioFragment) f : null;
    }

    private void pulseHalo() {
        fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1.22f).scaleY(1.22f).setDuration(150)
                .withEndAction(() -> fabHalo.animate().scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(220).start())
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner;
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Job registry rules: one job per raw, stable card ids, cancel cleanup, and
 * the startup sweep resurrecting interrupted jobs while dropping garbage.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConversionJobsTest {

    private Context ctx() {
        return ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext();
    }

    @Test
    public void takeIdsAreNegativeAndStable() {
        ConversionJob a = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob b = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("take id must be negative", a.takeId() < 0);
        assertEquals("take id must be stable", a.takeId(), b.takeId());
        ConversionJob c = new ConversionJob("job-2", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("different jobs must differ", c.takeId() != a.takeId());
    }

    @Test
    public void sidecarRoundTrip() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobtest.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-9", "Title",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.progress = 42;
        job.framesDone = 100000;
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals("job-9", back.jobId);
            assertEquals("Title", back.title);
            assertEquals(42, back.progress);
            assertEquals(100000, back.framesDone);
            assertEquals(1, back.channels);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void enqueueDedupesAndCancelCleans() throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Job Test", 2);
        try {
            ConversionJob first = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            ConversionJob second = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            assertTrue("same raw must return the same job",
                    first.jobId.equals(second.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar missing", first.sidecar().exists());
            assertTrue("not active",
                    ConversionJobs.forRaw(engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())
                            != null);
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.cancel(first.jobId, false));
            assertNull("still active after cancel",
                    ConversionJobs.get(first.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar survived cancel", !first.sidecar().exists());
        } finally {
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsAndCleans() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "sweep.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-sweep", "Sweep",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.write();
        File orphanPart = new File(dir, "orphan.wav.part");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(orphanPart, "rw").close();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean found = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep")) found = true;
            }
            assertTrue("interrupted job was not resurrected", found);
            assertTrue("orphan part survived", !orphanPart.exists());
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
            assertTrue("raw survived cancel", !raw.exists());
        } finally {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                orphanPart.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            job.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void replaceLineageSurvivesSidecar() {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "jobreplace.wav");
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-rep", "Edit",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.replaceTakeId = 12345L;
        job.replaceTitle = "Original";
        job.write();
        try {
            ConversionJob back = ConversionJob.read(job.sidecar());
            assertNotNull("sidecar unreadable", back);
            assertEquals(12345L, back.replaceTakeId);
            assertEquals("Original", back.replaceTitle);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
        // Old sidecars without the keys default to "no lineage".
        ConversionJob plain = new ConversionJob("job-plain", "T",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertEquals(-1L, plain.replaceTakeId);
        assertNull(plain.replaceTitle);
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsEveryJob() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw1 = new File(dir, "sweep1.wav");
        File raw2 = new File(dir, "sweep2.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw1, "rw").close();
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw2, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob j1 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-1", "One",
                raw1.getAbsolutePath(), raw1.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob j2 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-2", "Two",
                raw2.getAbsolutePath(), raw2.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        j1.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        j2.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
        j1.write();
        j2.write();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean f1 = false, f2 = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-1")) f1 = true;
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-2")) f2 = true;
            }
            assertTrue("first job lost", f1);
            assertTrue("second job lost (only first resumed)", f2);
        } finally {
            try {
                raw1.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                raw2.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            j1.deleteSidecar();
            j2.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-1", true);
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-2", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void dispatchSaveReplaceCancelsActiveConversionAndDeletesPreviousFileImmediately()
            throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // Case 1: Original take is still converting when user edits and chooses Replace
        File origRaw = new File(dir, "orig_conv_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(origRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 48000L * 2 * 4));
            w.write(new byte[48000 * 2 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJob origJob = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), origRaw,
                "Original Take", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
        long origSyntheticId = origJob.takeId();
        assertTrue("original job must be active",
                ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId) != null);

        // User edits in Studio and chooses a different format (OPUS) + Replace
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r1 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.OPUS, null,
                origSyntheticId, "Original Take");
        try {
            assertNull("original conversion must be cancelled immediately",
                    ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId));
            assertFalse("original raw must be deleted immediately",
                    origRaw.exists());
            assertFalse("original sidecar must be deleted immediately",
                    origJob.sidecar().exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must start immediately", r1.job);
            assertEquals("Original Take", r1.job.title);
            assertEquals("opus", r1.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r1.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r1.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r1.job.jobId, true);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }

        // Case 2: Original conversion finished (or was already a finished file)
        // before user clicked Replace -> must delete old file & Take immediately
        // before the new conversion runs!
        File finishedFile = new File(dir, "orig_done_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(finishedFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take oldTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                finishedFile, 1000, "Finished Take", "M4A");
        String finishedRawPath = new File(dir, "orig_done_raw.wav").getAbsolutePath();
        long finishedSyntheticId = -777777L;
        ConversionJobs.noteTakeRaw(finishedSyntheticId, finishedRawPath);
        ConversionJobs.noteCompletion(finishedRawPath, oldTake.id);

        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session 2", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r2 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.FLAC, null,
                finishedSyntheticId, "Finished Take");
        try {
            assertNull("old Take row must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    TakesRepository.find(oldTake.id));
            assertFalse("old file on disk must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    finishedFile.exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must be enqueued immediately", r2.job);
            assertEquals("Finished Take", r2.job.title);
            assertEquals("flac", r2.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r2.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r2.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r2.job.jobId, true);
            ConversionJobs.forgetCompletion(finishedRawPath);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void persistentFloatMasterLifecycleForRecordingsImportsAndCleanup()
            throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // 1) Recorded take saved as M4A: raw 32-bit float file is maintained in .float32/
        File recRaw = new File(dir, "rec_float_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(recRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        File recFinal = new File(dir, "rec_float_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(recFinal, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take recTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                recFinal, 1000, "Recorded Take", "M4A");
        ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                recRaw.getAbsolutePath(), recFinal);
        assertFalse("original scratch raw path must be moved out of takes/",
                recRaw.exists());
        File recMaster = TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(recFinal);
        assertNotNull(recMaster);
        assertTrue("persistent 32-bit float master must exist in .float32/",
                recMaster.exists());
        assertEquals("resolveFloatMaster must return the persistent float32 file",
                recMaster.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(recFinal).getAbsolutePath());
        assertTrue("resolved master must be a native 32-bit float WAV",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(recFinal)));

        // 2) Recorded take saved as WAV32: already 32-bit float -> no redundant copy in .float32/
        File wav32Raw = new File(dir, "rec_w32_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav32Raw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        File wav32Final = new File(dir, "rec_w32_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav32Final, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                wav32Raw.getAbsolutePath(), wav32Final);
        assertFalse("wav32 raw must be deleted to avoid duplicate files",
                wav32Raw.exists());
        assertFalse("wav32 final must not create a redundant .float32 copy",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(wav32Final).exists());
        assertEquals(wav32Final.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(wav32Final).getAbsolutePath());
        wav32Final.delete();

        // 3) Imported recording: no float32 file until first Edit, then persisted on first Edit
        File impFile = new File(dir, "imp_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(impFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wav16Header(1, 48000, 4800L * 2));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 2]);
        }
        Take impTake = TakesRepository.addImported(
                impFile, 1000, "Imported Take", "WAV");
        assertEquals("imported", impTake.origin);
        assertFalse("imported file must not have a float32 master before first edit",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
        assertFalse("16-bit imported file is not native float32 yet",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(impFile)));

        // Simulate first Edit press on the imported take
        File firstEditSession = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(
                impFile, dir, "Imported_Take", null);
        TakesRepository.saveFloatMasterCopy(firstEditSession, impFile);
        firstEditSession.delete();
        assertTrue("float32 master must be created and persisted on first edit",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
        assertTrue("subsequent edits must resolve directly to native float32 master",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(impFile)));

        // 4) Replace & Delete clean up both the main file and the .float32 master
        assertTrue(TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(recTake.id));
        assertFalse("replaced take file must be deleted", recFinal.exists());
        assertFalse("replaced take float32 master must be deleted",
                recMaster.exists());

        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(impTake.id);
        assertFalse("deleted imported file must be removed", impFile.exists());
        assertFalse("deleted imported float32 master must be removed",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
    }
}

FILE: takeone_save_and_paywall_fixes (2).txt

========================================================================================
TAKEONE STUDIO — FIRST-RECORDING EDIT FIX, FORMAT CONVERTER UNLOCK & CONVERSION PROGRESS
========================================================================================

SUMMARY OF CHANGES
------------------
1. Allow All Editing Options on the First Recording After Saving & Re-Editing (`TrialAndBillingManager.java`, `StudioFragment.java`, `TakesRepository.java`, `ConversionJob.java`, `ConversionJobs.java`, `ConversionService.java`):
   - Every recording is assigned a unique immutable positive ID (`TakesRepository.allocateId()`) persisted monotonically in SharedPreferences (`next_recording_id`).
   - Both the converted library-visible recording (`Take.id` + `Take.filePath`) and its separate 32-bit float master (`takes/.float32/rec_<id>.f32.wav`) are linked to that immutable ID (`ConversionJob.recordingId` and `ConversionJobs.SaveResult.recordingId`), and preserved across Save -> Replace and Rename (`TakesRepository.rename` renames the converted file on disk while keeping `rec_<id>.f32.wav` linked by ID).
   - `TrialAndBillingManager` binds the free allowance to the first recording's immutable ID (`free_recording_id`). `getFreeRecordingId()`, `onRecordingSaved()`, `isFreeRecordingUsed()`, and `hasProAccessForRecording()` automatically re-bind if previous takes were deleted or if upgrading from an earlier session without `free_recording_id`, and allow all editing tools whenever the user edits their first recording (`resolvedId == getFreeRecordingId()` or when editing the sole recording in the library).
   - `StudioFragment` passes `editSourceId` explicitly to `TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(requireActivity(), editSourceId, ...)` on every editing control and clears `editSourceId` / `EditLink` synchronously on the UI thread before launching the save worker thread so an async completion callback never clobbers a subsequent Edit session.

2. Enable Format Converter (Recording Settings) Along With Teleprompter on All Recordings (`StudioFragment.java`, `TrialAndBillingManager.java`):
   - Removed the paywall gate from `StudioFragment.showRecordingSettings()` so the Format Converter (`Auto`, `M4A`, `WAV 16`, `WAV 24`, `WAV 32`, `FLAC`, `OPUS`, `AMR`) and Recording Preset selector are accessible on all recordings alongside the Teleprompter.
   - Updated `StudioFragment.paint()` so `formatBadge` and `settingsRow` remain enabled (`!saving`), clickable (`!saving`), and undimmed (`1f` alpha) on subsequent recordings.

3. Show Live Format Conversion Progress in Library (`item_take.xml`, `TakesAdapter.java`, `StudioFragment.java`, `ConversionJobs.java`, `ConversionService.java`, `FormatConverter.java`, `LibraryFragment.java`):
   - Moved `@+id/convProgress` (horizontal `ProgressBar`) out of `@+id/expanded` (`android:visibility="gone"`) directly into `@+id/cardRoot` in `app/src/main/res/layout/item_take.xml` so the conversion progress bar is immediately visible on converting cards in the Library even when collapsed.
   - Updated `TakesAdapter.paintConvProgress()` to keep `convProgress` visible, update the cached `Take.convProgress` / `dateLabel` in-place, and fall back to `notifyForId(id)` if the ViewHolder has not been bound yet.
   - Updated `StudioFragment` (`startOrResumeCapture`, `showRecordingSettings`, `runSaveDispatch`) and `ConversionJobs.dispatchSave()` so saving from Studio always enqueues a `ConversionJob` and immediately starts `ConversionService.startJob(appCtx, r.job.jobId)` rather than silently pre-encoding in the background and bypassing the Library conversion progress card.
   - Updated `FormatConverter` (`toWav16`, `toWav24`, `toWav32`, `encodeMuxed`, `toFlac`) to use ~25-step progress chunks when a `Progress` callback is attached (preserving full unthrottled chunk sizes when `cb == null` for benchmarks), and paced `ConversionService.runJob()` progress updates so `0% -> ... -> 100%` visibly animates on the Library card.
   - Removed the pre-post `if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;` guard on the background caller thread in `LibraryFragment.repoListener` and `LibraryFragment.jobsListener` so job-enqueue events emitted during the Studio -> Library fragment transition are never dropped.

4. Button States & Disabled Non-Clickable Controls (`StudioFragment.java`, `TeleValue.java`, `PressAnim.java`):
   - On the 1st recording (and for Paid Pro), inactive editing buttons are non-clickable (`setEnabled(false)`, `setClickable(false)`, `alpha = 0.35f`), while on subsequent recordings locked editing buttons remain clickable (`setEnabled(true)`, `setClickable(true)`, `alpha = 0.35f`) so tapping any of them opens the Google Play Billing paywall.
   - `TeleValue` and `PressAnim` support `paywallInterceptor` and ignore disabled/non-clickable views on touch down.
