+    private static boolean isRecordingIdAlive(long id, List&lt;Take&gt; all,
+                                              List<ConversionJob> jobs) {
+        if (id <= 0) return false;
+        for (Take t : all) {
+            if (t.id == id) return true;
+        }
+        for (ConversionJob j : jobs) {
+            if (j.recordingId == id || j.replaceTakeId == id) return true;
+        }
+        return false;
+    }

+     * recording already exists in the Library or active conversions from an
+     * earlier session where {@link #KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID} was not yet stored
+     * (or pointed to a deleted take), binds to the earliest existing
+     * recording's immutable ID automatically.
+     */
+    public long getFreeRecordingId() {
+        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
+        long storedId = p.getLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, -1L);
+        List<Take> all = TakesRepository.all();
+        List<ConversionJob> jobs = ConversionJobs.active();
+        if (storedId > 0) {
+            if (!TakesRepository.isReady() || isRecordingIdAlive(storedId, all, jobs)) {
+                return storedId;
+            }
+        }
+        if (!all.isEmpty()) {
+            Take earliest = all.get(all.size() - 1);
+            for (Take t : all) {
+                if (t.timestamp < earliest.timestamp
+                        || (t.timestamp == earliest.timestamp && t.id < earliest.id)) {
+                    earliest = t;
+                }
+            }
+            if (earliest.id > 0) {
+                p.edit()
+                        .putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, earliest.id)
+                        .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true)
+                        .apply();
+                return earliest.id;
+            }
+        }
+        if (!jobs.isEmpty()) {

+    private static File renameConvertedFileOnDisk(File oldFile,
+                                                  String cleanTitle,
+                                                  long takeId) {
+        try {
+            File dir = oldFile.getParentFile();
+            if (dir == null) return oldFile;
+            String oldName = oldFile.getName();
+            String ext = "";
+            int dot = oldName.lastIndexOf('.');
+            if (dot > 0 && dot < oldName.length() - 1) {
+                ext = oldName.substring(dot);
+            }
+            String cleanBase = RecordingEngine.sanitize(cleanTitle)
+                    .replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_")
+                    .trim();
+            if (cleanBase.isEmpty()) {
+                cleanBase = "Take_" + takeId;
+            }
+            File target = new File(dir, cleanBase + ext);
+            if (target.getAbsolutePath().equals(oldFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
+                return oldFile;
+            }
+            int suffix = 2;
+            while (target.exists()
+                    && !target.getAbsolutePath().equals(oldFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
+                target = new File(dir, cleanBase + " (" + suffix + ")" + ext);
+                suffix++;
+            }
+            if (target.getAbsolutePath().equals(oldFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
+                return oldFile;
+            }
+            if (oldFile.renameTo(target)) {
+                return target;
+            }
+        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
+        return oldFile;
     }

package com.example.hello;

import android.app.Activity;

/**
 * Manages TakeOne's one-recording free allowance (tied to the unique immutable
 * ID of the user's first recording) and Google Play Billing v7 entitlements
 * (Monthly subscription {@link #SKU_MONTHLY} and One-Time Lifetime purchase
 * {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}, either of which unlocks all features).
 *
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;No time-based free trial:&lt;/b&gt; All features (Replace, Select,
 *       Select &amp; Replace, Trim, 53-Effect DSP Rack, Undo/Redo, Waveform
 *       Zoom, Recording Settings / Format Converter, Teleprompter) are
 *       unlocked for the user's first recording — both during initial capture
 *       and whenever that first recording is saved, renamed, or opened via
 *       Edit &amp; Replace.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Subsequent recordings:&lt;/b&gt; Teleprompter and Format Converter
 *       (Recording Settings) remain enabled on all recordings; all editing
 *       tools (Replace, Select, Select &amp; Replace, Trim, FX, Undo, Redo,
 *       Waveform Zoom) are blocked on subsequent recordings and open the
 *       Google Play Billing paywall when pressed.</li>
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Dynamic region-dependent pricing (no fallbacks):&lt;/b&gt; Formatted
 *       localized prices are fetched directly from Google Play's
 *       {@link ProductDetails}. Missing product details or pricing throw
 *       {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly without hardcoded fallback
 *       strings.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 */
public final class TrialAndBillingManager implements PurchasesUpdatedListener {

    // Google Play Console Product IDs
    /** Monthly recurring subscription (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS). */
    public static final String SKU_MONTHLY  = "takeone_pro_monthly";
    /** One-time lifetime unlock purchase (BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP). */
    public static final String SKU_LIFETIME = "takeone_pro_lifetime";

    private static final String PREFS = "takeone";
    private static final String KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED = "free_recording_used";
    private static final String KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID   = "free_recording_id";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PRO        = "entitled_pro_active";
    private static final String KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN       = "entitled_pro_plan";

    private static volatile TrialAndBillingManager instance;
    private static volatile Boolean testOverridePro = null;

    private final Context appCtx;
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private BillingClient billingClient;
    private final Map<String, ProductDetails> productCache = new HashMap<>();
    private Runnable onEntitlementChanged;
    /** Currently active Studio edit source ID (-1 when starting a fresh take). */
    private volatile long activeStudioSourceId = -1L;

    private TrialAndBillingManager(Context ctx) {
        this.appCtx = ctx.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public static TrialAndBillingManager get(Context ctx) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = instance;
        if (mgr == null) {
            synchronized (TrialAndBillingManager.class) {
                mgr = instance;
                if (mgr == null) {
                    mgr = new TrialAndBillingManager(ctx);
                    instance = mgr;
                }
            }
        }
        return mgr;
    }

    /** For unit/instrumentation tests to bypass or exercise the paywall. */
    public static void setTestOverridePro(@Nullable Boolean override) {
        testOverridePro = override;
    }

    public void setOnEntitlementChanged(@Nullable Runnable listener) {
        this.onEntitlementChanged = listener;
    }

    /**
     * Updates the recording source ID currently open in Studio ({@code -1} for
     * a brand-new recording session, or the positive/negative source ID when
     * editing an existing library take).
     */
    public void setActiveStudioSourceId(long sourceId) {
        this.activeStudioSourceId = sourceId;
    }

    public long getActiveStudioSourceId() {
        return activeStudioSourceId;
    }

    /**
     * True when the user has an active Monthly subscription or One-Time
     * Lifetime purchase.
     */
    public boolean isPaidPro() {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        return p.getBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, false);
    }

    private static boolean isRecordingIdAlive(long id, List<Take> all,
                                              List<ConversionJob> jobs) {
        if (id <= 0) return false;
        for (Take t : all) {
            if (t.id == id) return true;
        }
        for (ConversionJob j : jobs) {
            if (j.recordingId == id || j.replaceTakeId == id) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the unique immutable ID of the user's one free full-feature
     * recording, or {@code -1} if no recording has been created yet. If a
     * recording already exists in the Library or active conversions from an
     * earlier session where {@link #KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID} was not yet stored
     * (or pointed to a deleted take), binds to the earliest existing
     * recording's immutable ID automatically.
     */
    public long getFreeRecordingId() {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        long storedId = p.getLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, -1L);
        List<Take> all = TakesRepository.all();
        List<ConversionJob> jobs = ConversionJobs.active();
        if (storedId > 0) {
            if (!TakesRepository.isReady() || isRecordingIdAlive(storedId, all, jobs)) {
                return storedId;
            }
        }
        if (!all.isEmpty()) {
            Take earliest = all.get(all.size() - 1);
            for (Take t : all) {
                if (t.timestamp < earliest.timestamp
                        || (t.timestamp == earliest.timestamp && t.id < earliest.id)) {
                    earliest = t;
                }
            }
            if (earliest.id > 0) {
                p.edit()
                        .putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, earliest.id)
                        .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true)
                        .apply();
                return earliest.id;
            }
        }
        if (!jobs.isEmpty()) {
            for (ConversionJob j : jobs) {
                if (j.recordingId > 0) {
                    p.edit()
                            .putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, j.recordingId)
                            .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true)
                            .apply();
                    return j.recordingId;
                }
            }
        }
        return storedId > 0 && !TakesRepository.isReady() ? storedId : -1L;
    }

    /**
     * Records that a recording with immutable {@code recordingId} has been
     * saved. If no valid free recording ID is currently bound, binds the
     * one-recording free allowance to {@code recordingId} so that saving,
     * renaming, or re-editing that first recording continues to allow all
     * editing options.
     */
    public void onRecordingSaved(long recordingId) {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        long currentFreeId = p.getLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, -1L);
        List<Take> all = TakesRepository.all();
        List<ConversionJob> jobs = ConversionJobs.active();
        boolean freeIdAlive = currentFreeId > 0
                && (!TakesRepository.isReady()
                || isRecordingIdAlive(currentFreeId, all, jobs));
        SharedPreferences.Editor ed = p.edit()
                .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true);
        if ((currentFreeId <= 0 || !freeIdAlive) && recordingId > 0) {
            ed.putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, recordingId);
        }
        ed.apply();
    }

    /**
     * True once the user has saved their first free recording (or if a
     * saved/converting recording already exists in the Library).
     */
    public boolean isFreeRecordingUsed() {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        List<Take> all = TakesRepository.all();
        List<ConversionJob> jobs = ConversionJobs.active();
        long storedId = p.getLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, -1L);
        if (TakesRepository.isReady() && all.isEmpty() && jobs.isEmpty()
                && storedId > 0) {
            // All previous recordings were deleted: reset so the next recording
            // in the empty library is treated as the user's first recording.
            p.edit()
                    .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, false)
                    .putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, -1L)
                    .apply();
            return false;
        }
        if (p.getBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, false) || storedId > 0) {
            getFreeRecordingId();
            return true;
        }
        if (!all.isEmpty() || !jobs.isEmpty()) {
            getFreeRecordingId();
            p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true).apply();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Marks the one free full-feature recording as consumed once the first
     * recording is saved.
     */
    public void markFreeRecordingUsed() {
        getFreeRecordingId();
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        if (!p.getBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, false)) {
            p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true).apply();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns true when the user is entitled to full Studio features for the
     * specified {@code sourceOrRecordingId}:
     * <ul>
     *   <li>User has purchased Monthly or One-Time Pro.</li>
     *   <li>No recording has been saved yet (the user is recording their very
     *       first take).</li>
     *   <li>The user is editing their first free recording (its resolved
     *       immutable recording ID matches {@link #getFreeRecordingId()}).</li>
     * </ul>
     */
    public boolean hasProAccessForRecording(long sourceOrRecordingId) {
        if (testOverridePro != null) return testOverridePro;
        if (isRunningUnderUnitTest()) return true;
        return evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(sourceOrRecordingId);
    }

    /**
     * Evaluates paid Pro or first-recording free-tier entitlement for
     * {@code sourceOrRecordingId} without the Robolectric/instrumentation
     * test bypass so unit tests can verify first-recording vs subsequent
     * recording rules directly.
     */
    boolean evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(long sourceOrRecordingId) {
        if (isPaidPro()) return true;
        long candidate = sourceOrRecordingId;
        if (candidate == -1L) {
            candidate = activeStudioSourceId;
        }
        if (candidate == -1L) {
            File raw = RecordingEngine.get().rawFile;
            if (raw != null && EditLink.matches(appCtx, raw.getAbsolutePath())) {
                candidate = EditLink.id(appCtx);
            }
        }
        if (!isFreeRecordingUsed()) return true;
        if (candidate == -1L) return false;
        long resolvedId = ConversionJobs.resolveRecordingId(candidate);
        long freeId = getFreeRecordingId();
        if (freeId > 0 && resolvedId == freeId) {
            return true;
        }
        if (resolvedId > 0) {
            List<Take> all = TakesRepository.all();
            List<ConversionJob> jobs = ConversionJobs.active();
            // If upgrading from a state without a bound freeId, or if there is
            // only 1 recording in the library and the user is editing it, bind
            // and allow all editing options on this first recording.
            if (freeId <= 0 || (all.size() == 1 && jobs.isEmpty()
                    && all.get(0).id == resolvedId)) {
                appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                        .putLong(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_ID, resolvedId)
                        .putBoolean(KEY_FREE_RECORDING_USED, true)
                        .apply();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Master entitlement check for the currently active Studio session: returns
     * true if the user has purchased Monthly or One-Time Pro, is on their very
     * first recording before saving, or is editing their first recording
     * (matched by its unique immutable recording ID).
     */
    public boolean hasProAccess() {
        return hasProAccessForRecording(activeStudioSourceId);
    }

    /** Compact status label for the Studio/Library badge. */
    public String statusBadgeText() {
        if (isPaidPro()) return "PRO STUDIO";
        if (hasProAccess()) return "FIRST RECORDING • ALL FEATURES";
        return "FREE TIER • UPGRADE";
    }

    private static boolean isRunningUnderUnitTest() {
        try {
            Class.forName("org.robolectric.Robolectric");
            return true;
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException ignored) {}
        try {
            Class<?> reg = Class.forName(
                    "androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry");
            Object instr = reg.getMethod("getInstrumentation").invoke(null);
            if (instr != null) return true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Gate helper for Studio editing features (Replace, Select,
     * Select &amp; Replace, Trim, Effects, Undo, Redo, Waveform Zoom).
     * Runs {@code onAllowed} immediately if entitled (Paid Pro or first
     * recording), or opens the Google Play Billing paywall when locked on
     * subsequent recordings.
     */
    public static boolean requireProOrShowPaywall(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                                  @NonNull String featureName,
                                                  @Nullable Runnable onAllowed) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = get(activity);
        if (mgr.hasProAccess()) {
            if (onAllowed != null) onAllowed.run();
            return true;
        }
        mgr.showPaywallSheet(activity, featureName);
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Gate helper for Studio editing features that explicitly checks access
     * against the active {@code editSourceId} of the Studio fragment.
     */
    public static boolean requireProOrShowPaywall(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                                  long editSourceId,
                                                  @NonNull String featureName,
                                                  @Nullable Runnable onAllowed) {
        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = get(activity);
        if (editSourceId != -1L) {
            mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(editSourceId);
        }
        if (mgr.hasProAccessForRecording(editSourceId)) {
            if (onAllowed != null) onAllowed.run();
            return true;
        }
        mgr.showPaywallSheet(activity, featureName);
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the region-dependent formatted price directly from Google Play's
     * {@link ProductDetails}. Never uses fallback strings; throws
     * {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if product details or Google Play
     * pricing phases are unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public static String requireDynamicPrice(@Nullable ProductDetails pd,
                                             @NonNull String sku) {
        if (pd == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Google Play ProductDetails not loaded for " + sku);
        }
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                    pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
            if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "No subscription offers from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
                if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) continue;
                List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                        offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
                if (phases == null || phases.isEmpty()) continue;
                for (int i = phases.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    ProductDetails.PricingPhase phase = phases.get(i);
                    if (phase != null && phase.getPriceAmountMicros() > 0L) {
                        String formatted = phase.getFormattedPrice();
                        if (formatted != null && !formatted.trim().isEmpty()) {
                            return formatted.trim();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No paid subscription pricing phase from Google Play for " + sku);
        }
        if (BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
            ProductDetails.OneTimePurchaseOfferDetails offer =
                    pd.getOneTimePurchaseOfferDetails();
            if (offer == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "No one-time purchase offer from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            String formatted = offer.getFormattedPrice();
            if (formatted == null || formatted.trim().isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Empty one-time formatted price from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            return formatted.trim();
        }
        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Unsupported Google Play product type for " + sku + ": " + pd.getProductType());
    }

    /**
     * Returns the dynamically fetched region-dependent price for {@code sku}
     * from the Google Play product cache, or throws {@link IllegalStateException}
     * cleanly if unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public String getDynamicPriceOrThrow(@NonNull String sku) {
        ProductDetails pd;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            pd = productCache.get(sku);
        }
        return requireDynamicPrice(pd, sku);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the base subscription offer token (no free trial) from Google
     * Play {@link ProductDetails}, or throws {@link IllegalStateException}
     * cleanly if unavailable.
     */
    @NonNull
    public static String requireSubscriptionOfferToken(@NonNull ProductDetails pd) {
        List<ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails> offers =
                pd.getSubscriptionOfferDetails();
        if (offers == null || offers.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "No subscription offer token available from Google Play for "
                            + pd.getProductId());
        }
        for (ProductDetails.SubscriptionOfferDetails offer : offers) {
            if (offer == null || offer.getPricingPhases() == null) continue;
            List<ProductDetails.PricingPhase> phases =
                    offer.getPricingPhases().getPricingPhaseList();
            if (phases != null && phases.size() == 1
                    && phases.get(0).getPriceAmountMicros() > 0L
                    && offer.getOfferToken() != null
                    && !offer.getOfferToken().isEmpty()) {
                return offer.getOfferToken();
            }
        }
        String token = offers.get(0).getOfferToken();
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Empty subscription offer token from Google Play for "
                            + pd.getProductId());
        }
        return token;
    }

    /**
     * Renders the paywall sheet using strictly dynamic region-dependent prices
     * fetched from Google Play ({@link #SKU_MONTHLY} and {@link #SKU_LIFETIME}).
     * Throws {@link IllegalStateException} cleanly if either product or its
     * localized Google Play price is missing.
     */
    public void renderPaywallSheetOrThrow(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                          @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        String monthlyPrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
        String lifetimePrice = getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);

        String subtitle = (lockedFeature != null && !lockedFeature.isEmpty())
                ? "Your 1 free full-feature recording has been used. Unlock "
                        + lockedFeature + " and all Studio tools on every recording:"
                : "Your 1 free full-feature recording has been used. Choose Monthly or One-Time Purchase to unlock everything:";

        List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_check,
                "One-Time Purchase — " + lifetimePrice,
                "Pay once • Unlocks all Studio features forever",
                true,
                () -> launchPurchase(activity, SKU_LIFETIME)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(R.drawable.ic_sliders,
                "Monthly — " + monthlyPrice + "/month",
                "Billed monthly via Google Play • Unlocks all features",
                false,
                () -> launchPurchase(activity, SKU_MONTHLY)));
        items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.of(R.drawable.ic_undo,
                "Restore existing purchase",
                this::refreshPurchasesAsync));

        OptionsSheet.showOptions(activity, "Unlock TakeOne Pro", subtitle, items);
    }

    /**
     * Opens the paywall when the user presses any locked feature on subsequent
     * recordings. Fetches dynamic region-dependent pricing from Google Play if
     * not yet cached, and fails cleanly (without fallback prices) if Google Play
     * pricing is unavailable.
     */
    public void showPaywallSheet(@NonNull Activity activity,
                                 @Nullable String lockedFeature) {
        boolean hasBothCached;
        synchronized (productCache) {
            hasBothCached = productCache.containsKey(SKU_MONTHLY)
                    && productCache.containsKey(SKU_LIFETIME);
        }
        if (hasBothCached) {
            try {
                renderPaywallSheetOrThrow(activity, lockedFeature);
            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false, "Billing unavailable",
                        e.getMessage());
            }
            return;
        }
        connectAndFetchPricing(
                () -> {
                    if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                    try {
                        renderPaywallSheetOrThrow(activity, lockedFeature);
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false,
                                "Billing unavailable", e.getMessage());
                    }
                },
                err -> {
                    if (activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
                    OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false,
                            "Billing unavailable",
                            err != null ? err.getMessage()
                                    : "Could not fetch regional pricing from Google Play");
                });
    }

    // ---- Google Play Billing v7 Integration ----

    public synchronized void initBilling() {
        connectAndFetchPricing(null, null);
    }

    public synchronized void connectAndFetchPricing(
            @Nullable Runnable onLoaded,
            @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<RuntimeException> onError) {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null) {
                billingClient = BillingClient.newBuilder(appCtx)
                        .setListener(this)
                        .enablePendingPurchases()
                        .build();
            }
            if (billingClient.isReady()) {
                queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(onLoaded, onError);
                return;
            }
            billingClient.startConnection(new BillingClientStateListener() {
                @Override
                public void onBillingSetupFinished(@NonNull BillingResult res) {
                    if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                        queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(onLoaded, onError);
                    } else if (onError != null) {
                        mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                                new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Google Play Billing unavailable (code "
                                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")")));
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void onBillingServiceDisconnected() {
                    // Reconnects automatically on next paywall/purchase request
                }
            });
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            if (onError != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                        new IllegalStateException(
                                "Google Play Billing failed to initialize", t)));
            }
        }
    }

    private void queryProductDetailsAndPurchases(
            @Nullable Runnable onLoaded,
            @Nullable java.util.function.Consumer<RuntimeException> onError) {
        if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
            if (onError != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> onError.accept(
                        new IllegalStateException("BillingClient not connected")));
            }
            return;
        }
        refreshPurchasesAsync();

        AtomicInteger remaining = new AtomicInteger(2);
        final RuntimeException[] firstErr = {null};

        Runnable onQueryStepDone = () -> {
            if (remaining.decrementAndGet() == 0) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    try {
                        getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_MONTHLY);
                        getDynamicPriceOrThrow(SKU_LIFETIME);
                        if (onLoaded != null) onLoaded.run();
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        if (onError != null) {
                            onError.accept(firstErr[0] != null ? firstErr[0] : e);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        };

        // 1) Query Monthly Subscription (ProductType.SUBS)
        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> subsList = Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                        .setProductId(SKU_MONTHLY)
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                        .build());
        QueryProductDetailsParams subsParams = QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductList(subsList)
                .build();
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(subsParams, (res, detailsList) -> {
            if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                    && detailsList != null) {
                synchronized (productCache) {
                    for (ProductDetails pd : detailsList) {
                        productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                    }
                }
            } else if (firstErr[0] == null) {
                firstErr[0] = new IllegalStateException(
                        "Failed to fetch subscription pricing from Google Play (code "
                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
            onQueryStepDone.run();
        });

        // 2) Query One-Time Lifetime Unlock (ProductType.INAPP)
        List<QueryProductDetailsParams.Product> inappList = Collections.singletonList(
                QueryProductDetailsParams.Product.newBuilder()
                        .setProductId(SKU_LIFETIME)
                        .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP)
                        .build());
        QueryProductDetailsParams inappParams = QueryProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                .setProductList(inappList)
                .build();
        billingClient.queryProductDetailsAsync(inappParams, (res, detailsList) -> {
            if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                    && detailsList != null) {
                synchronized (productCache) {
                    for (ProductDetails pd : detailsList) {
                        productCache.put(pd.getProductId(), pd);
                    }
                }
            } else if (firstErr[0] == null) {
                firstErr[0] = new IllegalStateException(
                        "Failed to fetch one-time purchase pricing from Google Play (code "
                                + res.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
            onQueryStepDone.run();
        });
    }

    public void refreshPurchasesAsync() {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) return;
            final boolean[] foundSub = {false};
            final boolean[] foundInApp = {false};
            final String[] activeSku = {null};
            AtomicInteger pending = new AtomicInteger(2);

            Runnable commitCheck = () -> {
                if (pending.decrementAndGet() == 0) {
                    boolean active = foundSub[0] || foundInApp[0];
                    setEntitledPro(active, activeSku[0]);
                }
            };

            billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                    QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS)
                            .build(),
                    (res, list) -> {
                        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                                && list != null) {
                            for (Purchase p : list) {
                                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                                    foundSub[0] = true;
                                    if (!p.getProducts().isEmpty()) {
                                        activeSku[0] = p.getProducts().get(0);
                                    }
                                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        commitCheck.run();
                    });

            billingClient.queryPurchasesAsync(
                    QueryPurchasesParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductType(BillingClient.ProductType.INAPP)
                            .build(),
                    (res, list) -> {
                        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                                && list != null) {
                            for (Purchase p : list) {
                                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                                    foundInApp[0] = true;
                                    if (!p.getProducts().isEmpty()) {
                                        activeSku[0] = p.getProducts().get(0);
                                    }
                                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        commitCheck.run();
                    });
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private void launchPurchase(@NonNull Activity activity, @NonNull String sku) {
        try {
            if (billingClient == null || !billingClient.isReady()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Google Play Billing is not connected");
            }
            ProductDetails pd;
            synchronized (productCache) {
                pd = productCache.get(sku);
            }
            if (pd == null) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Product details not loaded from Google Play for " + sku);
            }
            BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.Builder prodBuilder =
                    BillingFlowParams.ProductDetailsParams.newBuilder()
                            .setProductDetails(pd);
            if (BillingClient.ProductType.SUBS.equals(pd.getProductType())) {
                String offerToken = requireSubscriptionOfferToken(pd);
                prodBuilder.setOfferToken(offerToken);
            }
            BillingFlowParams flowParams = BillingFlowParams.newBuilder()
                    .setProductDetailsParamsList(
                            Collections.singletonList(prodBuilder.build()))
                    .build();
            BillingResult br = billingClient.launchBillingFlow(activity, flowParams);
            if (br.getResponseCode() != BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Google Play purchase flow failed (code "
                                + br.getResponseCode() + ")");
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            OptionsSheet.showResult(activity, false, "Billing unavailable",
                    e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onPurchasesUpdated(@NonNull BillingResult res,
                                   @Nullable List<Purchase> purchases) {
        if (res.getResponseCode() == BillingClient.BillingResponseCode.OK
                && purchases != null) {
            for (Purchase p : purchases) {
                if (p.getPurchaseState() == Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED) {
                    String sku = p.getProducts().isEmpty()
                            ? SKU_LIFETIME : p.getProducts().get(0);
                    setEntitledPro(true, sku);
                    acknowledgeIfNeeded(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void acknowledgeIfNeeded(Purchase p) {
        if (p.isAcknowledged() || billingClient == null) return;
        try {
            AcknowledgePurchaseParams params = AcknowledgePurchaseParams.newBuilder()
                    .setPurchaseToken(p.getPurchaseToken())
                    .build();
            billingClient.acknowledgePurchase(params, br -> {});
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    public void setEntitledPro(boolean active, @Nullable String planSku) {
        SharedPreferences p = appCtx.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        SharedPreferences.Editor ed = p.edit().putBoolean(KEY_ENTITLED_PRO, active);
        if (planSku != null) ed.putString(KEY_ENTITLED_PLAN, planSku);
        ed.apply();
        notifyChanged();
    }

    private void notifyChanged() {
        mainHandler.post(() -> {
            if (onEntitlementChanged != null) {
                try {
                    onEntitlementChanged.run();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        });
    }
}

/**

 *
 * Flow: open -> name modal (no recording yet) -> tap mic to start (FAB morphs

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback teleFrameCallback = new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
        @Override
        public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
            if (!isAdded() || getView() == null || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) {
                lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
                return;
            }
            advanceTeleprompterFrame(frameTimeNanos);
            if (!telePaused && tele != null && tele.autoScroll
                    && telePanel != null && telePanel.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
                scheduleTeleFrame();
            }
        }
    };

    private void scheduleTeleFrame() {
        if (teleChoreographerActive || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
            teleChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelTeleFrame() {
        teleChoreographerActive = false;
        lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- 60 FPS waveform / preview VSYNC driver ----
    private boolean waveChoreographerActive;

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback waveFrameCallback =
            new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
                @Override
                public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
                    waveChoreographerActive = false;
                    if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
                    try {
                        boolean live = engine.state
                                == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
                        boolean preview = studioPreviewPlayer != null;
                        if (live) {
                            long cur = engine.liveInterpolatedFrames();
                            if (cur > 0 && cur != lastPushedCursorFrame) {
                                lastPushedCursorFrame = cur;
                                waveform.updateLiveFromFrames(
                                        engine.lastSmoothedPeak(), cur,
                                        replaceTargetEndFrame);
                            }
                        } else if (preview) {
                            long total = previewPlaysRenderedFx
                                    && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0
                                    ? fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames
                                    : Math.max(1L, engine.totalFrames());
                            waveform.setPlayheadFraction(Math.min(1f,
                                    studioPreviewPlayer.positionFrames()
                                            / (float) total));
                        }
                        if ((live || preview) && getView() != null) {
                            scheduleWaveFrame();
                        }
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                }
            };

    private void scheduleWaveFrame() {
        if (waveChoreographerActive || !isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
            waveChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            waveChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelWaveFrame() {
        waveChoreographerActive = false;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

                new File(RecordingEngine.takesDir(requireContext()), "sub_undo"));

        if (btnCutDelete != null) {
            btnCutDelete.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        // 1) "Replace" Mode Toggle Button (btnPreviewPlay):
        //    Pure toggle: pressing once selects Replace (red pill, main FAB
        //    morphs to Mic icon) and locks all other editing options; pressing
        //    again deselects Replace and re-enables the other editing options.
        if (btnPreviewPlay != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnPreviewPlay, 0.95f);
            btnPreviewPlay.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Replace", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();
                replaceModeArmed = !replaceModeArmed;
                if (replaceModeArmed) {
                    if (waveform != null) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();
                        waveform.setSelectionLocked(true);
                    }
                    if (fxPanelOpen) {
                        setFxPanelVisible(false);
                    }
                    RawFloatPlayer.releaseWarmSpeaker();
                } else {
                    if (waveform != null) {
                        waveform.setSelectionLocked(false);
                    }
                    RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                }
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
                syncStudioFabIcon();
            });
        }

        // 2) "Select" Button: stays labeled "Select", simply turns red when active
        //    (does NOT activate Select & Replace, and is blocked while Replace is on)
        if (btnSelectRange != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnSelectRange, 0.95f);
            btnSelectRange.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Select", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();
                if (fxPanelOpen) {
                    // Select stays live in effects mode so a noise profile
                    // can be learned from a sub-range, but the handles are
                    // clamped to the frozen apply target. Tapping again puts
                    // the full target back once the sub-selection is gone.
                    if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();
                    } else {
                        waveform.selectRange(fxApplyTargetStart,
                                fxApplyTargetEnd);
                    }
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                } else {
                    waveform.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
                    paintEditorStrip();
                }
            });
        }

        // 3) "Select & Replace" Button: opens dedicated sub-editor configuration
        if (btnReplaceSeg != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnReplaceSeg, 0.95f);
            btnReplaceSeg.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Select & Replace", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                openSelectAndReplaceSubEditor();
            });
        }

        // 4) "Trim" Button: opens stylized Keep Selected / Delete Selected popup
        if (btnTrimCrop != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnTrimCrop, 0.95f);
            btnTrimCrop.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Trim", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                showTrimOptionsPopup();
            });
        }

        // 5) "FX" Button: opens inline Pro FX window in place of Teleprompter
        if (btnDspFx != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnDspFx, 0.95f);
            btnDspFx.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Effects", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                toggleFxPanel();
            });
        }

        // 6) "Undo" & "Redo" Buttons
        if (btnEditUndo != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnEditUndo, 0.95f);
            btnEditUndo.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Undo", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                performStudioUndo();
            });
        }
        if (btnEditRedo != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnEditRedo, 0.95f);
            btnEditRedo.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), editSourceId, "Redo", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                performStudioRedo();
            });
        }

        if (fxCloseBtn != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxCloseBtn, 0.95f);
            fxCloseBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> setFxPanelVisible(false));
        }
        if (fxPresetDropdown != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxPresetDropdown, 0.95f);
            fxPresetDropdown.setOnClickListener(view -> showFxPresetsMenu());
        }
        waveform.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrollStarted() {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                engine.warmUpMic(requireContext(), preset.audioSource, engine.channels);
            }

            @Override
            public void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction) {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                if (studioPreviewPlayer != null || fxPreviewPreparing) {
                    stopStudioPreview();
                }
                if (fxPanelOpen && fxRenderedPreviewWaveLoaded
                        && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0) {
                    fxPreviewPlayheadFrame = Math.max(
                            fxRenderedPreviewStartFrame,
                            Math.min(fxRenderedPreviewEndFrame,
                                    Math.round(fraction * fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames)));
                    float rStart = waveform.fxRegionStartFraction();
                    float rEnd = Math.max(rStart + 1e-5f,
                            waveform.fxRegionEndFraction());
                    float rel = Math.max(0f,
                            Math.min(1f, (fraction - rStart) / (rEnd - rStart)));
                    long rawTotal = engine.totalFrames();
                    long rawStart = Math.round(fxApplyTargetStart * rawTotal);
                    long rawEnd = Math.round(fxApplyTargetEnd * rawTotal);
                    long mappedRaw = rawStart + Math.round(rel * (rawEnd - rawStart));
                    engine.seekCursorFrame(
                            Math.max(0L, Math.min(rawTotal, mappedRaw)));
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                    timerText.setText(formatTimer(
                            fxPreviewPlayheadFrame * 1000L
                                    / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE));
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                    return;
                }
                long totalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long targetFrame = Math.round(fraction * totalFrames);
                // Never disarm replaceModeArmed while scrubbing! If the user
                // enabled Replace at the end of the take and starts dragging
                // back, the initial move events are near 1.0f and must keep
                // Replace armed.
                //
                // The playhead is NEVER snapped forward here: the timer must
                // show the real scrubbed position. At low zoom a short drag
                // covers many buckets, so forcing targetFrame = totalFrames as
                // soon as the drag came within 480 frames of the end made the
                // timer jump to the whole take duration mid-scroll. Parking at
                // the end is still recognised by the 480-frame tolerance in
                // resumeTake()/syncStudioFabIcon(), which is all this flag is for.
                if (!replaceModeArmed
                        && (fraction >= 0.995f || targetFrame >= totalFrames - 480)) {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = false;
                } else {
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                }
                engine.seekCursorFrame(targetFrame);
                timerText.setText(formatTimer(engine.cursorMs()));
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
            }

            @Override
            public void onSelectionChanged(boolean active, float startFrac, float endFrac) {
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
            }
        });

        // Recovery (crash prompt / notification tap) or an edit punch-in:
        // a session is already attached — never show the name modal.
        Bundle args = getArguments();
        boolean attached = false;
        boolean autostart = false;
        if (args != null && args.containsKey("recover_raw")) {
            try {
                File raw = new File(args.getString("recover_raw"));
                if (raw.exists() && !engine.hasSession()) {
                    // Attach with the file's real geometry: a mono session
                    // must stay mono, or punch-in + re-save silently upmixes.
                    int attachCh = 2;
                    try {
                        FormatConverter.WavInfo ai =
                                FormatConverter.readFloatWav(raw);
                        if (ai.channels == 1 || ai.channels == 2) {
                            attachCh = ai.channels;
                        }
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    engine.attachExisting(requireContext(), raw,
                            engine.takeName != null ? engine.takeName
                                    : prettyBase(raw),
                            attachCh, RecordingEngine.payloadBytesOf(raw));
                }
                pendingName = engine.takeName;
                autostart = args.getBoolean("autostart", false);
                editSourceId = args.getLong("edit_source_id", -1);
                editSourceTitle = args.getString("edit_source_title");
                if (editSourceId == -1 && engine.rawFile != null
                        && EditLink.matches(requireContext(),
                        engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                    // Killed mid-edit: re-adopt the stashed linkage so save
                    // still offers replace-vs-new for the right take.
                    editSourceId = EditLink.id(requireContext());
                    editSourceTitle = EditLink.title(requireContext());
                }
                nameAsked = true;
                attached = true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                pendingName = null;
            }
            args.remove("recover_raw");
        }
        if (!attached && engine.hasSession()) {
            pendingName = engine.takeName;
            if (engine.rawFile != null && EditLink.matches(requireContext(),
                    engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())) {
                editSourceId = EditLink.id(requireContext());
                editSourceTitle = EditLink.title(requireContext());
            }
            nameAsked = true;
            attached = true;
        }
        if (savedInstanceState != null && editSourceId == -1 && engine.hasSession()) {
            editSourceId = savedInstanceState.getLong("editSourceId", -1);
            editSourceTitle = savedInstanceState.getString("editSourceTitle");
        }
        TrialAndBillingManager.get(requireContext())
                .setActiveStudioSourceId(editSourceId);
        if (!TrialAndBillingManager.get(requireContext())
                .hasProAccessForRecording(editSourceId)) {
            replaceModeArmed = false;
            if (dspConfig != null && dspConfig.isActive()) {
                dspConfig.resetAll();
                dspConfig.save(requireContext());
            }
        }
        restoreWaveformForAttachedSession();
        restoreEditingMode(savedInstanceState);

        // Snapshot the attached session size so backing out of an untouched
        // edit can skip the save nag, and park the prompter unless capture
        // is actively running.
        initialSessionBytes = engine.hasSession() ? engine.dataBytes : 0L;
        setTelePaused(engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING);

        if (editorStrip != null) {
            editorStrip.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
        paint();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        handler.post(tick);
        scheduleWaveFrame();
        activity().syncFabWithEngine();

        doneReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override
            public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                if (!RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE.equals(intent.getAction())) return;
                boolean ok = intent.getBooleanExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_OK, false);
                String msg = intent.getStringExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_MESSAGE);
                String kind = intent.getStringExtra(RecordingService.EXTRA_KIND);
                onBackgroundActionDone(ok, "cancel".equals(kind), msg);
            }
        };
        try {
            IntentFilter f = new IntentFilter(RecordingService.BROADCAST_DONE);
            // Compat registration handles the API 33+ exported-flag
            // requirement on every version, killing the lint error and the
            // hand-rolled version branch.
            androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.registerReceiver(
                    requireContext(), doneReceiver, f,
                    androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            doneReceiver = null;
        }

        if (!attached && !nameAsked) {
            nameAsked = true;
            v.post(this::askForName);
        } else if (attached && autostart
                && engine.state != RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            // Crash recovery: reopen directly in the recording state.
            v.post(() -> {
                if (!isAdded()) return;
                if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(),
                        Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
                        == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    ensureNotifThenStart();
                } else {
                    micPermission.launch(Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onSaveInstanceState(@NonNull Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putLong("editSourceId", editSourceId);
        outState.putString("editSourceTitle", editSourceTitle);
        outState.putBoolean("fxPanelOpen", fxPanelOpen);
        outState.putBoolean("fxEverOpened", fxEverOpened);
        outState.putBoolean("replaceModeArmed", replaceModeArmed);
        outState.putBoolean("inSelectAndReplaceEditor", inSelectAndReplaceEditor);
        outState.putBoolean("userScrolledWhilePaused", userScrolledWhilePaused);
        outState.putBoolean("dspBakedToRaw", dspBakedToRaw);
        outState.putBoolean("dspSubRangeBaked", dspSubRangeBaked);
        outState.putBoolean("lastEditWasSubRangeBake", lastEditWasSubRangeBake);
        outState.putBoolean("fxTargetHasSelection", fxApplyTargetHasSelection);
        outState.putFloat("fxTargetStart", fxApplyTargetStart);
        outState.putFloat("fxTargetEnd", fxApplyTargetEnd);
        if (waveform != null) {
            if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                outState.putBoolean("selActive", true);
                outState.putFloat("selStart", waveform.selectionStartFraction());
                outState.putFloat("selEnd", waveform.selectionEndFraction());
            }
            waveform.saveSubEditorState(outState);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Puts the editor back into the mode the user was in before a rotation.
     * The engine session survives the configuration change, but the fragment
     * is recreated, so every mode flag has to travel in the saved state.
     */
    private void restoreEditingMode(@Nullable Bundle state) {
        if (state == null || waveform == null) return;
        boolean fxWasOpen = state.getBoolean("fxPanelOpen", false);
        fxEverOpened = state.getBoolean("fxEverOpened", false) || fxWasOpen;
        boolean selActive = state.getBoolean("selActive", false);
        float selStart = state.getFloat("selStart", 0f);
        float selEnd = state.getFloat("selEnd", 1f);

        dspBakedToRaw = state.getBoolean("dspBakedToRaw", false);
        dspSubRangeBaked = state.getBoolean("dspSubRangeBaked", false);
        lastEditWasSubRangeBake =
                state.getBoolean("lastEditWasSubRangeBake", false);

        if (state.getBoolean("inSelectAndReplaceEditor", false)
                && engine.isInSubSession()) {
            inSelectAndReplaceEditor = true;
            waveform.restoreSubEditorState(state);
        }

        replaceModeArmed = state.getBoolean("replaceModeArmed", false);
        if (replaceModeArmed) {
            waveform.clearSelection();
            waveform.setSelectionLocked(true);
        }
        userScrolledWhilePaused =
                state.getBoolean("userScrolledWhilePaused", false);

        // Ranges need buckets. The attached take loads in the background, so
        // finish the restore from that callback instead of losing the mode.
        if ((fxWasOpen || selActive) && waveform.historyCount() <= 1) {
            pendingModeRestore = state;
            paintEditorStrip();
            return;
        }

        if (fxWasOpen) {
            float ts = state.getFloat("fxTargetStart", 0f);
            float te = state.getFloat("fxTargetEnd", 1f);
            if (te <= ts) {
                ts = 0f;
                te = 1f;
            }
            fxApplyTargetStart = ts;
            fxApplyTargetEnd = te;
            fxApplyTargetHasSelection = true;
            // Bounds first: selectRange and the handle drags are clamped to
            // this region for the whole lifetime of the mode.
            waveform.setFxRegionBounds(ts, te);
            waveform.selectRange(ts, te);
            fxPanelOpen = false;
            setFxPanelVisible(true);
            if (selActive) {
                waveform.selectRange(selStart, selEnd);
            }
        } else if (selActive) {
            waveform.selectRange(selStart, selEnd);
        }

        pendingModeRestore = null;
        paintEditorStrip();
        paintFxPanelControls();
    }

    @Override
    public void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        handler.post(tick);
        scheduleWaveFrame();
        if (!telePaused) scheduleTeleFrame();
        paint();
        activity().syncFabWithEngine();
    }

    @Override
    public void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        handler.removeCallbacks(tick);
        cancelWaveFrame();
        cancelTeleFrame();
        persistTeleScript();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroyView() {
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
        cancelWaveFrame();
        cancelTeleFrame();
        stopDotPulse();
        stopStudioPreview();
        pendingModeRestore = null;
        persistTeleScript();
        // Never abort here: the take keeps recording in the background via
        // the foreground service when the user leaves the studio.
        try {
            if (doneReceiver != null) requireContext().unregisterReceiver(doneReceiver);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        doneReceiver = null;
        super.onDestroyView();
    }

    // ---- entry: name first, never auto-record ----

    private void askForName() {
        if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
        if (engine.hasSession()) return;
        namingModalOpen = true;
        OptionsSheet.showInputWithCancel(requireContext(),
                getString(R.string.name_take_title),
                nextTakeName(),
                getString(R.string.name_take_save),
                text -> {
                    namingModalOpen = false;
                    pendingName = RecordingEngine.sanitize(text);
                    paint();
                    activity().syncFabWithEngine();
                },
                () -> {
                    namingModalOpen = false;
                    if (!isAdded()) return;
                    if (!engine.hasSession() && pendingName == null) {
                        activity().exitStudio();
                    }
                },
                true);
    }

    private void showRenameModal() {
        if (!isAdded()) return;
        if (engine.state == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), R.string.studio_recording_hint,
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        String current = engine.hasSession() && engine.takeName != null
                ? engine.takeName : pendingName;
        if (current == null) current = nextTakeName();
        OptionsSheet.showInput(requireContext(), getString(R.string.rename_title),
                current, getString(R.string.rename_save), text -> {
                    String clean = RecordingEngine.sanitize(text);
                    try {
                        if (engine.hasSession()) {
                            engine.renameSession(requireContext(), clean);
                            pendingName = engine.takeName;
                            if (editSourceId != -1 && engine.rawFile != null) {
                                editSourceTitle = clean;
                                EditLink.save(requireContext(), editSourceId,
                                        clean, engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath());
                            }
                        } else {
                            pendingName = clean;
                        }
                        paint();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                R.string.rename_failed_msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    }
                });
    }

    private void attachRenameGestures(View target) {
        final GestureDetector gd = new GestureDetector(requireContext(),
                new GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener() {
                    @Override
                    public boolean onDoubleTap(MotionEvent e) {
                        if (pendingName != null || engine.hasSession()) showRenameModal();
                        else askForName();
                        return true;
                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onLongPress(MotionEvent e) {
                        try {
                            if (pendingName != null || engine.hasSession()) {
                                showRenameModal();
                            } else {
                                askForName();
                            }
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                });
        target.setOnTouchListener((view, event) -> gd.onTouchEvent(event));
    }

    // ---- unified recording settings: presets + format toggles ----

    private int presetIcon(RecordPreset p) {
        switch (p) {
            case PODCAST: return R.drawable.ic_sliders;
            case MUSIC: return R.drawable.ic_wave;
            default: return R.drawable.ic_mic;
        }
    }

    private void showRecordingSettings() {
        if (!isAdded()) return;
        OptionsSheet.SettingsState state = new OptionsSheet.SettingsState() {
            @Override
            public List<OptionsSheet.Item> presets() {
                List<OptionsSheet.Item> items = new ArrayList<>();
                for (RecordPreset p : RecordPreset.all()) {
                    final RecordPreset pick = p;
                    items.add(OptionsSheet.Item.detail(
                            presetIcon(p),
                            getString(p.titleRes), getString(p.subRes),
                            p == preset,
                            () -> {
                                // NEW-06 fix: lock preset changes whenever
                                // recording OR when an attached session
                                // already holds recorded audio on disk
                                // (whose channel geometry is fixed).
                                if (engine.state
                                        == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING
                                        || (engine.hasSession()
                                        && engine.dataBytes > 0)) {
                                    try {
                                        PressAnim.nudge(settingsRow, 1.02f);
                                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                                R.string.preset_locked,
                                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                                    return;
                                }
                                preset = pick;
                                preset.save(requireContext());
                                paint();
                            }));
                }
                return items;
            }

            @Override
            public List<OptionsSheet.Chip> formats() {
                List<OptionsSheet.Chip> chips = new ArrayList<>();
                for (SaveFormat f : SaveFormat.values()) {
                    if (!f.available(requireContext())) continue;
                    final SaveFormat pick = f;
                    String label = f == SaveFormat.AUTO
                            ? getString(R.string.save_auto)
                            : chipLabel(f);
                    // Size is resolved against AUTO so the Auto chip shows
                    // what it will actually produce, and re-read on every
                    // preset change so mono/stereo estimates stay honest.
                    SaveFormat shown = f == SaveFormat.AUTO ? f.effective(preset)
                            : f;
                    chips.add(OptionsSheet.Chip.of(label,
                            shown.sizePerMinuteLabel(preset),
                            f == saveFormat,
                            () -> {
                                if (saving) {
                                    try {
                                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                                R.string.save_locked,
                                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                                    return;
                                }
                                saveFormat = pick;
                                saveFormat.save(requireContext());
                                if (engine.hasSession()) {
                                    engine.abortStreaming();
                                }
                                paint();
                            }));
                }
                return chips;
            }

            @Override
            public String formatHint() {
                return getString(R.string.save_auto_sub) + " • "
                        + TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, SaveFormat.AUTO);
            }
        };
        OptionsSheet.showRecordingSettings(requireContext(),
                getString(R.string.settings_title),
                getString(R.string.preset_title), micCapabilityLine(),
                getString(R.string.settings_format), state,
                getString(R.string.settings_done));
    }

    /** Short chip text: "M4A", "WAV 16", "WAV 24", "AMR", "FLAC", … */
    private String chipLabel(SaveFormat f) {
        switch (f) {
            case WAV16: return "WAV 16";
            case WAV24: return "WAV 24";
            case WAV32: return "WAV 32";
            default: return TakeSaver.labelFor(preset, f);
        }
    }

    private String micCapabilityLine() {
        int n = MicSupport.physicalMicCount(audioManager);
        if (n >= 2) return getString(R.string.mic_stereo_ok, n);
        if (n == 1) return getString(R.string.mic_mono_only);
        return getString(R.string.mic_unknown);
    }

    // ---- teleprompter ----

    private void initTeleprompter() {
        tele = TeleSettings.load(requireContext());
        String savedScript = loadTeleScript();
        teleView.setScript(savedScript);
        // A4-10: the header title only ever updated on an explicit edit, so
        // reopening the studio showed a stale/empty title.
        if (teleTitle != null) {
            teleTitle.setText(scriptNameOf(savedScript));
        }
        applyTeleSettings();
        // The control chrome overlays the top of the panel: keep the reading
        // centre in the middle of the visible area, not the middle of the
        // view, as the chrome height settles.
        final View chrome = requireView().findViewById(R.id.teleChrome);
        if (chrome != null && telePanel != null) {
            telePanel.addOnLayoutChangeListener(
                    (v, left, top, right, bottom,
                     oldLeft, oldTop, oldRight, oldBottom) -> {
                        if (teleView != null) {
                            teleView.setCenterShiftPx(chrome.getHeight() / 2f);
                        }
                    });
        }
        // On by default: a performer opening the studio wants the script,
        // not an empty recorder.
        setTeleprompterVisible(true);
        scriptPicker = registerForActivityResult(
                new ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument(), uri -> {
                    if (uri == null || !isAdded()) return;
                    ScriptImporter.Result r = ScriptImporter.read(
                            requireContext(), uri);
                    if (!r.ok()) {
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                getString(R.string.tele_import_failed),
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        return;
                    }
                    persistTeleScript(r.text);
                    teleView.setScript(r.text);
                    teleTitle.setText(scriptNameOf(r.text));
                    // Reflect it in the editor too, if it is still open.
                    TeleDialogs.applyImported(requireContext(), r.text,
                            scriptNameOf(r.text), tele.wordsPerMinute);
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                            getString(R.string.tele_imported,
                                    scriptNameOf(r.text),
                                    TeleMath.wordCount(r.text)),
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });
    }

    private static String scriptNameOf(String text) {
        String first = "";
        if (text != null) {
            for (String line : text.split("\n")) {
                String t = line.trim();
                if (!t.isEmpty()) {
                    first = t;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (first.isEmpty()) return "Script";
        return first.length() > 28 ? first.substring(0, 28) + "…" : first;
    }

    /** Pushes settings into the view, applying the words-per-line clamp. */
    private void applyTeleSettings() {
        if (tele == null || teleView == null || getView() == null) return;
        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        teleView.setTextSizePx(tele.textSizeSp * density);
        teleView.setWordsPerLine(tele.wordsPerLine);
        teleView.setMirror(tele.mirror);
    }

    private void setTeleprompterVisible(boolean visible) {
        if (telePanel == null) return;
        // Teleprompter is always present unless the inline FX screen is open.
        boolean showTele = visible || !fxPanelOpen;
        telePanel.setVisibility(showTele ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        setTeleActive(showTele);
    }

    private void toggleTeleprompter() {
        // Teleprompter is permanently visible when not in the FX screen; if FX is
        // open, switching back restores the teleprompter.
        if (fxPanelOpen) {
            setFxPanelVisible(false);
        } else {
            setTeleprompterVisible(true);
        }
    }

    private void setTeleActive(boolean active) {
        if (teleToggle != null) {
            teleToggle.setBackgroundResource(active
                    ? R.drawable.bg_chip_selected : R.drawable.bg_search);
        }
        if (teleToggleIcon != null) {
            teleToggleIcon.setAlpha(active ? 1f : 0.55f);
        }
        if (teleState != null) {
            teleState.setText(active ? R.string.tele_hide_short : R.string.tele_show);
        }
    }

    private void openTeleEditor() {
        if (!isAdded()) return;
        TeleDialogs.showEditor(requireContext(), loadTeleScript(),
                tele != null ? tele.wordsPerMinute : 120,
                script -> {
                    persistTeleScript(script);
                    if (teleView != null) teleView.setScript(script);
                    if (teleTitle != null) teleTitle.setText(scriptNameOf(script));
                },
                () -> {
                    try {
                        scriptPicker.launch(new String[]{
                                "text/plain",
                                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument"
                                        + ".wordprocessingml.document",
                                "*/*"
                        });
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(),
                                getString(R.string.tele_import_failed),
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    }
                });
    }

    private String loadTeleScript() {
        try {
            return requireContext().getSharedPreferences("takeone",
                            Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getString("tele_script", TeleSettings.DEFAULT_SCRIPT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private void persistTeleScript() {
        if (teleView != null) persistTeleScript(teleView.getScript());
    }

    private void persistTeleScript(String text) {
        try {
            requireContext().getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putString("tele_script", text == null ? "" : text)
                    .apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /**
     * Drives the prompter: advances whenever not paused (both while recording
     * AND before recording starts so the user can check the speed), yields
     * while the user's finger is actively dragging the script, and resumes
     * immediately on finger lift.
     */
    /**
     * Native display refresh-rate (60Hz/90Hz/120Hz) VSYNC callback so the
     * teleprompter scrolls smoothly every single display frame.
     */
    private void advanceTeleprompterFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
        if (teleView == null || tele == null) return;
        long nowMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        if (!tele.autoScroll || telePaused || namingModalOpen) {
