import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Three-way value control: minus, value, plus.
 *
 * &lt;ul&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tap&lt;/b&gt; minus/plus to step the value.&lt;/li&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Double-tap the value&lt;/b&gt; to type an exact number.&lt;/li&gt;
 *   &lt;li&gt;&lt;b&gt;Tap and scroll left/right&lt;/b&gt; anywhere on the control to scrub the
 *       value continuously, without lifting off.</li>
 * &lt;/ul&gt;
 *
 * A single tap deliberately does nothing: no popup list and no keyboard.
 * Used for teleprompter text size / speed / words-per-line, the FX rack and
 * waveform zoom, so the same muscle memory applies everywhere.
 */
public class TeleValue extends LinearLayout {

    public interface OnValueChanged {
        void onValueChanged(int value);
    }

    /**
     * Continuous scrub notifications. Unlike {@link OnValueChanged}, these fire
     * while the finger is still down; the final committed value is reported
     * through {@link #onScrubFinished(int)} rather than the discrete listener.
     */
    public interface OnScrubListener {
        void onScrubValueChanged(int value);
        void onScrubFinished(int value);
    }

    private static final int DOUBLE_TAP_MS = 280;

    private int min;
    private int max = 100;
    private int step = 1;
    private int value;
    private String unit = "";

    public interface StepRule {
        int stepFor(int currentValue, int direction);
    }

    /**
     * Optional presentation override so a consumer can render dB, Hz or ratio
     * labels without subclassing. When unset, the numeric value is joined
     * with the configured unit.
     */
    public interface ValueFormatter {
        String formatValueText(int value);
    }

    private int valueScale = 1;
    private StepRule stepRule;
    private ValueFormatter valueFormatter;
    private Runnable paywallInterceptor;

    public void setValueFormatter(ValueFormatter formatter) {
        this.valueFormatter = formatter;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    /**
     * When non-null, marks this control as locked by the paywall on subsequent
     * recordings: visually dimmed ({@code alpha = 0.35f}) while keeping its
     * minus, plus, and value buttons clickable so any tap or scrub opens the
     * paywall immediately.
     */
    public void setPaywallInterceptor(Runnable interceptor) {
        this.paywallInterceptor = interceptor;
        setAlpha(interceptor != null ? 0.35f : 1f);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    /**
     * Fixed-point divisor for high-resolution controls (e.g. 100 for basis
     * points where 10000 = 100% and 92 = 0.92%). Default is 1 (integer).
     */
    public void setValueScale(int scale) {
        this.valueScale = Math.max(1, scale);
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatValueText(value));
        }
    }

    public int getValueScale() {
        return valueScale;
    }

    public void setStepRule(StepRule rule) {
        this.stepRule = rule;
    }

    private int effectiveStep(int fromValue, int dir) {
        if (stepRule != null) {
            return Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(fromValue, dir));
        }
        return Math.max(1, step);
    }

    private String formatNumberPart(int v) {
        if (valueScale <= 1) {
            return String.valueOf(v);
        }
        if (v % valueScale == 0) {
            return String.valueOf(v / valueScale);
        }
        double d = v / (double) valueScale;
        if (Math.abs((long) v) >= 10L * valueScale) {
            String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", d);
            if (s.endsWith(".0")) s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 2);
            return s;
        }
        String s = String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", d);
        while (s.contains(".") && (s.endsWith("0") || s.endsWith("."))) {
            if (s.endsWith(".")) {
                s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
                break;
            }
            s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
        }
        return s;
    }

    private String formatValueText(int v) {
        if (valueFormatter != null) {
            return valueFormatter.formatValueText(v);
        }
        String num = formatNumberPart(v);
        return unit.isEmpty() ? num : num + unit;
    }

    private OnValueChanged listener;
    private OnScrubListener scrubListener;

    private TextView caption;
    private LinearLayout controlRow;
    private boolean stacked;
    private TextView minus;
    private TextView plus;
    private TextView label;

    private float downX;
    private boolean scrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubbing;
    private boolean verticalScrubEnabled;
    private float downY;
    private int activePointerId = -1;
    private boolean movedBeyondSlop;
    private int dragStartValue;
    private float dragStartPos;
    private long lastTapAt = -DOUBLE_TAP_MS - 1;
    private boolean compact;
    private Dialog keyboardDialog;

    public TeleValue(Context context) {
        this(context, null);
    }

    /** Required for XML inflation; without it the studio screen crashes. */
    public TeleValue(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        build(context);
    }

    private void build(Context ctx) {
        setOrientation(VERTICAL);
        setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL);

        caption = new TextView(ctx);
        caption.setTextSize(8.5f);
        caption.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        caption.setTextColor(0xFF8A93A0);
        caption.setSingleLine(true);
        caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        addView(caption, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
        row.setOrientation(HORIZONTAL);
        row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        row.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
        row.setPadding(dp(ctx, 2), 0, dp(ctx, 2), 0);
        controlRow = row;

        minus = button(ctx, "−");
        plus = button(ctx, "+");

        label = new TextView(ctx);
        label.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        label.setTextSize(12);
        label.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        label.setSingleLine(true);
        label.setMaxLines(1);
        label.setContentDescription("value");
        // The system long-press listener is intentionally not used: Android
        // would schedule the keyboard as soon as the finger rests, even if the
        // user then begins a scrub. A value hold is detected below instead.
        label.setLongClickable(false);

        row.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                        LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
        row.addView(label, lp);
        row.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(dp(ctx, 26), dp(ctx, 24)));

        addView(row, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dp(ctx, 26)));

        minus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, -1);
            int next = value - s;
            // If stepping down lands within one step of min, snap to min.
            if (value > min && next < min) next = min;
            setValue(next, true);
        });
        plus.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            int s = effectiveStep(value, 1);
            setValue(value + s, true);
        });

        // A single tap is intentionally inert when unlocked. Only a double-tap
        // opens the exact-value keyboard; when paywall-locked, any tap opens
        // the paywall.
        label.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (scrubbing || movedBeyondSlop) return;
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                return;
            }
            long now = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
            if (now - lastTapAt < DOUBLE_TAP_MS) {
                lastTapAt = 0;
                showKeyboardInput();
            } else {
                lastTapAt = now;
            }
        });
    }

    private void updateStepperButtons() {
        if (minus == null || plus == null) return;
        if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
            minus.setEnabled(true);
            minus.setClickable(true);
            minus.setAlpha(1f);
            plus.setEnabled(true);
            plus.setClickable(true);
            plus.setAlpha(1f);
            return;
        }
        boolean canDec = value > min;
        boolean canInc = value < max;
        minus.setEnabled(canDec);
        minus.setClickable(canDec);
        minus.setAlpha(canDec ? 1f : 0.35f);
        plus.setEnabled(canInc);
        plus.setClickable(canInc);
        plus.setAlpha(canInc ? 1f : 0.35f);
    }

    private void clearChildPress() {
        if (minus != null) {
            minus.cancelLongPress();
            minus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (plus != null) {
            plus.cancelLongPress();
            plus.setPressed(false);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.cancelLongPress();
            label.setPressed(false);
        }
    }

    private TextView button(Context ctx, String glyph) {
        TextView t = new TextView(ctx);
        t.setText(glyph);
        t.setTextSize(15);
        t.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        t.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
        t.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_round_btn);
        t.setContentDescription(glyph.equals("+") ? "increase" : "decrease");
        return t;
    }

    public boolean isStacked() {
        return stacked;
    }

    /** Small name shown above the stepper, so controls need no external label. */
    public void setCaption(String s) {
        if (caption == null) return;
        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) {
            caption.setVisibility(GONE);
        } else {
            caption.setText(s);
            caption.setVisibility(VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Stacks minus/value/plus vertically for a narrow rail, such as waveform
     * zoom. Gesture handling is unchanged: a horizontal scrub still adjusts
     * the value, while taps retain their four behaviours.
     */
    public void setStacked(boolean stacked) {
        if (controlRow == null || minus == null || label == null || plus == null) {
            return;
        }
        this.stacked = stacked;
        int button = dp(getContext(), 26);
        int height = dp(getContext(), 24);
        controlRow.setOrientation(stacked ? VERTICAL : HORIZONTAL);
        controlRow.setGravity(stacked ? Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
                : Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        controlRow.removeAllViews();
        if (stacked) {
            // The row must wrap its content: it was built for a single 24dp
            // horizontal strip, which would crush a vertical stack to 2px.
            // High-resolution labels ("0.92%") also need a slightly more
            // compact text size to fit cleanly inside the 40dp rail.
            // Plus sits on top, minus at the bottom, matching the drag
            // direction (up increases, down decreases).
            label.setTextSize(10.5f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(getContext(), 20)));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        } else {
            label.setTextSize(12f);
            controlRow.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, height));
            controlRow.addView(minus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
            controlRow.addView(label, new LayoutParams(0,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f));
            controlRow.addView(plus, new LayoutParams(button, height));
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    /**
     * Compacts the control for dense FX cards: smaller caption, label and
     * stepper buttons without changing its gestures. Ignored in stacked mode
     * because that rail already has its own sizing.
     */
    public void setCompact(boolean compact) {
        this.compact = compact;
        Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (caption != null) {
            caption.setTextSize(compact ? 8f : 8.5f);
        }
        if (label != null) {
            label.setTextSize(compact ? 11f : 12f);
        }
        if (!stacked && controlRow != null
                && minus != null && plus != null) {
            int size = dp(ctx, compact ? 22 : 26);
            minus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            plus.setLayoutParams(new LayoutParams(size, size));
            if (controlRow.getLayoutParams() instanceof LayoutParams) {
                LayoutParams rp = (LayoutParams)
                        controlRow.getLayoutParams();
                rp.height = size;
                controlRow.setLayoutParams(rp);
            }
        }
        requestLayout();
    }

    public boolean isCompact() {
        return compact;
    }

    /** Values the wheel may show when {@code step > 1}, padded to range. */
    private int[] steppedValues() {
        java.util.ArrayList&lt;Integer&gt; out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (stepRule != null) {
            int cur = min;
            out.add(cur);
            while (cur < max) {
                int s = Math.max(1, stepRule.stepFor(cur, 1));
                int next = (cur == min && s > 1)
                        ? ((cur / s) + 1) * s
                        : cur + s;
                if (next <= cur) next = cur + 1;
                if (next >= max) {
                    out.add(max);
                    break;
                }
                out.add(next);
                cur = next;
            }
        } else {
            int rem = ((min % step) + step) % step;
            int first = (rem == 0) ? min : Math.min(max, min + (step - rem));
            if (first > min && (valueScale > 1 || min < 0)) {
                out.add(min);
            }
            for (int v = first; v <= max; v += step) {
                out.add(v);
            }
            if (!out.isEmpty() && out.get(out.size() - 1) < max) {
                out.add(max);
            }
            if (out.isEmpty()) {
                for (int v = min; v <= max; v++) out.add(v);
            }
        }
        int[] arr = new int[out.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) arr[i] = out.get(i);
        return arr;
    }

    private String[] steppedLabels() {
        int[] vals = steppedValues();
        String[] out = new String[vals.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
            out[i] = formatValueText(vals[i]);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Test hook: the wheel labels for the configured step. */
    String[] steppedLabelsForTest() {
        return steppedLabels();
    }

    public void configure(int min, int max, int step, int value, String unit) {
        this.min = min;
        this.max = max;
        this.step = Math.max(1, step);
        this.unit = unit == null ? "" : unit;
        setValue(value, false);
        updateStepperButtons();
    }

    public void setOnValueChanged(OnValueChanged l) {
        listener = l;
    }

    public void setOnScrubListener(OnScrubListener l) {
        scrubListener = l;
    }

    /**
     * Allows vertical drags to scrub the value (drag up increases), reported
     * through the same {@link OnScrubListener} as horizontal scrubs. Off by
     * default so a vertical pass over an unrelated control stays inert.
     */
    public void setVerticalScrub(boolean enabled) {
        verticalScrubEnabled = enabled;
    }

    public int getValue() {
        return value;
    }

    public int getMin() {
        return min;
    }

    private int clamp(int v) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
    }

    public void setValue(int v, boolean notify) {
        int nv = clamp(v);
        String formatted = formatValueText(nv);
        if (nv == value && label != null
                && formatted.contentEquals(label.getText())) {
            updateStepperButtons();
            return;
        }
        value = nv;
        if (label != null) {
            label.setText(formatted);
        }
        updateStepperButtons();
        if (notify && listener != null) listener.onValueChanged(value);
    }

    // ---- keyboard ----

    private String captionTitle() {
        CharSequence cap = caption != null ? caption.getText() : null;
        if (cap != null && cap.length() > 0) {
            return cap.toString();
        }
        return getContext().getString(R.string.tele_value_picker);
    }

    private static void styleModalWindow(Dialog dialog) {
        OptionsSheet.styleAsCentered(dialog);
    }

    /** Overridable presentation hook so gesture routing is unit-testable. */
    protected void showKeyboardInput() {
        final Context ctx = getContext();
        if (ctx == null) return;
        if (keyboardDialog != null && keyboardDialog.isShowing()) return;
        try {
            final Dialog d = new Dialog(ctx, R.style.TakeOneCenterDialog);
            keyboardDialog = d;
            d.setOnDismissListener(dd -> {
                if (keyboardDialog == d) keyboardDialog = null;
            });
            d.requestWindowFeature(Window.FEATURE_NO_TITLE);

            int pad = dp(ctx, 20);
            LinearLayout box = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            box.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            box.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_modal);
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 21) {
                box.setElevation(dp(ctx, 16));
            }
            box.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

            TextView title = new TextView(ctx);
            title.setText(captionTitle());
            title.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            title.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            title.setTextSize(18);
            title.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            box.addView(title, new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

            TextView sub = new TextView(ctx);
            sub.setText(formatValueText(min) + " – " + formatValueText(max));
            sub.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            sub.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            sub.setTextSize(12);
            LayoutParams subLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            subLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 4);
            box.addView(sub, subLp);

            LinearLayout inputBox = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            inputBox.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            inputBox.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_search);
            inputBox.setPadding(dp(ctx, 14), dp(ctx, 2),
                    dp(ctx, 14), dp(ctx, 2));
            LayoutParams ibLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            ibLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 16);

            final EditText input = new EditText(ctx);
            input.setBackground(null);
            input.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            input.setTextColor(0xFFF2F4F7);
            input.setHintTextColor(0xFF5D6672);
            input.setTextSize(16);
            input.setSingleLine(true);
            input.setMaxLines(1);
            // Signed keyboards appear only for ranges that can go negative
            // (e.g. a -24..+24 dB trim), so every existing positive-only
            // control keeps its familiar keypad.
            int inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER;
            if (min < 0) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_SIGNED;
            }
            if (valueScale > 1) {
                inputType |= InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_DECIMAL;
            }
            input.setInputType(inputType);
            input.setText(formatNumberPart(value));
            input.setSelectAllOnFocus(true);
            inputBox.addView(input, new LayoutParams(
                    LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, dp(ctx, 50)));
            box.addView(inputBox, ibLp);

            LinearLayout row = new LinearLayout(ctx);
            row.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            LayoutParams rowLp = new LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
            rowLp.topMargin = dp(ctx, 14);

            TextView cancelBtn = new TextView(ctx);
            cancelBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.cancel));
            cancelBtn.setTextSize(14);
            cancelBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            cancelBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            cancelBtn.setTextColor(0xFF9AA3AF);
            cancelBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_ghost);

            TextView okBtn = new TextView(ctx);
            okBtn.setText(ctx.getString(R.string.settings_done));
            okBtn.setTextSize(14);
            okBtn.setTypeface(android.graphics.Typeface.create(
                    "sans-serif-medium", android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL));
            okBtn.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            okBtn.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
            okBtn.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_btn_primary);

            LayoutParams half = new LayoutParams(0, dp(ctx, 48), 1f);
            half.rightMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            LayoutParams half2 = new LayoutParams(0, dp(ctx, 48), 1f);
            half2.leftMargin = dp(ctx, 6);
            row.addView(cancelBtn, half);
            row.addView(okBtn, half2);
            box.addView(row, rowLp);
            PressAnim.apply(cancelBtn);
            PressAnim.apply(okBtn);

            d.setContentView(box);
            input.setImeOptions(android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                    .IME_ACTION_DONE);
            input.setOnEditorActionListener((v2, actionId, ev) -> {
                if (actionId == android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo
                        .IME_ACTION_DONE) {
                    commitTyped(input);
                    d.dismiss();
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            });
            cancelBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> d.dismiss());
            okBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                commitTyped(input);
                d.dismiss();
            });
            styleModalWindow(d);
            Window w = d.getWindow();
            if (w != null) {
                w.setSoftInputMode(WindowManager.LayoutParams
                        .SOFT_INPUT_STATE_VISIBLE
                        | WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE);
            }
            d.setOnShowListener(dd -> input.requestFocus());
            d.show();
            input.post(() -> {
                android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager imm =
                        (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager) ctx
                                .getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
                if (imm != null) {
                    imm.showSoftInput(input,
                            android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager
                                    .SHOW_IMPLICIT);
                }
            });
            // Back / outside-tap dismisses WITHOUT committing: cancelling
            // must never mutate the value.
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            keyboardDialog = null;
        }
    }

    /** Parses and commits the typed value exactly once. */
    private void commitTyped(EditText input) {
        try {
            String raw = input.getText().toString().trim();
            if (raw.isEmpty()) return;
            int v = valueScale > 1
                    ? (int) Math.round(Double.parseDouble(raw) * valueScale)
                    : Integer.parseInt(raw);
            setValue(v, true);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    /**
     * Horizontal scrubs are intercepted here rather than in an
     * {@code OnTouchListener}: the minus, value and plus children are all
     * clickable, so they consume ACTION_DOWN and the parent would never see
     * the gesture at all.
     *
     * &lt;p&gt;Only a clean tap reaches the children. Motion beyond touch slop is
     * consumed here, so a scrolling finger can never turn into a value change
     * or a stray double-tap.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                downX = ev.getX();
                downY = ev.getY();
                activePointerId = eventPointerId(ev, 0);
                movedBeyondSlop = false;
                scrubbing = false;
                verticalScrubbing = false;
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN:
                // A second finger invalidates tap and double-tap semantics.
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                clearChildPress();
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE: {
                int pointerIndex = ev.findPointerIndex(activePointerId);
                if (pointerIndex < 0) return true;
                float x = ev.getX(pointerIndex);
                float y = ev.getY(pointerIndex);
                float dx = x - downX;
                float dy = y - downY;
                float slop = ViewConfiguration.get(getContext())
                        .getScaledTouchSlop();
                if (!movedBeyondSlop
                        && Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) > slop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = true;
                    clearChildPress();
                }
                if (!scrubbing && !verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Claim the gesture once its direction is clear. A
                    // vertical move is consumed so it cannot become a tap
                    // when the finger lifts — unless vertical scrubbing is
                    // enabled, in which case it drives the value.
                    if (!movedBeyondSlop) {
                        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
                    }
                    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
                        scrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        dragStartPos = x;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else if (verticalScrubEnabled) {
                        verticalScrubbing = true;
                        lastTapAt = 0;
                        dragStartValue = value;
                        // Anchor at the current position like horizontal
                        // scrub does: anchoring at the touch-down point
                        // makes the value jump by the slop distance.
                        dragStartPos = y;
                        if (getParent() != null) {
                            getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true);
                        }
                    } else {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                    return true;
                }
                if (verticalScrubbing) {
                    // Drag upward increases the value, drag downward decreases it,
                    // matching the direction the finger moves away from the
                    // starting point.
                    int delta = (int) Math.round((dragStartPos - y)
                            / dp(getContext(), 7));
                    int s = effectiveStep(dragStartValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
                    setLiveValue(dragStartValue + delta * s);
                    return true;
                }
                int delta = (int) Math.round((x - dragStartPos)
                        / dp(getContext(), 7));
                scrubTo(dragStartValue, delta);
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP: {
                int lifted = eventPointerId(ev, ev.getActionIndex());
                if (lifted == activePointerId) {
                    return finishInterruptedGesture();
                }
                return true;
            }
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
                    scrubbing = false;
                    verticalScrubbing = false;
                    if (getParent() != null) {
                        getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
                    }
                    if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                        paywallInterceptor.run();
                        return true;
                    }
                    // A scrub reports through the scrub listener only. The
                    // discrete listener remains reserved for +/- and keyboard
                    // commits.
                    if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
                    performClick();
                    return true;
                }
                if (movedBeyondSlop) {
                    movedBeyondSlop = false;
                    return true;
                }
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
            default:
                return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
        }
    }

    private boolean finishInterruptedGesture() {
        activePointerId = -1;
        if (scrubbing || verticalScrubbing) {
            scrubbing = false;
            verticalScrubbing = false;
            if (getParent() != null) {
                getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(false);
            }
            if (paywallInterceptor != null) {
                paywallInterceptor.run();
                movedBeyondSlop = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (scrubListener != null) scrubListener.onScrubFinished(value);
            performClick();
        }
        movedBeyondSlop = true;
        return true;
    }

    private static int eventPointerId(MotionEvent ev, int pointerIndex) {
        try {
            return ev.getPointerId(pointerIndex);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    private void setLiveValue(int v) {
        int before = value;
        setValue(v, false);
        if (value != before && scrubListener != null) {
            scrubListener.onScrubValueChanged(value);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies a scrub delta measured in 7dp ticks. Without a step rule this
     * is one fixed step per tick; with a piecewise rule (e.g. zoom) each
     * tick steps from the running value so bracket boundaries are honored
     * instead of extrapolating a single step across the whole drag.
     */
    private void scrubTo(int startValue, int delta) {
        if (delta == 0) {
            setLiveValue(startValue);
            return;
        }
        if (stepRule == null) {
            int s = effectiveStep(startValue, delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1);
            setLiveValue(startValue + delta * s);
            return;
        }
        int dir = delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
        int v = startValue;
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.abs(delta); i++) {
            v += effectiveStep(v, dir);
        }
        setLiveValue(v);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        scrubbing = false;
        verticalScrubbing = false;
        movedBeyondSlop = false;
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
    }

    private static int dp(Context c, int v) {
        return Math.round(v * c.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }
}


--- FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/hello/PressAnim.java ---
package com.example.hello;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.animation.PathInterpolator;

/**
 * Restrained press feedback for every tappable view.
 *
 * The effect is deliberately shallow — a small scale dip plus a barely-there
 * alpha change — and every transition runs on a falloff curve so the motion
 * decays quickly instead of flashing. Nothing here changes layout, so it can
 * safely coexist with the selection scale driven by the adapter.
 */
public final class PressAnim {

    /** Fast lift-off, long settle: the "falloff" easing used on release. */
    private static final PathInterpolator FALLOFF =
            new PathInterpolator(0.2f, 0f, 0f, 1f);
    /** Opposite curve for pressing in: moves a little, then eases. */
    private static final PathInterpolator SETTLE_IN =
            new PathInterpolator(0.4f, 0f, 0.6f, 1f);

    private PressAnim() {}

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void apply(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    // A disabled or non-clickable chip must not give press
                    // feedback: that is what made disabled actions look tappable.
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(0.97f).scaleY(0.97f)
                            .alpha(0.9f)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .alpha(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false; // let click listeners still fire
        });
    }

    public static void applyAll(View... views) {
        if (views == null) return;
        for (View v : views) apply(v);
    }

    /**
     * Gentler variant for elements that already have their own emphasis
     * (icons, chips): scales a touch and never dips alpha, so there is no
     * visible flash — just a soft give.
     */
    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void applySoft(View v, final float pressedScale) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setOnTouchListener((view, ev) -> {
            switch (ev.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    if (!view.isEnabled() || !view.isClickable()) return false;
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(pressedScale).scaleY(pressedScale)
                            .setDuration(70)
                            .setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                            .start();
                    break;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    view.animate().cancel();
                    view.animate()
                            .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                            .setDuration(240)
                            .setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN)
                            .start();
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            return false;
        });
    }

    /**
     * Small confirmation pop for icons — a light nudge on the same falloff
     * curve. Used instead of a hard overshoot so nothing flashes.
     */
    public static void nudge(View v, float peak) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.animate().cancel();
        v.animate().scaleX(peak).scaleY(peak)
                .setDuration(90).setInterpolator(FALLOFF)
                .withEndAction(() -> v.animate()
                        .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(260).setInterpolator(SETTLE_IN).start())
                .start();
    }

    /** One-shot entrance pop used for dialog icons. */
    public static void pop(View v) {
        if (v == null) return;
        v.setScaleX(0.6f);
        v.setScaleY(0.6f);
        v.setAlpha(0f);
        v.animate()
                .scaleX(1f).scaleY(1f).alpha(1f)
                .setDuration(280)
                .setInterpolator(new android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f))
                .start();
    }
}

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;

/**
 * Job registry rules: one job per raw, stable card ids, cancel cleanup, and
 * the startup sweep resurrecting interrupted jobs while dropping garbage.
 */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner.class)
@Config(sdk = 34)
public class ConversionJobsTest {

    @Test
    public void takeIdsAreNegativeAndStable() {
        ConversionJob a = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob b = new ConversionJob("job-1", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("take id must be negative", a.takeId() < 0);
        assertEquals("take id must be stable", a.takeId(), b.takeId());
        ConversionJob c = new ConversionJob("job-2", "T", "/r.wav",
                "/r.wav.part", "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        assertTrue("different jobs must differ", c.takeId() != a.takeId());
    }

    @Test

                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "m4a", 1, 96000, 5000, 240000);
        job.progress = 42;

            assertEquals("Title", back.title);

            assertEquals(100000, back.framesDone);
            assertEquals(1, back.channels);
        } finally {
            job.deleteSidecar();
        }
    }

    @Test

        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Job Test", 2);
        try {
            ConversionJob first = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            ConversionJob second = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), engine.rawFile,
                    "Job Test", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
            assertTrue("same raw must return the same job",
                    first.jobId.equals(second.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar missing", first.sidecar().exists());
            assertTrue("not active",
                    ConversionJobs.forRaw(engine.rawFile.getAbsolutePath())
                            != null);
            assertTrue(ConversionJobs.cancel(first.jobId, false));
            assertNull("still active after cancel",
                    ConversionJobs.get(first.jobId));
            assertTrue("sidecar survived cancel", !first.sidecar().exists());
        } finally {
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsAndCleans() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "sweep.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob job = new ConversionJob("job-sweep", "Sweep",
                raw.getAbsolutePath(), raw.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        job.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        job.write();
        File orphanPart = new File(dir, "orphan.wav.part");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(orphanPart, "rw").close();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean found = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep")) found = true;
            }
            assertTrue("interrupted job was not resurrected", found);
            assertTrue("orphan part survived", !orphanPart.exists());
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
            assertTrue("raw survived cancel", !raw.exists());
        } finally {
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                raw.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                // noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                orphanPart.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            job.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void sweepResurrectsEveryJob() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw1 = new File(dir, "sweep1.wav");
        File raw2 = new File(dir, "sweep2.wav");
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw1, "rw").close();
        new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw2, "rw").close();
        ConversionJob j1 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-1", "One",
                raw1.getAbsolutePath(), raw1.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        ConversionJob j2 = new ConversionJob("job-sweep-2", "Two",
                raw2.getAbsolutePath(), raw2.getAbsolutePath() + ".part",
                "memo", "auto", 2, 96000, 1000, 100);
        j1.state = ConversionJob.RUNNING;
        j2.state = ConversionJob.QUEUED;
        j1.write();
        j2.write();
        try {
            List&lt;ConversionJob&gt; resume = ConversionJobs.sweep(ctx());
            boolean f1 = false, f2 = false;
            for (ConversionJob j : resume) {
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-1")) f1 = true;
                if (j.jobId.equals("job-sweep-2")) f2 = true;
            }
            assertTrue("first job lost", f1);
            assertTrue("second job lost (only first resumed)", f2);
        } finally {
            try {
                raw1.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                raw2.delete();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            j1.deleteSidecar();
            j2.deleteSidecar();
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-1", true);
            ConversionJobs.cancel("job-sweep-2", true);
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void dispatchSaveReplaceCancelsActiveConversionAndDeletesPreviousFileImmediately()
            throws Exception {
        RecordingEngine engine = RecordingEngine.get();
        engine.abortAndDelete();
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // Case 1: Original take is still converting when user edits and chooses Replace
        File origRaw = new File(dir, "orig_conv_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(origRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, 48000L * 2 * 4));
            w.write(new byte[48000 * 2 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJob origJob = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx(), origRaw,
                "Original Take", RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 1000);
        long origSyntheticId = origJob.takeId();
        assertTrue("original job must be active",
                ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId) != null);

        // User edits in Studio and chooses a different format (OPUS) + Replace
        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r1 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.OPUS, null,
                origSyntheticId, "Original Take");
        try {
            assertNull("original conversion must be cancelled immediately",
                    ConversionJobs.get(origJob.jobId));
            assertFalse("original raw must be deleted immediately",
                    origRaw.exists());
            assertFalse("original sidecar must be deleted immediately",
                    origJob.sidecar().exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must start immediately", r1.job);
            assertEquals("Original Take", r1.job.title);
            assertEquals("opus", r1.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r1.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r1.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r1.job.jobId, true);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }

        // Case 2: Original conversion finished (or was already a finished file)
        // before user clicked Replace -> must delete old file & Take immediately
        // before the new conversion runs!
        File finishedFile = new File(dir, "orig_done_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(finishedFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take oldTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                finishedFile, 1000, "Finished Take", "M4A");
        String finishedRawPath = new File(dir, "orig_done_raw.wav").getAbsolutePath();
        long finishedSyntheticId = -777777L;
        ConversionJobs.noteTakeRaw(finishedSyntheticId, finishedRawPath);
        ConversionJobs.noteCompletion(finishedRawPath, oldTake.id);

        engine.startNewSession(ctx(), "Edited Session 2", 2);
        ConversionJobs.SaveResult r2 = ConversionJobs.dispatchSave(
                ctx(), RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.FLAC, null,
                finishedSyntheticId, "Finished Take");
        try {
            assertNull("old Take row must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    TakesRepository.find(oldTake.id));
            assertFalse("old file on disk must be deleted immediately when Replace is chosen",
                    finishedFile.exists());
            assertNotNull("new conversion job must be enqueued immediately", r2.job);
            assertEquals("Finished Take", r2.job.title);
            assertEquals("flac", r2.job.formatId);
            assertEquals(-1L, r2.job.replaceTakeId);
        } finally {
            if (r2.job != null) ConversionJobs.cancel(r2.job.jobId, true);
            ConversionJobs.forgetCompletion(finishedRawPath);
            engine.abortAndDelete();
        }
    }

    @Test
    public void persistentFloatMasterLifecycleForRecordingsImportsAndCleanup()
            throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());

        // 1) Recorded take saved as M4A: raw 32-bit float file is maintained in .float32/
        File recRaw = new File(dir, "rec_float_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(recRaw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        File recFinal = new File(dir, "rec_float_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(recFinal, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take recTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(
                recFinal, 1000, "Recorded Take", "M4A");
        ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                recRaw.getAbsolutePath(), recFinal);
        assertFalse("original scratch raw path must be moved out of takes/",
                recRaw.exists());
        File recMaster = TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(recFinal);
        assertNotNull(recMaster);
        assertTrue("persistent 32-bit float master must exist in .float32/",
                recMaster.exists());
        assertEquals("resolveFloatMaster must return the persistent float32 file",
                recMaster.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(recFinal).getAbsolutePath());
        assertTrue("resolved master must be a native 32-bit float WAV",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(recFinal)));

        // 2) Recorded take saved as WAV32: already 32-bit float -> no redundant copy in .float32/
        File wav32Raw = new File(dir, "rec_w32_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav32Raw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        File wav32Final = new File(dir, "rec_w32_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav32Final, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, 4800L * 4));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 4]);
        }
        ConversionJobs.completeOrDeferRawMaster(
                wav32Raw.getAbsolutePath(), wav32Final);
        assertFalse("wav32 raw must be deleted to avoid duplicate files",
                wav32Raw.exists());
        assertFalse("wav32 final must not create a redundant .float32 copy",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(wav32Final).exists());
        assertEquals(wav32Final.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(wav32Final).getAbsolutePath());
        wav32Final.delete();

        // 3) Imported recording: no float32 file until first Edit, then persisted on first Edit
        File impFile = new File(dir, "imp_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(impFile, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wav16Header(1, 48000, 4800L * 2));
            w.write(new byte[4800 * 2]);
        }
        Take impTake = TakesRepository.addImported(
                impFile, 1000, "Imported Take", "WAV");
        assertEquals("imported", impTake.origin);
        assertFalse("imported file must not have a float32 master before first edit",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
        assertFalse("16-bit imported file is not native float32 yet",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(impFile)));

        // Simulate first Edit press on the imported take
        File firstEditSession = AudioImporter.takeToFloatWav(
                impFile, dir, "Imported_Take", null);
        TakesRepository.saveFloatMasterCopy(firstEditSession, impFile);
        firstEditSession.delete();
        assertTrue("float32 master must be created and persisted on first edit",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impFile).exists());
        assertTrue("subsequent edits must resolve directly to native float32 master",
                AudioImporter.isNativeFloatWav(
                        TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(impFile)));

        // 3b) Renaming a converted library-visible recording renames the disk
        // file while keeping its immutable ID and .float32/rec_<id>.f32.wav link intact!
        long recImmutableId = recTake.id;
        assertEquals("rec_" + recImmutableId + ".f32.wav", recMaster.getName());
        TakesRepository.rename(recImmutableId, "Renamed Chorus Vocal");
        Take afterRename = TakesRepository.find(recImmutableId);
        assertNotNull(afterRename);
        assertEquals("Renamed Chorus Vocal", afterRename.title);
        File renamedDiskFile = new File(afterRename.filePath);
        assertTrue("renamed converted file must exist on disk",
                renamedDiskFile.exists());
        assertTrue("renamed file name must reflect new title",
                renamedDiskFile.getName().startsWith("Renamed_Chorus_Vocal"));
        assertEquals("ID-linked float32 master must still resolve after rename",
                recMaster.getAbsolutePath(),
                TakesRepository.resolveFloatMaster(
                        recImmutableId, renamedDiskFile).getAbsolutePath());

        // 4) Replace & Delete clean up both the main file and the .float32 master
        assertTrue(TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(recTake.id));
        assertFalse("replaced take file must be deleted", renamedDiskFile.exists());
        assertFalse("replaced take float32 master must be deleted",
                recMaster.exists());

        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(impTake.id);
        assertFalse("deleted imported file must be removed", impFile.exists());
        assertFalse("deleted imported float32 master must be removed",
                TakesRepository.floatMasterFor(impTake.id, impFile).exists());
    }

    @Test
    public void firstRecordingAllowsAllEditsAfterSavingAndReplacingWhileSecondBlocks()
            throws Exception {
        for (Take t : new java.util.ArrayList<>(TakesRepository.all())) {
            TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(t.id);
        }
        for (ConversionJob j : new java.util.ArrayList<>(ConversionJobs.active())) {
            ConversionJobs.cancel(j.jobId, true);
        }
        ctx().getSharedPreferences("takeone", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().clear().commit();

        TrialAndBillingManager mgr = TrialAndBillingManager.get(ctx());
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(-1L);
        assertTrue("Fresh first recording must allow all features",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(-1L));

        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File f1 = new File(dir, "first_take_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f1, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take firstTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(f1, 2000L, "First Take", "M4A");
        assertEquals(firstTake.id, mgr.getFreeRecordingId());

        // Editing the first recording after saving it once MUST still be allowed
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(firstTake.id);
        assertTrue("Editing first recording after saving once must be allowed",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(firstTake.id));

        // Replacing the first recording preserves its immutable ID and keeps edits allowed
        File f1Replaced = new File(dir, "first_take_rep_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f1Replaced, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take replacedFirst = TakesRepository.replaceRecording(
                firstTake.id, f1Replaced, 2500L, "First Take Edited", "M4A");
        assertEquals("Immutable ID must be preserved on Replace",
                firstTake.id, replacedFirst.id);
        assertTrue("Editing first recording after Replace must still be allowed",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(replacedFirst.id));

        // Starting a 2nd recording (-1) or editing a 2nd recording must be blocked
        mgr.setActiveStudioSourceId(-1L);
        assertFalse("Starting a 2nd recording must be gated by paywall",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(-1L));

        File f2 = new File(dir, "second_take_" + System.nanoTime() + ".m4a");
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(f2, "rw")) {
            w.write(new byte[2048]);
        }
        Take secondTake = TakesRepository.addRecording(f2, 2000L, "Second Take", "M4A");
        assertFalse("Editing 2nd recording must be gated by paywall",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(secondTake.id));
        assertTrue("Editing 1st recording must still be allowed even after 2nd recording exists",
                mgr.evaluateFreeTierAccessForRecording(replacedFirst.id));

        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(replacedFirst.id);
        TakesRepository.deleteImmediateForReplace(secondTake.id);
    }

    @Test
    public void formatConversionReportsGranularProgressCallbacks() throws Exception {
        File dir = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx());
        File raw = new File(dir, "prog_test_" + System.nanoTime() + ".raw.wav");
        int samples = 48000; // 1 second mono
        try (java.io.RandomAccessFile w = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(raw, "rw")) {
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(1, 48000, samples * 4L));
            w.write(new byte[samples * 4]);
        }
        File out = new File(dir, "prog_test_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        java.util.List&lt;Integer&gt; ticks = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try {
            FormatConverter.toWav16(raw, out, ticks::add);
            assertTrue("Expected multiple granular progress updates for 1s audio, got " + ticks.size(),
                    ticks.size() >= 10);
            assertEquals(Integer.valueOf(100), ticks.get(ticks.size() - 1));
        } finally {
            raw.delete();
            out.delete();
        }
    }

package com.example.hello;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNull;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;

import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * BUG-02 on device: an edit punch-in saved through the background worker
 * honours the replace choice — the original take is replaced under its own
 * title instead of duplicating the library.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class EditReplaceWorkerTest {

    private File makeRaw(Context ctx, String name) throws Exception {
        File takes = RecordingEngine.takesDir(ctx);
        File f = new File(takes, name + "_" + System.nanoTime() + ".wav");
        int frames = 48000 * 2; // 2s stereo
        RandomAccessFile w = new RandomAccessFile(f, "rw");
        try {
            w.setLength(0);
            w.write(Dsp.wavFloatHeader(2, 48000, (long) frames * 2 * 4));
            float[] buf = new float[frames * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) {
                buf[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.05) * 0.4f;
            }
            Dsp.writeFloatsLE(w, buf, 0, buf.length);
        } finally {
            w.close();
        }
        return f;
    }

    private void runToDone(ConversionJob job) throws Exception {
        ConversionService.startJob(
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().getTargetContext(),
                job.jobId);
        long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
        while (ConversionJobs.get(job.jobId) != null
                && System.currentTimeMillis() - t0 < 60_000) {
            Thread.sleep(500);
        }
        assertNull("job never finished", ConversionJobs.get(job.jobId));
    }

    private Take findByTitle(String title) {
        for (Take t : TakesRepository.all()) {
            if (title.equals(t.title)) return t;
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Test
    public void backgroundSaveWithReplaceLineageReplacesOriginal()
            throws Exception {
        android.app.Instrumentation instr =
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation();
        android.content.Intent i = new android.content.Intent(
                instr.getTargetContext(), MainActivity.class);
        i.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                | android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        instr.startActivitySync(i);
        Context ctx = instr.getTargetContext();

        // 1) A finished "original" take in the library.
        File raw1 = makeRaw(ctx, "EditOrig");
        ConversionJob j1 = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx, raw1, "Edit Original",
                RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 2000);
        runToDone(j1);
        Take original = findByTitle("Edit Original");
        assertNotNull("original take missing", original);
        String originalPath = original.filePath;

        // 2) An edit of it, saved to the background worker with replace.
        File raw2 = makeRaw(ctx, "EditNew");
        ConversionJob j2 = ConversionJobs.enqueue(ctx, raw2, "Edit Session",
                RecordPreset.MEMO, SaveFormat.M4A, 2000,
                original.id, original.title);
        Take replaced = null;
        try {
            runToDone(j2);
            replaced = findByTitle("Edit Original");
            assertNotNull("replacement take missing", replaced);
            assertTrue("replacement must preserve immutable recording ID",
                    replaced.id == original.id);
            assertTrue("replacement has no file", replaced.hasFile());
        } finally {
            if (replaced != null) {
                TakesRepository.delete(replaced.id);
                File f = new File(replaced.filePath);
                if (f.exists()) f.delete();
            } else {
                Take leftover = findByTitle("Edit Session");
                if (leftover != null) TakesRepository.delete(leftover.id);
            }
            Take orig = findByTitle("Edit Original");
            if (orig != null && (replaced == null
                    || orig.id != replaced.id)) {
                TakesRepository.delete(orig.id);
            }
            ConversionJobs.cancel(j2.jobId, true);
            if (raw2.exists()) raw2.delete();
        }
    }
}

================================================================================
TAKEONE — INSTANT LIBRARY APPEARANCE ON SAVE & EFFECTS TAB PAYWALL (7-DAY TRIAL)
================================================================================

SUMMARY OF CHANGES:
1. Instant Recording Appearance in Library After Pressing Save:
   - StudioFragment.java:
     * Started incremental background encoding (`engine.beginStreaming(requireContext(), preset, saveFormat)`) in `startOrResumeCapture()` and restarted it (`engine.restartStreaming(...)`) when changing save format in `showRecordingSettings()`, allowing recordings to finish encoding while recording/paused so `ConversionJobs.dispatchSave()` adopts them inline in milliseconds.
     * Fixed `doSaveSequence()` and `syncFxBakeRequired()` so untouched dry recordings no longer write `dsp_slots_json` to SharedPreferences before saving or falsely set `fxBakeRequired = true` (which previously aborted `StreamingEncoder` and ran a full-file 4-stage DSP bake before enqueueing the conversion job).
     * Captured `MainActivity` reference before `exitStudio()` in `runSaveDispatch()` and invoked `hostAct.refreshLibraryIfShown()` on completion for both adopted and background saves.
   - TakesRepository.java & LibraryFragment.java & MainActivity.java:
     * Added `TakesRepository.Listener` (`addListener`, `removeListener`, `fireChanged()`) fired on `addRecording`, `addTake`, and `deleteImmediateForReplace`.
     * Registered `repoListener` in `LibraryFragment.onResume()`/`onPause()` to trigger `refreshImmediate()` the instant a saved take is added to `TakesRepository`.
     * Made `MainActivity.refreshLibraryIfShown()` package-private and checked `f.isAdded()` so post-transition refreshes never miss.
   - ConversionJobs.java:
     * In `dispatchSave()`, when `e.isFxBakeRequired()` is true, enqueued the `ConversionJob` into `ACTIVE` before running `EditEngine.applyDspToRange()` so the converting card appears in the Library at 0% immediately.

2. Effects Tab Paywall (Weekly, Monthly, Yearly + 7-Day Free Trial):
   - TrialAndBillingManager.java:
     * Updated `TRIAL_DAYS = 7` (`TRIAL_DURATION_MS = 7 days`) and `trialDaysRemaining()` cap from 14 to 7 days.
     * Added `SKU_WEEKLY = "takeone_pro_weekly"`, `SKU_MONTHLY = "takeone_pro_monthly"`, and `SKU_YEARLY = "takeone_pro_yearly"` subscription structures.
     * Updated `showPaywallSheet()` to present Yearly, Monthly, and Weekly subscription options with a 7-day free trial callout, and updated `launchPurchase()` to select the free-trial offer token when available.
   - StudioFragment.java:
     * Gated the Effects (`btnDspFx`) tab with `TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(requireActivity(), "Effects", null)` while leaving core recording/editing tools (Teleprompter, Replace, Select & Replace, Trim) directly accessible.

/**

 *
 * Flow: open -> name modal (no recording yet) -> tap mic to start (FAB morphs
 * into pause/play + split stop) -> stop asks save/discard -> convert to the
 * chosen preset with a live progress bar -> back to the library.

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback teleFrameCallback = new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
        @Override
        public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
            if (!isAdded() || getView() == null || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) {
                lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
                return;
            }
            advanceTeleprompterFrame(frameTimeNanos);
            if (!telePaused && tele != null && tele.autoScroll
                    && telePanel != null && telePanel.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
                scheduleTeleFrame();
            }
        }
    };

    private void scheduleTeleFrame() {
        if (teleChoreographerActive || telePaused || namingModalOpen || fxPanelOpen) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
            teleChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            teleChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelTeleFrame() {
        teleChoreographerActive = false;
        lastTeleFrameNanos = 0L;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(teleFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    // ---- 60 FPS waveform / preview VSYNC driver ----
    private boolean waveChoreographerActive;

    private final Choreographer.FrameCallback waveFrameCallback =
            new Choreographer.FrameCallback() {
                @Override
                public void doFrame(long frameTimeNanos) {
                    waveChoreographerActive = false;
                    if (!isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
                    try {
                        boolean live = engine.state
                                == RecordingEngine.State.RECORDING;
                        boolean preview = studioPreviewPlayer != null;
                        if (live) {
                            long cur = engine.liveInterpolatedFrames();
                            if (cur > 0 && cur != lastPushedCursorFrame) {
                                lastPushedCursorFrame = cur;
                                waveform.updateLiveFromFrames(
                                        engine.lastSmoothedPeak(), cur,
                                        replaceTargetEndFrame);
                            }
                        } else if (preview) {
                            long total = previewPlaysRenderedFx
                                    && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0
                                    ? fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames
                                    : Math.max(1L, engine.totalFrames());
                            waveform.setPlayheadFraction(Math.min(1f,
                                    studioPreviewPlayer.positionFrames()
                                            / (float) total));
                        }
                        if ((live || preview) && getView() != null) {
                            scheduleWaveFrame();
                        }
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                }
            };

    private void scheduleWaveFrame() {
        if (waveChoreographerActive || !isAdded() || getView() == null) return;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
            waveChoreographerActive = true;
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            waveChoreographerActive = false;
        }
    }

    private void cancelWaveFrame() {
        waveChoreographerActive = false;
        try {
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(waveFrameCallback);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

        saveFormat = SaveFormat.load(requireContext());

                .getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);

        v.findViewById(R.id.backBtn).setOnClickListener(view -> onBackPressed());
        PressAnim.apply(v.findViewById(R.id.backBtn));

        attachRenameGestures(takeNameView);
        attachRenameGestures(statusText);

        settingsRow.setOnClickListener(view -> showRecordingSettings());
        // Soft variant: plain apply() resets alpha to 1 on release, which
        // would wipe the converting dim. applySoft only touches scale.
        PressAnim.applySoft(settingsRow, 0.97f);
        if (formatBadge != null) {
            formatBadge.setOnClickListener(view -> showRecordingSettings());
        }
        teleEditBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> openTeleEditor());
        PressAnim.applySoft(teleEditBtn, 0.95f);
        telePauseBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> toggleTelePaused());
        PressAnim.applySoft(telePauseBtn, 0.95f);
        teleMirrorBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> {
            tele = TeleSettings.load(requireContext());
            TeleSettings.toggleMirror(requireContext(), !tele.mirror);
            applyTeleSettings();
            paintTeleMirror();
        });
        PressAnim.applySoft(teleMirrorBtn, 0.95f);
        // Vertical drag on the waveform zooms, like a timeline in a DAW.
        waveform.setOnZoomGesture((dir, dy) -> stepZoom(dir > 0 ? 1 : -1));
        // Touching the script lets the performer scrub it by hand. The view
        // itself tracks the active drag (TeleprompterView.isDragging), so a
        // tap never pauses scrolling and auto-scroll resumes on finger lift.
        initTeleprompter();
        initTeleValueControls();

        editorStrip = v.findViewById(R.id.editorStrip);
        btnPreviewPlay = v.findViewById(R.id.btnPreviewPlay);
        btnSelectRange = v.findViewById(R.id.btnSelectRange);
        btnReplaceSeg = v.findViewById(R.id.btnReplaceSeg);
        btnTrimCrop = v.findViewById(R.id.btnTrimCrop);
        btnCutDelete = v.findViewById(R.id.btnCutDelete);
        btnDspFx = v.findViewById(R.id.btnDspFx);
        btnEditUndo = v.findViewById(R.id.btnEditUndo);
        btnEditRedo = v.findViewById(R.id.btnEditRedo);

        fxPanel = v.findViewById(R.id.fxPanel);
        fxTitle = v.findViewById(R.id.fxTitle);
        fxPresetDropdown = v.findViewById(R.id.fxPresetDropdown);
        fxCloseBtn = v.findViewById(R.id.fxCloseBtn);
        fxListContainer = v.findViewById(R.id.fxListContainer);
        fxHint = v.findViewById(R.id.fxHint);

        dspConfig = DspChain.Config.load(requireContext());
        dspBakedToRaw = false;
        dspSubRangeBaked = false;
        lastEditWasSubRangeBake = false;
        undoJournal = new EditEngine.UndoJournal(RecordingEngine.takesDir(requireContext()));
        subEditorUndoJournal = new EditEngine.UndoJournal(
                new File(RecordingEngine.takesDir(requireContext()), "sub_undo"));

        if (btnCutDelete != null) {
            btnCutDelete.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        // 1) "Replace" Mode Toggle Button (btnPreviewPlay):
        //    Pure toggle: pressing once selects Replace (red pill, main FAB
        //    morphs to Mic icon) and locks all other editing options; pressing
        //    again deselects Replace and re-enables the other editing options.
        if (btnPreviewPlay != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnPreviewPlay, 0.95f);
            btnPreviewPlay.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();
                replaceModeArmed = !replaceModeArmed;
                if (replaceModeArmed) {
                    if (waveform != null) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();
                        waveform.setSelectionLocked(true);
                    }
                    if (fxPanelOpen) {
                        setFxPanelVisible(false);
                    }
                    RawFloatPlayer.releaseWarmSpeaker();
                } else {
                    if (waveform != null) {
                        waveform.setSelectionLocked(false);
                    }
                    RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                }
                paintEditorStrip();
                paintFxPanelControls();
                syncStudioFabIcon();
            });
        }

        // 2) "Select" Button: stays labeled "Select", simply turns red when active
        //    (does NOT activate Select & Replace, and is blocked while Replace is on)
        if (btnSelectRange != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnSelectRange, 0.95f);
            btnSelectRange.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                stopStudioPreview();
                if (fxPanelOpen) {
                    // Select stays live in effects mode so a noise profile
                    // can be learned from a sub-range, but the handles are
                    // clamped to the frozen apply target. Tapping again puts
                    // the full target back once the sub-selection is gone.
                    if (waveform.hasSelection()) {
                        waveform.clearSelection();
                    } else {
                        waveform.selectRange(fxApplyTargetStart,
                                fxApplyTargetEnd);
                    }
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                } else {
                    waveform.toggleSelectionAtPlayhead();
                    paintEditorStrip();
                }
            });
        }

        // 3) "Select & Replace" Button: opens dedicated sub-editor configuration
        if (btnReplaceSeg != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnReplaceSeg, 0.95f);
            btnReplaceSeg.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                openSelectAndReplaceSubEditor();
            });
        }

        // 4) "Trim" Button: opens stylized Keep Selected / Delete Selected popup
        if (btnTrimCrop != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnTrimCrop, 0.95f);
            btnTrimCrop.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                showTrimOptionsPopup();
            });
        }

        // 5) "FX" Button: opens inline Pro FX window in place of Teleprompter
        if (btnDspFx != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnDspFx, 0.95f);
            btnDspFx.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (replaceModeArmed) return;
                if (!TrialAndBillingManager.requireProOrShowPaywall(
                        requireActivity(), "Effects", null)) {
                    return;
                }
                toggleFxPanel();
            });
        }

        // 6) "Undo" & "Redo" Buttons
        if (btnEditUndo != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnEditUndo, 0.95f);
            btnEditUndo.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                performStudioUndo();
            });
        }
        if (btnEditRedo != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(btnEditRedo, 0.95f);
            btnEditRedo.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                if (replaceModeArmed || fxPanelOpen) return;
                if (!ensurePausedForEditing()) return;
                performStudioRedo();
            });
        }

        if (fxCloseBtn != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxCloseBtn, 0.95f);
            fxCloseBtn.setOnClickListener(view -> setFxPanelVisible(false));
        }
        if (fxPresetDropdown != null) {
            PressAnim.applySoft(fxPresetDropdown, 0.95f);
            fxPresetDropdown.setOnClickListener(view -> showFxPresetsMenu());
        }
        waveform.setTimelineListener(new WaveformView.TimelineListener() {
            @Override
            public void onScrollStarted() {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                RawFloatPlayer.warmUpSpeaker(engine.channels);
                engine.warmUpMic(requireContext(), preset.audioSource, engine.channels);
            }

            @Override
            public void onPlayheadScrubbed(int bucketIndex, float fraction) {
                if (!isSessionEditable()) return;
                if (studioPreviewPlayer != null || fxPreviewPreparing) {
                    stopStudioPreview();
                }
                if (fxPanelOpen && fxRenderedPreviewWaveLoaded
                        && fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames > 0) {
                    fxPreviewPlayheadFrame = Math.max(
                            fxRenderedPreviewStartFrame,
                            Math.min(fxRenderedPreviewEndFrame,
                                    Math.round(fraction * fxRenderedPreviewTotalFrames)));
                    float rStart = waveform.fxRegionStartFraction();
                    float rEnd = Math.max(rStart + 1e-5f,
                            waveform.fxRegionEndFraction());
                    float rel = Math.max(0f,
                            Math.min(1f, (fraction - rStart) / (rEnd - rStart)));
                    long rawTotal = engine.totalFrames();
                    long rawStart = Math.round(fxApplyTargetStart * rawTotal);
                    long rawEnd = Math.round(fxApplyTargetEnd * rawTotal);
                    long mappedRaw = rawStart + Math.round(rel * (rawEnd - rawStart));
                    engine.seekCursorFrame(
                            Math.max(0L, Math.min(rawTotal, mappedRaw)));
                    userScrolledWhilePaused = true;
                    timerText.setText(formatTimer(
                            fxPreviewPlayheadFrame * 1000L
                                    / RecordingEngine.SAMPLE_RATE));
                    paintEditorStrip();
                    paintFxPanelControls();
                    return;
                }
                long totalFrames = engine.totalFrames();
                long targetFrame = Math.round(fraction * totalFrames);
                // Never disarm replaceModeArmed while scrubbing! If the user
                // enabled Replace at the end of the take and starts dragging
                // back, the initial move events are near 1.0f and must keep
                // Replace armed.
                //
                // The playhead is NEVER snapped forward here: the timer must
                // show the real scrubbed position. At low zoom a short drag
                // covers many buckets, so forcing targetFrame = totalFrames as
                // soon as the drag came within 480 frames of the end made the
